		private static ServerViewProperty[] FillDefaultPropertiesIfNotProvided(XPClassInfo ci, ServerViewProperty[] providedProperties)
		{
			if (providedProperties != null && providedProperties.Length != 0)
			{
				return providedProperties;
			}
			return GetDefaultProperties(ci);
		}

		private static ServerViewProperty[] GetDefaultProperties(XPClassInfo ci)
		{
			//IL_0097: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a1: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<ServerViewProperty> list = new List<ServerViewProperty>();
			IEnumerable<XPMemberInfo> enumerable = ci.PersistentProperties.Cast<XPMemberInfo>().Union(ci.Members.Where((XPMemberInfo t) => t.IsAliased));
			foreach (XPMemberInfo item in enumerable)
			{
				if (!item.IsKey && !(item is ServiceField))
				{
					string name = ((!(item.FindAttributeInfo(typeof(DisplayNameAttribute)) is DisplayNameAttribute displayNameAttribute)) ? item.Name : displayNameAttribute.DisplayName);
					list.Add(new ServerViewProperty(name, SortDirection.None, (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(item.Name)));
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public XPInstantFeedbackView(XPClassInfo classInfo, ServerViewProperty[] properties, CriteriaOperator fixedCriteria, EventHandler<ResolveSessionEventArgs> resolveSession, EventHandler<ResolveSessionEventArgs> dismissSession)

		}

		private static EventHandler<T> ToEventHandler<T>(Action<T> action) where T : EventArgs
		{
			if (action == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return delegate(object sender, T e)
			{
				action(e);
			};
		}

		private XPDictionary GetDesignDictionary()
		{
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				return XPInstantViewDesignTimeWrapper.GetDesignDictionary(Site);
			}
			return XpoDefault.GetDictionary();
		}

		IList IListSource.GetList()
		{
			if (_List == null)
			{
				if (IsDisposed)
				{
					throw new ObjectDisposedException(ToString());
				}
				if (IsDesignMode)
				{
					_List = (_DTWrapper = CreateDesignTimeWrapper());
				}
				else
				{
					_List = (IList)(_AsyncListServer = GetRunTimeProxy());
				}
			}
			return _List;
		}

		private XPInstantViewDesignTimeWrapper CreateDesignTimeWrapper()
		{
			ServerViewPropertiesCollection serverViewPropertiesCollection = Properties;
			if (serverViewPropertiesCollection.Count == 0 && ObjectType != null)
			{
				XPClassInfo designClassInfo = GetDesignClassInfo();
				if (designClassInfo != null)
				{
					serverViewPropertiesCollection = new ServerViewPropertiesCollection();
					serverViewPropertiesCollection.AddRange(GetDefaultProperties(designClassInfo));
				}
			}
			return new XPInstantViewDesignTimeWrapper(Site, ObjectType, serverViewPropertiesCollection);
		}

		private AsyncListServer2DatacontrollerProxy GetRunTimeProxy()
		{
			XPAsyncListServerCore xPAsyncListServerCore = CreateRuntimeCore();
			((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).ListServerGet = (EventHandler<ListServerGetOrFreeEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).ListServerGet, new EventHandler<ListServerGetOrFreeEventArgs>(listServerGet));
			((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).ListServerFree = (EventHandler<ListServerGetOrFreeEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).ListServerFree, new EventHandler<ListServerGetOrFreeEventArgs>(listServerFree));
			((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetTypeInfo = (EventHandler<GetTypeInfoEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetTypeInfo, new EventHandler<GetTypeInfoEventArgs>(getTypeInfo));
			((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetPropertyDescriptors = (EventHandler<GetPropertyDescriptorsEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetPropertyDescriptors, new EventHandler<GetPropertyDescriptorsEventArgs>(getPropertyDescriptors));
			((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetWorkerThreadRowInfo = (EventHandler<GetWorkerThreadRowInfoEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetWorkerThreadRowInfo, new EventHandler<GetWorkerThreadRowInfoEventArgs>(getWorkerRowInfo));
			((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetUIThreadRow = (EventHandler<GetUIThreadRowEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetUIThreadRow, new EventHandler<GetUIThreadRowEventArgs>(getUIRow));
			return CreateRuntimeProxy(xPAsyncListServerCore);
		}

		private void listServerGet(object sender, ListServerGetOrFreeEventArgs e)
		{
			ResolveSessionEventArgs e2 = new ResolveSessionEventArgs();
			listServerViewGetTag listServerViewGetTag = new listServerViewGetTag();
			listServerViewGetTag.Args = e2;
			e.Tag = listServerViewGetTag;
			if (this.ResolveSession != null)
			{
				this.ResolveSession(this, e2);
			}
			Session session = null;
			if (e2.Session != null)
			{
				session = e2.Session.Session;
			}
			if (session == null)
			{
				session = (listServerViewGetTag.OurSession = new Session(serviceProvider));
			}
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = null;
			session.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(ObjectType);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_TypeName))
			{
				xPClassInfo = session.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(_AssemblyName, _TypeName);
			}
			if (xPClassInfo == null)
			{
				xPClassInfo = session.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(ObjectType);
			}
			if (xPClassInfo == null)
			{
				xPClassInfo = session.GetClassInfo<PersistentBase>();
			}
			e.ListServerSource = (listServerViewGetTag.View = new XPServerModeView(session, xPClassInfo, FixedFilterCriteria));
			listServerViewGetTag.View.Properties.AddRangeAsCopy(Properties);
		}

		private void listServerFree(object sender, ListServerGetOrFreeEventArgs e)
		{
			listServerViewGetTag listServerViewGetTag = (listServerViewGetTag)e.Tag;
			if (listServerViewGetTag.OurSession != null)
			{
				listServerViewGetTag.OurSession.Dispose();
			}
			if (this.DismissSession != null)
			{
				this.DismissSession(this, listServerViewGetTag.Args);
			}
		}

		private void getTypeInfo(object sender, GetTypeInfoEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0113: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PropertyDescriptorCollection listItemProperties = ListBindingHelper.GetListItemProperties(e.ListServerSource);
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list2 = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			string[] array = new string[0];
			if (Properties.Count > 0)
			{
				array = (from ServerViewProperty t in Properties
					select t.Name into t
					where !string.IsNullOrEmpty(t)
					select t).Distinct().ToArray();
			}
			else if (ObjectType != null)
			{
				ReflectionDictionary reflectionDictionary = new ReflectionDictionary();
				XPClassInfo classInfo = reflectionDictionary.GetClassInfo(ObjectType);
				array = (from t in GetDefaultProperties(classInfo)
					select t.Name).ToArray();
			}
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string name in array2)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = listItemProperties.Find(name, ignoreCase: false);
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 = XPInstantViewDesignTimeWrapper.GetMessagingDescriptorIfUnsafe(name, propertyDescriptor);
				if (propertyDescriptor2 == null)
				{
					propertyDescriptor2 = (PropertyDescriptor)new ReadonlyThreadSafeProxyForObjectFromAnotherThreadPropertyDescriptor(propertyDescriptor, list.Count);
				}
				list2.Add(propertyDescriptor2);
				if (propertyDescriptor != null)
				{
					list.Add(propertyDescriptor);
				}
			}
			e.TypeInfo = new PropertyDescriptorCollection[2]
			{
				new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list2.ToArray(), readOnly: true),
				new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray(), readOnly: true)
			};
		}

		private void getWorkerRowInfo(object sender, GetWorkerThreadRowInfoEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			object workerThreadRow = e.WorkerThreadRow;
			List<object> list = new List<object>();

				list.Add(item.GetValue(workerThreadRow));
			}
			e.RowInfo = (object)new ReadonlyThreadSafeProxyForObjectFromAnotherThread(workerThreadRow, list.ToArray());
		}

		private void getUIRow(object sender, GetUIThreadRowEventArgs e)

			e.UIThreadRow = e.RowInfo;

		private void TestCanChangeProperties()
		{
			if (_AsyncListServer != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Async_CanChangeViewProperties"));
			}
		}

		public void PopulateProperties()
		{
			if (!(ObjectType == null))
			{
				XPClassInfo designClassInfo = GetDesignClassInfo();
				if (designClassInfo != null)
				{
					Properties.Clear();
					Properties.AddRange(GetDefaultProperties(designClassInfo));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ForceCatchUp()
		{
			if (_DTWrapper != null)
			{
				_DTWrapper.ElementType = ObjectType;
				_DTWrapper.Properties.Clear();
				_DTWrapper.Properties.AddRangeAsCopy(Properties);
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			IsDisposed = true;
			_List = null;
			_DTWrapper = null;
			if (_AsyncListServer != null)
			{
				_AsyncListServer.Dispose();
				_AsyncListServer = null;
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public void Refresh()
		{
			if (_AsyncListServer != null)
			{
				_AsyncListServer.Refresh(new DictionaryEntry[0]);
			}
		}

		object IDXCloneable.DXClone()
		{
			return DXClone();
		}

		protected virtual object DXClone()
		{
			XPInstantFeedbackView xPInstantFeedbackView = DXCloneCreate();
			xPInstantFeedbackView._AssemblyName = _AssemblyName;
			xPInstantFeedbackView.Properties.AddRangeAsCopy(Properties);
			xPInstantFeedbackView._ElementType = _ElementType;
			xPInstantFeedbackView._FixedFilter = _FixedFilter;
			xPInstantFeedbackView._TypeName = _TypeName;
			xPInstantFeedbackView.IsDisposed = IsDisposed;
			xPInstantFeedbackView.ResolveSession = this.ResolveSession;
			xPInstantFeedbackView.DismissSession = this.DismissSession;
			return xPInstantFeedbackView;
		}

		protected virtual XPInstantFeedbackView DXCloneCreate()
		{
			return new XPInstantFeedbackView(serviceProvider);
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public object ExtractOriginalRow(object uiThreadRow)
		{
			return ReadonlyThreadSafeProxyForObjectFromAnotherThread.ExtractOriginalRow(uiThreadRow);
		}

		private XPClassInfo GetDesignClassInfo()
		{
			XPDictionary designDictionary = GetDesignDictionary();
			designDictionary.QueryClassInfo(ObjectType);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_TypeName))
			{
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = designDictionary.QueryClassInfo(_AssemblyName, _TypeName);
				if (xPClassInfo != null)
				{
					return xPClassInfo;
				}
			}
			return designDictionary.QueryClassInfo(ObjectType);
		}
	}

		private static EventHandler<T> ToEventHandler<T>(Action<T> action) where T : EventArgs
		{
			if (action == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return delegate(object sender, T e)
			{
				action(e);
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDisplayableProperties()
		{
			return DisplayableProperties != GetDefaultDisplayableProperties();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDefaultSorting()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(DefaultSorting);
		}

		private XPDictionary GetDesignDictionary()
		{
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				return XPInstantListDesignTimeWrapper.GetDesignDictionary(Site);
			}
			return XpoDefault.GetDictionary();
		}

		private string GetDefaultDisplayableProperties()
		{
			return GetDefaultDisplayableProperties(GetDesignClassInfo());
		}

		private static string GetDefaultDisplayableProperties(XPClassInfo ci)
		{
			if (ci == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return string.Join(";", XPInstantListDesignTimeWrapper.GetDefaultDisplayableProperties(ci));
		}

		IList IListSource.GetList()
		{
			if (_List == null)
			{
				if (IsDisposed)
				{
					throw new ObjectDisposedException(ToString());
				}
				if (IsDesignMode)
				{
					_List = (_DTWrapper = CreateDesignTimeWrapper());
				}
				else
				{
					_List = (IList)(_AsyncListServer = GetRunTimeProxy());
				}
			}
			return _List;
		}

		private XPInstantListDesignTimeWrapper CreateDesignTimeWrapper()
		{
			return new XPInstantListDesignTimeWrapper(Site, ObjectType, DisplayableProperties);
		}

		private AsyncListServer2DatacontrollerProxy GetRunTimeProxy()
		{
			XPAsyncListServerCore xPAsyncListServerCore = CreateRuntimeCore();
			((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).ListServerGet = (EventHandler<ListServerGetOrFreeEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).ListServerGet, new EventHandler<ListServerGetOrFreeEventArgs>(listServerGet));
			((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).ListServerFree = (EventHandler<ListServerGetOrFreeEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).ListServerFree, new EventHandler<ListServerGetOrFreeEventArgs>(listServerFree));
			((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetTypeInfo = (EventHandler<GetTypeInfoEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetTypeInfo, new EventHandler<GetTypeInfoEventArgs>(getTypeInfo));
			((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetPropertyDescriptors = (EventHandler<GetPropertyDescriptorsEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetPropertyDescriptors, new EventHandler<GetPropertyDescriptorsEventArgs>(getPropertyDescriptors));
			((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetWorkerThreadRowInfo = (EventHandler<GetWorkerThreadRowInfoEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetWorkerThreadRowInfo, new EventHandler<GetWorkerThreadRowInfoEventArgs>(getWorkerRowInfo));
			((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetUIThreadRow = (EventHandler<GetUIThreadRowEventArgs>)Delegate.Combine(((AsyncListServerCore)xPAsyncListServerCore).GetUIThreadRow, new EventHandler<GetUIThreadRowEventArgs>(getUIRow));
			return CreateRuntimeProxy(xPAsyncListServerCore);
		}

		protected virtual AsyncListServer2DatacontrollerProxy CreateRuntimeProxy(XPAsyncListServerCore core)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new AsyncListServer2DatacontrollerProxy((IAsyncListServer)(object)core);
		}

		protected virtual XPAsyncListServerCore CreateRuntimeCore()
		{
			return new XPAsyncListServerCore(null);
		}

		private void listServerGet(object sender, ListServerGetOrFreeEventArgs e)
		{
			ResolveSessionEventArgs e2 = new ResolveSessionEventArgs();
			listServerGetTag listServerGetTag = new listServerGetTag();
			listServerGetTag.Args = e2;
			e.Tag = listServerGetTag;
			if (this.ResolveSession != null)
			{
				this.ResolveSession(this, e2);
			}
			Session session = null;
			if (e2.Session != null)
			{
				session = e2.Session.Session;
			}
			if (session == null)
			{
				session = (listServerGetTag.OurSession = new Session(serviceProvider));
			}
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = null;
			session.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(ObjectType);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_TypeName))
			{
				xPClassInfo = session.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(_AssemblyName, _TypeName);
			}
			if (xPClassInfo == null)
			{
				xPClassInfo = session.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(ObjectType);
			}
			if (xPClassInfo == null)
			{
				xPClassInfo = session.GetClassInfo<PersistentBase>();
			}
			e.ListServerSource = (listServerGetTag.Src = new XPServerCollectionSource(session, xPClassInfo, FixedFilterCriteria));
			listServerGetTag.Src.DisplayableProperties = DisplayableProperties;
			listServerGetTag.Src.DefaultSorting = DefaultSorting;
		}

		private void listServerFree(object sender, ListServerGetOrFreeEventArgs e)
		{
			listServerGetTag listServerGetTag = (listServerGetTag)e.Tag;
			if (listServerGetTag.OurSession != null)
			{
				listServerGetTag.OurSession.Dispose();
			}
			if (this.DismissSession != null)
			{
				this.DismissSession(this, listServerGetTag.Args);
			}
		}

		private void getTypeInfo(object sender, GetTypeInfoEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0089: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0090: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PropertyDescriptorCollection listItemProperties = ListBindingHelper.GetListItemProperties(e.ListServerSource);
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list2 = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (string item in (from s in DisplayableProperties.Split(';')
				where !string.IsNullOrEmpty(s)
				select s).Distinct())
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = listItemProperties.Find(item, ignoreCase: false);
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 = XPInstantListDesignTimeWrapper.GetMessagingDescriptorIfUnsafe(item, propertyDescriptor);
				if (propertyDescriptor2 == null)
				{
					propertyDescriptor2 = (PropertyDescriptor)new ReadonlyThreadSafeProxyForObjectFromAnotherThreadPropertyDescriptor(propertyDescriptor, list.Count);
				}
				list2.Add(propertyDescriptor2);
				if (propertyDescriptor != null)
				{
					list.Add(propertyDescriptor);
				}
			}
			e.TypeInfo = new PropertyDescriptorCollection[2]
			{
				new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list2.ToArray(), readOnly: true),
				new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray(), readOnly: true)
			};
		}

		private void getPropertyDescriptors(object sender, GetPropertyDescriptorsEventArgs e)
		{
			e.PropertyDescriptors = ((PropertyDescriptorCollection[])e.TypeInfo)[0];
		}

		private void getWorkerRowInfo(object sender, GetWorkerThreadRowInfoEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			object workerThreadRow = e.WorkerThreadRow;
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			PropertyDescriptorCollection propertyDescriptorCollection = ((PropertyDescriptorCollection[])e.TypeInfo)[1];
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in propertyDescriptorCollection)
			{
				list.Add(item.GetValue(workerThreadRow));
			}
			e.RowInfo = (object)new ReadonlyThreadSafeProxyForObjectFromAnotherThread(workerThreadRow, list.ToArray());
		}

		private void getUIRow(object sender, GetUIThreadRowEventArgs e)
		{
			e.UIThreadRow = e.RowInfo;
		}

		private void TestCanChangeProperties()
		{
			if (_AsyncListServer != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Async_CanChangeProperties"));
			}
		}

		private void ForceCatchUp()
		{
			if (_DTWrapper != null)
			{
				_DTWrapper.ElementType = ObjectType;
				_DTWrapper.DisplayableProperties = DisplayableProperties;
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			IsDisposed = true;
			_List = null;
			_DTWrapper = null;
			if (_AsyncListServer != null)
			{
				_AsyncListServer.Dispose();
				_AsyncListServer = null;
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public void Refresh()
		{
			if (_AsyncListServer != null)
			{
				_AsyncListServer.Refresh(new DictionaryEntry[0]);
			}
		}

		object IDXCloneable.DXClone()
		{
			return DXClone();
		}

		protected virtual object DXClone()
		{
			XPInstantFeedbackSource xPInstantFeedbackSource = DXCloneCreate();
			xPInstantFeedbackSource._AssemblyName = _AssemblyName;
			xPInstantFeedbackSource._DefaultSorting = _DefaultSorting;
			xPInstantFeedbackSource._DisplayableProperties = _DisplayableProperties;
			xPInstantFeedbackSource._ElementType = _ElementType;
			xPInstantFeedbackSource._FixedFilter = _FixedFilter;
			xPInstantFeedbackSource._TypeName = _TypeName;
			xPInstantFeedbackSource.IsDisposed = IsDisposed;
			xPInstantFeedbackSource.ResolveSession = this.ResolveSession;
			xPInstantFeedbackSource.DismissSession = this.DismissSession;
			return xPInstantFeedbackSource;
		}

		protected virtual XPInstantFeedbackSource DXCloneCreate()
		{
			return new XPInstantFeedbackSource(serviceProvider);
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public object ExtractOriginalRow(object uiThreadRow)
		{
			return ReadonlyThreadSafeProxyForObjectFromAnotherThread.ExtractOriginalRow(uiThreadRow);
		}

		private XPClassInfo GetDesignClassInfo()
		{
			XPDictionary designDictionary = GetDesignDictionary();
			designDictionary.QueryClassInfo(ObjectType);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_TypeName))
			{
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = designDictionary.QueryClassInfo(_AssemblyName, _TypeName);
				if (xPClassInfo != null)
				{
					return xPClassInfo;
				}
			}
			return designDictionary.QueryClassInfo(ObjectType);
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property | AttributeTargets.Field, Inherited = true)]
	public sealed class ValueConverterAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private Type converterType;

		private ValueConverter converter;

		[Description("Gets the converter’s type.")]
		public Type ConverterType
		{
			get
			{
				return converterType;
			}
			set
			{
				converterType = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the value converter.")]
		public ValueConverter Converter
		{
			get
			{
				if (converter == null)
				{
					converter = (ValueConverter)Activator.CreateInstance(ConverterType);
				}
				return converter;
			}
		}

		public ValueConverterAttribute(Type converterType)
		{
			this.converterType = converterType;
		}

		private ValueConverterAttribute(XmlNode attributeNode)
		{
			if (attributeNode.Attributes["ConverterType"] != null)
			{
				converterType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownUserType(attributeNode.Attributes["ConverterType"].Value, false);
			}
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property | AttributeTargets.Field, Inherited = true)]
	public sealed class NullValueAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private object value;

		[Description("Gets or sets a null value for a property or a field.")]
		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return value;
			}
			set
			{
				this.value = value;
			}
		}

		public NullValueAttribute(object value)
		{
			this.value = value;
		}

		public NullValueAttribute(byte value)
			: this((object)value)
		{
		}

		public NullValueAttribute(short value)
			: this((object)value)
		{
		}

		public NullValueAttribute(int value)
			: this((object)value)
		{
		}

		public NullValueAttribute(long value)
			: this((object)value)
		{
		}

		public NullValueAttribute(float value)
			: this((object)value)
		{
		}

		public NullValueAttribute(double value)
			: this((object)value)
		{
		}

		public NullValueAttribute(char value)
			: this((object)value)
		{
		}

		public NullValueAttribute(string value)
			: this((object)value)
		{
		}

		public NullValueAttribute(bool value)
			: this((object)value)
		{
		}

		public NullValueAttribute(Type type, string value)
		{
			try
			{
				this.value = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(type).ConvertFromInvariantString(value);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

	public sealed class OptimisticLockingAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private OptimisticLockingBehavior lockingKind;

		public const string DefaultFieldName = "OptimisticLockField";

		private string fieldName;

		[Description("Gets or sets whether optimistic locking is enabled.")]
		public bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				return lockingKind == OptimisticLockingBehavior.ConsiderOptimisticLockingField;
			}
			set
			{
				lockingKind = (value ? OptimisticLockingBehavior.ConsiderOptimisticLockingField : OptimisticLockingBehavior.NoLocking);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the name of the system field which is used to control object locking for objects that have the object locking option enabled.")]
		public string FieldName => fieldName;

		public OptimisticLockingBehavior LockingKind
		{
			get
			{
				return lockingKind;
			}
			set
			{
				lockingKind = value;
			}
		}

		public OptimisticLockingAttribute()
			: this(enabled: true)
		{
		}

		public OptimisticLockingAttribute(bool enabled)
		{
			Enabled = enabled;
			fieldName = "OptimisticLockField";
		}

		public OptimisticLockingAttribute(string fieldName)
		{
			this.fieldName = fieldName;
			Enabled = true;
		}

		public OptimisticLockingAttribute(OptimisticLockingBehavior lockingKind)
		{
			fieldName = "OptimisticLockField";
			this.lockingKind = lockingKind;
		}

		private OptimisticLockingAttribute(XmlNode attributeNode)
		{
			if (attributeNode.Attributes["Enabled"] != null)
			{
				Enabled = attributeNode.Attributes["Enabled"].Value.ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) == "true";
			}
			if (attributeNode.Attributes["FieldName"] != null)
			{
				fieldName = attributeNode.Attributes["FieldName"].Value;
			}
		}
	}

	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class, Inherited = true)]
	public sealed class IndicesAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private static char[] splitter = new char[1] { ';' };

		private IList<StringCollection> indices;

		public IList<StringCollection> Indices => indices;

		public IndicesAttribute()
			: this((string[])null)
		{
		}

		public IndicesAttribute(string index)
			: this(new string[1] { index })
		{
		}

		public IndicesAttribute(string index1, string index2)
			: this(new string[2] { index1, index2 })
		{
		}

		public IndicesAttribute(string index1, string index2, string index3)
			: this(new string[3] { index1, index2, index3 })
		{
		}

		public IndicesAttribute(params string[] indices)
		{
			if (indices == null || indices.Length == 0)
			{
				this.indices = new StringCollection[0];
				return;
			}
			List<StringCollection> list = new List<StringCollection>(indices.Length);
			foreach (string text in indices)
			{
				StringCollection stringCollection = new StringCollection();
				stringCollection.AddRange(text.Split(splitter, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries));
				list.Add(stringCollection);
			}
			this.indices = list.AsReadOnly();
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property | AttributeTargets.Field, Inherited = true)]
	public sealed class IndexedAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private bool unique;

		private string name;

		private StringCollection additionalFields = new StringCollection();

		[Description("Gets or sets whether the index created by a property or field is a unique one.")]
		public bool Unique
		{
			get
			{
				return unique;
			}
			set
			{
				unique = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the name of the index.")]
		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return name;
			}
			set
			{
				name = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the names of additional columns that affect index creation.")]
		public StringCollection AdditionalFields => additionalFields;

		private IndexedAttribute(XmlNode attributeNode)
		{
			if (attributeNode.Attributes["Unique"] != null)
			{
				unique = Convert.ToBoolean(attributeNode.Attributes["Unique"].Value);
			}
			if (attributeNode.Attributes["Name"] != null)
			{
				name = attributeNode.Attributes["Name"].Value;
			}
			XmlNode xmlNode = null;
			foreach (XmlNode childNode in attributeNode.ChildNodes)
			{
				if (childNode.Name == "AdditionalFields")
				{
					xmlNode = childNode;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (xmlNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XmlNode childNode2 in xmlNode.ChildNodes)
			{
				if (childNode2.Name == "string")
				{
					additionalFields.Add(childNode2.InnerText);
				}
			}
		}

		public IndexedAttribute(string additionalFields)
			: this(additionalFields.Split(';'))
		{
		}

		public IndexedAttribute()
		{
			unique = false;
		}

		public IndexedAttribute(params string[] additionalFields)
		{
			unique = false;
			this.additionalFields.AddRange(additionalFields);
		}

		public IndexedAttribute(string additionalField1, string additionalField2)
			: this(new string[2] { additionalField1, additionalField2 })
		{
		}

		public IndexedAttribute(string additionalField1, string additionalField2, string additionalField3)
			: this(new string[3] { additionalField1, additionalField2, additionalField3 })
		{
		}
	}

				dbDefaultValue = attributeNode.Attributes["DbDefaultValue"].Value;
			}
		}

	[ListBindable(BindableSupport.No)]
	[Editor("DevExpress.Xpo.Design.SortingCollectionEditor, DevExpress.Xpo.v23.2.Design, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public sealed class SortingCollection : IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, IEnumerable<SortProperty>
	{
		private List<SortProperty> list = new List<SortProperty>();

		private EventHandler changed;

		public SortProperty this[int index] => list[index];

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => false;

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => false;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return ((IList)list)[index];
			}
			set
			{
				((IList)list)[index] = value;
				FireChanded();
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the number of elements contained within the collection.")]
		public int Count => list.Count;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => false;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => ((ICollection)list).SyncRoot;

		[EditorBrowsable]
		public event EventHandler Changed
		{
			add
			{
				changed = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(changed, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				changed = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(changed, value);
			}
		}

		public SortingCollection()
		{
		}

		public SortingCollection(params SortProperty[] sortProperties)
		{
			if (sortProperties != null)
			{
				AddRange(sortProperties);
			}
		}

		public SortingCollection(object owner, params SortProperty[] sortProperties)
			: this(sortProperties)
		{
		}

		public void AddRange(SortProperty[] sortProperties)
		{
			foreach (SortProperty val in sortProperties)
			{
				if (val != null)
				{
					list.Add(val);
				}
			}
			FireChanded();
		}

		public void Add(SortingCollection sortProperties)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			foreach (SortProperty sortProperty in sortProperties)
			{
				SortProperty item = sortProperty;
				list.Add(item);
			}
			FireChanded();
		}

		public void Add(SortProperty sortProperty)
		{
			list.Add(sortProperty);
			FireChanded();
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			int result = ((IList)list).Add(value);
			FireChanded();
			return result;
		}

		private void FireChanded()
		{
			if (changed != null)
			{
				changed(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			list.Clear();
			FireChanded();
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return ((IList)list).Contains(value);
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			return ((IList)list).IndexOf(value);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			((IList)list).Insert(index, value);
			FireChanded();
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			((IList)list).Remove(value);
			FireChanded();
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			((IList)list).RemoveAt(index);
			FireChanded();
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			((ICollection)list).CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return list.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator<SortProperty> IEnumerable<SortProperty>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return list.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				if (ObjectClassInfo == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ObjectClassInfo.ClassType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!Initializing && !base.IsDesignMode2)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Collections_CannotAssignProperty", "ObjectType", GetType().Name));
				}
				objectType = value;
				InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged, null, -1);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the metadata information that describes the type of objects stored in the current collection.")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]

		{
			get
			{
				return GetObjectClassInfo();

			set
			{
				if (!Initializing && !base.IsDesignMode2)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Collections_CannotAssignProperty", "ObjectClassInfo", GetType().Name));
				}
				if (Helper.ObjectClassInfo != value)
				{
					Helper.ObjectClassInfo = value;
					objectType = null;
					if (!Initializing)
					{
						base.Sorting.Clear();
						_Criteria = null;
						Clear();
						base.DisplayableProperties = null;
					}
					InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged, null, -1);
				}
			}
		}

	public enum PersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehavior
	{
		BeforeTransaction,

	[Designer("DevExpress.Xpo.Design.XPCollectionDesigner, DevExpress.Xpo.v23.2.Design, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.ComponentModel.Design.IDesigner, System, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089")]
	public abstract class XPBaseCollection : Component, IBindingList, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ITypedList, ISupportInitialize, IXPClassInfoAndSessionProvider, IXPClassInfoProvider, IXPDictionaryProvider, ISessionProvider, IObjectLayerProvider, IDataLayerProvider, IObjectChange, IFilteredXtraBindingList, IFilteredDataSource, IXPPrefetchableAssociationList, IXPBulkLoadableCollection
	{
		private class UpdateStrategy
		{
			public XPBaseCollection collection;

			public UpdateStrategy(XPBaseCollection collection)
			{
				this.collection = collection;
			}

			public virtual void Add(object obj, int index)
			{
				collection.InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.ItemAdded, null, FixIndex(index, obj));
			}

			public virtual void Remove(object obj, int index)
			{
				collection.InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.ItemDeleted, null, FixIndex(index, obj));
			}

			public virtual void Change(object obj, string propertyName, int index)
			{
				collection.InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.ItemChanged, propertyName, FixIndex(index, obj));
			}

			private int FixIndex(int index, object obj)
			{
				if (index == -1)
				{
					index = collection.Helper.ObjList.IndexOf(obj);
				}
				return index;
			}
		}

		private class FilterUpdateStrategy : UpdateStrategy
		{
			private UpdateStrategy parent;

			public FilterUpdateStrategy(UpdateStrategy parent)
				: base(parent.collection)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
			}

			public override void Add(object obj, int index)
			{
				if (IsFit(obj))
				{
					parent.Add(obj, collection.filtered.Add(obj));
				}
			}

			private bool IsFit(object obj)
			{
				return collection.IsFilterFit(obj);
			}

			public override void Remove(object obj, int index)
			{
				index = collection.filtered.IndexOf(obj);
				if (index >= 0)
				{
					collection.filtered.RemoveAt(index);
					parent.Remove(obj, index);
				}
			}

			public override void Change(object obj, string propertyName, int index)
			{
				index = collection.filtered.IndexOf(obj);
				if (index >= 0)
				{
					if (IsFit(obj))
					{
						parent.Change(obj, propertyName, index);
						return;
					}
					collection.filtered.RemoveAt(index);
					parent.Remove(obj, index);
				}
				else if (IsFit(obj))
				{
					parent.Add(obj, collection.filtered.Add(obj));
				}
			}
		}

		private class SortingUpdateStrategy : UpdateStrategy
		{
			private UpdateStrategy parent;

			public SortingUpdateStrategy(UpdateStrategy parent)
				: base(parent.collection)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
			}

			public override void Add(object obj, int index)
			{
				int index2;
				if (collection.newAdding == obj || !collection.CanFireChangedEvents)
				{
					index2 = collection.sorted.Add(obj);
				}
				else
				{
					index2 = XPCollectionCompareHelper.GetPos(collection.sortedComparer, obj, collection.sorted, -1, collection.sorted.Count);
					collection.sorted.Insert(index2, obj);
				}
				parent.Add(obj, index2);
			}

			public override void Remove(object obj, int index)
			{
				int index2 = collection.sorted.IndexOf(obj);
				collection.sorted.RemoveAt(index2);
				parent.Remove(obj, index2);
			}

			public override void Change(object obj, string propertyName, int index)
			{
				int num = collection.sorted.IndexOf(obj);
				if (collection.newAdding == null && collection.CanFireChangedEvents)
				{
					IComparer sortedComparer = collection.sortedComparer;
					int pos = XPCollectionCompareHelper.GetPos(sortedComparer, obj, collection.sorted, num, num);
					if (pos != num)
					{
						collection.sorted.RemoveAt(num);
						collection.sorted.Insert(pos, obj);
						collection.InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.ItemMoved, null, pos, num);
					}
					else
					{
						parent.Change(obj, propertyName, num);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					parent.Change(obj, propertyName, num);
				}
			}
		}

			}
		}

		private UpdateStrategy Strategy
		{
			get
			{
				if (strategy == null)
				{
					if (IsLoaded)
					{
						EnsureFilteredAndSorted();
					}
					strategy = new UpdateStrategy(this);
					if (sorted != null)
					{
						strategy = new SortingUpdateStrategy(strategy);
					}
					if (filtered != null)
					{
						strategy = new FilterUpdateStrategy(strategy);
					}
				}
				return strategy;
			}
		}

			hasChangesDuringInit = false;
		}

		{
			Clear();
			Initializing = false;

				Reset();
			}
			hasChangesDuringInit = false;
		}

		private bool IsFilterFit(object theObject)
		{
			if (newAdding == theObject)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!CanFireChangedEvents)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return validator(theObject);
		}

		private bool IsFilteringAndSortingEnsured()
		{
			if (_Filter == null == (filtered == null))
			{
				return Sorting.Count == 0 == (sorted == null);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IList EnsureFilteredAndSorted()
		{
			IList objList = Helper.ObjList;
			if (_Filter != null)
			{
				if (filtered == null)
				{
					filtered = new ObjectList();
					int count = Helper.ObjList.Count;
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						object obj = Helper.ObjList[i];
						if (IsFilterFit(obj))
						{
							filtered.Add(obj);
						}
					}
				}
				objList = filtered;
			}
			if (Sorting.Count > 0)
			{
				if (sorted == null)
				{
					sortedComparer = CreateComparer();
					if (objList.Count > 1)
					{
						ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(objList);
						arrayList.Sort(sortedComparer);
						sorted = new ObjectList(arrayList);
					}
					else
					{
						sorted = new ObjectList(objList);
					}
				}
				objList = sorted;
			}
			return objList;
		}

		private void ClearFilteredSortedStrategy()
		{
			filtered = null;
			sorted = null;
			sortedComparer = null;
			strategy = null;
		}

		protected void Clear()
		{
			_IsLoaded = false;
			_ClearCount++;
			Helper.ClearObjList();
			ClearFilteredSortedStrategy();
		}

		[Obsolete("Use InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType changeType, string propertyName, int newIndex) instead.")]
		protected virtual void InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType changeType, int newIndex)
		{
			InvokeListChanged(changeType, null, newIndex, -1);
		}

		protected virtual void InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType changeType, string propertyName, int newIndex)
		{
			if (!isOldInvokeListChangedOverriden.HasValue)
			{
				isOldInvokeListChangedOverriden = oldInvokeListChangedOverridenByType.GetOrAdd(GetType(), (Type t) => typeof(XPBaseCollection) != t.GetMethod("InvokeListChanged", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, new Type[2]
				{
					typeof(ListChangedType),
					typeof(int)
				}, null).DeclaringType);
			}
			if (isOldInvokeListChangedOverriden.Value)
			{
				InvokeListChanged(changeType, newIndex);
			}
			else
			{
				InvokeListChanged(changeType, propertyName, newIndex, -1);
			}
		}

		private void InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType changeType, string propertyName, int newIndex, int oldIndex)
		{
			if (changeType == ListChangedType.Reset)
			{
				filtered = null;
				sorted = null;
				sortedComparer = null;
				strategy = null;
			}
			if (Initializing)
			{
				hasChangesDuringInit = true;
			}
			else if (rootDesignCollection != this)
			{
				OnListChanged(changeType, propertyName, newIndex, oldIndex);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GoMuteIfNeeded()
		{
			if (SessionStateStack.IsInAnyOf(Session, SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant | SessionState.ReceivingObjectsFromNestedUow))
			{
				Session.MuteCollection(this);
			}
		}

		private void OnListChanged(ListChangedType changeType, string propertyName, int newIndex, int oldIndex)
		{
			if ((object)base.Events[EventListChanged] == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			GoMuteIfNeeded();
			if (CanFireChangedEvents || (uint)(changeType - 5) <= 2u)
			{
				ValidateBindingListChanged(changeType, newIndex, oldIndex);
				if (base.Events[EventListChanged] is ListChangedEventHandler listChangedEventHandler)
				{
					listChangedEventHandler(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(changeType, newIndex, oldIndex));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ValidateBindingListChanged(ListChangedType changeType, int newIndex, int oldIndex)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnCollectionChanged(XPCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			GoMuteIfNeeded();
			if (CanFireChangedEvents && !Initializing && (object)base.Events[EventCollectionChanged] != null)
			{
				((XPCollectionChangedEventHandler)base.Events[EventCollectionChanged])(this, args);
			}
		}

		public void SuspendChangedEvents()
		{
			suspendChangesCount++;
		}

		public void ResumeChangedEvents()
		{
			suspendChangesCount--;
			if (CanFireChangedEvents)
			{
				Reset();
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				Clear();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			isDisposed = true;
		}

		private bool CanAddNewObject()
		{
			if (GetObjectClassInfo() == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !GetObjectClassInfo().IsAbstract;
		}

		private void InitData()
		{
			_SelectDeleted = false;
			bindingBehavior = CollectionBindingBehavior.AllowNew | CollectionBindingBehavior.AllowRemove;
			_DisplayableProperties = string.Empty;
			Initializing = false;
			_SkipReturnedObjects = 0;
			_TopReturnedObjects = 0;
			hasChangesDuringInit = false;
		}

		internal void SortingChanged()
		{
			Reset();
		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.Reset, null, -1);
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual void SuppressEvents(object sender)
		{
			if (!_EnableObjectChangedNotificationsWhileEditing)
			{
				if (objectsEditingStarted == null)
				{
					objectsEditingStarted = new Dictionary<object, object>();
				}
				objectsEditingStarted[sender] = sender;
			}
		}

		private void UnsuppressEvents(object sender)
		{
			if (objectsEditingStarted != null)
			{
				objectsEditingStarted.Remove(sender);
				if (objectsEditingStarted.Count == 0)
				{
					objectsEditingStarted = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsEventsSuppressed(object sender)
		{
			if (objectsEditingStarted == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return objectsEditingStarted.Contains(sender);
		}

		void IObjectChange.OnObjectChanged(object sender, ObjectChangeEventArgs args)
		{
			switch (args.Reason)
			{
			case ObjectChangeReason.BeforePropertyDescriptorChangeWithinBeginEdit:
				SuppressEvents(sender);
				break;
			case ObjectChangeReason.Delete:
				if (!SelectDeleted)
				{
					BaseRemove(sender);
					UnsuppressEvents(sender);
				}
				else if (!IsEventsSuppressed(sender))
				{
					Strategy.Change(sender, null, -1);
				}
				break;
			case ObjectChangeReason.PropertyChanged:
				if (!IsEventsSuppressed(sender))
				{
					Strategy.Change(sender, args.PropertyName, -1);
				}
				break;
			case ObjectChangeReason.Reset:
				if (!IsEventsSuppressed(sender))
				{
					Strategy.Change(sender, null, -1);
				}
				break;
			case ObjectChangeReason.EndEdit:
				if (sender == newAdding)
				{
					newAdding = null;
					UnsuppressEvents(sender);
					Strategy.Change(sender, null, -1);
				}
				else if (IsEventsSuppressed(sender))
				{
					UnsuppressEvents(sender);
					Strategy.Change(sender, null, -1);
				}
				break;
			case ObjectChangeReason.CancelEdit:
				UnsuppressEvents(sender);
				if (sender != newAdding)
				{
					break;
				}
				newAdding = null;
				if (rootDesignCollection == this || !IsDesignMode)
				{
					BaseRemove(sender);
					if (Session.IsUnitOfWork && Session.IsObjectToSave(sender) && !IsDesignMode)
					{
						Session.Delete(sender);
						Session.RemoveFromSaveList(sender);
					}
					Helper.KickOutCancelledAddNew(sender);
					rootDesignCollection = null;
				}
				break;
			case ObjectChangeReason.BeginEdit:
				break;
			}
		}

				Helper = new XPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany(this, theOwner, refProperty);

			{
				Helper = new XPRefCollectionHelperOneToMany(this, theOwner, refProperty);
			}
			Helper.Session = session;
			Helper.ObjectClassInfo = refProperty.CollectionElementType;
			_loadingEnabled = true;
			InitData();
		}

		protected XPBaseCollection(Session session, XPClassInfo objType, Session originalSession, IEnumerable originalCollection, CriteriaOperator copyFilter, bool caseSensitive)
			: this(session, objType, loadingEnabled: false)
		{
			NestedUnitOfWork mySessionAsNested = session as NestedUnitOfWork;
			IEnumerable originalCollection2 = ((mySessionAsNested != null && mySessionAsNested != originalSession) ? (from object o in originalCollection
				select mySessionAsNested.GetNestedObject(o)) : originalCollection);
			_CaseSensitive = caseSensitive;
			ICollection objects = FilterList(session, objType, originalCollection2, copyFilter, caseSensitive);
			BaseAddRange(objects);
		}

		private void PersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehaviorFillInTransaction(CriteriaOperator condition)

			BaseAddRange(Session.GetObjectsInTransaction(GetObjectClassInfo(), condition, SelectDeleted));
		}

		private void PersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehaviorFillBeforeTransaction(CriteriaOperator condition)
		{
			ICollection objects = Session.GetObjectsInternal(new ObjectsQuery[1]
			{
				new ObjectsQuery(GetObjectClassInfo(), condition, null, 0, 0, new CollectionCriteriaPatcher(SelectDeleted, Session.TypesManager), force: false)
			})[0];
			BaseAddRange(objects);
		}

		protected XPBaseCollection(PersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehavior criteriaEvaluationBehavior, Session session, XPClassInfo objType, CriteriaOperator condition, bool selectDeleted)
			: this(session, objType, loadingEnabled: false)
		{
			SelectDeleted = selectDeleted;
			switch (criteriaEvaluationBehavior)
			{
			case PersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehavior.InTransaction:
				PersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehaviorFillInTransaction(condition);
				break;
			case PersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehavior.BeforeTransaction:
				PersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehaviorFillBeforeTransaction(condition);
				break;
			default:
				throw new NotImplementedException(Res.GetString("Collections_CriteriaEvaluationBehaviorIsNotSupported", criteriaEvaluationBehavior.ToString()));
			}
		}

		public ObjectsQuery BeginLoad()
		{
			return BeginLoad(force: false);
		}

		public ObjectsQuery BeginLoad(bool force)
		{
			if ((!IsLoaded || force) && !Initializing && !IsDesignMode && GetObjectClassInfo() != null)
			{
				IEnumerable enumerable = GetHintContentCore();
				if (enumerable == null)
				{
					enumerable = Helper.GetContentWithoutQueryIfPossible();
				}
				if (enumerable != null)
				{
					EndLoad(enumerable);
				}
				else if (LoadingEnabled)
				{
					return CreateObjectsQueryForLoad();
				}
				_IsLoaded = true;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Task<ObjectsQuery> BeginLoadAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return BeginLoadAsync(force: false, cancellationToken);
		}

		public async Task<ObjectsQuery> BeginLoadAsync(bool force, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if ((!IsLoaded || force) && !Initializing && !IsDesignMode && GetObjectClassInfo() != null)
			{
				IEnumerable enumerable = GetHintContentCore();
				if (enumerable == null)
				{
					enumerable = await Helper.GetContentWithoutQueryIfPossibleAsync(cancellationToken);
				}
				if (enumerable != null)
				{
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					EndLoad(enumerable);
				}
				else if (LoadingEnabled)
				{
					return CreateObjectsQueryForLoad();
				}
				_IsLoaded = true;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ObjectsQuery CreateObjectsQueryForLoad()
		{
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SortingCollection sortingCollection = new SortingCollection();
			if ((TopReturnedObjects != 0 || SkipReturnedObjects != 0) && Sorting != null)
			{
				foreach (SortProperty item in Sorting)
				{
					SortProperty val = item;
					sortingCollection.Add(new SortProperty(Helper.PatchCriteriaFromUserToFetch(val.Property), val.Direction));
				}
			}
			CriteriaOperator realFetchCriteria = GetRealFetchCriteria();
			return new ObjectsQuery(GetRealFetchClassInfo(), realFetchCriteria, sortingCollection, SkipReturnedObjects, TopReturnedObjects, new CollectionCriteriaPatcher(SelectDeleted, Session.TypesManager), force: false);
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public XPClassInfo GetRealFetchClassInfo()
		{
			return Helper.FetchObjectsClassInfo;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public CriteriaOperator GetRealFetchCriteria()
		{
			return Helper.GetHardcodedCriterion() & Helper.PatchCriteriaFromUserToFetch(Criteria);
		}

		public int EvaluateDatastoreCount()
		{
			return ((int?)Session.Evaluate(GetRealFetchClassInfo(), (CriteriaOperator)(object)AggregateOperand.TopLevel((Aggregate)1, (CriteriaOperator)null), GetRealFetchCriteria())).GetValueOrDefault();
		}

		private IEnumerable GetHintContentCore()
		{
			IEnumerable enumerable = HintCollection;
			HintCollection = null;
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (TopReturnedObjects != 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (SkipReturnedObjects != 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CriteriaOperator copyFilter = Helper.PatchCriteriaFromUserToFetch(Criteria);
			if (!SelectDeleted && GetRealFetchClassInfo().IsGCRecordObject)
			{
				XPMemberInfo gcMember = GetRealFetchClassInfo().GetMember(GCRecordField.StaticName);
				enumerable = from object theObject in enumerable
					where gcMember.GetValue(theObject) == null
					select theObject;
			}
			return FilterList(Session, GetRealFetchClassInfo(), enumerable, copyFilter, CaseSensitive);
		}

		private static ICollection FilterList(Session session, XPClassInfo objType, IEnumerable originalCollection, CriteriaOperator copyFilter, bool caseSensitive)
		{
			Func<object, bool> func = CreatePredicate(session, objType, copyFilter, caseSensitive);
			IList list = new List<object>();
			foreach (object item in originalCollection)
			{
				if (func(item))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal static Func<object, bool> CreatePredicate(Session session, XPClassInfo objType, CriteriaOperator criteria, bool caseSensitive)
		{
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (criteria == null)
			{
				return (object x) => true;
			}
			return CriteriaCompiler.ToUntypedPredicate(criteria, objType.GetCriteriaCompilerDescriptor(session), new CriteriaCompilerAuxSettings(caseSensitive, session.Dictionary.CustomFunctionOperators));
		}

		public void EndLoad(IEnumerable objects)
		{
			IEnumerable enumerable = Helper.PatchLoadedCollectionWithChangesWhileNotLoaded(objects);
			Clear();
			foreach (object item in enumerable)
			{
				Helper.InternalAddObject(item);
			}
			_IsLoaded = true;
		}

		public virtual void Load()
		{
			ObjectsQuery objectsQuery = BeginLoad();
			if (objectsQuery != null)
			{
				EndLoad(Session.GetObjects(objectsQuery));
			}
		}

		public virtual async Task LoadAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			ObjectsQuery objectsQuery = await BeginLoadAsync(force: true, cancellationToken);
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			if (objectsQuery != null)
			{
				ICollection[] array = await Session.GetObjectsAsync(new ObjectsQuery[1] { objectsQuery }, cancellationToken);
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				EndLoad(array[0]);
			}
		}

		public virtual bool LoadAsync()
		{
			return LoadAsync(null);
		}

		public virtual bool LoadAsync(AsyncLoadObjectsCallback callback)
		{
			if (isAsyncLoading)
			{
				return false;
			}
			isAsyncLoading = true;
			ObjectsQuery objectsQuery = null;
			try
			{
				objectsQuery = BeginLoad(force: true);
				if (objectsQuery != null)
				{
					Session.GetObjectsAsync(new ObjectsQuery[1] { objectsQuery }, delegate(ICollection[] result, Exception e)
					{
						isAsyncLoading = false;
						if (e == null)
						{
							EndLoad(result[0]);
						}
						else
						{
							EndLoad(new object[0]);
						}
						InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.Reset, null, -1);
						if (callback != null)
						{
							callback(new ICollection[1] { this }, e);
						}
					});
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (objectsQuery == null)
				{
					isAsyncLoading = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private XPPropertyDescriptorCollection GetProps(IList objects)
		{
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = GetTargetClass();
			foreach (object @object in objects)
			{
				XPClassInfo classInfo = Session.GetClassInfo(@object);
				if (!xPClassInfo.IsAssignableTo(classInfo))
				{
					xPClassInfo = classInfo;
				}
			}
			return new XPPropertyDescriptorCollection(Session, xPClassInfo, new PropertyDescriptor[0]);
		}

		private XPClassInfo GetTargetClass()
		{
			return GetObjectClassInfo();
		}

			//IL_0045: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (IsDesignMode)

		}

		public virtual int BaseIndexOf(object value)
		{
			return Objects.IndexOf(value);
		}

		public virtual int BaseAdd(object newObject)
		{
			if (isDisposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(ToString());
			}
			if (nowAdding == newObject)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (nowAdding != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Collections_RecurringObjectAdd"));
			}
			nowAdding = newObject;
			try
			{
				Session.ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(newObject);
				if (!IsDesignMode && !Session.GetClassInfo(newObject).IsAssignableTo(GetObjectClassInfo()))
				{
					throw new InvalidCastException(Res.GetString("Collections_InvalidCastOnAdd", newObject.GetType().FullName, (GetObjectClassInfo() == null) ? string.Empty : GetObjectClassInfo().FullName));
				}
				if (Helper.LoadCollectionOnModify)
				{
					Load();
				}
				if (IsLoaded)
				{
					EnsureFilteredAndSorted();
				}
				if (!Helper.ObjList.Contains(newObject))
				{
					OnCollectionChanged(new XPCollectionChangedEventArgs(XPCollectionChangedType.BeforeAdd, newObject));
					int index = Helper.Add(newObject);
					if (IsLoaded && !IsFilteringAndSortingEnsured())
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Collection was reset during object adding");
					}
					Strategy.Add(newObject, index);
					int num = (IsLoaded ? BaseIndexOf(newObject) : Helper.ObjList.IndexOf(newObject));
					OnCollectionChanged(new XPCollectionChangedEventArgs(XPCollectionChangedType.AfterAdd, newObject, num));
					return num;
				}
				return IsLoaded ? BaseIndexOf(newObject) : Helper.ObjList.IndexOf(newObject);
			}
			finally
			{
				nowAdding = null;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool BaseRemove(object theObject)
		{
			if (isDisposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(ToString());
			}
			if (theObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (nowRemoving == theObject)
			{
				return false;
			}
			nowRemoving = theObject;
			try
			{
				if (Helper.LoadCollectionOnModify)
				{
					Load();
				}
				if (!ProcessBaseRemove(theObject))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (DeleteObjectOnRemove && !IsDesignMode)
				{
					Session.Delete(theObject);
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				nowRemoving = null;
			}
		}

		public async Task<bool> BaseRemoveAsync(object theObject, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (isDisposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(ToString());
			}
			if (theObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (nowRemoving == theObject)
			{
				return false;
			}
			nowRemoving = theObject;
			try
			{
				if (Helper.LoadCollectionOnModify)
				{
					await LoadAsync(cancellationToken);
				}
				if (!ProcessBaseRemove(theObject))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (DeleteObjectOnRemove && !IsDesignMode)
				{
					await Session.DeleteAsync(theObject, cancellationToken);
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				nowRemoving = null;
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessBaseRemove(object theObject)
		{
			if (IsLoaded)
			{
				EnsureFilteredAndSorted();
			}
			if (!Helper.IsThereForDelete(theObject))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = (IsLoaded ? BaseIndexOf(theObject) : Helper.ObjList.IndexOf(theObject));
			OnCollectionChanged(new XPCollectionChangedEventArgs(XPCollectionChangedType.BeforeRemove, theObject, num));
			Helper.Remove(theObject);
			if (IsLoaded && !IsFilteringAndSortingEnsured())
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Collection was reset during object removing");
			}
			Strategy.Remove(theObject, num);
			Helper.BeforeAfterRemove(theObject);
			OnCollectionChanged(new XPCollectionChangedEventArgs(XPCollectionChangedType.AfterRemove, theObject));
			return true;
		}

		public virtual object BaseIndexer(int index)
		{
			if (isDisposed)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Objects[index];
		}

		public void BaseAddRange(ICollection objects)
		{
			if (objects.Count <= 1)
			{
				AddRangeCore(objects);
				return;
			}
			SuspendChangedEvents();
			try
			{
				AddRangeCore(objects);
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeChangedEvents();
			}
		}

		private void AddRangeCore(ICollection c)
		{
			foreach (object item in c)
			{
				BaseAdd(item);
			}
		}

		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				value = new SortingCollection();
			}
			if (_Sorting != value)
			{
				if (_Sorting != null)
				{
					_Sorting.Changed -= sortingCollection_ListChanged;
				}
				_Sorting = value;
				_Sorting.Changed += sortingCollection_ListChanged;
			}
		}

		private Session DoResolveSession()
		{
			if (IsDesignMode2)
			{
				return new DefaultSession(Site);
			}
			ResolveSessionEventArgs e = new ResolveSessionEventArgs();
			OnResolveSession(e);
			if (e.Session != null)
			{
				Session session = e.Session.Session;
				if (session != null)
				{
					return session;
				}
			}
			return XpoDefault.GetSession();
		}

			}
		}

		object IBindingList.AddNew()
		{
			if (!IsDesignMode && (BindingBehavior & CollectionBindingBehavior.AllowNew) == 0)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			object obj = null;
			if (GetObjectClassInfo() != null)
			{
				if (IsDesignMode)
				{
					if (rootDesignCollection == null)
					{
						rootDesignCollection = this;
					}
					obj = new IntermediateObject(Session, GetObjectClassInfo());
				}
				else
				{
					obj = CreateAddNewInstance();
				}
				newAdding = obj;
				if (BaseAdd(obj) < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return obj;
			}
			return null;
		}

		void IBindingList.ApplySort(PropertyDescriptor property, ListSortDirection direction)
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string text = ((property is XPPropertyDescriptor xPPropertyDescriptor) ? XPPropertyDescriptorBase.GetMemberName(xPPropertyDescriptor.Name) : property.Name);
			Sorting = new SortingCollection(new SortProperty((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(text), (SortingDirection)((direction != ListSortDirection.Ascending) ? 1 : 0)));
		}

		int IBindingList.Find(PropertyDescriptor property, object key)
		{
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (property.GetValue(item).Equals(key))
				{
					return BaseIndexOf(item);
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		void IBindingList.RemoveIndex(PropertyDescriptor property)
		{
		}

		void IBindingList.RemoveSort()
		{
			Sorting = new SortingCollection();
		}

		bool IXPPrefetchableAssociationList.NeedPrefetch()
		{
			if (!IsLoaded && HintCollection == null)
			{
				return LoadingEnabled;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IXPPrefetchableAssociationList.FinishPrefetch(ICollection hint)
		{
			HintCollection = hint;
		}

		public void PreFetch(params string[] propertyPaths)
		{
			Session.PreFetch(GetObjectClassInfo(), this, propertyPaths);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = (isDisposed ? "Disposed" : ((!IsLoaded) ? "NotLoaded" : ("Count(" + Count + ")")));
			return base.ToString() + "(" + seqNum + ") " + text;
		}
	}

		private int roadBlock;

		private const string ReentrancyOrCrossThreadFailureMessage = "Reentrancy or cross thread operation detected. Use ThreadSafeDataLayer or find the cause of the cross thread access to the SimpleDataLayer instance from your code as described in https://www.devexpress.com/kb=T419520. To suppress this exception, set DevExpress.Xpo.SimpleDataLayer.SuppressReentrancyAndThreadSafetyCheck = true";

		private static bool _SuppressReentrancyAndThreadSafetyCheck;

		[Description("A IDbConnection object that specifies the connection to the data store if it allows commands to be created.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public override IDbConnection Connection
		{
			get

				if (val != null)
				{
					try
					{
						return val.Connection;
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("Reentrancy and thread safety check suppressed")]
		public static bool SuppressReentrancyAndThreadSafetyCheck
		{

		protected override void OnClassInfoChanged(object sender, ClassInfoEventArgs e)

				return (object)null;

		public override UpdateSchemaResult UpdateSchema(bool doNotCreate, params XPClassInfo[] types)
		{
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ICollection<XPClassInfo> typesNeedEnsure = UpdateSchemaBegin(types);
			if (typesNeedEnsure == null)
			{
				return (UpdateSchemaResult)0;
			}
			DBTable[] tables = XPDictionary.CollectTables(typesNeedEnsure);
			UpdateSchemaResult val = ReentrancyAndThreadSafetyChecked((Func<UpdateSchemaResult>)delegate
			{
				//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if ((int)base.ConnectionProvider.UpdateSchema(doNotCreate, tables) != 1)
				{
					RegisterEnsuredTypes(typesNeedEnsure);
					return (UpdateSchemaResult)0;
				}
				return (UpdateSchemaResult)1;
			});
			if ((int)val == 0)
			{
				RaiseSchemaInit(typesNeedEnsure);
			}
			return val;
		}

		public override async Task<UpdateSchemaResult> UpdateSchemaAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken, bool doNotCreate, params XPClassInfo[] types)
		{
			ICollection<XPClassInfo> typesNeedEnsure = UpdateSchemaBegin(types);
			if (typesNeedEnsure == null)
			{
				return (UpdateSchemaResult)0;
			}
			DBTable[] tables = XPDictionary.CollectTables(typesNeedEnsure);
			UpdateSchemaResult val = await ReentrancyAndThreadSafetyCheckedAsync<UpdateSchemaResult>(async delegate
			{
				if ((int)(await DataStoreAsyncFallbackHelper.UpdateSchemaAsyncWithSmartFallback(base.ConnectionProvider, cancellationToken, doNotCreate, tables)) == 1)
				{
					return (UpdateSchemaResult)1;
				}
				RegisterEnsuredTypes(typesNeedEnsure);
				return (UpdateSchemaResult)0;
			});
			if ((int)val == 0)
			{
				RaiseSchemaInit(typesNeedEnsure);
			}
			return val;
		}

		private ICollection<XPClassInfo> UpdateSchemaBegin(XPClassInfo[] types)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)AutoCreateOption == 3)
			{
				foreach (XPClassInfo xPClassInfo in types)
				{
					xPClassInfo.CheckAbstractReference();
				}
				return null;
			}
			ICollection<XPClassInfo> collection = base.Dictionary.ExpandTypesToEnsure(types, EnsuredTypes);
			if (collection.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return collection;
		}

		public override SelectedData SelectData(params SelectStatement[] selects)

		}

		}

		public void ClearDatabase()
		{
			ReentrancyAndThreadSafetyChecked(delegate
			{
				//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				EnsuredTypes.Clear();
				ClearStaticData();
				((IDataStoreForTests)base.ConnectionProvider).ClearDatabase();
				return (object)null;
			});
		}

		public override IDbCommand CreateCommand()
		{
			return ReentrancyAndThreadSafetyChecked(delegate
			{
				IDataStore connectionProvider = base.ConnectionProvider;
				ISqlDataStore val = (ISqlDataStore)(object)((connectionProvider is ISqlDataStore) ? connectionProvider : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					try
					{
						return val.CreateCommand();
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return (IDbCommand)null;
			});
		}

		private T ReentrancyAndThreadSafetyChecked<T>(Func<T> action)
		{
			if (_SuppressReentrancyAndThreadSafetyCheck)
			{
				return action();
			}
			if (Interlocked.Increment(ref roadBlock) != 1)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Reentrancy or cross thread operation detected. Use ThreadSafeDataLayer or find the cause of the cross thread access to the SimpleDataLayer instance from your code as described in https://www.devexpress.com/kb=T419520. To suppress this exception, set DevExpress.Xpo.SimpleDataLayer.SuppressReentrancyAndThreadSafetyCheck = true");
			}
			bool flag = true;
			try
			{
				return action();
			}
			catch
			{
				flag = false;
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref roadBlock) != 0 && flag)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Reentrancy or cross thread operation detected. Use ThreadSafeDataLayer or find the cause of the cross thread access to the SimpleDataLayer instance from your code as described in https://www.devexpress.com/kb=T419520. To suppress this exception, set DevExpress.Xpo.SimpleDataLayer.SuppressReentrancyAndThreadSafetyCheck = true");
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task<T> ReentrancyAndThreadSafetyCheckedAsync<T>(Func<Task<T>> action)
		{
			if (_SuppressReentrancyAndThreadSafetyCheck)
			{
				return await action().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			if (Interlocked.Increment(ref roadBlock) != 1)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Reentrancy or cross thread operation detected. Use ThreadSafeDataLayer or find the cause of the cross thread access to the SimpleDataLayer instance from your code as described in https://www.devexpress.com/kb=T419520. To suppress this exception, set DevExpress.Xpo.SimpleDataLayer.SuppressReentrancyAndThreadSafetyCheck = true");
			}
			bool throwExceptionOnLeave = true;
			try
			{
				return await action().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			catch
			{
				throwExceptionOnLeave = false;
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref roadBlock) != 0 && throwExceptionOnLeave)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Reentrancy or cross thread operation detected. Use ThreadSafeDataLayer or find the cause of the cross thread access to the SimpleDataLayer instance from your code as described in https://www.devexpress.com/kb=T419520. To suppress this exception, set DevExpress.Xpo.SimpleDataLayer.SuppressReentrancyAndThreadSafetyCheck = true");
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class ThreadSafeDataLayer : BaseDataLayer, ICommandChannel, IDataLayerAsync, IDataLayer, IDisposable, IDataLayerProvider, IXPDictionaryProvider, ICommandChannelAsync
	{
		private readonly AsyncReaderWriterLock ensuredTypesRwl = new AsyncReaderWriterLock();

		[Description("This property always returns  null (Nothing in Visual Basic).")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public override IDbConnection Connection => null;

		public ThreadSafeDataLayer(XPDictionary dictionary, IDataStore provider, Action<XPDictionary> dictionaryInit)
			: base(dictionary, provider, dictionaryInit)

		}//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		protected override void OnClassInfoChanged(object sender, ClassInfoEventArgs e)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("ThreadSafeDataLayer_DictionaryModified", e.ClassInfo.FullName));
		}

		public override UpdateSchemaResult UpdateSchema(bool doNotCreate, params XPClassInfo[] types)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00eb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b9: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00d1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)AutoCreateOption == 3)
			{
				foreach (XPClassInfo xPClassInfo in types)
				{
					xPClassInfo.CheckAbstractReference();
				}
				return (UpdateSchemaResult)0;
			}
			using (ensuredTypesRwl.EnterUpgradeableReadLock())
			{
				int count = EnsuredTypes.Count;
				ICollection<XPClassInfo> collection = base.Dictionary.ExpandTypesToEnsure(types, EnsuredTypes);
				if (collection.Count == 0)
				{
					return (UpdateSchemaResult)0;
				}
				using (ensuredTypesRwl.EnterWriteLock())
				{
					if (EnsuredTypes.Count != count)
					{
						collection = base.Dictionary.ExpandTypesToEnsure(types, EnsuredTypes);
						if (collection.Count == 0)
						{
							return (UpdateSchemaResult)0;
						}
					}
					DBTable[] array = XPDictionary.CollectTables(collection);
					if ((int)base.ConnectionProvider.UpdateSchema(doNotCreate, array) == 1)
					{
						return (UpdateSchemaResult)1;
					}
					RegisterEnsuredTypes(collection);
					RaiseSchemaInit(collection);
					return (UpdateSchemaResult)0;
				}
			}
		}

		public override async Task<UpdateSchemaResult> UpdateSchemaAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken, bool doNotCreate, params XPClassInfo[] types)
		{
			if ((int)AutoCreateOption == 3)
			{
				foreach (XPClassInfo xPClassInfo in types)
				{
					xPClassInfo.CheckAbstractReference();
				}
				return (UpdateSchemaResult)0;
			}
			AsyncOperationIdentifier asyncOperationId = AsyncOperationIdentifier.New();
			using (await ensuredTypesRwl.EnterUpgradeableReadLockAsync(asyncOperationId, cancellationToken))
			{
				int ensuredTypesCount = EnsuredTypes.Count;
				ICollection<XPClassInfo> typesNeedEnsure = base.Dictionary.ExpandTypesToEnsure(types, EnsuredTypes);
				if (typesNeedEnsure.Count == 0)
				{
					return (UpdateSchemaResult)0;
				}
				using (await ensuredTypesRwl.EnterWriteLockAsync(asyncOperationId, cancellationToken))
				{
					if (EnsuredTypes.Count != ensuredTypesCount)
					{
						typesNeedEnsure = base.Dictionary.ExpandTypesToEnsure(types, EnsuredTypes);
						if (typesNeedEnsure.Count == 0)
						{
							return (UpdateSchemaResult)0;
						}
					}
					DBTable[] array = XPDictionary.CollectTables(typesNeedEnsure);
					if ((int)(await DataStoreAsyncFallbackHelper.UpdateSchemaAsyncWithSmartFallback(base.ConnectionProvider, cancellationToken, doNotCreate, array)) == 1)
					{
						return (UpdateSchemaResult)1;
					}
					RegisterEnsuredTypes(typesNeedEnsure);
					RaiseSchemaInit(typesNeedEnsure);
					return (UpdateSchemaResult)0;
				}
			}
		}

		public override SelectedData SelectData(params SelectStatement[] selects)
		{
			using (ensuredTypesRwl.EnterReadLock())
			{
				return base.ConnectionProvider.SelectData(selects);
			}
		}

		public override async Task<SelectedData> SelectDataAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken, params SelectStatement[] selects)
		{
			using (await ensuredTypesRwl.EnterReadLockAsync(AsyncOperationIdentifier.New(), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))
			{
				return await DataStoreAsyncFallbackHelper.SelectDataAsyncWithSmartFallback(base.ConnectionProvider, cancellationToken, selects).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
		}

			}
		}

		protected override void BeforeClassInfoSubscribe()
		{
			base.BeforeClassInfoSubscribe();
			using Session session = new StrongSession(SimpleObjectLayer.FromDataLayer(this));
			session.TypesManager.EnsureIsTypedObjectValid();
			Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo> processedClassInfos = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo>();
			foreach (XPClassInfo item in new ArrayList(base.Dictionary.Classes))
			{
				item.TouchRecursive(processedClassInfos);
			}
		}

		protected override object Do(string command, object args)
		{
			switch (command)
			{
			case "DevExpress.Xpo.Helpers.CommandChannelHelper.ExplicitBeginTransaction":
			case "DevExpress.Xpo.Helpers.CommandChannelHelper.ExplicitCommitTransaction":
			case "DevExpress.Xpo.Helpers.CommandChannelHelper.ExplicitRollbackTransaction":
				throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format("Command '{0}' is not supported by {1}.", command, "ThreadSafeDataLayer"));
			default:
				return base.Do(command, args);
			}
		}

		protected override Task<object> DoAsync(string command, object args, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))

			case "DevExpress.Xpo.Helpers.CommandChannelHelper.ExplicitCommitTransaction":
			case "DevExpress.Xpo.Helpers.CommandChannelHelper.ExplicitRollbackTransaction":
				throw new NotSupportedException(string.Format("Command '{0}' is not supported by {1}.", command, "ThreadSafeDataLayer"));
			default:
				return base.DoAsync(command, args, cancellationToken);
			}
		}

			{
				IdentityMapBehavior = IdentityMapBehavior.Strong

			session.CreateObjectTypeRecords(createOnlyNecessary: false, types);
		}
