	public static class XpoObjectInCriteriaProcessingHelper
	{
		private class ParseCriteriaSessionScope : IDisposable
		{
			private Session prevValue;

			private Session myValue;

			private bool isDisposed;

			public ParseCriteriaSessionScope(Session session)
			{
				myValue = session;
				prevValue = CurrentContext;
				CurrentContext = session;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				if (!isDisposed)
				{
					isDisposed = true;
					if (CurrentContext != myValue)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format("Incorrect ParseCriteriaSessionScope usage detected! Expected session: '{0}', actual: '{1}'", (myValue == null) ? ((object)"null") : ((object)myValue), (CurrentContext == null) ? ((object)"null") : ((object)CurrentContext)));
					}
					CurrentContext = prevValue;
				}
			}
		}

		public static class Tweaks
		{
			public static bool SuppressXpoObjectToString;

			public static bool SuppressXpoObjectToStringWhenSessionScopeNotCreated;

			public static bool ThrowExceptionOnNewObjectToString;

			public static bool SuppressExceptionsOnParse;
		}

		public const string TagXpoObject = "XpoObject";

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Session CurrentContext;

		internal static void Register()
		{
		}

		static XpoObjectInCriteriaProcessingHelper()
		{
			CriteriaOperator.UserValueParse += CriteriaOperator_UserValueParse;
			CriteriaOperator.UserValueToString += CriteriaOperator_UserValueToString;
		}

		private static void CriteriaOperator_UserValueToString(object sender, UserValueProcessingEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_010b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0115: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00cd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d7: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (Tweaks.SuppressXpoObjectToString || (Tweaks.SuppressXpoObjectToStringWhenSessionScopeNotCreated && CurrentContext == null) || ((HandledEventArgs)(object)e).Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			Session session = ((!(e.Value is IXPSimpleObject iXPSimpleObject)) ? CurrentContext : iXPSimpleObject.Session);
			if (session == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = session.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(e.Value);
			if (xPClassInfo == null || !xPClassInfo.IsPersistent)
			{
				return;
			}
			string arg;
			if (session.IsNewObject(e.Value))
			{
				if (Tweaks.ThrowExceptionOnNewObjectToString)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("New xpo object passed to XpoObjectInCriteriaProcessingHelper and XpoObjectInCriteriaProcessingHelper.Tweaks.ThrowExceptionOnNewObjectToString set to true");
				}
				arg = "New";
			}
			else
			{
				object keyValue = session.GetKeyValue(e.Value);
				if (keyValue is IdList idList)
				{
					List<string> list = new List<string>(idList.Count);
					foreach (object item in idList)
					{
						list.Add(((object)new ConstantValue(item)).ToString());
					}
					arg = string.Join(",", list.ToArray());
				}
				else
				{
					arg = ((object)new ConstantValue(keyValue)).ToString();
				}
			}
			e.Tag = "XpoObject";
			e.Data = $"{xPClassInfo.FullName}({arg})";
			((HandledEventArgs)(object)e).Handled = true;
		}

		private static void CriteriaOperator_UserValueParse(object sender, UserValueProcessingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((HandledEventArgs)(object)e).Handled || e.Tag != "XpoObject")
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Tweaks.SuppressExceptionsOnParse)
			{
				try
				{
					CriteriaOperator_UserValueParse_Core(e);
					return;
				}
				catch
				{
					e.Value = e.Data;
					((HandledEventArgs)(object)e).Handled = true;
					return;
				}
			}
			CriteriaOperator_UserValueParse_Core(e);
		}

		private static void CriteriaOperator_UserValueParse_Core(UserValueProcessingEventArgs e)
		{
			Session currentContext = CurrentContext;
			if (currentContext == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Session scope is not specified for CriteriaOperator.Parse operation. Please use session.ParseCriteria or using(session.CreateParseCriteriaSessionScope()) { CriteriaOperator.Parse(...); } instead");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.Data))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("e.Data");
			}
			int num = e.Data.IndexOf('(');
			if (num < 0 || e.Data[e.Data.Length - 1] != ')')
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid e.Data; expected format is 'Namespace.ClassName(KeyValue)'");
			}
			string className = e.Data.Substring(0, num);
			string text = e.Data.Substring(num + 1, e.Data.Length - num - 2);
			if (text == "New")
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("New object can't be restored");
			}
			XPClassInfo classInfo = currentContext.GetClassInfo(null, className);
			CriteriaOperator[] array = CriteriaOperator.ParseList(text, new object[0]);
			List<object> list = new List<object>(array.Length);
			CriteriaOperator[] array2 = array;
			foreach (CriteriaOperator val in array2)
			{
				ConstantValue val2 = (ConstantValue)(object)((val is ConstantValue) ? val : null);
				if (val2 == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("invalid key value");
				}
				list.Add(((OperandValue)val2).Value);
			}
			e.Value = currentContext.GetObjectByKey(classInfo, list.Count switch
			{
				0 => null, 
				1 => list[0], 
				_ => new IdList(list), 
			});
			((HandledEventArgs)(object)e).Handled = true;
		}

		public static IDisposable CreateParseCriteriaSessionScope(this Session session)
		{
			return new ParseCriteriaSessionScope(session);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator ParseCriteria(this Session session, string stringCriteria, out OperandValue[] criteriaParametersList)
		{
			using (session.CreateParseCriteriaSessionScope())
			{
				return CriteriaOperator.Parse(stringCriteria, ref criteriaParametersList);
			}
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator ParseCriteria(this Session session, string stringCriteria, params object[] parameters)
		{
			using (session.CreateParseCriteriaSessionScope())
			{
				return CriteriaOperator.Parse(stringCriteria, parameters);
			}
		}

		private struct ExpressionEvaluatorCacheItem

			public readonly XPClassInfo ClassInfo;

			public ExpressionEvaluatorCacheItem(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperator criteria)
			{
				if (classInfo == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("classInfo");
				}
				ClassInfo = classInfo;
				Criteria = criteria;
			}
		}

		private class ExpressionEvaluatorCacheItemComparer : IEqualityComparer<ExpressionEvaluatorCacheItem>
		{
			private static ExpressionEvaluatorCacheItemComparer instance = new ExpressionEvaluatorCacheItemComparer();

			public static ExpressionEvaluatorCacheItemComparer Instance => instance;

			private ExpressionEvaluatorCacheItemComparer()
			{
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<ExpressionEvaluatorCacheItem>.Equals(ExpressionEvaluatorCacheItem x, ExpressionEvaluatorCacheItem y)
			{
				if (x.ClassInfo == y.ClassInfo)
				{
					return CriteriaOperator.CriterionEquals(x.Criteria, y.Criteria);
				}
				return false;
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<ExpressionEvaluatorCacheItem>.GetHashCode(ExpressionEvaluatorCacheItem obj)
			{
				return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<XPClassInfo, CriteriaOperator>(obj.ClassInfo, obj.Criteria);
			}
		}

				return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<ISecurityRule2, XPClassInfo, XPMemberInfo>(obj.Rule2, obj.ClassInfo, obj.MemberInfo);
			}
		}

		private class DelayedPropertiesFinder : IClientCriteriaVisitor<string[]>, ICriteriaVisitor<string[]>
		{
			private bool hasJoinOperand;

			private XPClassInfo currentClassInfo;

			private readonly Stack<XPClassInfo> stack = new Stack<XPClassInfo>();

			private HashSet<string> result;

			public static string[] Find(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperator expression, out bool hasJoinOperand)
			{
				DelayedPropertiesFinder delayedPropertiesFinder = new DelayedPropertiesFinder(classInfo);
				delayedPropertiesFinder.Process(expression);
				hasJoinOperand = delayedPropertiesFinder.hasJoinOperand;
				if (delayedPropertiesFinder.result != null)
				{
					return delayedPropertiesFinder.result.ToArray();
				}
				return new string[0];
			}

			private static void UpdatePaths(string[] paths, string root)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < paths.Length; i++)
				{
					paths[i] = root + "." + paths[i];
				}
			}

			private static string[] Union(params string[][] arrays)
			{
				HashSet<string> hashSet = null;
				foreach (string[] array in arrays)
				{
					if (array != null)
					{
						if (hashSet == null)
						{
							hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
						}
						string[] array2 = array;
						foreach (string item in array2)
						{
							hashSet.Add(item);
						}
					}
				}
				return hashSet?.ToArray();
			}

			private DelayedPropertiesFinder(XPClassInfo topLevelClassInfo)
			{
				currentClassInfo = topLevelClassInfo;
			}

			protected bool IsTopLevel()
			{
				return stack.Count == 0;
			}

			protected void AddResults(params string[] paths)
			{
				if (result == null)
				{
					result = new HashSet<string>();
				}
				foreach (string item in paths)
				{
					result.Add(item);
				}
			}

			protected string[] Process(CriteriaOperator expression)
			{
				if (!CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull(expression))
				{
					return expression.Accept<string[]>((ICriteriaVisitor<string[]>)this);
				}
				return null;
			}

			protected string[] Process(IList<CriteriaOperator> expressions)
			{
				HashSet<string> hashSet = null;
				foreach (CriteriaOperator expression in expressions)
				{
					string[] array = Process(expression);
					if (array != null)
					{
						if (hashSet == null)
						{
							hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
						}
						string[] array2 = array;
						foreach (string item in array2)
						{
							hashSet.Add(item);
						}
					}
				}
				return hashSet?.ToArray();
			}

			public string[] Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)
			{
				//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0117: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Stack<XPClassInfo> localStack = null;
				string propertyName = null;
				if (!theOperand.IsTopLevel)
				{
					propertyName = theOperand.CollectionProperty.PropertyName;
					localStack = BeginProcessParentRelatingOperator(ref propertyName);
				}
				try
				{
					MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = null;
					if (!theOperand.IsTopLevel)
					{
						memberInfoCollection = currentClassInfo.ParsePath(propertyName);
						if (memberInfoCollection.Count == 0)
						{
							throw new InvalidPropertyPathException(Res.GetString("MetaData_IncorrectPath", currentClassInfo.FullName, propertyName));
						}
						XPClassInfo owner = currentClassInfo;
						for (int i = 0; i < memberInfoCollection.Count; i++)
						{
							if (!owner.IsAssignableTo(memberInfoCollection[i].Owner))
							{
								return null;
							}
							owner = memberInfoCollection[i].Owner;
						}
						foreach (XPMemberInfo item in memberInfoCollection)
						{
							stack.Push(currentClassInfo);
							if (item.ReferenceType == null)
							{
								if (!item.IsAssociationList && !item.IsManyToManyAlias)
								{
									throw new InvalidPropertyPathException(Res.GetString("MetaData_IncorrectPath", currentClassInfo.FullName, propertyName));
								}
								currentClassInfo = item.CollectionElementType;
							}
							else
							{
								currentClassInfo = item.ReferenceType;
							}
						}
					}
					string[] array = null;
					string[] array2 = null;
					string[] array3 = null;
					try
					{
						array = Process(theOperand.Condition);
						array2 = Process(theOperand.AggregatedExpression);
						array3 = Process((IList<CriteriaOperator>)theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands);
					}
					finally
					{
						if (memberInfoCollection != null)
						{
							for (int j = 0; j < memberInfoCollection.Count; j++)
							{
								if (stack.Count <= 0)
								{
									break;
								}
								currentClassInfo = stack.Pop();
							}
						}
					}
					string[] array4 = Union(array, array2, array3);
					if (array4 != null)
					{
						UpdatePaths(array4, propertyName);
					}
					else
					{
						array4 = new string[1] { string.Join(".", MemberInfoCollection.SplitPath(propertyName)) };
					}
					return PrepareResult(array4);
				}
				finally
				{
					EndProcessParentRelatingOperator(localStack);
				}
			}

			public string[] Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
			{
				hasJoinOperand = true;
				return null;
			}

			public string[] Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
			{
				string propertyName = theOperand.PropertyName;
				Stack<XPClassInfo> localStack = BeginProcessParentRelatingOperator(ref propertyName);
				try
				{
					string[] paths = null;
					MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = MemberInfoCollection.ParsePath(currentClassInfo, propertyName);
					if (!IsTopLevel() || currentClassInfo.IsAssignableTo(memberInfoCollection[0].Owner))
					{
						for (int num = memberInfoCollection.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
						{
							XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = memberInfoCollection[num];
							if (xPMemberInfo.IsExpandableToPersistent && NeedsPreFetch(xPMemberInfo))
							{
								paths = new string[1] { string.Join(".", MemberInfoCollection.SplitPath(propertyName), 0, num + 1) };
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					return PrepareResult(paths);
				}
				finally
				{
					EndProcessParentRelatingOperator(localStack);
				}
			}

			public string[] Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
			{
				return PrepareResult(Union(Process(theOperator.BeginExpression), Process(theOperator.EndExpression), Process(theOperator.TestExpression)));
			}

			public string[] Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
			{
				return PrepareResult(Union(Process(theOperator.LeftOperand), Process(theOperator.RightOperand)));
			}

			public string[] Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
			{
				return PrepareResult(Process(theOperator.Operand));
			}

			public string[] Visit(InOperator theOperator)
			{
				return PrepareResult(Union(Process(theOperator.LeftOperand), Process((IList<CriteriaOperator>)theOperator.Operands)));
			}

			public string[] Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
			{
				return PrepareResult(Process((IList<CriteriaOperator>)theOperator.Operands));
			}

			public string[] Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
			{
				return null;
			}

			public string[] Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
			{
				return PrepareResult(Process((IList<CriteriaOperator>)theOperator.Operands));
			}

			private static bool NeedsPreFetch(XPMemberInfo memberInfo)
			{
				if (!memberInfo.IsDelayed && !memberInfo.IsCollection && !memberInfo.IsManyToManyAlias)
				{
					return memberInfo.IsAssociationList;
				}
				return true;
			}

			protected Stack<XPClassInfo> BeginProcessParentRelatingOperator(ref string propertyName)
			{
				Stack<XPClassInfo> stack = null;
				while (propertyName.StartsWith("^."))
				{
					if (stack == null)
					{
						stack = new Stack<XPClassInfo>();
					}
					if (this.stack.Count == 0)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("^.");
					}
					propertyName = propertyName.Substring(2);
					stack.Push(currentClassInfo);
					currentClassInfo = this.stack.Pop();
				}
				return stack;
			}

			protected void EndProcessParentRelatingOperator(Stack<XPClassInfo> localStack)
			{
				if (localStack != null)
				{
					while (localStack.Count > 0)
					{
						stack.Push(currentClassInfo);
						currentClassInfo = localStack.Pop();
					}
				}
			}

			protected string[] PrepareResult(string[] paths)
			{
				if (paths == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (IsTopLevel())
				{
					AddResults(paths);
					return null;
				}
				return paths;
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<SelectMemberExpressionCacheItem, SelectMemberExpressionCacheItemResult> selectMemberExpressionDictionary = new Dictionary<SelectMemberExpressionCacheItem, SelectMemberExpressionCacheItemResult>(SelectMemberExpressionCacheItemComparer.Instance);

		private XPDictionary Dictionary => parentObjectLayer.Dictionary;

		public async Task CommitChangesAsync(Session session, ICollection fullListForDelete, ICollection completeListForSave, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{

			{
				int asyncOperationId = SessionStateStack.GetNewAsyncOperationId();

				try
				{
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

		}

		public object SelectDataAsync(Session session, ObjectsQuery query, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties, CriteriaOperator groupCriteria, AsyncSelectDataCallback callback)
		{

			if (callback == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			return new AsyncRequest(syncContext, delegate

				List<object[]> result = null;
				try
				{
					if (query == null)
					{
						result = new List<object[]>(0);

		private ICollection FilterListForDelete(Session session, ICollection fullListForDelete)
		{
			if (fullListForDelete == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (fullListForDelete.Count == 0)
			{
				return fullListForDelete;
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>(fullListForDelete.Count / 2);
			foreach (object item in fullListForDelete)
			{
				if (!session.IsNewObject(item))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public void CommitChanges(Session session, ICollection fullListForDelete, ICollection completeListForSave)
		{
			ICollection fullListForDelete2 = FilterListForDelete(session, fullListForDelete);
			BatchWideDataHolder4Modification batchWideDataHolder4Modification = new BatchWideDataHolder4Modification(this);
			batchWideDataHolder4Modification.RegisterDeletedObjects(fullListForDelete);
			CommitChangesContext commitChangesContext = new CommitChangesContext(session, batchWideDataHolder4Modification);
			BeginCommitChangesInsideTransaction(commitChangesContext, fullListForDelete2, completeListForSave);
			if (commitChangesContext.Statements.Length != 0)
			{
				SessionStateStack.Enter(session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner);
				try
				{
					commitChangesContext.Result = DataLayer.ModifyData(commitChangesContext.Statements);
				}
				finally
				{
					SessionStateStack.Leave(session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner);
				}
			}
			EndCommitChangesInsideTransaction(commitChangesContext);
		}

		public object CommitChangesAsync(Session session, ICollection fullListForDelete, ICollection completeListForSave, AsyncCommitCallback callback)
		{
			SynchronizationContext syncContext = AsyncOperationsHelper.CaptureSynchronizationContextOrFail();
			if (callback == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			BatchWideDataHolder4Modification batchWideDataHolder4Modification = new BatchWideDataHolder4Modification(this);
			ICollection fullListForDelete2 = FilterListForDelete(session, fullListForDelete);
			batchWideDataHolder4Modification.RegisterDeletedObjects(fullListForDelete);
			CommitChangesContext commitChangesContext = new CommitChangesContext(session, batchWideDataHolder4Modification);
			BeginCommitChangesInsideTransaction(commitChangesContext, fullListForDelete2, completeListForSave);
			SessionStateStack.Enter(session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner);
			return new AsyncCommitRequest(commitChangesContext, callback, syncContext, CommitTransactionAsyncExec).Start(session.AsyncExecuteQueue);
		}

		private void CommitTransactionAsyncExec(AsyncRequest ar)
		{
			AsyncCommitRequest request = ar as AsyncCommitRequest;
			if (request == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			CommitChangesContext commitContext = request.CommitContext;
			try
			{
				if (commitContext.Statements.Length != 0)
				{
					commitContext.Result = DataLayer.ModifyData(commitContext.Statements);
				}
				commitContext.Session.AsyncExecuteQueue.Invoke(request.SyncContext, delegate
				{
					try
					{
						SessionStateStack.Leave(request.CommitContext.Session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner);
						SessionStateStack.Enter(request.CommitContext.Session, SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant);
						try
						{
							EndCommitChangesInsideTransaction(request.CommitContext);
						}
						finally
						{
							SessionStateStack.Leave(request.CommitContext.Session, SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant);
						}
						request.Callback(request.CommitContext.Ex);
					}
					catch (Exception ex3)
					{
						try
						{
							request.Callback(ex3);
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					}
				}, null, operationEnd: true);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				try
				{
					commitContext.Ex = ex;
					commitContext.Session.AsyncExecuteQueue.Invoke(request.SyncContext, delegate
					{
						try
						{
							SessionStateStack.Leave(request.CommitContext.Session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner);
							request.Callback(request.CommitContext.Ex);
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					}, null, operationEnd: true);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private void BeginCommitChangesInsideTransaction(CommitChangesContext context, ICollection fullListForDelete, ICollection completeListForSave)
		{
			context.ProcessingSave = new ProcessingSave(context.Session, context.BatchWideData);
			ProcessDeletedObjects(context, fullListForDelete, completeListForSave, out var beforeInserts, out var afterUpdates);
			List<ModificationStatement> collection = context.ProcessingSave.Process();
			List<ModificationStatement> list = new List<ModificationStatement>();
			list.AddRange(beforeInserts);
			list.AddRange(collection);
			list.AddRange(afterUpdates);
			if (list.Count != 0 && context.Session.LockingOption == LockingOption.None)
			{
				foreach (ModificationStatement item in list)
				{
					item.RecordsAffected = 0;
				}
			}
			context.Statements = list.ToArray();
		}

		private async Task BeginCommitChangesInsideTransactionAsync(CommitChangesContext context, ICollection fullListForDelete, ICollection completeListForSave, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			context.ProcessingSave = new ProcessingSave(context.Session, context.BatchWideData);
			ProcessDeletedObjects(context, fullListForDelete, completeListForSave, out var deleteFirstList, out var deleteLastList);
			List<ModificationStatement> collection = await context.ProcessingSave.ProcessAsync(cancellationToken);
			List<ModificationStatement> list = new List<ModificationStatement>();
			list.AddRange(deleteFirstList);
			list.AddRange(collection);
			list.AddRange(deleteLastList);
			if (list.Count != 0 && context.Session.LockingOption == LockingOption.None)
			{
				foreach (ModificationStatement item in list)
				{
					item.RecordsAffected = 0;
				}
			}
			context.Statements = list.ToArray();
		}

		private void EndCommitChangesInsideTransaction(CommitChangesContext context)
		{
			context.ProcessingSave.ProcessResults(context.Result);
		}

								dictionary.Remove(item2);

					}
				}
			}

				{
					list.Add(item3);
				}
				else
				{
					list2.Add(item3);

			}

		}

		object ICommandChannel.Do(string command, object args)
		{
			if (nestedCommandChannel == null)
			{
				if (dataLayer == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported.");
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported by {dataLayer.GetType().FullName}.");
			}
			return nestedCommandChannel.Do(command, args);
		}

		Task<object> ICommandChannelAsync.DoAsync(string command, object args, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (nestedCommandChannelAsync == null)
			{
				if (nestedCommandChannel == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported.");
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Async_CommandChannelDoesNotImplementICommandChannelAsync", ((object)nestedCommandChannel).GetType().FullName));
			}
			return nestedCommandChannelAsync.DoAsync(command, args, cancellationToken);
		}
	}
	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public class NestedUnitOfWork : UnitOfWork
	{
		private Session parent;

		private NestedParentMap map;

		[Description("Gets the parent session or unit of work.")]
		[Category("Data")]
		public Session Parent => parent;

		internal NestedParentMap Map => map;

		protected internal NestedUnitOfWork(Session parent)
			: base(parent.ServiceProvider, new SessionObjectLayer(parent))
		{
			this.parent = parent;
			map = ((SessionObjectLayer)base.ObjectLayer).GetNestedParentMap(this);
		}

		public T GetParentObject<T>(T obj)
		{
			return (T)GetParentObject((object)obj);
		}

		public object GetParentObject(object obj)
		{
			return NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(this, Parent, Map, obj);
		}

		public object TryGetNestedObject(object obj)
		{
			return NestedWorksHelper.TryGetNestedObject(Parent, Map, obj);
		}

		public T GetNestedObject<T>(T obj)
		{
			return (T)GetNestedObject((object)obj);
		}

		public object GetNestedObject(object obj)
		{
			return NestedWorksHelper.GetNestedObject(this, Parent, Map, obj);
		}

		public object[] GetNestedObjects(params object[] parentObjects)
		{
			ICollection collection = new NestedLoader(this, Parent, Map).GetNestedObjects(new ICollection[1] { parentObjects })[0];
			return ListHelper.FromCollection(collection).ToArray();
		}

		protected override void OnBeforeCommitTransaction()
		{
			base.OnBeforeCommitTransaction();
			Parent.OnBeforeCommitNestedUnitOfWork(new SessionManipulationEventArgs(this));
		}

		protected override void OnAfterCommitTransaction()
		{
			base.OnAfterCommitTransaction();
			Parent.OnAfterCommitNestedUnitOfWork(new SessionManipulationEventArgs(this));
		}
	}

	[Serializable]
	public class ObjectChangeEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private ObjectChangeReason reason;

		private string propertyName;

		private object oldValue;

		private object newValue;

		private abstract class CollectionCreatorCreator : GenericInvoker<Func<PersistentBase, XPMemberInfo, XPBaseCollection>, CollectionCreatorCreator.Impl<object>>
		{

					return (PersistentBase @this, XPMemberInfo property) => @this.CreateCollection<T>(property);

			}
		}

		private void Init(Session session, XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			_Session = session;
			_ClassInfo = classInfo;
			if (!session.IsObjectsLoading)
			{
				AfterConstruction();
			}
		}

		public virtual void AfterConstruction()
		{
			if (Session.IsUnitOfWork && !Session.IsDesignMode && ClassInfo.IsPersistent)
			{
				Session.Save(this);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ThrowObjectDisposedException()
		{
			throw new ObjectDisposedException(ToString());
		}

		protected virtual void Invalidate(bool disposing)
		{
			_Session = null;
		}

		void IXPInvalidateableObject.Invalidate()
		{
			Invalidate(disposing: true);
		}

		void IXPModificationsStore.ClearModifications()
		{
			if (HasModificationStore)
			{
				ModificationsStore.Clear();
			}
		}

		void IXPModificationsStore.SetPropertyModified(XPMemberInfo property, object oldValue)
		{
			if (!ModificationsStore.ContainsKey(property))
			{
				ModificationsStore.Add(property, oldValue);
			}
		}

		bool IXPModificationsStore.GetPropertyModified(XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			if (HasModificationStore)
			{
				return ModificationsStore.ContainsKey(property);
			}
			return false;
		}

		object IXPModificationsStore.GetPropertyOldValue(XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			if (HasModificationStore && ModificationsStore.TryGetValue(property, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		void IXPModificationsStore.ResetPropertyModified(XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			if (HasModificationStore)
			{
				ModificationsStore.Remove(property);
			}
		}

		bool IXPModificationsStore.HasModifications()
		{
			if (!HasModificationStore)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ModificationsStore.Count > 0;
		}

		public static IXPModificationsStore GetModificationsStore(object theObject)
		{
			IXPModificationsStore iXPModificationsStore = theObject as IXPModificationsStore;
			if (iXPModificationsStore == null)
			{
				iXPModificationsStore = (IXPModificationsStore)ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(theObject);
			}
			return iXPModificationsStore;
		}

		object IXPCustomPropertyStore.GetCustomPropertyValue(XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			return GetCustomPropertyValue(property);
		}

		internal object GetCustomPropertyValue(XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			object value = null;
			if (HasCustomPropertyStore)
			{
				CustomPropertyStore.TryGetValue(property, out value);
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				value = CreateDefValue(property);
				if (value != null)
				{
					CustomPropertyStore[property] = value;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private object CreateDefValue(XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			if (property.IsCollection)
			{
				return CheckPropertyValue(property, CustomCreateCollection(property));
			}
			if (property.IsAssociationList)
			{
				return CheckPropertyValue(property, CreateAssociationList(property));
			}
			if (property.IsManyToManyAlias)
			{
				return CheckPropertyValue(property, CreateManyToManyAliasList(property));
			}
			if (property.IsDelayed)
			{
				return new XPDelayedProperty(Session, this, property);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private object CheckPropertyValue(XPMemberInfo property, object value)
		{
			if (UseUnsafeCreateCollectionStrategy || value == null || property.MemberType.IsAssignableFrom(value.GetType()))
			{
				return value;
			}
			object[] args = new object[4]
			{
				value.GetType(),
				property.MemberType,
				property.Owner.FullName,
				property.Name
			};
			string message = Res.GetString("CreateCollection_InvalidCastException", args);
			throw new InvalidCastException(message);
		}

		private static bool CanCreateGenericList(Type memberType)
		{
			if (DisableSmartCreateAssociationListStrategy || !memberType.IsGenericType)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type genericTypeDefinition = memberType.GetGenericTypeDefinition();
			if (!(genericTypeDefinition == typeof(XPCollection<>)))
			{
				return genericTypeDefinition == typeof(IList<>);
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool IXPCustomPropertyStore.SetCustomPropertyValue(XPMemberInfo property, object theValue)
		{
			return SetCustomPropertyValue(property, theValue);
		}

		internal bool SetCustomPropertyValue(XPMemberInfo property, object theValue)
		{
			if (property.IsDelayed && !property.IsAssociationList)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(Res.GetString("Object_DelayedPropertyContainerCannotBeAssigned"), property.Owner.FullName, property.Name));
			}
			if (HasCustomPropertyStore || theValue != null)
			{
				object customPropertyValue = ((IXPCustomPropertyStore)this).GetCustomPropertyValue(property);
				if (CanSkipAssignment(theValue, customPropertyValue))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (theValue == null)
				{
					CustomPropertyStore.Remove(property);
				}
				else
				{
					CustomPropertyStore[property] = theValue;
				}
				OnChanged(property.Name, customPropertyValue, theValue);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static IXPCustomPropertyStore GetCustomPropertyStore(object theObject)
		{
			IXPCustomPropertyStore iXPCustomPropertyStore = theObject as IXPCustomPropertyStore;
			if (iXPCustomPropertyStore == null)
			{
				iXPCustomPropertyStore = (IXPCustomPropertyStore)ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(theObject);
			}
			return iXPCustomPropertyStore;
		}

		internal static bool CanSkipAssignment(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue == newValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (oldValue is ValueType && newValue is ValueType && object.Equals(oldValue, newValue))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (oldValue is string && newValue is string && object.Equals(oldValue, newValue))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected IList GetList([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			XPMemberInfo member = ClassInfo.GetMember(propertyName);
			return (IList)GetCustomPropertyValue(member);
		}

		protected virtual IList CreateAssociationList(XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			if (CanCreateGenericList(property.MemberType))
			{
				return GenericInvoker<Func<PersistentBase, XPMemberInfo, IList>, AssociationListCreatorCreator.Impl<object>>.GetInvoker(property.CollectionElementType.ClassType)(this, property);
			}
			return new XPAssociationList(Session, this, property);
		}

		protected virtual IList CreateManyToManyAliasList(IList aliasedCollection, XPMemberInfo skippedProperty)
		{
			return new XPManyToManyAliasList(Session, aliasedCollection, skippedProperty);
		}

		private IList CreateManyToManyAliasList(XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			ManyToManyAliasAttribute manyToManyAliasAttribute = (ManyToManyAliasAttribute)property.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(ManyToManyAliasAttribute));
			XPMemberInfo member = ClassInfo.GetMember(manyToManyAliasAttribute.OneToManyCollectionName);
			IList list = (IList)member.GetValue(this);
			XPMemberInfo member2 = member.CollectionElementType.GetMember(manyToManyAliasAttribute.ReferenceInTheIntermediateTableName);
			if (CanCreateGenericList(property.MemberType))
			{
				return GenericInvoker<Func<PersistentBase, IList, XPMemberInfo, IList>, ManyToManyAliasListCreatorCreator.Impl<object>>.GetInvoker(member2.MemberType)(this, list, member2);
			}
			return CreateManyToManyAliasList(list, member2);
		}

		protected IList<T> GetList<T>([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			XPMemberInfo member = ClassInfo.GetMember(propertyName);
			CustomPropertyStore.TryGetValue(member, out var value);
			IList<T> list = (IList<T>)value;
			if (list == null)
			{
				if (member.IsAssociationList)
				{
					list = CreateAssociationList<T>(member);
				}
				else
				{
					ManyToManyAliasAttribute manyToManyAliasAttribute = (ManyToManyAliasAttribute)member.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(ManyToManyAliasAttribute));
					XPMemberInfo member2 = ClassInfo.GetMember(manyToManyAliasAttribute.OneToManyCollectionName);
					IList aliasedCollection = (IList)member2.GetValue(this);
					XPMemberInfo member3 = member2.CollectionElementType.GetMember(manyToManyAliasAttribute.ReferenceInTheIntermediateTableName);
					list = CreateManyToManyAliasList<T>(aliasedCollection, member3);
				}
				CustomPropertyStore[member] = list;
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected virtual XPCollection<T> CreateCollection<T>(XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			XPCollection<T> xPCollection = new XPCollection<T>(Session, (object)this, property);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(xPCollection);
			return xPCollection;
		}

		}

		protected virtual IList<T> CreateManyToManyAliasList<T>(IList aliasedCollection, XPMemberInfo skippedProperty)

		}

		protected virtual XPCollection CreateCollection(XPMemberInfo property)

			return xPCollection;
		}

		protected virtual XPBaseCollection CustomCreateCollection(XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			if (CanCreateGenericList(property.MemberType))
			{
				return GenericInvoker<Func<PersistentBase, XPMemberInfo, XPBaseCollection>, CollectionCreatorCreator.Impl<object>>.GetInvoker(property.CollectionElementType.ClassType)(this, property);
			}
			return CreateCollection(property);
		}

		protected virtual void OnChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (!IsLoading)
			{
				TriggerObjectChangedCached(ObjectChangeReason.PropertyChanged, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void TriggerObjectChanged(ObjectChangeEventArgs args)
		{
			switch (args.Reason)
			{
			case ObjectChangeReason.Reset:
				RaisePropertyChangedEvent(null);
				break;
			case ObjectChangeReason.PropertyChanged:
				RaisePropertyChangedEvent(args.PropertyName);
				break;
			}
			Session.TriggerObjectChanged(this, args);
		}

		internal void TriggerObjectChangedCached(ObjectChangeReason reason, string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			ObjectChangeEventArgs e = Interlocked.Exchange(ref cachedObjectChangeEventArgs, null);
			if (e == null)
			{
				e = new ObjectChangeEventArgs(Session, this, reason, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			}
			else
			{
				e.Init(Session, this, reason, propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			}
			TriggerObjectChanged(e);
			if (!ObjectChangeEventArgs.DisableObjectChangeEventArgsCache)
			{
				e.Clear();
				cachedObjectChangeEventArgs = e;
			}
		}

		internal void TriggerObjectChangedCached(ObjectChangeReason reason)
		{
			TriggerObjectChangedCached(reason, null, null, null);
		}

		protected bool SetPropertyValue(string propertyName, object newValue)
		{
			XPMemberInfo member = ClassInfo.GetMember(propertyName);
			if (member.IsDelayed)
			{
				return ((XPDelayedProperty)GetCustomPropertyValue(member)).SetValue(newValue);
			}
			return SetCustomPropertyValue(member, newValue);
		}

		protected bool SetPropertyValue(string propertyName, ref string propertyValueHolder, string newValue)
		{
			if (Session.IsObjectsLoading)
			{
				propertyValueHolder = newValue;
			}
			else
			{
				string text = propertyValueHolder;
				if (text == newValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				propertyValueHolder = newValue;
				OnChanged(propertyName, text, newValue);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool SetPropertyEquatableValue<T>(string propertyName, ref T propertyValueHolder, T newValue) where T : struct, IEquatable<T>
		{
			if (Session.IsObjectsLoading)
			{
				propertyValueHolder = newValue;
			}
			else
			{
				T val = propertyValueHolder;
				if (val.Equals(newValue))
				{
					return false;
				}
				propertyValueHolder = newValue;
				OnChanged(propertyName, val, newValue);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool SetPropertyNullableEquatableValue<T>(string propertyName, ref T? propertyValueHolder, T? newValue) where T : struct, IEquatable<T>
		{
			if (Session.IsObjectsLoading)
			{
				propertyValueHolder = newValue;
			}
			else
			{
				T? val = propertyValueHolder;
				if (!newValue.HasValue)
				{
					if (!val.HasValue)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (val.HasValue && val.Value.Equals(newValue.Value))
				{
					return false;
				}
				propertyValueHolder = newValue;
				OnChanged(propertyName, val, newValue);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool SetPropertyValue(string propertyName, ref bool propertyValueHolder, bool newValue)
		{
			if (Session.IsObjectsLoading)
			{
				propertyValueHolder = newValue;
			}
			else
			{
				bool flag = propertyValueHolder;
				if (flag == newValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				propertyValueHolder = newValue;
				OnChanged(propertyName, ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase.BoxBool(flag), ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase.BoxBool(newValue));
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool SetPropertyValue(string propertyName, ref bool? propertyValueHolder, bool? newValue)
		{
			if (Session.IsObjectsLoading)
			{
				propertyValueHolder = newValue;
			}
			else
			{
				bool? flag = propertyValueHolder;
				if (flag == newValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				propertyValueHolder = newValue;
				OnChanged(propertyName, ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase.BoxBool3VL(flag), ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase.BoxBool3VL(newValue));
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool SetPropertyValue<T>(string propertyName, ref T propertyValueHolder, T newValue)
		{
			if (Session.IsObjectsLoading)
			{
				propertyValueHolder = newValue;
			}
			else
			{
				T val = propertyValueHolder;
				object obj = val;
				object obj2 = newValue;
				if (CanSkipAssignment(obj2, obj))
				{
					return false;
				}
				propertyValueHolder = newValue;
				OnChanged(propertyName, obj, obj2);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool SetDelayedPropertyValue(string propertyName, object newValue)
		{
			return SetPropertyValue(propertyName, newValue);
		}

		protected bool SetDelayedPropertyValue<T>(string propertyName, T newValue)
		{
			return SetPropertyValue(propertyName, newValue);
		}

		protected object GetPropertyValue([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			XPMemberInfo member = ClassInfo.GetMember(propertyName);
			object obj = GetCustomPropertyValue(member);
			if (member.IsDelayed)
			{
				obj = ((XPDelayedProperty)obj).Value;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected T GetPropertyValue<T>([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(propertyName);
			if (propertyValue == null)
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			return (T)propertyValue;
		}

		protected object GetDelayedPropertyValue([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			return GetPropertyValue(propertyName);
		}

		protected T GetDelayedPropertyValue<T>([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			return GetPropertyValue<T>(propertyName);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!IsInvalidated && Session.IsDesignMode)
			{
				return base.ToString();
			}
			object obj = ClassInfo.GetId(this);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj = string.Empty;
			}
			return ClassInfo.FullName + "(" + obj.ToString() + ")";
		}

			}

	[NonPersistent]
	[MemberDesignTimeVisibility(false)]
	[OptimisticLocking(true)]
	public abstract class XPBaseObject : PersistentBase, IEditableObject, ICustomTypeDescriptor, IComparable, IXPReceiveOnChangedFromXPPropertyDescriptor
	{
		[Flags]
		private enum ObjectState
		{
			None = 0,
			Editing = 1,
			Changed = 4,
			TrackChangedEvent = 0x10000,
			ChangedInsideTrackChangedEvent = 0x20000,
			SkipChangedOnNextLoaded = 0x40000,
			NeedSaveAtTheEndOfEndEdit = 0x80000
		}

		private ObjectState _state;

		private List<object> _values;

		public static bool AutoSaveOnEndEdit = true;

		private ObjectChangeEventHandler handler;

		[Browsable(false)]
		public object This => this;

		[Obsolete("Use the XPBaseObject.IsLoading property instead.", true)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[MemberDesignTimeVisibility(false)]
		public bool Loading => base.IsLoading;

		public event ObjectChangeEventHandler Changed
		{
			add
			{
				AddChangedEventHandler(this, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				RemoveChangedEventHandler(this, value);
			}
		}

		void IEditableObject.BeginEdit()
		{
			BeginEdit();
		}

		void IEditableObject.EndEdit()
		{
			EndEdit();
		}

		void IEditableObject.CancelEdit()
		{
			CancelEdit();
		}

		protected void RaiseChangeEvent(ObjectChangeEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseChangedEvent(this, args);
		}

		private bool GetState(ObjectState state)
		{
			return (_state & state) == state;
		}

		private void SetState(ObjectState state, bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				_state |= state;
			}
			else
			{
				_state &= ~state;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void BeginEdit()
		{
			if (!GetState(ObjectState.Editing))
			{
				SetState(ObjectState.Editing, value: true);
				SetState(ObjectState.Changed, value: false);
				if (!base.Session.IsDesignMode)
				{
					SaveState();
				}
				TriggerObjectChangedCached(ObjectChangeReason.BeginEdit);
			}
		}

		private void SaveState()
		{
			_values = new List<object>();
			ObjectSet objects = new ObjectSet();
			SaveState(this, objects);
		}

		private bool IsGoodForIEditableObjectSaveRestoreState(XPMemberInfo mi)
		{
			if (!mi.IsReadOnly && !(mi is ServiceField))
			{
				return !mi.IsFetchOnly;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SaveState(object target, ObjectSet objects)
		{
			if (target == null || objects.Contains(target))
			{
				return;
			}
			objects.Add(target);
			XPClassInfo classInfo = base.Session.GetClassInfo(target);
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
			{
				if (IsGoodForIEditableObjectSaveRestoreState(persistentProperty))
				{
					if (persistentProperty.IsDelayed)
					{
						XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(target, persistentProperty);
						_values.Add(delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded);
						_values.Add(delayedPropertyContainer.InternalValue);
					}
					else
					{
						_values.Add(persistentProperty.GetValue(target));
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in classInfo.ObjectProperties)
			{
				if (objectProperty.IsAggregated)
				{
					SaveState(objectProperty.GetValue(target), objects);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RestoreState()
		{
			int index = 0;
			ObjectSet objects = new ObjectSet();
			SessionStateStack.Enter(base.Session, SessionState.CancelEdit);
			try
			{
				RestoreState(this, ref index, objects);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(base.Session, SessionState.CancelEdit);
			}
			base.Session.TriggerObjectsLoaded(objects);
			_values = null;
		}

		private void RestoreState(object target, ref int index, ObjectSet objects)
		{
			if (target == null || objects.Contains(target))
			{
				return;
			}
			objects.Add(target);
			XPClassInfo classInfo = base.Session.GetClassInfo(target);
			base.Session.TriggerObjectLoading(target);
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
			{
				if (!IsGoodForIEditableObjectSaveRestoreState(persistentProperty))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (persistentProperty.IsDelayed)
				{
					XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(target, persistentProperty);
					bool flag = (bool)_values[index++];
					object obj = _values[index++];
					if (flag)
					{
						delayedPropertyContainer.Value = obj;
					}
					else
					{
						delayedPropertyContainer.InternalValue = obj;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					persistentProperty.SetValue(target, _values[index++]);
				}
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in classInfo.ObjectProperties)
			{
				if (objectProperty.IsAggregated)
				{
					RestoreState(objectProperty.GetValue(target), ref index, objects);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void EndEdit()
		{
			if (GetState(ObjectState.Editing))
			{
				ObjectState state = _state;
				List<object> values = _values;
				if (GetState(ObjectState.Changed) || base.Session.IsNewObject(this))
				{
					SetState(ObjectState.NeedSaveAtTheEndOfEndEdit, value: true);
				}
				SetState(ObjectState.Editing, value: false);
				SetState(ObjectState.Changed, value: false);
				_values = null;
				try
				{
					TriggerObjectChangedCached(ObjectChangeReason.EndEdit);
					if (GetState(ObjectState.NeedSaveAtTheEndOfEndEdit))
					{
						SetState(ObjectState.NeedSaveAtTheEndOfEndEdit, value: false);
						DoEndEditAction();
					}
					return;
				}
				catch
				{
					_state = state;
					_values = values;
					throw;
				}
			}
			TriggerObjectChangedCached(ObjectChangeReason.EndEdit);
		}

		protected virtual void DoEndEditAction()
		{
			if (AutoSaveOnEndEdit && base.ClassInfo.IsPersistent)
			{
				Save();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CancelEdit()
		{
			if (GetState(ObjectState.Editing))
			{
				if (GetState(ObjectState.Changed))
				{
					RestoreState();
				}
				_values = null;
				SetState(ObjectState.Changed, value: false);
				SetState(ObjectState.Editing, value: false);
				TriggerObjectChangedCached(ObjectChangeReason.CancelEdit);
			}
		}

		protected void OnChanged()
		{
			OnChanged(null, null, null);
		}

		protected void OnChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			OnChanged(propertyName, null, null);
		}

		protected override void OnChanged(string propertyName, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (!base.IsLoading)
			{
				SetState(ObjectState.Changed, value: true);
				if (GetState(ObjectState.TrackChangedEvent))
				{
					SetState(ObjectState.ChangedInsideTrackChangedEvent, value: true);
				}
				base.OnChanged(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("Use GetPropertyValue<T> instead", true)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected object GetPropertyValueWithDefault(string propertyName, object defaultValue)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue(propertyName);
			if (propertyValue == null)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return propertyValue;
		}

		protected XPBaseObject()
			: this(XpoDefault.GetSession())
		{
		}

		protected XPBaseObject(Session session)
			: base(session)
		{
			CommonCtorCode();
		}

		protected XPBaseObject(Session session, XPClassInfo classInfo)
			: base(session, classInfo)
		{
			CommonCtorCode();
		}

		private void CommonCtorCode()
		{
			if (base.IsLoading)
			{
				SetState(ObjectState.SkipChangedOnNextLoaded, value: true);
			}
		}

		public static void AddChangedEventHandler(object persistentObject, ObjectChangeEventHandler handler)
		{
			if (!(persistentObject is XPBaseObject xPBaseObject) || xPBaseObject.Session.GetIdentityMapBehavior() == IdentityMapBehavior.Weak)
			{
				ObjectRecord.AddChangeHandler(persistentObject, handler);
			}
			else
			{
				xPBaseObject.handler = (ObjectChangeEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(xPBaseObject.handler, handler);
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveChangedEventHandler(object persistentObject, ObjectChangeEventHandler handler)
		{
			if (!(persistentObject is XPBaseObject xPBaseObject))
			{
				ObjectRecord.RemoveChangeHandler(persistentObject, handler);
			}
			else if (!xPBaseObject.IsInvalidated)
			{
				if (xPBaseObject.Session.GetIdentityMapBehavior() == IdentityMapBehavior.Weak)
				{
					ObjectRecord.RemoveChangeHandler(persistentObject, handler);
				}
				else
				{
					xPBaseObject.handler = (ObjectChangeEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(xPBaseObject.handler, handler);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void AddChangedEventHandler(object persistentObject, IObjectChange handler)
		{
			if (!(persistentObject is XPBaseObject xPBaseObject) || xPBaseObject.Session.GetIdentityMapBehavior() == IdentityMapBehavior.Weak)
			{
				ObjectRecord.AddChangeHandler(persistentObject, ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(handler));
			}
			else
			{
				xPBaseObject.handler = (ObjectChangeEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(xPBaseObject.handler, new ObjectChangeEventHandler(handler.OnObjectChanged));
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveChangedEventHandler(object persistentObject, IObjectChange handler)
		{
			if (!(persistentObject is XPBaseObject xPBaseObject))
			{
				ObjectRecord.RemoveChangeHandler(persistentObject, ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(handler));
			}
			else if (!xPBaseObject.IsInvalidated)
			{
				if (xPBaseObject.Session.GetIdentityMapBehavior() == IdentityMapBehavior.Weak)
				{
					ObjectRecord.RemoveChangeHandler(persistentObject, ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(handler));
				}
				else
				{
					xPBaseObject.handler = (ObjectChangeEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(xPBaseObject.handler, new ObjectChangeEventHandler(handler.OnObjectChanged));
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void TriggerObjectChanged(ObjectChangeEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseChangeEvent(args);
			if (!IsInvalidated)
			{
				base.TriggerObjectChanged(args);
			}
		}

		public static void RaiseChangedEvent(object persistentObject, ObjectChangeEventArgs args)
		{
			if (!(persistentObject is XPBaseObject xPBaseObject) || xPBaseObject.Session.GetIdentityMapBehavior() == IdentityMapBehavior.Weak)
			{
				ObjectRecord.OnChange(persistentObject, persistentObject, args);
			}
			else if (xPBaseObject.handler != null)
			{
				xPBaseObject.handler(persistentObject, args);
			}
		}

		public void Save()
		{
			base.Session.Save(this);
		}

		public void Delete()
		{
			base.Session.Delete(this);
		}

		public void Reload()
		{
			base.Session.Reload(this);
		}

		int IComparable.CompareTo(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is XPBaseObject xPBaseObject))
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if ((object)xPBaseObject == (object)this)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = Comparer.Default.Compare(base.Session.GetKeyValue(this), base.Session.GetKeyValue(xPBaseObject));
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			bool flag = base.Session.IsNewObject(this);
			bool flag2 = base.Session.IsNewObject(xPBaseObject);
			if (flag)
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					num = GetImmutableHashCode() - xPBaseObject.GetImmutableHashCode();
					if (num != 0)
					{
						return num;
					}
					return -1;
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		protected override void OnDeleting()
		{
			SetState(ObjectState.Changed, value: true);
			base.OnDeleting();
		}

		protected override void OnSaved()
		{
			SetState(ObjectState.NeedSaveAtTheEndOfEndEdit, value: false);
			base.OnSaved();
			TriggerObjectChangedCached(ObjectChangeReason.Reset);
		}

		protected override void OnLoaded()
		{
			base.OnLoaded();
			if (GetState(ObjectState.SkipChangedOnNextLoaded))
			{
				SetState(ObjectState.SkipChangedOnNextLoaded, value: false);
			}
			else
			{
				TriggerObjectChangedCached(ObjectChangeReason.Reset);
			}
		}

		protected XPCollection GetCollection([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			return (XPCollection)GetPropertyValue(propertyName);
		}

		protected XPCollection<T> GetCollection<T>([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null) where T : class
		{
			XPMemberInfo member = base.ClassInfo.GetMember(propertyName);
			base.CustomPropertyStore.TryGetValue(member, out var value);
			XPCollection<T> xPCollection = (XPCollection<T>)value;
			if (xPCollection == null)
			{
				xPCollection = CreateCollection<T>(member);
				base.CustomPropertyStore[member] = xPCollection;
			}
			return xPCollection;
		}

			member.SetValue(this, newValue);
		}

		}

			base.Invalidate(disposing);
			handler = null;
		}

		public object Evaluate(CriteriaOperator expression)
		{
			return ((ExpressionEvaluator)new XpoExpressionEvaluator(base.Session, base.ClassInfo.GetEvaluatorContextDescriptor(), expression, base.Session.CaseSensitive, (ICollection<ICustomFunctionOperator>)base.Session.Dictionary.CustomFunctionOperators, (ICollection<ICustomAggregate>)base.Session.Dictionary.CustomAggregates)).Evaluate((object)this);
		}

		public bool Fit(CriteriaOperator condition)
		{
			return ((ExpressionEvaluator)new XpoExpressionEvaluator(base.Session, base.ClassInfo.GetEvaluatorContextDescriptor(), condition, base.Session.CaseSensitive, (ICollection<ICustomFunctionOperator>)base.Session.Dictionary.CustomFunctionOperators, (ICollection<ICustomAggregate>)base.Session.Dictionary.CustomAggregates)).Fit((object)this);
		}

		public object Evaluate(string expression)
		{
			return Evaluate(CriteriaOperator.Parse(expression, new object[0]));
		}

		public bool Fit(string condition)
		{
			return Fit(CriteriaOperator.Parse(condition, new object[0]));
		}

		public object EvaluateAlias([CallerMemberName] string memberName = null)
		{
			XPMemberInfo member = base.ClassInfo.GetMember(memberName);
			PersistentAliasAttribute persistentAliasAttribute = (PersistentAliasAttribute)member.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(PersistentAliasAttribute));
			return Evaluate(persistentAliasAttribute.Criteria);
		}

		{
			if (!base.IsLoading)
			{
				OnChanged(member.Name, oldValue, newValue);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void FireChangedByXPPropertyDescriptor(string memberName)
		{
			if (!GetState(ObjectState.TrackChangedEvent) || !GetState(ObjectState.ChangedInsideTrackChangedEvent))
			{
				OnChanged(memberName);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void BeforeChangeByXPPropertyDescriptor()
		{
			if (GetState(ObjectState.Editing))
			{
				TriggerObjectChangedCached(ObjectChangeReason.BeforePropertyDescriptorChangeWithinBeginEdit);
			}
			SetState(ObjectState.TrackChangedEvent, value: true);
		}

		protected virtual void AfterChangeByXPPropertyDescriptor()
		{
			SetState(ObjectState.TrackChangedEvent | ObjectState.ChangedInsideTrackChangedEvent, value: false);
		}

		void IXPReceiveOnChangedFromXPPropertyDescriptor.FireChangedByXPPropertyDescriptor(string memberName)
		{
			FireChangedByXPPropertyDescriptor(memberName);
		}

		void IXPReceiveOnChangedFromXPPropertyDescriptor.BeforeChangeByXPPropertyDescriptor()
		{
			BeforeChangeByXPPropertyDescriptor();
		}

		void IXPReceiveOnChangedFromXPPropertyDescriptor.AfterChangeByXPPropertyDescriptor()
		{
			AfterChangeByXPPropertyDescriptor();
		}
	}

	public class XPDelayedProperty
	{
		private object _value;

		private bool isLoaded;

		private object owner;

		private XPMemberInfo property;

		private Session session;

		private bool _IsChanged;

		internal object InternalValue
		{
			get
			{
				return _value;
			}
			set
			{
				isLoaded = false;
				_IsChanged = false;
				_value = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the value of the property which is delayed for loading.")]
		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				LoadValue();
				return _value;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets whether the property’s value remains unassigned after the persistent object has been loaded from the data store.")]
		public bool IsLoaded => isLoaded;

		[Description("Gets the property value’s modified status.")]
		public bool IsModified => _IsChanged;

		public XPDelayedProperty()
		{
		}

		internal XPDelayedProperty(Session session, object theObject, XPMemberInfo mi)
		{
			this.session = session;
			owner = theObject;
			property = mi;
		}

		internal static string GetGroupName(XPMemberInfo mi)
		{
			return ((DelayedAttribute)mi.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(DelayedAttribute))).GroupName;
		}

		internal static bool UpdateModifiedOnly(XPMemberInfo mi)
		{
			return ((DelayedAttribute)mi.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(DelayedAttribute))).UpdateModifiedOnly;
		}

		internal static XPDelayedProperty GetDelayedPropertyContainer(object theObject, XPMemberInfo mi)
		{
			DelayedAttribute delayedAttribute = (DelayedAttribute)mi.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(DelayedAttribute));
			if ((delayedAttribute.FieldName == null || delayedAttribute.FieldName.Length == 0) && theObject is IXPCustomPropertyStore)
			{
				return (XPDelayedProperty)((IXPCustomPropertyStore)theObject).GetCustomPropertyValue(mi);
			}
			XPMemberInfo member = mi.Owner.GetMember(delayedAttribute.FieldName);
			if (!(member.GetValue(theObject) is XPDelayedProperty result))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("Object_DelayedPropertyDoesNotContainProperObject", theObject.GetType().FullName, delayedAttribute.FieldName));
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static void Init(Session session, object theObject, XPMemberInfo mi, object val)
		{
			XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = GetDelayedPropertyContainer(theObject, mi);
			delayedPropertyContainer.property = mi;
			delayedPropertyContainer.owner = theObject;
			delayedPropertyContainer._value = val;
			delayedPropertyContainer.isLoaded = false;
			delayedPropertyContainer.session = session;
		}

		internal static void PreFetchRefProps(Session session, IEnumerable objects, XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			//IL_00ed: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fc: Expected O, but got Unknown
			XPClassInfo referenceType = property.ReferenceType;
			Dictionary<object, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, object>();
			List<XPDelayedProperty> list = new List<XPDelayedProperty>();
			foreach (object @object in objects)
			{
				XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = GetDelayedPropertyContainer(@object, property);
				if (delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded)
				{
					continue;
				}
				object value = delayedPropertyContainer._value;
				if (value == null)
				{
					delayedPropertyContainer.isLoaded = true;
					continue;
				}
				object loadedObjectByKey = session.GetLoadedObjectByKey(referenceType, value);
				if (loadedObjectByKey != null)
				{
					delayedPropertyContainer._value = loadedObjectByKey;
					delayedPropertyContainer.isLoaded = true;
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary[value] = value;
					list.Add(delayedPropertyContainer);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList list2 = new List<object>(dictionary.Keys);
			List<ObjectsQuery> list3 = new List<ObjectsQuery>();
			int terminalInSize;
			for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i += terminalInSize)
			{
				terminalInSize = XpoDefault.GetTerminalInSize(list2.Count - i);
				list3.Add(new ObjectsQuery(referenceType, (CriteriaOperator)new InOperator(referenceType.KeyProperty.Name, (IEnumerable)GetRangeHelper.GetRange(list2, i, terminalInSize)), null, 0, 0, null, force: false));
			}
			ICollection[] objects2 = session.GetObjects(list3.ToArray());
			foreach (XPDelayedProperty item in list)
			{
				item._value = session.GetLoadedObjectByKey(referenceType, item._value);
				item.isLoaded = true;
			}
			GC.KeepAlive(objects2);
		}

		internal static async Task PreFetchRefPropsAsync(Session session, IEnumerable objects, XPMemberInfo property, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			XPClassInfo refType = property.ReferenceType;
			Dictionary<object, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, object>();
			List<XPDelayedProperty> containers = new List<XPDelayedProperty>();
			foreach (object @object in objects)
			{
				XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = GetDelayedPropertyContainer(@object, property);
				if (delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded)
				{
					continue;
				}
				object value = delayedPropertyContainer._value;
				if (value == null)
				{
					delayedPropertyContainer.isLoaded = true;
					continue;
				}
				object loadedObjectByKey = session.GetLoadedObjectByKey(refType, value);
				if (loadedObjectByKey != null)
				{
					delayedPropertyContainer._value = loadedObjectByKey;
					delayedPropertyContainer.isLoaded = true;
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary[value] = value;
					containers.Add(delayedPropertyContainer);
				}
			}
			if (containers.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList list = new List<object>(dictionary.Keys);
			List<ObjectsQuery> list2 = new List<ObjectsQuery>();
			int terminalInSize;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i += terminalInSize)
			{
				terminalInSize = XpoDefault.GetTerminalInSize(list.Count - i);
				list2.Add(new ObjectsQuery(refType, (CriteriaOperator)new InOperator(refType.KeyProperty.Name, (IEnumerable)GetRangeHelper.GetRange(list, i, terminalInSize)), null, 0, 0, null, force: false));
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			ICollection[] obj = await session.GetObjectsAsync(list2.ToArray(), cancellationToken);
			foreach (XPDelayedProperty item in containers)
			{
				item._value = session.GetLoadedObjectByKey(refType, item._value);
				item.isLoaded = true;
			}
			GC.KeepAlive(obj);
		}

		internal static void PreFetchGenericProps(Session session, IEnumerable objects, XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (object @object in objects)
			{
				XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = GetDelayedPropertyContainer(@object, property);
				if (!delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded)
				{
					list.Add(@object);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ObjectDictionary<object> objectDictionary = session.LoadDelayedProperties(list, property);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<object, object> item in objectDictionary)
			{
				XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer2 = GetDelayedPropertyContainer(item.Key, property);
				delayedPropertyContainer2._value = item.Value;
				delayedPropertyContainer2.isLoaded = true;
			}
		}

		internal static async Task PreFetchGenericPropsAsync(Session session, IEnumerable objects, XPMemberInfo property, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (object @object in objects)
			{
				XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = GetDelayedPropertyContainer(@object, property);
				if (!delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded)
				{
					list.Add(@object);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<object, object> item in await session.LoadDelayedPropertiesAsync(list, property, cancellationToken))
			{
				XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer2 = GetDelayedPropertyContainer(item.Key, property);
				delayedPropertyContainer2._value = item.Value;
				delayedPropertyContainer2.isLoaded = true;
			}
		}

		private void LoadValue()
		{
			if (isLoaded || owner == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (session.IsNewObject(owner))
			{
				isLoaded = true;
				return;
			}
			XPClassInfo referenceType = property.ReferenceType;
			if (referenceType != null)
			{
				if (_value != null)
				{
					_value = session.GetObjectByKey(referenceType, _value);
				}
				isLoaded = true;
			}
			else
			{
				LoadDelayedGroup(session, owner, GetGroupName(property));
			}
		}

		private static void LoadDelayedGroup(Session session, object owner, string groupName)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = session.GetClassInfo(owner);
			MemberPathCollection memberPathCollection = new MemberPathCollection();
			List<XPDelayedProperty> list = new List<XPDelayedProperty>();
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
			{
				if (persistentProperty.IsDelayed && persistentProperty.ReferenceType == null && !(GetGroupName(persistentProperty) != groupName))
				{
					XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = GetDelayedPropertyContainer(owner, persistentProperty);
					if (!delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded)
					{
						memberPathCollection.Add(new MemberInfoCollection(classInfo, persistentProperty));
						list.Add(delayedPropertyContainer);
					}
				}
			}
			object[] array = session.LoadDelayedProperties(owner, memberPathCollection);
			for (int i = 0; i < memberPathCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				XPDelayedProperty xPDelayedProperty = list[i];
				xPDelayedProperty._value = array[i];
				xPDelayedProperty.isLoaded = true;
			}
		}

		internal bool SetValue(object newValue)
		{
			object value = Value;
			if (PersistentBase.CanSkipAssignment(value, newValue))
			{
				return false;
			}
			_value = newValue;
			isLoaded = true;
			_IsChanged = true;
			if (owner is IXPReceiveOnChangedFromDelayedProperty iXPReceiveOnChangedFromDelayedProperty)
			{
				iXPReceiveOnChangedFromDelayedProperty.FireChangedByDelayedPropertySetter(property, value, newValue);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void ResetIsModified()
		{
			_IsChanged = false;
		}
	}
