		public static string KeyToString(object key)
		{
			if (key == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ICollection collection = key as IdList;
			if (collection == null)
			{
				collection = new object[1] { key };
			}
			if (collection.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			foreach (object item in collection)
			{
				string text2 = SimpleKeyToString(item);
				if (text.Length > 0)
				{
					text += ",";
				}
				text += text2;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static object StringToKey(string s)
		{
			if (s == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (s.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ICollection collection = SplitStringToSimplePairs(s);
			IdList idList = new IdList();
			foreach (object[] item in collection)
			{
				idList.Add(SimpleStringToKey((string)item[0], (string)item[1]));
			}
			if (idList.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (idList.Count == 1)
			{
				return idList[0];
			}
			return idList;
		}

		private static ICollection SplitStringToSimplePairs(string s)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			CriteriaLexer val = new CriteriaLexer((TextReader)new StringReader(s));
			if (val.Advance())
			{
				while (true)
				{
					object currentValue = val.CurrentValue;
					OperandProperty val2 = (OperandProperty)((currentValue is OperandProperty) ? currentValue : null);
					if (val2 == null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException();
					}
					if (!val.Advance())
					{
						throw new ArgumentException();
					}
					object currentValue2 = val.CurrentValue;
					OperandValue val3 = (OperandValue)((currentValue2 is OperandValue) ? currentValue2 : null);
					if (val3 == null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException();
					}
					arrayList.Add(new object[2] { val2.PropertyName, val3.Value });
					if (!val.Advance())
					{
						break;
					}
					if (val.CurrentToken != 44)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException();
					}
					if (!val.Advance())
					{
						throw new ArgumentException();
					}
				}
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		private static string SimpleKeyToString(object key)
		{
			//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0074: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (key == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			string text;
			string text2;
			if (key is Guid)
			{
				text = "Guid";
				text2 = ((Guid)key/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString();
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(key is IConvertible))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException();
				}
				text = Type.GetTypeCode(key.GetType()).ToString();
				text2 = Convert.ToString(key, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			object obj = (object)new OperandProperty(text);
			object obj2 = (object)new OperandValue((object)text2);
			return obj.ToString() + obj2.ToString();
		}

		private static object SimpleStringToKey(string typeCodeString, string value)
		{
			if (typeCodeString == "Guid")
			{
				return new Guid(value);
			}
			TypeCode typeCode = (TypeCode)Enum.Parse(typeof(TypeCode), typeCodeString, ignoreCase: false);
			return Convert.ChangeType(value, typeCode, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}
	}
	public class PageSelector
	{
		private IList keys;

		private XPClassInfo objectClassInfo;

		private int currentPageBase = -1;

		private int currentPageSize = -1;

		private CriteriaOperator criteria;

		public XPClassInfo ObjectClassInfo => objectClassInfo;

		public int Count => keys.Count;

		public PageSelector(XPClassInfo objectClassInfo, IList keysList)
		{
			this.objectClassInfo = objectClassInfo;
			keys = keysList;
		}

		public PageSelector(Session session, XPClassInfo objectClassInfo, CriteriaOperator criteria, int topReturnedObjects, bool selectDeleted, SortingCollection sorting)
		{
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Expected O, but got Unknown
			this.objectClassInfo = objectClassInfo;
			lock (session)
			{
				keys = new List<object>();
				CriteriaOperatorCollection val = new CriteriaOperatorCollection();
				((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)val).Add((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(ObjectClassInfo.KeyProperty.Name));
				List<object[]> list = session.SelectData(ObjectClassInfo, val, criteria, selectDeleted, 0, topReturnedObjects, sorting);
				foreach (object[] item in list)
				{
					keys.Add(item[0]);
				}
			}
		}

		public CriteriaOperator GetPageCriteria(int pageBase, int pageSize)
		{
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0082: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0064: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (currentPageBase != pageBase || currentPageSize != pageSize)
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				for (int i = pageBase; i < pageBase + pageSize && i < Count; i++)
				{
					list.Add(keys[i]);
				}
				if (list.Count == 0)
				{
					criteria = (CriteriaOperator)new NullOperator(ObjectClassInfo.KeyProperty.Name);
				}
				else
				{
					criteria = (CriteriaOperator)new InOperator(ObjectClassInfo.KeyProperty.Name, (IEnumerable)list);
				}
				currentPageBase = pageBase;
				currentPageSize = pageSize;
			}
			return criteria;
		}

		public int GetElementsInPage(int pageBase, int pageSize)
		{
			int num = Count - pageBase;
			if (num > pageSize)
			{
				num = pageSize;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public ICollection FillCollectionWithPageVerified(Session session, SortingCollection sorting, int pageBase, int pageSize)
		{
			ICollection objects = session.GetObjects(objectClassInfo, GetPageCriteria(pageBase, pageSize), sorting, 0, 0, selectDeleted: true, force: false);
			if (GetElementsInPage(pageBase, pageSize) != objects.Count)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Paging_EnumeratorObjectModifiedOrDeleted"));
			}
			return objects;
		}
	}
	[DXToolboxItem(true)]
	[ToolboxTabName("DX.23.2: ORM Components")]
	[DefaultProperty("Collection")]
	[Description("Allows the contents of an XPCollection to be split into pages. Can serve as a data source for data-aware controls.")]
	[ToolboxBitmap(typeof(XPPageSelector))]
	[Designer("DevExpress.Xpo.Design.XPPageSelectorDesigner, DevExpress.Xpo.v23.2.Design, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.ComponentModel.Design.IDesigner, System, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089")]
	public class XPPageSelector : Component, IListSource
	{
		private XPBaseCollection collection;

		private PageSelector pageSelector;

		private int pageSize = 10;

		private int currentPage;

		private int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (pageSelector == null)
				{
					((IListSource)this).GetList();
				}
				if (pageSelector == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return pageSelector.Count;
			}
		}

		bool IListSource.ContainsListCollection => false;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public int CurrentPage
		{
			get
			{
				return currentPage;
			}
			set
			{
				if (currentPage != value)
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("CurrentPage", value, Res.GetString("Paging_CurrentPageShouldBeGreaterOrEqualZero"));
					}
					if (value >= PageCount)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("CurrentPage", value, Res.GetString("Paging_CurrentPageShouldBeLessThanPageCount"));
					}
					currentPage = value;
					UpdateCollection();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public int PageCount => (Count - 1) / PageSize + 1;

		[Description("Gets or sets the maximum number of persistent objects that can be contained in a single page.")]
		[DefaultValue(10)]
		[Category("Data")]
		public int PageSize
		{
			get
			{
				return pageSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value <= 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("PageSize", value, Res.GetString("Paging_PageSizeShouldBeGreaterThanZero"));
				}
				if (pageSize != value)
				{
					pageSize = value;
					currentPage = 0;
					UpdateCollection();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the collection of persistent objects that the page selector is bound to.")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[Category("Data")]
		public XPBaseCollection Collection
		{
			get
			{
				return collection;
			}
			set
			{
				collection = value;
			}
		}

		IList IListSource.GetList()
		{
			if (collection != null && !collection.Session.IsDesignMode)
			{
				if (pageSelector == null)
				{
					pageSelector = new PageSelector(collection.Session, collection.GetObjectClassInfo(), collection.Criteria, collection.TopReturnedObjects, collection.SelectDeleted, collection.Sorting);
				}
				UpdateCollection();
			}
			return collection;
		}

		private void UpdateCollection()
		{
			if (pageSelector != null)
			{
				collection.LoadingEnabled = false;
				((IList)collection).Clear();
				collection.BaseAddRange(pageSelector.FillCollectionWithPageVerified(collection.Session, collection.Sorting, CurrentPage * PageSize, PageSize));
			}
		}

		public XPPageSelector()
		{
		}

		public XPPageSelector(IContainer container)
			: this()
		{
			container.Add(this);
		}

		public XPPageSelector(XPBaseCollection collection)
		{
			Collection = collection;
		}
	}
	public class XPCursor : ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		private Session session;

		private int topReturnedObjects;

		private XPClassInfo objInfo;

		private SortingCollection sorting;

		private CriteriaOperator criteria;

		private int pageSize = 512;

		private bool selectDeleted;

		private PageSelector pageSelector;

		private bool IsLoaded => pageSelector != null;

		[Description("Gets the number of persistent objects within the collection.")]
		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsLoaded)
				{
					Load();
				}
				return pageSelector.Count;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the maximum number of persistent objects that can be contained in a single page.")]
		public int PageSize
		{
			get
			{
				return pageSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value <= 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("PageSize", value, Res.GetString("Paging_PageSizeShouldBeGreaterThanZero"));
				}
				pageSize = value;
			}
		}

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => false;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => this;

		[Description("Provides access to the collection whose elements identify the sorted columns in a data store.")]
		public SortingCollection Sorting => sorting;

		[Description("Gets or sets the maximum number of objects retrieved by the XPCursor collection.")]
		public int TopReturnedObjects
		{
			get
			{
				return topReturnedObjects;
			}
			set
			{
				topReturnedObjects = value;
				Clear();
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the metadata information for the persistent objects retrieved by the collection.")]
		public XPClassInfo ObjectClassInfo => objInfo;

		[Description("Gets the session which is used to load and save persistent objects.")]
		public Session Session => session;

		[Description("Gets or sets whether deleted objects are retrieved by the XPCursor the next time it is reloaded.")]
		public bool SelectDeleted
		{
			get
			{
				return selectDeleted;
			}
			set
			{
				if (selectDeleted != value)
				{
					selectDeleted = value;
					Clear();
				}
			}
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					object current = enumerator.Current;
					array.SetValue(current, index++);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			if (!IsLoaded)
			{
				Load();
			}
			return new XPCursorEnumerator(Session, ObjectClassInfo, pageSelector, PageSize, Sorting);
		}

		protected void Clear()
		{
			pageSelector = null;
		}

		public XPCursor(Type objType)
			: this(objType, null)
		{
		}

		public XPCursor(Type objType, CriteriaOperator theCriteria, params SortProperty[] sortProperties)
			: this(XpoDefault.GetSession(), objType, theCriteria, sortProperties)
		{
		}

		public XPCursor(Session session, Type objType)
			: this(session, objType, null, (SortProperty[])(object)new SortProperty[0])
		{
		}

		public XPCursor(Session session, XPClassInfo objType)
			: this(session, objType, (CriteriaOperator)null)
		{
		}

		public XPCursor(Session session, Type objType, CriteriaOperator theCriteria, params SortProperty[] sortProperties)
			: this(session, session.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(objType), theCriteria, sortProperties)
		{
		}

		public XPCursor(Session session, XPClassInfo objType, CriteriaOperator theCriteria)
		{
			this.session = session;
			sorting = new SortingCollection();
			objInfo = objType;
			criteria = theCriteria;
		}

		public XPCursor(Session session, XPClassInfo objType, CriteriaOperator theCriteria, params SortProperty[] sortProperties)
			: this(session, objType, theCriteria)
		{
			Sorting.AddRange(sortProperties);
		}

		public XPCursor(Session session, XPClassInfo objType, IList keysList)
			: this(session, objType, (CriteriaOperator)null)
		{
			pageSelector = new PageSelector(objType, keysList);
		}

		public XPCursor(Session session, Type objType, IList keysList)
			: this(session, session.GetClassInfo(objType), keysList)
		{
		}

		protected void Load()
		{
			pageSelector = new PageSelector(Session, ObjectClassInfo, criteria, TopReturnedObjects, SelectDeleted, Sorting);
		}
	}

		private Res()
		{
			manager = new ResourceManager("DevExpress.Xpo.Messages", GetType().Assembly);
		}

		private static Res GetLoader()
		{
			if (res == null)
			{
				lock (typeof(Res))
				{
					if (res == null)
					{
						res = new Res();
					}
				}
			}
			return res;
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetLoader()?.manager.GetString(name, culture);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			Res loader = GetLoader();
			if (loader == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = loader.manager.GetString(name, culture);
			if (args != null && args.Length != 0)
			{
				return string.Format(text, args);
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return GetString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetString(null, name, args);
		}
	}

	[Serializable]
	[XmlType("XPClassInfo")]
	public class XPClassInfoStub
	{
		private string className;

		[NonSerialized]
		private Dictionary<string, int> members;

		private string keyFieldName;

		private string optimisticLockFieldName;

		private string optimisticLockFieldInDataLayerName;

		private XPClassInfoStubMemberItem[] membersList;

		[Description("This member supports the internal infrastructure and is not intended to be used directly from your code.")]
		public string ClassName
		{
			get
			{
				return className;
			}
			set
			{
				className = value;
			}
		}

		[XmlIgnore]
		private Dictionary<string, int> Members
		{
			get
			{
				if (members == null)
				{
					members = GetMembers(membersList);
				}
				return members;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XmlArray(ElementName = "Members", IsNullable = true)]
		public XPClassInfoStubMemberItem[] MembersList
		{
			get
			{
				return membersList;
			}
			set
			{
				membersList = value;
				members = null;
			}
		}

		[Description("This member supports the internal infrastructure and is not intended to be used directly from your code.")]
		public string KeyFieldName
		{
			get
			{
				return keyFieldName;
			}
			set
			{
				keyFieldName = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("This member supports the internal infrastructure and is not intended to be used directly from your code.")]
		public string OptimisticLockFieldName
		{
			get
			{
				return optimisticLockFieldName;
			}
			set
			{
				optimisticLockFieldName = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("This member supports the internal infrastructure and is not intended to be used directly from your code.")]
		public string OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayerName
		{
			get
			{
				return optimisticLockFieldInDataLayerName;
			}
			set
			{
				optimisticLockFieldInDataLayerName = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("This member supports the internal infrastructure and is not intended to be used directly from your code.")]
		public int MemberCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (membersList != null)
				{
					return membersList.Length;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public XPClassInfoStub()
			: this(string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public XPClassInfoStub(string className)
		{
			this.className = className;
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, int> GetMembers(XPClassInfoStubMemberItem[] newMembersList)
		{
			Dictionary<string, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, int>();
			if (newMembersList != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < newMembersList.Length; i++)
				{
					dictionary.Add(newMembersList[i].Name, newMembersList[i].Index);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public int GetMemberIndex(string memberName, bool raiseException)
		{
			if (!Members.TryGetValue(memberName, out var value))
			{
				if (raiseException)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("ObjectLayer_MemberNotFound", className, memberName));
				}
				return -1;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public object GetMemberValue(XPObjectStub obj, string memberName)
		{
			if (memberName == keyFieldName)
			{
				return obj.Key;
			}
			return obj.Data[GetMemberIndex(memberName, raiseException: true)];
		}

		public void SetMemberValue(XPObjectStub obj, string memberName, object value)
		{
			if (memberName == keyFieldName)
			{
				obj.Key = value;
				return;
			}
			int memberIndex = GetMemberIndex(memberName, raiseException: true);
			obj.Data[memberIndex] = value;
			obj.Changed[memberIndex] = true;
		}

		public object GetMemberOldValue(XPObjectStub obj, string memberName)
		{
			if (memberName == keyFieldName)
			{
				return obj.Key;
			}
			if (obj.OldData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return obj.OldData[GetMemberIndex(memberName, raiseException: true)].Data;
		}

		public object GetMemberHasOldValue(XPObjectStub obj, string memberName)
		{
			if (memberName == keyFieldName)
			{
				return obj.Key;
			}
			if (obj.OldData == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return obj.OldData[GetMemberIndex(memberName, raiseException: true)] != null;
		}

		public void SetMemberOldValue(XPObjectStub obj, string memberName, object value)
		{
			if (!(memberName == keyFieldName))
			{
				int memberIndex = GetMemberIndex(memberName, raiseException: true);
				if (obj.OldData == null)
				{
					obj.OldData = new XPClassInfoStubOldValueContainer[obj.Data.Length];
				}
				obj.OldData[memberIndex] = new XPClassInfoStubOldValueContainer(value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsMemberChanged(XPObjectStub obj, string memberName)
		{
			if (memberName == keyFieldName)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return obj.Changed[GetMemberIndex(memberName, raiseException: true)];
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return className;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.GetHashCode<string>(className);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is XPClassInfoStub xPClassInfoStub))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return string.Equals(className, xPClassInfoStub.className);
		}

		public static XPClassInfoStub FromClassInfo(XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			XPClassInfoStub xPClassInfoStub = new XPClassInfoStub(classInfo.FullName);
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
			{
				if (!persistentProperty.IsKey)
				{
					list.Add(persistentProperty.Name);
				}
			}
			list.Sort();
			XPClassInfoStubMemberItem[] array = new XPClassInfoStubMemberItem[list.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new XPClassInfoStubMemberItem(list[i], i);
			}
			xPClassInfoStub.MembersList = array;
			xPClassInfoStub.KeyFieldName = classInfo.KeyProperty.Name;
			if (classInfo.OptimisticLockField != null)
			{
				xPClassInfoStub.optimisticLockFieldName = classInfo.OptimisticLockField.Name;
			}
			else
			{
				xPClassInfoStub.optimisticLockFieldName = null;
			}
			if (classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer != null)
			{
				xPClassInfoStub.optimisticLockFieldInDataLayerName = classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer.Name;
			}
			else
			{
				xPClassInfoStub.optimisticLockFieldInDataLayerName = null;
			}
			return xPClassInfoStub;
		}
	}

	public class XPObjectClassInfoStubCache : IXPDictionaryProvider
	{
		private readonly XPDictionary dictionary;

		private Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfoStub> classInfoDict;

		private Dictionary<string, XPClassInfo> classNameDict;

		private List<XPClassInfoStub> newItems;

		public XPDictionary Dictionary => dictionary;

		public XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(IXPDictionaryProvider dictionaryProvider)
		{
			dictionary = dictionaryProvider.Dictionary;
		}

		public XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(IXPDictionaryProvider dictionaryProvider, XPDictionaryStub dictionaryStub)
			: this(dictionaryProvider)
		{
			UpdateClasses(dictionaryStub);
		}

		public XPDictionaryStub GetNewDictionaryStub()
		{
			return new XPDictionaryStub((newItems == null) ? null : newItems.ToArray());
		}

		public void UpdateClasses(XPDictionaryStub dictionaryStub)
		{
			if (dictionaryStub != null && dictionaryStub.ClassInfoList != null)
			{
				if (classInfoDict == null)
				{
					classInfoDict = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfoStub>();
				}
				XPClassInfoStub[] classInfoList = dictionaryStub.ClassInfoList;
				foreach (XPClassInfoStub xPClassInfoStub in classInfoList)
				{
					XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(xPClassInfoStub.ClassName);
					classInfoDict[classInfo] = xPClassInfoStub;
				}
			}
		}

		public XPClassInfoStub GetStub(XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			if (classInfoDict == null)
			{
				classInfoDict = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfoStub>();
			}
			if (!classInfoDict.TryGetValue(classInfo, out var value))
			{
				if (newItems == null)
				{
					newItems = new List<XPClassInfoStub>();
				}
				value = XPClassInfoStub.FromClassInfo(classInfo);
				classInfoDict.Add(classInfo, value);
				newItems.Add(value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public XPClassInfo GetClassInfo(XPClassInfoStub classInfoStub)
		{
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(string.Empty, classInfoStub.ClassName);
			if (xPClassInfo == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("ObjectLayer_XPClassInfoNotFound", classInfoStub.ClassName));
			}
			return xPClassInfo;
		}

		public XPClassInfo GetClassInfo(string className)
		{
			if (classNameDict == null)
			{
				classNameDict = new Dictionary<string, XPClassInfo>();
			}
			if (!classNameDict.TryGetValue(className, out var value))
			{
				value = Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(string.Empty, className);
				if (value == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("ObjectLayer_XPClassInfoNotFound", className));
				}
				classNameDict.Add(className, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public XPClassInfoStub GetStub(string className)
		{
			return GetStub(GetClassInfo(className));
		}
	}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = HashCodeHelper.StartGeneric<int, Guid, object>(GetClassNameHashCode(), guid, optimisticLockFieldInDataLayer);
			for (int i = 0; i < data.Length; i++)
			{
				if (data[i] == null)
				{
					num = HashCodeHelper.Combine(num, 1);
				}
				else if (data[i] is XPObjectStub xPObjectStub)
				{
					num = HashCodeHelper.Combine(num, xPObjectStub.GetClassNameHashCode());
					num = HashCodeHelper.CombineGeneric<object>(num, xPObjectStub.Key);
				}
				else
				{
					num = HashCodeHelper.CombineGeneric<object>(num, data[i]);
				}
			}
			return HashCodeHelper.Finish(num);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)

			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < data.Length; i++)
			{
				XPObjectStub xPObjectStub2 = data[i] as XPObjectStub;
				XPObjectStub xPObjectStub3 = xPObjectStub.data[i] as XPObjectStub;
				if (xPObjectStub2 != null && xPObjectStub3 != null)
				{
					if (xPObjectStub2 != xPObjectStub3)
					{
						if (!string.Equals(xPObjectStub2.ClassName, xPObjectStub3.ClassName))
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (!object.Equals(xPObjectStub2.Key, xPObjectStub3.Key) && xPObjectStub2.Guid != xPObjectStub3.Guid && !xPObjectStub2.Equals(xPObjectStub3))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (!object.Equals(data[i], xPObjectStub.data[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return object.Equals(optimisticLockFieldInDataLayer, xPObjectStub.optimisticLockFieldInDataLayer);
		}

	public class SortingCollectionSerializer
	{
		private const string SortingCollectionSerializerV2Prefix = "XPOSCSV2";

		public static string[] Serialize(SortingCollection collection)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[] array = new string[collection.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < collection.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = Serialize(collection[i]);
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static SortingCollection Deserialize(string[] collection)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SortProperty[] array = (SortProperty[])(object)new SortProperty[collection.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < collection.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = Deserialize(collection[i]);
			}
			return new SortingCollection(array);
		}

		private static string Serialize(SortProperty property)
		{
			using StringWriter stringWriter = new StringWriter();
			stringWriter.WriteLine("XPOSCSV2");
			Cached.Serialize<SortProperty>((TextWriter)stringWriter, (object)property);
			return stringWriter.ToString();
		}

		private static SortProperty Deserialize(string strProperty)
		{
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (strProperty.StartsWith("XPOSCSV2", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				using (StringReader stringReader = new StringReader(strProperty))
				{
					stringReader.ReadLine();
					return Cached.Deserialize<SortProperty>((TextReader)stringReader);
				}
			}
			return new SortProperty(strProperty.Substring(1), (SortingDirection)(strProperty[0] != 'A'));
		}
	}

			void IObjectMap.Add(object theObject, object id)
			{
				if (!ContainsKey(id))
				{
					Add(id, theObject);
					return;
				}
				throw new ObjectCacheException(id, theObject, base[id]);
			}

			void IObjectMap.Remove(object id)
			{
				Remove(id);
			}

			public object Get(object id)
			{
				if (!TryGetValue(id, out var value))

					return null;

			}

		internal static NestedParentGuidMap GetNestedParentGuidMap(Session session)
		{
			object value = null;
			if (!((IWideDataStorage)session).TryGetWideDataItem(nestedParentGuidMapKeyObject, out value))
			{
				value = ((session.GetIdentityMapBehavior() != IdentityMapBehavior.Weak) ? new StrongNestedParentGuidMap(session) : new WeakNestedParentGuidMap(session));
				((IWideDataStorage)session).SetWideDataItem(nestedParentGuidMapKeyObject, value);
			}
			return (NestedParentGuidMap)value;
		}

		public ICollection[] LoadObjects(Session session, ObjectsQuery[] queries)
		{
			session.WaitForAsyncOperationEnd();
			XPObjectClassInfoStubCache xPObjectClassInfoStubCache = new XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(session);
			ObjectStubsQuery[] array = new ObjectStubsQuery[queries.Length];
			bool[] array2 = new bool[queries.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < queries.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new ObjectStubsQuery(queries[i], session, GetNestedParentGuidMap(session), xPObjectClassInfoStubCache);
				array2[i] = queries[i].Force;
			}

		private static void PrepareSelectDataResult(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, object[][] result)
		{
			if (properties == null || ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)properties).Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)properties).Count; i++)
			{
				CriteriaOperator obj = ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)properties)[i];
				OperandProperty val = (OperandProperty)(object)((obj is OperandProperty) ? obj : null);
				if (val == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = MemberInfoCollection.ParsePath(classInfo, val.PropertyName);
				ValueConverter converter;
				if (memberInfoCollection.Count != 0 && (converter = memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1].Converter) != null)
				{
					foreach (object[] array in result)
					{
						array[i] = converter.ConvertFromStorageType(array[i]);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static CriteriaOperatorCollection PrepareProperties(Session session, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, XPObjectClassInfoStubCache classInfoCache, NestedParentGuidMap map)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CriteriaOperatorCollection val;
			if (properties == null || ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)properties).Count == 0)
			{
				val = properties;
			}
			else
			{
				val = new CriteriaOperatorCollection();
				foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)properties)
				{
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)val).Add(XPObjectStubCriteriaGenerator.GetStubCriteria(session, map, classInfoCache, item));
				}
			}
			return val;
		}

		private ICollection FilterListForDelete(Session session, NestedParentGuidMap map, ICollection fullListForDelete)
		{
			if (fullListForDelete == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (fullListForDelete.Count == 0)
			{
				return fullListForDelete;
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>(fullListForDelete.Count / 2);
			foreach (object item in fullListForDelete)
			{
				if (!session.IsNewObject(item) || !(map.GetParent(item) == Guid.Empty))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public void CommitChanges(Session session, ICollection fullListForDelete, ICollection completeListForSave)
		{
			NestedParentGuidMap nestedParentGuidMap = GetNestedParentGuidMap(session);
			ICollection collection = FilterListForDelete(session, nestedParentGuidMap, fullListForDelete);
			SessionStateStack.Enter(session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner);
			CommitObjectStubsResult[] array;
			try
			{
				XPObjectStubCache objCache = new XPObjectStubCache();
				XPObjectClassInfoStubCache xPObjectClassInfoStubCache = new XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(session);
				XPObjectStubCollection xPObjectStubCollection = new XPObjectStubCollection(collection.Count);
				XPObjectStubCollection xPObjectStubCollection2 = new XPObjectStubCollection(completeListForSave.Count);
				foreach (object item in collection)
				{
					if (session.LockingOption == LockingOption.None)
					{
						xPObjectStubCollection.Add(NestedStubWorksHelper.CreateParentStubObjectJustWithIdentities(session, nestedParentGuidMap, xPObjectClassInfoStubCache, item));
					}
					else
					{
						xPObjectStubCollection.Add(NestedStubWorksHelper.CreateParentStubObject(session, nestedParentGuidMap, objCache, xPObjectClassInfoStubCache, item));
					}
				}
				foreach (object item2 in completeListForSave)
				{
					xPObjectStubCollection2.Add(NestedStubWorksHelper.CreateParentStubObject(session, nestedParentGuidMap, objCache, xPObjectClassInfoStubCache, item2));
				}
				array = objectLayer.CommitObjects(xPObjectClassInfoStubCache.GetNewDictionaryStub(), xPObjectStubCollection, xPObjectStubCollection2, session.LockingOption);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner);
			}
			if (array != null)
			{
				SessionStateStack.Enter(session, SessionState.ApplyIdentities);
				try
				{
					int num = -1;
					foreach (object item3 in completeListForSave)
					{
						num++;
						CommitObjectStubsResult commitObjectStubsResult = array[num];
						if (commitObjectStubsResult != null)
						{
							XPClassInfo classInfo = session.GetClassInfo(item3);
							if (commitObjectStubsResult.Key != null)
							{
								classInfo.KeyProperty.SetValue(item3, commitObjectStubsResult.Key);
								SessionIdentityMap.RegisterObject(session, item3, classInfo.KeyProperty.ExpandId(commitObjectStubsResult.Key));
							}
							if (commitObjectStubsResult.OptimisticLockField != null)
							{
								classInfo.OptimisticLockField?.SetValue(item3, commitObjectStubsResult.OptimisticLockField);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					SessionStateStack.Leave(session, SessionState.ApplyIdentities);
				}
			}
			foreach (object item4 in fullListForDelete)
			{
				if (!session.IsNewObject(item4))
				{
					SessionIdentityMap.UnregisterObject(session, item4);
				}
				nestedParentGuidMap.KickOut(item4);
				if (item4 is IXPInvalidateableObject iXPInvalidateableObject)
				{
					iXPInvalidateableObject.Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		public async Task CommitChangesAsync(Session session, ICollection fullListForDelete, ICollection completeListForSave, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			NestedParentGuidMap map = GetNestedParentGuidMap(session);
			ICollection readyListForDelete = FilterListForDelete(session, map, fullListForDelete);
			int asyncOperationId = SessionStateStack.GetNewAsyncOperationId();
			await SessionStateStack.EnterAsync(session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			CommitObjectStubsResult[] results;
			try
			{
				XPObjectStubCache objCache = new XPObjectStubCache();
				XPObjectClassInfoStubCache ciCache = new XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(session);
				XPObjectStubCollection serializableListForDelete = new XPObjectStubCollection(readyListForDelete.Count);
				XPObjectStubCollection serializableListForSave = new XPObjectStubCollection(completeListForSave.Count);
				foreach (object item in readyListForDelete)
				{
					if (session.LockingOption == LockingOption.None)
					{
						serializableListForDelete.Add(NestedStubWorksHelper.CreateParentStubObjectJustWithIdentities(session, map, ciCache, item));
					}
					else
					{
						serializableListForDelete.Add(NestedStubWorksHelper.CreateParentStubObject(session, map, objCache, ciCache, item));
					}
				}
				foreach (object item2 in completeListForSave)
				{
					serializableListForSave.Add(NestedStubWorksHelper.CreateParentStubObject(session, map, objCache, ciCache, item2));
				}
				results = await Task.Run(delegate
				{
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					return objectLayer.CommitObjects(ciCache.GetNewDictionaryStub(), serializableListForDelete, serializableListForSave, session.LockingOption);
				}, cancellationToken);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner, asyncOperationId);
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			if (results != null)
			{
				await SessionStateStack.EnterAsync(session, SessionState.ApplyIdentities, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
				try
				{
					int num = -1;
					foreach (object item3 in completeListForSave)
					{
						num++;
						CommitObjectStubsResult commitObjectStubsResult = results[num];
						if (commitObjectStubsResult != null)
						{
							XPClassInfo classInfo = session.GetClassInfo(item3);
							if (commitObjectStubsResult.Key != null)
							{
								classInfo.KeyProperty.SetValue(item3, commitObjectStubsResult.Key);
								SessionIdentityMap.RegisterObject(session, item3, classInfo.KeyProperty.ExpandId(commitObjectStubsResult.Key));
							}
							if (commitObjectStubsResult.OptimisticLockField != null)
							{
								classInfo.OptimisticLockField?.SetValue(item3, commitObjectStubsResult.OptimisticLockField);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					SessionStateStack.Leave(session, SessionState.ApplyIdentities, asyncOperationId);
				}
			}
			foreach (object item4 in fullListForDelete)
			{
				if (!session.IsNewObject(item4))
				{
					SessionIdentityMap.UnregisterObject(session, item4);
				}
				map.KickOut(item4);
				if (item4 is IXPInvalidateableObject iXPInvalidateableObject)
				{
					iXPInvalidateableObject.Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		public object CommitChangesAsync(Session session, ICollection fullListForDelete, ICollection completeListForSave, AsyncCommitCallback callback)
		{
			SynchronizationContext syncContext = AsyncOperationsHelper.CaptureSynchronizationContextOrFail();
			if (callback == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			NestedParentGuidMap map = GetNestedParentGuidMap(session);
			ICollection collection = FilterListForDelete(session, map, fullListForDelete);
			XPObjectStubCache objCache = new XPObjectStubCache();
			XPObjectClassInfoStubCache ciCache = new XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(session);
			XPObjectStubCollection serializableListForDelete = new XPObjectStubCollection(collection.Count);
			XPObjectStubCollection serializableListForSave = new XPObjectStubCollection(completeListForSave.Count);
			SessionStateStack.Enter(session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner);
			try
			{
				foreach (object item in collection)
				{
					serializableListForDelete.Add(NestedStubWorksHelper.CreateParentStubObjectJustWithIdentities(session, map, ciCache, item));
				}
				foreach (object item2 in completeListForSave)
				{
					serializableListForSave.Add(NestedStubWorksHelper.CreateParentStubObject(session, map, objCache, ciCache, item2));
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner);
				throw;
			}
			return new AsyncRequest(syncContext, delegate
			{
				try
				{
					objectLayer.CommitObjects(ciCache.GetNewDictionaryStub(), serializableListForDelete, serializableListForSave, session.LockingOption);
					session.AsyncExecuteQueue.Invoke(syncContext, delegate
					{
						try
						{
							SessionStateStack.Leave(session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner);
							foreach (object item3 in fullListForDelete)
							{
								if (!session.IsNewObject(item3))
								{
									SessionIdentityMap.UnregisterObject(session, item3);
								}
								map.KickOut(item3);
								if (item3 is IXPInvalidateableObject iXPInvalidateableObject)
								{
									iXPInvalidateableObject.Invalidate();
								}
							}
							callback(null);
						}
						catch (Exception ex5)
						{
							try
							{
								callback(ex5);
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}
					}, null, operationEnd: true);
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					Exception ex3 = ex2;
					Exception ex4 = ex3;
					session.AsyncExecuteQueue.Invoke(syncContext, delegate
					{
						try
						{
							SessionStateStack.Leave(session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner);
							callback(ex4);
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					}, null, operationEnd: true);
				}
			}).Start(session.AsyncExecuteQueue);
		}

		public IObjectMap GetStaticCache(XPClassInfo info)
		{
			Dictionary<XPClassInfo, IObjectMap> dictionary = (Dictionary<XPClassInfo, IObjectMap>)GetObjectLayerWideData(staticCacheKey);
			if (dictionary == null)
			{
				dictionary = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, IObjectMap>();
				SetObjectLayerWideData(staticCacheKey, dictionary);
			}
			if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(info, out var value))
			{
				value = new StrongObjectMap();
				dictionary.Add(info, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		object ICommandChannel.Do(string command, object args)
		{
			if (nestedCommandChannel == null)
			{
				if (objectLayer == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported.");
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported by {objectLayer.GetType().FullName}.");
			}
			return nestedCommandChannel.Do(command, args);
		}

		Task<object> ICommandChannelAsync.DoAsync(string command, object args, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (nestedCommandChannelAsync == null)
			{
				if (nestedCommandChannel == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported.");
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Async_CommandChannelDoesNotImplementICommandChannelAsync", ((object)nestedCommandChannel).GetType().FullName));
			}
			return nestedCommandChannelAsync.DoAsync(command, args, cancellationToken);
		}

		public CommitObjectStubsResult[] CommitObjects(XPDictionaryStub dictionary, XPObjectStubCollection objectsForDelete, XPObjectStubCollection objectsForSave, LockingOption lockingOption)
		{
			//IL_0158: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XPObjectClassInfoStubCache xPObjectClassInfoStubCache = new XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(parentSession, dictionary);
			ObjectSet objectSet = new ObjectSet();
			XPClassInfo[] array = new XPClassInfo[objectsForDelete.Count];
			XPClassInfo[] array2 = new XPClassInfo[objectsForSave.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < objectsForDelete.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = xPObjectClassInfoStubCache.GetClassInfo(objectsForDelete[i].ClassName);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < objectsForSave.Count; j++)
			{
				array2[j] = xPObjectClassInfoStubCache.GetClassInfo(objectsForSave[j].ClassName);
			}
			if (lockingOption != LockingOption.None)
			{
				NestedStubWorksHelper.ValidateVersions(parentSession, map, xPObjectClassInfoStubCache, objectSet, array, objectsForDelete, lockingOption, objectsToDelete: true);
				NestedStubWorksHelper.ValidateVersions(parentSession, map, xPObjectClassInfoStubCache, objectSet, array2, objectsForSave, lockingOption, objectsToDelete: false);
			}
			CommitChangesMode commitChangesMode;
			if (!parentSession.InTransaction)
			{
				commitChangesMode = ((!parentSession.IsUnitOfWork) ? CommitChangesMode.NotInTransactionSession : CommitChangesMode.NotInTransactionUnitOfWork);
				parentSession.BeginTransaction();
			}
			else
			{
				commitChangesMode = CommitChangesMode.InTransaction;
			}
			SessionStateStack.Enter(parentSession, SessionState.ReceivingObjectsFromNestedUow);
			switch (commitChangesMode)
			{
			case CommitChangesMode.InTransaction:
			case CommitChangesMode.NotInTransactionUnitOfWork:
				Commit(xPObjectClassInfoStubCache, objectsForDelete, objectsForSave, array, array2);
				break;
			case CommitChangesMode.NotInTransactionSession:
				try
				{
					Commit(xPObjectClassInfoStubCache, objectsForDelete, objectsForSave, array, array2);
					parentSession.CommitTransaction();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (parentSession.InTransaction)
					{
						try
						{
							parentSession.RollbackTransaction();
						}
						catch (Exception ex2)
						{
							throw new ExceptionBundleException(new Exception[2] { ex, ex2 });
						}
					}
					throw;
				}
				break;
			}
			GC.KeepAlive(objectSet);
			if (ThroughCommitMode && (commitChangesMode == CommitChangesMode.NotInTransactionUnitOfWork || commitChangesMode == CommitChangesMode.InTransaction))
			{
				if (parentSession.InTransaction)
				{
					parentSession.CommitTransaction();
				}
				CommitObjectStubsResult[] array3 = null;
				object[] parentObjects = NestedStubWorksHelper.GetParentObjects(parentSession, map, array2, objectsForSave);
				for (int k = 0; k < objectsForSave.Count; k++)
				{
					XPObjectStub xPObjectStub = objectsForSave[k];
					XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = array2[k];
					object obj = parentObjects[k];
					if (obj == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					object obj2 = (xPObjectStub.IsNew ? xPClassInfo.KeyProperty.GetValue(obj) : null);
					object obj3 = ((xPClassInfo.OptimisticLockField == null) ? null : xPClassInfo.OptimisticLockField.GetValue(obj));
					if (obj2 != null || obj3 != null)
					{
						if (array3 == null)
						{
							array3 = new CommitObjectStubsResult[objectsForSave.Count];
						}
						array3[k] = new CommitObjectStubsResult(obj2, obj3);
					}
				}
				return array3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void Commit(XPObjectClassInfoStubCache ciCache, XPObjectStubCollection objectsForDelete, XPObjectStubCollection objectsForSave, XPClassInfo[] classInfoForDelete, XPClassInfo[] classInfoForSave)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			bool flag = true;
			try
			{
				NestedStubWorksHelper.CommitDeletedObjects(parentSession, map, ciCache, classInfoForDelete, objectsForDelete);
				list.AddRange(NestedStubWorksHelper.CreateParentObjects(parentSession, map, classInfoForSave, objectsForSave));
				if (IsAuditEnabled(parentSession))
				{
					SessionStateStack.Leave(parentSession, SessionState.ReceivingObjectsFromNestedUow);
					flag = false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < objectsForSave.Count; i++)
				{
					NestedStubWorksHelper.CommitObjectProperties(parentSession, map, ciCache, classInfoForSave[i], objectsForSave[i], list[i]);
				}
				parentSession.Save(list);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					SessionStateStack.Leave(parentSession, SessionState.ReceivingObjectsFromNestedUow);
				}
			}
			parentSession.TriggerObjectsLoaded(list);
		}

		public object[][] SelectData(XPDictionaryStub dictionary, ObjectStubsQuery query, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties, CriteriaOperator groupCriteria)
		{
			XPObjectClassInfoStubCache xPObjectClassInfoStubCache = new XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(parentSession, dictionary);
			XPClassInfo classInfo = xPObjectClassInfoStubCache.GetClassInfo(query.ClassInfo);
			CriteriaOperator criteria = XPObjectStubCriteriaGenerator.GetSessionCriteria(parentSession, map, xPObjectClassInfoStubCache, query.Criteria);
			SortingCollection sorting = query.Sorting;
			SelectingData(classInfo, ref properties, ref criteria, ref groupProperties, ref groupCriteria, ref sorting);
			List<object[]> data = parentSession.SelectData(classInfo, properties, criteria, groupProperties, groupCriteria, query.SelectDeleted, query.SkipSelectedRecords, query.TopSelectedRecords, sorting);
			SelectedData((IList<CriteriaOperator>)properties, ref data);
			if (properties != null && ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)properties).Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)properties).Count; i++)
				{
					CriteriaOperator obj = ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)properties)[i];
					OperandProperty val = (OperandProperty)(object)((obj is OperandProperty) ? obj : null);
					if (val == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = MemberInfoCollection.ParsePath(classInfo, val.PropertyName);
					ValueConverter converter;
					if (memberInfoCollection.Count != 0 && (converter = memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1].Converter) != null)
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < data.Count; j++)
						{
							object[] array = data[j];
							array[i] = converter.ConvertToStorageType(array[i]);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return data.ToArray();
		}

		public SerializableObjectLayerResult<XPObjectStubCollection> LoadCollectionObjects(XPDictionaryStub dictionary, string refPropertyName, XPObjectStub ownerObject)
		{
			XPObjectClassInfoStubCache xPObjectClassInfoStubCache = new XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(parentSession, dictionary);
			XPObjectStubCache objCache = new XPObjectStubCache();
			XPClassInfo classInfo = xPObjectClassInfoStubCache.GetClassInfo(ownerObject.ClassName);
			object parentObject = NestedStubWorksHelper.GetParentObject(parentSession, map, classInfo, ownerObject);
			if (parentObject == null)
			{
				return new SerializableObjectLayerResult<XPObjectStubCollection>(null, new XPObjectStubCollection(0));
			}
			XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = classInfo.FindMember(refPropertyName);
			XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)xPMemberInfo.GetValue(parentObject);
			xPBaseCollection.Load();
			XPObjectStubCollection xPObjectStubCollection = new XPObjectStubCollection(xPBaseCollection.Count);
			foreach (object intObj in xPBaseCollection.Helper.IntObjList)
			{
				xPObjectStubCollection.Add(NestedStubWorksHelper.CreateNestedStubObject(parentSession, map, objCache, xPObjectClassInfoStubCache, intObj));
			}
			return new SerializableObjectLayerResult<XPObjectStubCollection>(xPObjectClassInfoStubCache.GetNewDictionaryStub(), xPObjectStubCollection);
		}

		public PurgeResult Purge()
		{
			return parentSession.PurgeDeletedObjects();
		}

		public SerializableObjectLayerResult<object[]> LoadDelayedProperties(XPDictionaryStub dictionary, XPObjectStub theObject, string[] props)
		{
			XPObjectStubCache objCache = new XPObjectStubCache();
			XPObjectClassInfoStubCache xPObjectClassInfoStubCache = new XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(parentSession, dictionary);
			XPClassInfo classInfo = xPObjectClassInfoStubCache.GetClassInfo(theObject.ClassName);
			object parentObject = NestedStubWorksHelper.GetParentObject(parentSession, map, classInfo, theObject);
			object[] array = new object[props.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < props.Length; i++)
			{
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = classInfo.FindMember(props[i]);
				object obj = xPMemberInfo.GetValue(parentObject);
				if (xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType != null && obj != null)
				{
					array[i] = NestedStubWorksHelper.CreateNestedStubObject(parentSession, map, objCache, xPObjectClassInfoStubCache, obj);
					continue;
				}
				if (xPMemberInfo.Converter != null)
				{
					obj = xPMemberInfo.Converter.ConvertToStorageType(obj);
				}
				array[i] = obj;
			}
			return new SerializableObjectLayerResult<object[]>(xPObjectClassInfoStubCache.GetNewDictionaryStub(), array);
		}

		public SerializableObjectLayerResult<object[]> LoadDelayedProperties(XPDictionaryStub dictionary, XPObjectStubCollection objects, string property)
		{
			XPObjectStubCache objCache = new XPObjectStubCache();
			XPObjectClassInfoStubCache xPObjectClassInfoStubCache = new XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(parentSession, dictionary);
			object[] array = new object[objects.Count];
			XPClassInfo[] array2 = new XPClassInfo[objects.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < objects.Count; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = xPObjectClassInfoStubCache.GetClassInfo(objects[i].ClassName);
			}
			object[] parentObjects = NestedStubWorksHelper.GetParentObjects(parentSession, map, array2, objects);
			for (int j = 0; j < objects.Count; j++)
			{
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = array2[j];
				object theObject = parentObjects[j];
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = xPClassInfo.FindMember(property);
				object obj = xPMemberInfo.GetValue(theObject);
				if (xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType != null && obj != null)
				{
					array[j] = NestedStubWorksHelper.CreateNestedStubObject(parentSession, map, objCache, xPObjectClassInfoStubCache, obj);
					continue;
				}
				if (xPMemberInfo.Converter != null)
				{
					obj = xPMemberInfo.Converter.ConvertToStorageType(obj);
				}
				array[j] = obj;
			}
			return new SerializableObjectLayerResult<object[]>(xPObjectClassInfoStubCache.GetNewDictionaryStub(), array);
		}

		public bool IsParentObjectToSave(XPDictionaryStub dictionary, XPObjectStub theObject)
		{
			if (theObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			XPObjectClassInfoStubCache xPObjectClassInfoStubCache = new XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(parentSession, dictionary);
			object parentObject = NestedStubWorksHelper.GetParentObject(parentSession, map, xPObjectClassInfoStubCache.GetClassInfo(theObject.ClassName), theObject);
			if (parentObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return parentSession.IsObjectToSave(parentObject, includeParent: true);
		}

		public bool IsParentObjectToDelete(XPDictionaryStub dictionary, XPObjectStub theObject)
		{
			if (theObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			XPObjectClassInfoStubCache xPObjectClassInfoStubCache = new XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(parentSession, dictionary);
			object parentObject = NestedStubWorksHelper.GetParentObject(parentSession, map, xPObjectClassInfoStubCache.GetClassInfo(theObject.ClassName), theObject);
			if (parentObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return parentSession.IsObjectToDelete(parentObject, includeParent: true);
		}

		public SerializableObjectLayerResult<XPObjectStubCollection> GetParentObjectsToSave()
		{
			ICollection objectsToSave = parentSession.GetObjectsToSave(includeParent: true);
			XPObjectStubCache objCache = new XPObjectStubCache();
			XPObjectClassInfoStubCache xPObjectClassInfoStubCache = new XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(parentSession);
			XPObjectStubCollection xPObjectStubCollection = new XPObjectStubCollection(objectsToSave.Count);
			foreach (object item in objectsToSave)
			{
				xPObjectStubCollection.Add(NestedStubWorksHelper.CreateNestedStubObject(parentSession, map, objCache, xPObjectClassInfoStubCache, item));
			}
			return new SerializableObjectLayerResult<XPObjectStubCollection>(xPObjectClassInfoStubCache.GetNewDictionaryStub(), xPObjectStubCollection);
		}

		public SerializableObjectLayerResult<XPObjectStubCollection> GetParentObjectsToDelete()
		{
			ICollection objectsToDelete = parentSession.GetObjectsToDelete(includeParent: true);
			XPObjectStubCache objCache = new XPObjectStubCache();
			XPObjectClassInfoStubCache xPObjectClassInfoStubCache = new XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(parentSession);
			XPObjectStubCollection xPObjectStubCollection = new XPObjectStubCollection(objectsToDelete.Count);
			foreach (object item in objectsToDelete)
			{
				xPObjectStubCollection.Add(NestedStubWorksHelper.CreateNestedStubObject(parentSession, map, objCache, xPObjectClassInfoStubCache, item));
			}
			return new SerializableObjectLayerResult<XPObjectStubCollection>(xPObjectClassInfoStubCache.GetNewDictionaryStub(), xPObjectStubCollection);
		}

		public string[] GetParentTouchedClassInfos()
		{
			ICollection touchedClassInfosIncludeParent = parentSession.GetTouchedClassInfosIncludeParent();
			string[] array = new string[touchedClassInfosIncludeParent.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (XPClassInfo item in touchedClassInfosIncludeParent)
			{
				array[num++] = item.FullName;
			}
			return array;
		}

		object ICommandChannel.Do(string command, object args)
		{
			if (nestedCommandChannel == null)
			{
				if (parentSession == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported.");
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported by {parentSession.GetType().FullName}.");
			}
			return nestedCommandChannel.Do(command, args);
		}

		Task<object> ICommandChannelAsync.DoAsync(string command, object args, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (nestedCommandChannelAsync == null)
			{
				if (parentSession == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported.");
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Async_CommandChannelDoesNotImplementICommandChannelAsync", ((object)nestedCommandChannel).GetType().FullName));
			}
			return nestedCommandChannelAsync.DoAsync(command, args, default(CancellationToken));
		}
	}

		private IList CreateList()
		{
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				XPCollection xPCollection = new XPCollection();
				xPCollection.Site = Site;
				return xPCollection;
			}
			if (IsInitialized())
			{
				IXpoServerModeGridDataSource xpoServerModeGridDataSource = EquipServerModeCore(CreateServerModeCore());
				((IListServer)xpoServerModeGridDataSource).InconsistencyDetected += result_InconsistencyDetected;
				((IListServer)xpoServerModeGridDataSource).ExceptionThrown += result_ExceptionThrown;
				return xpoServerModeGridDataSource;
			}
			return new object[0];
		}

		protected virtual IXpoServerModeGridDataSource EquipServerModeCore(IXpoServerModeGridDataSource result)
		{
			if (AllowRemove || AllowNew)
			{
				result = new XpoServerCollectionAdderRemover(result, DeleteObjectOnRemove);
			}
			if (AllowEdit || AllowRemove || AllowNew)
			{
				result = new XpoServerCollectionFlagger(result, AllowEdit, AllowNew, AllowRemove);
			}
			if (TrackChanges)
			{
				result = new XpoServerCollectionChangeTracker(result);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual IXpoServerModeGridDataSource CreateServerModeCore()
		{
			return new XpoServerModeCore(Session, ObjectClassInfo, FixedFilterCriteria, DisplayableProperties, DefaultSorting);
		}

		{
			_List = null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSession()
		{
			return !(Session is DefaultSession);
		}

		private Session DoResolveSession()
		{
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				return new DefaultSession(Site);
			}
			ResolveSessionEventArgs e = new ResolveSessionEventArgs();
			OnResolveSession(e);
			if (e.Session != null)
			{
				Session session = e.Session.Session;
				if (session != null)
				{
					return session;
				}
			}
			return XpoDefault.GetSession();
		}

		protected virtual void OnResolveSession(ResolveSessionEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this._ResolveSession != null)
			{
				this._ResolveSession(this, args);
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDisplayableProperties()
		{
			return DisplayableProperties != StringListHelper.DelimitedText(ClassMetadataHelper.GetDefaultDisplayableProperties(ObjectClassInfo), ";");
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDefaultSorting()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(DefaultSorting);
		}

		{
			if (!IsDesignMode)
			{
				if (!IsInit)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				IsInit = false;
				KillList();
				if (this.Initialized != null && IsInitialized())
				{
					this.Initialized(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

		}

				foreach (ServerViewProperty property2 in Properties)

					list.Add(Tuple.Create<string, CriteriaOperator>(property2.Name, property2.Property));
					if (!flag && xPMemberInfo != null)

						if (val != null && string.Compare(val.PropertyName, xPMemberInfo.Name, ignoreCase: true) == 0)
						{

						}
					}
				}
			}

						list.Add(Tuple.Create<string, CriteriaOperator>(item, (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(item2.Name)));
					}

		private string GetSortingForServerModeCore()
		{
			if (Properties.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (ServerViewProperty property in Properties)
			{
				if (property.Sorting != SortDirection.None)
				{
					if (stringBuilder.Length != 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(';');
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(property.Name);
					if (property.Sorting == SortDirection.Ascending)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(" ASC");
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(" DESC");
					}
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private Session DoResolveSession()
		{
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				return new DefaultSession(Site);
			}
			ResolveSessionEventArgs e = new ResolveSessionEventArgs();
			OnResolveSession(e);
			if (e.Session != null)
			{
				Session session = e.Session.Session;
				if (session != null)
				{
					return session;
				}
			}
			return XpoDefault.GetSession();
		}

		protected virtual void OnResolveSession(ResolveSessionEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this._ResolveSession != null)
			{
				this._ResolveSession(this, args);
			}
		}

		protected bool IsInitialized()
		{
			if (IsInit)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ObjectClassInfo != null;
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.BeginInit()
		{
			if (!IsDesignMode)
			{
				if (IsInit)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				KillList();
				IsInit = true;
			}
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			if (!IsDesignMode)
			{
				if (!IsInit)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				IsInit = false;
				KillList();
				if (this.Initialized != null && IsInitialized())
				{
					this.Initialized(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

		IList IListSource.GetList()
		{
			return List;
		}

			ServerViewProperty serverViewProperty = new ServerViewProperty(name, sorting, property);
			Properties.Add(serverViewProperty);

			{
				KillList();
				Reload();
			}
			return serverViewProperty;
		}

		public void Reload()
		{
			if (List is XpoViewServerModeCore xpoViewServerModeCore)
			{
				((ServerModeCore)xpoViewServerModeCore).Refresh();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnServerExceptionThrown(ServerExceptionThrownEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this._ServerExceptionThrown != null)
			{
				this._ServerExceptionThrown(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void result_ExceptionThrown(object sender, ServerModeExceptionThrownEventArgs e)
		{
			FatalException(e.Exception);
		}

		protected virtual void FatalException(Exception e)
		{
			ServerExceptionThrownEventArgs e2 = new ServerExceptionThrownEventArgs(e);
			OnServerExceptionThrown(e2);
			if (e2.Action == ServerExceptionThrownAction.Rethrow)
			{
				throw e;
			}
		}

		private void result_InconsistencyDetected(object sender, ServerModeInconsistencyDetectedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Inconsistent(e);
			if (!((HandledEventArgs)(object)e).Handled)
			{
				((HandledEventArgs)(object)e).Handled = true;
				InconsistentHelper.PostponedInconsistent((MyMethodInvoker)delegate
				{
					Reload();
				}, (MyMethodInvoker)null);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Inconsistent(ServerModeInconsistencyDetectedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

			xPServerModeView.Properties.AddRangeAsCopy(Properties);

		}

					List<IDataColumnInfo> list = new List<IDataColumnInfo>();
					if (column.owner == null || column.owner.ClassInfo == null)
					{
						return list;
					}
					foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in column.owner.ClassInfo.PersistentProperties)
					{
						if (persistentProperty.IsKey || !(persistentProperty is ServiceField))
						{
							list.Add((IDataColumnInfo)(object)new ServerViewPropertyMemberIDataPropertyInfoWrapper(persistentProperty));
						}
					}
					foreach (XPMemberInfo member in column.owner.ClassInfo.Members)
					{
						if (member.IsAliased)
						{
							list.Add((IDataColumnInfo)(object)new ServerViewPropertyMemberIDataPropertyInfoWrapper(member));
						}
					}
					foreach (XPMemberInfo collectionProperty in column.owner.ClassInfo.CollectionProperties)
					{
						list.Add((IDataColumnInfo)(object)new ServerViewPropertyMemberIDataPropertyInfoWrapper(collectionProperty));
					}
					return list;
				}
			}

			{

					}
					return "";
				}
			}

			Type IDataColumnInfo.FieldType
			{
				get
				{
					if (column.owner == null || column.owner.ClassInfo == null)
					{
						return typeof(object);
					}
					return CriteriaTypeResolver.ResolveType(column.owner.ClassInfo, column.Property);
				}
			}

	internal class ServerViewPropertyConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object val, Type destinationType)
		{
			ServerViewProperty serverViewProperty = val as ServerViewProperty;
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && serverViewProperty != null)
			{
				ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(ServerViewProperty).GetConstructor(new Type[3]
				{
					typeof(string),
					typeof(SortDirection),
					typeof(string)
				});
				if (constructor != null)
				{
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[3]
					{
						serverViewProperty.Name,
						serverViewProperty.Sorting,
						(serverViewProperty.Property == null) ? string.Empty : ((object)serverViewProperty.Property).ToString()
					});
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, val, destinationType);
		}
	}

	{
		private IXPClassInfoProvider owner;

		public ServerViewProperty this[int index] => (ServerViewProperty)base.List[index];

		public ServerViewProperty this[CriteriaOperator expression]
		{
			get
			{
				IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						ServerViewProperty serverViewProperty = (ServerViewProperty)enumerator.Current;
						if (object.Equals(expression, serverViewProperty.Property))
						{
							return serverViewProperty;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
					if (disposable != null)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public ServerViewProperty this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						ServerViewProperty serverViewProperty = (ServerViewProperty)enumerator.Current;
						if (object.Equals(name, serverViewProperty.Name))
						{
							return serverViewProperty;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
					if (disposable != null)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		public ServerViewPropertiesCollection(IXPClassInfoProvider owner)

		{
			((IList)this).Add((object)property);
		}

		public void AddRange(ServerViewProperty[] properties)
		{
			foreach (ServerViewProperty property in properties)
			{
				Add(property);
			}
		}

		public void AddRangeAsCopy(IEnumerable properties)
		{
			foreach (ServerViewProperty property in properties)
			{
				ServerViewProperty serverViewProperty2 = new ServerViewProperty(property.Name, property.Sorting, property.Property);
				serverViewProperty2.PropertyChanged += OnItemPropertyChanged;
				Add(serverViewProperty2);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInsertComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			((ServerViewProperty)value).SetOwner(owner);
			((ServerViewProperty)value).PropertyChanged += OnItemPropertyChanged;
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, new object[1] { value }, index));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRemoveComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			((ServerViewProperty)value).SetOwner(null);
			((ServerViewProperty)value).PropertyChanged -= OnItemPropertyChanged;
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, new object[1] { value }, index));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClear()
		{
			base.OnClear();
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ServerViewProperty serverViewProperty = (ServerViewProperty)enumerator.Current;
					serverViewProperty.PropertyChanged -= OnItemPropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClearComplete()
		{
			base.OnClearComplete();
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSetComplete(int index, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			base.OnSetComplete(index, oldValue, newValue);
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace, newValue, oldValue));
			}
		}

		private void OnItemPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace, sender, sender));
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public virtual XPDictionary Dictionary
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsConnected)
				{
					return dict;
				}
				if (IsDesignMode2)
				{
					if (dict == null)
					{
						if (!(this is DefaultSession))
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException();
						}
						dict = CreateDesignTimeDictionary(Site);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Connect();
				}
				return dict;
			}
		}

		private static ExpandedCriteriaHolder ExpandToLogical(CriteriaOperator criteria, XPClassInfo classInfo, bool doDetectPostProcessing, IPersistentValueExtractor persistentValueExtractor)
		{
			ExpandedCriteriaHolder expandedCriteriaHolder = PersistentCriterionExpander.ExpandToLogical(persistentValueExtractor, classInfo, criteria, doDetectPostProcessing);
			if (expandedCriteriaHolder.RequiresPostProcessing)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("PersistentAliasExpander_NonPersistentCriteria", CriteriaOperator.ToString(criteria), expandedCriteriaHolder.PostProcessingCause));
			}
			return expandedCriteriaHolder;
		}

		private static ExpandedCriteriaHolder ExpandToValue(CriteriaOperator criteria, XPClassInfo classInfo, bool doDetectPostProcessing, IPersistentValueExtractor persistentValueExtractor)
		{
			ExpandedCriteriaHolder expandedCriteriaHolder = PersistentCriterionExpander.ExpandToValue(persistentValueExtractor, classInfo, criteria, doDetectPostProcessing);
			if (expandedCriteriaHolder.RequiresPostProcessing)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("PersistentAliasExpander_NonPersistentCriteria", CriteriaOperator.ToString(criteria), expandedCriteriaHolder.PostProcessingCause));
			}
			return expandedCriteriaHolder;
		}

		internal virtual List<object[]> SelectDataInternal(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, CriteriaOperator criteria, CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties, CriteriaOperator groupCriteria, bool selectDeleted, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords, SortingCollection sorting)
		{
			List<object[]> list = PrepareSelectData(classInfo, ref properties, ref criteria, ref groupProperties, ref groupCriteria, ref sorting, doDetectPostProcessing: true, this);
			if (list == null)
			{
				list = ObjectLayer.SelectData(this, new ObjectsQuery(classInfo, criteria, sorting, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, new CollectionCriteriaPatcher(selectDeleted, TypesManager), force: true), properties, groupProperties, groupCriteria);
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal virtual async Task<List<object[]>> SelectDataInternalAsync(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, CriteriaOperator criteria, CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties, CriteriaOperator groupCriteria, bool selectDeleted, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords, SortingCollection sorting, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			await UpdateSchemaAsync(cancellationToken, classInfo);
			await TypesManager.EnsureIsTypedObjectValidAsync(cancellationToken);
			List<object[]> list = PrepareSelectDataInternal(classInfo, ref properties, ref criteria, ref groupProperties, ref groupCriteria, ref sorting, doDetectPostProcessing: true, this);
			if (list == null)
			{
				return await GetObjectLayerAsync().SelectDataAsync(this, new ObjectsQuery(classInfo, criteria, sorting, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, new CollectionCriteriaPatcher(selectDeleted, TypesManager), force: true), properties, groupProperties, groupCriteria, cancellationToken);
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal ObjectsQuery[] PrepareQueries(ObjectsQuery[] queries, bool doDetectPostProcessing, IPersistentValueExtractor persistentValueExtractor)
		{
			int num = ((queries != null) ? queries.Length : 0);
			ObjectsQuery[] array = new ObjectsQuery[num];
			TypesManager.EnsureIsTypedObjectValid();
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = PrepareQuery(queries[i], doDetectPostProcessing, persistentValueExtractor);
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				XPClassInfo[] array2 = new XPClassInfo[num];
				for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
				{
					array2[j] = array[j].ClassInfo;
				}
				UpdateSchema(array2);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private ObjectsQuery PrepareQuery(ObjectsQuery objectsQuery, bool doDetectPostProcessing, IPersistentValueExtractor persistentValueExtractor)
		{
			//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0075: Expected O, but got Unknown
			XPClassInfo classInfo = objectsQuery.ClassInfo;
			CriteriaOperator val = objectsQuery.Criteria;
			if (!IsNull(val))
			{
				ExpandedCriteriaHolder expandedCriteriaHolder = ExpandToLogical(val, classInfo, doDetectPostProcessing, persistentValueExtractor);
				val = expandedCriteriaHolder.ExpandedCriteria;

		internal static List<object[]> PrepareEvaluate(XPClassInfo classInfo, ref CriteriaOperator expression, ref CriteriaOperator criteria, IPersistentValueExtractor extractor, bool caseSensitive)
		{
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Expected O, but got Unknown

			if (expandedCriteriaHolder.IsFalse)
			{
				ExpressionEvaluator val = new ExpressionEvaluator((EvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)new FalseCriteriaTopLevelEvaluatorDescriptor(), expression, caseSensitive, (ICollection<ICustomFunctionOperator>)classInfo.Dictionary.CustomFunctionOperators, (ICollection<ICustomAggregate>)classInfo.Dictionary.CustomAggregates);
				object obj = val.Evaluate((object)null);
				return new List<object[]>(new object[1][] { new object[1] { obj } });
			}
			expression = ExpandToValue(expression, classInfo, doDetectPostProcessing: true, extractor).ExpandedCriteria;
			criteria = ExpandedCriteriaHolder.IfNeededConvertToLogicalOperator(criteria);
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual Task<ObjectDictionary<object>> LoadDelayedPropertiesAsync(IList objects, XPMemberInfo property, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
