"null" : property.Name)));
		}

		public void Reload(object theObject)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
			LogManager.Log("Session", (LogHandlerVoid)delegate
			{
				//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0070: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0070: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_006b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_007a: Expected O, but got Unknown
				ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(theObject);
				RemoveFromLists(theObject);
				if (!IsNewObject(theObject))
				{
					XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(theObject);
					if (GetObjects(classInfo, (CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(classInfo.KeyProperty.Name), (CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue(theObject), (BinaryOperatorType)0), null, 0, 1, selectDeleted: true, force: true).Count == 0)
					{
						throw new CannotLoadObjectsException(classInfo.FullName + "(" + GetKeyValue(theObject)?.ToString() + ")");
					}
					if (classInfo.HasModifications(theObject))
					{
						objectsMarkedSaved.Add(theObject);
					}
				}
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing Reload(theObject)", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString(), "theObject", GetObjectString(theObject))), (ExceptionHandler)null);
		}

		public Task ReloadAsync(object theObject, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return LogManager.LogAsync("Session", (LogHandler<Task>)async delegate
			{
				ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(theObject);
				RemoveFromLists(theObject);
				if (!IsNewObject(theObject))
				{
					XPClassInfo ci = GetClassInfo(theObject);
					if ((await GetObjectsAsync(ci, (CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(ci.KeyProperty.Name), (CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue(theObject), (BinaryOperatorType)0), null, 0, 1, selectDeleted: true, force: true, cancellationToken)).Count == 0)
					{
						throw new CannotLoadObjectsException(ci.FullName + "(" + GetKeyValue(theObject)?.ToString() + ")");
					}
					if (ci.HasModifications(theObject))
					{
						objectsMarkedSaved.Add(theObject);
					}
				}
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing ReloadAsync(theObject)", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString(), "theObject", GetObjectString(theObject))), (ExceptionHandler)null);
		}

		public void Reload(object theObject, bool forceAggregatesReload)
		{
			Reload(theObject);
			if (!forceAggregatesReload)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in GetClassInfo(theObject).ObjectProperties)
			{
				if (objectProperty.IsAggregated)
				{
					object value = objectProperty.GetValue(theObject);
					if (value != null)
					{
						Reload(value, forceAggregatesReload);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo associationListProperty in GetClassInfo(theObject).AssociationListProperties)
			{
				if (!associationListProperty.IsAggregated)
				{
					continue;
				}
				IList list = (IList)associationListProperty.GetValue(theObject);
				if (associationListProperty.IsCollection)
				{
					((XPBaseCollection)list).Reload();
				}
				else if (list is IXPUnloadableAssociationList)
				{
					((IXPUnloadableAssociationList)list).Unload();
				}
				foreach (object item in ListHelper.FromCollection(list))
				{
					if (item != null)
					{
						Reload(item, forceAggregatesReload);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public async Task ReloadAsync(object theObject, bool forceAggregatesReload, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			await ReloadAsync(theObject, cancellationToken);
			if (!forceAggregatesReload)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in GetClassInfo(theObject).ObjectProperties)
			{
				if (objectProperty.IsAggregated)
				{
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					object value = objectProperty.GetValue(theObject);
					if (value != null)
					{
						await ReloadAsync(value, forceAggregatesReload, cancellationToken);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo associationListProperty in GetClassInfo(theObject).AssociationListProperties)
			{
				if (!associationListProperty.IsAggregated)
				{
					continue;
				}
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				IList list = (IList)associationListProperty.GetValue(theObject);
				if (associationListProperty.IsCollection)
				{
					((XPBaseCollection)list).Reload();
				}
				else if (list is IXPUnloadableAssociationList)
				{
					((IXPUnloadableAssociationList)list).Unload();
				}
				foreach (object item in ListHelper.FromCollection(list))
				{
					if (item != null)
					{
						await ReloadAsync(item, forceAggregatesReload, cancellationToken);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void PreProcessSavedList()
		{
			ObjectSet objectSet = new ObjectSet();
			bool flag = false;
			bool? flag2 = null;
			while (flag || (objectSet.Count != GetObjectsToSave().Count && (!flag2.HasValue || flag2.Value)))
			{
				flag = false;
				flag2 = false;
				int num = GetObjectsToSave().Count;
				foreach (object item in ListHelper.FromCollection(GetObjectsToSave()))
				{
					if (objectSet.Contains(item))
					{
						continue;
					}
					flag2 = true;
					objectSet.Add(item);
					XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(item);
					InternalBeforeSave(item);
					TriggerObjectSaving(item);
					if (classInfo.IsTypedObject)
					{
						classInfo.GetMember("ObjectType").SetValue(item, GetObjectType(item));
					}
					foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in classInfo.ObjectProperties)
					{
						if (objectProperty.IsDelayed && !XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(item, objectProperty).IsLoaded)
						{
							continue;
						}
						object value = objectProperty.GetValue(item);
						if (value != null)
						{
							ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(value);
							if (IsNewObject(value) || (objectProperty.IsAggregated && !IsUnitOfWork))
							{
								Save(value);
							}
						}
					}
					foreach (XPMemberInfo collectionProperty in classInfo.CollectionProperties)
					{
						XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)collectionProperty.GetValue(item);
						if (xPBaseCollection != null)
						{
							if (xPBaseCollection.IsLoaded && !xPBaseCollection.LoadingEnabled && !_SuppressThrowingAssociationCollectionWithDisabledLoading)
							{
								throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_AssociationCollectionWithDisabledLoading"));
							}
							XPRefCollectionHelper.GetRefCollectionHelperChecked<XPRefCollectionHelper>(xPBaseCollection, item, collectionProperty).Save();
						}
					}
					int count = GetObjectsToSave().Count;
					if (num != count)
					{
						flag = true;
						num = count;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (object item2 in new ArrayList(GetObjectsToDelete()))
			{
				if (objectSet.Contains(item2))
				{
					continue;
				}
				objectSet.Add(item2);
				XPClassInfo classInfo2 = GetClassInfo(item2);
				foreach (XPMemberInfo collectionProperty2 in classInfo2.CollectionProperties)
				{
					XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection2 = (XPBaseCollection)collectionProperty2.GetValue(item2);
					if (xPBaseCollection2 != null)
					{
						if (xPBaseCollection2.IsLoaded && !xPBaseCollection2.LoadingEnabled && !_SuppressThrowingAssociationCollectionWithDisabledLoading)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_AssociationCollectionWithDisabledLoading"));
						}
						XPRefCollectionHelper.GetRefCollectionHelperChecked<XPRefCollectionHelper>(xPBaseCollection2, item2, collectionProperty2).Save();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task PreProcessSavedListAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			ObjectSet processedItems = new ObjectSet();
			bool isObjectsToSaveCountChanged = false;
			bool? hasNewProcessedObjects = null;
			while (isObjectsToSaveCountChanged || (processedItems.Count != GetObjectsToSave().Count && (!hasNewProcessedObjects.HasValue || hasNewProcessedObjects.Value)))
			{
				isObjectsToSaveCountChanged = false;
				hasNewProcessedObjects = false;
				int lastObjectsToSaveCount = GetObjectsToSave().Count;
				foreach (object obj in ListHelper.FromCollection(GetObjectsToSave()))
				{
					if (processedItems.Contains(obj))
					{
						continue;
					}
					hasNewProcessedObjects = true;
					processedItems.Add(obj);
					XPClassInfo ci = GetClassInfo(obj);
					await InternalBeforeSaveAsync(obj, cancellationToken);
					TriggerObjectSaving(obj);
					if (ci.IsTypedObject)
					{
						ci.GetMember("ObjectType").SetValue(obj, GetObjectType(obj));
					}
					foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in ci.ObjectProperties)
					{
						if (objectProperty.IsDelayed && !XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(obj, objectProperty).IsLoaded)
						{
							continue;
						}
						object value = objectProperty.GetValue(obj);
						if (value != null)
						{
							ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(value);
							if (IsNewObject(value) || (objectProperty.IsAggregated && !IsUnitOfWork))
							{
								await SaveAsync(value, cancellationToken);
							}
						}
					}
					foreach (XPMemberInfo collectionProperty in ci.CollectionProperties)
					{
						XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)collectionProperty.GetValue(obj);
						if (xPBaseCollection != null)
						{
							if (xPBaseCollection.IsLoaded && !xPBaseCollection.LoadingEnabled && !_SuppressThrowingAssociationCollectionWithDisabledLoading)
							{
								throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_AssociationCollectionWithDisabledLoading"));
							}
							XPRefCollectionHelper.GetRefCollectionHelperChecked<XPRefCollectionHelper>(xPBaseCollection, obj, collectionProperty).Save();
						}
					}
					int count = GetObjectsToSave().Count;
					if (lastObjectsToSaveCount != count)
					{
						isObjectsToSaveCountChanged = true;
						lastObjectsToSaveCount = count;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (object item in new ArrayList(GetObjectsToDelete()))
			{
				if (processedItems.Contains(item))
				{
					continue;
				}
				processedItems.Add(item);
				XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(item);
				foreach (XPMemberInfo collectionProperty2 in classInfo.CollectionProperties)
				{
					XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection2 = (XPBaseCollection)collectionProperty2.GetValue(item);
					if (xPBaseCollection2 != null)
					{
						if (xPBaseCollection2.IsLoaded && !xPBaseCollection2.LoadingEnabled && !_SuppressThrowingAssociationCollectionWithDisabledLoading)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_AssociationCollectionWithDisabledLoading"));
						}
						XPRefCollectionHelper.GetRefCollectionHelperChecked<XPRefCollectionHelper>(xPBaseCollection2, item, collectionProperty2).Save();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessingProcessNextObject(ObjectSet markedObjectsHolder, object theObject)
		{
			ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(theObject);
			XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(theObject);
			classInfo.CheckAbstractReference();
			if (!markedObjectsHolder.Contains(theObject))
			{
				SessionStateStack.ThrowIfCantEnter(this, SessionState.SessionObjectsToSaveOrDeleteChanging);
				markedObjectsHolder.Add(theObject);
				if (theObject is PersistentBase persistentBase)
				{
					persistentBase.OnSessionProcessingProcessProcessed();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessingProcessObjectListOrCollection(ObjectSet markedObjectsHolder, object theObjectOrCollection)
		{
			if (theObjectOrCollection is ICollection)
			{
				foreach (object item in (ICollection)theObjectOrCollection)
				{
					ProcessingProcessNextObject(markedObjectsHolder, item);
				}
				return;
			}
			ProcessingProcessNextObject(markedObjectsHolder, theObjectOrCollection);
		}

		private void ProcessingProcess(ObjectSet markedObjectsHolder, object theObject)
		{
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!TrackingChanges)
			{
				BeginTrackingChanges();
				if (!IsUnitOfWork)
				{
					try
					{
						ProcessingProcessObjectListOrCollection(markedObjectsHolder, theObject);
						FlushChanges();
						return;
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (TrackingChanges)
						{
							try
							{
								DropChanges();
							}
							catch (Exception ex2)
							{
								throw new ExceptionBundleException(new Exception[2] { ex, ex2 });
							}
						}
						throw;
					}
				}
				ProcessingProcessObjectListOrCollection(markedObjectsHolder, theObject);
			}
			else
			{
				ProcessingProcessObjectListOrCollection(markedObjectsHolder, theObject);
			}
		}

		private async Task ProcessingProcessAsync(ObjectSet markedObjectsHolder, object theObject, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (!TrackingChanges)
			{
				BeginTrackingChanges();
				if (!IsUnitOfWork)
				{
					try
					{
						ProcessingProcessObjectListOrCollection(markedObjectsHolder, theObject);
						await FlushChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
						return;
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (TrackingChanges)
						{
							try
							{
								DropChanges();
							}
							catch (Exception ex2)
							{
								throw new ExceptionBundleException(new Exception[2] { ex, ex2 });
							}
						}
						throw;
					}
				}
				ProcessingProcessObjectListOrCollection(markedObjectsHolder, theObject);
			}
			else
			{
				ProcessingProcessObjectListOrCollection(markedObjectsHolder, theObject);
			}
		}

		public void Save(object theObject)
		{
			ThrowIfCommitChangesToDataLayerInner();
			ProcessingProcess(objectsMarkedSaved, theObject);
		}

		public Task SaveAsync(object theObject, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			ThrowIfCommitChangesToDataLayerInner();
			return ProcessingProcessAsync(objectsMarkedSaved, theObject, cancellationToken);
		}

		public void Save(ICollection objects)
		{
			Save((object)objects);
		}

		private static int NextGCRecordValue()
		{
			return NonCryptographicRandom.System.Next(1, int.MaxValue);
		}

		private void DeleteObject(object theObject)
		{
			if (theObject == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(theObject);
			if (classInfo.IsGCRecordObject)
			{
				XPMemberInfo member = classInfo.GetMember(GCRecordField.StaticName);
				if (member.GetValue(theObject) == null)
				{
					if (this is ExplicitUnitOfWork)
					{
						LoadAggregatedMembers(classInfo, theObject);
					}
					TriggerObjectDeleting(theObject);
					member.SetValue(theObject, NextGCRecordValue());
					DeleteCore(classInfo, theObject);
					TriggerObjectDeleted(theObject);
					Save(theObject);
				}
			}
			else if (!IsObjectToDelete(theObject))
			{
				if (this is ExplicitUnitOfWork)
				{
					LoadAggregatedMembers(classInfo, theObject);
				}
				TriggerObjectDeleting(theObject);
				ProcessingProcess(objectsMarkedDeleted, theObject);
				DeleteCore(classInfo, theObject);
				TriggerObjectDeleted(theObject);
			}
		}

		private async Task DeleteObjectAsync(object theObject, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (theObject == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(theObject);
			if (classInfo.IsGCRecordObject)
			{
				XPMemberInfo gcRecord = classInfo.GetMember(GCRecordField.StaticName);
				if (gcRecord.GetValue(theObject) == null)
				{
					if (this is ExplicitUnitOfWork)
					{
						await LoadAggregatedMembersAsync(classInfo, theObject, cancellationToken);
					}
					TriggerObjectDeleting(theObject);
					gcRecord.SetValue(theObject, NextGCRecordValue());
					await DeleteCoreAsync(classInfo, theObject, cancellationToken);
					TriggerObjectDeleted(theObject);
					await SaveAsync(theObject, cancellationToken);
				}
			}
			else if (!IsObjectToDelete(theObject))
			{
				if (this is ExplicitUnitOfWork)
				{
					await LoadAggregatedMembersAsync(classInfo, theObject, cancellationToken);
				}
				TriggerObjectDeleting(theObject);
				await ProcessingProcessAsync(objectsMarkedDeleted, theObject, cancellationToken);
				await DeleteCoreAsync(classInfo, theObject, cancellationToken);
				TriggerObjectDeleted(theObject);
			}
		}

		private void DeleteObjectOrCollection(object theObject)
		{
			if (!(theObject is ICollection collection))
			{
				DeleteObject(theObject);
				return;
			}
			foreach (object item in ListHelper.FromCollection(collection))
			{
				DeleteObject(item);
			}
		}

		private async Task DeleteObjectOrCollectionAsync(object theObject, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (!(theObject is ICollection collection))
			{
				await DeleteObjectAsync(theObject, cancellationToken);
				return;
			}
			foreach (object item in ListHelper.FromCollection(collection))
			{
				await DeleteObjectAsync(item, cancellationToken);
			}
		}

		private void DeleteCore(XPClassInfo classInfo, object theObject)
		{
			foreach (XPMemberInfo associationListProperty in classInfo.AssociationListProperties)
			{
				if (associationListProperty.IsAggregated)
				{
					if (associationListProperty.IsCollection)
					{
						XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)associationListProperty.GetValue(theObject);
						CheckFilteredAggregateDeletion(theObject, associationListProperty, xPBaseCollection);
						FixedSizeList<object> val = LohPooled.ToListForDispose<object>(xPBaseCollection.Cast<object>(), (int?)xPBaseCollection.Count);
						try
						{
							for (int num = val.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
							{
								Delete(val[num]);
							}
							if (!xPBaseCollection.SelectDeleted)
							{
								for (int num2 = val.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
								{
									xPBaseCollection.BaseRemove(val[num2]);
								}
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
						}
						continue;
					}
					IList list = (IList)associationListProperty.GetValue(theObject);
					FixedSizeList<object> val2 = LohPooled.ToListForDispose<object>(list.Cast<object>(), (int?)list.Count);
					try
					{
						for (int num3 = val2.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
						{
							Delete(val2[num3]);
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)val2)?.Dispose();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!associationListProperty.IsManyToMany)
					{
						continue;
					}
					XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection2 = (XPBaseCollection)associationListProperty.GetValue(theObject);
					if (xPBaseCollection2.SelectDeleted)
					{
						continue;
					}
					FixedSizeList<object> val3 = LohPooled.ToListForDispose<object>(xPBaseCollection2.Cast<object>(), (int?)xPBaseCollection2.Count);
					try
					{
						for (int num4 = val3.Count - 1; num4 >= 0; num4--)
						{
							xPBaseCollection2.BaseRemove(val3[num4]);
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)val3)?.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in classInfo.ObjectProperties)
			{
				if (objectProperty.IsAggregated)
				{
					object value = objectProperty.GetValue(theObject);
					Delete(value);
				}
				if (objectProperty.IsAssociation)
				{
					object value2 = objectProperty.GetValue(theObject);
					if (value2 != null)
					{
						XPMemberInfo associatedMember = objectProperty.GetAssociatedMember();
						((IList)associatedMember.GetValue(value2))?.Remove(theObject);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task DeleteCoreAsync(XPClassInfo classInfo, object theObject, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			foreach (XPMemberInfo associationListProperty in classInfo.AssociationListProperties)
			{
				if (associationListProperty.IsAggregated)
				{
					FixedSizeList<object> toDelete;
					if (associationListProperty.IsCollection)
					{
						XPBaseCollection collection = (XPBaseCollection)associationListProperty.GetValue(theObject);
						CheckFilteredAggregateDeletion(theObject, associationListProperty, collection);
						if (!collection.IsLoaded)
						{
							await collection.LoadAsync(cancellationToken);
						}
						toDelete = LohPooled.ToListForDispose<object>(collection.Cast<object>(), (int?)collection.Count);
						try
						{
							for (int i = toDelete.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
							{
								await DeleteAsync(toDelete[i], cancellationToken);
							}
							if (!collection.SelectDeleted)
							{
								for (int i = toDelete.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
								{
									await collection.BaseRemoveAsync(toDelete[i], cancellationToken);
								}
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							((IDisposable)toDelete)?.Dispose();
						}
						continue;
					}
					IList list = (IList)associationListProperty.GetValue(theObject);
					await LoadAssociationListAsync(list, cancellationToken);
					toDelete = LohPooled.ToListForDispose<object>(list.Cast<object>(), (int?)list.Count);
					try
					{
						for (int i = toDelete.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
						{
							await DeleteAsync(toDelete[i], cancellationToken);
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)toDelete)?.Dispose();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!associationListProperty.IsManyToMany)
					{
						continue;
					}
					XPBaseCollection collection = (XPBaseCollection)associationListProperty.GetValue(theObject);
					if (collection.SelectDeleted)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (!collection.IsLoaded)
					{
						await collection.LoadAsync(cancellationToken);
					}
					FixedSizeList<object> toDelete = LohPooled.ToListForDispose<object>(collection.Cast<object>(), (int?)collection.Count);
					try
					{
						for (int i = toDelete.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
						{
							await collection.BaseRemoveAsync(toDelete[i], cancellationToken);
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)toDelete)?.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in classInfo.ObjectProperties)
			{
				if (objectProperty.IsAggregated)
				{
					object value = objectProperty.GetValue(theObject);
					Delete(value);
				}
				if (objectProperty.IsAssociation)
				{
					object value2 = objectProperty.GetValue(theObject);
					if (value2 != null)
					{
						XPMemberInfo associatedMember = objectProperty.GetAssociatedMember();
						IList list = (IList)associatedMember.GetValue(value2);
						await LoadAssociationListAsync(list, cancellationToken);
						list?.Remove(theObject);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadAggregatedMembers(XPClassInfo classInfo, object theObject)
		{
			foreach (XPMemberInfo associationListProperty in classInfo.AssociationListProperties)
			{
				if (associationListProperty.IsAggregated)
				{
					if (associationListProperty.IsCollection)
					{
						XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)associationListProperty.GetValue(theObject);
						if (!xPBaseCollection.IsLoaded)
						{
							xPBaseCollection.Load();
						}
					}
					else
					{
						IList list = (IList)associationListProperty.GetValue(theObject);
						list.GetEnumerator();
					}
				}
				else if (associationListProperty.IsManyToMany)
				{
					XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection2 = (XPBaseCollection)associationListProperty.GetValue(theObject);
					if (!xPBaseCollection2.IsLoaded)
					{
						xPBaseCollection2.Load();
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in classInfo.ObjectProperties)
			{
				if (objectProperty.IsAggregated)
				{
					objectProperty.GetValue(theObject);
				}
				if (objectProperty.IsAssociation)
				{
					object value = objectProperty.GetValue(theObject);
					if (value != null)
					{
						XPMemberInfo associatedMember = objectProperty.GetAssociatedMember();
						((IList)associatedMember.GetValue(value))?.GetEnumerator();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task LoadAggregatedMembersAsync(XPClassInfo classInfo, object theObject, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			foreach (XPMemberInfo associationListProperty in classInfo.AssociationListProperties)
			{
				if (associationListProperty.IsAggregated)
				{
					if (associationListProperty.IsCollection)
					{
						XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)associationListProperty.GetValue(theObject);
						if (!xPBaseCollection.IsLoaded)
						{
							await xPBaseCollection.LoadAsync(cancellationToken);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						object value = associationListProperty.GetValue(theObject);
						await LoadAssociationListAsync(value, cancellationToken);
					}
				}
				else if (associationListProperty.IsManyToMany)
				{
					XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection2 = (XPBaseCollection)associationListProperty.GetValue(theObject);
					if (!xPBaseCollection2.IsLoaded)
					{
						await xPBaseCollection2.LoadAsync(cancellationToken);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in classInfo.ObjectProperties)
			{
				if (objectProperty.IsAggregated)
				{
					objectProperty.GetValue(theObject);
				}
				if (!objectProperty.IsAssociation)
				{
					continue;
				}
				object value2 = objectProperty.GetValue(theObject);
				if (value2 != null)
				{
					XPMemberInfo associatedMember = objectProperty.GetAssociatedMember();
					object value3 = associatedMember.GetValue(value2);
					if (value3 != null)
					{
						await LoadAssociationListAsync(value3, cancellationToken);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task LoadAssociationListAsync(object list, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (list is XPAssociationList xPAssociationList)
			{
				await xPAssociationList.LoadAsync(cancellationToken);
			}
			else if (list is XPManyToManyAliasList xPManyToManyAliasList)
			{
				await xPManyToManyAliasList.EnumerateAsync(cancellationToken);
			}
			else
			{
				((IList)list).GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		private static void CheckFilteredAggregateDeletion(object theObject, XPMemberInfo mi, XPBaseCollection collection)
		{
			if (collection.Criteria == null && collection.SkipReturnedObjects <= 0 && collection.TopReturnedObjects <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = Res.GetString("Collections_WantNotDeleteFilteredAggregateCollection", theObject, mi.Name);
			bool flag = collection.GetObjectClassInfo().IsGCRecordObject || mi.GetAssociatedMember().HasAttribute(typeof(NoForeignKeyAttribute));
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (collection.Criteria != null)
			{
				string text2 = null;
				if (flag)
				{
					try
					{
						text2 = ".Criteria = '" + CriteriaOperator.ToString(collection.Criteria) + "'";
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				list.Add(text2 ?? ".Criteria");
			}
			if (collection.SkipReturnedObjects > 0)
			{
				list.Add(".SkipReturnedObjects = " + collection.SkipReturnedObjects);
			}
			if (collection.TopReturnedObjects > 0)
			{
				list.Add(".TopReturnedObjects = " + collection.TopReturnedObjects);
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				text = text + " (" + string.Join(", ", list) + ")";
			}
			InvalidOperationException ex = new InvalidOperationException(text);
			if (flag)
			{
				throw ex;
			}
			try
			{
				throw ex;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public void Delete(object theObject)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
			LogManager.Log("Session", (LogHandlerVoid)delegate
			{
				//IL_008a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				ThrowIfCommitChangesToDataLayerInner();
				if (TrackingChanges)
				{
					DeleteObjectOrCollection(theObject);
					return;
				}
				BeginTrackingChanges();
				try
				{
					DeleteObjectOrCollection(theObject);
					if (!IsUnitOfWork)
					{
						FlushChanges();
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (TrackingChanges)
					{
						try
						{
							DropChanges();
						}
						catch (Exception ex2)
						{
							throw new ExceptionBundleException(new Exception[2] { ex, ex2 });
						}
					}
					throw;
				}
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing Delete(theObject)", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString(), "theObject", GetObjectString(theObject))), (ExceptionHandler)null);
		}

		public Task DeleteAsync(object theObject, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return LogManager.LogAsync("Session", (LogHandler<Task>)async delegate
			{
				ThrowIfCommitChangesToDataLayerInner();
				if (TrackingChanges)
				{
					await DeleteObjectOrCollectionAsync(theObject, cancellationToken);
					return;
				}
				BeginTrackingChanges();
				try
				{
					await DeleteObjectOrCollectionAsync(theObject, cancellationToken);
					if (!IsUnitOfWork)
					{
						await FlushChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (TrackingChanges)
					{
						try
						{
							DropChanges();
						}
						catch (Exception ex2)
						{
							throw new ExceptionBundleException(new Exception[2] { ex, ex2 });
						}
					}
					throw;
				}
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing DeleteAsync(theObject)", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString(), "theObject", GetObjectString(theObject))), (ExceptionHandler)null);
		}

		public void Delete(ICollection objects)
		{
			Delete((object)objects);
		}

		public Task DeleteAsync(ICollection objects, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return DeleteAsync((object)objects, cancellationToken);
		}

		public static PurgeResult PurgeDeletedObjects(IObjectLayer objectLayer)
		{
			return LogManager.Log<PurgeResult>("Session", (LogHandler<PurgeResult>)(() => objectLayer.Purge()), (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => new LogMessage((LogMessageType)3, "Executing PurgeDeletedObjects()", d)));
		}

		private void InternalBeforeSave(object theObject)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(theObject);
			classInfo.CheckAbstractReference();
			XPMemberInfo keyProperty = classInfo.KeyProperty;
			if (classInfo.IsTypedObject || classInfo.IsGCRecordObject || classInfo.HasPurgebleObjectReferences())
			{
				GetObjectType(classInfo);
			}
		}

		private Task InternalBeforeSaveAsync(object theObject, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(theObject);
			classInfo.CheckAbstractReference();
			XPMemberInfo keyProperty = classInfo.KeyProperty;
			if (classInfo.IsTypedObject || classInfo.IsGCRecordObject || classInfo.HasPurgebleObjectReferences())
			{
				return GetObjectTypeAsync(classInfo, cancellationToken);
			}
			return Task.FromResult(0);
		}

		internal void CheckDuplicateObjectInIdentityMap(object theObject)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(theObject);
			object loadedObjectByKey = SessionIdentityMap.GetLoadedObjectByKey(this, classInfo, classInfo.GetId(theObject));
			if (loadedObjectByKey != null && loadedObjectByKey != theObject)
			{
				throw new DifferentObjectsWithSameKeyException();
			}
		}

		internal void RegisterInsertedObject(object theObject)
		{
			SessionIdentityMap.RegisterObject(this, theObject, Dictionary.GetId(theObject));
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			isDisposed = true;
			if (disposing)
			{
				_AsyncLockSemaphore.Dispose();
				Disconnect();
			}
			else if (IsConnected && Environment.OSVersion.Platform == PlatformID.Win32NT)
			{
				PerformanceCounters.SessionCount.Decrement();
				PerformanceCounters.SessionDisconnected.Increment();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected virtual bool OnFailedCommitTransaction(Exception ex)
		{
			SessionOperationFailEventArgs e = new SessionOperationFailEventArgs(ex);
			if (this.FailedCommitTransaction != null)
			{
				this.FailedCommitTransaction(this, e);
			}
			return e.Handled;
		}

		protected virtual bool OnFailedFlushChanges(Exception ex)
		{
			if (!OnFailedFlushChangesInternal(ex))
			{
				return OnFailedCommitTransaction(ex);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool OnFailedFlushChangesInternal(Exception ex)
		{
			SessionOperationFailEventArgs e = new SessionOperationFailEventArgs(ex);
			if (this.FailedFlushChanges != null)
			{
				this.FailedFlushChanges(this, e);
			}
			return e.Handled;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeIsObjectModifiedOnNonPersistentPropertyChange()
		{
			return isObjectModifiedOnNonPersistentPropertyChange.HasValue;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void TriggerObjectChanged(object changedObject, ObjectChangeEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Reason == ObjectChangeReason.PropertyChanged)
			{
				XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(changedObject);
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = null;
				bool flag = e.OldValue != e.NewValue;
				if (e.PropertyName != null && e.PropertyName.Length > 0)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						xPMemberInfo = classInfo.FindMember(e.PropertyName);
						if (xPMemberInfo != null && (classInfo.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? TrackPropertiesModifications))
						{
							xPMemberInfo.SetModified(changedObject, e.OldValue);
						}
					}
					else if (e.OldValue == null && e.NewValue == null)
					{
						xPMemberInfo = classInfo.FindMember(e.PropertyName);
					}
				}
				if (IsUnitOfWork && classInfo.IsPersistent && (xPMemberInfo == null || xPMemberInfo.IsPersistent || (!xPMemberInfo.IsPersistent && (IsObjectModifiedOnNonPersistentPropertyChange ?? XpoDefault.IsObjectModifiedOnNonPersistentPropertyChange))))
				{
					Save(changedObject);
				}
				OnObjectChanged(changedObject, e);
				if (flag)
				{
					xPMemberInfo?.ProcessAssociationRefChange(this, changedObject, e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				OnObjectChanged(changedObject, e);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnObjectChanged(object changedObject, ObjectChangeEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ObjectChanged != null)
			{
				this.ObjectChanged(changedObject, e);
			}
		}

		private void SessionInitCommon()
		{
			_connectionString = string.Empty;
			_connection = null;
			closeConnectionOnDisconnect = false;
		}

		private void SessionInitDisconnected(XPDictionary dictionary)
		{
			objectLayer = null;
			dict = dictionary;
			_DisposeOnDisconnect = null;
			SessionInitCommon();
		}

		private void SessionInitConnected(IObjectLayer layer, IDisposable[] disposeOnDisconnect)
		{
			if (layer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("layer");
			}
			OnBeforeConnect();
			_DisposeOnDisconnect = disposeOnDisconnect;
			objectLayer = layer;
			dict = objectLayer.Dictionary;
			SessionInitCommon();
			OnAfterConnect();
		}

		{
			return GetLoadedObjectByKey(Dictionary.GetClassInfo(classType), id);

		public object GetLoadedObjectByKey(XPClassInfo classInfo, object id)
		{
			if (classInfo == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("classInfo");
			}
			if (classInfo.KeyProperty == null)
			{
				classInfo.CheckAbstractReference();
			}
			if (id == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!classInfo.KeyProperty.MemberType.IsAssignableFrom(id.GetType()) && ((!typeof(ArrayList).IsAssignableFrom(id.GetType()) && !typeof(List<object>).IsAssignableFrom(id.GetType())) || !classInfo.KeyProperty.IsStruct) && (classInfo.KeyProperty.ReferenceType == null || !classInfo.KeyProperty.ReferenceType.KeyProperty.MemberType.IsAssignableFrom(id.GetType())))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("Session_IncompatibleIdType", id.GetType().FullName, classInfo.FullName, classInfo.KeyProperty.Name, classInfo.KeyProperty.MemberType.FullName));
			}
			return SessionIdentityMap.GetLoadedObjectByKey(this, classInfo, classInfo.KeyProperty.ExpandId(id));
		}

		public ICollection[] GetObjectsByKey(ObjectsByKeyQuery[] queries, bool alwaysGetFromDataStore)
		{

					List<object> list6 = new List<object>();
					List<object> list7 = new List<object>();
					ObjectsByKeyQuery objectsByKeyQuery = queries[i];
					foreach (object item in objectsByKeyQuery.IdCollection)
					{
						object loadedObjectByKey = GetLoadedObjectByKey(objectsByKeyQuery.ClassInfo, item);
						if (loadedObjectByKey == null)
						{
							list6.Add(item);
						}
						else if (alwaysGetFromDataStore)
						{
							RemoveFromLists(loadedObjectByKey);
							list7.Add(item);
						}
						else
						{
							list5.Add(loadedObjectByKey);
						}
					}
					list.Add(list5);
					if (list7.Count > 0)
					{

						list3.Add(new ObjectsByKeyQuery(objectsByKeyQuery.ClassInfo, list7.ToArray()));
					}
					else
					{
						list2.Add(null);
					}
					list4.Add(new ObjectsByKeyQuery(objectsByKeyQuery.ClassInfo, list6.ToArray()));
				}
				ICollection[] array = null;
				if (list3.Count > 0)
				{
					array = ObjectLayer.GetObjectsByKey(this, list3.ToArray());
					for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
					{
						if (array[j].Count != list3[j].IdCollection.Count)
						{
							throw new CannotLoadObjectsException(list3[j].ClassInfo.FullName);
						}
						int num = 0;
						foreach (object item2 in array[j])
						{
							if (item2 == null)
							{
								throw new CannotLoadObjectsException(list3[j].ClassInfo.FullName + "(" + ((object[])list3[j].IdCollection)[num].ToString() + ")");
							}
							num++;
						}
					}
				}

				ICollection[] array2 = new ICollection[objectsByKey.Length];
				for (int k = 0; k < objectsByKey.Length; k++)
				{
					List<object> list8 = list[k];
					ICollection collection = objectsByKey[k];
					object[] array3;
					if (list2[k].HasValue)
					{
						ICollection collection2 = array[k];
						array3 = new object[list8.Count + collection.Count + collection2.Count];
						list8.CopyTo(array3, 0);
						collection.CopyTo(array3, list8.Count);
						collection2.CopyTo(array3, list8.Count + collection.Count);
					}
					else
					{
						array3 = new object[list8.Count + collection.Count];
						list8.CopyTo(array3, 0);
						collection.CopyTo(array3, list8.Count);
					}
					array2[k] = array3;
				}
				ICollection[] array4 = new ICollection[queries.Length];
				for (int l = 0; l < queries.Length; l++)
				{
					List<object> list9 = new List<object>(queries[l].IdCollection.Count);
					XPClassInfo classInfo = queries[l].ClassInfo;
					foreach (object item3 in queries[l].IdCollection)
					{
						list9.Add(GetLoadedObjectByKey(classInfo, item3));
					}
					array4[l] = list9.ToArray();
				}
				GC.KeepAlive(list);
				GC.KeepAlive(objectsByKey);
				GC.KeepAlive(array2);
				GC.KeepAlive(array);
				return array4;

		private ObjectsByKeyQuery[] OptimizeGetObjectsByKeyQueries(List<ObjectsByKeyQuery> queries)
		{
			ObjectsByKeyQuery[] array = new ObjectsByKeyQuery[queries.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < queries.Count; i++)
			{
				Dictionary<object, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, bool>();
				foreach (object item in queries[i].IdCollection)
				{
					if (item != null)
					{
						dictionary[item] = true;
					}
				}
				object[] array2 = new object[dictionary.Count];
				dictionary.Keys.CopyTo(array2, 0);
				array[i] = new ObjectsByKeyQuery(queries[i].ClassInfo, array2);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static void FindObjectAsyncResultProcess(ICollection[] res, Exception ex, AsyncFindObjectCallback callback)
		{
			if (ex != null)
			{
				try
				{
					callback(null, ex);
					return;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			object result = null;
			try
			{
				if (res != null && res.Length != 0 && res[0] != null)
				{
					IEnumerator enumerator = res[0].GetEnumerator();
					result = (enumerator.MoveNext() ? enumerator.Current : null);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex3)
			{
				try
				{
					callback(null, ex3);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			try
			{
				callback(result, null);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

					return InTransactionLoader.GetObjectsAsync(this, new ObjectsQuery[1] { queryForFindObject }, callback2);

					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_UnexpectedPersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehavior", criteriaEvaluationBehavior.ToString()));

		public object FindObject(PersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehavior criteriaEvaluationBehavior, XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperator criteria, bool selectDeleted)
		{
			return LogManager.Log<object>("Session", (LogHandler<object>)delegate
			{
				switch (criteriaEvaluationBehavior)
				{
				case PersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehavior.BeforeTransaction:
				{
					ObjectsQuery queryForFindObject2 = GetQueryForFindObject(classInfo, criteria, selectDeleted);
					ICollection collection2 = GetObjectsInternal(new ObjectsQuery[1] { queryForFindObject2 })[0];
					IEnumerator enumerator2 = collection2.GetEnumerator();
					if (!enumerator2.MoveNext())
					{
						return (object)null;
					}
					return enumerator2.Current;
				}
				case PersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehavior.InTransaction:
				{
					ObjectsQuery queryForFindObject = GetQueryForFindObject(classInfo, criteria, selectDeleted);
					ICollection collection = InTransactionLoader.GetObjects(this, new ObjectsQuery[1] { queryForFindObject })[0];
					IEnumerator enumerator = collection.GetEnumerator();
					if (!enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						return (object)null;
					}
					return enumerator.Current;
				}
				default:
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_UnexpectedPersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehavior", criteriaEvaluationBehavior.ToString()));
				}
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing FindObject()", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString(), "criteriaEvaluationBehavior", criteriaEvaluationBehavior.ToString(), "classInfo", classInfo.FullName, "criteria", (criteria == null) ? "null" : ((object)criteria).ToString(), "selectDeleted", selectDeleted)));
		}

		{

					return enumerator.MoveNext() ? enumerator.Current : null;
				}

					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_UnexpectedPersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehavior", criteriaEvaluationBehavior.ToString()));
				}
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing FindObject()", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString(), "criteriaEvaluationBehavior", criteriaEvaluationBehavior.ToString(), "classInfo", classInfo.FullName, "criteria", (criteria == null) ? "null" : ((object)criteria).ToString(), "selectDeleted", selectDeleted)));
		}

		public virtual ICollection GetObjectsToSave(bool includeParent)
		{
			ICollection objectsToSave = GetObjectsToSave();
			if (!includeParent)
			{
				return objectsToSave;
			}
			if (!(ObjectLayer is IObjectLayerOnSession objectLayerOnSession))
			{
				return objectsToSave;
			}
			ICollection parentObjectsToSave = objectLayerOnSession.GetParentObjectsToSave(this);
			if (parentObjectsToSave.Count == 0)
			{
				return objectsToSave;
			}
			ObjectSet objectSet = new ObjectSet(objectsToSave.Count + parentObjectsToSave.Count);
			foreach (object item in objectsToSave)
			{
				objectSet.Add(item);
			}
			foreach (object item2 in parentObjectsToSave)
			{
				objectSet.Add(item2);
			}
			return objectSet;
		}

		public ICollection CollectReferencingObjects(object target, PersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehavior behavior, bool selectDeleted)
		{
			//IL_015d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0167: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0188: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0194: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_018f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0196: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (target == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("target");
			}
			ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(target);
			XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(target);
			classInfo.CheckAbstractReference();
			TypesManager.EnsureIsTypedObjectValid();
			Dictionary<XPClassInfo, List<XPMemberInfo>> dictionary = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, List<XPMemberInfo>>();
			foreach (XPClassInfo @class in Dictionary.Classes)
			{
				if (!@class.IsPersistent)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in @class.ObjectProperties)
				{
					if (classInfo.IsAssignableTo(objectProperty.ReferenceType))
					{
						XPClassInfo mappingClass = objectProperty.GetMappingClass(@class);
						if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(mappingClass, out var value))
						{
							value = new List<XPMemberInfo>();
							dictionary.Add(mappingClass, value);
						}
						if (!value.Contains(objectProperty))
						{
							value.Add(objectProperty);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ObjectSet objectSet = new ObjectSet();
			foreach (XPClassInfo key in dictionary.Keys)
			{
				List<CriteriaOperator> list = new List<CriteriaOperator>();
				foreach (XPMemberInfo item in (IEnumerable)dictionary[key])
				{
					list.Add((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(item.Name));
				}
				InOperator val = new InOperator((CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue(target), (IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)list);
				ICollection collection = ((behavior != PersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehavior.InTransaction) ? GetObjectsInternal(new ObjectsQuery[1]
				{
					new ObjectsQuery(key, (CriteriaOperator)(object)val, null, 0, 0, new CollectionCriteriaPatcher(selectDeleted, TypesManager), force: false)
				})[0] : GetObjectsInTransaction(key, (CriteriaOperator)(object)val, selectDeleted));
				foreach (object item2 in collection)
				{
					objectSet.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			return objectSet;
		}

		public ICollection CollectReferencingObjects(object target)
		{
			return CollectReferencingObjects(target, PersistentCriteriaEvaluationBehavior.BeforeTransaction, selectDeleted: false);
		}

		public IList ProcessReferences(object target, ProcessReferenceHandler process)
		{
			List<object> list = ListHelper.FromCollection(CollectReferencingObjects(target));
			XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(target);
			foreach (object item in list)
			{
				foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in GetClassInfo(item).ObjectProperties)
				{
					if (classInfo.IsAssignableTo(objectProperty.ReferenceType) && target == objectProperty.GetValue(item))
					{
						process(item, objectProperty);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public bool IsObjectMarkedDeleted(object theObject)

		}

			{
				foreach (XPClassInfo parentTouchedClassInfo in objectLayerOnSession.GetParentTouchedClassInfos(this))
				{
					dictionary[parentTouchedClassInfo] = null;
				}
			}
			return dictionary.Keys;
		}

		public virtual void BeginTransaction()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Expected O, but got Unknown
			LogManager.Log("Session", (LogHandlerVoid)delegate
			{
				BeginTrackingChanges();
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing BeginTransaction()", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString())), (ExceptionHandler)null);
		}

		public void BeginTrackingChanges()
		{
			OnBeforeBeginTrackingChanges();
			if (TrackingChanges)
			{
				throw new TransactionSequenceException(Res.GetString("Session_TranSequenceBegin"));
			}
			SessionStateStack.Enter(this, SessionState.BeginTransaction);
			try
			{
				Connect();
				trackingChanges = true;
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(this, SessionState.BeginTransaction);
			}
			OnAfterBeginTrackingChanges();
		}

		private void FlushChangesInsideTransaction()
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (object item in GetObjectsToDelete())
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			foreach (object item2 in GetObjectsToSave())
			{
				if (!IsObjectToDelete(item2))
				{
					list2.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			ObjectLayer.CommitChanges(this, list, list2);
		}

		private Task FlushChangesInsideTransactionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (object item in GetObjectsToDelete())
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			foreach (object item2 in GetObjectsToSave())
			{
				if (!IsObjectToDelete(item2))
				{
					list2.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			return GetObjectLayerAsync().CommitChangesAsync(this, list, list2, cancellationToken);
		}

		private void ThrowIfCommitChangesToDataLayerInner()
		{
			if (SessionStateStack.IsInAnyOf(this, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_ObjectModificationIsNotAllowed"));
			}
		}

		public virtual object CommitTransactionAsync(AsyncCommitCallback callback)
		{
			return FlushChangesAsync(callback);
		}

		public object FlushChangesAsync(AsyncCommitCallback callback)
		{
			return LogManager.Log<object>("Session", (LogHandler<object>)delegate
			{
				try
				{
					IList objectsToFireSaved = BeginFlushChanges();
					List<object> list = new List<object>();
					foreach (object item in GetObjectsToDelete())
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
					foreach (object item2 in GetObjectsToSave())
					{
						if (!IsObjectToDelete(item2))
						{
							list2.Add(item2);
						}
					}
					SessionStateStack.Enter(this, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayer);
					return ObjectLayer.CommitChangesAsync(this, list, list2, delegate(Exception commitEx)
					{
						SessionStateStack.Leave(this, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayer);
						if (commitEx == null)
						{
							try
							{
								EndFlushChanges(objectsToFireSaved);
								callback(null);
								return;
							}
							catch (Exception ex2)
							{
								try
								{
									callback(OnFailedFlushChanges(ex2) ? null : ex2);
									return;
								}
								catch (Exception)
								{
									return;
								}
							}
						}
						try
						{
							callback(OnFailedFlushChanges(commitEx) ? null : commitEx);
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					});
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (!OnFailedFlushChanges(ex))
					{
						throw;
					}
					return (object)null;
				}
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)delegate(TimeSpan d)
			{
				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000d: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0032: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0052: Expected O, but got Unknown
				LogMessage val = new LogMessage((LogMessageType)3, "Executing FlushChangesAsync()", d);
				val.ParameterList.Add(new LogMessageParameter("sessionType", (object)GetType().ToString()));
				val.ParameterList.Add(new LogMessageParameter("sessionID", (object)ToString()));
				return val;
			});
		}

		public virtual Task CommitTransactionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))

		}

		public virtual void CommitTransaction()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Expected O, but got Unknown
			LogManager.Log("Session", (LogHandlerVoid)delegate
			{
				FlushChanges();
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing CommitTransaction()", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString())), (ExceptionHandler)null);
		}

		public void FlushChanges()
		{
			try
			{
				WaitForAsyncOperationEnd();
				IList objectsToFireSaved = BeginFlushChanges();
				SessionStateStack.Enter(this, SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant);
				try
				{
					SessionStateStack.Enter(this, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayer);
					try
					{
						FlushChangesInsideTransaction();
					}
					finally
					{
						SessionStateStack.Leave(this, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayer);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					SessionStateStack.Leave(this, SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant);
				}
				EndFlushChanges(objectsToFireSaved);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!OnFailedFlushChanges(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		public async Task FlushChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			_ = 3;
			try
			{
				int asyncOperationId = SessionStateStack.GetNewAsyncOperationId();
				IList objectsToFireSaved = await BeginFlushChangesAsync(asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
				await SessionStateStack.EnterAsync(this, SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
				try
				{
					SessionStateStack.Enter(this, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayer);
					try
					{
						await FlushChangesInsideTransactionAsync(cancellationToken);
					}
					finally
					{
						SessionStateStack.Leave(this, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayer);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					SessionStateStack.Leave(this, SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant, asyncOperationId);
				}
				await EndFlushChangesAsync(objectsToFireSaved, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!OnFailedFlushChanges(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual IList BeginFlushChanges()
		{
			IList objectsToFireSaved = null;
			if (!IsUnitOfWork && !TrackingChanges)
			{
				throw new TransactionSequenceException(Res.GetString("Session_TranSequenceCommit"));
			}
			ThrowIfCommitChangesToDataLayerInner();
			SessionStateStack.Enter(this, SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant);
			try
			{
				PreProcessSavedList();
				return BeginFlushChangesCore(objectsToFireSaved);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(this, SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant);
			}
		}

		protected virtual async Task<IList> BeginFlushChangesAsync(int asyncOperationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			IList objectsToFireSaved = null;
			if (!IsUnitOfWork && !TrackingChanges)
			{
				throw new TransactionSequenceException(Res.GetString("Session_TranSequenceCommit"));
			}
			ThrowIfCommitChangesToDataLayerInner();
			await SessionStateStack.EnterAsync(this, SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			try
			{
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				await PreProcessSavedListAsync(cancellationToken);
				return BeginFlushChangesCore(objectsToFireSaved);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(this, SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant, asyncOperationId);
			}
		}

		private void EndFlushChanges(IList objectsToFireSaved)
		{
			SessionStateStack.Enter(this, SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant);
			try
			{
				EndFlushChangesCore(objectsToFireSaved);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(this, SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant);
			}
			TriggerObjectsSaved(objectsToFireSaved);
			OnAfterFlushChanges();
		}

		private async Task EndFlushChangesAsync(IList objectsToFireSaved, int asyncOperationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			await SessionStateStack.EnterAsync(this, SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			try
			{
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				EndFlushChangesCore(objectsToFireSaved);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(this, SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant, asyncOperationId);
			}
			TriggerObjectsSaved(objectsToFireSaved);
			OnAfterFlushChanges();
		}

		private IList BeginFlushChangesCore(IList objectsToFireSaved)
		{
			OnBeforeFlushChanges();
			ICollection objectsToSave = GetObjectsToSave();
			objectsToFireSaved = new List<object>(objectsToSave.Count);
			foreach (object item in objectsToSave)
			{
				if (!IsObjectToDelete(item))
				{
					objectsToFireSaved.Add(item);
				}
			}
			SessionStateStack.Enter(this, SessionState.OptimisticLockFieldsProcessing);
			try
			{
				foreach (object item2 in objectsToSave)
				{
					XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(item2);
					XPMemberInfo optimisticLockField = classInfo.OptimisticLockField;
					if (optimisticLockField != null)
					{
						int? num = (int?)optimisticLockField.GetValue(item2);
						int? num2 = ((!num.HasValue || !(num < int.MaxValue)) ? new int?(0) : new int?(num.Value + 1));
						optimisticLockField.SetValue(item2, num2);
						if (classInfo.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? TrackPropertiesModifications)
						{
							optimisticLockField.SetModified(item2, num);
						}
					}
				}
				return objectsToFireSaved;
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(this, SessionState.OptimisticLockFieldsProcessing);
			}
		}

		private void EndFlushChangesCore(IList objectsToFireSaved)
		{
			SessionStateStack.Enter(this, SessionState.OptimisticLockFieldsProcessing);
			try
			{
				foreach (object item in objectsToFireSaved)
				{
					XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(item);
					foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
					{
						if (persistentProperty.IsDelayed)
						{
							XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(item, persistentProperty);
							delayedPropertyContainer.ResetIsModified();
						}
					}
					XPMemberInfo optimisticLockField = classInfo.OptimisticLockField;
					if (optimisticLockField != null)
					{
						classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer.SetValue(item, optimisticLockField.GetValue(item));
					}
					classInfo.ClearModifications(item);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(this, SessionState.OptimisticLockFieldsProcessing);
			}
			foreach (XPRefCollectionHelper key in collectionsMarkedSaved.Keys)
			{
				key.ClearChangesCache();
			}
			collectionsMarkedSaved.Clear();
			objectsMarkedSaved.Clear();
			objectsMarkedDeleted.Clear();
			trackingChanges = false;
		}

		private void RollbackVersions()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<object, int?> item in objectsMarkedSaved)
			{
				if (item.Value.HasValue)
				{
					GetClassInfo(item.Key).OptimisticLockField?.SetValue(item.Key, item.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void RollbackTransaction()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Expected O, but got Unknown
			LogManager.Log("Session", (LogHandlerVoid)delegate
			{
				DropChanges();
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing RollbackTransaction()", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString())), (ExceptionHandler)null);
		}

		public void DropChanges()
		{
			OnBeforeDropChanges();
			if (!IsUnitOfWork && !TrackingChanges)
			{
				throw new TransactionSequenceException(Res.GetString("Session_TranSequenceRollback"));
			}
			SessionStateStack.Enter(this, SessionState.RollbackTransaction);
			try
			{
				collectionsMarkedSaved.Clear();
				objectsMarkedSaved.Clear();
				objectsMarkedDeleted.Clear();
				trackingChanges = false;
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(this, SessionState.RollbackTransaction);
			}
			OnAfterDropChanges();
		}

		public void Connect(IObjectLayer layer, params IDisposable[] disposeOnDisconnect)
		{
			if (isDisposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().FullName);
			}
			if (IsConnected)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_AlreadyConnected"));
			}
			SessionInitConnected(layer, disposeOnDisconnect);
		}

		private void ConnectOldStyle()
		{
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			OnBeforeConnect();
			closeConnectionOnDisconnect = false;
			if (_connection != null)
			{
				closeConnectionOnDisconnect = _connection.State != ConnectionState.Open;
				objectLayer = SimpleObjectLayer.FromDataLayer(XpoDefault.GetDataLayer(_connection, dict, AutoCreateOption, out _DisposeOnDisconnect));
			}
			else
			{
				objectLayer = SimpleObjectLayer.FromDataLayer(XpoDefault.GetDataLayer(ConnectionString, dict, AutoCreateOption, out _DisposeOnDisconnect));
			}
			dict = objectLayer.Dictionary;
			OnAfterConnect();
		}

		public void Connect()
		{
			if (isDisposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(ToString());
			}
			if (IsConnected)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_connection != null || (_connectionString != null && _connectionString.Length > 0))
			{
				ConnectOldStyle();
			}
			else
			{
				IObjectLayer objectLayer = XpoDefault.ObjectLayer;
				if (objectLayer == null)
				{
					objectLayer = SimpleObjectLayer.FromDataLayer(XpoDefault.DataLayer);
				}
				if (objectLayer != null)
				{
					if (dict != null && dict != objectLayer.Dictionary)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_DictConstractor"));
					}
					Connect(objectLayer);
				}
				else
				{
					ConnectOldStyle();
				}
			}
			if (Environment.OSVersion.Platform == PlatformID.Win32NT)
			{
				PerformanceCounters.SessionCount.Increment();
				PerformanceCounters.SessionConnected.Increment();
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("Use DropIdentityMap() instead")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void DropCache()
		{
			DropIdentityMap();
		}

		public void DropIdentityMap()
		{
			if (TrackingChanges)
			{
				DropChanges();
			}
			if (_IdentityMap != null)
			{
				_IdentityMap.Clear();
				_IdentityMap = null;
			}
			typesManager = null;
			OnAfterDropIdentityMap();
		}

		private void Clear()
		{
			DropIdentityMap();
			trackingChanges = false;
			if (_DisposeOnDisconnect != null)
			{
				IDisposable[] disposeOnDisconnect = _DisposeOnDisconnect;
				for (int i = 0; i < disposeOnDisconnect.Length; i++)
				{
					disposeOnDisconnect[i]?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			objectLayer = null;
			_DisposeOnDisconnect = null;
			if (_connection != null && closeConnectionOnDisconnect)
			{
				try
				{
					_connection.Close();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		public void Disconnect()
		{
			if (InTransaction)
			{
				RollbackTransaction();
			}
			if (IsConnected)
			{
				OnBeforeDisconnect();
				Clear();
				OnAfterDisconnect();
				if (Environment.OSVersion.Platform == PlatformID.Win32NT)
				{
					PerformanceCounters.SessionCount.Decrement();
					PerformanceCounters.SessionDisconnected.Increment();
				}
			}
		}

		public void BulkLoad(params IXPBulkLoadableCollection[] collections)
		{
			if (collections == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("collections");
			}
			List<ObjectsQuery> list = new List<ObjectsQuery>();
			List<IXPBulkLoadableCollection> list2 = new List<IXPBulkLoadableCollection>();
			for (int i = 0; i < collections.Length; i++)
			{
				if (collections[i] != null)
				{
					ObjectsQuery objectsQuery = collections[i].BeginLoad();
					if (objectsQuery != null)
					{
						list.Add(objectsQuery);
						list2.Add(collections[i]);
					}
				}
			}
			ICollection[] objects = GetObjects(list.ToArray());
			for (int j = 0; j < objects.Length; j++)
			{
				list2[j].EndLoad(objects[j]);
			}
		}

		public async Task BulkLoadAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken), params IXPBulkLoadableCollection[] collections)
		{
			if (collections == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("collections");
			}
			List<ObjectsQuery> list = new List<ObjectsQuery>();
			List<IXPBulkLoadableCollection> colls = new List<IXPBulkLoadableCollection>();
			for (int i = 0; i < collections.Length; i++)
			{
				if (collections[i] != null)
				{
					ObjectsQuery objectsQuery = collections[i].BeginLoad();
					if (objectsQuery != null)
					{
						list.Add(objectsQuery);
						colls.Add(collections[i]);
					}
				}
			}
			ICollection[] array = await GetObjectsAsync(list.ToArray(), cancellationToken);
			for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
			{
				colls[j].EndLoad(array[j]);
			}
		}

		object IPersistentValueExtractor.ExtractPersistentValue(object criterionValue)
		{
			ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(criterionValue);
			if (Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(criterionValue) == null)
			{
				return criterionValue;
			}
			if (IsNewObject(criterionValue))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetKeyValue(criterionValue);
		}

		public void PreFetch(XPClassInfo classInfo, IEnumerable objects, params string[] propertyPaths)
		{
			ICollection uniqueObjects = null;
			ObjectsUniquer(ref uniqueObjects, objects);
			foreach (string path in propertyPaths)
			{
				string[] array = MemberInfoCollection.SplitPath(path);
				if (array.Length == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = MemberInfoCollection.FindMember(classInfo, array[0]);
				if (xPMemberInfo.IsAssociationList || xPMemberInfo.IsManyToManyAlias)
				{
					XPMemberInfo member = (xPMemberInfo.IsAssociationList ? xPMemberInfo : classInfo.GetMember(((ManyToManyAliasAttribute)xPMemberInfo.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(ManyToManyAliasAttribute))).OneToManyCollectionName));
					PreFetchCore(classInfo, uniqueObjects, member);
					if (array.Length <= 1)
					{
						continue;
					}
					List<object> list = new List<object>();
					if (classInfo.IsAssignableTo(xPMemberInfo.Owner))
					{
						foreach (object item in uniqueObjects)
						{
							ICollection collection = (ICollection)xPMemberInfo.GetValue(item);
							list.AddRange(ListHelper.FromCollection(collection));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						foreach (object item2 in uniqueObjects)
						{
							XPClassInfo classInfo2 = GetClassInfo(item2);
							if (classInfo2.IsAssignableTo(xPMemberInfo.Owner))
							{
								ICollection collection2 = (ICollection)xPMemberInfo.GetValue(item2);
								list.AddRange(ListHelper.FromCollection(collection2));
							}
						}
					}
					if (list.Count > 0)
					{
						PreFetch(xPMemberInfo.CollectionElementType, list, string.Join(".", array, 1, array.Length - 1));
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (xPMemberInfo.IsPersistent && xPMemberInfo.IsDelayed)
				{
					if (xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType == null)
					{
						XPDelayedProperty.PreFetchGenericProps(this, uniqueObjects, xPMemberInfo);
					}
					else
					{
						XPDelayedProperty.PreFetchRefProps(this, uniqueObjects, xPMemberInfo);
					}
				}
				if (array.Length <= 1 || xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				IList list2 = new List<object>();
				if (classInfo.IsAssignableTo(xPMemberInfo.Owner))
				{
					foreach (object item3 in uniqueObjects)
					{
						list2.Add(xPMemberInfo.GetValue(item3));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (object item4 in uniqueObjects)
					{
						XPClassInfo classInfo3 = GetClassInfo(item4);
						if (classInfo3.IsAssignableTo(xPMemberInfo.Owner))
						{
							list2.Add(xPMemberInfo.GetValue(item4));
						}
					}
				}
				if (list2.Count > 0)
				{
					PreFetch(xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType, list2, string.Join(".", array, 1, array.Length - 1));
				}
			}
		}

		public async Task PreFetchAsync(XPClassInfo classInfo, IEnumerable objects, CancellationToken cancellationToken, params string[] propertyPaths)
		{
			ICollection uniqueObjects = null;
			ObjectsUniquer(ref uniqueObjects, objects);
			foreach (string path in propertyPaths)
			{
				string[] membersPath = MemberInfoCollection.SplitPath(path);
				if (membersPath.Length == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				XPMemberInfo member = MemberInfoCollection.FindMember(classInfo, membersPath[0]);
				if (member.IsAssociationList || member.IsManyToManyAlias)
				{
					XPMemberInfo member2 = (member.IsAssociationList ? member : classInfo.GetMember(((ManyToManyAliasAttribute)member.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(ManyToManyAliasAttribute))).OneToManyCollectionName));
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					await PreFetchCoreAsync(classInfo, uniqueObjects, member2, cancellationToken);
					if (membersPath.Length <= 1)
					{
						continue;
					}
					List<object> list = new List<object>();
					if (classInfo.IsAssignableTo(member.Owner))
					{
						foreach (object item in uniqueObjects)
						{
							ICollection collection = (ICollection)member.GetValue(item);
							list.AddRange(ListHelper.FromCollection(collection));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						foreach (object item2 in uniqueObjects)
						{
							XPClassInfo classInfo2 = GetClassInfo(item2);
							if (classInfo2.IsAssignableTo(member.Owner))
							{
								ICollection collection2 = (ICollection)member.GetValue(item2);
								list.AddRange(ListHelper.FromCollection(collection2));
							}
						}
					}
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					if (list.Count > 0)
					{
						await PreFetchAsync(member.CollectionElementType, list, cancellationToken, string.Join(".", membersPath, 1, membersPath.Length - 1));
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (member.IsPersistent && member.IsDelayed)
				{
					if (member.ReferenceType != null)
					{
						await XPDelayedProperty.PreFetchRefPropsAsync(this, uniqueObjects, member, cancellationToken);
					}
					else
					{
						await XPDelayedProperty.PreFetchGenericPropsAsync(this, uniqueObjects, member, cancellationToken);
					}
				}
				if (membersPath.Length <= 1 || member.ReferenceType == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				IList list2 = new List<object>();
				if (classInfo.IsAssignableTo(member.Owner))
				{
					foreach (object item3 in uniqueObjects)
					{
						list2.Add(member.GetValue(item3));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (object item4 in uniqueObjects)
					{
						XPClassInfo classInfo3 = GetClassInfo(item4);
						if (classInfo3.IsAssignableTo(member.Owner))
						{
							list2.Add(member.GetValue(item4));
						}
					}
				}
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				if (list2.Count > 0)
				{
					await PreFetchAsync(member.ReferenceType, list2, cancellationToken, string.Join(".", membersPath, 1, membersPath.Length - 1));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ObjectsUniquer(ref ICollection uniqueObjects, IEnumerable nonUniqueObjects)
		{
			if (uniqueObjects != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ObjectSet objectSet = new ObjectSet();
			foreach (object nonUniqueObject in nonUniqueObjects)
			{
				if (nonUniqueObject != null)
				{
					ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(nonUniqueObject);
					if (!IsNewObject(nonUniqueObject))
					{
						objectSet.Add(nonUniqueObject);
					}
				}
			}
			uniqueObjects = objectSet;
		}

		internal void ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ISessionProvider sessionProvider && sessionProvider.Session != this)
			{
				throw new SessionMixingException(sessionProvider.Session, obj);
			}
		}

		private void PreFetchCore(XPClassInfo classInfo, IEnumerable objects, XPMemberInfo member)
		{
			if (PreFetchCoreBegin(classInfo, objects, member, out var queries, out var objectsByOwners, out var loadedClassInfo))
			{
				ICollection[] objects2 = GetObjects(queries.ToArray());
				PreFetchCoreEnd(classInfo, objects, member, loadedClassInfo, objectsByOwners, objects2);
			}
		}

		private async Task PreFetchCoreAsync(XPClassInfo classInfo, IEnumerable objects, XPMemberInfo member, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (PreFetchCoreBegin(classInfo, objects, member, out var queries, out var objectsByOwners, out var loadedClassInfo))
			{
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				ICollection[] results = await GetObjectsAsync(queries.ToArray(), cancellationToken);
				PreFetchCoreEnd(classInfo, objects, member, loadedClassInfo, objectsByOwners, results);
			}
		}

		private bool PreFetchCoreBegin(XPClassInfo classInfo, IEnumerable objects, XPMemberInfo member, out List<ObjectsQuery> queries, out ObjectDictionary<ObjectSet> objectsByOwners, out XPClassInfo loadedClassInfo)
		{
			//IL_011d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0137: Expected O, but got Unknown
			queries = null;
			objectsByOwners = null;
			loadedClassInfo = null;
			if (member.IsManyToManyAlias)
			{
				ManyToManyAliasAttribute manyToManyAliasAttribute = (ManyToManyAliasAttribute)member.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(ManyToManyAliasAttribute));
				XPMemberInfo member2 = classInfo.GetMember(manyToManyAliasAttribute.OneToManyCollectionName);
				PreFetchCore(classInfo, objects, member2);
				return false;
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			objectsByOwners = new ObjectDictionary<ObjectSet>();
			foreach (object @object in objects)
			{
				ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(@object);
				if (member.GetValue(@object) is IXPPrefetchableAssociationList iXPPrefetchableAssociationList && iXPPrefetchableAssociationList.NeedPrefetch())
				{
					list.Add(GetKeyValue(@object));
					objectsByOwners.Add(@object, new ObjectSet());
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			queries = new List<ObjectsQuery>();
			loadedClassInfo = (member.IsManyToMany ? member.IntermediateClass : member.CollectionElementType);
			int terminalInSize;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i += terminalInSize)
			{
				terminalInSize = XpoDefault.GetTerminalInSize(list.Count - i);
				queries.Add(new ObjectsQuery(loadedClassInfo, (CriteriaOperator)new InOperator(member.GetAssociatedMember().Name, (IEnumerable)GetRangeHelper.GetRange(list, i, terminalInSize)), null, 0, 0, new CollectionCriteriaPatcher(selectDeleted: false, TypesManager), force: false));
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void PreFetchCoreEnd(XPClassInfo classInfo, IEnumerable objects, XPMemberInfo member, XPClassInfo loadedClassInfo, ObjectDictionary<ObjectSet> objectsByOwners, ICollection[] results)
		{
			XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = (member.IsManyToMany ? member.IntermediateClass.GetMember(member.GetAssociatedMember().Name) : member.GetAssociatedMember());
			XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo2 = loadedClassInfo.FindMember(GCRecordField.StaticName);
			foreach (ICollection collection in results)
			{
				foreach (object item in collection)
				{
					if (!IsObjectToDelete(item, includeParent: true) && (xPMemberInfo2 == null || xPMemberInfo2.GetValue(item) == null))
					{
						object value = xPMemberInfo.GetValue(item);
						if (value != null && objectsByOwners.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
						{
							value2.Add(item);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (object item2 in GetObjectsToSave(includeParent: true))
			{
				if (!IsObjectToDelete(item2, includeParent: true) && GetClassInfo(item2).IsAssignableTo(loadedClassInfo) && (xPMemberInfo2 == null || xPMemberInfo2.GetValue(item2) == null))
				{
					object value3 = xPMemberInfo.GetValue(item2);
					if (value3 != null && objectsByOwners.TryGetValue(value3, out var value4))
					{
						value4.Add(item2);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<object, ObjectSet> objectsByOwner in objectsByOwners)
			{
				IXPPrefetchableAssociationList iXPPrefetchableAssociationList = (IXPPrefetchableAssociationList)member.GetValue(objectsByOwner.Key);
				iXPPrefetchableAssociationList.FinishPrefetch(objectsByOwner.Value);
			}
		}

		public void PreFetch(IEnumerable objects, XPMemberInfo collectionInObjects, IEnumerable collectionsContent)
		{
			if (collectionInObjects == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("collectionInObjects");
			}
			if (!collectionInObjects.IsAssociationList)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("Session_AssociationListExpected"), "collectionInObjects");
			}
			IXPBulkLoadableCollection iXPBulkLoadableCollection = objects as IXPBulkLoadableCollection;
			IXPBulkLoadableCollection iXPBulkLoadableCollection2 = collectionsContent as IXPBulkLoadableCollection;
			if (iXPBulkLoadableCollection != null && iXPBulkLoadableCollection2 != null && iXPBulkLoadableCollection != iXPBulkLoadableCollection2)
			{
				BulkLoad(iXPBulkLoadableCollection, iXPBulkLoadableCollection2);
			}
			ObjectDictionary<ObjectSet> objectDictionary = new ObjectDictionary<ObjectSet>();
			foreach (object @object in objects)
			{
				if (collectionInObjects.GetValue(@object) is IXPPrefetchableAssociationList iXPPrefetchableAssociationList && iXPPrefetchableAssociationList.NeedPrefetch())
				{
					objectDictionary.Add(@object, new ObjectSet());
				}
			}
			if (objectDictionary.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			XPMemberInfo associatedMember = collectionInObjects.GetAssociatedMember();
			foreach (object item in collectionsContent)
			{
				object value = associatedMember.GetValue(item);
				if (value != null && objectDictionary.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
				{
					value2.Add(item);
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<object, ObjectSet> item2 in objectDictionary)
			{
				IXPPrefetchableAssociationList iXPPrefetchableAssociationList2 = (IXPPrefetchableAssociationList)collectionInObjects.GetValue(item2.Key);
				iXPPrefetchableAssociationList2.FinishPrefetch(item2.Value);
			}
		}
