		internal void MuteCollection(XPBaseCollection c)
		{
			if (mutedCollections == null)
			{
				mutedCollections = new Dictionary<XPBaseCollection, object>();
			}
			else if (mutedCollections.ContainsKey(c))
			{
				return;
			}
			mutedCollections.Add(c, c);
			c.SuspendChangedEvents();
		}

		private void UnMuteCollections()
		{
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (mutedCollections == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ICollection<XPBaseCollection> keys = mutedCollections.Keys;
			mutedCollections = null;
			List<Exception> list = new List<Exception>();
			foreach (XPBaseCollection item2 in keys)
			{
				try
				{
					item2.ResumeChangedEvents();
				}
				catch (Exception item)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			throw new ExceptionBundleException(list.ToArray());
		}

		private static string ParametersToString(string[] parameterNames, QueryParameterCollection parameters)
		{
			return LogMessage.CollectionToString((IList<string>)parameterNames, (IList)parameters, (Function2<string, string, object>)((string name, object value) => string.Format("{0}:{1}", string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) ? "_" : name, (value == null) ? "null" : value.ToString())));
		}

		private static string ParametersToString(QueryParameterCollection parameters)
		{
			return LogMessage.CollectionToString<OperandValue>((ICollection<OperandValue>)parameters, (Function<string, OperandValue>)((OperandValue arg) => (arg != null) ? ((object)arg).ToString() : "null"));
		}

		private static string ParametersToString(string[] parameterNames, object[] parameterValues)
		{
			return LogMessage.CollectionToString((IList<string>)parameterNames, (IList)parameterValues, (Function2<string, string, object>)((string name, object value) => string.Format("{0}:{1}", string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) ? "_" : name, (value == null) ? "null" : value.ToString())));
		}

		private static string ParametersToString(object[] parameterValues)
		{
			return LogMessage.CollectionToString<object>((ICollection<object>)parameterValues, (Function<string, object>)((object arg) => (arg != null) ? arg.ToString() : "null"));
		}

		private static Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, int> CheckClassInfoAndMembers(XPClassInfo classInfo, List<XPMemberInfo> members)
		{
			if (members == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, int> dictionary = null;
			foreach (XPMemberInfo member in members)
			{
				if (member.Owner != classInfo && !classInfo.IsAssignableTo(member.Owner))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_NotClassMember", member.Name, classInfo.FullName));
				}
				if (member.ReferenceType != null)
				{
					if (dictionary == null)
					{
						dictionary = new Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, int>();
					}
					dictionary.Add(member, dictionary.Count);
				}
				if (member.IsCollection || member.IsAssociationList)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("DirectSQL_CollectionMembersAreNotSupported"));
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public ICollection GetObjectsFromQuery(XPClassInfo classInfo, LoadDataMemberOrderItem[] members, string sql, string[] parameterNames, QueryParameterCollection parameters)

			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing GetObjectsFromQuery()", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString(), "classInfo", classInfo.FullName, "members", LogMessage.CollectionToString<LoadDataMemberOrderItem>((ICollection<LoadDataMemberOrderItem>)members, (Function<string, LoadDataMemberOrderItem>)((LoadDataMemberOrderItem arg) => arg.ClassMemberName)), "sql", sql, "parameters", ParametersToString(parameterNames, parameters))));

		public Task<ICollection> GetObjectsFromQueryAsync(XPClassInfo classInfo, LoadDataMemberOrderItem[] members, string sql, string[] parameterNames, QueryParameterCollection parameters, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return LogManager.LogAsync<ICollection>("Session", (LogHandler<Task<ICollection>>)async delegate
			{
				Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, int> referenceIndexDict;
				List<XPMemberInfo> memberInfos = CheckClassInfoAndMembers(classInfo, members, out referenceIndexDict);
				SelectedData sprocResultData = await ExecuteQueryAsync(sql, parameterNames, parameters, cancellationToken);
				return await GetObjectsHelper.GetObjectsFromDataAsync(this, classInfo, memberInfos, members, sprocResultData, referenceIndexDict, cancellationToken);
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing GetObjectsFromQueryAsync()", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString(), "classInfo", classInfo.FullName, "members", LogMessage.CollectionToString<LoadDataMemberOrderItem>((ICollection<LoadDataMemberOrderItem>)members, (Function<string, LoadDataMemberOrderItem>)((LoadDataMemberOrderItem arg) => arg.ClassMemberName)), "sql", sql, "parameters", ParametersToString(parameterNames, parameters))));
		}

		private static List<XPMemberInfo> CheckClassInfoAndMembers(XPClassInfo classInfo, LoadDataMemberOrderItem[] members, out Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, int> referenceIndexDict)
		{
			referenceIndexDict = null;
			List<XPMemberInfo> list = new List<XPMemberInfo>(members.Length);
			for (int i = 0; i < members.Length; i++)
			{
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = classInfo.FindMember(members[i].ClassMemberName);
				if (xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType != null)
				{
					if (referenceIndexDict == null)
					{
						referenceIndexDict = new Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, int>();
					}
					referenceIndexDict.Add(xPMemberInfo, referenceIndexDict.Count);
				}
				if (xPMemberInfo.IsCollection || xPMemberInfo.IsAssociationList)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("DirectSQL_CollectionMembersAreNotSupported"));
				}
				list.Add(xPMemberInfo);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public ICollection GetObjectsByKeyFromSproc(XPClassInfo classInfo, bool alwaysGetFromDataStore, string sprocName, params OperandValue[] parameters)
		{
			return LogManager.Log<ICollection>("Session", (LogHandler<ICollection>)delegate
			{
				SelectedData sprocResultData = ExecuteSproc(sprocName, parameters);
				return GetObjectsByKeyFromQuery(classInfo, alwaysGetFromDataStore, sprocResultData);
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing GetObjectsByKeyFromSproc()", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString(), "classInfo", classInfo.FullName, "alwaysGetFromDataStore", alwaysGetFromDataStore, "sprocName", sprocName, "parameters", LogMessage.CriteriaOperatorCollectionToString<OperandValue>((IEnumerable<OperandValue>)parameters))));
		}

		}

		public ICollection GetObjectsByKeyFromQuery(XPClassInfo classInfo, bool alwaysGetFromDataStore, string sql)
		{
			return LogManager.Log<ICollection>("Session", (LogHandler<ICollection>)delegate
			{
				SelectedData sprocResultData = ExecuteQuery(sql);
				return GetObjectsByKeyFromQuery(classInfo, alwaysGetFromDataStore, sprocResultData);
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing GetObjectsByKeyFromQuery()", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString(), "classInfo", classInfo.FullName, "alwaysGetFromDataStore", alwaysGetFromDataStore, "sql", sql)));
		}

		private ICollection GetObjectsByKeyFromQuery(XPClassInfo classInfo, bool alwaysGetFromDataStore, SelectedData sprocResultData)
		{
			if (sprocResultData == null || sprocResultData.ResultSet == null || sprocResultData.ResultSet.Length == 0)
			{
				return new object[0];
			}
			SelectStatementResult val = sprocResultData.ResultSet[0];
			if (val == null || val.Rows == null || val.Rows.Length == 0)
			{
				return new object[0];
			}
			SelectStatementResultRow[] rows = val.Rows;
			object[] array = new object[rows.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < rows.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = GetObjectsHelper.ChangeDbTypeToMemberType(rows[i].Values[0], classInfo.KeyProperty.MemberType);
			}
			return GetObjectsByKey(classInfo, array, alwaysGetFromDataStore);
		}

		object ICommandChannel.Do(string command, object args)
		{
			IObjectLayer obj = ObjectLayer;
			ICommandChannel val = (ICommandChannel)((obj is ICommandChannel) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				if (ObjectLayer == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported.");
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported by {ObjectLayer.GetType().FullName}.");
			}
			return val.Do(command, args);
		}

		Task<object> ICommandChannelAsync.DoAsync(string command, object args, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			IObjectLayer obj = ObjectLayer;
			ICommandChannelAsync val = (ICommandChannelAsync)((obj is ICommandChannelAsync) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				if (ObjectLayer == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported.");
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Async_CommandChannelDoesNotImplementICommandChannelAsync", ObjectLayer.GetType().FullName));
			}
			return val.DoAsync(command, args, cancellationToken);
		}

		protected LogMessage CreateLogMessage(string title, TimeSpan duration, params object[] parameters)
		{
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			LogMessage val = new LogMessage((LogMessageType)3, title, duration);
			if (parameters != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < parameters.Length; i += 2)
				{
					val.ParameterList.Add(new LogMessageParameter((string)parameters[i], parameters[i + 1]));
				}
			}
			return val;
		}

		protected string GetObjectString(object theObject)
		{
			if (theObject == null)
			{
				return "null";
			}
			Type type = theObject.GetType();
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(type);
			if (xPClassInfo == null || xPClassInfo.KeyProperty == null)
			{
				return type.ToString();
			}
			return $"{type}({xPClassInfo.GetId(theObject)})";
		}
	}
	[Description("Loads and saves persistent objects keeping track of every change to every persistent object during a transaction.")]
	[DXToolboxItem(true)]
	[ToolboxTabName("DX.23.2: ORM Components")]
	[ToolboxBitmap(typeof(UnitOfWork))]
	public class UnitOfWork : Session
	{
		protected internal override bool IsUnitOfWork => true;

		public UnitOfWork()
			: this((IServiceProvider)null)
		{
		}

		public UnitOfWork(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
			: base(serviceProvider)
		{
		}

		public UnitOfWork(IContainer container)
			: this(null, container)
		{
		}

		public UnitOfWork(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, IContainer container)
			: base(serviceProvider, container)
		{
		}

		public UnitOfWork(XPDictionary dictionary)
			: this(null, dictionary)
		{
		}

		public UnitOfWork(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, XPDictionary dictionary)
			: base(serviceProvider, dictionary)
		{
		}

		public UnitOfWork(IDataLayer layer, params IDisposable[] disposeOnDisconnect)
			: this(null, layer, disposeOnDisconnect)
		{
		}

		public UnitOfWork(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, IDataLayer layer, params IDisposable[] disposeOnDisconnect)
			: base(serviceProvider, layer, disposeOnDisconnect)
		{
		}

		public UnitOfWork(IObjectLayer layer, params IDisposable[] disposeOnDisconnect)
			: this(null, layer, disposeOnDisconnect)
		{
		}

		public UnitOfWork(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, IObjectLayer layer, params IDisposable[] disposeOnDisconnect)
			: base(serviceProvider, layer, disposeOnDisconnect)
		{
		}

		public void CommitChanges()
		{
			WaitForAsyncOperationEnd();
			if (InTransaction)
			{
				CommitTransaction();
			}
		}

		public object CommitChangesAsync(AsyncCommitCallback callback)
		{
			if (!InTransaction)
			{
				callback(null);
				return null;
			}
			return CommitTransactionAsync(callback);
		}

		public Task CommitChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (!InTransaction)
			{
				return Task.FromResult(result: false);
			}
			return CommitTransactionAsync(cancellationToken);
		}

		public void ReloadChangedObjects()
		{
			if (!InTransaction)
			{
				return;
			}
			ObjectSet objectSet = new ObjectSet();
			foreach (object item in GetObjectsToDelete())
			{
				objectSet.Add(item);
			}
			foreach (object item2 in GetObjectsToSave())
			{
				objectSet.Add(item2);
			}
			foreach (object item3 in objectSet)
			{
				try
				{
					Reload(item3);
				}
				catch (CannotLoadObjectsException)
				{
				}
			}
			RollbackTransaction();
		}
	}
	[DXToolboxItem(true)]
	[ToolboxTabName("DX.23.2: ORM Components")]
	[ToolboxBitmap(typeof(ExplicitUnitOfWork))]
	public class ExplicitUnitOfWork : UnitOfWork
	{
		private bool inTransaction;

		[Description("Indicates whether the explicit unit of work has started a database level transaction or tracked data modifications.")]
		public override bool InTransaction
		{
			get
			{
				if (!inTransaction)
				{
					return base.TrackingChanges;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsInTransactionMode => false;

		public ExplicitUnitOfWork()
			: this((IServiceProvider)null)
		{
		}

			: base(serviceProvider, layer, disposeOnDisconnect)

		public override void BeginTransaction()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Expected O, but got Unknown
			LogManager.Log("Session", (LogHandlerVoid)delegate
			{
				OnBeforeBeginTransaction();
				if (inTransaction)
				{
					throw new TransactionSequenceException(Res.GetString("Session_TranSequenceBegin"));
				}
				ExplicitBeginTransaction();
				inTransaction = true;
				OnAfterBeginTransaction();
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing BeginTransaction()", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString())), (ExceptionHandler)null);
		}

		public override void RollbackTransaction()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Expected O, but got Unknown
			LogManager.Log("Session", (LogHandlerVoid)delegate
			{
				OnBeforeRollbackTransaction();
				if (base.TrackingChanges)
				{
					DropChanges();
				}
				if (inTransaction)
				{
					ExplicitRollbackTransaction();
					inTransaction = false;
				}
				OnAfterRollbackTransaction();
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing RollbackTransaction()", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString())), (ExceptionHandler)null);
		}

		public Task RollbackTransactionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return LogManager.LogAsync("Session", (LogHandler<Task>)async delegate
			{
				OnBeforeRollbackTransaction();
				if (base.TrackingChanges)
				{
					DropChanges();
				}
				if (inTransaction)
				{
					await ExplicitRollbackTransactionAsync(cancellationToken);
					inTransaction = false;
				}
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				OnAfterRollbackTransaction();
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing RollbackTransaction()", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString())), (ExceptionHandler)null);
		}

		public override void CommitTransaction()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			LogManager.Log("Session", (LogHandlerVoid)delegate
			{
				OnBeforeCommitTransaction();
				if (base.TrackingChanges)
				{
					FlushChanges();
				}
				if (inTransaction)
				{
					ExplicitCommitTransaction();
					inTransaction = false;
				}
				OnAfterCommitTransaction();
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing CommitTransaction()", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString())), (ExceptionHandler)((Exception ex) => !OnFailedCommitTransaction(ex)));
		}

		public override Task CommitTransactionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return LogManager.LogAsync("Session", (LogHandler<Task>)async delegate
			{
				OnBeforeCommitTransaction();
				if (base.TrackingChanges)
				{
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					await FlushChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
				}
				if (inTransaction)
				{
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					await ExplicitCommitTransactionAsync(cancellationToken);
					inTransaction = false;
				}
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				OnAfterCommitTransaction();
			}, (MessageHandler<LogMessage>)((TimeSpan d) => CreateLogMessage("Executing CommitTransactionAsync()", d, "sessionType", GetType().ToString(), "sessionID", ToString())), (ExceptionHandler)((Exception ex) => !OnFailedCommitTransaction(ex)));
		}

		public override object CommitTransactionAsync(AsyncCommitCallback callback)
		{
			try
			{
				OnBeforeCommitTransaction();
				if (base.TrackingChanges)
				{
					return FlushChangesAsync(delegate(Exception ex2)
					{
						try
						{
							if (ex2 == null)
							{
								if (inTransaction)
								{
									ExplicitCommitTransaction();
									inTransaction = false;
								}
								OnAfterCommitTransaction();
							}
						}
						catch (Exception ex3)
						{
							if (!OnFailedCommitTransaction(ex3))
							{
								callback(ex3);
							}
							return;
						}
						if (ex2 == null || !OnFailedCommitTransaction(ex2))
						{
							callback(ex2);
						}
					});
				}
				if (inTransaction)
				{
					ExplicitCommitTransaction();
					inTransaction = false;
				}
				OnAfterCommitTransaction();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (!OnFailedCommitTransaction(ex))
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnBeforeBeginTrackingChanges()
		{
			OnBeforeBeginTrackingChangesInternal();
		}

		protected override void OnAfterBeginTrackingChanges()
		{
			OnAfterBeginTrackingChangesInternal();
		}

		protected override void OnBeforeFlushChanges()
		{
			OnBeforeFlushChangesInternal();
		}

		protected override void OnAfterFlushChanges()
		{
			OnAfterFlushChangesInternal();
		}

		protected override void OnBeforeDropChanges()
		{
			OnBeforeDropChangesInternal();
		}

		protected override void OnAfterDropChanges()
		{
			OnAfterDropChangesInternal();
		}

		protected override bool OnFailedFlushChanges(Exception ex)
		{
			return OnFailedFlushChangesInternal(ex);
		}

		protected override IList BeginFlushChanges()
		{
			if (!inTransaction)
			{
				BeginTransaction();
			}
			return base.BeginFlushChanges();
		}

		protected override Task<IList> BeginFlushChangesAsync(int asyncOperationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (!inTransaction)
			{
				BeginTransaction();
			}
			return base.BeginFlushChangesAsync(asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
		}

		internal override List<object[]> SelectDataInternal(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, CriteriaOperator criteria, CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties, CriteriaOperator groupCriteria, bool selectDeleted, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords, SortingCollection sorting)
		{
			List<object[]> list = PrepareSelectData(classInfo, ref properties, ref criteria, ref groupProperties, ref groupCriteria, ref sorting, doDetectPostProcessing: true, this);
			if (list == null)
			{
				ObjectsQuery objectsQuery = new ObjectsQuery(classInfo, criteria, sorting, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, new CollectionCriteriaPatcher(selectDeleted, base.TypesManager), force: true);
				if (IsFlushRequired(new ObjectsQuery[1] { objectsQuery }))
				{
					FlushChanges();
				}
				list = base.ObjectLayer.SelectData(this, objectsQuery, properties, groupProperties, groupCriteria);
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal override async Task<List<object[]>> SelectDataInternalAsync(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, CriteriaOperator criteria, CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties, CriteriaOperator groupCriteria, bool selectDeleted, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords, SortingCollection sorting, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			await UpdateSchemaAsync(cancellationToken, classInfo);
			await base.TypesManager.EnsureIsTypedObjectValidAsync(cancellationToken);
			List<object[]> list = Session.PrepareSelectDataInternal(classInfo, ref properties, ref criteria, ref groupProperties, ref groupCriteria, ref sorting, doDetectPostProcessing: true, this);
			if (list == null)
			{
				ObjectsQuery preparedQuery = new ObjectsQuery(classInfo, criteria, sorting, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, new CollectionCriteriaPatcher(selectDeleted, base.TypesManager), force: true);
				if (IsFlushRequired(new ObjectsQuery[1] { preparedQuery }))
				{
					await FlushChangesAsync();
				}
				list = await GetObjectLayerAsync().SelectDataAsync(this, preparedQuery, properties, groupProperties, groupCriteria, cancellationToken);
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal override object SelectDataInternalAsync(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, CriteriaOperator criteria, CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties, CriteriaOperator groupCriteria, bool selectDeleted, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords, SortingCollection sorting, AsyncSelectDataCallback callback)
		{
			AsyncOperationsHelper.FailIfSynchronizationContextUnavailable();
			if (callback == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			List<object[]> list = PrepareSelectData(classInfo, ref properties, ref criteria, ref groupProperties, ref groupCriteria, ref sorting, doDetectPostProcessing: true, this);
			if (list != null)
			{
				return base.ObjectLayer.SelectDataAsync(this, null, properties, groupProperties, groupCriteria, callback);
			}
			ObjectsQuery preparedQuery = new ObjectsQuery(classInfo, criteria, sorting, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, new CollectionCriteriaPatcher(selectDeleted, base.TypesManager), force: true);
			if (IsFlushRequired(new ObjectsQuery[1] { preparedQuery }))
			{
				return FlushChangesAsync(delegate(Exception ex)
				{
					if (ex != null)
					{
						callback(null, ex);
						return;
					}
					try
					{
						base.ObjectLayer.SelectDataAsync(this, preparedQuery, properties, groupProperties, groupCriteria, callback);
					}
					catch (Exception ex2)
					{
						callback(null, ex2);
					}
				});
			}
			return base.ObjectLayer.SelectDataAsync(this, preparedQuery, properties, groupProperties, groupCriteria, callback);
		}

		internal override ICollection[] GetObjectsInternal(ObjectsQuery[] queries)
		{
			if (IsFlushRequired(queries))
			{
				FlushChanges();
			}
			return base.GetObjectsInternal(queries);
		}

		internal override async Task<ICollection[]> GetObjectsInternalAsync(ObjectsQuery[] queries, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (IsFlushRequired(queries))
			{
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				await FlushChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			return await base.GetObjectsInternalAsync(queries, cancellationToken);
		}

		internal override object GetObjectsInternalAsync(ObjectsQuery[] queries, AsyncLoadObjectsCallback callback)
		{
			AsyncOperationsHelper.FailIfSynchronizationContextUnavailable();
			if (callback == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			if (IsFlushRequired(queries))
			{
				return FlushChangesAsync(delegate(Exception ex)
				{
					if (ex != null)
					{
						callback(null, ex);
						return;
					}
					try
					{
						GetObjectsInternalAsync(queries, callback);
					}
					catch (Exception ex2)
					{
						callback(null, ex2);
					}
				});
			}
			return base.GetObjectsInternalAsync(queries, callback);
		}

		private bool IsFlushRequired(ObjectsQuery[] queries)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (base.TrackingChanges)
			{
				ICollection objectsToSave = GetObjectsToSave(includeParent: true);
				ICollection objectsToDelete = GetObjectsToDelete(includeParent: true);
				if (objectsToSave.Count != 0 || objectsToDelete.Count != 0)
				{
					ObjectsQuery[] array = PrepareQueries(queries, doDetectPostProcessing: false, this);
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						AnalyzeResult analyzeResult;
						string[] modifiedNodes = InTransactionLoader.GetModifiedNodes(this, objectsToSave, objectsToDelete, array[i], out analyzeResult);
						if (modifiedNodes.Length != 0)
						{
							result = true;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		internal NestedParentMap GetNestedParentMap(Session session)
		{
			object value = null;
			if (!((IWideDataStorage)session).TryGetWideDataItem(nestedParentMapKeyObject, out value))
			{

				value = ((session.GetIdentityMapBehavior() != IdentityMapBehavior.Weak) ? new StrongNestedParentMap(session) : new WeakNestedParentMap(session));
				((IWideDataStorage)session).SetWideDataItem(nestedParentMapKeyObject, value);
			}
			return (NestedParentMap)value;
		}

		public ICollection[] LoadObjects(Session session, ObjectsQuery[] queries)
		{
			if (queries == null || queries.Length == 0)
			{
				return new object[0][];
			}
			SecurityContext securityContext = GetSecurityContext(session);
			ObjectsQuery[] parentQueries = GetParentQueries(session, queries, securityContext);
			ICollection[] objects = ParentSession.GetObjects(parentQueries);
			NestedParentMap nestedParentMap = GetNestedParentMap(session);
			ICollection[] nestedObjects = new NestedLoader(session, ParentSession, nestedParentMap, securityContext).GetNestedObjects(objects, GetForceList(queries));
			OnLoadedObjects(objects, nestedObjects, nestedParentMap, securityContext);
			return nestedObjects;
		}

			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			ICollection[] parentObjects = await ParentSession.GetObjectsAsync(parentQueries, cancellationToken);
			NestedParentMap nestedParentMap = GetNestedParentMap(session);
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			int newAsyncOperationId = SessionStateStack.GetNewAsyncOperationId();
			ICollection[] array = await new NestedLoader(session, ParentSession, nestedParentMap, securityContext).GetNestedObjectsAsync(parentObjects, GetForceList(queries), newAsyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			OnLoadedObjects(parentObjects, array, nestedParentMap, securityContext);
			return array;
		}

		private ICollection FilterListForDelete(Session session, NestedParentMap map, ICollection fullListForDelete)
		{
			if (fullListForDelete == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (fullListForDelete.Count == 0)
			{
				return fullListForDelete;
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>(fullListForDelete.Count / 2);
			foreach (object item in fullListForDelete)
			{
				if (session.IsNewObject(item))
				{
					object parentObject = NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(session, ParentSession, map, item);
					if (parentObject == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void InvalidateDeletedObjects(AsyncCommitContext context)
		{
			foreach (object item in context.FullListForDelete)
			{
				if (!context.Session.IsNewObject(item))
				{
					SessionIdentityMap.UnregisterObject(context.Session, item);
				}
				context.Map.KickOut(item);
				if (item is IXPInvalidateableObject iXPInvalidateableObject)
				{
					iXPInvalidateableObject.Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		public void CommitChanges(Session session, ICollection fullListForDelete, ICollection completeListForSave)
		{
			NestedParentMap nestedParentMap = GetNestedParentMap(session);
			ICollection readyListForDelete = FilterListForDelete(session, nestedParentMap, fullListForDelete);
			AsyncCommitContext asyncCommitContext = new AsyncCommitContext(session, fullListForDelete, readyListForDelete, completeListForSave, nestedParentMap, GetSecurityContext(session));
			BeginCommitChanges(asyncCommitContext);
			EndCommitChanges(asyncCommitContext);
			if (ThroughCommitMode && (asyncCommitContext.Mode == CommitChangesMode.NotInTransactionUnitOfWork || asyncCommitContext.Mode == CommitChangesMode.InTransaction))
			{
				if (ParentSession.TrackingChanges)
				{
					ParentSession.FlushChanges();
				}
				ThroughCommitExec(asyncCommitContext);
			}
			InvalidateDeletedObjects(asyncCommitContext);
		}

		public async Task CommitChangesAsync(Session session, ICollection fullListForDelete, ICollection completeListForSave, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			NestedParentMap nestedParentMap = GetNestedParentMap(session);
			ICollection readyListForDelete = FilterListForDelete(session, nestedParentMap, fullListForDelete);
			AsyncCommitContext context = new AsyncCommitContext(session, fullListForDelete, readyListForDelete, completeListForSave, nestedParentMap, GetSecurityContext(session));
			BeginCommitChanges(context);
			await EndCommitChangesAsync(context, cancellationToken);
			if (ThroughCommitMode && (context.Mode == CommitChangesMode.NotInTransactionUnitOfWork || context.Mode == CommitChangesMode.InTransaction))
			{
				if (ParentSession.TrackingChanges)
				{
					await ParentSession.FlushChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
				}
				ThroughCommitExec(context);
			}
			InvalidateDeletedObjects(context);
		}

		public object CommitChangesAsync(Session session, ICollection fullListForDelete, ICollection completeListForSave, AsyncCommitCallback callback)
		{
			SynchronizationContext syncContext = AsyncOperationsHelper.CaptureSynchronizationContextOrFail();
			if (callback == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			NestedParentMap nestedParentMap = GetNestedParentMap(session);
			ICollection readyListForDelete = FilterListForDelete(session, nestedParentMap, fullListForDelete);
			AsyncCommitContext context = new AsyncCommitContext(session, fullListForDelete, readyListForDelete, completeListForSave, nestedParentMap, GetSecurityContext(session));
			BeginCommitChanges(context);
			return new AsyncRequest(syncContext, delegate(AsyncRequest request)
			{
				try
				{
					session.AsyncExecuteQueue.Invoke(request.SyncContext, delegate
					{
						try
						{
							EndCommitChanges(context);
							if (ThroughCommitMode && (context.Mode == CommitChangesMode.NotInTransactionUnitOfWork || context.Mode == CommitChangesMode.InTransaction))
							{
								if (ParentSession.TrackingChanges)
								{
									request.AddNestedRequest(ParentSession.CommitTransactionAsync(delegate
									{
										try
										{
											ThroughCommitExec(context);
											InvalidateDeletedObjects(context);
											callback(null);
										}
										catch (Exception ex7)
										{
											try
											{
												callback(ex7);
											}
											catch (Exception)
											{
											}
										}
									}) as AsyncRequest);
									return;
								}
								ThroughCommitExec(context);
							}
							InvalidateDeletedObjects(context);
							callback(null);
						}
						catch (Exception ex5)
						{
							try
							{
								callback(ex5);
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}
					}, null, operationEnd: true);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception ex2 = ex;
					Exception ex3 = ex2;
					try
					{
						session.AsyncExecuteQueue.Invoke(request.SyncContext, delegate
						{
							try
							{
								callback(ex3);
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}, request, operationEnd: true);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
			}).Start(session.AsyncExecuteQueue);
		}

		private void ThroughCommitExec(AsyncCommitContext context)
		{
			SessionStateStack.Enter(context.Session, SessionState.ApplyIdentities);
			try
			{
				foreach (object item in context.CompleteListForSave)
				{
					XPClassInfo classInfo = context.Session.GetClassInfo(item);
					object parentObject = NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(context.Session, ParentSession, context.Map, item);
					if (parentObject != null)
					{
						if (context.Session.IsNewObject(item))
						{
							object value = classInfo.KeyProperty.GetValue(parentObject);
							classInfo.KeyProperty.SetValue(item, value);
							SessionIdentityMap.RegisterObject(context.Session, item, classInfo.KeyProperty.ExpandId(value));
						}
						XPMemberInfo optimisticLockField = classInfo.OptimisticLockField;
						optimisticLockField?.SetValue(item, optimisticLockField.GetValue(parentObject));
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(context.Session, SessionState.ApplyIdentities);
			}
		}

		private void BeginCommitChanges(AsyncCommitContext context)
		{
			if (context.Session.LockingOption != LockingOption.None)
			{
				NestedWorksHelper.ValidateVersions(context.Session, ParentSession, GetNestedParentMap(context.Session), context.LockedParentsObjects, context.ReadyListForDelete, context.Session.LockingOption, objectsForDelete: true);
				NestedWorksHelper.ValidateVersions(context.Session, ParentSession, GetNestedParentMap(context.Session), context.LockedParentsObjects, context.CompleteListForSave, context.Session.LockingOption, objectsForDelete: false);
			}
			if (context.SecurityContext != null && (!(context.SecurityContext.SecurityRuleProvider is ISecurityRuleProvider2) || !((ISecurityRuleProvider2)context.SecurityContext.SecurityRuleProvider).Enabled))
			{
				ValidateObjectsOnCommit(context);
			}
			if (!ParentSession.TrackingChanges)
			{
				if (ParentSession.IsUnitOfWork)
				{
					context.Mode = CommitChangesMode.NotInTransactionUnitOfWork;
				}
				else
				{
					context.Mode = CommitChangesMode.NotInTransactionSession;
				}
				ParentSession.BeginTrackingChanges();
			}
			else
			{
				context.Mode = CommitChangesMode.InTransaction;
			}
			SessionStateStack.Enter(context.Session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner);
			SessionStateStack.Enter(ParentSession, SessionState.ReceivingObjectsFromNestedUow);
		}

		private void EndCommitChanges(AsyncCommitContext context)
		{
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			switch (context.Mode)
			{
			case CommitChangesMode.InTransaction:
			case CommitChangesMode.NotInTransactionUnitOfWork:
				Commit(context);
				break;
			case CommitChangesMode.NotInTransactionSession:
				try
				{
					Commit(context);
					ParentSession.FlushChanges();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (ParentSession.TrackingChanges)
					{
						try
						{
							ParentSession.DropChanges();
						}
						catch (Exception ex2)
						{
							throw new ExceptionBundleException(new Exception[2] { ex, ex2 });
						}
					}
					throw;
				}
				break;
			}
			GC.KeepAlive(context.LockedParentsObjects);
		}

		private async Task EndCommitChangesAsync(AsyncCommitContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			switch (context.Mode)
			{
			case CommitChangesMode.InTransaction:
			case CommitChangesMode.NotInTransactionUnitOfWork:
				Commit(context);
				break;
			case CommitChangesMode.NotInTransactionSession:
				try
				{
					Commit(context);
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					await ParentSession.FlushChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (ParentSession.TrackingChanges)
					{
						try
						{
							ParentSession.DropChanges();
						}
						catch (Exception ex2)
						{
							throw new ExceptionBundleException(new Exception[2] { ex, ex2 });
						}
					}
					throw;
				}
				break;
			}
			GC.KeepAlive(context.LockedParentsObjects);
		}

		private void Commit(AsyncCommitContext context)
		{
			bool abortChangesInParentSession = false;
			try
			{
				ISecurityRuleProvider2 securityRuleProvider = null;
				if (context.SecurityContext != null && context.SecurityContext.SecurityRuleProvider is ISecurityRuleProvider2)
				{
					securityRuleProvider = (ISecurityRuleProvider2)context.SecurityContext.SecurityRuleProvider;
				}
				if (securityRuleProvider != null && securityRuleProvider.Enabled)
				{
					ValidateObjectOnCommitGenericSecurityRule(context);
					if (context.SecurityContext != null)
					{
						foreach (object item in context.ReadyListForDelete)
						{
							ValidateDeleteObjects(context, securityRuleProvider, item);
						}
					}
					Dictionary<object, XPMemberInfo[]> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, XPMemberInfo[]>();
					foreach (object item2 in context.CompleteListForSave)
					{
						XPMemberInfo[] value = new XPMemberInfo[0];
						XPClassInfo classInfo = context.Session.GetClassInfo(item2);
						ISecurityRule2 rule = securityRuleProvider.GetRule(classInfo);
						if (rule == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						object parentObject = NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(context.Session, ParentSession, context.Map, item2);
						if (parentObject != null)
						{
							if (context.Session.IsObjectMarkedDeleted(item2))
							{
								if (!rule.ValidateObjectOnDelete(context.SecurityContext, classInfo, parentObject))
								{
									throw new ObjectLayerSecurityException(classInfo.FullName, isDeletion: true);
								}
							}
							else
							{
								value = ValidateBeforeCommitObject(securityRuleProvider, rule, context, item2, parentObject);
							}
						}
						dictionary.Add(item2, value);
					}
					foreach (object item3 in context.ReadyListForDelete)
					{
						NestedWorksHelper.CommitDeletedObject(context.Session, ParentSession, context.Map, item3);
					}
					ObjectDictionary<Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object>> objectDictionary = new ObjectDictionary<Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object>>();
					foreach (object item4 in context.CompleteListForSave)
					{
						XPMemberInfo[] value2 = null;
						dictionary.TryGetValue(item4, out value2);
						Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object> modifyMembers = null;
						object obj = NestedWorksHelper.CommitObject2(context.Session, ParentSession, context.Map, item4, value2, out modifyMembers);
						objectDictionary.Add(obj, modifyMembers);
						context.ParentsToSave.Add(obj);
					}
					foreach (object item5 in context.ParentsToSave)
					{
						if (!ParentSession.IsObjectMarkedDeleted(item5))
						{
							try
							{
								ValidateAfterCommitObject(securityRuleProvider, context, item5, objectDictionary[item5], ref abortChangesInParentSession);
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
								abortChangesInParentSession = true;
								RollbackParentObjects(context, objectDictionary);
								throw;
							}
						}
					}
					if (context.SecurityContext != null)
					{
						foreach (object item6 in context.ReadyListForDelete)
						{
							if (item6 is IntermediateObject)
							{
								ValidateDeleteObjects(context, securityRuleProvider, item6);
							}
						}
					}
					ParentSession.Save(context.ParentsToSave);
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (object item7 in context.ReadyListForDelete)
					{
						NestedWorksHelper.CommitDeletedObject(context.Session, ParentSession, context.Map, item7);
					}
					foreach (object item8 in context.CompleteListForSave)
					{
						XPMemberInfo[] value3 = null;
						if (context.SecurityContext != null && context.IsMembersNotToSaveDictionaryExists)
						{
							context.MembersNotToSaveDictionary.TryGetValue(item8, out value3);
						}
						context.ParentsToSave.Add(NestedWorksHelper.CommitObject(context.Session, ParentSession, context.Map, item8, value3));
					}
					ParentSession.Save(context.ParentsToSave);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(ParentSession, SessionState.ReceivingObjectsFromNestedUow);
				SessionStateStack.Leave(context.Session, SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner);
				if (abortChangesInParentSession)
				{
					if (ParentSession.IsUnitOfWork || ParentSession.TrackingChanges)
					{
						ParentSession.DropChanges();
					}
					context.ParentsToSave.Clear();
				}
			}
			ParentSession.TriggerObjectsLoaded(context.ParentsToSave);
		}

		private void ValidateDeleteObjects(AsyncCommitContext context, ISecurityRuleProvider2 ruleProvider2, object objToDel)
		{
			object parentObject = NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(context.Session, ParentSession, context.Map, objToDel);
			ValidateDeleteObjectsOnCommit(ruleProvider2, context, parentObject);
		}

		private void ValidateObjectsOnCommit(AsyncCommitContext context)
		{
			SecurityContext securityContext = context.SecurityContext;
			SecurityContextValidateItem[] array = new SecurityContextValidateItem[context.CompleteListForSave.Count];
			SecurityContextValidateItem[] array2 = new SecurityContextValidateItem[context.ReadyListForDelete.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object item in context.CompleteListForSave)
			{
				array[num++] = new SecurityContextValidateItem(context.Session.GetClassInfo(item), item, NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(context.Session, ParentSession, context.Map, item));
			}
			num = 0;
			foreach (object item2 in context.ReadyListForDelete)
			{
				array2[num++] = new SecurityContextValidateItem(context.Session.GetClassInfo(item2), item2, NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(context.Session, ParentSession, context.Map, item2));
			}
			if (securityContext.GenericSecurityRule != null && !securityContext.GenericSecurityRule.ValidateObjectsOnCommit(securityContext, array, array2))
			{
				throw new ObjectLayerSecurityException();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				SecurityContextValidateItem securityContextValidateItem = array[i];
				XPClassInfo classInfo = securityContextValidateItem.ClassInfo;
				ISecurityRule rule = securityContext.SecurityRuleProvider.GetRule(classInfo);
				if (rule == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!rule.ValidateObjectOnSave(securityContext, classInfo, securityContextValidateItem.TheObject, securityContextValidateItem.RealObject))
				{
					throw new ObjectLayerSecurityException(classInfo.FullName, isDeletion: false);
				}
				List<XPMemberInfo> list = null;
				foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
				{
					if ((persistentProperty.IsDelayed && !XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(securityContextValidateItem.TheObject, persistentProperty).IsLoaded) || persistentProperty.IsReadOnly || persistentProperty.IsFetchOnly)
					{
						continue;
					}
					object value = persistentProperty.GetValue(securityContextValidateItem.TheObject);
					if (SecurityContext.IsSystemProperty(persistentProperty))
					{
						continue;
					}
					object obj = null;
					object obj2 = null;
					if (securityContextValidateItem.RealObject != null)
					{
						obj2 = persistentProperty.GetValue(securityContextValidateItem.RealObject);
						obj = ((!rule.GetSelectMemberExpression(securityContext, classInfo, persistentProperty, out var expression)) ? obj2 : securityContext.Evaluate(AnalyzeCriteriaCreator.GetUpClass(classInfo, persistentProperty.Owner), expression, securityContextValidateItem.RealObject));
					}
					if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType != null && obj != null)
					{
						ISecurityRule rule2 = securityContext.SecurityRuleProvider.GetRule(persistentProperty.ReferenceType);
						if (rule2 != null)
						{
							obj = (rule2.ValidateObjectOnSelect(securityContext, persistentProperty.ReferenceType, obj) ? obj : null);
						}
					}
					switch (rule.ValidateMemberOnSave(securityContext, persistentProperty, securityContextValidateItem.TheObject, securityContextValidateItem.RealObject, value, obj, obj2))
					{
					case ValidateMemberOnSaveResult.DoRaiseException:
						throw new ObjectLayerSecurityException(securityContextValidateItem.ClassInfo.FullName, persistentProperty.Name);
					case ValidateMemberOnSaveResult.DoNotSaveMember:
						if (list == null)
						{
							list = new List<XPMemberInfo>();
						}
						list.Add(persistentProperty);
						break;
					}
				}
				if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
				{
					context.MembersNotToSaveDictionary.Add(securityContextValidateItem.TheObject, list.ToArray());
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
			{
				SecurityContextValidateItem securityContextValidateItem2 = array2[j];
				ISecurityRule rule3 = securityContext.SecurityRuleProvider.GetRule(securityContextValidateItem2.ClassInfo);
				if (rule3 != null && !rule3.ValidateObjectOnDelete(securityContext, securityContextValidateItem2.ClassInfo, securityContextValidateItem2.TheObject, securityContextValidateItem2.RealObject))
				{
					throw new ObjectLayerSecurityException(securityContextValidateItem2.ClassInfo.FullName, isDeletion: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ValidateAfterCommitObject(ISecurityRuleProvider2 ruleProvider2, AsyncCommitContext context, object realObject, Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object> modifyMember, ref bool abortChangesInParentSession)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull(realObject, "realObject");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)ruleProvider2, "ruleProvider2");
			XPClassInfo classInfo = context.Session.GetClassInfo(realObject);
			ISecurityRule2 rule = ruleProvider2.GetRule(classInfo);
			SecurityContext securityContext = context.SecurityContext;
			if (securityContext == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!rule.ValidateObjectOnSave(securityContext, realObject))
			{
				throw new ObjectLayerSecurityException(classInfo.FullName, isDeletion: false);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<XPMemberInfo, object> item in modifyMember)
			{
				if ((!item.Key.IsDelayed || XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(realObject, item.Key).IsLoaded) && !item.Key.IsReadOnly && !SecurityContext.IsSystemProperty(item.Key) && !rule.ValidateMemberOnSave(securityContext, item.Key, realObject))
				{
					throw new ObjectLayerSecurityException(classInfo.FullName, item.Key.Name);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RollbackParentObjects(AsyncCommitContext context, ObjectDictionary<Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object>> modifiedObjects)
		{
			RollbackDeletedObjects(context);
			RollbackModifiedObjects(context, modifiedObjects);
			RemoveParentObjects(context);
		}

		private void RollbackModifiedObjects(AsyncCommitContext context, ObjectDictionary<Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object>> modifiedObjects)
		{
			NestedParentMap nestedParentMap = GetNestedParentMap(context.Session);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<object, Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object>> modifiedObject in modifiedObjects)
			{
				object key = modifiedObject.Key;
				if (key is IntermediateObject)
				{
					IntermediateObject intermediateObject = (IntermediateObject)key;
					IntermediateClassInfo intermediateClassInfo = (IntermediateClassInfo)ParentSession.GetClassInfo(intermediateObject);
					if (intermediateObject.LeftIntermediateObjectField != null && intermediateObject.RightIntermediateObjectField != null)
					{
						XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)intermediateClassInfo.intermediateObjectFieldInfoRight.refProperty.GetValue(intermediateObject.LeftIntermediateObjectField);
						xPBaseCollection.BaseRemove(intermediateObject.RightIntermediateObjectField);
					}
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<XPMemberInfo, object> item in modifiedObject.Value)
				{
					XPMemberInfo key2 = item.Key;
					object value = item.Value;
					if (key2.ReferenceType != null)
					{
						object value2 = key2.GetValue(key);
						if (!object.Equals(value2, value))
						{
							key2.SetValue(key, value);
						}
						key2.ProcessAssociationRefChange(ParentSession, key, value2, value);
					}
					else
					{
						key2.SetValue(key, value);
					}
				}
				object nested = nestedParentMap.GetNested(modifiedObject.Key);
				XPClassInfo classInfo = context.Session.GetClassInfo(nested);
				if (classInfo.OptimisticLockField != null && classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer != null)
				{
					object value3 = classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer.GetValue(nested);
					classInfo.OptimisticLockField.SetValue(modifiedObject.Key, value3);
				}
				nestedParentMap.KickOut(modifiedObject.Key);
			}
		}

		private void RollbackDeletedObjects(AsyncCommitContext context)
		{
			foreach (object item in context.ReadyListForDelete)
			{
				object parentObject = NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(context.Session, ParentSession, context.Map, item);
				if (parentObject == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				XPClassInfo classInfo = context.Session.GetClassInfo(item);
				bool flag = classInfo.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? ParentSession.TrackPropertiesModifications;
				bool flag2 = classInfo.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? context.Session.TrackPropertiesModifications;
				foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
				{
					if (flag2 && flag && persistentProperty.GetModified(item) && persistentProperty.GetModified(parentObject))
					{
						persistentProperty.ResetModified(parentObject);
					}
				}
				if (parentObject is IntermediateObject)
				{
					IntermediateObject intermediateObject = (IntermediateObject)parentObject;
					IntermediateClassInfo intermediateClassInfo = (IntermediateClassInfo)ParentSession.GetClassInfo(intermediateObject);
					if (intermediateObject.LeftIntermediateObjectField != null && intermediateObject.RightIntermediateObjectField != null)
					{
						XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)intermediateClassInfo.intermediateObjectFieldInfoRight.refProperty.GetValue(intermediateObject.LeftIntermediateObjectField);
						xPBaseCollection.BaseAdd(intermediateObject.RightIntermediateObjectField);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void RemoveParentObjects(AsyncCommitContext context)
		{
			NestedParentMap nestedParentMap = GetNestedParentMap(context.Session);
			foreach (object item in context.CompleteListForSave)
			{
				nestedParentMap.KickOut(item);
			}
		}

		private XPMemberInfo[] ValidateBeforeCommitObject(ISecurityRuleProvider2 securityRuleProvider2, ISecurityRule2 rulev2, AsyncCommitContext context, object objToSave, object realObject)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull(realObject, "realObject");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull(objToSave, "objToSave");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)rulev2, "rulev2");
			List<XPMemberInfo> list = new List<XPMemberInfo>();
			SecurityContext securityContext = context.SecurityContext;
			if (securityContext != null)
			{
				XPClassInfo classInfo = context.Session.GetClassInfo(objToSave);
				if (!rulev2.ValidateObjectOnSave(securityContext, realObject))
				{
					throw new ObjectLayerSecurityException(classInfo.FullName, isDeletion: false);
				}
				foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
				{
					if ((persistentProperty.IsDelayed && !XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(objToSave, persistentProperty).IsLoaded) || persistentProperty.IsReadOnly || persistentProperty.IsFetchOnly || SecurityContext.IsSystemProperty(persistentProperty))
					{
						continue;
					}
					object value = persistentProperty.GetValue(objToSave);
					object obj = null;
					object obj2 = null;
					obj2 = persistentProperty.GetValue(realObject);
					obj = ((!rulev2.GetSelectMemberExpression(securityContext, classInfo, persistentProperty, out var expression)) ? obj2 : securityContext.Evaluate(AnalyzeCriteriaCreator.GetUpClass(classInfo, persistentProperty.Owner), expression, realObject));
					if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType != null && obj != null)
					{
						ISecurityRule2 rule = securityRuleProvider2.GetRule(persistentProperty.ReferenceType);
						if (rule != null)
						{
							obj = (rule.ValidateObjectOnSelect(securityContext, persistentProperty.ReferenceType, obj) ? obj : null);
						}
						else
						{
							ISecurityRule rule2 = securityContext.SecurityRuleProvider.GetRule(persistentProperty.ReferenceType);
							if (rule2 != null)
							{
								obj = (rule2.ValidateObjectOnSelect(securityContext, persistentProperty.ReferenceType, obj) ? obj : null);
							}
						}
					}
					if (!PersistentPropertiesEquals(context, persistentProperty, value, obj) && !rulev2.IsDoNotSaveMember(securityContext, realObject, persistentProperty, value, obj))
					{
						if (!rulev2.ValidateMemberOnSave(securityContext, persistentProperty, realObject))
						{
							throw new ObjectLayerSecurityException(classInfo.FullName, persistentProperty.Name);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(persistentProperty);
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private bool PersistentPropertiesEquals(AsyncCommitContext context, XPMemberInfo mi, object value, object valueOnLoad)
		{
			if (mi.ReferenceType != null && valueOnLoad != null && value != null)
			{
				value = NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(context.Session, ParentSession, context.Map, value);
			}
			return object.Equals(valueOnLoad, value);
		}

		private void ValidateObjectOnCommitGenericSecurityRule(AsyncCommitContext context)
		{
			SecurityContext securityContext = context.SecurityContext;
			SecurityContextValidateItem[] array = new SecurityContextValidateItem[context.CompleteListForSave.Count];
			SecurityContextValidateItem[] array2 = new SecurityContextValidateItem[context.ReadyListForDelete.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object item in context.CompleteListForSave)
			{
				array[num++] = new SecurityContextValidateItem(context.Session.GetClassInfo(item), item, NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(context.Session, ParentSession, context.Map, item));
			}
			num = 0;
			foreach (object item2 in context.ReadyListForDelete)
			{
				array2[num++] = new SecurityContextValidateItem(context.Session.GetClassInfo(item2), item2, NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(context.Session, ParentSession, context.Map, item2));
			}
			if (securityContext.GenericSecurityRule != null && !securityContext.GenericSecurityRule.ValidateObjectsOnCommit(securityContext, array, array2))
			{
				throw new ObjectLayerSecurityException();
			}
		}

		private void ValidateDeleteObjectsBeforeCommit(ISecurityRuleProvider2 securityRuleProvider2, AsyncCommitContext context, object realObject)
		{
			SecurityContext securityContext = context.SecurityContext;
			XPClassInfo classInfo = context.Session.GetClassInfo(realObject);
			ISecurityRule2 rule = securityRuleProvider2.GetRule(classInfo);
			if (rule != null && !rule.ValidateObjectOnDelete(securityContext, classInfo, realObject))
			{
				throw new ObjectLayerSecurityException(classInfo.FullName, isDeletion: true);
			}
		}

		private void ValidateDeleteObjectsOnCommit(ISecurityRuleProvider2 securityRuleProvider2, AsyncCommitContext context, object realObject)
		{
			SecurityContext securityContext = context.SecurityContext;
			XPClassInfo classInfo = context.Session.GetClassInfo(realObject);
			ISecurityRule2 securityRule = securityRuleProvider2?.GetRule(classInfo);
			if (securityRule != null && !securityRule.ValidateObjectOnDelete(securityContext, classInfo, realObject))
			{
				throw new ObjectLayerSecurityException(classInfo.FullName, isDeletion: true);
			}
		}

		public void CreateObjectType(XPObjectType type)
		{
			ParentSession.ObjectLayer.CreateObjectType(type);
		}

		public Task CreateObjectTypeAsync(XPObjectType type, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (!(ParentSession.ObjectLayer is IObjectLayerAsync objectLayerAsync))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("Async_ObjectLayerDoesNotImplementIObjectLayerAsync", ParentSession.ObjectLayer));
			}
			return objectLayerAsync.CreateObjectTypeAsync(type, cancellationToken);
		}

		public ICollection[] GetObjectsByKey(Session session, ObjectsByKeyQuery[] queries)
		{
			if (queries == null || queries.Length == 0)
			{
				return new object[0][];
			}
			ICollection[] objectsByKey = ParentSession.GetObjectsByKey(queries, alwaysGetFromDataStore: false);
			bool[] array = new bool[objectsByKey.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = true;
			}
			SecurityContext securityContext = GetSecurityContext(session);
			NestedParentMap nestedParentMap = GetNestedParentMap(session);
			ICollection[] nestedObjects = new NestedLoader(session, ParentSession, nestedParentMap, securityContext).GetNestedObjects(objectsByKey, array);
			OnLoadedObjects(objectsByKey, nestedObjects, nestedParentMap, securityContext);
			return nestedObjects;
		}

		public async Task<ICollection[]> GetObjectsByKeyAsync(Session session, ObjectsByKeyQuery[] queries, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (queries == null || queries.Length == 0)
			{
				return new object[0][];
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			ICollection[] parentObjects = await ParentSession.GetObjectsByKeyAsync(queries, alwaysGetFromDataStore: false, cancellationToken);
			bool[] array = new bool[parentObjects.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = true;
			}
			SecurityContext securityContext = GetSecurityContext(session);
			NestedParentMap nestedParentMap = GetNestedParentMap(session);
			int newAsyncOperationId = SessionStateStack.GetNewAsyncOperationId();
			ICollection[] array2 = await new NestedLoader(session, ParentSession, nestedParentMap, securityContext).GetNestedObjectsAsync(parentObjects, array, newAsyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			OnLoadedObjects(parentObjects, array2, nestedParentMap, securityContext);
			return array2;
		}

		public object[] LoadDelayedProperties(Session session, object theObject, MemberPathCollection props)
		{
			object[] array = new object[props.Count];
			SecurityContext securityContext = GetSecurityContext(session);
			object parentObject = NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(session, ParentSession, GetNestedParentMap(session), theObject);
			for (int i = 0; i < props.Count; i++)
			{
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = props[i][0];
				if (securityContext != null)
				{
					array[i] = securityContext.GetValueBySecurityRule(parentObject, xPMemberInfo);
				}
				else
				{
					array[i] = xPMemberInfo.GetValue(parentObject);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public async Task<object[]> LoadDelayedPropertiesAsync(Session session, object theObject, MemberPathCollection props, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			object[] result = new object[props.Count];
			SecurityContext securityContext = GetSecurityContext(session);
			object obj = await NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObjectAsync(session, ParentSession, GetNestedParentMap(session), theObject);
			for (int i = 0; i < props.Count; i++)
			{
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = props[i][0];
				if (securityContext != null)
				{
					result[i] = securityContext.GetValueBySecurityRule(obj, xPMemberInfo);
				}
				else
				{
					result[i] = xPMemberInfo.GetValue(obj);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public ObjectDictionary<object> LoadDelayedProperties(Session session, IList objects, XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			ObjectDictionary<object> objectDictionary = new ObjectDictionary<object>(objects.Count);
			SecurityContext securityContext = GetSecurityContext(session);
			foreach (object @object in objects)
			{
				object parentObject = NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(session, ParentSession, GetNestedParentMap(session), @object);
				if (securityContext != null)
				{
					objectDictionary.Add(@object, securityContext.GetValueBySecurityRule(parentObject, property));
				}
				else
				{
					objectDictionary.Add(@object, property.GetValue(parentObject));
				}
			}
			return objectDictionary;
		}

		public async Task<ObjectDictionary<object>> LoadDelayedPropertiesAsync(Session session, IList objects, XPMemberInfo property, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			ObjectDictionary<object> result = new ObjectDictionary<object>(objects.Count);
			SecurityContext securityContext = GetSecurityContext(session);
			foreach (object obj in objects)
			{
				object obj2 = await NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObjectAsync(session, ParentSession, GetNestedParentMap(session), obj);
				if (securityContext != null)
				{
					result.Add(obj, securityContext.GetValueBySecurityRule(obj2, property));
				}
				else
				{
					result.Add(obj, property.GetValue(obj2));
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public ICollection GetParentObjectsToSave(Session session)
		{

			object[] array = new object[objectsToSave.Count];

			SecurityContext securityContext = GetSecurityContext(session);
			foreach (object item in objectsToSave)

			}
			return array;
		}

		public object[] LoadCollectionObjects(Session session, XPMemberInfo refProperty, object owner)
		{
			object parentObject = NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(session, ParentSession, GetNestedParentMap(session), owner);
			if (parentObject == null)
			{
				return new object[0];
			}
			XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)refProperty.GetValue(owner);
			XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection2 = (XPBaseCollection)refProperty.GetValue(parentObject);
			if (xPBaseCollection2.IsLoaded && (xPBaseCollection.IsLoaded || xPBaseCollection.ClearCount > 0))
			{
				xPBaseCollection2.Reload();
			}
			xPBaseCollection2.Load();
			object[] array = ListHelper.FromCollection(xPBaseCollection2.Helper.IntObjList).ToArray();
			return ListHelper.FromCollection(new NestedLoader(session, ParentSession, GetNestedParentMap(session), GetSecurityContext(session)).GetNestedObjects(new ICollection[1] { array })[0]).ToArray();
		}

		public async Task<object[]> LoadCollectionObjectsAsync(Session session, XPMemberInfo refProperty, object owner, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			object obj = await NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObjectAsync(session, ParentSession, GetNestedParentMap(session), owner, cancellationToken);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return new object[0];
			}
			XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)refProperty.GetValue(owner);
			XPBaseCollection parentCollection = (XPBaseCollection)refProperty.GetValue(obj);
			if (parentCollection.IsLoaded && (xPBaseCollection.IsLoaded || xPBaseCollection.ClearCount > 0))
			{
				parentCollection.Reload();
			}
			await parentCollection.LoadAsync(cancellationToken);
			object[] array = ListHelper.FromCollection(parentCollection.Helper.IntObjList).ToArray();
			NestedLoader nestedLoader = new NestedLoader(session, ParentSession, GetNestedParentMap(session), GetSecurityContext(session));
			int newAsyncOperationId = SessionStateStack.GetNewAsyncOperationId();
			return ListHelper.FromCollection((await nestedLoader.GetNestedObjectsAsync(new ICollection[1] { array }, newAsyncOperationId, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false))[0]).ToArray();
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoadedObjects(ICollection[] parentObjects, ICollection[] nestedObjects, NestedParentMap nestedParentMap, SecurityContext securityContext)
		{
			if (this.ObjectsLoaded != null)
			{
				ObjectsLoadedEventArgs e = new ObjectsLoadedEventArgs(parentObjects, nestedObjects, nestedParentMap, securityContext);
				this.ObjectsLoaded(this, e);
			}
		}

		object ICommandChannel.Do(string command, object args)
		{
			ThrowIfNotAllowICommandChannelDo();
			if (nestedCommandChannel == null)
			{
				if (ParentSession == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported.");
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported by {ParentSession.GetType().FullName}.");
			}
			return nestedCommandChannel.Do(command, args);
		}

		Task<object> ICommandChannelAsync.DoAsync(string command, object args, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			ThrowIfNotAllowICommandChannelDo();
			if (nestedCommandChannelAsync == null)
			{
				if (nestedCommandChannel == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException($"Command '{command}' is not supported.");
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Async_CommandChannelDoesNotImplementICommandChannelAsync", ((object)nestedCommandChannel).GetType().FullName));
			}
			return nestedCommandChannelAsync.DoAsync(command, args, cancellationToken);
		}

		private void ThrowIfNotAllowICommandChannelDo()
		{
			if (securityContextMain != null && !AllowICommandChannelDoWithSecurityContext)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Security_ICommandChannel_TransferringRequestsIsProhibited"));
			}
		}
	}

	public sealed class ViewRecord : ICustomTypeDescriptor
	{
		private XPView view;

		private object[] data;

		internal object[] Data => data;

		[Description("Gets the view to which this record belongs.")]
		public XPView View => view;

		public object this[int index] => View.DisplayProps[index].GetValue(this);

		public object this[string name] => View.DisplayProps.Find(name, ignoreCase: true).GetValue(this);

		public object this[CriteriaOperator property]
		{
			get
			{
				ViewProperty viewProperty = View.Properties[property];
				if (viewProperty == null || !viewProperty.Fetch)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("View_PropertyNotFetched", CriteriaOperator.ToString(property)));
				}
				return this[viewProperty.Name];
			}
		}

		public ViewRecord(XPView view, object[] data)
		{
			this.view = view;
			this.data = data;
		}

		public object GetObject()
		{
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			XPMemberInfo keyProperty = View.ObjectClassInfo.KeyProperty;
			object id;
			if (keyProperty.SubMembers.Count == 0)
			{
				id = this[(CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(keyProperty.Name)];
			}
			else
			{
				IdList idList = new IdList();
				foreach (XPMemberInfo subMember in keyProperty.SubMembers)
				{
					if (subMember.IsPersistent)
					{
						idList.Add(this[(CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(subMember.Name)]);
					}
				}
				id = idList;
			}
			return View.Session.GetObjectByKey(View.ObjectClassInfo, id);
		}

			{
				get
				{
					List<IDataColumnInfo> list = new List<IDataColumnInfo>();
					if (column.owner == null || column.owner.ObjectClassInfo == null)
					{
						return list;
					}
					foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in column.owner.ObjectClassInfo.PersistentProperties)
					{
						list.Add((IDataColumnInfo)(object)new ViewPropertyMemberIDataPropertyInfoWrapper(persistentProperty));
					}
					foreach (XPMemberInfo collectionProperty in column.owner.ObjectClassInfo.CollectionProperties)
					{
						list.Add((IDataColumnInfo)(object)new ViewPropertyMemberIDataPropertyInfoWrapper(collectionProperty));
					}
					return list;
				}
			}

			DataControllerBase IDataColumnInfo.Controller => null;

			string IDataColumnInfo.FieldName
			{
				get
				{
					if (column.Property != null)
					{
						return ((object)column.Property).ToString();
					}
					return "";
				}
			}

			Type IDataColumnInfo.FieldType
			{
				get
				{
					if (column.owner == null || column.owner.ObjectClassInfo == null)
					{
						return typeof(object);
					}
					return CriteriaTypeResolver.ResolveType(column.owner.ObjectClassInfo, column.Property);
				}
			}

			string IDataColumnInfo.Name => column.Name;

			string IDataColumnInfo.UnboundExpression
			{
				get
				{
					if (column.Property != null)
					{
						return ((object)column.Property).ToString();
					}
					return "";
				}
			}

			}

	internal class ViewPropertyConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object val, Type destinationType)
		{
			ViewProperty viewProperty = val as ViewProperty;
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && viewProperty != null)
			{
				ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(ViewProperty).GetConstructor(new Type[5]
				{
					typeof(string),
					typeof(SortDirection),
					typeof(string),
					typeof(bool),
					typeof(bool)
				});
				if (constructor != null)
				{
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[5]
					{
						viewProperty.Name,
						viewProperty.Sorting,
						(viewProperty.Property == null) ? string.Empty : ((object)viewProperty.Property).ToString(),
						viewProperty.Group,
						viewProperty.Fetch
					});
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, val, destinationType);
		}
	}
	[ListBindable(BindableSupport.No)]
	[Editor("DevExpress.Xpo.Design.ViewPropertiesCollectionEditor,DevExpress.Xpo.v23.2.Design, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public sealed class ViewPropertiesCollection : CollectionBase
	{
		private XPView owner;

		public ViewProperty this[int index] => (ViewProperty)base.List[index];

		public ViewProperty this[CriteriaOperator expression]
		{
			get
			{
				IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						ViewProperty viewProperty = (ViewProperty)enumerator.Current;
						if (object.Equals(expression, viewProperty.Property))
						{
							return viewProperty;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
					if (disposable != null)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public ViewProperty this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						ViewProperty viewProperty = (ViewProperty)enumerator.Current;
						if (object.Equals(name, viewProperty.Name))
						{
							return viewProperty;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
					if (disposable != null)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public ViewPropertiesCollection(XPView owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		public void Add(ViewProperty sortProperty)
		{
			((IList)this).Add((object)sortProperty);
		}

		public void AddRange(ViewProperty[] sortProperties)
		{
			foreach (ViewProperty sortProperty in sortProperties)
			{
				Add(sortProperty);
			}
		}

		public void Add(ViewPropertiesCollection sortProperties)
		{
			foreach (ViewProperty sortProperty in sortProperties)
			{
				Add(sortProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInsertComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			((ViewProperty)value).SetOwner(owner);
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.ClearProps();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRemoveComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			((ViewProperty)value).SetOwner(null);
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.ClearProps();
			}
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				if (Session.IsDesignMode)
				{
					return GetSampleData();
				}
				if (isInAsyncLoading)
				{
					if (objects == null)
					{
						return new List<object>(0);
					}
					return Sorted;
				}
				if (objects == null)
				{
					objects = Load();
				}
				return Sorted;
			}
		}

		{
			get

				{
					return Session.CaseSensitive;

				return caseSensitive.Value;

				Reset(metadataChanged: false);
			}

		private List<object> Sorted
		{
			get
			{
				if (Sorting.Count == 0)
				{
					return Filtered;
				}
				if (sorted == null)
				{
					sorted = Filtered;
					sorted.Sort(new XPViewComparerWrapper(CreateComparer()));
				}
				return sorted;
			}
		}

		private List<object> Filtered
		{
			get
			{
				if (filter == null)
				{
					return objects;
				}
				if (filtered == null)
				{
					filtered = new List<object>();
					int count = objects.Count;
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						object obj = objects[i];
						if (fitPredicate(obj))
						{
							filtered.Add(obj);
						}
					}
				}
				return filtered;
			}
		}

		private List<object> GetSampleData()
		{
			if (ObjectClassInfo == null)
			{
				return new List<object>(0);
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			list.Add(new ViewRecord(this, new object[DisplayProps.Count]));
			return list;
		}
