		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			ClearProps();
			Initializing = false;
			if (hasChangesDuringInit)
			{
				Reset(metadataChanged: true);
			}
			hasChangesDuringInit = false;
		}

		private IComparer CreateComparer()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0031: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return XPCollectionCompareHelper.CreateComparer(Sorting, (CriteriaCompilerDescriptor)new CriteriaCompiledContextDescriptorDescripted(DisplayProps), new CriteriaCompilerAuxSettings(CaseSensitive, Session.Dictionary.CustomFunctionOperators));
		}

		public bool LoadAsync()
		{
			return LoadAsync(null);
		}

		public bool LoadAsync(AsyncLoadObjectsCallback callback)
		{
			if (isInAsyncLoading)
			{
				return false;
			}
			isInAsyncLoading = true;
			try
			{
				PrepareLoad(out var properties, out var groupProperties, out var sortingCollection);
				Session.SelectDataAsync(ObjectClassInfo, properties, Criteria, groupProperties, GroupCriteria, SelectDeleted, SkipReturnedRecords, TopReturnedRecords, sortingCollection, delegate(List<object[]> data, Exception ex)
				{
					isInAsyncLoading = false;
					if (ex == null)
					{
						List<object> list = new List<object>();
						foreach (object[] datum in data)
						{
							list.Add(new ViewRecord(this, datum));
						}
						objects = list;
						Reset(metadataChanged: false);
						if (callback != null)
						{
							callback(new ICollection[1] { this }, null);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						objects = new List<object>(0);
						Reset(metadataChanged: false);
						if (callback != null)
						{
							callback(null, ex);
						}
					}
				});
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				isInAsyncLoading = false;
				throw;
			}
		}

		private List<object> Load()
		{
			PrepareLoad(out var properties, out var groupProperties, out var sortingCollection);
			return EndLoad(properties, groupProperties, sortingCollection);
		}

		private void PrepareLoad(out CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, out CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties, out SortingCollection sorting)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0076: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Expected O, but got Unknown
			properties = new CriteriaOperatorCollection();
			groupProperties = new CriteriaOperatorCollection();
			sorting = new SortingCollection();
			foreach (ViewProperty property in Properties)
			{
				if (property.Fetch)
				{
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)properties).Add(property.Property);
				}
				if (property.Group)
				{
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)groupProperties).Add(property.Property);
				}
				if (property.Sorting != SortDirection.None)
				{
					sorting.Add(new SortProperty(property.Property, (SortingDirection)(property.Sorting != SortDirection.Ascending)));
				}
			}
			if (((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)properties).Count == 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("View_AtLeastOneFetchProperptyShouldBeDefined"));
			}
		}

		private List<object> EndLoad(CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties, SortingCollection sorting)
		{
			List<object[]> list = Session.SelectData(ObjectClassInfo, properties, Criteria, groupProperties, GroupCriteria, SelectDeleted, SkipReturnedRecords, TopReturnedRecords, sorting);
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			foreach (object[] item in list)
			{
				list2.Add(new ViewRecord(this, item));
			}
			return list2;
		}

		public void Reload()
		{
			if (isInAsyncLoading)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("View_IsInLoading"));
			}
			Clear();
			Reset(metadataChanged: false);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSession()
		{
			if (session != null)
			{
				return !(session is DefaultSession);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeCaseSensitive()
		{
			return caseSensitive.HasValue;
		}

		private void ResetCaseSensitive()
		{
			caseSensitive = null;
		}

		private Session DoResolveSession()
		{
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				return new DefaultSession(Site);
			}
			ResolveSessionEventArgs e = new ResolveSessionEventArgs();
			OnResolveSession(e);
			if (e.Session != null)
			{
				Session session = e.Session.Session;
				if (session != null)
				{
					return session;
				}
			}
			return XpoDefault.GetSession();
		}

		protected virtual void OnResolveSession(ResolveSessionEventArgs args)
		{
			if ((object)base.Events[EventResolveSession] != null)
			{
				((ResolveSessionEventHandler)base.Events[EventResolveSession])(this, args);
			}
		}

		internal void Reset(bool metadataChanged)
		{
			filtered = null;
			sorted = null;
			if (Initializing)
			{
				hasChangesDuringInit = true;
			}
			else if (this.listChanged != null)
			{
				if (metadataChanged)
				{
					this.listChanged(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged, null));
				}
				this.listChanged(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.Reset, -1));
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSorting()
		{
			return sorting != null;
		}

		public XPView()
		{
			props = new ViewPropertiesCollection(this);
		}

			: this()

		}

		public XPView(Session session, XPClassInfo info, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, CriteriaOperator criteria, CriteriaOperator groupCriteria)
			: this()
		{
			this.session = session;
			this.info = info;
			if (properties != null)
			{
				foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)properties)
				{
					AddProperty(item);
				}
			}
			this.criteria = criteria;
			this.groupCriteria = groupCriteria;
		}

		private static CriteriaOperatorCollection GetProperties(XPClassInfo info, string properties)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CriteriaOperatorCollection val = new CriteriaOperatorCollection();
			if (properties != null)
			{
				CriteriaOperator[] array = CriteriaOperator.ParseList(properties, new object[0]);
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)val).Add(array[i]);
				}
			}
			return val;
		}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ViewPropertiesCollection properties)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection propertyDescriptorCollection = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(null);
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ViewProperty property in properties)
			{
				if (!property.Fetch)
				{
					continue;
				}
				try
				{
					Type type = CriteriaTypeResolver.ResolveType(ObjectClassInfo, property.Property);
					propertyDescriptorCollection.Add(new ViewPropertyDescriptor(property.Name, type, num));
					num++;
				}
				catch
				{
					if (!IsDesignMode)
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
			}
			return propertyDescriptorCollection;
		}

			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown

		}

		int IBindingList.Find(PropertyDescriptor property, object key)
		{
			int count = Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (property.GetValue(this[i]).Equals(key))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		}

	internal class DataViewPropertyConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object val, Type destinationType)
		{
			DataViewProperty dataViewProperty = val as DataViewProperty;
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && dataViewProperty != null)
			{
				ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(DataViewProperty).GetConstructor(new Type[2]
				{
					typeof(string),
					typeof(Type)
				});
				if (constructor != null)
				{
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[2] { dataViewProperty.Name, dataViewProperty.ValueType });
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, val, destinationType);
		}
	}

	[Editor("DevExpress.Xpo.Design.DataViewPropertiesCollectionEditor,DevExpress.Xpo.v23.2.Design, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public sealed class DataViewPropertiesCollection : CollectionBase
	{
		private XPDataView owner;

		public DataViewProperty this[int index] => (DataViewProperty)base.List[index];

		public DataViewProperty this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						DataViewProperty dataViewProperty = (DataViewProperty)enumerator.Current;
						if (object.Equals(name, dataViewProperty.Name))
						{
							return dataViewProperty;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
					if (disposable != null)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public DataViewPropertiesCollection(XPDataView owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		public void Add(DataViewProperty sortProperty)
		{
			((IList)this).Add((object)sortProperty);
		}

		public void AddRange(DataViewProperty[] sortProperties)
		{
			foreach (DataViewProperty sortProperty in sortProperties)
			{
				Add(sortProperty);
			}
		}

		public void Add(DataViewPropertiesCollection sortProperties)
		{
			foreach (DataViewProperty sortProperty in sortProperties)
			{
				Add(sortProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInsertComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			((DataViewProperty)value).SetOwner(owner);
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.ClearProps();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRemoveComplete(int index, object value)
		{
			((DataViewProperty)value).SetOwner(null);
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.ClearProps();
			}
		}
	}

	{
		private bool? _isDesignMode;

		private ArrayList objects = new ArrayList();

		private bool Initializing;

		private bool? caseSensitive;

		private bool hasChangesDuringInit;

		private XPDictionary designDictionary;

		private DataViewPropertiesCollection props;

		private CriteriaOperator filter;

		private ArrayList sorted;

		private ArrayList filtered;

		private SortingCollection sorting;

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection displayProps;

		private XPDictionary dictionary;

		protected bool IsDesignMode => IsDesignModeHelper.GetIsDesignModeBypassable((Component)this, ref _isDesignMode);

		private ArrayList Objects
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsDesignMode)
				{
					return GetSampleData();
				}
				return Sorted;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets whether string comparisons evaluated by the XPDataView on the client are case-sensitive.")]
		[Category("Data")]
		public bool CaseSensitive
		{
			get
			{
				if (!caseSensitive.HasValue)
				{
					return XpoDefault.DefaultCaseSensitive;
				}
				return caseSensitive.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				caseSensitive = value;
				Reset(metadataChanged: false);
			}
		}

		private ArrayList Sorted
		{
			get
			{
				if (Sorting.Count == 0)
				{
					return Filtered;
				}
				if (sorted == null)
				{
					sorted = Filtered;
					sorted.Sort(CreateComparer());
				}
				return sorted;
			}
		}

		private ArrayList Filtered
		{
			get
			{
				if (filter == null)
				{
					return objects;
				}
				if (filtered == null)
				{
					filtered = new ArrayList();
					int count = objects.Count;
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						object obj = objects[i];
						if (IsFilterFit(obj))
						{
							filtered.Add(obj);
						}
					}
				}
				return filtered;
			}
		}

		public DataViewRecord this[int index] => (DataViewRecord)Objects[index];

		internal XPDictionary DesignDictionary
		{
			get
			{
				if (designDictionary == null)
				{
					if (!IsDesignMode)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException();
					}
					designDictionary = new DesignTimeReflection(Site);
				}
				return designDictionary;
			}
		}

		private IComparer CreateComparer()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return XPCollectionCompareHelper.CreateComparer(Sorting, (CriteriaCompilerDescriptor)new CriteriaCompiledContextDescriptorDescripted(DisplayProps), new CriteriaCompilerAuxSettings(CaseSensitive, (Dictionary == null) ? null : Dictionary.CustomFunctionOperators));
		}

		private bool IsFilterFit(object theObject)
		{
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (fitPredicate == null)
			{
				fitPredicate = CriteriaCompiler.ToUntypedPredicate(filter, CriteriaCompilerDescriptor.Get(((ITypedList)this).GetItemProperties((PropertyDescriptor[])null)), new CriteriaCompilerAuxSettings(CaseSensitive, (dictionary == null) ? null : dictionary.CustomFunctionOperators));
			}
			return fitPredicate(theObject);
		}

		public void LoadData(SelectedData data)

			objects = LoadDataInternal(data);
			Reset(metadataChanged: false);
		}

		public static SelectStatementResult GetTargetResultSet(SelectedData data)
		{
			SelectStatementResult result = data.ResultSet[0];
			if (data.ResultSet.Length > 1 && data.ResultSet[0].Rows.Length != 0 && data.ResultSet[0].Rows[0].Values != null && data.ResultSet[0].Rows[0].Values.Length == 3)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				object[] values = data.ResultSet[0].Rows[0].Values;
				foreach (object obj in values)
				{
					if (obj != null && !(obj is string))
					{
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					result = data.ResultSet[1];
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private ArrayList LoadDataInternal(SelectedData data)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			if (data == null || data.ResultSet == null || data.ResultSet.Length == 0)
			{
				return arrayList;
			}
			SelectStatementResult targetResultSet = GetTargetResultSet(data);
			SelectStatementResultRow[] rows = targetResultSet.Rows;
			foreach (SelectStatementResultRow val in rows)
			{
				if (val.Values.Length != Properties.Count)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("DirectSQL_WrongColumnCount"));
				}
				arrayList.Add(new DataViewRecord(this, val.Values));
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		public void LoadOrderedData(LoadDataMemberOrderItem[] members, SelectedData data)
		{
			objects = LoadOrderedDataInternal(members, data);
			Reset(metadataChanged: false);
		}

		private ArrayList LoadOrderedDataInternal(LoadDataMemberOrderItem[] members, SelectedData data)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			if (members == null || data == null || data.ResultSet == null || data.ResultSet.Length == 0)
			{
				if (Properties.Count == 0)
				{
					return arrayList;
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("DirectSQL_WrongColumnCount"));
			}
			if (members.Length != Properties.Count)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("DirectSQL_WrongColumnCount"));
			}
			SelectStatementResult targetResultSet = GetTargetResultSet(data);
			SelectStatementResultRow[] rows = targetResultSet.Rows;
			foreach (SelectStatementResultRow val in rows)
			{
				DataViewRecord dataViewRecord = new DataViewRecord(this, new object[members.Length]);
				for (int j = 0; j < members.Length; j++)
				{
					dataViewRecord.Data[j] = val.Values[members[j].IndexInResultSet];
				}
				arrayList.Add(dataViewRecord);
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		private void ResetValidator()
		{
			fitPredicate = null;
		}

		private void Reset(bool metadataChanged)
		{
			filtered = null;
			sorted = null;
			if (Initializing)
			{
				hasChangesDuringInit = true;
			}
			else if (this.listChanged != null)
			{
				if (metadataChanged)
				{
					this.listChanged(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged, null));
				}
				this.listChanged(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.Reset, -1));
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSorting()
		{
			return sorting != null;
		}

			: this(dictionary)

			{
				PopulatePropertiesOrdered(classInfo, members);
				LoadOrderedData(members, data);
			}
		}

		public void PopulateProperties(XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			PopulateProperties(classInfo.PersistentProperties as List<XPMemberInfo>);
		}

		public void PopulateProperties(List<XPMemberInfo> memberInfoList)
		{
			Properties.Clear();
			Reset(metadataChanged: true);
			if (memberInfoList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo memberInfo in memberInfoList)
			{
				AddProperty(memberInfo);
			}
		}

		public void PopulateProperties(XPClassInfo classInfo, params string[] members)
		{
			Properties.Clear();
			Reset(metadataChanged: true);
			if (members != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < members.Length; i++)
				{
					AddProperty(classInfo.FindMember(members[i]));
				}
			}
		}

		public void PopulatePropertiesOrdered(XPClassInfo classInfo, LoadDataMemberOrderItem[] members)
		{
			Properties.Clear();
			Reset(metadataChanged: true);
			if (members == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < members.Length; i++)
			{
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = classInfo.FindMember(members[i].ClassMemberName);
				if (xPMemberInfo == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(Res.GetString("Session_NotClassMember"), members[i].ClassMemberName, classInfo.FullName));
				}
				AddProperty(xPMemberInfo);
			}
		}

		private void AddProperty(XPMemberInfo mi)
		{
			if (mi.ReferenceType != null || mi.IsStruct)
			{
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = mi;
				do
				{
					if (xPMemberInfo.IsStruct)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("DataView_ReferenceMembersWithCompoundKeyAreNotSupported"));
					}
					xPMemberInfo = xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType.KeyProperty;
				}
				while (xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType != null || xPMemberInfo.IsStruct);
				AddProperty(mi.Name, xPMemberInfo.MemberType);
			}
			else
			{
				if (mi.IsCollection || mi.IsAssociationList)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("DirectSQL_CollectionMembersAreNotSupported"));
				}
				AddProperty(mi.Name, mi.MemberType);
			}
		}

		public DataViewProperty AddProperty(string name, Type valueType)
		{
			DataViewProperty dataViewProperty = new DataViewProperty(name, valueType);
			Properties.Add(dataViewProperty);
			Reset(metadataChanged: true);
			return dataViewProperty;
		}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(DataViewPropertiesCollection properties)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection propertyDescriptorCollection = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(null);
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DataViewProperty property in properties)
			{
				try
				{
					propertyDescriptorCollection.Add(new DataViewPropertyDescriptor(property.Name, property.ValueType, num));
					num++;
				}
				catch
				{
					if (!IsDesignMode)
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
			}
			return propertyDescriptorCollection;
		}

		PropertyDescriptorCollection ITypedList.GetItemProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			if (listAccessors == null || listAccessors.Length == 0)
			{
				return DisplayProps;
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(null);
		}

		string ITypedList.GetListName(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)

			return string.Empty;
		}

		void IBindingList.ApplySort(PropertyDescriptor property, ListSortDirection direction)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Sorting = new SortingCollection(new SortProperty((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(property.Name), (SortingDirection)((direction != ListSortDirection.Ascending) ? 1 : 0)));
		}

		int IBindingList.Find(PropertyDescriptor property, object key)
		{
			int count = Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (property.GetValue(this[i]).Equals(key))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		void IBindingList.RemoveIndex(PropertyDescriptor property)
		{
		}

		void IBindingList.RemoveSort()
		{
			Sorting = new SortingCollection();
		}
	}
	[DXToolboxItem(true)]

	[ToolboxBitmap(typeof(XPBindingSource))]

	[Designer("DevExpress.Xpo.Design.XPBindingSourceDesigner, DevExpress.Xpo.v23.2.Design, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.ComponentModel.Design.IDesigner, System, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089")]
	public class XPBindingSource : Component, IBindingList, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ITypedList, ISupportInitialize, IXPClassInfoProvider, IXPDictionaryProvider, ISessionProvider, IObjectLayerProvider, IDataLayerProvider, IObjectChange
	{
		protected bool Initializing;

		private bool hasChangesDuringInit;

		private IServiceProvider serviceProvider;

		private bool? _isDesignMode;

		private bool disableDesignModeDetection;

		private object dataSource;

		private bool isSingleObjectDataSource;

		private IList innerList;

		private CollectionBindingBehavior bindingBehavior;

		private string displayableProperties;

		private Type objectType;

		private Session inMemorySession;

		private bool IsDesignMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (!disableDesignModeDetection)
				{
					return IsDesignModeHelper.GetIsDesignModeBypassable((Component)this, ref _isDesignMode);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets a data source the XPBindingSource binds to a control.")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[TypeConverter("DevExpress.Xpo.Design.XPBindingSourceDataSourceReferenceConverter, DevExpress.Xpo.v23.2.Design, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[Category("Data")]
		public object DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return dataSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataSource == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				UnsubscribeDataSourceEvents();
				dataSource = value;
				innerList = null;
				isSingleObjectDataSource = false;
				if (value is IXPDictionaryProvider)
				{
					dictionary = null;
				}
				if (value is IXPClassInfoProvider)
				{
					objectClassInfo = null;
					objectType = null;
				}
				else if (value != null)
				{
					if (value is IEnumerable enumerable)
					{
						objectType = GetEnumerableElementType(enumerable);
						objectClassInfo = null;
					}
					else
					{
						objectType = value.GetType();
						objectClassInfo = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					objectType = typeof(object);
					objectClassInfo = null;
				}
				if (!Initializing)
				{
					InvokeDataSourceChanged();
				}
				PropertyDescriptorChanged();
				Reset();
			}
		}

		private IList InnerList
		{
			get
			{
				if (innerList != null)
				{
					return innerList;
				}
				if (dataSource != null)
				{
					isSingleObjectDataSource = false;
					if (dataSource is IBindingList bindingList)
					{
						innerList = bindingList;
					}
					else if (dataSource is IList list)
					{
						innerList = list;
					}
					else if (dataSource is IEnumerable source)
					{
						innerList = source.Cast<object>().ToList();
					}
					else if (dataSource is IListSource listSource)
					{
						innerList = listSource.GetList();
					}
					else
					{
						isSingleObjectDataSource = true;
						innerList = new object[1] { dataSource };
					}
				}
				else
				{
					innerList = new List<object>();
				}
				if (innerList != null)
				{
					SubscribeDataSourceEvents();
				}
				return innerList;
			}
		}

		[Description("Defines operations the bound control can perform with the data source.")]
		[DefaultValue(CollectionBindingBehavior.AllowNew | CollectionBindingBehavior.AllowRemove)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.Xpo.Design.FlagsEnumEditor, DevExpress.Xpo.v23.2.Design, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]

		[Category("View")]

		public string DisplayableProperties
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayableProperties))
				{
					return displayableProperties;
				}
				string[] defaultDisplayableProperties = GetDefaultDisplayableProperties();
				if (defaultDisplayableProperties != null)
				{
					return string.Join(";", defaultDisplayableProperties);
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (displayableProperties != value)
				{
					displayableProperties = value;
					PropertyDescriptorChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the XPClassInfo metadata that describes the type of items the data source contains.")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[TypeConverter("DevExpress.Xpo.Design.ObjectClassInfoTypeConverter, DevExpress.Xpo.v23.2.Design, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a")]
		[MergableProperty(false)]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]

		[Category("Data")]

			get
			{
				return GetObjectClassInfo();
			}
			set
			{
				if (!Initializing)
				{
					ThrowIfBadClassInfo(value);
				}
				if (CanSetObjectClassInfo())
				{
					objectClassInfo = value;
					objectType = null;
					PropertyDescriptorChanged();
				}
			}
		}

					if (!Initializing)
					{

					objectType = value;

		[IndexerName("Object")]

		public object this[int index]
		{
			get

				if (IsDesignMode)
				{
					return nowAddingObject;

				if (InnerList != null)
				{
					return InnerList[index];
				}
				return null;

				if (InnerList != null)

					InnerList[index] = value;
				}
			}

		bool IBindingList.AllowNew
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsDesignMode && !IsDesignerHosted(useSession: true))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ((BindingBehavior & CollectionBindingBehavior.AllowNew) == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (InnerList is IBindingList bindingList)
				{
					return bindingList.AllowNew;
				}
				if (InnerList == null || InnerList.IsFixedSize || InnerList.IsReadOnly || !(InnerList is ISessionProvider))
				{
					return false;
				}
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = GetObjectClassInfo();
				if (xPClassInfo == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return !xPClassInfo.IsAbstract;
			}
		}

		bool IBindingList.AllowEdit
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataSource == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (InnerList is IBindingList bindingList)
				{
					return bindingList.AllowEdit;
				}
				if (InnerList != null)
				{
					return !InnerList.IsReadOnly;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		bool IBindingList.AllowRemove
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataSource == null || (BindingBehavior & CollectionBindingBehavior.AllowRemove) == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (InnerList is IBindingList bindingList)
				{
					return bindingList.AllowRemove;
				}
				if (InnerList != null)
				{
					return !InnerList.IsFixedSize;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		PropertyDescriptor IBindingList.SortProperty
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataSource == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!(InnerList is IBindingList { SortProperty: not null } bindingList))
				{
					return null;
				}
				PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = ((ITypedList)this).GetItemProperties((PropertyDescriptor[])null);
				return itemProperties.Find(bindingList.SortProperty.Name, ignoreCase: false);
			}
		}

		ListSortDirection IBindingList.SortDirection
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataSource == null)
				{
					return ListSortDirection.Ascending;
				}
				if (!(InnerList is IBindingList bindingList))
				{
					return ListSortDirection.Ascending;
				}
				return bindingList.SortDirection;
			}
		}

		{

				{
					return true;

					return true;
				}

			}

			get

				if (dataSource == null)
				{
					return true;

				if (InnerList == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return InnerList.IsFixedSize;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsDesignMode)
				{
					if (nowAddingObject == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return 1;
				}
				if (Initializing)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (InnerList == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return InnerList.Count;
			}
		}

			container.Add(this);
		}

		private void InitData()
		{
			BindingBehavior = CollectionBindingBehavior.AllowNew | CollectionBindingBehavior.AllowRemove;
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.BeginInit()
		{
			Initializing = true;
			hasChangesDuringInit = false;
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			Initializing = false;
			if (hasChangesDuringInit)
			{
				PropertyDescriptorChanged();
				Reset();
			}
			hasChangesDuringInit = false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void DisableDesignModeDetection()
		{
			disableDesignModeDetection = true;
		}

		private bool IsDesignerHosted(bool useSession)
		{
			return GetDesignerHostSite(useSession) != null;
		}

		private ISite GetDesignerHostSite(bool useSession)
		{
			if (IsDesignerHostSite(Site))
			{
				return Site;
			}
			if (dataSource is Component component && IsDesignerHostSite(component.Site))
			{
				return component.Site;
			}
			if (useSession)
			{
				Session session = GetSession();
				if (IsDesignerHostSite(session.Site))
				{
					return session.Site;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool IsDesignerHostSite(ISite site)
		{
			if (site == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IServiceContainer serviceContainer = (IServiceContainer)site.GetService(typeof(IServiceContainer));
			if (serviceContainer == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IDesignerHost designerHost = (IDesignerHost)serviceContainer.GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost));
			if (designerHost != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Type GetEnumerableElementType(IEnumerable enumerable)
		{
			Type type = enumerable.GetType();
			if (type.IsGenericType)
			{
				Type[] genericTypeArguments = type.GenericTypeArguments;
				if (genericTypeArguments.Length == 1)
				{
					return genericTypeArguments[0];
				}
			}
			else if (type.IsArray && type.HasElementType)
			{
				return type.GetElementType();
			}
			return typeof(object);
		}

		private void SubscribeDataSourceEvents()
		{
			if (InnerList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!isSingleObjectDataSource)
			{
				if (InnerList is IBindingList bindingList)
				{
					bindingList.ListChanged += OnInnerListChanged;
				}
				else if (InnerList is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged += OnInnerListNotifyCollectionChanged;
				}
			}
			else if (dataSource is INotifyPropertyChanged notifyPropertyChanged)
			{
				notifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged += OnInnerObjectNotifyPropertyChanged;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeDataSourceEvents()
		{
			if (innerList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!isSingleObjectDataSource)
			{
				if (InnerList is IBindingList bindingList)
				{
					bindingList.ListChanged -= OnInnerListChanged;
				}
				else if (InnerList is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged -= OnInnerListNotifyCollectionChanged;
				}
			}
			else if (dataSource is INotifyPropertyChanged notifyPropertyChanged)
			{
				notifyPropertyChanged.PropertyChanged -= OnInnerObjectNotifyPropertyChanged;
			}
		}

		private string[] GetDefaultDisplayableProperties()
		{
			string[] dataSourceDisplayableProperties = GetDataSourceDisplayableProperties();
			if (dataSourceDisplayableProperties != null)
			{
				return dataSourceDisplayableProperties;
			}
			return GetClassInfoDisplayableProperties(GetObjectClassInfo());
		}

		private string[] GetClassInfoDisplayableProperties(XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			if (classInfo == null)
			{
				return new string[0];
			}
			return (from string t in ClassMetadataHelper.GetDefaultDisplayableProperties(classInfo)
				where !t.EndsWith("!")
				select t).ToArray();
		}

		private string[] GetDataSourceDisplayableProperties()
		{
			if (dataSource is XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(xPBaseCollection.DisplayableProperties))
				{
					return xPBaseCollection.DisplayableProperties.Split(';');
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (dataSource is XPBindingSource xPBindingSource)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(xPBindingSource.DisplayableProperties))
				{
					return xPBindingSource.DisplayableProperties.Split(';');
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (dataSource is XPServerCollectionSource xPServerCollectionSource)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(xPServerCollectionSource.DisplayableProperties))
				{
					return xPServerCollectionSource.DisplayableProperties.Split(';');
				}
				return null;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void ThrowIfBadClassInfo(XPClassInfo newClassInfo)
		{
			if (dataSource is IXPClassInfoProvider iXPClassInfoProvider && iXPClassInfoProvider.ClassInfo != newClassInfo && (!IsDesignMode || iXPClassInfoProvider.ClassInfo == null || newClassInfo == null || !(iXPClassInfoProvider.ClassInfo.FullName == newClassInfo.FullName)))
			{
				if (iXPClassInfoProvider.ClassInfo != newClassInfo)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("XPBindingSource_BadClassInfo_DataSource"));
				}
				IXPDictionaryProvider iXPDictionaryProvider = dataSource as IXPDictionaryProvider;
				if (newClassInfo != null && iXPDictionaryProvider != null && iXPDictionaryProvider.Dictionary != newClassInfo.Dictionary)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("XPBindingSource_BadClassInfo_DataSourceDictionary"));
				}
				if (newClassInfo != null && dictionary != null && newClassInfo.Dictionary != dictionary)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("XPBindingSource_BadClassInfo_Dictionary"));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ThrowIfBadObjectType(Type newObjectType)
		{
			if (dataSource is IXPClassInfoProvider { ClassInfo: not null } iXPClassInfoProvider && iXPClassInfoProvider.ClassInfo.ClassType != newObjectType)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("XPBindingSource_BadObjectType_DataSource"));
			}
		}

		private bool CanSetObjectClassInfo()
		{
			if (dataSource is IXPClassInfoProvider)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private Session GetSession()
		{
			if (IsDesignMode && IsDesignerHosted(useSession: false))
			{
				return new DefaultSession(GetDesignerHostSite(useSession: false));
			}
			if (dataSource != null && dataSource is ISessionProvider { Session: not null } sessionProvider)
			{
				return sessionProvider.Session;
			}
			XPDictionary xPDictionary = GetDictionary(useSession: false);
			if (inMemorySession == null || (xPDictionary != null && xPDictionary != inMemorySession.Dictionary))
			{
				inMemorySession = new UnitOfWork(serviceProvider, new SimpleDataLayer(xPDictionary, (IDataStore)(object)new InMemoryDataStore()));
			}
			return inMemorySession;
		}

		private XPDictionary GetDictionary(bool useSession)
		{
			if (IsDesignMode && IsDesignerHosted(useSession))
			{
				if (designDictionary == null)
				{
					designDictionary = new DesignTimeReflection(GetDesignerHostSite(useSession));
				}
				return designDictionary;
			}
			if (dictionary != null)
			{
				return dictionary;
			}
			if (objectClassInfo != null)
			{
				return objectClassInfo.Dictionary;
			}
			if (dataSource is IXPDictionaryProvider iXPDictionaryProvider)
			{
				return iXPDictionaryProvider.Dictionary;
			}
			if (useSession)
			{
				Session session = GetSession();
				return session.Dictionary;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private XPClassInfo GetObjectClassInfo()
		{
			if (objectClassInfo != null)
			{
				return objectClassInfo;
			}
			if (dataSource is IXPClassInfoProvider iXPClassInfoProvider)
			{
				return iXPClassInfoProvider.ClassInfo;
			}
			if (objectType == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetDictionary(useSession: true)?.QueryClassInfo(objectType);
		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.Reset, -1, -1);
		}

		private void PropertyDescriptorChanged()
		{
			InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged, 0, 0);
		}

		private void InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType changeType, int newIndex, int oldIndex)
		{
			if (Initializing)
			{
				hasChangesDuringInit = true;
			}
			else if (this.ListChanged != null)
			{
				this.ListChanged(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(changeType, newIndex, oldIndex));
			}
		}

		private void InvokeDataSourceChanged()
		{
			if (this.DataSourceChanged != null)
			{
				this.DataSourceChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void OnInnerListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Initializing)
			{
				hasChangesDuringInit = true;
			}
			else if (this.ListChanged != null)
			{
				this.ListChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void OnInnerObjectNotifyPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ListChanged != null)
			{
				this.ListChanged(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.ItemChanged, 0, 0));
			}
		}

		private void OnInnerListNotifyCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < e.NewItems.Count; l++)
				{
					InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.ItemAdded, e.NewStartingIndex + l, -1);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < e.OldItems.Count; j++)
				{
					InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.ItemMoved, e.NewStartingIndex + j, e.OldStartingIndex + j);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < e.OldItems.Count; k++)
				{
					InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.ItemDeleted, e.OldStartingIndex + k, -1);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < e.OldItems.Count; i++)
				{
					InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.ItemChanged, e.OldStartingIndex + i, e.OldStartingIndex + i);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				Reset();
				break;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeDisplayableProperties()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayableProperties);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeObjectType()
		{
			if (ObjectType != null)
			{
				return CanSetObjectClassInfo();
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IObjectChange.OnObjectChanged(object sender, ObjectChangeEventArgs args)
		{
			if (args.Reason == ObjectChangeReason.CancelEdit)
			{
				if (IsDesignMode)
				{
					nowAddingObject = null;
					InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.ItemDeleted, 0, 0);
				}
				else if (nowAddingObject == args.Object && InnerList != null && !(InnerList is IBindingList))
				{
					InnerList.Remove(nowAddingObject);
					XPBaseObject.RemoveChangedEventHandler(nowAddingObject, ((IObjectChange)this).OnObjectChanged);
					Session session = GetSession();
					session.Delete(nowAddingObject);
					nowAddingObject = null;
				}
			}
			if (InnerList is IObjectChange objectChange)
			{
				objectChange.OnObjectChanged(sender, args);
			}
		}

		object IBindingList.AddNew()
		{
			Session session = GetSession();
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = GetObjectClassInfo();
			if (IsDesignMode)
			{
				if (xPClassInfo != null)
				{
					if (IsDesignerHosted(useSession: true))
					{
						nowAddingObject = new IntermediateObject(session, xPClassInfo);
						((IntermediateObject)nowAddingObject).Changed += ((IObjectChange)this).OnObjectChanged;
						InvokeListChanged(ListChangedType.ItemAdded, 0, 0);
						return nowAddingObject;
					}
					nowAddingObject = xPClassInfo.CreateNewObject(session);
					XPBaseObject.AddChangedEventHandler(nowAddingObject, ((IObjectChange)this).OnObjectChanged);
					InnerList.Add(nowAddingObject);
					return nowAddingObject;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (InnerList is IBindingList bindingList)
				{
					return bindingList.AddNew();
				}
				if (xPClassInfo != null)
				{
					nowAddingObject = xPClassInfo.CreateNewObject(session);
					XPBaseObject.AddChangedEventHandler(nowAddingObject, ((IObjectChange)this).OnObjectChanged);
					InnerList.Add(nowAddingObject);
					return nowAddingObject;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		void IBindingList.ApplySort(PropertyDescriptor property, ListSortDirection direction)
		{
			if (dataSource != null && InnerList is IBindingList bindingList)
			{
				bindingList.ApplySort(property, direction);
			}
		}

		}

		{
		}

		void IBindingList.RemoveSort()
		{
			if (dataSource != null && InnerList is IBindingList bindingList)
			{
				bindingList.RemoveSort();
			}
		}

		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{

			{

			}

		int IBindingList.Find(PropertyDescriptor property, object key)
		{
			if (dataSource == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (!(InnerList is IBindingList bindingList))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return bindingList.Find(property, key);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()

		}

		}

		PropertyDescriptorCollection ITypedList.GetItemProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = GetObjectClassInfo();
			if (xPClassInfo == null)
			{
				return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(new PropertyDescriptor[0]);
			}
			if (listAccessors == null || listAccessors.Length == 0)
			{
				string[] array = DisplayableProperties.Split(';');
				return new XPBindingSourcePropertyDescriptorCollection(xPClassInfo, array, this);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < listAccessors.Length; i++)
			{
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = xPClassInfo.FindMember(listAccessors[i].Name);
				if (xPMemberInfo == null)
				{
					xPClassInfo = null;
					break;
				}
				if (xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType != null)
				{
					xPClassInfo = xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType;
					continue;
				}
				if (xPMemberInfo.IsCollection || xPMemberInfo.IsAssociationList || xPMemberInfo.IsNonAssociationList)
				{
					xPClassInfo = xPMemberInfo.CollectionElementType;
					continue;
				}
				xPClassInfo = null;
				break;
			}
			if (xPClassInfo != null)
			{
				string[] classInfoDisplayableProperties = GetClassInfoDisplayableProperties(xPClassInfo);
				return new XPBindingSourcePropertyDescriptorCollection(xPClassInfo, classInfoDisplayableProperties, this);
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(new PropertyDescriptor[0]);
		}

		string ITypedList.GetListName(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			return ClassMetadataHelper.GetListName(listAccessors);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				UnsubscribeDataSourceEvents();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		[SpecialName]
		object IList.get_Item(int index)
		{
			return this[index];
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void IList.set_Item(int index, object value)
		{
			this[index] = value;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class XPBindingSourcePropertyDescriptorCollection : PropertyDescriptorCollection
	{
		private readonly XPClassInfo objectType;

		private readonly ISessionProvider sessionProvider;

		public override PropertyDescriptor this[string itemIndex] => FindCaseSmart(itemIndex);

		public override PropertyDescriptor this[int itemIndex] => base[itemIndex];

		public XPBindingSourcePropertyDescriptorCollection(XPClassInfo objectType, string[] displayableProperties, ISessionProvider sessionProvider)
			: base(null)
		{
			this.objectType = objectType;
			this.sessionProvider = sessionProvider;
			foreach (string name in displayableProperties)
			{
				Find(name, ignoreCase: false);
			}
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptor Find(string name, bool ignoreCase)
		{
			if (name == null || name.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = base.Find(name, ignoreCase);
			if (propertyDescriptor == null)
			{
				MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = new MemberInfoCollection(objectType, XPPropertyDescriptorBase.GetMemberName(name), addNonPersistent: true, throwOnError: false);
				if (memberInfoCollection.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (name.EndsWith("!"))
				{
					return null;
				}
				propertyDescriptor = new XPBindingSourcePropertyDescriptor(objectType, name, sessionProvider);
				Add(propertyDescriptor);
			}
			return propertyDescriptor;
		}

		public PropertyDescriptor FindCaseSmart(string name)
		{
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = Find(name, ignoreCase: false);
			if (propertyDescriptor != null)
			{
				return propertyDescriptor;
			}
			return Find(name, ignoreCase: true);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class XPBindingSourcePropertyDescriptor : XPPropertyDescriptorBase, IObjectChange
	{
		private class XPBindingSourceAccessor : ValueAccessor
		{
			protected readonly XPMemberInfo Member;

			private readonly bool upCast;

			public override string ChangedPropertyName => Member.Name;

			public XPBindingSourceAccessor(XPClassInfo objectType, XPMemberInfo member)
			{
				Member = member;
				upCast = !objectType.IsAssignableTo(member.Owner);
			}

			public override object GetValue(object obj)
			{
				if (obj == null || (upCast && !Member.Owner.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(obj).IsAssignableTo(Member.Owner)))
				{
					return null;
				}
				object value = Member.GetValue(obj);
				XPBindingSource xPBindingSource = new XPBindingSource();
				xPBindingSource.DataSource = value;
				return xPBindingSource;
			}

			public override bool SetValue(object obj, object value)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Object_ReferencePropertyViaCollectionAccessor"));
			}
		}

		private XPMemberInfo targetMember;

		private XPClassInfo objectType;

		private MemberInfoCollection path;

		private Type propertyType;

		private ValueAccessor accessor;

		private string displayName;

		private string memberName;

		public override string DisplayName => displayName;

		public override bool IsReadOnly
		{
			get
			{
				if (targetMember.IsReadOnly || propertyType == typeof(XPCollection) || propertyType == typeof(XPBindingSource) || targetMember.IsFetchOnly)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (((ReadOnlyAttribute)Attributes[typeof(ReadOnlyAttribute)]).IsReadOnly)
				{
					return true;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < path.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!path[i].IsAggregated)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override Type PropertyType
		{
			get
			{
				if (propertyType == null)
				{
					return typeof(object);
				}
				return propertyType;
			}
		}

		public override Type ComponentType => objectType.ClassType;

		public XPMemberInfo MemberInfo => targetMember;

		public XPBindingSourcePropertyDescriptor(XPClassInfo objectType, string propertyName, ISessionProvider sessionProvider)
			: base(propertyName)
		{
			//IL_018e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.objectType = objectType;
			MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = new MemberInfoCollection(objectType, XPPropertyDescriptorBase.GetMemberName(propertyName), addNonPersistent: true);
			targetMember = memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1];
			memberName = XPPropertyDescriptorBase.GetMemberName(propertyName);
			displayName = targetMember.DisplayName;
			if (displayName == string.Empty)
			{
				displayName = memberName;
			}
			memberInfoCollection.RemoveAt(memberInfoCollection.Count - 1);
			path = memberInfoCollection;
			if (sessionProvider.Session != null && sessionProvider.Session.IsDesignMode)
			{
				if (propertyName.EndsWith("!Key"))
				{
					if (targetMember.ReferenceType != null)
					{
						propertyType = targetMember.ReferenceType.KeyProperty.MemberType;
					}
				}
				else if (targetMember.IsAssociationList || targetMember.IsNonAssociationList)
				{
					propertyType = typeof(XPBindingSource);
				}
				else
				{
					propertyType = targetMember.MemberType;
				}
				accessor = new DesignAccessor(PropertyType, sessionProvider, (targetMember.IsAssociationList || targetMember.IsNonAssociationList) ? targetMember.CollectionElementType : targetMember.ReferenceType);
				return;
			}
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = ((memberInfoCollection.Count == 0) ? objectType : memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1].Owner);
			if (propertyName.EndsWith("!Key"))
			{
				if (targetMember.ReferenceType == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidPropertyPathException(propertyName);
				}
				propertyType = targetMember.ReferenceType.KeyProperty.MemberType;
				accessor = new RelationAsKeyAccessor(xPClassInfo, targetMember, sessionProvider);
			}
			else if (targetMember.IsAssociationList)
			{
				propertyType = typeof(XPBindingSource);
				accessor = new XPBindingSourceAccessor(xPClassInfo, targetMember);
			}
			else
			{
				propertyType = targetMember.MemberType;
				accessor = new MemberAccessor(xPClassInfo, targetMember);
			}
			for (int num = memberInfoCollection.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				accessor = new RelatedMemberAccessor((num == 0) ? objectType : memberInfoCollection[num - 1].Owner, memberInfoCollection[num], accessor);
			}
		}

		protected override void FillAttributes(IList attributeList)
		{
			Attribute[] array = targetMember.Attributes;
			foreach (object value in array)
			{
				attributeList.Add(value);
			}
		}

		protected override DataSourceView GetView(string viewName)
		{
			if (viewName != null && (viewName.Length == 0 || string.Equals(viewName, "DefaultView", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
			{
				return GetView();
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("", "viewName");
		}

		private XpoDataSourceView GetView()
		{
			if (_view == null)
			{
				_view = new XpoDataSourceView(this, "DefaultView", Context);
				if (base.IsTrackingViewState)
				{
					((IStateManager)_view).TrackViewState();
				}
			}
			return _view;
		}

		protected override ICollection GetViewNames()
		{
			if (_viewNames == null)
			{
				_viewNames = new string[1] { "DefaultView" };
			}
			return _viewNames;

			if (Page != null)
			{
				Page.LoadComplete += LoadCompleteEventHandler;

		private void LoadCompleteEventHandler(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CriteriaParameters.UpdateValues(Context, this);
		}

		protected override void TrackViewState()
		{
			base.TrackViewState();
			if (_view != null)
			{
				((IStateManager)_view).TrackViewState();
			}
		}

		protected override void LoadViewState(object savedState)
		{
			if (savedState == null)
			{
				base.LoadViewState(null);
				return;
			}
			Pair pair = (Pair)savedState;
			base.LoadViewState(pair.First);
			if (pair.Second != null)
			{
				((IStateManager)GetView()).LoadViewState(pair.Second);
			}
		}

		protected override object SaveViewState()
		{
			Pair pair = new Pair();
			pair.First = base.SaveViewState();
			if (_view != null)
			{
				pair.Second = ((IStateManager)_view).SaveViewState();
			}
			if (pair.First == null && pair.Second == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return pair;
		}
	}

		public XpoDataSourceView(XpoDataSource owner, string name, HttpContext context)
			: base(owner, name)
		{

		protected override IEnumerable ExecuteSelect(DataSourceSelectArguments arguments)
		{
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00be: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c5: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00c0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ca: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (TypeName == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SortingCollection sortingCollection = null;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(arguments.SortExpression))
			{
				string[] array = arguments.SortExpression.Split(',');
				sortingCollection = new SortingCollection();
				string[] array2 = array;
				foreach (string text in array2)
				{
					string text2 = text.Trim();
					SortingDirection val = (SortingDirection)0;
					if (text2.EndsWith(" DESC"))
					{
						text2 = text2.Substring(0, text2.Length - 5).TrimEnd();
						val = (SortingDirection)1;
					}
					else if (text2.EndsWith(" ASC"))
					{
						text2 = text2.Substring(0, text2.Length - 4).TrimEnd();
					}
					sortingCollection.Add(new SortProperty((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(text2), val));
				}
			}
			XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo();
			IOrderedDictionary values = CriteriaParameters.GetValues(context, owner);
			object[] array3 = new object[values.Count];
			for (int j = 0; j < values.Count; j++)
			{
				array3[j] = values[j];
			}
			CriteriaOperator val2 = CriteriaOperator.Parse(Criteria, array3);
			if (ServerMode)
			{
				XPServerCollectionSource xPServerCollectionSource = new XPServerCollectionSource(Session, classInfo, val2);
				xPServerCollectionSource.DefaultSorting = DefaultSorting;
				GC.SuppressFinalize(xPServerCollectionSource);
				return ((IListSource)xPServerCollectionSource).GetList();
			}
			if (arguments.RetrieveTotalRowCount)
			{
				arguments.TotalRowCount = ((int?)Session.Evaluate(classInfo, (CriteriaOperator)(object)AggregateOperand.TopLevel((Aggregate)1, (CriteriaOperator)null), val2)).GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			XPCollection xPCollection = new XPCollection(Session, classInfo, val2);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(xPCollection);
			if (sortingCollection == null)
			{
				sortingCollection = GetDefaultSorting();
			}
			if (sortingCollection != null)
			{
				xPCollection.Sorting = sortingCollection;
			}
			if (arguments.MaximumRows > 0 && arguments.StartRowIndex >= 0)
			{
				xPCollection.SkipReturnedObjects = arguments.StartRowIndex;
				xPCollection.TopReturnedObjects = arguments.MaximumRows;
			}
			return xPCollection;
		}

		private SortingCollection GetDefaultSorting()
		{
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ServerModeOrderDescriptor[] sortingDescriptors = ServerModeCore.GetSortingDescriptors(DefaultSorting);
			if (sortingDescriptors == null || sortingDescriptors.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SortingCollection sortingCollection = new SortingCollection();
			ServerModeOrderDescriptor[] array = sortingDescriptors;
			foreach (ServerModeOrderDescriptor val in array)
			{
				sortingCollection.Add(new SortProperty(val.SortExpression, (SortingDirection)(val.IsDesc ? 1 : 0)));
			}
			return sortingCollection;
		}

		protected override int ExecuteUpdate(IDictionary keys, IDictionary values, IDictionary oldValues)
		{
			if (keys.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			object obj = null;
			foreach (DictionaryEntry key in keys)
			{
				obj = key.Value;
			}
			XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo();
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = Session.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(obj);
			object obj2 = ((xPClassInfo != null && xPClassInfo.IsAssignableTo(classInfo)) ? obj : Session.GetObjectByKey(classInfo, obj));
			if (obj2 == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			SetValues(values, classInfo, obj2);
			Session.Save(obj2);
			OnDataSourceViewChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
			return 1;
		}

		protected override int ExecuteInsert(IDictionary values)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo();
			object obj = classInfo.CreateNewObject(Session);
			SetValues(values, classInfo, obj);
			Session.Save(obj);
			OnInserted(new XpoDataSourceInsertedEventArgs(obj));
			OnDataSourceViewChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
			return 1;
		}

		private void SetValues(IDictionary values, XPClassInfo ci, object rootObj)
		{
			foreach (DictionaryEntry value in values)
			{
				string text = (string)value.Key;
				bool flag = text.EndsWith("!Key");
				text = text.Replace("!Key", string.Empty);
				MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = MemberInfoCollection.ParsePath(ci, text);
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = memberInfoCollection[0];
				object obj = rootObj;
				for (int i = 1; i < memberInfoCollection.Count; i++)
				{
					obj = xPMemberInfo.GetValue(obj);
					if (obj == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					xPMemberInfo = memberInfoCollection[i];
				}
				if (obj != null)
				{
					if (xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType != null && flag)
					{
						object theValue = ((value.Value == null) ? null : Session.GetObjectByKey(xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType, ConvertValue(value.Value, xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType.KeyProperty.MemberType)));
						xPMemberInfo.SetValue(obj, theValue);
					}
					else
					{
						xPMemberInfo.SetValue(obj, (value.Value == null) ? null : ConvertValue(value.Value, xPMemberInfo.MemberType));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private object ConvertValue(object value, Type targetType)
		{
			if (targetType.IsInstanceOfType(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			Type type = GetType(targetType);
			if (value is string text)
			{
				TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(type);
				if (converter != null)
				{
					return converter.ConvertFromString(text);
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private Type GetType(Type type)
		{
			Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type);
			if (!(underlyingType == null))
			{
				return underlyingType;
			}
			return type;
		}

		protected override int ExecuteDelete(IDictionary keys, IDictionary oldValues)
		{
			if (keys.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			object id = null;
			foreach (DictionaryEntry key in keys)
			{
				id = key.Value;
			}
			XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo();
			object objectByKey = Session.GetObjectByKey(classInfo, id);
			if (objectByKey == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			Session.Delete(objectByKey);
			OnDataSourceViewChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
			return 1;
		}

		private void CriteriaParametersChangedEventHandler(object o, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnDataSourceViewChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		protected virtual void OnInserted(XpoDataSourceInsertedEventArgs e)
		{

			{
				xpoDataSourceInsertedEventHandler(this, e);
			}
		}

		bool IColumnsServerActions.AllowAction(string fieldName, ColumnServerActionType action)
		{
			return XpoServerModeCore.IColumnsServerActionsAllowAction(Session, GetClassInfo(), fieldName);
		}

		public XPClassInfo GetClassInfo()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(TypeName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = BuildManager.GetType(TypeName, throwOnError: false, ignoreCase: true);
			if (type != null)
			{
				return Session.GetClassInfo(type);
			}
			return Session.GetClassInfo("", TypeName);
		}

		protected virtual void LoadViewState(object savedState)

		protected virtual object SaveViewState()

			}
		}

		void IStateManager.LoadViewState(object savedState)
		{
			LoadViewState(savedState);
		}

		object IStateManager.SaveViewState()
		{
			return SaveViewState();
		}

		void IStateManager.TrackViewState()
		{
			TrackViewState();
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the default session.")]
		public static Session Session
		{
			get
			{
				return session;
			}
			set
			{
				if (session == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				lock (SyncRoot)
				{
					if (session != null)
					{
						session.Dispose();
					}
					session = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the default data access layer which is used by Session objects by default, to access a data store.")]
		public static IDataLayer DataLayer
		{
			get
			{
				return dataLayer;
			}
			set
			{
				if (DataLayer == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				lock (SyncRoot)
				{
					if (ConnectionString != null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("XpoDefault_CannotAssignPropertyWhileAnotherIsNotNull", "DataLayer", "ConnectionString"));
					}
					if (Dictionary != null && value != null && Dictionary != value.Dictionary)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("XpoDefault_CannotAssignPropertyWhileAnotherIsNotNull", "DataLayer", "Dictionary"));
					}
					dataLayer = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets metadata on the persistent objects in a data store.")]
		public static XPDictionary Dictionary

			set

		[DllImport("rpcrt4.dll", SetLastError = true)]
		private static extern int UuidCreateSequential(out Guid guid);

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static Guid NewGuidSequential()
		{
			try
			{
				if (Environment.OSVersion.Platform != PlatformID.Win32NT)
				{
					throw new PlatformNotSupportedException();
				}
				if (UuidCreateSequential(out var guid) == 0)
				{
					return guid;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			uuidbroken = true;
			return Guid.NewGuid();
		}

		public static Guid NewGuid()
		{
			if (GuidGenerationMode == GuidGenerationMode.UuidCreateSequential && !uuidbroken)
			{
				return NewGuidSequential();
			}
			if (GuidGenerationMode == GuidGenerationMode.Custom)
			{
				if (CustomGuidGenerationHandler == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("XpoDefault_CustomGuidGenerationHandlerCannotBeNull"));
				}
				return CustomGuidGenerationHandler();
			}
			return Guid.NewGuid();
		}

		private static void GetPoolParameters(ConnectionStringParser helper, ref string plainConnectionString, out bool? pool, out int? poolSize, out int? poolMaxConnections)
		{
			pool = null;
			poolSize = null;
			poolMaxConnections = null;
			string partByName = helper.GetPartByName("XpoDataStorePool");
			string partByName2 = helper.GetPartByName("XpoDataStorePoolSize");
			string partByName3 = helper.GetPartByName("XpoDataStorePoolMaxConnections");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(partByName))
			{
				pool = StringExtensions.CompareInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(partByName, "false") != 0 && StringExtensions.CompareInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(partByName, "disable") != 0 && StringExtensions.CompareInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(partByName, "disabled") != 0 && partByName != "0";
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(partByName2) && int.TryParse(partByName2, out var result))
			{
				poolSize = result;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(partByName3) && int.TryParse(partByName3, out var result2))
			{
				poolMaxConnections = result2;
			}
			if (helper.PartExists("XpoDataStorePool") || helper.PartExists("XpoDataStorePoolSize") || helper.PartExists("XpoDataStorePoolMaxConnections"))
			{
				helper.RemovePartByName("XpoDataStorePool");
				helper.RemovePartByName("XpoDataStorePoolSize");
				helper.RemovePartByName("XpoDataStorePoolMaxConnections");
				plainConnectionString = helper.GetConnectionString();
			}
		}

		public static IDataStore GetConnectionProvider(string connectionString, AutoCreateOption defaultAutoCreateOption, out IDisposable[] objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
				text = null;
			}
			string plainConnectionString = string.Empty;
			GetPoolParameters(val, ref plainConnectionString, out var pool, out var poolSize, out var poolMaxConnections);
			if ((pool.HasValue && pool.Value) || (!pool.HasValue && (poolSize.HasValue || poolMaxConnections.HasValue)))

			}

			{
				text = "MSSqlServer";
			}
			else
			{
				string text2 = val.GetPartByName("Provider").ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				if (text2.IndexOf("microsoft.ace.oledb") < 0 && text2.IndexOf("microsoft.jet.oledb") < 0)
				{

		internal static bool TryResolveAspDataDirectory(ref string filename)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filename) && filename.StartsWith("|DataDirectory|"))
			{
				object data = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetData("DataDirectory");
				string text = data as string;
				if (text == null && data != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					text = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory;
				}
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = "";
				}
				filename = Path.Combine(text, filename.Substring("|DataDirectory|".Length).TrimStart('\\'));
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static int GetTerminalInSize(int size, int parametersPerObject)
		{
			if (parametersPerObject <= 1)
			{
				return GetTerminalInSize(size);
			}
			return GetTerminalInSize(Math.Min(Math.Max(GetTerminalInSize(int.MaxValue) / parametersPerObject, 1), size));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static int GetTerminalInSize(int size)
		{
			if (size <= 16)
			{
				return size;
			}
			int num = terminalInSizes.Length - 1;
			while (size < terminalInSizes[num])
			{
				num--;
			}
			return terminalInSizes[num];
		}
	}

		private class CreateItemCommonKeyComparer : IEqualityComparer<CreateItemCommonKey>
		{
			public bool Equals(CreateItemCommonKey x, CreateItemCommonKey y)
			{
				if (x.Type != y.Type)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.ProjectionSample == y.ProjectionSample)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x.ProjectionSample == null || y.ProjectionSample == null || x.ProjectionSample.Count != y.ProjectionSample.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				int count = x.ProjectionSample.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (!object.Equals(x.ProjectionSample[i], y.ProjectionSample[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			public int GetHashCode(CreateItemCommonKey obj)
			{
				int num = HashCodeHelper.StartGeneric<Type>(obj.Type);
				if (obj.ProjectionSample != null)
				{
					num = HashCodeHelper.CombineGenericList<object>(num, (IList<object>)obj.ProjectionSample);
				}
				return HashCodeHelper.Finish(num);
			}
		}

		private class Resolver : CriteriaTypeResolver, IClientCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>, ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>, ILinqExtendedCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>
		{
			private readonly XPClassInfo classInfo;

			public Resolver(XPClassInfo info)
				: base(info, CriteriaTypeResolveKeyBehavior.AsIs)
			{
				classInfo = info;
			}

			public Resolver(XPClassInfo[] upLevels, XPDictionary dictionary)
				: base(upLevels, dictionary, CriteriaTypeResolveKeyBehavior.AsIs)
			{
				classInfo = upLevels.FirstOrDefault();
			}

			CriteriaTypeResolverResult ILinqExtendedCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>.Visit(MemberInitOperator theOperand)
			{
				//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (!theOperand.CreateNewObject && theOperand.Members.Count == 1)
				{
					CriteriaOperator property = theOperand.Members[0].Property;
					if (IsNull(property))
					{
						return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(typeof(object));
					}
					return property.Accept<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>)this);
				}
				return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(theOperand.GetDeclaringType());
			}

			CriteriaTypeResolverResult ILinqExtendedCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>.Visit(ExpressionAccessOperator theOperand)
			{
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(theOperand.LinqExpression.Type);
			}

			CriteriaTypeResolverResult ILinqExtendedCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>.Visit(QuerySet theOperand)
			{
				//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0094: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (theOperand.IsEmpty)
				{
					return Parser.ThisCriteria.Accept<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>)this);
				}
				if (IsNull(theOperand.Property))
				{
					if (!IsNull(theOperand.Projection))
					{
						return theOperand.Projection.Accept<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>)this);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (IsNull(theOperand.Projection))
					{
						return theOperand.Property.Accept<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>)this);
					}
					MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = MemberInfoCollection.ParsePath(classInfo, theOperand.Property.PropertyName);
					XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1];
					if (xPMemberInfo.IsAssociationList)
					{
						return ((CriteriaTypeResolverBase)new Resolver(xPMemberInfo.CollectionElementType)).Process((CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand.Projection);
					}
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		private class SelectionPropertyPatcher : ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase, ILinqExtendedCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>
		{
			private readonly CriteriaOperatorCollection props;

			private readonly CriteriaOperatorCollection correspondingProps;

			private readonly XPQueryBase owner;

			private bool isRoot = true;

			private SelectionPropertyPatcher(XPQueryBase owner, CriteriaOperatorCollection props, CriteriaOperatorCollection correspondingProps)
			{
				this.props = props;
				this.correspondingProps = correspondingProps;
				this.owner = owner;
			}

			public static void ProcessAndAdd(XPQueryBase owner, CriteriaOperatorCollection props, CriteriaOperatorCollection correspondingProps, CriteriaOperator property)
			{
				//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001b: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (property == null)
				{
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)correspondingProps).Add(property);
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)props).Add((CriteriaOperator)new ConstantValue((object)0));
					return;
				}
				CriteriaOperator val = ((ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase)new SelectionPropertyPatcher(owner, props, correspondingProps)).Process(property);
				if (val != null)
				{
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)correspondingProps).Add(val);
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)props).Add(val);
				}
			}

			private OperandProperty ProcessCollectionProperty(OperandProperty collectionProperty)
			{
				//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001a: Expected O, but got Unknown
				CriteriaOperator val = ((ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase)this).Process((CriteriaOperator)(object)collectionProperty);
				if (val == null || val is OperandProperty)
				{
					return (OperandProperty)val;
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Process within ProcessCollectionProperty expected to return OperandProperty or null; " + ((object)val).GetType().FullName + " (" + ((object)val).ToString() + ") returned instead");
			}

			public override CriteriaOperator Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)
			{
				CriteriaOperator fixedOperand;
				return GoesOutOfRoot<AggregateOperand>((Func<AggregateOperand, CriteriaOperator>)((AggregateOperand op) => (CriteriaOperator)(((int)op.AggregateType != 7) ? (NeedGetOutOfContextUp(((ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase)this).Process(op.AggregatedExpression), out fixedOperand) ? ((object)fixedOperand) : ((object)ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase.NewIfDifferent(op, ProcessCollectionProperty(op.CollectionProperty), fixedOperand, ((ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase)this).Process(op.Condition)))) : ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase.NewIfDifferent(op, ProcessCollectionProperty(op.CollectionProperty), ((ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase)this).Process((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)op.CustomAggregateOperands), ((ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase)this).Process(op.Condition)))), theOperand);
			}

			public override CriteriaOperator Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
			{
				CriteriaOperator fixedOperand;
				return GoesOutOfRoot<JoinOperand>((Func<JoinOperand, CriteriaOperator>)((JoinOperand op) => (CriteriaOperator)(((int)op.AggregateType != 7) ? (NeedGetOutOfContextUp(((ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase)this).Process(op.AggregatedExpression), out fixedOperand) ? ((object)fixedOperand) : ((object)ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase.NewIfDifferent(op, ((ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase)this).Process(op.Condition), fixedOperand))) : ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase.NewIfDifferent(op, ((ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase)this).Process(op.Condition), ((ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase)this).Process((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)op.CustomAggregateOperands)))), theOperand);
			}

			public override CriteriaOperator Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
			{
				return GoesOutOfRoot<FunctionOperator>((Func<FunctionOperator, CriteriaOperator>)((FunctionOperator op) => ((ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase)this).Visit(op)), theOperator);
			}

			public override CriteriaOperator Visit(InOperator theOperator)

			}
