			CriteriaOperator ILinqExtendedCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(MemberInitOperator theOperand)
			{
				if (!isRoot)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ComplexDataSelectionIsNotSupportedPerhapsY"));
				}
				foreach (XPMemberAssignment member in theOperand.Members)
				{
					AddToPropsIfNotProcessed(member.Property);
				}
				return null;
			}

			CriteriaOperator ILinqExtendedCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(ExpressionAccessOperator theOperand)
			{
				if (!isRoot)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ComplexDataSelectionIsNotSupportedPerhapsY"));
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < theOperand.SourceItems.Length; i++)
				{
					AddToPropsIfNotProcessed(theOperand.SourceItems[i]);
				}
				return null;
			}

			CriteriaOperator ILinqExtendedCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(QuerySet theOperand)
			{
				if (theOperand is GroupSet)
				{
					if (!isRoot)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ComplexDataSelectionIsNotSupportedPerhapsY"));
					}
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)correspondingProps).Add((CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand);
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)props).AddRange((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)owner.GetGrouping());
					return null;
				}
				if (!IsNull(theOperand.Property) && theOperand.Property.PropertyName == "^" && IsNull(theOperand.Projection) && IsNull(theOperand.Condition))
				{
					OperandProperty upThisCriteria = Parser.UpThisCriteria;
					if (isRoot)
					{
						((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)correspondingProps).Add((CriteriaOperator)(object)upThisCriteria);
						((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)props).Add((CriteriaOperator)(object)upThisCriteria);
						return null;
					}
					return (CriteriaOperator)(object)upThisCriteria;
				}
				if (theOperand is FreeQuerySet || (!IsNull(theOperand.Projection) && !IsNull(theOperand.Property)) || (!isRoot && !IsNull(theOperand.Property)))
				{
					CriteriaOperator property;
					if (IsNull(theOperand.Projection))
					{
						property = (CriteriaOperator)(object)Parser.ThisCriteria;
					}
					else if (!theOperand.TryGetProjectionSingleProperty(out property))
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ComplexDataSelectionIsNotSupportedPerhapsY"));
					}
					property = GoesOutOfRoot<CriteriaOperator>((Func<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator>)((CriteriaOperator op) => ((ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase)this).Process(op)), property);
					CriteriaOperator val = ((!NeedGetOutOfContextUp(property, out property)) ? theOperand.CreateCriteriaOperator(property, (Aggregate)6) : property);
					if (isRoot)
					{
						((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)correspondingProps).Add(val);
						((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)props).Add(val);
						return null;
					}
					return val;
				}
				if ((!theOperand.IsEmpty && IsNull(theOperand.Property)) || !IsNull(theOperand.Condition))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ComplexDataSelectionIsNotSupportedPerhapsY"));
				}
				if (isRoot)
				{
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)correspondingProps).Add((CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand);
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)props).Add((CriteriaOperator)(object)Parser.ThisCriteria);
					return null;
				}
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)Parser.ThisCriteria;
			}

			private bool NeedGetOutOfContextUp(CriteriaOperator theOperand, out CriteriaOperator fixedOperand)
			{
				//IL_0120: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0126: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0100: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_010a: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_01b3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_01ca: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_01c5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_01cb: Expected O, but got Unknown
				fixedOperand = theOperand;
				OperandProperty val = (OperandProperty)(object)((theOperand is OperandProperty) ? theOperand : null);
				if (!IsNull(val) && !IsNull(val.PropertyName) && val.PropertyName == Parser.UpThisCriteria.PropertyName)
				{
					fixedOperand = (CriteriaOperator)(object)Parser.ThisCriteria;
					return true;
				}
				QuerySet querySet = theOperand as QuerySet;
				if (!IsNull(querySet))
				{
					if (querySet is FreeQuerySet || IsNull(querySet.Property) || IsNull(querySet.Property.PropertyName))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (querySet.Property.PropertyName == "^")
					{
						fixedOperand = (CriteriaOperator)(object)new QuerySet
						{
							Projection = querySet.Projection,
							Condition = querySet.Condition,
							Property = null
						};
						return true;
					}
					if (querySet.Property.PropertyName.StartsWith("^."))
					{
						fixedOperand = (CriteriaOperator)(object)new QuerySet
						{
							Projection = querySet.Projection,
							Condition = querySet.Condition,
							Property = new OperandProperty(querySet.Property.PropertyName.Substring(2))
						};
						return true;
					}
				}
				AggregateOperand val2 = (AggregateOperand)(object)((theOperand is AggregateOperand) ? theOperand : null);
				if (!IsNull(val2) && (int)val2.AggregateType == 6)
				{
					if (IsNull(val2.CollectionProperty) || IsNull(val2.CollectionProperty.PropertyName))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (val2.CollectionProperty.PropertyName == "^")
					{
						if (!IsNull(val2.Condition))
						{
							throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ComplexDataSelectionIsNotSupportedPerhapsY"));
						}
						fixedOperand = val2.AggregatedExpression;
						return true;
					}
					if (val2.CollectionProperty.PropertyName.StartsWith("^."))
					{
						fixedOperand = (CriteriaOperator)new AggregateOperand(new OperandProperty(val2.CollectionProperty.PropertyName.Substring(2)), val2.AggregatedExpression, (Aggregate)6, val2.Condition);
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
			{
				if (isRoot && theOperand is ConstantCompiler)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return GoesOutOfRoot<OperandValue>((Func<OperandValue, CriteriaOperator>)((OperandValue op) => ((ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase)this).Visit(op)), theOperand);
			}

			private CriteriaOperator GoesOutOfRoot<T>(Func<T, CriteriaOperator> work, T operand) where T : CriteriaOperator
			{
				bool flag = isRoot;
				try
				{
					isRoot = false;
					return work(operand);
				}
				finally
				{
					isRoot = flag;
				}
			}

			private void AddToPropsIfNotProcessed(CriteriaOperator source)
			{
				if (!IsNull(source))
				{
					CriteriaOperator val = ((ClientCriteriaLazyPatcherBase)this).Process(source);
					if (!IsNull(val))
					{
						((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)correspondingProps).Add(val);
						((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)props).Add(val);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private class GroupCollection<TKey, TElement> : XPQuery<TElement>, IGrouping<TKey, TElement>, IEnumerable<TElement>, IEnumerable

			public GroupCollection(TKey key, XPQueryBase parent, CriteriaOperatorCollection props, MemberInitOperator projection, object[] row)
				: base(parent.session, parent.session.DataLayer, parent.session.Dictionary)
			{
				//IL_0083: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_008e: Expected O, but got Unknown

				//IL_0093: Expected O, but got Unknown

				query.ObjectTypeName = parent.query.ObjectTypeName;
				objectClassInfo = parent.objectClassInfo;
				List<CriteriaOperator> list = new List<CriteriaOperator> { parent.Criteria };

					list.Add((CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator(((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)props)[i], (CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue(row[i]), (BinaryOperatorType)0));
				}
				base.Criteria = CriteriaOperator.And(list.ToArray());
				query.Projection = projection;
			}
		}

		private IDataLayer GetLayer()

			if (session == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_SessionIsNull"));
			}
			return layer;
		}

		object IPersistentValueExtractor.ExtractPersistentValue(object criterionValue)
		{
			if (Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(criterionValue) != null)
			{
				throw new CannotResolveClassInfoException((criterionValue == null) ? "null" : criterionValue.GetType().AssemblyQualifiedName, (criterionValue == null) ? "null" : criterionValue.GetType().FullName);
			}
			return criterionValue;
		}

		private List<object[]> SessionSelectData(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, CriteriaOperator criteria, CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties, CriteriaOperator groupCriteria, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords, SortingCollection sorting)
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (groupProperties != null)
			{
				groupProperties = new CriteriaOperatorCollection(((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)groupProperties).Where((CriteriaOperator x) => !CriteriaProcessingExtensions.Is<OperandValue>(x)));
			}
			properties = XPQueryExecutePreprocessor.Preprocess(properties);
			criteria = XPQueryExecutePreprocessor.Preprocess(criteria);
			groupProperties = XPQueryExecutePreprocessor.Preprocess(groupProperties);
			groupCriteria = XPQueryExecutePreprocessor.Preprocess(groupCriteria);
			sorting = XPQueryExecutePreprocessor.Preprocess(sorting);
			if (InTransaction)
			{
				return GetSession().SelectDataInTransaction(classInfo, properties, criteria, groupProperties, groupCriteria, WithDeleted, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, sorting);
			}
			if (layer != null)
			{
				if (WithDeleted)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_WithDeletedOptionNotSupported"));
				}
				List<object[]> list = Session.PrepareSelectDataInternal(classInfo, ref properties, ref criteria, ref groupProperties, ref groupCriteria, ref sorting, doDetectPostProcessing: true, this);
				if (list != null)
				{
					return list;
				}
				return SimpleObjectLayer.SelectDataInternal(layer, new ObjectsQuery(classInfo, criteria, sorting, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, null, force: true), properties, groupProperties, groupCriteria);
			}
			return GetSession().SelectData(classInfo, properties, criteria, groupProperties, groupCriteria, WithDeleted, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, sorting);
		}

		private object SessionEvaluate(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperator expression, CriteriaOperator condition)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0019: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CriteriaOperatorCollection val = new CriteriaOperatorCollection();
			((List<CriteriaOperator>)val).Add(expression);
			List<object[]> list = SessionSelectData(classInfo, val, condition, null, null, 0, 1, null);
			if (list != null && list.Count != 0 && list[0] != null && list[0].Length != 0)
			{
				return list[0][0];
			}
			return null;
		}

		private async Task<object> SessionEvaluateAsync(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperator expression, CriteriaOperator condition, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{

			List<object[]> list = await xPQueryBase.SessionSelectDataAsync(classInfo, val, condition, null, null, 0, 1, null, cancellationToken);
			return (list == null || list.Count == 0 || list[0] == null || list[0].Length == 0) ? null : list[0][0];
		}

		protected XPQueryBase(XPQueryBase baseQuery)
			: this(baseQuery.Session, baseQuery.layer, baseQuery.Dictionary)

			create = baseQuery.create;
		}

		protected XPQueryBase(XPQueryBase baseQuery, bool? inTransaction = null, bool? withDeleted = null)
			: this(baseQuery)
		{
			if (inTransaction.HasValue)
			{
				InTransaction = inTransaction.Value;
			}
			if (withDeleted.HasValue)
			{
				WithDeleted = withDeleted.Value;
			}
		}

		protected XPQueryBase(XPQueryBase baseQuery, CustomCriteriaCollection customCriteriaCollection)
			: this(baseQuery)
		{
			if (this.customCriteriaCollection == null)

				this.customCriteriaCollection = customCriteriaCollection;
			}
			else
			{
				((CustomDictionaryCollection<MethodInfo, ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable>)this.customCriteriaCollection).Add((IEnumerable<ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable>)customCriteriaCollection);
			}
		}

		internal static CriteriaOperator GetFreeQuerySet(XPQueryBase query)
		{
			if (query.IsGroup || query.Skip > 0 || query.Top > 0)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_X0WithSkipOrTakeOrGroupingIsNotSupported", "Subquery"));
			}
			if (!IsNull(query.Projection))
			{
				if (query.Projection.CreateNewObject || query.Projection.Members.Count > 1)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ComplexDataSelectionIsNotSupportedPerhapsY"));
				}
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)new FreeQuerySet(query.ObjectClassInfo.ClassType, query.Criteria)
				{
					Projection = query.Projection
				};
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)new FreeQuerySet(query.ObjectClassInfo.ClassType, query.Criteria);
		}

		public string Serialize()
		{
			using StringWriter stringWriter = new StringWriter();
			SafeXml.Serialize<XPQueryData>((TextWriter)stringWriter, (object)query, (Type[])null);
			return stringWriter.ToString();
		}

		protected internal void Call(MethodCallExpression call, XPQueryBase prev)
		{
			Assign(prev);
			Call(call);
		}

		protected void Assign(XPQueryBase prev)
		{
			Criteria = prev.Criteria;
			for (int i = 0; i < prev.Sorting.Count; i++)
			{
				Sorting.Add(prev.Sorting[i]);
			}
			Projection = prev.Projection;
			GroupCriteria = prev.GroupCriteria;
			query.ObjectTypeName = prev.query.ObjectTypeName;
			objectClassInfo = prev.objectClassInfo;
			Top = prev.Top;
			Skip = prev.Skip;
			GroupKey = prev.GroupKey;
			InTransaction = prev.InTransaction;
			WithDeleted = prev.WithDeleted;
			ExistingJoins = ((prev.ExistingJoins == null) ? null : new HashSet<CriteriaOperator>(prev.ExistingJoins));
			customCriteriaCollection = prev.CustomCriteriaCollection;
		}

		protected static bool IsNull(object val)
		{
			return val == null;
		}

		private CriteriaOperator ParseExpression(Expression expression, params CriteriaOperator[] maps)
		{
			return Parser.ParseExpression(ObjectClassInfo, customCriteriaCollection, expression, maps);
		}

		private CriteriaOperator ParseObjectExpression(Expression expression, params CriteriaOperator[] maps)
		{
			return Parser.ParseObjectExpression(ObjectClassInfo, customCriteriaCollection, expression, maps);
		}

		private void Call(MethodCallExpression call)
		{
			switch (call.Method.Name)
			{
			case "Where":
				Where(call);
				break;
			case "OrderBy":
				Order(call, thenBy: false, (SortingDirection)0);
				break;
			case "ThenBy":
				Order(call, thenBy: true, (SortingDirection)0);
				break;
			case "OrderByDescending":
				Order(call, thenBy: false, (SortingDirection)1);
				break;
			case "ThenByDescending":
				Order(call, thenBy: true, (SortingDirection)1);
				break;
			case "Reverse":
				Reverse();
				break;
			case "Select":
				Select(call);
				break;
			case "Distinct":
				Distinct(call);
				break;
			case "GroupBy":
				GroupBy(call);
				break;
			case "Take":
				Take(call);
				break;
			case "Skip":
				SkipFn(call);
				break;
			case "Join":
				Join(call, groupJoin: false);
				break;
			case "GroupJoin":
				Join(call, groupJoin: true);
				break;
			case "OfType":
				OfType(call);
				break;
			case "SelectMany":
				SelectMany(call);
				break;
			case "Intersect":
				Intersect(call);
				break;
			case "Union":
				Union(call);
				break;
			case "SkipWhile":
			case "TakeWhile":
			case "DefaultIfEmpty":
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_TheX0MethodIsNotSupported", call.Method.Name));
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException(call.Method.Name);
			case "Cast":
				break;
			}
		}

		protected bool CanIntersect()
		{
			if (!Top.HasValue && !Skip.HasValue && Sorting.Count == 0 && IsNull(Projection))
			{
				return !IsGroup;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void Union(MethodCallExpression call)
		{
			XPQueryBase xPQueryBase = (XPQueryBase)((ConstantExpression)call.Arguments[1]).Value;
			if (IsNull(Criteria) || IsNull(xPQueryBase.Criteria))
			{
				Criteria = null;
			}
			else
			{
				Criteria = CriteriaOperator.Or(Criteria, xPQueryBase.Criteria);
			}
		}

		private void Intersect(MethodCallExpression call)
		{
			XPQueryBase xPQueryBase = (XPQueryBase)((ConstantExpression)call.Arguments[1]).Value;
			Criteria = CriteriaOperator.And(Criteria, xPQueryBase.Criteria);
		}

		private void SelectMany(MethodCallExpression call)
		{
			//IL_00eb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f2: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0447: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0451: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0428: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0432: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_04ea: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_04f4: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_04ef: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_04f5: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0519: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_051f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0527: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_052d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_052d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0537: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0566: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_056d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (IsGroup || Top.HasValue || Skip.HasValue)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_X0WithSkipOrTakeOrGroupingIsNotSupported", "SelectMany"));
			}
			if (call.Arguments.Count < 2)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_X0WithSoManyParametersIsNotSupported", "SelectMany"));
			}
			CriteriaOperator val = ParseExpression(call.Arguments[1], ParseExpression(call.Arguments[0]));
			QuerySet querySet = val as QuerySet;
			if (call.Arguments.Count == 3)
			{
				CriteriaOperator val2 = val;
				if (!IsNull(querySet) && !querySet.IsEmpty)
				{
					CriteriaOperator property;
					if (IsNull(querySet.Projection))
					{
						property = (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty("This");
					}
					else if (!querySet.TryGetProjectionSingleProperty(out property))
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ExpressionX0IsNotSupportedInX1", call.Arguments[1], "SelectMany"));
					}
					FreeQuerySet freeQuerySet = querySet as FreeQuerySet;
					if (IsNull(freeQuerySet))
					{
						if (IsNull(querySet.Property))
						{
							throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ExpressionX0IsNotSupportedInX1", call.Arguments[1], "SelectMany"));
						}
						val2 = querySet.CreateCriteriaOperator(property, (Aggregate)6);
					}
					else
					{
						val2 = freeQuerySet.CreateCriteriaOperator(property, (Aggregate)6);
					}
				}
				CriteriaOperator val3 = ParseExpression(call.Arguments[2], Projection, val2);
				if (val3 is QuerySet || val3 is IAggregateOperand)
				{
					Projection = MemberInitOperator.CreateUntypedMemberInitOperator(val3);
					return;
				}
				MemberInitOperator memberInitOperator = val3 as MemberInitOperator;
				if (!IsNull(memberInitOperator))
				{
					Projection = memberInitOperator;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (IsNull(querySet) && !Parser.TryConvertToQuerySet(val, ObjectClassInfo, out querySet))
			{
				MemberInitOperator memberInitOperator2 = val as MemberInitOperator;
				if (!IsNull(memberInitOperator2))
				{
					Projection = memberInitOperator2;
					return;
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ExpressionX0IsNotSupportedInX1", call.Arguments[1], "SelectMany"));
			}
			if (call.Arguments.Count != 2)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_X0WithSoManyParametersIsNotSupported", "SelectMany"));
			}
			if (IsNull(querySet.Property))
			{
				FreeQuerySet freeQuerySet2 = querySet as FreeQuerySet;
				if (!IsNull(freeQuerySet2))

					{
						foreach (XPMemberAssignment member in freeQuerySet2.Projection.Members)
						{
							member.Property = freeQuerySet2.CreateCriteriaOperator(member.Property, (Aggregate)6);
						}
						Projection = freeQuerySet2.Projection;
					}
					else
					{
						Projection = MemberInitOperator.CreateUntypedMemberInitOperator((CriteriaOperator)(object)freeQuerySet2);
					}
					return;
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ExpressionX0IsNotSupportedInX1", call.Arguments[1], "SelectMany"));
			}
			MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = MemberInfoCollection.ParsePersistentPath(ObjectClassInfo, querySet.Property.PropertyName);
			if (memberInfoCollection.Count != 1 || !memberInfoCollection[0].IsAssociationList)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ExpressionX0IsNotSupportedInX1", call.Arguments[1], "SelectMany"));
			}
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = objectClassInfo;
			objectClassInfo = memberInfoCollection[0].CollectionElementType;
			XPMemberInfo associatedMember = memberInfoCollection[0].GetAssociatedMember();
			string name = associatedMember.Name;
			if (memberInfoCollection[0].IsManyToManyAlias || memberInfoCollection[0].IsManyToMany)
			{
				if (xPClassInfo != associatedMember.CollectionElementType)
				{
					Criteria = CriteriaOperator.And(Criteria, (CriteriaOperator)new FunctionOperator("IsInstanceOfType", (CriteriaOperator[])(object)new CriteriaOperator[2]
					{
						(CriteriaOperator)Parser.ThisCriteria,
						CriteriaOperator.op_Implicit(xPClassInfo.FullName)
					}));
				}
				Criteria = CriteriaOperator.And(querySet.Condition, (CriteriaOperator)new AggregateOperand(name, (Aggregate)0, Criteria));
				Projection = querySet.Projection;
				if (Sorting == null || Sorting.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_SortingIsNotSupportedForSelectManyOperatio"));
			}
			bool flag = associatedMember.ReferenceType != null && xPClassInfo != associatedMember.ReferenceType;
			string p = (flag ? $"{name}.<{xPClassInfo.FullName}>" : name);

			{
				querySet.Condition,
				PatchParentCriteria(Criteria, p),
				(CriteriaOperator)new NotOperator((CriteriaOperator)new NullOperator(name))
			});
			if (flag)
			{
				Criteria = CriteriaOperator.And(Criteria, (CriteriaOperator)new FunctionOperator("IsInstanceOfType", (CriteriaOperator[])(object)new CriteriaOperator[2]
				{
					(CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(name),
					(CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue((object)xPClassInfo.FullName)
				}));
			}
			Projection = querySet.Projection;
			if (Sorting == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SortProperty item in Sorting)
			{
				SortProperty val4 = item;
				val4.Property = PatchParentCriteria(val4.Property, p);
			}
		}

		private CriteriaOperator PatchParentCriteria(CriteriaOperator criteria, string p)
		{
			return PersistentCriterionExpander.Prefix(p, criteria);
		}

		private void OfType(MethodCallExpression call)
		{
			Type classType = call.Method.GetGenericArguments()[0];
			XPClassInfo classInfo = Dictionary.GetClassInfo(classType);
			if (!classInfo.IsAssignableTo(objectClassInfo))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			objectClassInfo = classInfo;
			query.ObjectTypeName = objectClassInfo.FullName;
		}

		private void Join(MethodCallExpression call, bool groupJoin)
		{
			//IL_0180: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0190: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CriteriaOperator val = ParseExpression(call.Arguments[2], Projection);
			XPQueryBase xPQueryBase = ((ConstantExpression)call.Arguments[1]).Value as XPQueryBase;
			if ((xPQueryBase.Top.HasValue && xPQueryBase.Top.Value > 0) || (xPQueryBase.Skip.HasValue && xPQueryBase.Skip.Value > 0))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_QueryWithAppliedTheSkipOrTheTakeOperations"));
			}
			Type classType = xPQueryBase.ObjectClassInfo.ClassType;
			CriteriaOperator val2 = xPQueryBase.ParseExpression(call.Arguments[3], xPQueryBase.Projection);
			if (IsNull(val))
			{
				OperandProperty val3 = (OperandProperty)(object)((val2 is OperandProperty) ? val2 : null);
				if (IsNull(val3))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ExpressionX0IsNotSupportedInX1", call.Arguments[3], "Join"));
				}
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = Dictionary.GetClassInfo(classType).FindMember(val3.PropertyName);
				if (xPMemberInfo == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ExpressionX0IsNotSupportedInX1", call.Arguments[3], "Join"));
				}
				MemberInitOperator projection = (MemberInitOperator)(object)ParseExpression(call.Arguments[4], Projection, new QuerySet(new OperandProperty(xPMemberInfo.GetAssociatedMember().Name), xPQueryBase.Criteria));
				Projection = projection;
				return;
			}
			FreeQuerySet freeQuerySet = new FreeQuerySet(classType, val, val2, xPQueryBase.Criteria);
			freeQuerySet.Projection = xPQueryBase.Projection;
			CriteriaOperator val4 = ParseExpression(call.Arguments[4], Projection, freeQuerySet);
			if (!(val4 is MemberInitOperator memberInitOperator))
			{
				if (!(val4 is QuerySet querySet))
				{
					XPMemberAssignmentCollection xPMemberAssignmentCollection = new XPMemberAssignmentCollection();
					xPMemberAssignmentCollection.Add(new XPMemberAssignment(val4));

		protected object Execute(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression.NodeType == ExpressionType.Call)
			{
				MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = (MethodCallExpression)expression;
				if (methodCallExpression.Method.DeclaringType != typeof(Queryable) && methodCallExpression.Method.DeclaringType != typeof(Enumerable))
				{
					ICustomAggregate customAggregate = GetCustomAggregate(methodCallExpression.Method.Name);
					if (IsValidCustomAggregateQueryable(methodCallExpression, customAggregate))
					{
						return AggregateCall(methodCallExpression);
					}
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_IncorrectDeclaringTypeX0InTheMethodCallQue", methodCallExpression.Method.DeclaringType));
				}
				switch (methodCallExpression.Method.Name)
				{
				case "Count":
					return Count(methodCallExpression);
				case "LongCount":
					return LongCount(methodCallExpression);
				case "Min":
				case "Max":
				case "Sum":
					return AggregateCall(methodCallExpression);
				case "Contains":
					return Contains(methodCallExpression);
				case "Average":
					return Average(methodCallExpression);
				case "FirstOrDefault":
					return ExecuteSingle(methodCallExpression, allowDefault: true, SortAction.Sort);
				case "First":
					return ExecuteSingle(methodCallExpression, allowDefault: false, SortAction.Sort);
				case "Single":
					return ExecuteSingle(methodCallExpression, allowDefault: false, SortAction.None);
				case "SingleOrDefault":
					return ExecuteSingle(methodCallExpression, allowDefault: true, SortAction.None);
				case "Last":
					return ExecuteSingle(methodCallExpression, allowDefault: false, SortAction.Reverse);
				case "LastOrDefault":
					return ExecuteSingle(methodCallExpression, allowDefault: true, SortAction.Reverse);
				case "All":
					return All(methodCallExpression);
				case "Any":
					return Any(methodCallExpression);
				case "ElementAt":
					return ExecuteElementAt(methodCallExpression, allowDefault: false);
				case "ElementAtOrDefault":
					return ExecuteElementAt(methodCallExpression, allowDefault: true);
				case "Aggregate":
				case "SequenceEqual":
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_TheX0MethodIsNotSupported", methodCallExpression.Method.Name));
				default:
					throw new ArgumentException(methodCallExpression.Method.Name);
				}
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

				case "Min":
				case "Max":
				case "Sum":
					return await AggregateCallAsync(methodCallExpression, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);

					return await AverageAsync(methodCallExpression, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				case "FirstOrDefault":

				case "First":
					return await ExecuteSingleAsync(methodCallExpression, allowDefault: false, SortAction.Sort, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				case "Single":
					return await ExecuteSingleAsync(methodCallExpression, allowDefault: false, SortAction.None, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				case "SingleOrDefault":
					return await ExecuteSingleAsync(methodCallExpression, allowDefault: true, SortAction.None, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);

				default:
					throw new ArgumentException(methodCallExpression.Method.Name);
				}
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		internal ICustomAggregate GetCustomAggregate(string customAggregateName)
		{
			ICustomAggregate customAggregate = Dictionary.CustomAggregates.GetCustomAggregate(customAggregateName);
			if (customAggregate == null && CriteriaOperator.CustomAggregateCount > 0)
			{
				return CriteriaOperator.GetCustomAggregate(customAggregateName);
			}
			return customAggregate;
		}

		private static bool IsValidCustomAggregateQueryable(MethodCallExpression call, ICustomAggregate customAggregate)
		{
			if (!(customAggregate is ICustomAggregateQueryable customAggregateQueryable))
			{
				return false;
			}
			MethodInfo methodInfo = customAggregateQueryable.GetMethodInfo();
			if (methodInfo.Name == call.Method.Name && methodInfo.DeclaringType == call.Method.DeclaringType)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private object AggregateCall(MethodCallExpression call)
		{
			if (IsGroup)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_X0OverGroupingIsNotSupported", call.Method.Name));
			}
			if (Top.HasValue || Skip.HasValue)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_X0OperatorAfterSkipOrTakeIsNotSupported", call.Method.Name));
			}
			CriteriaOperator val = ParseExpression(call);
			object obj = SessionEvaluate(ObjectClassInfo, val, Criteria);
			ValueConverter valueConverter = new PropertyValueConverterFinder(ObjectClassInfo).Process(val);
			if (valueConverter == null)
			{
				if (call.Type == typeof(TimeSpan) && obj is long && GetTimeOfDayValueFinder.TryToFind(val))
				{
					return new TimeSpan((long)obj);
				}
				valueConverter = Dictionary.GetConverter(call.Type);
			}
			if (valueConverter != null)
			{
				return valueConverter.ConvertFromStorageType(obj);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		private object Average(MethodCallExpression call)
		{
			object obj = AggregateCall(call);
			IConvertible convertible = obj as IConvertible;
			if (obj != null && convertible == null && obj.GetType() != call.Type)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (convertible == null)
			{
				return obj;
			}
			return convertible.ToType(call.Type, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		private async Task<object> AverageAsync(MethodCallExpression call, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			object obj = await AggregateCallAsync(call, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			IConvertible convertible = obj as IConvertible;
			if (obj != null && convertible == null && obj.GetType() != call.Type)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			return (convertible != null) ? convertible.ToType(call.Type, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : obj;
		}

		private void ParseSingleCallArgs(MethodCallExpression call, bool allowDefault, out CriteriaOperator condition, out object defaultValue)
		{
			condition = null;

					condition = ParseExpression(call.Arguments[1], Projection);
					TryParseValue(call.Arguments[2], out defaultValue);
				}
				else if (!allowDefault || !call.Type.IsAssignableFrom(call.Arguments[1].Type) || !TryParseValue(call.Arguments[1], out defaultValue))
				{
					condition = ParseExpression(call.Arguments[1], Projection);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void DivePropertyName(Stack<XPClassInfo> classInfoStack, ref string propertyName, ref XPClassInfo classInfo, bool throwOnEmptyStack = true)
		{
			while (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName) && (propertyName.StartsWith("^.") || propertyName == "^"))
			{
				if (classInfoStack.Count < 2)
				{
					if (!throwOnEmptyStack)
					{
						break;
					}
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				classInfoStack.Pop();
				propertyName = ((propertyName == "^") ? "This" : propertyName.Substring(2));
			}
			classInfo = classInfoStack.Peek();
		}

		private static Expression ConvertToType(Expression exp, Type targetType, Type sourceType)
		{
			Type type = exp.Type;
			if (sourceType == null)
			{
				if (!(type == targetType))
				{
					return Expression.Convert(exp, targetType);
				}
				return exp;
			}
			Expression expression;
			if (!type.IsValueType && sourceType.IsValueType && Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(targetType) == null)
			{
				sourceType = NullableHelpers.GetBoxedType(sourceType);
				expression = Expression.Condition(Expression.Equal(exp, Expression.Constant(null)), Expression.Default(sourceType), Expression.Convert(exp, sourceType));
			}
			else if (type.IsValueType || !sourceType.IsValueType || !(exp.Type == typeof(object)))
			{
				expression = ((!(type != sourceType)) ? exp : Expression.Convert(exp, sourceType));
			}
			else
			{
				if (Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(targetType) != null)
				{
					if (targetType != sourceType)
					{
						return Expression.Condition(Expression.Equal(exp, Expression.Constant(null)), Expression.Constant(null, targetType), Expression.Convert(Expression.Convert(exp, sourceType), targetType));
					}
					return Expression.Condition(Expression.Equal(exp, Expression.Constant(null)), Expression.Constant(null, sourceType), Expression.Convert(exp, sourceType));
				}
				expression = Expression.Condition(Expression.Equal(exp, Expression.Constant(null)), Expression.Default(sourceType), Expression.Convert(exp, sourceType));
			}
			if (targetType != sourceType)
			{
				Expression expression2 = ElementwiseConversion(expression, targetType);
				expression = ((expression2 != null) ? expression2 : ((sourceType == typeof(long) && targetType == typeof(TimeSpan)) ? Expression.Call(typeof(TimeSpan), "FromTicks", null, expression) : ((!(sourceType == typeof(double)) || !(targetType == typeof(TimeSpan))) ? ((Expression)Expression.Convert(expression, targetType)) : ((Expression)Expression.Call(typeof(TimeSpan), "FromSeconds", null, expression)))));
			}
			return expression;
		}

		}

		private Expression GetArrayIndexExpression(ParameterExpression row, int rowIndex, Type sourceType)
		{
			BinaryExpression binaryExpression = Expression.ArrayIndex(row, Expression.Constant(rowIndex));
			ValueConverter converter = Dictionary.GetConverter(sourceType);
			if (converter != null)
			{
				return Expression.Condition(Expression.TypeIs(binaryExpression, converter.StorageType), Expression.Call(Expression.Constant(converter), "ConvertFromStorageType", null, binaryExpression), binaryExpression);
			}
			return binaryExpression;
		}

		private Expression CreateSubItemCore(Type subType, MemberInitOperator last, CriteriaTypeResolver resolver, ParameterExpression row, ref int rowIndex)
		{
			if (subType == null)
			{
				subType = last.GetDeclaringType();
			}
			if (last.CreateNewObject)
			{
				Type declaringType = last.GetDeclaringType();
				if (subType != declaringType && subType.IsAssignableFrom(declaringType))
				{
					subType = declaringType;
				}
				if (last.UseConstructor)
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = last.GetConstructor(subType);
					ParameterInfo[] parameters = constructor.GetParameters();
					Type[] sourceTypes = last.GetSourceTypes(subType, resolver);
					List<Expression> list = new List<Expression>(parameters.Length);
					int num = -1;
					for (int i = 0; i < parameters.Length; i++)
					{
						if (parameters[i].ParameterType.IsArray && parameters[i].GetCustomAttribute<ParamArrayAttribute>() != null && (!sourceTypes[i].IsArray || !parameters[i].ParameterType.GetElementType().IsAssignableFrom(sourceTypes[i].GetElementType())))
						{
							num = i;
							break;
						}
						CriteriaOperator property = last.Members[i].Property;
						if (property is MemberInitOperator)
						{
							list.Add(CreateSubItemCore(sourceTypes[i], (MemberInitOperator)(object)property, resolver, row, ref rowIndex));
						}
						else if (property is ExpressionAccessOperator)
						{
							list.Add(CreateSubItemCore(sourceTypes[i], (ExpressionAccessOperator)(object)property, resolver, row, ref rowIndex));
						}
						else if (property is ConstantCompiler)
						{
							Expression expression = ((ConstantCompiler)(object)property).Expression;
							list.Add(ConvertToType(expression, expression.Type, sourceTypes[i]));
						}
						else
						{
							list.Add(ConvertToType(GetArrayIndexExpression(row, rowIndex++, sourceTypes[i]), parameters[i].ParameterType, sourceTypes[i]));
						}
					}
					if (num != -1)
					{
						List<Expression> list2 = new List<Expression>(last.Members.Count - num);
						Type elementType = parameters[num].ParameterType.GetElementType();
						for (int j = num; j < last.Members.Count; j++)
						{
							CriteriaOperator property2 = last.Members[j].Property;
							if (property2 is MemberInitOperator)
							{
								list2.Add(CreateSubItemCore(sourceTypes[j], (MemberInitOperator)(object)property2, resolver, row, ref rowIndex));
							}
							else if (property2 is ExpressionAccessOperator)
							{
								list2.Add(CreateSubItemCore(sourceTypes[j], (ExpressionAccessOperator)(object)property2, resolver, row, ref rowIndex));
							}
							else if (property2 is ConstantCompiler)
							{
								Expression expression2 = ((ConstantCompiler)(object)property2).Expression;
								list2.Add(ConvertToType(expression2, expression2.Type, sourceTypes[j]));
							}
							else
							{
								list2.Add(ConvertToType(GetArrayIndexExpression(row, rowIndex++, sourceTypes[j]), elementType, sourceTypes[j]));
							}
						}
						list.Add(Expression.NewArrayInit(elementType, list2));
					}
					return Expression.New(constructor, list);
				}
				MemberInfo[] array = new MemberInfo[last.Members.Count];
				Type[] sourceTypes2 = last.GetSourceTypes(subType, resolver);
				for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
				{
					array[k] = last.Members[k].GetMember(subType);
				}
				MemberBinding[] array2 = new MemberBinding[array.Length];
				for (int l = 0; l < array.Length; l++)
				{
					CriteriaOperator property3 = last.Members[l].Property;
					if (property3 is MemberInitOperator)
					{
						array2[l] = Expression.Bind(array[l], CreateSubItemCore(sourceTypes2[l], (MemberInitOperator)(object)property3, resolver, row, ref rowIndex));
					}
					else if (property3 is ExpressionAccessOperator)
					{
						array2[l] = Expression.Bind(array[l], CreateSubItemCore(sourceTypes2[l], (ExpressionAccessOperator)(object)property3, resolver, row, ref rowIndex));
					}
					else if (property3 is ConstantCompiler)
					{
						Expression expression3 = ((ConstantCompiler)(object)property3).Expression;
						array2[l] = Expression.Bind(array[l], ConvertToType(expression3, expression3.Type, sourceTypes2[l]));
					}
					else
					{
						array2[l] = Expression.Bind(array[l], ConvertToType(GetArrayIndexExpression(row, rowIndex++, sourceTypes2[l]), MemberInitOperator.GetMemberType(array[l]), sourceTypes2[l]));
					}
				}
				return Expression.MemberInit(Expression.New(subType), array2);
			}
			bool flag = (subType == typeof(byte[]) || !subType.IsArray) && last.Members.Count == 1;
			Type type = (flag ? subType : subType.GetElementType());
			Type[] sourceTypes3 = last.GetSourceTypes(subType, resolver);
			Expression[] array3 = new Expression[last.Members.Count];
			for (int m = 0; m < last.Members.Count; m++)
			{
				CriteriaOperator property4 = last.Members[m].Property;
				if (property4 is MemberInitOperator)
				{
					array3[m] = CreateSubItemCore(sourceTypes3[m], (MemberInitOperator)(object)last.Members[m].Property, resolver, row, ref rowIndex);
				}
				else if (property4 is ExpressionAccessOperator)
				{
					array3[m] = CreateSubItemCore(sourceTypes3[m], (ExpressionAccessOperator)(object)property4, resolver, row, ref rowIndex);
				}
				else if (property4 is ConstantCompiler)
				{
					Expression expression4 = ((ConstantCompiler)(object)property4).Expression;
					array3[m] = ConvertToType(expression4, expression4.Type, sourceTypes3[m]);
				}
				else
				{
					array3[m] = ConvertToType(GetArrayIndexExpression(row, rowIndex++, sourceTypes3[m]), type, sourceTypes3[m]);
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return Expression.NewArrayInit(type, array3);
			}
			return array3[0];
		}

		private static Expression[] GetArgumentExpressions(Expression[] init, MethodInfo method, bool shiftArguments, bool isLifted)
		{
			ParameterInfo[] array = ((method == null) ? null : method.GetParameters());
			Expression[] array2 = new Expression[shiftArguments ? (init.Length - 1) : init.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				Expression expression = init[shiftArguments ? (i + 1) : i];
				if (array == null)
				{
					array2[i] = expression;
					continue;
				}
				Type parameterType = array[i].ParameterType;
				parameterType = ((isLifted && !NullableHelpers.CanAcceptNull(parameterType)) ? NullableHelpers.MakeNullableType(parameterType) : parameterType);
				array2[i] = ((parameterType != expression.Type) ? Expression.Convert(expression, parameterType) : expression);
			}
			return array2;
		}

		private static Expression[] GetArgumentExpressions(Expression[] arguments, Type[] parameterTypes, Type[] sourceTypes)
		{
			Expression[] array = new Expression[arguments.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = ConvertToType(arguments[i], parameterTypes[i], sourceTypes[i]);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private Expression CreateBinaryItemWithMethod(BinaryExpression bin, Expression[] init, Type[] sourceTypes)
		{
			Expression[] array = ((!(bin.Method == null)) ? GetArgumentExpressions(init, bin.Method, shiftArguments: false, bin.IsLifted) : GetArgumentExpressions(init, new Type[2]
			{
				bin.Left.Type,
				bin.Right.Type
			}, sourceTypes));
			return bin.NodeType switch
			{
				ExpressionType.Add => Expression.Add(array[0], array[1], bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.AddChecked => Expression.AddChecked(array[0], array[1], bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.And => Expression.And(array[0], array[1], bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.AndAlso => Expression.AndAlso(array[0], array[1], bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.GreaterThan => Expression.GreaterThan(array[0], array[1], bin.IsLiftedToNull, bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.GreaterThanOrEqual => Expression.GreaterThanOrEqual(array[0], array[1], bin.IsLiftedToNull, bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.LessThan => Expression.LessThan(array[0], array[1], bin.IsLiftedToNull, bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.LessThanOrEqual => Expression.LessThanOrEqual(array[0], array[1], bin.IsLiftedToNull, bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.Modulo => Expression.Modulo(array[0], array[1], bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.Multiply => Expression.Multiply(array[0], array[1], bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.MultiplyChecked => Expression.MultiplyChecked(array[0], array[1], bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.Equal => Expression.Equal(array[0], array[1], bin.IsLiftedToNull, bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.NotEqual => Expression.NotEqual(array[0], array[1], bin.IsLiftedToNull, bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.Or => Expression.Or(array[0], array[1], bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.OrElse => Expression.OrElse(array[0], array[1], bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.Subtract => Expression.Subtract(array[0], array[1], bin.Method), 
				ExpressionType.SubtractChecked => Expression.SubtractChecked(array[0], array[1], bin.Method), 
				_ => throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_CurrentExpressionWithX0IsNotSupported", bin)), 
			};
		}

		private Expression TryMakeNullSafeIif(Expression expression, Expression nullableInstance)
		{
			if (nullableInstance == null || isInsideNestedXPQueryCounter > 0)
			{
				return expression;
			}
			if (NullableHelpers.CanAcceptNull(nullableInstance.Type))
			{
				return Expression.Condition(Expression.Equal(nullableInstance, Expression.Constant(null, nullableInstance.Type)), Expression.Default(expression.Type), expression);
			}
			return expression;
		}

		private Expression CreateSubItemCore(Type subType, ExpressionAccessOperator expressionOperator, CriteriaTypeResolver resolver, ParameterExpression row, ref int rowIndex)
		{
			if (expressionOperator.SourceItems == null || expressionOperator.SourceItems.Length == 0)
			{
				return expressionOperator.LinqExpression;
			}
			Expression[] array = new Expression[expressionOperator.SourceItems.Length];
			Type[] sourceTypes = expressionOperator.GetSourceTypes(subType, resolver);
			int num = isInsideNestedXPQueryCounter;
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					CriteriaOperator val = expressionOperator.SourceItems[i];
					if (IsNull(val))
					{
						array[i] = null;
						continue;
					}
					Type type = sourceTypes[i];
					if (type != null && expressionOperator.LinqExpression.NodeType == ExpressionType.Call && type.IsGenericType && typeof(XPQueryBase).IsAssignableFrom(type))
					{
						isInsideNestedXPQueryCounter++;
					}
					if (val is MemberInitOperator)
					{
						array[i] = CreateSubItemCore(type, (MemberInitOperator)(object)val, resolver, row, ref rowIndex);
					}
					else if (val is ExpressionAccessOperator)
					{
						array[i] = CreateSubItemCore(type, (ExpressionAccessOperator)(object)val, resolver, row, ref rowIndex);
					}
					else if (val is ConstantCompiler)
					{
						array[i] = ((ConstantCompiler)(object)val).Expression;
					}
					else if (type == typeof(long) && GetTimeOfDayValueFinder.TryToFind(val))
					{
						array[i] = CreateTimeStampFromTicksExpression(Expression.ArrayIndex(row, Expression.Constant(rowIndex++)));
					}
					else
					{
						array[i] = Expression.ArrayIndex(row, Expression.Constant(rowIndex++));
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isInsideNestedXPQueryCounter = num;
			}
			switch (expressionOperator.LinqExpression.NodeType)
			{
			case ExpressionType.Invoke:
				return Expression.Invoke(array[0], GetArgumentExpressions(array, null, shiftArguments: true, isLifted: false));
			case ExpressionType.MemberAccess:
			{
				MemberInfo member = ((MemberExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression).Member;
				Expression expression2 = array[0];
				if (expression2.Type != member.DeclaringType)
				{
					expression2 = Expression.Convert(expression2, member.DeclaringType);
				}
				MemberExpression expression3 = Expression.MakeMemberAccess(expression2, ((MemberExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression).Member);
				return TryMakeNullSafeIif(expression3, array[0]);
			}
			case ExpressionType.Call:
			{
				MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = (MethodCallExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression;
				Expression expression5 = (expressionOperator.InsertFirstNull ? null : array[0]);
				if (expression5 != null && methodCallExpression.Method.DeclaringType != expression5.Type)
				{
					expression5 = Expression.Convert(expression5, methodCallExpression.Method.DeclaringType);
				}
				MethodCallExpression expression6 = Expression.Call(expression5, methodCallExpression.Method, GetArgumentExpressions(array, methodCallExpression.Method, !expressionOperator.InsertFirstNull, isLifted: false));
				return TryMakeNullSafeIif(expression6, expressionOperator.InsertFirstNull ? null : array[0]);
			}
			case ExpressionType.Constant:
				return expressionOperator.LinqExpression;
			case ExpressionType.Add:
			case ExpressionType.AddChecked:
			case ExpressionType.And:
			case ExpressionType.AndAlso:
			case ExpressionType.Coalesce:
			case ExpressionType.Divide:
			case ExpressionType.Equal:
			case ExpressionType.GreaterThan:
			case ExpressionType.GreaterThanOrEqual:
			case ExpressionType.LessThan:
			case ExpressionType.LessThanOrEqual:
			case ExpressionType.Modulo:
			case ExpressionType.Multiply:
			case ExpressionType.MultiplyChecked:
			case ExpressionType.NotEqual:
			case ExpressionType.Or:
			case ExpressionType.OrElse:
			case ExpressionType.Subtract:
			case ExpressionType.SubtractChecked:
				return CreateBinaryItemWithMethod((BinaryExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression, array, sourceTypes);
			case ExpressionType.ArrayIndex:
				return Expression.ArrayIndex(array[0], (array[1].Type == typeof(int)) ? array[1] : Expression.Convert(array[1], typeof(int)));
			case ExpressionType.ArrayLength:
				return Expression.ArrayLength(array[0]);
			case ExpressionType.Convert:
			{
				UnaryExpression unaryExpression = (UnaryExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression;
				Expression expression = array[0];
				if (expression.Type == typeof(object))
				{
					if (unaryExpression.Type == typeof(object))
					{
						return expression;
					}
					if (unaryExpression.Operand.Type != typeof(object))
					{
						expression = Expression.Convert(expression, unaryExpression.Operand.Type);
					}
				}
				return ElementwiseConversion(expression, expressionOperator.LinqExpression.Type) ?? Expression.Convert(expression, expressionOperator.LinqExpression.Type, unaryExpression.Method);
			}
			case ExpressionType.ConvertChecked:
			{
				UnaryExpression unaryExpression2 = (UnaryExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression;
				Expression expression4 = array[0];
				if (expression4.Type == typeof(object) && unaryExpression2.Operand.Type != typeof(object))
				{
					expression4 = Expression.Convert(expression4, unaryExpression2.Operand.Type);
				}
				return ElementwiseConversion(expression4, expressionOperator.LinqExpression.Type) ?? Expression.ConvertChecked(expression4, expressionOperator.LinqExpression.Type, ((UnaryExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression).Method);
			}
			case ExpressionType.Negate:
				return Expression.Negate(array[0], ((UnaryExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression).Method);
			case ExpressionType.NegateChecked:
				return Expression.NegateChecked(array[0], ((UnaryExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression).Method);
			case ExpressionType.Not:
				return Expression.Not(array[0], ((UnaryExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression).Method);
			case ExpressionType.Quote:
				return Expression.Quote(array[0]);
			case ExpressionType.UnaryPlus:
				return Expression.UnaryPlus(array[0], ((UnaryExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression).Method);
			case ExpressionType.Conditional:
			{
				ConditionalExpression conditionalExpression = (ConditionalExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression;
				if (array[0].Type != conditionalExpression.Test.Type)
				{
					array[0] = Expression.Convert(array[0], conditionalExpression.Test.Type);
				}
				if (array[1].Type != conditionalExpression.IfTrue.Type)
				{
					array[1] = Expression.Convert(array[1], conditionalExpression.IfTrue.Type);
				}
				if (array[2].Type != conditionalExpression.IfFalse.Type)
				{
					array[2] = Expression.Convert(array[2], conditionalExpression.IfFalse.Type);
				}
				return Expression.Condition(array[0], array[1], array[2]);
			}
			case ExpressionType.Lambda:
			{
				LambdaExpression lambdaExpression = (LambdaExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression;
				return Expression.Lambda(array[0], lambdaExpression.Parameters.ToArray());
			}
			case ExpressionType.TypeIs:
				return Expression.TypeIs(array[0], ((TypeBinaryExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression).TypeOperand);
			case ExpressionType.TypeAs:
				return Expression.TypeAs(array[0], ((UnaryExpression)expressionOperator.LinqExpression).Type);
			default:
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_CurrentExpressionWithX0IsNotSupported", expressionOperator.LinqExpression));
			}
		}

		private Expression CreateTimeStampFromTicksExpression(Expression ticksEpression)
		{
			if (ticksEpression.Type != typeof(long))
			{
				ticksEpression = Expression.Convert(ticksEpression, typeof(long));
			}
			return Expression.New(timeSpanFromTicksConstructor, ticksEpression);
		}

		private static Delegate GetElementwiseConversionDelegate(Type destTypeArgument, Type sourceTypeArgument, ParameterExpression parameter, out Type delegateType)
		{
			delegateType = typeof(Func<, >).MakeGenericType(sourceTypeArgument, destTypeArgument);
			lock (elementwiseConversionCache)
			{
				if (!elementwiseConversionCache.TryGetValue(delegateType, out var value))
				{
					value = Expression.Lambda(delegateType, Expression.Convert(parameter, destTypeArgument), parameter).Compile();
					elementwiseConversionCache.Add(delegateType, value);
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		private static Expression MakeElementwiseConversionExpression(Expression source, Type targetTypeArgument, Type sourceTypeArgument)
		{
			ParameterExpression parameter = Expression.Parameter(sourceTypeArgument, "s");
			Type delegateType;
			ConstantExpression constantExpression = Expression.Constant(GetElementwiseConversionDelegate(targetTypeArgument, sourceTypeArgument, parameter, out delegateType), delegateType);
			MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = Expression.Call(typeof(Enumerable), "Select", new Type[2] { sourceTypeArgument, targetTypeArgument }, source, constantExpression);
			return Expression.Call(typeof(Enumerable), "ToList", new Type[1] { targetTypeArgument }, methodCallExpression);
		}

		private static Expression ElementwiseConversion(Expression source, Type targetType)
		{
			Type type = source.Type;
			if (targetType.IsInterface && targetType.IsGenericType)
			{
				Type targetTypeGenericDefinition = targetType.GetGenericTypeDefinition();
				if (convertedInterfaces.Any((Type i) => i == targetTypeGenericDefinition))
				{
					Type targetTypeArgument = targetType.GetGenericArguments()[0];
					if (type.IsGenericType)
					{
						if (Parser.IsImplementsInterface(targetType, type) || Parser.IsImplementsInterface(type, targetType))
						{
							return null;
						}
						Type[] genericArguments = type.GetGenericArguments();
						if (genericArguments.Length == 1)
						{
							return MakeElementwiseConversionExpression(source, targetTypeArgument, genericArguments[0]);
						}
					}
					else if (type == typeof(IEnumerable) || type.GetInterfaces().Any((Type i) => i == typeof(IEnumerable)))
					{
						if (Parser.IsImplementsInterface(type, targetType))
						{
							return null;
						}
						Type type2 = type.GetInterfaces().FirstOrDefault((Type i) => i.IsGenericType && i.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IEnumerable<>));
						Type type3;
						Expression source2;
						if (type2 == null)
						{
							type3 = typeof(object);
							source2 = Expression.Call(typeof(Enumerable), "OfType", new Type[1] { type3 }, source);
						}
						else
						{
							type3 = type2.GetGenericArguments()[0];
							source2 = Expression.Convert(source, type2);
						}
						return MakeElementwiseConversionExpression(source2, targetTypeArgument, type3);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private CreateItemDelegate CreateItemCore(Type type, MemberInitOperator last, CriteriaOperatorCollection effectiveProps)
		{
			if (!last.CreateNewObject)
			{
				if (!type.IsArray)
				{
					CriteriaOperator property = last.Members[0].Property;
					if (!(property is ExpressionAccessOperator) && !(property is ConstantCompiler) && (effectiveProps == null || ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)effectiveProps).Count > 0))
					{
						if (type.IsValueType && Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type) == null)
						{
							object defaultValue = Activator.CreateInstance(type);
							if (type == typeof(TimeSpan))
							{
								return delegate(object[] row)
								{
									if (row[0] is long)
									{
										return new TimeSpan((long)row[0]);
									}
									return (row[0] is double) ? ((object)TimeSpan.FromSeconds((double)row[0])) : (row[0] ?? defaultValue);
								};
							}
							return (object[] row) => row[0] ?? defaultValue;
						}
						return (object[] row) => row[0];
					}
				}
				else if (type == typeof(object[]))
				{
					return (object[] row) => row;
				}
			}
			CriteriaTypeResolver resolver = new Resolver(ObjectClassInfo);
			List<object> projectionSample = new List<object>(40);
			if (GetProjectionSample(type, resolver, (CriteriaOperator)(object)last, effectiveProps, projectionSample))
			{
				CreateItemCommonKey key = new CreateItemCommonKey
				{
					Type = type,
					ProjectionSample = projectionSample
				};
				lock (createItemCommonCache)
				{
					if (!createItemCommonCache.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
					{
						value = CreateCreateItemDelegate(type, last, resolver);
						createItemCommonCache.Add(key, value);
					}
					return value;
				}
			}
			return CreateCreateItemDelegate(type, last, resolver);
		}

		private CreateItemDelegate CreateCreateItemDelegate(Type type, MemberInitOperator last, CriteriaTypeResolver resolver)
		{
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression = Expression.Parameter(typeof(object[]), "row");
			int rowIndex = 0;
			Expression expression = CreateSubItemCore(type, last, resolver, parameterExpression, ref rowIndex);
			if (expression.NodeType == ExpressionType.MemberInit)
			{
				expression = Expression.Convert(expression, typeof(object));
			}
			if (expression.NodeType == ExpressionType.Quote)
			{
				expression = ((UnaryExpression)expression).Operand;
			}
			if (expression.NodeType == ExpressionType.Lambda)
			{
				expression = ((LambdaExpression)expression).Body;
			}
			if (expression.Type != typeof(object))
			{
				expression = Expression.Convert(expression, typeof(object));
			}
			return Expression.Lambda<CreateItemDelegate>(expression, new ParameterExpression[1] { parameterExpression }).Compile();
		}

		private bool GetProjectionSample(Type type, CriteriaTypeResolver resolver, CriteriaOperator property, CriteriaOperatorCollection effectiveProps, List<object> projectionSample)
		{
			//IL_0354: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (effectiveProps != null)
			{
				projectionSample.Add(projectionSamplePropsStart);
				foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)effectiveProps)
				{
					projectionSample.Add(IsNull(item) ? projectionSamplePropsNull : GetSourceType(resolver, item));
				}
				projectionSample.Add(projectionSamplePropsEnd);
			}
			if (property is GroupSet)
			{
				CriteriaOperatorCollection grouping = GetGrouping();
				for (int i = 0; i < ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)grouping).Count; i++)
				{
					projectionSample.Add(GetSourceType(resolver, ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)grouping)[i]));
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (property is QuerySet)
			{
				QuerySet querySet = (QuerySet)(object)property;
				if (querySet is FreeQuerySet)
				{
					FreeQuerySet freeQuerySet = (FreeQuerySet)querySet;
					if (IsNull(freeQuerySet.Projection))
					{
						projectionSample.Add(projectionFreeQueryThis);
					}
					else
					{
						if (!freeQuerySet.TryGetProjectionSingleProperty(out var property2))
						{
							throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ComplexDataSelectionIsNotSupportedPerhapsY"));
						}
						projectionSample.Add(property2);
					}
					projectionSample.Add(freeQuerySet.JoinType);
					return true;
				}
				if ((!querySet.IsEmpty && IsNull(querySet.Property)) || !IsNull(querySet.Condition))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_ComplexDataSelectionIsNotSupportedPerhapsY"));
				}
				projectionSample.Add(type);
				return true;
			}
			if (property is MemberInitOperator)
			{
				MemberInitOperator memberInitOperator = (MemberInitOperator)(object)property;
				projectionSample.Add(projectionSampleMIO);
				projectionSample.Add(memberInitOperator.CreateNewObject);
				projectionSample.Add(memberInitOperator.UseConstructor);
				projectionSample.Add(memberInitOperator.DeclaringTypeName);
				if (memberInitOperator.UseConstructor)
				{
					projectionSample.Add(memberInitOperator.GetConstructor(type));
				}
				projectionSample.Add(projectionSampleBegin);
				Type[] sourceTypes = memberInitOperator.GetSourceTypes(type, resolver);
				for (int j = 0; j < memberInitOperator.Members.Count; j++)
				{
					projectionSample.Add(memberInitOperator.Members[j].MemberName);
					if (!GetProjectionSample(sourceTypes[j], resolver, memberInitOperator.Members[j].Property, null, projectionSample))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				projectionSample.Add(projectionSampleEnd);
				return true;
			}
			if (property is ExpressionAccessOperator)
			{
				ExpressionAccessOperator expressionAccessOperator = (ExpressionAccessOperator)(object)property;
				projectionSample.Add(projectionSampleEAO);
				projectionSample.Add(expressionAccessOperator.LinqExpression.NodeType);
				projectionSample.Add(expressionAccessOperator.LinqExpression.Type);
				switch (expressionAccessOperator.LinqExpression.NodeType)
				{
				case ExpressionType.Call:
					projectionSample.Add(((MethodCallExpression)expressionAccessOperator.LinqExpression).Method);
					break;
				case ExpressionType.MemberAccess:
					projectionSample.Add(((MemberExpression)expressionAccessOperator.LinqExpression).Member);
					break;
				}
				projectionSample.Add(projectionSampleBegin);
				Type[] sourceTypes2 = expressionAccessOperator.GetSourceTypes(type, resolver);
				if (expressionAccessOperator.SourceItems.Length == 0)
				{
					projectionSample.Add(expressionAccessOperator.LinqExpression.ToString());
				}
				else
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < expressionAccessOperator.SourceItems.Length; k++)
					{
						if (!GetProjectionSample(sourceTypes2[k], resolver, expressionAccessOperator.SourceItems[k], null, projectionSample))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				projectionSample.Add(projectionSampleEnd);
				return true;
			}
			if (property is OperandProperty)
			{
				projectionSample.Add(((OperandProperty)property).PropertyName);
			}
			if (property is ConstantCompiler)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (property == null)
			{
				projectionSample.Add(typeof(int));
				return true;
			}
			projectionSample.Add(type);
			return true;
		}

			if (operand1 is ExpressionAccessOperator || operand1 is MemberInitOperator || IsNotParsableQuerySet(operand1))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (operand2 is ExpressionAccessOperator || operand2 is MemberInitOperator || IsNotParsableQuerySet(operand2))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(operand3 is ExpressionAccessOperator) && !(operand3 is MemberInitOperator))
			{
				return IsNotParsableQuerySet(operand3);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static IList<ParameterExpression> GetLambdaParams(Expression call, int count)
		{
			if (call is UnaryExpression unaryExpression)
			{
				call = unaryExpression.Operand;
			}
			if (call is LambdaExpression lambdaExpression)
			{
				IList<ParameterExpression> list = lambdaExpression.Parameters;
				if (list.Count != count)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_TheLambdaExpressionWithSuchParametersIsNot", lambdaExpression));
				}
				return list;
			}
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_LambdaExpressionIsExpectedX0", call));
		}

		private static Expression ExtractLambdaExpressionIfNeeded(Expression call)
		{
			if (call.NodeType == ExpressionType.MemberAccess && typeof(LambdaExpression).IsAssignableFrom(call.Type))
			{
				MemberAccessOperator memberAccessOperator = new MemberAccessOperator((MemberExpression)call);
				return (Expression)((OperandValue)memberAccessOperator).Value;
			}
			return call;
		}

		private CriteriaOperator ParseExpression(Type type, Expression expression, params CriteriaOperator[] maps)
		{
			expression = ExtractLambdaExpressionIfNeeded(expression);
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = classInfo;
			if (!IsNull(type))
			{
				xPClassInfo = Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(type);
			}
			ParamExpression resolver = GetResolver(ref expression);
			Dictionary<ParameterExpression, CriteriaOperator> dictionary = PrepareParametersForJoin();
			AddMaps(expression, maps, dictionary);
			Parser parser = new Parser(xPClassInfo, customCriteriaCollection, Resolver ?? resolver, dictionary);
			return parser.ParseExpression(expression);
		}

		private static ParamExpression GetResolver(ref Expression expression)
		{
			ReadOnlyCollection<Expression> arguments;
			if (!(expression is MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression) || (arguments = methodCallExpression.Arguments).Count != 2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(arguments[1] is ConstantExpression constantExpression))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ParamExpression paramExpression = constantExpression.Value as ParamExpression;
			if (paramExpression != null)
			{
				expression = arguments[0];
			}
			return paramExpression;
		}

		private CriteriaOperator ParseExpression(OperandProperty col, Expression expression, params CriteriaOperator[] maps)
		{
			expression = ExtractLambdaExpressionIfNeeded(expression);
			int upDepth = 0;
			List<XPClassInfo> list = new List<XPClassInfo>(upDepthList);
			if (!IsNull(col))
			{
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = classInfo;
				int num = 0;
				string text = col.PropertyName;
				while (text.StartsWith("^."))
				{
					text = text.Remove(0, 2);
					num++;
					if (list.Count == 0)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException();
					}
					list.RemoveAt(0);
				}
				MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = MemberInfoCollection.ParsePersistentPath(upDepthList[num], text);
				upDepth = memberInfoCollection.Count;
				xPClassInfo = memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1].CollectionElementType;
				list.Insert(0, xPClassInfo);
			}
			ParamExpression resolver = GetResolver(ref expression);
			Dictionary<ParameterExpression, CriteriaOperator> dictionary = PrepareParameters(expression, col, upDepth);
			AddMaps(expression, maps, dictionary);
			Parser parser = new Parser(list.ToArray(), customCriteriaCollection, Resolver ?? resolver, dictionary);
			return parser.ParseExpression(expression);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator ParseObjectExpression(XPClassInfo classInfo, CustomCriteriaCollection customCriteriaCollection, Expression expression, params CriteriaOperator[] maps)
		{
			expression = ExtractLambdaExpressionIfNeeded(expression);

			Dictionary<ParameterExpression, CriteriaOperator> dictionary = new Dictionary<ParameterExpression, CriteriaOperator>();
			AddMaps(expression, maps, dictionary);
			Parser parser = new Parser(classInfo, customCriteriaCollection, resolver, dictionary);
			return parser.ParseObjectExpression(expression);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator ParseExpression(XPClassInfo classInfo, CustomCriteriaCollection customCriteriaCollection, Expression expression, params CriteriaOperator[] maps)
		{

			ParamExpression resolver = GetResolver(ref expression);
			Dictionary<ParameterExpression, CriteriaOperator> dictionary = new Dictionary<ParameterExpression, CriteriaOperator>();
			AddMaps(expression, maps, dictionary);

			return parser.ParseExpression(expression);
		}

		private static void AddMaps(Expression expression, CriteriaOperator[] maps, Dictionary<ParameterExpression, CriteriaOperator> parameters)
		{
			if (maps == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("maps");
			}
			IList<ParameterExpression> lambdaParams = GetLambdaParams(expression, maps.Length);
			for (int i = 0; i < maps.Length; i++)
			{
				parameters[lambdaParams[i]] = (CriteriaOperator)(object)(IsNull(maps[i]) ? QuerySet.Empty : ((QuerySet)(object)maps[i]));
			}
		}

		private CriteriaOperator ParseWithExpressionOperatorForceForConversion(Expression expression)
		{
			Interlocked.Increment(ref forceExpressionOperatorForConversion);
			try
			{
				return ParseExpression(expression);
			}
			finally
			{
				Interlocked.Decrement(ref forceExpressionOperatorForConversion);
			}
		}

		private CriteriaOperator ParseWithExpressionOperatorForceForQuerySet(Expression expression)

			}
			finally

				Interlocked.Decrement(ref forceExpressionOperatorForQuerySet);
			}
		}

		private CriteriaOperator ParseExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			CriteriaOperator value;
			if (cache != null)
			{
				lock (cache)
				{
					if (cache.TryGetValue(expression, out value))
					{
						return value;
					}
				}
				bool value2 = Resolver.Use();
				value = ParseExpressionCore(expression);
				if (!Resolver.UnUse(value2) && !(expression is ParameterExpression))
				{
					lock (cache)
					{
						cache[expression] = value;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				value = ParseExpressionCore(expression);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public CriteriaOperator ParseExpressionCore(Expression expression)
		{
			switch (expression.NodeType)
			{
			case ExpressionType.Add:
			case ExpressionType.AddChecked:
				return Binary((BinaryExpression)expression, (BinaryOperatorType)13);
			case ExpressionType.And:
				if (!IsLogical((BinaryExpression)expression))
				{
					return Binary((BinaryExpression)expression, (BinaryOperatorType)7);
				}
				return Group((BinaryExpression)expression, (GroupOperatorType)0);
			case ExpressionType.AndAlso:
				return Group((BinaryExpression)expression, (GroupOperatorType)0);
			case ExpressionType.ArrayIndex:
				return ArrayIndex((BinaryExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.ArrayLength:
				return ArrayLength((UnaryExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.Call:
				return Call((MethodCallExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.Coalesce:
				return Coalesce((BinaryExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.Conditional:
				return Conditional((ConditionalExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.Constant:
				return Constant((ConstantExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.Convert:
			case ExpressionType.ConvertChecked:
				return Convert((UnaryExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.Divide:
				return Binary((BinaryExpression)expression, (BinaryOperatorType)10);
			case ExpressionType.Equal:
				return Equal((BinaryExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.GreaterThan:
				return LogicalBinary((BinaryExpression)expression, (BinaryOperatorType)2);
			case ExpressionType.GreaterThanOrEqual:
				return LogicalBinary((BinaryExpression)expression, (BinaryOperatorType)5);
			case ExpressionType.Lambda:
			{
				CriteriaOperator val2 = ParseExpression(((LambdaExpression)expression).Body);
				if (val2 is ExpressionAccessOperator)
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)(object)new ExpressionAccessOperator(expression, val2);
				}
				return val2;
			}
			case ExpressionType.LessThan:
				return LogicalBinary((BinaryExpression)expression, (BinaryOperatorType)3);
			case ExpressionType.LessThanOrEqual:
				return LogicalBinary((BinaryExpression)expression, (BinaryOperatorType)4);
			case ExpressionType.MemberAccess:
				return MemberAccess((MemberExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.MemberInit:
				return MemberInit((MemberInitExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.Modulo:
				return Binary((BinaryExpression)expression, (BinaryOperatorType)11);
			case ExpressionType.Multiply:
			case ExpressionType.MultiplyChecked:
				return Binary((BinaryExpression)expression, (BinaryOperatorType)12);
			case ExpressionType.Negate:
			case ExpressionType.NegateChecked:
				return Unary((UnaryExpression)expression, (UnaryOperatorType)2);
			case ExpressionType.New:
				return New((NewExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.NewArrayInit:
				return NewArrayInit((NewArrayExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.Not:
				return Unary((UnaryExpression)expression, (UnaryOperatorType)3);
			case ExpressionType.NotEqual:
				return NotEqual((BinaryExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.Or:
				if (!IsLogical((BinaryExpression)expression))
				{
					return Binary((BinaryExpression)expression, (BinaryOperatorType)8);
				}
				return Group((BinaryExpression)expression, (GroupOperatorType)1);
			case ExpressionType.OrElse:
				return Group((BinaryExpression)expression, (GroupOperatorType)1);
			case ExpressionType.Parameter:
				return Parameter((ParameterExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.Subtract:
			case ExpressionType.SubtractChecked:
				return Binary((BinaryExpression)expression, (BinaryOperatorType)14);
			case ExpressionType.TypeIs:
				return TypeIs((TypeBinaryExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.TypeAs:
				return TypeAs((UnaryExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.Quote:
			{
				CriteriaOperator val = ParseExpression(((UnaryExpression)expression).Operand);
				if (val is ExpressionAccessOperator)
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)(object)new ExpressionAccessOperator(expression, val);
				}
				return val;
			}
			case ExpressionType.UnaryPlus:
				return Unary((UnaryExpression)expression, (UnaryOperatorType)1);
			case ExpressionType.Invoke:
				return ParseInvoke((InvocationExpression)expression);
			case ExpressionType.Default:
				return ParseDefault((DefaultExpression)expression);
			default:
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_CurrentExpressionWithX0IsNotSupported", expression.NodeType));
			}
		}

		public CriteriaOperator ParseInvoke(InvocationExpression invoke)
		{
			CriteriaOperator[] array = (CriteriaOperator[])(object)new CriteriaOperator[invoke.Arguments.Count + 1];
			array[0] = ParseExpression(invoke.Expression);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				array[i + 1] = ParseExpression(invoke.Arguments[i]);
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)new ExpressionAccessOperator(invoke, array);
		}

		private static bool IsLogical(BinaryExpression binaryExpression)
		{
			if (!(binaryExpression.Left.Type == typeof(bool)))
			{
				return binaryExpression.Left.Type == typeof(bool?);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private CriteriaOperator ArrayLength(UnaryExpression expression)
		{
			CriteriaOperator val = ParseExpression(expression.Operand);
			if (HasExpressionAccess(val))
			{
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)new ExpressionAccessOperator(expression, val);
			}
			if (!(val is OperandValue))
			{
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)new ExpressionAccessOperator(expression);
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)new ConstantCompiler(Dictionary, expression);
		}

		private CriteriaOperator ArrayIndex(BinaryExpression expression)
		{
			CriteriaOperator val = ParseExpression(expression.Left);
			CriteriaOperator val2 = ParseExpression(expression.Right);
			if (HasExpressionAccess(val, val2))
			{
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)new ExpressionAccessOperator(expression, val, val2);
			}
			if (!(val is OperandValue) || !(val2 is OperandValue))
			{
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)new ExpressionAccessOperator(expression, new ExpressionAccessOperator(expression.Left), val2);
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)new ConstantCompiler(Dictionary, expression);
		}

		private bool TryCallConvertClass(MethodCallExpression call, out CriteriaOperator outCriteriaOperator)
		{
			switch (call.Method.Name)
			{
			case "ToString":
				outCriteriaOperator = FnToStr(call, call.Arguments[0]);
				return true;
			case "ToDecimal":
			case "ToDouble":
			case "ToInt32":
			case "ToInt64":
			case "ToSingle":
			case "ToUInt32":
			case "ToUInt64":
				outCriteriaOperator = ConvertCore(call, call.Arguments[0], call.Type, classInfo);
				return true;
			default:
				outCriteriaOperator = null;
				return false;
			}
		}

		}

		public bool BinaryDetectCompare(Expression expression, Expression leftExpression, Expression rightExpression, CriteriaOperator right, BinaryOperatorType type, bool rightIsExpressionAccess, out CriteriaOperator result)

		private CriteriaOperator Conditional(ConditionalExpression expression)
