		public static bool IsPrimitive(Type type)
		{
			if (!type.IsPrimitive && !(type == typeof(string)) && !(type == typeof(decimal)) && !(type == typeof(DateTime)) && !(type == typeof(Guid)) && !(type == typeof(TimeSpan)))
			{
				if (type.IsArray)
				{
					return IsPrimitive(type.GetElementType());
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private CriteriaOperator Call(MethodCallExpression call)
		{
			if (call.Method.DeclaringType == typeof(Convert) && TryCallConvertClass(call, out var outCriteriaOperator))
			{
				return outCriteriaOperator;
			}
			if (call.Method.Name == "ToString")
			{
				return FnToStr(call, call.Object);
			}
			if (call.Method.Name == "CompareTo" && call.Arguments.Count == 1)
			{
				CriteriaOperator val = ParseExpression(call.Object);
				CriteriaOperator val2 = ParseExpression(call.Arguments[0]);
				if (HasExpressionOrMemberInitOrQuerySet(val, val2))
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)(object)new ExpressionAccessOperator(call, val, val2);
				}
				return FnCompareTo(val, val2);
			}
			if (call.Method.DeclaringType == typeof(string))
			{
				return CallString(call);
			}
			if (call.Method.DeclaringType == typeof(object) && call.Method.Name == "Equals")
			{
				if (call.Object == null)
				{
					return EqualsCore(call, call.Arguments[0], call.Arguments[1], negation: false);
				}
				return EqualsCore(call, call.Object, call.Arguments[0], negation: false);
			}
			if (call.Method.DeclaringType == typeof(Math))
			{
				return CallMath(call);
			}
			if (call.Method.DeclaringType == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return CallDateTime(call);
			}
			if (call.Method.DeclaringType.FullName == "System.Data.Linq.SqlClient.SqlMethods")
			{
				return CallSqlMethods(call);
			}
			if (call.Method.DeclaringType == typeof(Queryable) || call.Method.DeclaringType == typeof(Enumerable))
			{
				return CallQueryable(call);
			}
			if (CheckMethodIsContains(call.Method, call.Arguments))
			{
				return ListContains(call);
			}
			if (call.Method.DeclaringType == typeof(XPQueryExtensions) && call.Method.Name.StartsWith("Query") && TryGetNewXPQueryCriteria(call, out var criteria))
			{
				return criteria;
			}
			return CallDefault(call);
		}

		private bool CheckMethodIsContains(MethodInfo method, ReadOnlyCollection<Expression> arguments)
		{
			if (!(method.Name == "Contains") || !method.DeclaringType.IsGenericType || arguments.Count != 1 || !(method.DeclaringType.GetGenericArguments()[0] == method.GetParameters()[0].ParameterType) || !(method.ReturnType == typeof(bool)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type type = method.DeclaringType;
			do
			{
				if (type.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(ICollection<>) || (!type.IsInterface && type.GetInterfaces().Any((Type i) => i.IsGenericType && i.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(ICollection<>))))
				{
					return true;
				}
				type = DXTypeExtensions.GetBaseType(type);
			}
			while (type != null && type.IsGenericType);
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsStructType(Type type)

		private CriteriaOperator ConvertStructAccessIfNeeded(Expression expression, CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{

		}

		private Expression ExtractLambdaBody(Expression lambda)
		{
			Expression expression = lambda;
			while (true)
			{
				switch (expression.NodeType)
				{
				case ExpressionType.Lambda:
					expression = ((LambdaExpression)expression).Body;
					break;
				case ExpressionType.Quote:
					expression = ((UnaryExpression)expression).Operand;
					break;
				default:
					return expression;
				}
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<ParameterExpression, CriteriaOperator> PrepareParametersForJoin()

		private Dictionary<ParameterExpression, CriteriaOperator> PrepareParameters(Expression call, OperandProperty path, int upDepth)
		{

			if (!IsNull(path))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < upDepth; i++)

					text += (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? "^" : ".^");
				}
				return PatchParameters(text);
			}
			return parameters;
		}

		private Dictionary<ParameterExpression, CriteriaOperator> PatchParameters(string pathStr)
		{
			Dictionary<ParameterExpression, CriteriaOperator> dictionary = new Dictionary<ParameterExpression, CriteriaOperator>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<ParameterExpression, CriteriaOperator> parameter in parameters)
			{
				CriteriaOperator value = PatchParameter(pathStr, parameter.Value);
				dictionary.Add(parameter.Key, value);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator PatchParameter(string pathStr, CriteriaOperator p)
		{
			return PatchParameterVisitor.Patch(pathStr, p);
		}

		private bool IsVBStringCompare(BinaryExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression.Left.NodeType == ExpressionType.Call && expression.Right.NodeType == ExpressionType.Constant && 0.Equals(((ConstantExpression)expression.Right).Value) && (((MethodCallExpression)expression.Left).Method.DeclaringType.FullName == "Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.Operators" || ((MethodCallExpression)expression.Left).Method.DeclaringType.FullName == "Microsoft.VisualBasic.CompilerServices.EmbeddedOperators"))
			{
				return ((MethodCallExpression)expression.Left).Method.Name == "CompareString";
			}
			return false;
		}

		IQueryable IQueryProvider.CreateQuery(Expression expression)
		{
			Type type = expression.NodeType switch
			{
				ExpressionType.Call => ((MethodCallExpression)expression).Method.ReturnType, 
				ExpressionType.Constant => ((ConstantExpression)expression).Type, 
				_ => throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_TheCallExpressionIsExpectedX0", expression)), 
			};
			if (type == null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_TheCallExpressionReturnTypeX0", expression));
			}
			Type[] genericArguments = type.GetGenericArguments();
			if (genericArguments.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_TheCallExpressionGenericReturnTypeX0", expression));
			}
			return GetCreateQueryMethod(genericArguments[0])(this, expression);
		}

		private static QueryProviderEx.CreateQueryHandler GetCreateQueryMethod(Type type)
		{
			return createQueryMethods.GetOrAdd(type, delegate(Type t)
			{
				MethodInfo method = typeof(QueryProviderEx).GetMethod("CreateQuery").MakeGenericMethod(t);
				return (QueryProviderEx.CreateQueryHandler)Delegate.CreateDelegate(typeof(QueryProviderEx.CreateQueryHandler), method);
			});
		}

		IQueryable<S> IQueryProvider.CreateQuery<S>(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression.NodeType == ExpressionType.Constant && expression.Type == typeof(XPQuery<S>) && Parser.TryExtractXPQuery(expression, out var xpQueryBase))
			{
				return new XPQuery<S>((XPQuery<S>)xpQueryBase);
			}
			XPQuery<S> xPQuery = new XPQuery<S>(base.Session, base.DataLayer, base.Dictionary);
			if (expression.NodeType != ExpressionType.Call)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_TheCallExpressionIsExpectedX0", expression));
			}
			MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = (MethodCallExpression)expression;
			if (methodCallExpression.Method.DeclaringType != typeof(Queryable) && methodCallExpression.Method.DeclaringType != typeof(Enumerable))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_IncorrectDeclaringTypeX0InTheMethodCallQue", methodCallExpression.Method.DeclaringType));
			}
			ReadOnlyCollection<Expression> arguments = methodCallExpression.Arguments;
			if (arguments[0].NodeType == ExpressionType.Call)
			{
				IQueryable queryable = ((IQueryProvider)this).CreateQuery(arguments[0]);
				List<Expression> list = new List<Expression>(arguments);
				list[0] = Expression.Constant(queryable);
				return queryable.Provider.CreateQuery<S>(Expression.Call(methodCallExpression.Method, list.ToArray()));
			}
			if (!(arguments[0] is ConstantExpression constantExpression))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_TheCallExpressionXPQueryX0", arguments[0]));
			}
			XPQueryBase prev = constantExpression.Value as XPQueryBase;
			XPQuery<T> xPQuery2 = constantExpression.Value as XPQuery<T>;
			switch (methodCallExpression.Method.Name)
			{
			case "Union":
			case "Intersect":
			{
				if (xPQuery2 == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_TheCallExpressionXPQueryX0", arguments[0]));
				}
				Type type = methodCallExpression.Method.GetGenericArguments()[0];
				XPQuery<T> xPQuery3 = ((ConstantExpression)arguments[1]).Value as XPQuery<T>;
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo2 = base.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(type);
				if (xPQuery3 == null || type != typeof(T) || xPClassInfo2 == null || !xPQuery2.CanIntersect() || !xPQuery3.CanIntersect())
				{
					return xPQuery2.CallGeneric<S>(methodCallExpression);
				}
				break;
			}
			case "Except":
			case "Concat":
				if (xPQuery2 == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_TheCallExpressionXPQueryX0", arguments[0]));
				}
				return xPQuery2.CallGeneric<S>(methodCallExpression);
			case "Cast":
			{
				if (xPQuery2 == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_TheCallExpressionXPQueryX0", arguments[0]));
				}
				Type classType = methodCallExpression.Method.GetGenericArguments()[0];
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = base.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(classType);
				if (xPClassInfo == null || !xPQuery2.ObjectClassInfo.IsAssignableTo(xPClassInfo))
				{
					return xPQuery2.CallGeneric<S>(methodCallExpression);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			xPQuery.Call(methodCallExpression, prev);
			return xPQuery;
		}

		private IQueryable<S> CallGeneric<S>(MethodCallExpression e)
		{
			IQueryable queryable = new EnumerableWrapper<T>(this).AsQueryable();
			List<Expression> list = new List<Expression>(e.Arguments);
			list[0] = Expression.Constant(queryable);
			return queryable.Provider.CreateQuery<S>(Expression.Call(e.Method, list.ToArray()));
		}

		}

		{

			List<T> list = new List<T>(collection.Count);

				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list.GetEnumerator();
		}

		private class Cache<TSource>
		{
			public static Dictionary<Delegate, CachedQuery<TSource>> cache = new Dictionary<Delegate, CachedQuery<TSource>>();

			public static bool GetCached(Delegate f, out CachedQuery<TSource> q)
			{
				if (!cache.TryGetValue(f, out q))
				{
					if (f.Target != null && (Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(f.Target.GetType(), typeof(CompilerGeneratedAttribute)) == null || !Array.TrueForAll(f.Target.GetType().GetFields(), (FieldInfo ff) => ff.IsStatic)))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_CachedExpressionIsIncompatible"));
					}
					q = new CachedQuery<TSource>(f.Method);
					cache.Add(f, q);
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private static void ThrowIfNotXPQuery<T>(IQueryable<T> query)
		{
			if (!(query is XPQueryBase))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("query");
			}
		}

		public static void EnumerateAsync<T>(this IQueryable<T> query, AsyncEnumerateCallback<T> callback)
		{
			ThrowIfNotXPQuery(query);
			((XPQueryBase)query).EnumerateAsync(typeof(T), delegate(ICollection[] result, Exception ex)
			{
				if (ex != null)
				{
					callback(null, ex);
				}
				else
				{
					ICollection collection = result[0];
					List<T> list = new List<T>(collection.Count);
					foreach (T item in collection)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					callback(list, ex);
				}
			});
		}

		public static void EnumerateAsync<T>(this IQueryable<T> query, AsyncEnumerateCallback callback)
		{
			query.EnumerateAsync(delegate(IEnumerable<T> result, Exception ex)
			{
				callback(result, ex);
			});
		}

		public static async Task<IEnumerable<T>> EnumerateAsync<T>(this IQueryable<T> query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			ThrowIfNotXPQuery(query);
			return (await ((XPQueryBase)query).EnumerateAsync(typeof(T), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)).Cast<T>();
		}

		public static TResult CachedExpression<TSource, TResult>(this IQueryable<TSource> source, Func<IQueryable<TSource>, TResult> f)
		{
			CachedQuery<TSource> q;
			lock (Cache<TSource>.cache)
			{
				if (!Cache<TSource>.GetCached(f, out q))
				{
					f(q);
				}
			}
			return (TResult)q.Process(source);
		}

		public static TResult CachedExpression<TSource, TArg1, TResult>(this IQueryable<TSource> source, Func<IQueryable<TSource>, TArg1, TResult> f, TArg1 a1)
		{
			CachedQuery<TSource> q;
			lock (Cache<TSource>.cache)
			{
				if (!Cache<TSource>.GetCached(f, out q))
				{
					f(q, default(TArg1));
				}
			}
			return (TResult)q.Process(source, a1);
		}

		public static TResult CachedExpression<TSource, TArg1, TArg2, TResult>(this IQueryable<TSource> source, Func<IQueryable<TSource>, TArg1, TArg2, TResult> f, TArg1 a1, TArg2 a2)
		{
			CachedQuery<TSource> q;
			lock (Cache<TSource>.cache)
			{
				if (!Cache<TSource>.GetCached(f, out q))
				{
					f(q, default(TArg1), default(TArg2));
				}
			}
			return (TResult)q.Process(source, a1, a2);
		}

		public static TResult CachedExpression<TSource, TArg1, TArg2, TArg3, TResult>(this IQueryable<TSource> source, Func<IQueryable<TSource>, TArg1, TArg2, TArg3, TResult> f, TArg1 a1, TArg2 a2, TArg3 a3)
		{
			CachedQuery<TSource> q;
			lock (Cache<TSource>.cache)
			{
				if (!Cache<TSource>.GetCached(f, out q))
				{
					f(q, default(TArg1), default(TArg2), default(TArg3));
				}
			}
			return (TResult)q.Process(source, a1, a2, a3);
		}

				miSumNullableFloatWithSelector = typeof(Queryable).GetMethods().First((MethodInfo m) => m.Name == "Sum" && m.ReturnType == typeof(float?) && m.GetParameters().Length == 2);
			}
			return ExecuteWithTopLevelFunctionAsync<T, float?>(query, miSumNullableFloatWithSelector, selector, cancellationToken);
		}

		private static Task<TResult> ExecuteWithTopLevelFunctionAsync<T, TResult>(IQueryable<T> query, MethodInfo topLevelMethodInfo, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			ThrowIfNotXPQuery(query);
			if (topLevelMethodInfo.IsGenericMethod)
			{
				topLevelMethodInfo = topLevelMethodInfo.MakeGenericMethod(typeof(T));
			}
			MethodCallExpression expression = Expression.Call(null, topLevelMethodInfo, query.Expression);
			return ExecuteAsync<TResult>((XPQueryBase)query, expression, cancellationToken);
		}

		private static Task<TResult> ExecuteWithTopLevelFunctionAsync<T, TResult>(IQueryable<T> query, MethodInfo topLevelMethodInfo, LambdaExpression expression, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return ExecuteWithTopLevelFunctionAsync<T, TResult>(query, topLevelMethodInfo, Expression.Quote(expression), cancellationToken);
		}

		private static Task<TResult> ExecuteWithTopLevelFunctionAsync<T, TResult>(IQueryable<T> query, MethodInfo topLevelMethodInfo, LambdaExpression[] expressions, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			Expression[] array = null;
			if (expressions != null)
			{
				array = new Expression[expressions.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < expressions.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = Expression.Quote(expressions[i]);
				}
			}
			return ExecuteWithTopLevelFunctionAsync<T, TResult>(query, topLevelMethodInfo, array, cancellationToken);
		}

		private static Task<TResult> ExecuteWithTopLevelFunctionAsync<T, TResult>(IQueryable<T> query, MethodInfo topLevelMethodInfo, Expression argument, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return ExecuteWithTopLevelFunctionAsync<T, TResult>(query, topLevelMethodInfo, new Expression[1] { argument }, cancellationToken);
		}

		private static Task<TResult> ExecuteWithTopLevelFunctionAsync<T, TResult>(IQueryable<T> query, MethodInfo topLevelMethodInfo, Expression[] arguments, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			ThrowIfNotXPQuery(query);
			if (topLevelMethodInfo.IsGenericMethod)
			{
				topLevelMethodInfo = ((topLevelMethodInfo.GetGenericArguments().Length != 1) ? topLevelMethodInfo.MakeGenericMethod(typeof(T), typeof(TResult)) : topLevelMethodInfo.MakeGenericMethod(typeof(T)));
			}
			Expression[] arguments2 = CombineExpressions(query.Expression, arguments);
			MethodCallExpression expression = Expression.Call(null, topLevelMethodInfo, arguments2);
			return ExecuteAsync<TResult>((XPQueryBase)query, expression, cancellationToken);
		}

		private static TResult ExecuteWithTopLevelFunction<T, TResult>(IQueryable<T> query, MethodInfo topLevelMethodInfo, LambdaExpression[] arguments)
		{
			ThrowIfNotXPQuery(query);
			if (topLevelMethodInfo.IsGenericMethod)
			{
				topLevelMethodInfo = topLevelMethodInfo.MakeGenericMethod(typeof(T));
			}
			Expression[] arguments2 = CombineExpressions(query.Expression, arguments);
			MethodCallExpression expression = Expression.Call(null, topLevelMethodInfo, arguments2);
			return ((IQueryProvider)query).Execute<TResult>(expression);
		}

		private static Expression[] CombineExpressions(Expression firstArgument, Expression[] otherArguments)
		{
			Expression[] array;
			if (firstArgument != null)
			{
				array = new Expression[1 + otherArguments.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < otherArguments.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i + 1] = otherArguments[i];
				}
			}
			else
			{
				array = new Expression[1];
			}
			array[0] = firstArgument;
			return array;
		}

		private static async Task<TResult> ExecuteAsync<TResult>(XPQueryBase query, Expression expression, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			object obj = await query.ExecuteAsync(expression, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			return (obj == null) ? default(TResult) : ((TResult)obj);
		}

		public static object CustomAggregate<T>(this IQueryable<T> query, string customAggregateName, params Expression<Func<T, object>>[] arguments)
		{
			ThrowIfNotXPQuery(query);
			ICustomAggregate customAggregate = ((XPQueryBase)query).GetCustomAggregate(customAggregateName);
			if (customAggregate == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("CustomAggregate_NotFound", customAggregateName));
			}
			if (!(customAggregate is ICustomAggregateQueryable customAggregateQueryable))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("CustomAggregate_DoesNotImplementInterface", customAggregateName, typeof(ICustomAggregateQueryable)));
			}
			MethodInfo methodInfo = customAggregateQueryable.GetMethodInfo();
			return ExecuteWithTopLevelFunction<T, object>(query, methodInfo, arguments);
		}

		public static Task<object> CustomAggregateAsync<T>(this IQueryable<T> query, string customAggregateName, params Expression<Func<T, object>>[] arguments)
		{
			return query.CustomAggregateAsync(customAggregateName, arguments, CancellationToken.None);
		}

		public static Task<object> CustomAggregateAsync<T>(this IQueryable<T> query, string customAggregateName, Expression<Func<T, object>> argument, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return query.CustomAggregateAsync(customAggregateName, new Expression<Func<T, object>>[1] { argument }, cancellationToken);
		}

		public static Task<object> CustomAggregateAsync<T>(this IQueryable<T> query, string customAggregateName, Expression<Func<T, object>>[] arguments, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			ThrowIfNotXPQuery(query);
			ICustomAggregate customAggregate = ((XPQueryBase)query).GetCustomAggregate(customAggregateName);
			if (customAggregate == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("CustomAggregate_NotFound", customAggregateName));
			}
			if (!(customAggregate is ICustomAggregateQueryable customAggregateQueryable))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("CustomAggregate_DoesNotImplementInterface", customAggregateName, typeof(ICustomAggregateQueryable)));
			}
			MethodInfo methodInfo = customAggregateQueryable.GetMethodInfo();
			return ExecuteWithTopLevelFunctionAsync<T, object>(query, methodInfo, arguments, cancellationToken);
		}

	public class CustomCriteriaCollection : CustomDictionaryCollection<MethodInfo, ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable>
	{
		protected override MethodInfo GetKey(ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable item)
		{
			return item.GetMethodInfo();
		}
	}
	public static class CustomCriteriaManager
	{
		private static CustomCriteriaCollection registeredCustomCriteria = new CustomCriteriaCollection();

		[Description("Returns custom criteria registered in an application via the CustomCriteriaManager.RegisterCriterion and CustomCriteriaManager.RegisterCriteria method calls.")]
		public static int RegisteredCriterionCount => ((CustomDictionaryCollection<MethodInfo, ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable>)registeredCustomCriteria).Count;

		public static void RegisterCriterion(ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable customCriterion)
		{
			lock (registeredCustomCriteria)
			{
				((CustomDictionaryCollection<MethodInfo, ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable>)registeredCustomCriteria).Add(customCriterion);
			}
		}

		public static void RegisterCriteria(IEnumerable<ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable> customCriteria)
		{
			lock (registeredCustomCriteria)
			{
				((CustomDictionaryCollection<MethodInfo, ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable>)registeredCustomCriteria).Add(customCriteria);
			}
		}

		public static bool UnregisterCriterion(ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable customCriterion)
		{
			lock (registeredCustomCriteria)
			{
				return ((CustomDictionaryCollection<MethodInfo, ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable>)registeredCustomCriteria).Remove(customCriterion);
			}
		}

		public static bool UnregisterCriterion(MethodInfo methodInfo)
		{
			lock (registeredCustomCriteria)
			{
				ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable item = ((CustomDictionaryCollection<MethodInfo, ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable>)registeredCustomCriteria).GetItem(methodInfo);
				if (item == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ((CustomDictionaryCollection<MethodInfo, ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable>)registeredCustomCriteria).Remove(item);
			}
		}

		public static ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable GetCriteria(MethodInfo methodInfo)
		{
			return ((CustomDictionaryCollection<MethodInfo, ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable>)registeredCustomCriteria).GetItem(methodInfo);
		}

		public static CustomCriteriaCollection GetRegisteredCriteria()
		{
			CustomCriteriaCollection customCriteriaCollection = new CustomCriteriaCollection();
			lock (registeredCustomCriteria)
			{
				((CustomDictionaryCollection<MethodInfo, ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable>)customCriteriaCollection).Add((IEnumerable<ICustomCriteriaOperatorQueryable>)registeredCustomCriteria);
				return customCriteriaCollection;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class ValueConverter
	{
		[Description("When overridden in a derived class, gets the type that the property’s value is converted to when it’s saved in a data store.")]
		public abstract Type StorageType { get; }

		public abstract object ConvertToStorageType(object value);

		public abstract object ConvertFromStorageType(object value);
	}
	public class UtcDateTimeConverter : ValueConverter
	{
		[Description("Gets the type that the property’s value will be converted to when it’s saved in a data store.")]
		public override Type StorageType => typeof(DateTime);

		public override object ConvertFromStorageType(object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				return ((DateTime)value).ToLocalTime();
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override object ConvertToStorageType(object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				return ((DateTime)value).ToUniversalTime();
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class ImageValueConverter : ValueConverter
	{
		private static readonly TypeConverter imageConverterInstance;

		[Description("Gets the type that the property’s value is converted to when it’s saved in a data store.")]
		public override Type StorageType => typeof(byte[]);

		static ImageValueConverter()
		{
			Type knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(typeof(System.Drawing.Image).Assembly, "System.Drawing.ImageConverter", false, (bool?)null);
			if (knownType != null)
			{
				imageConverterInstance = (TypeConverter)Activator.CreateInstance(knownType);
			}
		}

		public override object ConvertToStorageType(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CallConvertFunction(() => imageConverterInstance.ConvertTo(value, StorageType));
		}

		public override object ConvertFromStorageType(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CallConvertFunction(() => imageConverterInstance.ConvertFrom(value));
		}

		private object CallConvertFunction(Func<object> fn)
		{
			if (imageConverterInstance == null)
			{
				throw new PlatformNotSupportedException(Res.GetString("ImageValueConverter_NotPresent"));
			}
			return fn();
		}
	}
	public abstract class XPTypeInfo
	{
		private Dictionary<string, Attribute> attributes;

		private Dictionary<Type, Attribute> typedAttributes;

		private bool? _IsPersistent;

		[Description("Gets the attributes for this type.")]
		public Attribute[] Attributes
		{
			get
			{
				if (attributes == null)
				{
					return new Attribute[0];
				}
				Attribute[] array = new Attribute[attributes.Values.Count];
				attributes.Values.CopyTo(array, 0);
				return array;
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool CanPersist { get; }

		[Description("Gets whether a class or member of this type is persistent.")]
		public bool IsPersistent
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_IsPersistent.HasValue)
				{
					_IsPersistent = CanPersist;
				}
				return _IsPersistent.Value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets whether a property or class is visible at design time.")]
		public bool IsVisibleInDesignTime => ((MemberDesignTimeVisibilityAttribute)FindAttributeInfo(typeof(MemberDesignTimeVisibilityAttribute)))?.IsVisible ?? true;

		private static string GetAttributeName(Attribute attribute)
		{
			if (!(attribute.GetType() == typeof(CustomAttribute)))
			{
				return attribute.GetType().Name;
			}
			return ((CustomAttribute)attribute).Name;
		}

		public bool HasAttribute(Type attributeType)
		{
			if (typedAttributes != null)
			{
				return typedAttributes.ContainsKey(attributeType);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool HasAttribute(string name)
		{
			if (attributes != null)
			{
				return attributes.ContainsKey(name);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Attribute FindAttributeInfo(Type attributeType)
		{
			if (typedAttributes != null)
			{
				if (!typedAttributes.TryGetValue(attributeType, out var value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Attribute FindAttributeInfo(string attributeName)
		{
			if (attributes != null)
			{
				if (!attributes.TryGetValue(attributeName, out var value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Attribute GetAttributeInfo(string name)
		{
			Attribute attribute = FindAttributeInfo(name);
			if (attribute == null)
			{
				throw new RequiredAttributeMissingException(ToString(), name);
			}
			return attribute;
		}

		public Attribute GetAttributeInfo(Type attributeType)
		{
			Attribute attribute = FindAttributeInfo(attributeType);
			if (attribute == null)
			{
				throw new RequiredAttributeMissingException(ToString(), attributeType.Name);
			}
			return attribute;
		}

		public void RemoveAttribute(Type attributeType)
		{
			if (typedAttributes != null)
			{
				typedAttributes.Remove(attributeType);
				attributes.Remove(attributeType.Name);
			}
		}

		public void AddAttribute(Attribute attribute)
		{
			if (attribute is MapToAttribute)
			{
				MapToAttribute mapToAttribute = (MapToAttribute)attribute;
				attribute = new PersistentAttribute(mapToAttribute.MappingName);
			}
			if (attribute is PersistentAttribute || attribute is NonPersistentAttribute || attribute is PersistentAliasAttribute)
			{
				RemoveAttribute(typeof(PersistentAttribute));
				RemoveAttribute(typeof(NonPersistentAttribute));
				RemoveAttribute(typeof(PersistentAliasAttribute));
			}
			string text = GetAttributeName(attribute);
			if (attributes == null)
			{
				attributes = new Dictionary<string, Attribute>();
				typedAttributes = new Dictionary<Type, Attribute>();
			}
			if (attributes.TryGetValue(text, out var _))
			{
				attributes.Remove(text);
				typedAttributes.Remove(attribute.GetType());
			}
			else
			{
				text = string.Intern(text);
			}
			attributes.Add(text, attribute);
			if (attribute.GetType() != typeof(CustomAttribute))
			{
				typedAttributes.Add(attribute.GetType(), attribute);
			}
			DropCache();
		}

		internal void DoDrop()
		{
			DropCache();
		}

		protected virtual void DropCache()
		{
			_IsPersistent = null;
		}
	}

		[Description("Gets a collection of XPMemberInfo objects that are owned by the current persistent class metadata information and all its ancestors.")]
		public ICollection<XPMemberInfo> Members
		{
			get
			{
				if (members == null)
				{
					List<XPClassInfo> list = new List<XPClassInfo>();
					for (XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = this; xPClassInfo != null; xPClassInfo = xPClassInfo.BaseClass)
					{
						list.Add(xPClassInfo);
					}
					if (IsInterface)
					{
						Type[] interfaces = ClassType.GetInterfaces();
						foreach (Type classType in interfaces)
						{
							XPClassInfo xPClassInfo2 = Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(classType);
							if (xPClassInfo2 != null)
							{
								list.Add(xPClassInfo2);
							}
						}
					}
					List<XPMemberInfo> list2 = new List<XPMemberInfo>();
					for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
					{
						list2.AddRange(list[num].OwnMembers);
					}
					members = list2.AsReadOnly();
				}
				return members;
			}
		}

		public NullableBehavior NullableBehavior
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isNullableBehaviorCached)
				{
					nullableBehaviorCachedItem = NullableBehavior.Default;
					for (XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = this; xPClassInfo != null; xPClassInfo = xPClassInfo.BaseClass)
					{
						NullableBehaviorAttribute nullableBehaviorAttribute = (NullableBehaviorAttribute)xPClassInfo.FindAttributeInfo(typeof(NullableBehaviorAttribute));
						if (nullableBehaviorAttribute != null)
						{
							nullableBehaviorCachedItem = nullableBehaviorAttribute.NullableBehavior;
							break;
						}
					}
					isNullableBehaviorCached = true;
				}
				return nullableBehaviorCachedItem;
			}
		}

		internal T CreateCache<T>(Func<T> creator)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				if (cache == null)
				{
					cache = new Dictionary<object, object>();
				}
				if (!cache.TryGetValue(creator, out var value))
				{
					value = creator();
					if (creator.Target != null && (Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(creator.Target.GetType(), typeof(CompilerGeneratedAttribute)) == null || !Array.TrueForAll(creator.Target.GetType().GetFields(), (FieldInfo ff) => ff.IsStatic)))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException();
					}
					cache.Add(creator, value);
				}
				return (T)value;
			}
		}

		protected override void DropCache()
		{
			tableName = null;
			key = null;
			members = null;
			objects = null;
			cache = null;
			collections = null;
			assocLists = null;
			persistentMembers = null;
			propertiesForInsert = null;
			propertiesForUpdate = null;
			idClass = null;
			table = null;
			directlyRefTypes = null;
			_evaluatorContextDescriptor = null;
			_evaluatorContextDescriptorInTransaction = null;
			cachedpaths = null;
			optimisticLockingReadBehaviorCache = null;
			isNullableBehaviorCached = false;
			base.DropCache();
			dictionary.OnClassInfoCacheDropped(this);
		}

		private XPMemberInfo GetKeyPropertyOfIdClass()
		{
			if (key == null)
			{
				foreach (XPMemberInfo member in Members)
				{
					if (member.IsKey)
					{
						key = member;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return key;
		}

		protected internal virtual XPMemberInfo QueryOwnMember(string memberName)
		{
			foreach (XPMemberInfo ownMember in OwnMembers)
			{
				if (ownMember.Name == memberName)
				{
					return ownMember;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void InitOptimisticLockingReadBehavior()
		{
			for (XPClassInfo baseClass = IdClass; baseClass != null; baseClass = baseClass.BaseClass)
			{
				OptimisticLockingReadBehaviorAttribute optimisticLockingReadBehaviorAttribute = (OptimisticLockingReadBehaviorAttribute)baseClass.FindAttributeInfo(typeof(OptimisticLockingReadBehaviorAttribute));
				if (optimisticLockingReadBehaviorAttribute != null)
				{
					optimisticLockingReadBehaviorCache = new OptimisticLockingReadBehaviorAttributeCacheItem(optimisticLockingReadBehaviorAttribute.TrackPropertiesModifications, optimisticLockingReadBehaviorAttribute.Behavior);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (optimisticLockingReadBehaviorCache == null)
			{
				optimisticLockingReadBehaviorCache = new OptimisticLockingReadBehaviorAttributeCacheItem(null, OptimisticLockingReadBehavior.Default);
			}
		}

		protected void InitServiceMembers()
		{
			if (this == IdClass)
			{
				string optimisticLockFieldName = OptimisticLockFieldName;
				OptimisticLockingBehavior optimisticLockingBehavior = OptimisticLockingBehavior.NoLocking;
				for (XPClassInfo baseClass = IdClass; baseClass != null; baseClass = baseClass.BaseClass)
				{
					OptimisticLockingAttribute optimisticLockingAttribute = (OptimisticLockingAttribute)baseClass.FindAttributeInfo(typeof(OptimisticLockingAttribute));
					if (optimisticLockingAttribute != null)
					{
						optimisticLockingBehavior = optimisticLockingAttribute.LockingKind;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (optimisticLockFieldName != null && optimisticLockingBehavior == OptimisticLockingBehavior.ConsiderOptimisticLockingField)
				{
					optimisticLockingCache = new OptimisticLockingCacheItem(optimisticLockingBehavior, new OptimisticLockField(this, optimisticLockFieldName), new OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer(this, OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayerName));
				}
				else
				{
					optimisticLockingCache = new OptimisticLockingCacheItem(optimisticLockingBehavior, null, null);
				}
				bool flag = false;
				for (XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = this; xPClassInfo != null; xPClassInfo = xPClassInfo.BaseClass)
				{
					DeferredDeletionAttribute deferredDeletionAttribute = (DeferredDeletionAttribute)xPClassInfo.FindAttributeInfo(typeof(DeferredDeletionAttribute));
					if (deferredDeletionAttribute != null)
					{
						flag = deferredDeletionAttribute.Enabled;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					new GCRecordField(this);
				}
			}
			else if (BaseClass != null && IdClass != null && !BaseClass.IsTypedObject)
			{
				new ObjectTypeField(IdClass);
				IdClass.isTypedObject = true;
			}
		}

		protected void CheckMembers()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in PersistentProperties)
			{
				if (dictionary.ContainsKey(persistentProperty.MappingField))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_DuplicateMappingField", persistentProperty.MappingField, FullName));
				}
				dictionary.Add(persistentProperty.MappingField, null);
				if (persistentProperty.IsKey)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						throw new DuplicateKeyPropertyException(FullName);
					}
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo member in Members)
			{
				if (member.IsKey && (!member.IsPersistent || member.IsReadOnly))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_NonpesistentKey", FullName, member.Name));
				}
				if (member.Converter != null && (member.IsKey || member.ReferenceType != null))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_ConverterOnKeyOrReference", FullName, member.Name));
				}
				if (member.IsKey)
				{
					foreach (XPMemberInfo subMember in member.SubMembers)
					{
						if (subMember.Converter != null)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_ConverterOnKeyOrReference", FullName, subMember.Name));
						}
					}
				}
				if (member.IsAliased && Dictionary.UseStrictMetadataValidation)
				{
					PersistentAliasAttribute persistentAliasAttribute = (PersistentAliasAttribute)member.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(PersistentAliasAttribute));
					CriteriaOperator criteria = persistentAliasAttribute.Criteria;
					OperandProperty val = (OperandProperty)(object)((criteria is OperandProperty) ? criteria : null);
					if (val != null && val.PropertyName == member.Name)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_PersistentAliasCircular", member.Owner.FullName, member.Name, persistentAliasAttribute.Criteria));
					}
				}
				if (member.IsFetchOnly && (!member.IsPersistent || member.IsCollection || member.IsKey || member.IsAssociation || member.IsAssociationList || member.IsAliased || member.IsManyToMany || member.IsManyToManyAlias || (member.ValueParent != null && member.ValueParent.IsStruct)))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_FetchOnlyAttributeNotApplicable", member.Owner.FullName, member.Name));
				}
			}
		}

		public XPMemberInfo FindMember(string memberName)
		{
			if (memberName == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = this; xPClassInfo != null; xPClassInfo = xPClassInfo.BaseClass)
			{
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = xPClassInfo.QueryOwnMember(memberName);
				if (xPMemberInfo != null)
				{
					return xPMemberInfo;
				}
			}
			if (IsInterface)
			{
				Type[] interfaces = ClassType.GetInterfaces();
				foreach (Type classType in interfaces)
				{
					XPClassInfo xPClassInfo2 = Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(classType);
					if (xPClassInfo2 != null)
					{
						XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo2 = xPClassInfo2.QueryOwnMember(memberName);
						if (xPMemberInfo2 != null)
						{
							return xPMemberInfo2;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public XPMemberInfo GetMember(string memberName)
		{
			XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = FindMember(memberName);
			if (xPMemberInfo != null)
			{
				return xPMemberInfo;
			}
			throw new PropertyMissingException(FullName, (memberName == null) ? "<null>" : memberName);
		}

		internal MemberInfoCollection ParsePersistentPath(string path)
		{
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = ParsePath(path);
			if (memberInfoCollection.HasNonPersistent)
			{
				throw new InvalidPropertyPathException(Res.GetString("MetaData_IncorrectPathMemberNotExists", FullName, path, string.Empty, string.Empty));
			}
			return memberInfoCollection;
		}

		internal MemberInfoCollection ParsePath(string path)
		{
			if (cachedpaths == null || !cachedpaths.TryGetValue(path, out var value))
			{
				value = new MemberInfoCollection(this, path, addNonPersistent: true);
				lock (this)
				{
					if (cachedpaths == null)
					{
						cachedpaths = new Dictionary<string, MemberInfoCollection>();
					}
					if (!cachedpaths.ContainsKey(path))
					{
						cachedpaths.Add(path, value);
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public XPMemberInfo GetPersistentMember(string memberName)
		{
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in PersistentProperties)
			{
				if (persistentProperty.Name == memberName)
				{
					return persistentProperty;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return FullName;
		}

		protected virtual string GetDefaultTableName()
		{
			return FullName;
		}

		protected virtual string GetTableName()
		{
			if (base.IsPersistent && GetTableMapType() == MapInheritanceType.OwnTable)
			{
				PersistentAttribute persistentAttribute = (PersistentAttribute)FindAttributeInfo(typeof(PersistentAttribute));
				if (persistentAttribute != null && persistentAttribute.MapTo != null && persistentAttribute.MapTo.Length > 0)
				{
					return persistentAttribute.MapTo;
				}
				return GetDefaultTableName();
			}
			if (base.IsPersistent && GetTableMapType() != MapInheritanceType.OwnTable && IdClass == this)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_YouCannotApplyTheMapInheritanceParentTable"));
			}
			if (BaseClass != null)
			{
				return BaseClass.TableName;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static void AddClassToDirectlyRefTypes(Dictionary<XPClassInfo, object> targetList, XPClassInfo info, string refClassName, string refMemberName)
		{
			try
			{
				info.CheckAbstractReference();
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				throw new UnableToFillRefTypeException(refClassName, refMemberName, innerException);
			}
			if (!targetList.ContainsKey(info))
			{
				targetList.Add(info, null);
			}
		}

		private ICollection GetDirectlyRefTypes()
		{
			if (directlyRefTypes == null)
			{
				Dictionary<XPClassInfo, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, object>();
				if (PersistentBaseClass != null)
				{
					AddClassToDirectlyRefTypes(dictionary, PersistentBaseClass, FullName, KeyProperty.Name);
					if (TableMapType == MapInheritanceType.ParentTable)
					{
						foreach (XPMemberInfo ownMember in OwnMembers)
						{
							if (!ownMember.IsPersistent || ownMember.ReferenceType == null)
							{
								continue;
							}
							lock (PersistentBaseClass)
							{
								if (PersistentBaseClass.childrenWithRelationsMappedToMe == null)
								{
									PersistentBaseClass.childrenWithRelationsMappedToMe = new List<XPClassInfo>();
								}
								if (!PersistentBaseClass.childrenWithRelationsMappedToMe.Contains(this))
								{
									PersistentBaseClass.childrenWithRelationsMappedToMe.Add(this);
								}
							}
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in ObjectProperties)
				{
					AddClassToDirectlyRefTypes(dictionary, objectProperty.ReferenceType, FullName, objectProperty.Name);
				}
				foreach (XPMemberInfo associationListProperty in AssociationListProperties)
				{
					AddClassToDirectlyRefTypes(dictionary, associationListProperty.CollectionElementType, FullName, associationListProperty.Name);
					if (associationListProperty.IsManyToMany)
					{
						AddClassToDirectlyRefTypes(dictionary, associationListProperty.IntermediateClass, FullName, associationListProperty.Name);
					}
				}
				if (IsGCRecordObject)
				{
					AddClassToDirectlyRefTypes(dictionary, Dictionary.GetClassInfo(typeof(XPObjectType)), FullName, GCRecordField.StaticName);
				}
				directlyRefTypes = ListHelper.FromCollection(dictionary.Keys);
			}
			return directlyRefTypes;
		}

		private void FillRefTypes(Dictionary<XPClassInfo, object> filled)
		{
			CheckAbstractReference();
			if (filled.ContainsKey(this))
			{
				return;
			}
			filled.Add(this, null);
			foreach (XPClassInfo directlyRefType in GetDirectlyRefTypes())
			{
				directlyRefType.FillRefTypes(filled);
			}
			if (childrenWithRelationsMappedToMe == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XPClassInfo item in childrenWithRelationsMappedToMe)
			{
				item.FillRefTypes(filled);
			}
		}

		public ICollection GetRefTypes()
		{
			Dictionary<XPClassInfo, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, object>();
			FillRefTypes(dictionary);
			return ListHelper.FromCollection(dictionary.Keys);
		}

		private void CreateTable()
		{
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DBTable val = (DBTable)((BaseClass == null || !(BaseClass.TableName == TableName)) ? ((object)new DBTable(TableName)) : ((object)BaseClass.Table));
			if (base.IsPersistent)
			{
				DBTableHelper.ProcessClassInfo(val, this);
			}
			table = val;
		}

		private bool IsAssignableToCore(XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			if (classInfo == this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (BaseClass == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return BaseClass.IsAssignableToCore(classInfo);
		}

		public bool IsAssignableTo(XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			if (classInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsAssignableToCore(classInfo))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (classInfo.IsInterface && ClassType != null)
			{
				Type[] interfaces = ClassType.GetInterfaces();
				foreach (Type type in interfaces)
				{
					if (type == classInfo.ClassType)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private MemberInfoCollection GetPropertiesListForUpdateInsert(object theObject, bool isUpdate, bool addDelayedReference)
		{
			if (isUpdate)
			{
				if (propertiesForUpdate == null)
				{
					MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = new MemberInfoCollection(this);
					foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in PersistentProperties)
					{
						if (persistentProperty is ObjectTypeField || persistentProperty.IsKey)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (persistentProperty.IsDelayed)
						{
							hasDelayedProperties = true;
							XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(theObject, persistentProperty);
							if (XPDelayedProperty.UpdateModifiedOnly(persistentProperty))
							{
								if (!delayedPropertyContainer.IsModified)
								{
									continue;
								}
							}
							else if (!delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded && (!addDelayedReference || persistentProperty.ReferenceType == null))
							{
								continue;
							}
						}
						if (persistentProperty.IsFetchOnly)
						{
							if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType != null)
							{
								throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_FetchOnlyAttributeNotApplicableToReference", persistentProperty.Owner.FullName, persistentProperty.Name));
							}
						}
						else
						{
							memberInfoCollection.Add(persistentProperty);
						}
					}
					if (!hasDelayedProperties)
					{
						propertiesForUpdate = memberInfoCollection;
					}
					return memberInfoCollection;
				}
				return propertiesForUpdate;
			}
			if (propertiesForInsert == null)
			{
				MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection2 = new MemberInfoCollection(this);
				foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty2 in PersistentProperties)
				{
					if (persistentProperty2.IsFetchOnly)
					{
						if (persistentProperty2.ReferenceType != null)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_FetchOnlyAttributeNotApplicableToReference", persistentProperty2.Owner.FullName, persistentProperty2.Name));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						memberInfoCollection2.Add(persistentProperty2);
					}
				}
				propertiesForInsert = memberInfoCollection2;
				return memberInfoCollection2;
			}
			return propertiesForInsert;
		}

		public static MemberInfoCollection GetPropertiesListForUpdateInsert(Session session, object theObject, bool isUpdate, bool addDelayedReference)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = session.GetClassInfo(theObject);
			return classInfo.GetPropertiesListForUpdateInsert(theObject, isUpdate, addDelayedReference);
		}

		{
			if (!base.IsPersistent)
			{
				throw new NonPersistentReferenceFoundException(FullName);
			}
		}

				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		}

		public virtual object CreateObject(Session session)
		{
			if (session.IsObjectsLoading)
			{
				return CreateObjectInstance(session, this);
			}
			SessionStateStack.Enter(session, SessionState.CreateObjectLoadingEnforcer);
			try
			{
				return CreateObjectInstance(session, this);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(session, SessionState.CreateObjectLoadingEnforcer);
			}
		}

		{
			return CreateObjectInstance(session, this);
		}

		private XPCustomMemberInfo CreateMember(string propertyName, Type propertyType, XPClassInfo referenceType, bool nonPersistent, bool nonPublic, params Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			if (!SupportObjectsReferencesFromCustomMembers && !(this is XPDataTableClassInfo) && (referenceType != null || Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(propertyType) != null || typeof(XPBaseCollection).IsAssignableFrom(propertyType)))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("Metadata_CustomProperties_ReferenceOrCollectionInSessionStore", FullName, propertyName, typeof(IXPCustomPropertyStore).FullName));
			}
			XPCustomMemberInfo xPCustomMemberInfo = new XPCustomMemberInfo(this, propertyName, propertyType, referenceType, nonPersistent, nonPublic);
			foreach (Attribute attribute in attributes)
			{
				xPCustomMemberInfo.AddAttribute(attribute);
			}
			return xPCustomMemberInfo;
		}

		internal void TouchRecursive(Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo> processedClassInfos)
		{
			if (processedClassInfos.ContainsKey(this))
			{
				return;
			}
			processedClassInfos.Add(this, this);
			if (BaseClass != null)
			{
				BaseClass.TouchRecursive(processedClassInfos);
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo item in new List<XPMemberInfo>(OwnMembers))
			{
				if (item.ReferenceType != null)
				{
					item.ReferenceType.TouchRecursive(processedClassInfos);
				}
				if (item.IsAssociationList)
				{
					if (item.IsManyToMany)
					{
						item.IntermediateClass.TouchRecursive(processedClassInfos);
					}
					else
					{
						item.CollectionElementType.TouchRecursive(processedClassInfos);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static string GetShortAssemblyName(Assembly assembly)
		{
			int num = assembly.FullName.IndexOf(',');
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return assembly.FullName.Substring(0, num);
			}
			return assembly.FullName;
		}

		public bool IsIdentity
		{
			get
			{
				if (StorageType == typeof(int) || StorageType == typeof(long))
				{
					return IsAutoGenerate;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool? IsNullable
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isNullableCached)
				{
					NullableAttribute nullableAttribute = (NullableAttribute)FindAttributeInfo(typeof(NullableAttribute));
					if (nullableAttribute != null)
					{
						isNullable = nullableAttribute.IsNullable;
					}
					else
					{
						isNullable = null;
					}
					isNullableCached = true;
				}
				return isNullable;
			}
		}

		public object DefaultValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isDefaultValueCached)
				{
					ColumnDefaultValueAttribute columnDefaultValueAttribute = (ColumnDefaultValueAttribute)FindAttributeInfo(typeof(ColumnDefaultValueAttribute));
					if (columnDefaultValueAttribute != null)
					{
						defaultValue = columnDefaultValueAttribute.DefaultValue;
					}
					else
					{
						defaultValue = null;
					}
					isDefaultValueCached = true;
				}
				return defaultValue;
			}
		}

					if (columnDbDefaultValueAttribute != null)

					}
					else
					{
						dbDefaultValue = null;
					}
					isDbDefaultValueCached = true;
				}
				return dbDefaultValue;

		public bool IsFetchOnly
		{

					isFetchOnly = fetchOnlyAttribute != null;

		[Description("Gets the value converter.")]

		{
			get
			{
				ValueConverterAttribute valueConverterAttribute = (ValueConverterAttribute)FindAttributeInfo(typeof(ValueConverterAttribute));
				if (valueConverterAttribute != null)
				{
					return valueConverterAttribute.Converter;
				}
				return Owner.Dictionary.GetConverter(MemberType);
			}

		[Description("Gets the type that the member’s value is saved as in the data store.")]
		public Type StorageType
		{
			get
			{
				ValueConverter converter = Converter;
				if (converter != null)
				{
					return converter.StorageType;
				}
				if (MemberType != null)
				{
					Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(MemberType);
					if (underlyingType != null)
					{
						return underlyingType;
					}
				}
				return MemberType;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the column’s name in the data store which the member’s value is stored in.")]
		public string MappingField
		{
			get
			{
				if (mappingField == null && (base.IsPersistent || IsStruct))
				{
					PersistentAttribute persistentAttribute = (PersistentAttribute)FindAttributeInfo(PersistentAttribute.AttributeType);
					if (persistentAttribute != null)
					{
						mappingField = persistentAttribute.MapTo;
					}
					if (mappingField == null || (mappingField.Length == 0 && (ReferenceType == null || ReferenceType.KeyProperty == null || !ReferenceType.KeyProperty.IsStruct)))
					{
						mappingField = GetDefaultMappingField();
					}
				}
				return mappingField;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the maximum number of characters that can be stored in a field which the member is mapped to.")]
		public int MappingFieldSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isMappingFieldInitialized)
				{
					InitializeMappingField();
				}
				return mappingFieldSize;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the XPClassInfo object which owns this XPMemberInfo object.")]

		[Description("When implemented in a derived class, gets the member’s name.")]

		[Description("Gets the member’s display name.")]
		public string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				Attribute[] array = base.Attributes;
				foreach (Attribute attribute in array)
				{
					if (attribute is DisplayNameAttribute displayNameAttribute)
					{
						return displayNameAttribute.DisplayName;
					}
				}
				Attribute[] array2 = base.Attributes;
				foreach (Attribute attribute2 in array2)
				{
					if (attribute2 is System.ComponentModel.DisplayNameAttribute displayNameAttribute2)
					{
						return displayNameAttribute2.DisplayName;
					}
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets whether the member represents a collection and is involved in associations.")]
		public bool IsCollection
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isCollection.HasValue)
				{
					isCollection = IsAssociationList && MemberType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(XPBaseCollection));
				}
				return isCollection.Value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Indicates whether the current member represents the “many” side of the association.")]
		public bool IsAssociationList
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isAssociationList.HasValue)
				{
					isAssociationList = IsAssociation && !Owner.Dictionary.CanGetClassInfoByType(MemberType) && IsAssociationListType();
				}
				return isAssociationList.Value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Indicates whether the current member represents a collection that is not decorated with AssociationAttribute.")]
		public bool IsNonAssociationList
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isNonAssociationList.HasValue)
				{
					isNonAssociationList = !IsAssociation && !Owner.Dictionary.CanGetClassInfoByType(MemberType) && Owner.Dictionary.CanGetClassInfoByType(GetGenericIListTypeArgument(MemberType));
				}
				return isNonAssociationList.Value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Indicates whether the ManyToManyAliasAttribute attribute is applied.")]

		{
			get

					isManyToManyAlias = !IsAssociationList && HasAttribute(typeof(ManyToManyAliasAttribute));
				}
				return isManyToManyAlias.Value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the XPClassInfo of the persistent object if the current member is a collection of these persistent objects.")]
		public XPClassInfo CollectionElementType
		{
			get
			{
				if (collectionElementType == null)
				{
					if (IsAssociationList)
					{
						AssociationAttribute associationAttribute = FindAssociationAttributeInfo();
						if (associationAttribute != null)
						{
							if (associationAttribute.ElementType != null)
							{
								collectionElementType = Owner.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(associationAttribute.ElementType);
							}
							if (collectionElementType == null)
							{
								if (associationAttribute.ElementTypeName.Length > 0)
								{
									collectionElementType = Owner.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(associationAttribute.AssemblyName, associationAttribute.ElementTypeName);
								}
								else
								{
									Type genericIListTypeArgument = GetGenericIListTypeArgument(MemberType);
									if (genericIListTypeArgument != null)
									{
										collectionElementType = Owner.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(genericIListTypeArgument);
									}
								}
							}
						}
						if (collectionElementType == null)
						{
							throw new AssociationElementTypeMissingException(Name);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (!IsNonAssociationList)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_NotCollection", Owner.FullName, Name));
						}
						Type genericIListTypeArgument2 = GetGenericIListTypeArgument(MemberType);
						collectionElementType = Owner.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(genericIListTypeArgument2);
					}
				}
				return collectionElementType;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets whether the member sets up the relation.")]
		public bool IsAssociation => HasAttribute(typeof(AssociationAttribute));

		[Description("Gets whether a member is involved in a many-to-many association.")]
		public bool IsManyToMany => IntermediateClass != null;

		public IntermediateClassInfo IntermediateClass
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsCollection)
				{
					return null;
				}
				GetAssociatedMember();
				return intermediateClass;
			}
		}

					isReferenceTypeCached = true;

				return referenceType;
			}

		[Description("Gets whether the member references other aggregated persistent objects.")]

		public OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior MergeCollisionBehavior
		{
			get
			{
				if (!mergeCollisionBehavior.HasValue)
				{
					MergeCollisionBehaviorAttribute mergeCollisionBehaviorAttribute = (MergeCollisionBehaviorAttribute)FindAttributeInfo(typeof(MergeCollisionBehaviorAttribute));
					if (mergeCollisionBehaviorAttribute == null)
					{
						mergeCollisionBehavior = OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Default;
					}
					else
					{
						mergeCollisionBehavior = mergeCollisionBehaviorAttribute.Behavior;
					}
				}
				return mergeCollisionBehavior.Value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsOptimisticLockingIgnored
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isOptimisticLockingIgnored.HasValue)
				{
					OptimisticLockingIgnoredAttribute optimisticLockingIgnoredAttribute = (OptimisticLockingIgnoredAttribute)FindAttributeInfo(typeof(OptimisticLockingIgnoredAttribute));
					isOptimisticLockingIgnored = optimisticLockingIgnoredAttribute != null;
				}
				return isOptimisticLockingIgnored.Value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsExpandableToPersistent
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.IsPersistent && !IsAliased && !IsAssociationList)
				{
					return IsManyToManyAlias;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected override void DropCache()
		{
			mappingField = null;
			isDelayedCached = false;
			isAliasedCached = false;
			collectionElementType = null;
			isCollection = null;
			isAssociationList = null;
			isNonAssociationList = null;
			isManyToManyAlias = null;
			isNullableCached = false;
			isDefaultValueCached = false;
			isDbDefaultValueCached = false;
			isFetchOnly = null;
			isMappingFieldInitialized = false;
			base.DropCache();
			Owner.DoDrop();
		}

		protected virtual string GetDefaultMappingField()
		{
			return Name;
		}

		private void InitializeMappingField()
		{
			InitializeMappingFieldSize();
			InitializeMappingFieldDBType();
			InitializeMappingFieldDBTypeName();
			isMappingFieldInitialized = true;
		}

		private void InitializeMappingFieldSize()
		{
			if (StorageType == typeof(string))
			{
				SizeAttribute sizeAttribute = (SizeAttribute)FindAttributeInfo(typeof(SizeAttribute));
				if (sizeAttribute != null)
				{
					mappingFieldSize = sizeAttribute.Size;
				}
				else
				{
					mappingFieldSize = XpoDefault.DefaultStringMappingFieldSize;
				}
			}
			else if (ReferenceType != null && ReferenceType.KeyProperty != null)
			{
				mappingFieldSize = ReferenceType.KeyProperty.MappingFieldSize;
			}
			else
			{
				mappingFieldSize = 0;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeMappingFieldDBType()
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsStruct || IsAssociationList || IsManyToMany || IsManyToManyAlias)
			{
				mappingFieldDBType = (DBColumnType)0;
			}
			else if (ReferenceType != null && ReferenceType.KeyProperty != null)
			{
				mappingFieldDBType = ReferenceType.KeyProperty.MappingFieldDBType;
			}
			else
			{
				mappingFieldDBType = DBColumn.GetColumnType(StorageType, true);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeMappingFieldDBTypeName()
		{
			if (ReferenceType == null || ReferenceType.KeyProperty == null)
			{
				DbTypeAttribute dbTypeAttribute = (DbTypeAttribute)FindAttributeInfo(typeof(DbTypeAttribute));
				if (dbTypeAttribute != null)
				{
					mappingFieldDBTypeName = dbTypeAttribute.DbColumnTypeName;
				}
				else
				{
					mappingFieldDBTypeName = null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				mappingFieldDBTypeName = ReferenceType.KeyProperty.MappingFieldDBTypeName;
			}
		}

		{

			this.isReadOnly = isReadOnly;

		public bool IsMappingClass(XPClassInfo branch)
		{
			XPClassInfo mappingClass = GetMappingClass(branch);
			if (mappingClass == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return branch.TableName == mappingClass.TableName;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Name;
		}

		public XPClassInfo GetMappingClass(XPClassInfo branch)
		{
			if (!branch.IsAssignableTo(Owner))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!branch.IsPersistent)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (IsKey)
			{
				return branch;
			}
			if (valueParent != null)
			{
				return valueParent.GetMappingClass(branch);
			}
			if (Owner.IsPersistent)
			{
				return Owner;
			}
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = branch;
			for (XPClassInfo baseClass = xPClassInfo.BaseClass; baseClass != Owner; baseClass = baseClass.BaseClass)
			{
				if (baseClass.IsPersistent)
				{
					xPClassInfo = baseClass;
				}
			}
			return xPClassInfo;
		}

		public XPMemberInfo GetAssociatedMember()
		{
			if (associatedMember == null)
			{
				AssociationAttribute associationAttributeInfo = GetAssociationAttributeInfo();
				string text = associationAttributeInfo.Name;
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = string.Empty;
				}
				if (!Owner.IsPersistent)
				{
					throw new AssociationInvalidException(Res.GetString("Metadata_AssociationInvalid_NonPersistentClassInTheAssociation", Owner.FullName, Name, Owner.FullName));
				}
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo;
				if (IsAssociationList)
				{
					xPClassInfo = CollectionElementType;
				}
				else
				{
					if (ReferenceType == null || !base.IsPersistent)
					{
						throw new AssociationInvalidException(Res.GetString("Metadata_AssociationInvalid_AssociationAttributeOnlyForListOrReference", text, Owner.FullName, Name));
					}
					xPClassInfo = ReferenceType;
				}
				if (!xPClassInfo.IsPersistent)
				{
					throw new AssociationInvalidException(Res.GetString("Metadata_AssociationInvalid_NonPersistentClassInTheAssociation", Owner.FullName, Name, xPClassInfo.FullName));
				}
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = null;
				foreach (XPMemberInfo item in new List<XPMemberInfo>(xPClassInfo.OwnMembers))
				{
					if (this == item || ((item.ReferenceType == null || !item.IsPersistent) && !item.IsAssociationList))
					{
						continue;
					}
					AssociationAttribute associationAttribute = item.FindAssociationAttributeInfo();
					if (associationAttribute == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					string text2 = associationAttribute.Name;
					if (text2 == null)
					{
						text2 = string.Empty;
					}
					if (text != text2)
					{
						continue;
					}
					XPClassInfo xPClassInfo2 = (item.IsAssociationList ? item.CollectionElementType : item.ReferenceType);
					if (xPClassInfo2 != Owner)
					{
						if (text.Length != 0)
						{
							throw new AssociationInvalidException(Res.GetString("Metadata_AssociationInvalid_PropertyTypeMismatch", text, Owner.FullName, Name, item.Owner.FullName, item.Name, xPClassInfo2.FullName));
						}
						continue;
					}
					if (xPMemberInfo != null)
					{
						throw new AssociationInvalidException(Res.GetString("Metadata_AssociationInvalid_MoreThenOneAssociatedMemberFound", text, xPClassInfo.FullName, xPMemberInfo.Name, item.Name));
					}
					if (!IsAssociationList && !item.IsAssociationList)
					{
						throw new AssociationInvalidException(Res.GetString("Metadata_AssociationInvalid_NoAssociationListInAssociation", text, Owner.FullName, Name, item.Owner.FullName, item.Name));
					}
					if (IsAssociationList && item.IsAssociationList && (!IsCollection || !item.IsCollection))
					{
						throw new AssociationInvalidException(Res.GetString("Metadata_AssociationInvalid_TwoAssociationListsInAssociation", text, Owner.FullName, Name, item.Owner.FullName, item.Name));
					}
					if (associationAttribute.UseAssociationNameAsIntermediateTableName != associationAttributeInfo.UseAssociationNameAsIntermediateTableName)
					{
						throw new AssociationInvalidException(Res.GetString("Metadata_AssociationInvalid_UseAssociationNameAsIntermediateTableNameMismatch", text, Owner.FullName, Name, item.Owner.FullName, item.Name));
					}
					xPMemberInfo = item;
				}
				if (xPMemberInfo == null)
				{
					throw new AssociationInvalidException(Res.GetString("Metadata_AssociationInvalid_NotFound", text, Owner.FullName, Name, xPClassInfo.FullName));
				}
				associatedMember = xPMemberInfo;
				if (IsCollection && associatedMember.IsCollection)
				{
					string tableNameOverload = (associationAttributeInfo.UseAssociationNameAsIntermediateTableName ? associationAttributeInfo.Name : null);
					InitIntermediateClassInfo(associatedMember, tableNameOverload);
				}
			}
			return associatedMember;
		}

		[Obsolete("Use GetAssociatedMember method instead", true)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public XPMemberInfo GetAssociatedProperty()
		{
			if (IsAssociation)
			{
				return GetAssociatedMember();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static Type GetGenericIListTypeArgument(Type elementType)
		{
			if (elementType == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (elementType.IsInterface && elementType.IsGenericType && elementType.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IList<>))
			{
				return elementType.GetGenericArguments()[0];
			}
			Type[] interfaces = elementType.GetInterfaces();
			foreach (Type type in interfaces)
			{
				if (type.IsGenericType && type.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IList<>))
				{
					return type.GetGenericArguments()[0];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool IsAssociationListType()
		{
			if (typeof(IList).IsAssignableFrom(MemberType))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return Owner.Dictionary.CanGetClassInfoByType(GetGenericIListTypeArgument(MemberType));
		}

		[Obsolete("Use GetAssociatedMember method instead", true)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public XPMemberInfo GetAssociatedCollectionProperty()
		{
			return GetAssociatedMember();
		}

		public void ProcessAssociationRefChange(Session session, object referenceMemberOwner, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			ProcessAssociationRefChange(session, referenceMemberOwner, oldValue, newValue, skipNonLoadedCollections: false);
		}

		internal void ProcessAssociationRefChange(Session session, object referenceMemberOwner, object oldValue, object newValue, bool skipNonLoadedCollections)
		{
			if (oldValue == newValue || ReferenceType == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			session.ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(newValue);
			if (!IsAssociation)
			{
				return;
			}
			XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = GetAssociatedMember();
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				IList list = (IList)xPMemberInfo.GetValue(oldValue);
				if (list != null && (!skipNonLoadedCollections || !xPMemberInfo.IsCollection || ((XPBaseCollection)list).IsLoaded))
				{
					if (xPMemberInfo.IsCollection)
					{
						XPRefCollectionHelperOneToMany refCollectionHelperChecked = XPRefCollectionHelper.GetRefCollectionHelperChecked<XPRefCollectionHelperOneToMany>((XPBaseCollection)list, oldValue, xPMemberInfo);
						object assocRefChangeRemovingObject = refCollectionHelperChecked.AssocRefChangeRemovingObject;
						refCollectionHelperChecked.AssocRefChangeRemovingObject = referenceMemberOwner;
						try
						{
							list.Remove(referenceMemberOwner);
						}
						finally
						{
							refCollectionHelperChecked.AssocRefChangeRemovingObject = assocRefChangeRemovingObject;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						list.Remove(referenceMemberOwner);
					}
				}
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				IList list2 = (IList)xPMemberInfo.GetValue(newValue);
				if (list2 != null && (!skipNonLoadedCollections || !xPMemberInfo.IsCollection || ((XPBaseCollection)list2).IsLoaded))
				{
					list2.Add(referenceMemberOwner);
				}
			}
		}

		protected AssociationAttribute FindAssociationAttributeInfo()
		{
			return (AssociationAttribute)FindAttributeInfo(typeof(AssociationAttribute));
		}

		protected AssociationAttribute GetAssociationAttributeInfo()
		{
			return (AssociationAttribute)GetAttributeInfo(typeof(AssociationAttribute));
		}

		private void InitIntermediateClassInfo(XPMemberInfo relatedProperty, string tableNameOverload)
		{
			bool isLeft;
			string relationTableName = GetRelationTableName(out isLeft, relatedProperty, tableNameOverload);
			intermediateClass = (IntermediateClassInfo)Owner.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo("", relationTableName);
			if (intermediateClass == null)
			{
				intermediateClass = new IntermediateClassInfo(isLeft ? this : relatedProperty, isLeft ? relatedProperty : this, Owner.Dictionary, relationTableName);
			}
		}

		private string GetRelationTableName(out bool isLeft, XPMemberInfo relatedProperty, string tableNameOverload)
		{
			string text = CollectionElementType.TableName + Name;
			string text2 = relatedProperty.CollectionElementType.TableName + relatedProperty.Name;
			isLeft = text2.CompareTo(text) > 0;
			if (tableNameOverload != null && tableNameOverload.Length > 0)
			{
				return tableNameOverload;
			}
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, isLeft ? "{0}_{1}" : "{1}_{0}", new object[2] { text2, text });
		}

		public object ExpandId(object id)
		{
			if (SubMembers.Count > 0)
			{
				if (id is ArrayList)
				{
					id = new IdList((ArrayList)id);
				}
				else if (id is List<object>)
				{
					id = ((id is IdList) ? id : new IdList((List<object>)id));
				}
				else
				{
					IdList idList = new IdList();
					foreach (XPMemberInfo subMember in SubMembers)
					{
						if (subMember.IsPersistent)
						{
							idList.Add(subMember.ExpandId(subMember.GetConst(id, this)));
						}
					}
					id = idList;
				}
			}
			else if (ReferenceType != null)
			{
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = Owner.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(id);
				if (xPClassInfo != null)
				{
					id = ReferenceType.GetId(id);
				}
			}
			return id;
		}

		public virtual Expression MakeGetExpression(Expression ownerExpression)
		{
			Expression expression = Expression.Call(Expression.Constant(this), "GetValue", null, ownerExpression);
			if (MemberType != typeof(object))
			{
				expression = Expression.Convert(expression, NullableHelpers.GetUnBoxedType(MemberType));
			}
			return expression;
		}
	}
	public class XPCustomMemberInfo : XPMemberInfo
	{
		private readonly string propertyName;

		private readonly Type propertyType;

		private readonly XPClassInfo referenceType;

		private readonly bool isPublic;

		private readonly bool isPersistent;

		[Description("Gets the XPClassInfo of the referenced object if the member is a reference to another persistent object.")]
		public override XPClassInfo ReferenceType
		{
			get
			{
				if (referenceType != null)
				{
					return referenceType;
				}
				return base.ReferenceType;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the member’s name.")]
		public override string Name => propertyName;

		[Description("Gets whether the member is public.")]
		public override bool IsPublic => isPublic;

		[Description("Gets the member’s type.")]
		public override Type MemberType => propertyType;

		protected override bool CanPersist => isPersistent;

		public XPCustomMemberInfo(XPClassInfo owner, string propertyName, Type propertyType, XPClassInfo referenceType, bool nonPersistent, bool nonPublic)
			: base(owner, isReadOnly: false)
		{
			if (propertyType == null && referenceType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("propertyType, referenceType");
			}
			if (propertyName == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("propertyName");
			}
			this.propertyName = propertyName;
			this.propertyType = propertyType;
			this.referenceType = referenceType;
			isPublic = !nonPublic;
			isPersistent = !nonPersistent;
			base.Owner.AddMember(this);
		}

		protected virtual IXPCustomPropertyStore GetStore(object theObject)
		{
			return PersistentBase.GetCustomPropertyStore(theObject);
		}

		public override object GetValue(object theObject)
		{
			object customPropertyValue = GetStore(theObject).GetCustomPropertyValue(this);
			if (base.IsDelayed)
			{
				return ((XPDelayedProperty)customPropertyValue).Value;
			}
			return customPropertyValue;
		}

		public override void SetValue(object theObject, object theValue)
		{
			if (base.IsDelayed)
			{
				((XPDelayedProperty)GetStore(theObject).GetCustomPropertyValue(this)).SetValue(theValue);
			}
			else
			{
				GetStore(theObject).SetCustomPropertyValue(this, theValue);
			}
		}

		public override bool GetModified(object theObject)
		{
			return PersistentBase.GetModificationsStore(theObject).GetPropertyModified(this);
		}

		public override void SetModified(object theObject, object oldValue)
		{
			PersistentBase.GetModificationsStore(theObject).SetPropertyModified(this, oldValue);
		}

		public override object GetOldValue(object theObject)
		{
			return PersistentBase.GetModificationsStore(theObject).GetPropertyOldValue(this);
		}

		public override void ResetModified(object theObject)
		{
			PersistentBase.GetModificationsStore(theObject).ResetPropertyModified(this);
		}
	}
