	public class XPDataTableClassInfo : XPClassInfo
	{
		private IList<XPMemberInfo> _ownMembers = new List<XPMemberInfo>();

		private XPClassInfo baseClass;

		private string className;

		private Type type;

		private string tableName;

		public override Type ClassType => type;

		protected internal override Type RealInstanceType => typeof(XPDataTableObject);

		public override XPClassInfo BaseClass => baseClass;

		public override string FullName => className;

		public override string AssemblyName => XPDataObjectClassInfo.DataObjectsAssembly;

		protected override bool CanPersist => !HasAttribute(NonPersistentAttribute.AttributeType);

		public override ICollection<XPMemberInfo> OwnMembers => _ownMembers;

		public XPDataTableClassInfo(XPDictionary dictionary, Type type)
			: base(dictionary)
		{
			this.type = type;
			baseClass = dictionary.QueryClassInfo(typeof(XPDataTableObject));
			className = type.FullName;
			DataTable dataTable = null;
			if (type.DeclaringType != null && typeof(DataSet).IsAssignableFrom(type.DeclaringType))
			{
				DataSet dataSet = (DataSet)Activator.CreateInstance(type.DeclaringType);
				foreach (DataTable table in dataSet.Tables)
				{
					if (type.IsInstanceOfType(table))
					{
						dataTable = table;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (dataTable == null)
			{
				dataTable = (DataTable)Activator.CreateInstance(type);
			}
			tableName = dataTable.TableName;
			if (dataTable.PrimaryKey == null || dataTable.PrimaryKey.Length != 1)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			base.Dictionary.AddClassInfo(this);
			foreach (DataColumn column in dataTable.Columns)
			{
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = null;
				string text = null;
				foreach (DataRelation parentRelation in dataTable.ParentRelations)
				{
					if (parentRelation.ParentColumns.Length == 1 && parentRelation.ChildColumns[0] == column && parentRelation.ParentTable.PrimaryKey[0] == parentRelation.ParentColumns[0])
					{
						xPClassInfo = base.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(parentRelation.ParentTable.GetType());
						text = parentRelation.RelationName;
						break;
					}
				}
				XPCustomMemberInfo xPCustomMemberInfo = ((xPClassInfo != null) ? CreateMember(column.ColumnName, xPClassInfo) : CreateMember(column.Caption, column.DataType));
				xPCustomMemberInfo.AddAttribute(new PersistentAttribute(column.ColumnName));
				xPCustomMemberInfo.AddAttribute(new DisplayNameAttribute(column.Caption));
				if (text != null)
				{
					xPCustomMemberInfo.AddAttribute(new AssociationAttribute(text));
				}
				if (dataTable.PrimaryKey[0] == column)
				{
					xPCustomMemberInfo.AddAttribute(new KeyAttribute(column.AutoIncrement));
				}
			}
			foreach (DataRelation childRelation in dataTable.ChildRelations)
			{
				if (childRelation.ParentColumns.Length == 1 && childRelation.ParentTable.PrimaryKey[0] == childRelation.ParentColumns[0])
				{
					XPClassInfo xPClassInfo2 = base.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(childRelation.ChildTable.GetType());
					if (xPClassInfo2 != null)
					{
						CreateMember(childRelation.RelationName, typeof(XPCollection), true, new AssociationAttribute(childRelation.RelationName, xPClassInfo2.ClassType));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override string GetTableName()
		{
			return tableName;
		}

		protected internal override object CreateObjectInstance(Session session, XPClassInfo instantiationClassInfo)
		{
			return BaseClass.CreateObjectInstance(session, instantiationClassInfo);
		}

		public override void AddMember(XPMemberInfo newMember)
		{
			_ownMembers.Add(newMember);
			base.AddMember(newMember);
		}

		public override bool HasModifications(object theObject)
		{
			return PersistentBase.GetModificationsStore(theObject).HasModifications();
		}

		public override void ClearModifications(object theObject)
		{
			PersistentBase.GetModificationsStore(theObject).ClearModifications();
		}
	}
	public class XPDataObjectClassInfo : XPClassInfo
	{

		private string className;

		public static readonly Type DataObjectsBaseType = typeof(XPDataObject);

		public override XPClassInfo BaseClass => baseClass;

		protected override bool CanPersist => !HasAttribute(NonPersistentAttribute.AttributeType);

		[Description("Gets a collection of XPMemberInfo objects that provide metadata information on all the members owned by the class.")]
		public override ICollection<XPMemberInfo> OwnMembers => _ownMembers;

		public XPDataObjectClassInfo(XPDictionary dictionary, XPClassInfo baseClass, string className, params Attribute[] attributes)
			: base(dictionary)
		{
			if (baseClass == null)
			{
				baseClass = dictionary.GetClassInfo(DataObjectsBaseType);
			}
			this.baseClass = baseClass;
			this.className = className;
			if (attributes != null && attributes.Length != 0)
			{
				foreach (Attribute attribute in attributes)
				{
					AddAttribute(attribute);
				}
			}
			InitServiceMembers();
			CheckMembers();
			base.Dictionary.AddClassInfo(this);
		}

		public XPDataObjectClassInfo(XPDictionary dictionary, string className, params Attribute[] attributes)
			: this(dictionary, null, className, attributes)
		{
		}

		public XPDataObjectClassInfo(XPClassInfo baseClass, string className, params Attribute[] attributes)
			: this(baseClass.Dictionary, baseClass, className, attributes)
		{
		}

		private static XPClassInfo ExtractBaseClassInfo(XPDictionary dictionary, XmlNode node)
		{
			if (node.Attributes["basetype"] == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dictionary.GetClassInfo(DataObjectsAssembly, node.Attributes["basetype"].Value);
		}

		public XPDataObjectClassInfo(XPDictionary dictionary, XmlNode node)
			: this(dictionary, ExtractBaseClassInfo(dictionary, node), node.Attributes["type"].Value)
		{
		}

		protected internal override object CreateObjectInstance(Session session, XPClassInfo instantiationClassInfo)
		{
			return BaseClass.CreateObjectInstance(session, instantiationClassInfo);
		}

			_ownMembers.Add(newMember);
			base.AddMember(newMember);
		}

		}

		}

		private static string ExtractPropertyName(XmlNode node)
		{
			return node.Attributes["name"]?.Value;
		}

		private static XPClassInfo ExtractReferenceType(XPClassInfo ownerInfo, XmlNode node)
		{
			XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = node.Attributes["type"];
			if (xmlAttribute == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ownerInfo.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(XPDataObjectClassInfo.DataObjectsAssembly, xmlAttribute.Value);
		}

		private static Type ExtractPropertyType(XPClassInfo ownerInfo, XmlNode node)
		{
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = ExtractReferenceType(ownerInfo, node);
			if (xPClassInfo != null)
			{
				return xPClassInfo.ClassType;
			}
			XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = node.Attributes["type"];
			if (xmlAttribute == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownUserType(xmlAttribute.Value, false);
		}

		public XPDataObjectMemberInfo(XPClassInfo owner, XmlNode node)
			: this(owner, ExtractPropertyName(node), ExtractPropertyType(owner, node), ExtractReferenceType(owner, node))
		{
		}

		private class LoadXMLMetadataContext
		{
			public Hashtable ClassInfos = new Hashtable();

			public Hashtable MemberInfos = new Hashtable();

			[Obsolete("We do not recommend that you use this method due to potential vulnerabilities if the input XML document contains names of untrusted assemblies and types. Validate or sanitize the input XML documents even in testing and non-production environments for the best security.", false)]
			public static void LoadInfosDescriptions(Hashtable table, XmlNode parentNode, string infoTag, string attributeName, XmlNamespaceManager nsmgr, Type[] constructorArguments)
			{
				foreach (XmlNode item in parentNode.SelectNodes(infoTag, nsmgr))
				{
					Type type = XPTypeActivator.GetType(item.Attributes["assembly"].Value, item.Attributes["type"].Value);
					if (type == null)
					{
						throw new XMLDictionaryException(Res.GetString("MetaData_XMLLoadErrorCannotFindClassinfoType"));
					}
					ConstructorInfo constructor = type.GetConstructor(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, constructorArguments, null);
					if (constructor == null)
					{
						throw new XMLDictionaryException(string.Format(Res.GetString("MetaData_XMLLoadErrorCannotFindConstructor"), type.FullName));
					}
					table.Add(item.Attributes[attributeName].Value, constructor);
				}
			}
		}

		}

		{

		[Obsolete("We do not recommend that you use this method due to potential vulnerabilities if the input XML document contains names of untrusted assemblies and types. Validate or sanitize the input XML documents even in testing and non-production environments for the best security.", false)]
		private void LoadXmlMetadata(XmlDocument doc)
		{
			XmlNamespaceManager xmlNamespaceManager = new XmlNamespaceManager(doc.NameTable);
			xmlNamespaceManager.AddNamespace("xpons", "http://www.devexpress.com/products/xpo/schemas/1.9/xpometadata.xsd");
			XmlNode xmlNode = doc.DocumentElement.SelectSingleNode("/xpons:Model", xmlNamespaceManager);
			if (xmlNode == null)
			{
				throw new XMLDictionaryException(Res.GetString("MetaData_XMLLoadErrorModelTagAbsent"));
			}
			LoadXMLMetadataContext loadXMLMetadataContext = new LoadXMLMetadataContext();
			LoadXMLMetadataContext.LoadInfosDescriptions(loadXMLMetadataContext.ClassInfos, xmlNode, "xpons:ClassInfoDescription", "classinfo", xmlNamespaceManager, new Type[2]
			{
				typeof(XPDictionary),
				typeof(XmlNode)
			});
			LoadXMLMetadataContext.LoadInfosDescriptions(loadXMLMetadataContext.MemberInfos, xmlNode, "xpons:MemberInfoDescription", "memberinfo", xmlNamespaceManager, new Type[2]
			{
				typeof(XPClassInfo),
				typeof(XmlNode)
			});
			IEnumerable enumerable = xmlNode.SelectNodes("xpons:Class", xmlNamespaceManager);
			while (true)
			{
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				Exception ex = null;
				bool flag = true;
				foreach (XmlNode item in enumerable)
				{
					string assemblyName = ((item.Attributes["assembly"] != null) ? item.Attributes["assembly"].Value : string.Empty);
					XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = QueryClassInfo(assemblyName, item.Attributes["type"].Value);
					if (xPClassInfo == null)
					{
						if (item.Attributes["classinfo"] == null)
						{
							throw new XMLDictionaryException(Res.GetString("MetaData_XMLLoadErrorCannotResolveClassinfoInstanceType"));
						}
						try
						{
							xPClassInfo = (XPClassInfo)((ConstructorInfo)loadXMLMetadataContext.ClassInfos[item.Attributes["classinfo"].Value]).Invoke(new object[2] { this, item });
						}
						catch (TargetInvocationException ex2)
						{
							ex = ((ex2.InnerException == null) ? ex2 : ex2.InnerException);
							arrayList.Add(item);
							continue;
						}
					}
					flag = false;
					LoadAttributes(item, xPClassInfo, xmlNamespaceManager);
				}
				if (arrayList.Count == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					throw ex;
				}
				enumerable = arrayList;
			}
			foreach (XmlNode item2 in xmlNode.SelectNodes("xpons:Class", xmlNamespaceManager))
			{
				string text = ((item2.Attributes["assembly"] != null) ? item2.Attributes["assembly"].Value : "");
				string value = item2.Attributes["type"].Value;
				XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(text, value);
				foreach (XmlNode item3 in item2.SelectNodes("xpons:Member", xmlNamespaceManager))
				{
					string value2 = item3.Attributes["name"].Value;
					XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = classInfo.QueryOwnMember(value2);
					if (xPMemberInfo == null)
					{
						if (item3.Attributes["memberinfo"] == null)
						{
							throw new XMLDictionaryException(Res.GetString("MetaData_XMLLoadErrorCannotLoadMember", text, value, value2));
						}
						try
						{
							xPMemberInfo = (XPMemberInfo)((ConstructorInfo)loadXMLMetadataContext.MemberInfos[item3.Attributes["memberinfo"].Value]).Invoke(new object[2] { classInfo, item3 });
						}
						catch (TargetInvocationException ex3)
						{
							throw (ex3.InnerException == null) ? ex3 : ex3.InnerException;
						}
					}
					LoadAttributes(item3, xPMemberInfo, xmlNamespaceManager);
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadAttributes(XmlNode parentNode, XPTypeInfo info, XmlNamespaceManager nsmgr)
		{
			XmlNode xmlNode = parentNode.SelectSingleNode("xpons:Attributes", nsmgr);
			if (xmlNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XmlNode childNode in xmlNode.ChildNodes)
			{
				if (childNode.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Element)
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text = childNode.Name;
				if (text.IndexOf("Attribute") < 0)
				{
					text += "Attribute";
				}
				if (text.IndexOf(".") < 0)
				{
					text = typeof(CustomAttribute).Namespace + "." + text;
				}
				Type knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(typeof(CustomAttribute).Assembly, text, true, (bool?)null);
				Attribute attribute = null;
				if (knownType != null)
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = knownType.GetConstructor(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, new Type[1] { typeof(XmlNode) }, null);
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						attribute = (Attribute)constructor.Invoke(new object[1] { childNode });
					}
					else
					{
						constructor = knownType.GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
						if (constructor != null)
						{
							attribute = (Attribute)constructor.Invoke(new object[0]);
						}
					}
				}
				if (attribute == null)
				{
					throw new XMLDictionaryException(Res.GetString("MetaData_XMLLoadErrorUnknownAttribute", childNode.Name));
				}
				info.AddAttribute(attribute);
			}
		}

		public void AddClassInfo(XPClassInfo info)
		{
			if (this != info.Dictionary)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_DictionaryMixing", info.FullName));
			}
			AddClassInfoCore(info);
			TriggerClassInfoChanged(info);
		}

		public XPClassInfo GetClassInfo(string assemblyName, string className)
		{
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = QueryClassInfo(assemblyName, className);
			if (xPClassInfo == null)
			{
				throw new CannotResolveClassInfoException(assemblyName, className);
			}
			return xPClassInfo;
		}

		public XPClassInfo GetClassInfo(Type classType)
		{
			if (classType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("classType");
			}
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = QueryClassInfo(classType);
			if (xPClassInfo == null)
			{
				throw new CannotResolveClassInfoException(classType.Assembly.FullName, classType.FullName);
			}
			return xPClassInfo;
		}

		public XPClassInfo QueryClassInfo(object theObject)
		{
			if (theObject == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (theObject is IXPSimpleObject iXPSimpleObject)
			{
				return iXPSimpleObject.ClassInfo;
			}
			return QueryClassInfo(theObject.GetType());
		}

		public XPClassInfo GetClassInfo(object theObject)
		{
			if (theObject is IXPSimpleObject iXPSimpleObject)
			{
				return iXPSimpleObject.ClassInfo;
			}
			if (theObject == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("theObject");
			}
			return GetClassInfo(theObject.GetType());
		}

		[Obsolete("We do not recommend that you use this method due to potential vulnerabilities if the input XML document contains names of untrusted assemblies and types. Validate or sanitize the input XML documents even in testing and non-production environments for the best security.", false)]
		public void LoadXmlMetadata(XmlReader reader)
		{
			XmlTextReader schema = SafeXml.CreateTextReader((TextReader)new StreamReader(GetType().Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("DevExpress.Xpo.XPOMetadata.xsd")));
			try
			{
				XmlDocument doc = SafeXml.CreateDocument(reader, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)delegate(XmlReaderSettings settings)
				{
					settings.ValidationType = ValidationType.Schema;
					settings.Schemas.Add(null, schema);
				});
				LoadXmlMetadata(doc);
			}
			finally
			{
				reader.Close();
				schema.Close();
			}
		}

		private void TriggerClassInfoChanged(XPClassInfo changedClassInfo)
		{
			this.ClassInfoChanged?.Invoke(this, new ClassInfoEventArgs(changedClassInfo));
		}

		internal void OnClassInfoCacheDropped(XPClassInfo changedClassInfo)
		{
			TriggerClassInfoChanged(changedClassInfo);
			DropDescendantsCache(changedClassInfo);
		}

		protected virtual void DropDescendantsCache(XPClassInfo changedClassInfo)
		{
			foreach (XPClassInfo @class in Classes)
			{
				if (@class.BaseClass == changedClassInfo)
				{
					@class.DoDrop();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool HasDescendants(XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			return HasDescendantsCore(classInfo);
		}

		protected virtual bool HasDescendantsCore(XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			foreach (XPClassInfo @class in Classes)
			{
				if (@class.BaseClass == classInfo)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public ValueConverter GetConverter(Type memberType)
		{
			if (memberType == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (converters.TryGetValue(memberType, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			Type type = memberType;
			Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type);
			if (underlyingType != null)
			{
				type = underlyingType;
			}
			if (type.IsEnum)
			{
				value = new EnumsConverter(type);
				converters[memberType] = value;
				return value;
			}
			if (!ConnectionProviderSql.UseLegacyTimeSpanSupport && type == typeof(TimeSpan))
			{
				value = new DefaultTimeSpanConverter();
				converters[memberType] = value;
				return value;
			}
			converters[memberType] = null;
			return null;
		}

		public void RegisterValueConverter(ValueConverter converter, Type memberType)
		{
			converters[memberType] = converter;
		}

		public object GetId(object obj)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = GetClassInfo(obj);
			return classInfo.GetId(obj);
		}

		protected virtual bool CanAssemblyContainPersistentClasses(Assembly assembly)
		{
			if (XPClassInfo.GetShortAssemblyName(assembly) == xpoName)
			{
				return true;
			}
			AssemblyName[] referencedAssemblies = assembly.GetReferencedAssemblies();
			foreach (AssemblyName assemblyName in referencedAssemblies)
			{
				if (assemblyName.Name == xpoName)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public XPClassInfo[] CollectClassInfos(bool addNonPersistent, params Assembly[] assemblies)
		{
			return CollectClassInfos(addNonPersistent, (IEnumerable<Assembly>)assemblies);
		}

		public XPClassInfo[] CollectClassInfos(bool addNonPersistent, IEnumerable<Assembly> assemblies)
		{
			if (assemblies == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("assemblies");
			}
			List<XPClassInfo> list = new List<XPClassInfo>();
			foreach (Assembly assembly in assemblies)
			{
				if (!CanAssemblyContainPersistentClasses(assembly))
				{
					continue;
				}
				Type[] types;
				try
				{
					types = assembly.GetTypes();
				}
				catch (Exception innerException)
				{
					ThrowCouldNotCollectClassInfoFromAssemblyWarning(assembly.FullName, innerException);
					continue;
				}
				Type[] array = types;
				foreach (Type classType in array)
				{
					XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = QueryClassInfo(classType);
					if (xPClassInfo != null && (addNonPersistent || xPClassInfo.IsPersistent) && !(xPClassInfo is XPDataTableClassInfo))
					{
						list.Add(xPClassInfo);
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static void ThrowCouldNotCollectClassInfoFromAssemblyWarning(string assemblyName, Exception innerException)
		{
			if (!couldNotCollectClassInfoFromAssemblyWarningThrown)
			{
				couldNotCollectClassInfoFromAssemblyWarningThrown = true;
				string message = Res.GetString(CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, "CollectClassInfos_CouldNotLoadAssembly", assemblyName);
				try
				{
					throw new WarningException(message, innerException);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		public XPClassInfo[] CollectClassInfos(params Assembly[] assemblies)
		{
			return CollectClassInfos(addNonPersistent: false, assemblies);
		}

		public XPClassInfo[] CollectClassInfos(IEnumerable<Assembly> assemblies)
		{
			return CollectClassInfos(addNonPersistent: false, assemblies);
		}

		public XPClassInfo[] CollectClassInfos(params Type[] types)
		{
			return CollectClassInfos((IEnumerable<Type>)types);
		}

		public XPClassInfo[] CollectClassInfos(IEnumerable<Type> types)
		{
			if (types == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("types");
			}
			return types.Select(GetClassInfo).ToArray();
		}

		private static void CheckDuplicateNames(ICollection<XPClassInfo> newTypes, ICollection<XPClassInfo> alreadyEnsuredTypes)
		{
			List<XPClassInfo> list = new List<XPClassInfo>(alreadyEnsuredTypes);
			list.AddRange(newTypes);
			foreach (XPClassInfo newType in newTypes)
			{
				if (newType.TableMapType != MapInheritanceType.OwnTable)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (XPClassInfo item in list)
				{
					if (item != newType && item.TableMapType == MapInheritanceType.OwnTable && item.TableName == newType.TableName)
					{
						throw new SameTableNameException(item, newType);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal ICollection<XPClassInfo> ExpandTypesToEnsure(ICollection<XPClassInfo> inputTypesToEnsure)
		{
			return ExpandTypesToEnsure(inputTypesToEnsure, new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo>());
		}

		internal ICollection<XPClassInfo> ExpandTypesToEnsure(ICollection<XPClassInfo> inputTypesToEnsure, IDictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo> alreadyEnsuredTypes)
		{
			if (inputTypesToEnsure == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("inputTypesToEnsure");
			}
			Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo>();
			foreach (XPClassInfo item in inputTypesToEnsure)
			{
				if (item.Dictionary != this)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_DictionaryMixing", item.FullName));
				}
				if (alreadyEnsuredTypes.ContainsKey(item))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (XPClassInfo refType in item.GetRefTypes())
				{
					if (!alreadyEnsuredTypes.ContainsKey(refType))
					{
						dictionary[refType] = refType;
					}
				}
			}
			ICollection<XPClassInfo> keys = dictionary.Keys;
			if (keys.Count > 0)
			{
				CheckDuplicateNames(keys, alreadyEnsuredTypes.Keys);
			}
			return keys;
		}

		internal static DBTable[] CollectTables(ICollection<XPClassInfo> classInfos)
		{
			Dictionary<DBTable, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<DBTable, string>(classInfos.Count);
			XPDictionary xPDictionary = null;
			foreach (XPClassInfo classInfo in classInfos)
			{
				if (xPDictionary == null)
				{
					xPDictionary = classInfo.Dictionary;
				}
				else if (xPDictionary != classInfo.Dictionary)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_DictionaryMixing", classInfo.FullName));
				}
				dictionary[classInfo.Table] = string.Empty;
			}
			return dictionary.Keys.ToArray();
		}

		public DBTable[] GetDataStoreSchema(params XPClassInfo[] types)
		{
			ICollection<XPClassInfo> classInfos = ExpandTypesToEnsure(types);
			DBTable[] array = CollectTables(classInfos);
			Array.Sort(array, (DBTable left, DBTable right) => string.CompareOrdinal(left.Name, right.Name));
			return array;
		}

		public DBTable[] GetDataStoreSchema(IEnumerable<XPClassInfo> types)
		{
			if (types == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("types");
			}
			return GetDataStoreSchema(types.ToArray());
		}

		public DBTable[] GetDataStoreSchema(params Assembly[] assemblies)
		{
			return GetDataStoreSchema(CollectClassInfos(assemblies));
		}

		public DBTable[] GetDataStoreSchema(IEnumerable<Assembly> assemblies)
		{
			return GetDataStoreSchema(CollectClassInfos(assemblies));
		}

		public DBTable[] GetDataStoreSchema(params Type[] types)
		{
			return GetDataStoreSchema(CollectClassInfos(types));
		}

		public DBTable[] GetDataStoreSchema(IEnumerable<Type> types)
		{
			return GetDataStoreSchema(CollectClassInfos(types));
		}

		public XPClassInfo CreateClass(XPClassInfo baseClassInfo, string className, params Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			return new XPDataObjectClassInfo(this, baseClassInfo, className, attributes);
		}

		public XPClassInfo CreateClass(string className, params Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			return CreateClass(null, className, attributes);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return base.ToString() + "(" + seqNum + ")";
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void Validate(XPClassInfo[] inputInfos)
		{
			foreach (XPClassInfo item in new List<XPClassInfo>(inputInfos))
			{
				foreach (XPMemberInfo member in item.Members)
				{
					if (member.IsAssociation)
					{
						member.GetAssociatedMember();
					}
					else if (member.IsAliased)
					{
						PersistentAliasAttribute persistentAliasAttribute = (PersistentAliasAttribute)member.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(PersistentAliasAttribute));
						PersistentCriterionExpander.Expand(item, DummyPersistentValuesSource.Instance, persistentAliasAttribute.Criteria);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class ReflectionClassInfo : XPClassInfo
	{
		public interface ICreator
		{
			object Create(Session session, XPClassInfo ci);
		}

		private interface IConstructor
		{
			object Create(Session session, XPClassInfo ci);
		}

		private delegate object CreatorDelegate(Session session, XPClassInfo ci);

		private class ConstructorWithoutSession : IConstructor, ICreator
		{
			private CreatorDelegate creator;

			private static Dictionary<ConstructorInfo, CreatorDelegate> creators = new Dictionary<ConstructorInfo, CreatorDelegate>();

			private ConstructorInfo constr;

			protected CreatorDelegate Creator => creator;

			protected ConstructorInfo Constr => constr;

			public ConstructorWithoutSession(ConstructorInfo constr)
			{
				this.constr = constr;
				if (XpoDefault.UseFastAccessors)
				{
					if (creators.TryGetValue(Constr, out creator))
					{
						return;
					}
					lock (creators)
					{
						if (!creators.TryGetValue(Constr, out creator))
						{
							ParameterExpression parameterExpression = Expression.Parameter(typeof(Session));
							ParameterExpression parameterExpression2 = Expression.Parameter(typeof(XPClassInfo));
							creator = Expression.Lambda<CreatorDelegate>(Expression.New(Constr, CreateArguments(parameterExpression, parameterExpression2)), new ParameterExpression[2] { parameterExpression, parameterExpression2 }).Compile();
							creators[Constr] = creator;
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				creator = InvokeConstructor;
			}

			protected virtual void CheckParameters(Session session, XPClassInfo ci)
			{
				if (session != XpoDefault.Session && typeof(IXPSimpleObject).IsAssignableFrom(ci.ClassType))
				{
					throw new SessionCtorAbsentException(ci);
				}
			}

			protected virtual object InvokeConstructor(Session session, XPClassInfo ci)
			{
				return Constr.Invoke(null);
			}

			object ICreator.Create(Session session, XPClassInfo ci)
			{
				return InvokeConstructor(session, ci);
			}

			object IConstructor.Create(Session session, XPClassInfo ci)
			{
				CheckParameters(session, ci);
				return Creator(session, ci);
			}

			protected virtual Expression[] CreateArguments(ParameterExpression sParam, ParameterExpression ciParam)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private class Constructor : ConstructorWithoutSession
		{
			private Type sessionType;

			protected Type SessionType
			{
				get
				{
					if (sessionType == null)
					{
						sessionType = base.Constr.GetParameters()[0].ParameterType;
					}
					return sessionType;
				}
			}

			protected override Expression[] CreateArguments(ParameterExpression sParam, ParameterExpression ciParam)
			{
				return new Expression[1] { Expression.Convert(sParam, SessionType) };
			}

			protected override void CheckParameters(Session session, XPClassInfo ci)
			{
				if (!SessionType.IsInstanceOfType(session))
				{
					throw new SessionCtorAbsentException(ci);
				}
			}

			protected override object InvokeConstructor(Session session, XPClassInfo ci)
			{
				return base.Constr.Invoke(new object[1] { session });
			}

			public Constructor(ConstructorInfo constr)
				: base(constr)
			{
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanPersist
		{
			get
			{
				if (ClassType.IsGenericType || ClassType.ContainsGenericParameters)
				{
					if (HasAttribute(PersistentAttribute.AttributeType))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_CantPersistGenericType", ClassType.FullName));
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (ClassType.IsInterface)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return !HasAttribute(NonPersistentAttribute.AttributeType);
			}
		}

				return defaultMembersPersistenceAttribute.DefaultMembersPersistence;

		private bool IsNullableType(Type currentType)
		{
			return Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(currentType) != null;
		}

		private void InternalCollectMembers(Type currentType, XPMemberInfo currentValueParent, bool inherited)
		{
			BindingFlags bindingFlags = BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic;
			if (!inherited)
			{
				bindingFlags |= BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly;
			}
			FieldInfo[] fields = currentType.GetFields(bindingFlags);
			foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in fields)
			{
				if (!IsSameMemberInBase(fieldInfo))
				{
					XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = new ReflectionFieldInfo(this, fieldInfo, currentValueParent);
					if (xPMemberInfo.IsStruct && !IsNullableType(xPMemberInfo.MemberType) && xPMemberInfo.HasAttribute(PersistentAttribute.AttributeType))
					{
						InternalCollectMembers(xPMemberInfo.MemberType, xPMemberInfo, inherited: false);
					}
				}
			}
			PropertyInfo[] properties = currentType.GetProperties(bindingFlags);
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
			{
				try
				{
					MethodInfo getMethod = propertyInfo.GetGetMethod(nonPublic: true);
					if (!(getMethod == null) && getMethod.GetParameters().Length == 0 && !IsSameMemberInBase(propertyInfo))
					{
						XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo2 = new ReflectionPropertyInfo(this, propertyInfo, currentValueParent);
						if (xPMemberInfo2.IsStruct && !IsNullableType(xPMemberInfo2.MemberType) && xPMemberInfo2.HasAttribute(PersistentAttribute.AttributeType))
						{
							InternalCollectMembers(xPMemberInfo2.MemberType, xPMemberInfo2, inherited: false);
						}
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsSameMemberInBase(MemberInfo mi)
		{
			XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = null;
			if (BaseClass != null)
			{
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo2 = BaseClass.FindMember(mi.Name);
				if (IsBaseMemberSuppressCurrent(mi, xPMemberInfo2))
				{
					xPMemberInfo = xPMemberInfo2;
				}
			}
			if (xPMemberInfo != null)
			{
				if (!_SuppressSuspiciousMemberInheritanceCheck && !(base.Dictionary is DesignTimeReflection))
				{
					object[] customAttributes = mi.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: false);
					for (int i = 0; i < customAttributes.Length; i++)
					{
						Attribute attribute = (Attribute)customAttributes[i];
						if (attribute.GetType().Namespace == typeof(PersistentAttribute).Namespace)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, Res.GetString("Metadata_SuppressSuspiciousMemberInheritanceCheckError", FullName, mi.Name, attribute.GetType().Name, xPMemberInfo.Owner.FullName)));
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsBaseMemberSuppressCurrent(MemberInfo currentMember, XPMemberInfo baseMember)
		{
			if (baseMember == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (baseMember.IsPersistent)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (baseMember.IsAliased)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (baseMember.IsAssociationList)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (baseMember.IsPublic)
			{
				return true;
			}
			PropertyInfo propertyInfo = currentMember as PropertyInfo;
			if (propertyInfo != null)
			{
				MethodInfo getMethod = propertyInfo.GetGetMethod(nonPublic: true);
				if (getMethod != null && getMethod.GetBaseDefinition() != getMethod)
				{
					return true;
				}
				MethodInfo setMethod = propertyInfo.GetSetMethod(nonPublic: true);
				if (setMethod != null && setMethod.GetBaseDefinition() != setMethod)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CollectMembers(Type currentType)
		{
			InternalCollectMembers(classType, null, BaseClass == null);
		}

		public override void AddMember(XPMemberInfo newMember)
		{
			ownMembers.Add(newMember);
			base.AddMember(newMember);
		}

		protected internal override XPMemberInfo QueryOwnMember(string memberName)
		{
			if (membersCache == null)
			{
				Dictionary<string, XPMemberInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, XPMemberInfo>();
				foreach (XPMemberInfo ownMember in OwnMembers)
				{
					dictionary.Add(ownMember.Name, ownMember);
				}
				membersCache = dictionary;
			}
			membersCache.TryGetValue(memberName, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public ReflectionClassInfo(Type classType, XPDictionary dictionary)
			: base(dictionary)
		{
			this.classType = classType;
			baseClass = base.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(DXTypeExtensions.GetBaseType(classType));
			bool flag = false;
			object[] customAttributes = GetCustomAttributes(classType);
			for (int i = 0; i < customAttributes.Length; i++)
			{
				Attribute attribute = (Attribute)customAttributes[i];
				if (attribute is PersistentAttribute || attribute is NonPersistentAttribute || attribute is MapToAttribute)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_ClassAttributeExclusive", FullName));
					}
					flag = true;
				}
				AddAttribute(attribute);
			}
			CollectMembers(classType);
			InitServiceMembers();
			CheckMembers();
			constructed = true;
			base.Dictionary.AddClassInfo(this);
		}

		private object[] GetCustomAttributes(Type classType)
		{
			if (base.IsDesignTimeReflection)
			{
				try
				{
					return classType.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: false);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (!(ex is BadImageFormatException) && !(ex is FileNotFoundException))
					{
						throw;
					}
					return new Attribute[0];
				}
			}
			return classType.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: false);
		}

		private IConstructor CreateConstructor()
		{
			if (IsAbstract)
			{
				return new NullConstructor();
			}
			ConstructorInfo[] constructors = classType.GetConstructors(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			ConstructorInfo[] array = constructors;
			foreach (ConstructorInfo constructorInfo in array)
			{
				ParameterInfo[] parameters = constructorInfo.GetParameters();
				if (parameters.Length == 2 && typeof(Session).IsAssignableFrom(parameters[0].ParameterType) && typeof(XPClassInfo).IsAssignableFrom(parameters[1].ParameterType))
				{
					return new ConstructorWithClassInfo(constructorInfo);
				}
			}
			ConstructorInfo[] array2 = constructors;
			foreach (ConstructorInfo constructorInfo2 in array2)
			{
				ParameterInfo[] parameters2 = constructorInfo2.GetParameters();
				if (parameters2.Length == 1 && typeof(Session).IsAssignableFrom(parameters2[0].ParameterType))
				{
					return new Constructor(constructorInfo2);
				}
			}
			ConstructorInfo[] array3 = constructors;
			foreach (ConstructorInfo constructorInfo3 in array3)
			{
				ParameterInfo[] parameters3 = constructorInfo3.GetParameters();
				if (parameters3.Length == 0)
				{
					return new ConstructorWithoutSession(constructorInfo3);
				}
			}
			return new NullConstructor();
		}

		protected override string GetDefaultTableName()
		{
			return ClassType.Name;
		}

		protected internal override object CreateObjectInstance(Session session, XPClassInfo instantiationClassInfo)
		{
			object obj = Creator.Create(session, instantiationClassInfo);
			session.ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(obj);
			if (obj is IXPClassInfoProvider iXPClassInfoProvider && iXPClassInfoProvider.ClassInfo != instantiationClassInfo)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_WrongObjectType", iXPClassInfoProvider, iXPClassInfoProvider.ClassInfo, instantiationClassInfo));
			}
			return obj;
		}

		}

	public interface IFieldAccessor
	{
		void SetValue(object theObject, object value);

		object GetValue(object theObject);
	}
	public abstract class ReflectionMemberInfo : XPMemberInfo, IFieldAccessor
	{
		private delegate object GetValueDelegate(object obj);

		private delegate void SetValueDelegate(object obj, object value);

		private class DelegateFieldAccessor : IFieldAccessor
		{
			private GetValueDelegate get;

			private SetValueDelegate set;

			public DelegateFieldAccessor(GetValueDelegate get, SetValueDelegate set)
			{
				this.get = get;
				this.set = set;
			}

			public void SetValue(object theObject, object value)
			{
				set(theObject, value);
			}

			public object GetValue(object theObject)
			{
				return get(theObject);
			}
		}

		private sealed class ValueParentAccessor : IFieldAccessor
		{
			private XPMemberInfo valueParent;

			private IFieldAccessor accessor;

			public IFieldAccessor Accessor => accessor;

			object IFieldAccessor.GetValue(object theObject)
			{
				return accessor.GetValue(valueParent.GetValue(theObject));
			}

			void IFieldAccessor.SetValue(object theObject, object theValue)
			{
				object value = valueParent.GetValue(theObject);
				accessor.SetValue(value, theValue);
				valueParent.SetValue(theObject, value);
			}

			public ValueParentAccessor(XPMemberInfo valueParent, IFieldAccessor accessor)
			{
				this.valueParent = valueParent;
				this.accessor = accessor;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public static class GetExpressionFixNullHelperMethods
		{
			public static Expression MakePatchNullValues(Expression expression, object nullValueSubst)
			{
				Type type = nullValueSubst.GetType();
				Type boxedType = NullableHelpers.GetBoxedType(expression.Type);
				Type type2 = typeof(IEquatable<>).MakeGenericType(boxedType);
				string methodName = (type2.IsAssignableFrom(type) ? ((!expression.Type.IsValueType) ? "GetExpressionFixNullEquatableClass" : ((!(Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(expression.Type) != null)) ? "GetExpressionFixNullEquatableStruct" : "GetExpressionFixNullEquatableNullable")) : ((!expression.Type.IsValueType) ? "GetExpressionFixNullClass" : ((!(Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(expression.Type) != null)) ? "GetExpressionFixNullStruct" : "GetExpressionFixNullNullable")));
				ParameterExpression parameterExpression = Expression.Parameter(expression.Type, "v");
				Expression body = Expression.Call(typeof(GetExpressionFixNullHelperMethods), methodName, new Type[2] { expression.Type, type }, parameterExpression, Expression.Constant(nullValueSubst));
				LambdaExpression expression2 = Expression.Lambda(body, parameterExpression);
				return Expression.Invoke(expression2, expression);
			}

			public static T? GetExpressionFixNullEquatableStruct<T, N>(T value, N nullValue) where T : struct where N : IEquatable<T>
			{
				if (nullValue.Equals(value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}

			public static T GetExpressionFixNullEquatableClass<T, N>(T value, N nullValue) where T : class where N : IEquatable<T>
			{
				if (nullValue.Equals(value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}

			public static T? GetExpressionFixNullEquatableNullable<T, N>(T? value, N nullValue) where T : struct where N : IEquatable<T>
			{
				if (value.HasValue && nullValue.Equals(value.Value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}

			public static T? GetExpressionFixNullStruct<T, N>(T value, N nullValue) where T : struct
			{
				if (nullValue.Equals(value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}

			public static T? GetExpressionFixNullNullable<T, N>(T? value, N nullValue) where T : struct
			{
				if (value.HasValue && nullValue.Equals(value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}

			public static T GetExpressionFixNullClass<T, N>(T value, N nullValue) where T : class
			{
				if (nullValue.Equals(value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		private static readonly Dictionary<MemberInfo, IFieldAccessor> accessors = new Dictionary<MemberInfo, IFieldAccessor>();

		private IFieldAccessor fieldAccessor;

		private string name;

		private static readonly object emtpyNullValue = new object();

		private object nullValue = emtpyNullValue;

		private bool? isStruct;

		protected virtual bool CanUseFastAccessors => XpoDefault.UseFastAccessors;

		protected abstract MemberInfo Info { get; }

		private bool Constructed => name != null;

		private IFieldAccessor Accessor
		{
			get
			{
				if (fieldAccessor == null)
				{
					CreateAccessor();
				}
				return fieldAccessor;
			}
		}

		private object NullValue
		{
			get
			{
				object obj = nullValue;
				if (emtpyNullValue == obj)
				{
					obj = (nullValue = GetNullValue());
				}
				return obj;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the member’s name.")]
		public override string Name => name;

		[Description("Gets whether the member represents a data structure.")]
		public override bool IsStruct
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isStruct.HasValue)
				{
					isStruct = MemberType.IsValueType && !DBColumn.IsStorableType(base.StorageType);
				}
				return isStruct.Value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual IFieldAccessor CreateAccessorInternal()
		{
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression = Expression.Parameter(typeof(object));
			Expression expression = ((base.ValueParent == null) ? Expression.Convert(parameterExpression, Info.DeclaringType) : Expression.Unbox(parameterExpression, base.ValueParent.MemberType));
			GetValueDelegate get = Expression.Lambda<GetValueDelegate>(Expression.Convert(Expression.MakeMemberAccess(expression, Info), typeof(object)), new ParameterExpression[1] { parameterExpression }).Compile();
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression2 = Expression.Parameter(typeof(object));
			SetValueDelegate set = ((!base.IsReadOnly) ? Expression.Lambda<SetValueDelegate>(Expression.Assign(right: (!MemberType.IsValueType || !(Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(MemberType) == null)) ? ((Expression)Expression.Convert(parameterExpression2, MemberType)) : ((Expression)Expression.Condition(Expression.Equal(parameterExpression2, Expression.Constant(null)), Expression.New(MemberType), Expression.Unbox(parameterExpression2, MemberType))), left: Expression.MakeMemberAccess(expression, Info)), new ParameterExpression[2] { parameterExpression, parameterExpression2 }).Compile() : null);
			return new DelegateFieldAccessor(get, set);
		}

		private void CreateAccessor()
		{
			IFieldAccessor value;
			if (CanUseFastAccessors)
			{
				if (!accessors.TryGetValue(Info, out value))
				{
					lock (accessors)
					{
						if (!accessors.TryGetValue(Info, out value))
						{
							value = CreateAccessorInternal();
							accessors[Info] = value;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				value = this;
			}
			if (base.ValueParent != null)
			{
				value = new ValueParentAccessor(base.ValueParent, value);
			}
			fieldAccessor = value;
		}

		protected override void DropCache()
		{
			if (Constructed)
			{
				isStruct = null;
				nullValue = emtpyNullValue;
				base.DropCache();
			}
		}

		protected ReflectionMemberInfo(XPClassInfo owner, MemberInfo info, XPMemberInfo valueParent, bool isReadOnly)
			: base(owner, isReadOnly)
		{
			base.valueParent = valueParent;
			for (ReflectionMemberInfo reflectionMemberInfo = valueParent as ReflectionMemberInfo; reflectionMemberInfo != null; reflectionMemberInfo = reflectionMemberInfo.valueParent as ReflectionMemberInfo)
			{
				if (reflectionMemberInfo.subMembersArray == XPMemberInfo.EmptyList)
				{
					reflectionMemberInfo.subMembersArray = new List<XPMemberInfo>(4);
				}
				reflectionMemberInfo.subMembersArray.Add(this);
			}
			name = ((valueParent != null) ? (base.valueParent.Name + "." + info.Name) : info.Name);
			bool flag = false;
			object[] customAttributes = GetCustomAttributes(owner, info);
			for (int i = 0; i < customAttributes.Length; i++)
			{
				Attribute attribute = (Attribute)customAttributes[i];
				if (attribute is PersistentAttribute || attribute is NonPersistentAttribute || attribute is PersistentAliasAttribute)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_MemberAttributeExclusive", base.Owner.FullName, Name));
					}
					flag = true;
				}
				AddAttribute(attribute);
			}
			base.Owner.AddMember(this);
		}

		private object[] GetCustomAttributes(XPClassInfo owner, MemberInfo info)
		{
			if (base.Owner.IsDesignTimeReflection)
			{
				try
				{
					return info.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: true);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (!(ex is BadImageFormatException) && !(ex is FileNotFoundException))
					{
						throw;
					}
					return new Attribute[0];
				}
			}
			return info.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: true);
		}

		private object GetNullValue()
		{
			NullValueAttribute nullValueAttribute = (NullValueAttribute)FindAttributeInfo(typeof(NullValueAttribute));
			if (nullValueAttribute == null)
			{
				if (!(MemberType == typeof(DateTime)))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new DateTime(0L);
			}
			return nullValueAttribute.Value;
		}

		public override object GetConst(object target, XPMemberInfo targetMember)
		{
			if (this == targetMember)
			{
				return target;
			}
			object obj = ((valueParent != null) ? ((ValueParentAccessor)Accessor).Accessor.GetValue(valueParent.GetConst(target, targetMember)) : target);
			if (obj != null && obj.Equals(NullValue))
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public override object GetValue(object theObject)
		{
			object value = Accessor.GetValue(theObject);
			if (value == null || !value.Equals(NullValue))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void SetValue(object theObject, object theValue)
		{
			if (!base.IsReadOnly)
			{
				Accessor.SetValue(theObject, (theValue == null) ? NullValue : theValue);
			}
		}

		public override bool GetModified(object theObject)
		{
			return PersistentBase.GetModificationsStore(theObject).GetPropertyModified(this);
		}

		public override void SetModified(object theObject, object oldValue)
		{
			PersistentBase.GetModificationsStore(theObject).SetPropertyModified(this, (oldValue == null) ? NullValue : oldValue);
		}

		public override object GetOldValue(object theObject)
		{
			object propertyOldValue = PersistentBase.GetModificationsStore(theObject).GetPropertyOldValue(this);
			if (propertyOldValue == null || !propertyOldValue.Equals(NullValue))
			{
				return propertyOldValue;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void ResetModified(object theObject)
		{
			PersistentBase.GetModificationsStore(theObject).ResetPropertyModified(this);
		}

		protected override string GetDefaultMappingField()
		{
			if (valueParent == null)
			{
				return Info.Name;
			}
			return valueParent.MappingField + Info.Name;
		}

		public override Expression MakeGetExpression(Expression ownerExpression)
		{
			if (!IsPublic)
			{
				return base.MakeGetExpression(ownerExpression);
			}
			if (base.ValueParent == null)
			{
				if (base.Owner.ClassType.IsInterface && base.Owner.ClassType != ownerExpression.Type)
				{
					ownerExpression = Expression.Convert(ownerExpression, base.Owner.ClassType);
				}
				return GetExpressionFinalTouch(Expression.MakeMemberAccess(ownerExpression, Info));
			}
			Expression expression = ownerExpression;
			string[] array = Name.Split('.');
			foreach (string propertyOrFieldName in array)
			{
				expression = Expression.PropertyOrField(expression, propertyOrFieldName);
			}
			return GetExpressionFinalTouch(expression);
		}

		private Expression GetExpressionFinalTouch(Expression expression)
		{
			if (ReferenceType != null)
			{
				if (ReferenceType.ClassType.IsAssignableFrom(expression.Type))
				{
					return expression;
				}
				return Expression.Convert(expression, ReferenceType.ClassType);
			}
			object obj = NullValue;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return expression;
			}
			return GetExpressionFixNullHelperMethods.MakePatchNullValues(expression, obj);
		}
	}
	public sealed class ReflectionPropertyInfo : ReflectionMemberInfo, IFieldAccessor
	{
		private class DelegateFieldAccessor<T, P> : IFieldAccessor
		{
			public delegate T GetValueDelegate(P obj);

			public delegate void SetValueDelegate(P obj, T value);

			private GetValueDelegate get;

			private SetValueDelegate set;

			public DelegateFieldAccessor(Delegate get, Delegate set)
			{
				this.get = (GetValueDelegate)get;
				this.set = (SetValueDelegate)set;
			}

			public void SetValue(object theObject, object value)
			{
				set((P)theObject, (value == null) ? default(T) : ((T)value));
			}

			public object GetValue(object theObject)
			{
				return get((P)theObject);
			}
		}

		private PropertyInfo info;

		private static bool isVista = Environment.OSVersion.Platform == PlatformID.Win32NT && Environment.OSVersion.Version.Major >= 6;

		protected override MemberInfo Info => info;

		protected override bool CanUseFastAccessors
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.CanUseFastAccessors)
				{
					if (isVista)
					{
						return !Info.DeclaringType.IsValueType;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets whether the property is declared as public.")]
		public override bool IsPublic => info.GetAccessors().Length != 0;

		protected override bool CanPersist
		{
			get
			{
				if (HasAttribute(PersistentAttribute.AttributeType))
				{
					if (IsStruct)
					{
						return base.ValueParent == null;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (base.Owner is ReflectionClassInfo && ((ReflectionClassInfo)base.Owner).DefaultMembersPersistence == DefaultMembersPersistence.OnlyDeclaredAsPersistent)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (HasAttribute(NonPersistentAttribute.AttributeType))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.IsAliased)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (DXTypeExtensions.GetBaseType(info.DeclaringType) != null && DXTypeExtensions.GetBaseType(info.DeclaringType).GetProperty(Name) != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (info.GetGetMethod() == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (info.GetSetMethod() == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (DBColumn.IsStorableType(base.StorageType))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (base.Owner.Dictionary.CanGetClassInfoByType(base.StorageType))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the type of this property.")]
		public override Type MemberType => info.PropertyType;

		protected override IFieldAccessor CreateAccessorInternal()
		{
			if (base.CanUseFastAccessors)
			{
				return base.CreateAccessorInternal();
			}
			Type[] typeArguments = new Type[2] { info.PropertyType, Info.DeclaringType };
			MethodInfo getMethod = info.GetGetMethod(nonPublic: true);
			MethodInfo setMethod = info.GetSetMethod(nonPublic: true);
			Delegate obj = ((getMethod != null) ? Delegate.CreateDelegate(typeof(DelegateFieldAccessor<, >.GetValueDelegate).MakeGenericType(typeArguments), null, getMethod) : null);
			Delegate obj2 = ((setMethod != null) ? Delegate.CreateDelegate(typeof(DelegateFieldAccessor<, >.SetValueDelegate).MakeGenericType(typeArguments), null, setMethod) : null);
			return (IFieldAccessor)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(DelegateFieldAccessor<, >).MakeGenericType(typeArguments), obj, obj2);
		}

		public ReflectionPropertyInfo(XPClassInfo owner, PropertyInfo propertyInfo, XPMemberInfo valueParent)
			: base(owner, propertyInfo, valueParent, !propertyInfo.CanWrite)
		{
			info = propertyInfo;
		}

		object IFieldAccessor.GetValue(object theObject)
		{
			return info.GetValue(theObject, null);
		}

		void IFieldAccessor.SetValue(object theObject, object theValue)
		{
			info.SetValue(theObject, theValue, null);
		}
	}
	public sealed class ReflectionFieldInfo : ReflectionMemberInfo, IFieldAccessor
	{
		private MemberInfo[] infoArray;

		private FieldInfo info;

		protected override MemberInfo Info => info;

		protected override bool CanPersist
		{
			get
			{
				if (HasAttribute(PersistentAttribute.AttributeType))
				{
					if (IsStruct)
					{
						return base.ValueParent == null;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (base.Owner is ReflectionClassInfo && ((ReflectionClassInfo)base.Owner).DefaultMembersPersistence == DefaultMembersPersistence.OnlyDeclaredAsPersistent)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (HasAttribute(NonPersistentAttribute.AttributeType))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.IsAliased)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!info.IsPublic)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (info.IsInitOnly)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (DBColumn.IsStorableType(base.StorageType))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (base.Owner.Dictionary.CanGetClassInfoByType(base.StorageType))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Description("Indicates whether the field is public.")]
		public override bool IsPublic => info.IsPublic;

		[Description("Gets the type of this field.")]
		public override Type MemberType => info.FieldType;

		public ReflectionFieldInfo(XPClassInfo owner, FieldInfo fieldInfo, XPMemberInfo valueParent)
			: base(owner, fieldInfo, valueParent, fieldInfo.IsInitOnly)
		{
			info = fieldInfo;
			infoArray = new MemberInfo[1] { info };
		}

		object IFieldAccessor.GetValue(object theObject)
		{
			if (!XpoDefault.UseFastAccessors)
			{
				return info.GetValue(theObject);
			}
			return GetValueFast(theObject);
		}

		void IFieldAccessor.SetValue(object theObject, object theValue)
		{
			if (theValue == null || !XpoDefault.UseFastAccessors)
			{
				info.SetValue(theObject, theValue);
			}
			else
			{
				SetValueFast(theObject, theValue);
			}
		}

		private object GetValueFast(object theObject)
		{
			return FormatterServices.GetObjectData(theObject, infoArray)[0];
		}

		private void SetValueFast(object theObject, object theValue)
		{
			FormatterServices.PopulateObjectMembers(theObject, infoArray, new object[1] { theValue });
		}
	}
	public class CanGetClassInfoByTypeEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		public readonly ReflectionDictionary Dictionary;

		public readonly Type ClassType;

		public bool? CanGetClassInfo;

		public CanGetClassInfoByTypeEventArgs(ReflectionDictionary dictionary, Type classType)
		{
			Dictionary = dictionary;
			ClassType = classType;
		}
	}
	public class ResolveClassInfoByTypeEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		public readonly ReflectionDictionary Dictionary;

		public readonly Type ClassType;

		public XPClassInfo ClassInfo;

		public ResolveClassInfoByTypeEventArgs(ReflectionDictionary dictionary, Type classType)
		{
			Dictionary = dictionary;
			ClassType = classType;
		}
	}
	public class ReflectionDictionary : XPDictionary
	{
		public EventHandler<CanGetClassInfoByTypeEventArgs> CanGetClassInfoByTypeHandler;

		public static EventHandler<CanGetClassInfoByTypeEventArgs> CanGetClassInfoByTypeGlobalHandler;

		public EventHandler<ResolveClassInfoByTypeEventArgs> ResolveClassInfoByTypeHandler;

		public static EventHandler<ResolveClassInfoByTypeEventArgs> ResolveClassInfoByTypeGlobalHandler;

		protected Dictionary<string, XPClassInfo> classesByName = new Dictionary<string, XPClassInfo>();

		protected Dictionary<Type, XPClassInfo> classesByType = new Dictionary<Type, XPClassInfo>();

		[Description("Gets a collection of the XPClassInfo objects that are supplied by the current ReflectionDictionary instance.")]
		public override ICollection Classes
		{
			get
			{
				List<XPClassInfo> list = new List<XPClassInfo>();
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, XPClassInfo> item in classesByName)
				{
					XPClassInfo value = item.Value;
					if (value != null)
					{
						list.Add(value);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		public static bool DefaultCanGetClassInfoByType(Type classType)
		{
			if (classType == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!classType.IsClass && !classType.IsInterface)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (classType.ContainsGenericParameters)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (classType.IsClass && typeof(IXPSimpleObject).IsAssignableFrom(classType))
			{
				return true;
			}
			try
			{
				if (classType.GetCustomAttributes(PersistentAttribute.AttributeType, inherit: true).Length != 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			try
			{
				if (classType.GetCustomAttributes(NonPersistentAttribute.AttributeType, inherit: true).Length != 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool CanGetClassInfoByType(Type classType)
		{
			if (classType == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (classesByType.TryGetValue(classType, out var value))
			{
				return value != null;
			}
			EventHandler<CanGetClassInfoByTypeEventArgs> canGetClassInfoByTypeHandler = CanGetClassInfoByTypeHandler;
			EventHandler<CanGetClassInfoByTypeEventArgs> canGetClassInfoByTypeGlobalHandler = CanGetClassInfoByTypeGlobalHandler;
			bool flag;
			if (canGetClassInfoByTypeHandler != null || canGetClassInfoByTypeGlobalHandler != null)
			{
				CanGetClassInfoByTypeEventArgs e = new CanGetClassInfoByTypeEventArgs(this, classType);
				canGetClassInfoByTypeHandler?.Invoke(this, e);
				canGetClassInfoByTypeGlobalHandler?.Invoke(this, e);
				if (e.CanGetClassInfo.HasValue)
				{
					flag = e.CanGetClassInfo.Value;
					if (!flag && !typeof(DataTable).IsAssignableFrom(classType))
					{
						lock (this)
						{
							if (!classesByType.ContainsKey(classType))
							{
								classesByType.Add(classType, null);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					flag = DefaultCanGetClassInfoByType(classType);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				flag = DefaultCanGetClassInfoByType(classType);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected virtual XPClassInfo ResolveClassInfoByType(Type classType)
		{
			if (CanGetClassInfoByType(classType))
			{
				EventHandler<ResolveClassInfoByTypeEventArgs> resolveClassInfoByTypeHandler = ResolveClassInfoByTypeHandler;
				EventHandler<ResolveClassInfoByTypeEventArgs> resolveClassInfoByTypeGlobalHandler = ResolveClassInfoByTypeGlobalHandler;
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo;
				if (resolveClassInfoByTypeHandler != null || resolveClassInfoByTypeGlobalHandler != null)
				{
					ResolveClassInfoByTypeEventArgs e = new ResolveClassInfoByTypeEventArgs(this, classType);
					resolveClassInfoByTypeHandler?.Invoke(this, e);
					resolveClassInfoByTypeGlobalHandler?.Invoke(this, e);
					xPClassInfo = e.ClassInfo;
					if (xPClassInfo != null)
					{
						lock (this)
						{
							if (!classesByType.ContainsKey(classType))
							{
								classesByType.Add(classType, xPClassInfo);
							}
							string fullName = GetFullName(classType);
							if (!classesByName.ContainsKey(fullName))
							{
								classesByName.Add(fullName, xPClassInfo);
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						xPClassInfo = CreateClassInfo(classType);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					xPClassInfo = CreateClassInfo(classType);
				}
				return xPClassInfo;
			}
			if (typeof(DataTable).IsAssignableFrom(classType))
			{
				try
				{
					return new XPDataTableClassInfo(this, classType);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual XPClassInfo CreateClassInfo(Type classType)
		{
			return new ReflectionClassInfo(classType, this);
		}

		protected virtual XPClassInfo ResolveClassInfoByName(string assemblyName, string typeName)
		{
			if (assemblyName == null || assemblyName == string.Empty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = XPTypeActivator.GetType(assemblyName, typeName);
			if (type == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ResolveClassInfoByType(type);
		}

		protected override void DropDescendantsCache(XPClassInfo changedClassInfo)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, XPClassInfo> item in classesByName)
			{
				XPClassInfo value = item.Value;
				if (value != null && value.BaseClass == changedClassInfo)
				{
					value.DoDrop();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool HasDescendantsCore(XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, XPClassInfo> item in classesByName)
			{
				XPClassInfo value = item.Value;
				if (value != null && value.BaseClass == classInfo)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void AddClassInfoCore(XPClassInfo info)
		{
			classesByName[info.FullName] = info;
			if (info.CanGetByClassType)
			{
				classesByType.Add(info.ClassType, info);
			}
		}

		public override XPClassInfo QueryClassInfo(Type classType)
		{
			if (classType == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (classesByType.TryGetValue(classType, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			lock (this)
			{
				if (classesByType.TryGetValue(classType, out value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				string fullName = GetFullName(classType);
				if (fullName != null && classesByName.TryGetValue(fullName, out var value2) && value2 != null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_SeveralClassesWithSameName", classType.Assembly.FullName, classType.FullName));
				}
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = ResolveClassInfoByType(classType);
				if (xPClassInfo == null)
				{
					classesByType[classType] = null;
				}
				return xPClassInfo;
			}
		}

		internal static string GetFullName(Type classType)
		{
			string result = classType.FullName;
			if (classType.ContainsGenericParameters)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (classType.IsGenericType)
			{
				result = classType.Namespace + "." + classType.Name + "<";
				bool flag = false;
				Type[] genericArguments = classType.GetGenericArguments();
				foreach (Type classType2 in genericArguments)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						result += ",";
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					result += GetFullName(classType2);
				}
				result += ">";
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override XPClassInfo QueryClassInfo(string assemblyName, string className)
		{
			if (className == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (classesByName.TryGetValue(className, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			lock (this)
			{
				if (classesByName.TryGetValue(className, out value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = ResolveClassInfoByName(assemblyName, className);
				if (xPClassInfo == null)
				{
					classesByName.Add(className, null);
				}
				return xPClassInfo;
			}
		}

		private void ClearClasses()
		{
			classesByName = new Dictionary<string, XPClassInfo>();
			classesByType = new Dictionary<Type, XPClassInfo>();
		}
	}
	public class DesignTimeReflection : ReflectionDictionary
	{
		internal sealed class AssemblyNameEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<AssemblyName>
		{
			bool IEqualityComparer<AssemblyName>.Equals(AssemblyName x, AssemblyName y)
			{
				return AssemblyName.ReferenceMatchesDefinition(y, x);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<AssemblyName>.GetHashCode(AssemblyName obj)
			{
				return obj.FullName.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		private readonly IDesignerHost host;

		private readonly ITypeResolutionService typeResolution;

		private readonly ISolutionTypesProvider solutionTypesProvider;

		private Dictionary<AssemblyName, bool> list = new Dictionary<AssemblyName, bool>(new AssemblyNameEqualityComparer());

		private bool inited;

		private Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPCollection> designCollections;

		protected internal override bool UseStrictMetadataValidation => false;

		public override ICollection Classes
		{
			get
			{
				Init();
				return base.Classes;
			}
		}

		public DesignTimeReflection(IServiceProvider provider)
			: this(provider, useSolutionTypesProvider: false)
		{
		}

		public DesignTimeReflection(IServiceProvider provider, bool useSolutionTypesProvider)
		{
			//IL_0076: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IServiceContainer serviceContainer = (IServiceContainer)provider.GetService(typeof(IServiceContainer));
			host = (IDesignerHost)serviceContainer.GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost));
			typeResolution = (ITypeResolutionService)serviceContainer.GetService(typeof(ITypeResolutionService));
			if (useSolutionTypesProvider)
			{
				solutionTypesProvider = (ISolutionTypesProvider)serviceContainer.GetService(typeof(ISolutionTypesProvider));
			}
		}

		private bool Init(AssemblyName name)
		{
			if (list.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return list[name];
			}
			Assembly assembly = null;
			try
			{
				assembly = typeResolution.GetAssembly(name, throwOnError: false);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (assembly == null)
			{
				try
				{
					assembly = SafeTypeResolver.GetOrLoadAssembly(name, false);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			if (assembly == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Init(assembly);
		}

		private bool Init(Assembly assembly)
		{
			AssemblyName name = assembly.GetName();
			if (!list.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				list.Add(name, value: false);
			}
			bool flag = false;
			string name2 = typeof(IXPSimpleObject).Assembly.GetName().Name;
			if (assembly.GetName().Name == name2)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			else
			{
				AssemblyName[] referencedAssemblies = assembly.GetReferencedAssemblies();
				foreach (AssemblyName name3 in referencedAssemblies)
				{
					if (Init(name3))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				flag = false;
				Type[] array;
				try
				{
					array = assembly.GetTypes();
				}
				catch
				{
					array = new Type[0];
				}
				Type[] array2 = array;
				foreach (Type type in array2)
				{
					Type type2 = typeResolution.GetType(type.FullName);
					if (!(type2 != null) || typeof(DataTable).IsAssignableFrom(type2))
					{
						continue;
					}
					try
					{
						if (QueryClassInfo(type2) != null)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}
			list[name] = flag;
			return flag;
		}

		private void Init()
		{
			bool resetClasses = false;
			foreach (XPClassInfo @class in base.Classes)
			{
				if (@class.ClassType != null && @class.ClassType != typeResolution.GetType(@class.ClassType.FullName))
				{
					inited = false;
					resetClasses = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!inited)
			{
				if (solutionTypesProvider != null)
				{
					InitUsingISolutionTypesProvider(resetClasses);
				}
				else
				{
					InitUsingITypeDiscoveryService(resetClasses);
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitUsingITypeDiscoveryService(bool resetClasses)
		{
			Type type = typeResolution.GetType(host.RootComponentClassName);
			if (type != null)
			{
				if (resetClasses)
				{
					classesByName.Clear();
					classesByType.Clear();
					designCollections = null;
				}
				inited = true;
				Init(typeResolution.GetType(host.RootComponentClassName).Assembly);
				ITypeDiscoveryService typeDiscoveryService = (ITypeDiscoveryService)host.GetService(typeof(ITypeDiscoveryService));
				list.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				if (resetClasses)
				{
					return;
				}
				Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
				foreach (XPClassInfo @class in base.Classes)
				{
					if (@class.ClassType != null)
					{
						hashtable[@class.ClassType.Assembly] = null;
					}
				}
				foreach (Assembly key in hashtable.Keys)
				{
					Init(key.GetName());
				}
				list.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void InitUsingISolutionTypesProvider(bool resetClasses)
		{
			if (resetClasses)
			{
				classesByName.Clear();
				classesByType.Clear();
				designCollections = null;
			}
			inited = true;
			IEnumerable<IDXTypeInfo> types = solutionTypesProvider.GetTypes();
			Dictionary<IDXTypeInfo, Type> dictionary = new Dictionary<IDXTypeInfo, Type>();
			foreach (IDXTypeInfo item in types)
			{
				Type type = typeResolution.GetType(item.FullName);
				if (type != null && !typeof(DataTable).IsAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					dictionary[item] = type;
					try
					{
						QueryClassInfo(type);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}
			list.Clear();
		}

		protected override XPClassInfo ResolveClassInfoByName(string assemblyName, string typeName)
		{
			Init();
			Type type = typeResolution.GetType(typeName);
			if (type == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (classesByName.TryGetValue(typeName, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return ResolveClassInfoByType(type);
		}

		protected override void DropDescendantsCache(XPClassInfo changedClassInfo)
		{
		}

		internal object GetDesignCollection(XPClassInfo classInfo, Session session)
		{
			XPCollection value;
			if (designCollections == null)
			{
				designCollections = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPCollection>();
			}
			else if (designCollections.TryGetValue(classInfo, out value) && value.Count == 0)
			{
				return value;
			}
			value = new XPCollection(session, classInfo, loadingEnabled: false);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(value);
			value.BindingBehavior = CollectionBindingBehavior.AllowNew | CollectionBindingBehavior.AllowRemove;
			designCollections[classInfo] = value;
			return value;
		}
	}

	public class IsExactTypeFunction : ICustomFunctionOperatorBrowsable, ICustomFunctionOperator, ICustomFunctionDisplayAttributes, ICustomFunctionOperatorConvertibleToExpression, ICustomFunctionOperatorCompileable
	{
		public const string FunctionName = "IsExactType";

		public string Name => "IsExactType";

		public FunctionCategory Category => (FunctionCategory)2;

		public string Description => "Determines whether a particular object has a specified type.";

		public int MaxOperandCount => 2;

		public int MinOperandCount => 2;

		public string DisplayName => "Is exact type";

		public object Image => null;

		private IsExactTypeFunction()
		{
		}

		public static void Register()
		{
			CriteriaOperator.RegisterCustomFunction((ICustomFunctionOperator)(object)new IsExactTypeFunction());
		}

		public object Evaluate(params object[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length != 2 || !(operands[1] is string))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			return Evaluate(operands[0], (string)operands[1]);
		}

		private static bool Evaluate(object obj, string typeString)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IXPSimpleObject iXPSimpleObject = obj as IXPSimpleObject;
			ISessionProvider sessionProvider = obj as ISessionProvider;
			string text = null;
			if (iXPSimpleObject != null)
			{
				text = iXPSimpleObject.ClassInfo.FullName;
			}
			else if (sessionProvider != null)
			{
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = sessionProvider.Session.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(obj);
				if (xPClassInfo != null)
				{
					text = xPClassInfo.FullName;
				}
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = obj.GetType().FullName;
			}
			return EqualsType(typeString, text);
		}

		public Type ResultType(params Type[] operands)
		{
			return typeof(bool);
		}

		public static bool IsExactType(object obj, Type type)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("IsExactTypeFunction_ShouldNotBeCalledExplicitly"));
		}

		public bool IsValidOperandCount(int count)
		{
			return count == 2;
		}

		public bool IsValidOperandType(int operandIndex, int operandCount, Type type)
		{
			if (operandCount == 2)
			{
				return operandIndex switch
				{
					1 => type == typeof(string), 
					0 => true, 
					_ => false, 
				};
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool EqualsType(string typeString, string objectTypeString)
		{
			if (objectTypeString == typeString)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int num = objectTypeString.LastIndexOf('.');
			int num2 = objectTypeString.LastIndexOf('+');
			if (num < 0 && num2 < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return objectTypeString.Substring(((num2 > num) ? num2 : num) + 1) == typeString;
		}

		public Expression Convert(ICriteriaToExpressionConverter converter, params Expression[] operands)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("IsExactTypeFunction_NotSupported"));
		}

		public Expression Create(params Expression[] operands)
		{
			return Expression.Call(typeof(IsExactTypeFunction), "Evaluate", Type.EmptyTypes, operands);
		}
	}
	public class IsInstanceOfTypeFunction : ICustomFunctionOperatorBrowsable, ICustomFunctionOperator, ICustomFunctionDisplayAttributes, ICustomFunctionOperatorConvertibleToExpression, ICustomFunctionOperatorCompileable
	{
		public const string FunctionName = "IsInstanceOfType";

		private static ConcurrentDictionary<string, Type> foundTypes = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, Type>();

		public string Name => "IsInstanceOfType";

		public FunctionCategory Category => (FunctionCategory)2;

		public string Description => "Determines whether a particular object is of a specified type or derives from it. ";

		public int MaxOperandCount => 2;

		public int MinOperandCount => 2;

		public string DisplayName => "Is instance of type";

		public object Image => null;

		private IsInstanceOfTypeFunction()
		{
		}

		public static void Register()
		{
			CriteriaOperator.RegisterCustomFunction((ICustomFunctionOperator)(object)new IsInstanceOfTypeFunction());
		}

		public object Evaluate(params object[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length != 2 || !(operands[1] is string))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			return Evaluate(operands[0], (string)operands[1]);
		}

		private static bool Evaluate(object obj, string typeString)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IXPSimpleObject iXPSimpleObject = obj as IXPSimpleObject;
			ISessionProvider sessionProvider = obj as ISessionProvider;
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = null;
			if (iXPSimpleObject != null)
			{
				xPClassInfo = iXPSimpleObject.ClassInfo;
			}
			else if (sessionProvider != null)
			{
				xPClassInfo = sessionProvider.Session.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(obj);
			}
			if (xPClassInfo != null)
			{
				return IsInstanceOfType(typeString, xPClassInfo);
			}
			return IsInstanceOfType(typeString, obj.GetType());
		}

		internal static bool IsInstanceOfType(string typeString, XPClassInfo objectClassInfo)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = null;
			if (!MemberInfoCollection.TryResolveTypeAlsoByShortName(typeString, objectClassInfo, out classInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return objectClassInfo.IsAssignableTo(classInfo);
		}

		internal static bool IsInstanceOfType(string typeString, XPClassInfo objectClassInfo, out XPClassInfo searchedClassInfo)
		{
			if (!MemberInfoCollection.TryResolveTypeAlsoByShortName(typeString, objectClassInfo, out searchedClassInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return objectClassInfo.IsAssignableTo(searchedClassInfo);
		}

		internal static bool IsInstanceOfType(string typeString, Type objectType)
		{
			do
			{
				if (IsExactTypeFunction.EqualsType(typeString, objectType.FullName))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			while ((objectType = DXTypeExtensions.GetBaseType(objectType)) != null);
			return false;
		}

		public Type ResultType(params Type[] operands)
		{
			return typeof(bool);
		}

		public static bool IsInstanceOfType(object obj, Type type)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("IsInstanceOfTypeFunction_ShouldNotBeCalledExplicitly"));
		}

		public bool IsValidOperandCount(int count)
		{
			return count == 2;
		}

		public bool IsValidOperandType(int operandIndex, int operandCount, Type type)
		{
			if (operandCount == 2)
			{
				return operandIndex switch
				{
					1 => type == typeof(string), 
					0 => true, 
					_ => false, 
				};
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Expression Convert(ICriteriaToExpressionConverter converter, params Expression[] operands)
		{
			if (operands[0] == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("Object");
			}
			if (!(operands[1] is ConstantExpression constantExpression))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("IsInstanceOfTypeFunction_ParametersMustBeConstants", "IsInstanceOfType"));
			}
			string text;
			try
			{
				text = (string)constantExpression.Value;
			}
			catch (InvalidCastException)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("IsInstanceOfTypeFunction_InvalidArgument_TypeName", "IsInstanceOfType", constantExpression.Type));
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("IsInstanceOfTypeFunction_ClassNotFound", "IsInstanceOfType", "[type name not provided]"));
			}
			Assembly preferredAssembly = operands[0].Type.Assembly;
			Type orAdd = foundTypes.GetOrAdd(text, (string tn) => GetTypeByName(tn, preferredAssembly));
			if (orAdd == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("IsInstanceOfTypeFunction_ClassNotFound", "IsInstanceOfType", text));
			}
			return Expression.TypeIs(operands[0], orAdd);
		}

		private static Type GetTypeByName(string typeName, Assembly preferredAssembly)
		{
			Type knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(preferredAssembly, typeName, false, (bool?)null);
			if (knownType == null)
			{
				foreach (Assembly loadedAssembly in AssemblyHelper.GetLoadedAssemblies())
				{
					knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(loadedAssembly, typeName, false, (bool?)null);
					if (knownType != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return knownType;
		}

		public Expression Create(params Expression[] operands)
		{
			return Expression.Call(typeof(IsInstanceOfTypeFunction), "Evaluate", Type.EmptyTypes, operands);
		}
	}

		{
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			bool addKeyTail;
