			MemberInfoCollection path;

			if (EvaluatorProperty.GetIsThisProperty(propertyContext))
			{

			}
			if (xPMemberInfo.IsKey && resolveKeyBehavior == CriteriaTypeResolveKeyBehavior.AlwaysReference)
			{
				if (path.Count == 1)
				{
					return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(upLevels[level].ClassType, (object)upLevels[level]);
				}
				xPMemberInfo = path[path.Count - 2];
			}
			if (xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType != null)

				if ((!(xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType.ClassType != null) || !xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType.ClassType.IsInterface) && resolveKeyBehavior == CriteriaTypeResolveKeyBehavior.AlwaysKey)
				{
					return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType.KeyProperty.MemberType, (object)xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType);
				}
				return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType.ClassType, (object)xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType);
			}
			return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(xPMemberInfo.MemberType);
		}

		CriteriaTypeResolverResult IClientCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>.Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)

			if ((int)aggregateType != 0)

		private string GetPropertyContext(string originalPropertyName, out int level, out MemberInfoCollection path)
		{
			level = 0;
			string text = originalPropertyName;
			while (text.StartsWith("^."))
			{
				level++;
				text = text.Substring(2);
			}
			path = upLevels[level].ParsePath(text);
			return text;
		}

		CriteriaTypeResolverResult IClientCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>.Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_006d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Aggregate aggregateType = theOperand.AggregateType;
			if ((int)aggregateType != 0)
			{
				if ((int)aggregateType == 1)
				{
					return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(typeof(int));
				}
				XPClassInfo classInfo = null;
				if (!MemberInfoCollection.TryResolveTypeAlsoByShortName(theOperand.JoinTypeName, upLevels[0], out classInfo))
				{
					throw new CannotResolveClassInfoException(string.Empty, theOperand.JoinTypeName);
				}

				{
					return ResolveTypeInContext(classInfo, 0, theOperand.AggregatedExpression, CriteriaTypeResolveKeyBehavior.AsIs);
				}
				Type[] array = new Type[((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands).Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands).Count; i++)
				{

					array[num] = ((CriteriaTypeResolverResult)(ref val)).Type;
				}

			}

		}

		private CriteriaTypeResolverResult ResolveTypeInContext(XPClassInfo joinedCi, int level, CriteriaOperator criteria, CriteriaTypeResolveKeyBehavior resolveKeyBehavior)
		{
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XPClassInfo[] array = new XPClassInfo[upLevels.Length + 1];
			Array.Copy(upLevels, level, array, 1, upLevels.Length - level);
			array[0] = joinedCi;
			return ResolveTypeResult(array, dictionary, criteria, resolveKeyBehavior);
		}

		private Type enumType;

		public override Type StorageType => Enum.GetUnderlyingType(enumType);

		public EnumsConverter(Type enumType)
		{
			this.enumType = enumType;
		}

		public override object ConvertFromStorageType(object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				return Enum.ToObject(enumType, value);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override object ConvertToStorageType(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (value is string)
			{
				value = Enum.Parse(enumType, (string)value, ignoreCase: false);
			}
			value = Convert.ChangeType(value, StorageType, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			return value;
		}
	}
	public class DefaultTimeSpanConverter : ValueConverter
	{
		public override Type StorageType => typeof(double);

		public override object ConvertFromStorageType(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (value is TimeSpan)
			{
				return value;
			}
			double num = Convert.ToDouble(value);
			if (num > TimeSpan.MaxValue.TotalSeconds - 0.0005 && num < TimeSpan.MaxValue.TotalSeconds + 0.0005)
			{
				return TimeSpan.MaxValue;
			}
			if (num < TimeSpan.MinValue.TotalSeconds + 0.0005 && num > TimeSpan.MinValue.TotalSeconds - 0.0005)
			{
				return TimeSpan.MinValue;
			}
			return TimeSpan.FromSeconds(num);
		}

		public override object ConvertToStorageType(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (value is double)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (value is float)
			{
				return Convert.ToDouble(value);
			}
			return ((TimeSpan)value).TotalSeconds;
		}
	}

	public sealed class IntermediateClassInfo : XPClassInfo
	{
		private MembersCollection ownMembers = new MembersCollection();

		private string name;

		internal IntermediateObjectFieldInfo intermediateObjectFieldInfoLeft;

		internal IntermediateObjectFieldInfo intermediateObjectFieldInfoRight;

		public const string IntermediateObjectAssemblyName = "";

		public override XPClassInfo BaseClass => base.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(typeof(IntermediateObject));

		public override ICollection<XPMemberInfo> OwnMembers => ownMembers;

		public override string FullName => name;

		public override string AssemblyName => "";

		protected override bool CanPersist => true;

		public override Type ClassType => typeof(IntermediateObject);

		public override bool CanGetByClassType => false;

		private void internalCollectMembers(Type currentType)
		{
			FieldInfo[] fields = currentType.GetFields(BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in fields)
			{
				new ReflectionFieldInfo(this, fieldInfo, null);
			}
			PropertyInfo[] properties = currentType.GetProperties(BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
			{
				new ReflectionPropertyInfo(this, propertyInfo, null);
			}
		}

		public override bool HasModifications(object theObject)
		{
			return PersistentBase.GetModificationsStore(theObject).HasModifications();
		}

		public override void ClearModifications(object theObject)
		{
			PersistentBase.GetModificationsStore(theObject).ClearModifications();
		}

		public override void AddMember(XPMemberInfo newMember)
		{
			ownMembers.Add(newMember);
			base.AddMember(newMember);
		}

		public IntermediateClassInfo(XPMemberInfo refProperty, XPMemberInfo relatedProperty, XPDictionary dictionary, string name)
			: base(dictionary)
		{
			base.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(typeof(IntermediateObject));
			base.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(typeof(XPBaseObject));
			this.name = name;
			internalCollectMembers(typeof(IntermediateObject));
			intermediateObjectFieldInfoLeft = new IntermediateObjectFieldInfo(refProperty, this, isLeft: true);
			IndexedAttribute attribute = new IndexedAttribute(relatedProperty.Name)
			{
				Unique = true
			};
			intermediateObjectFieldInfoLeft.AddAttribute(attribute);
			intermediateObjectFieldInfoRight = new IntermediateObjectFieldInfo(relatedProperty, this, isLeft: false);
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(int);
			if (intermediateObjectFieldInfoLeft.ReferenceType.KeyProperty.MemberType == typeof(Guid) && intermediateObjectFieldInfoRight.ReferenceType.KeyProperty.MemberType == typeof(Guid))
			{
				typeFromHandle = typeof(Guid);
			}
			new IntermediateObjectKeyFieldInfo(this, typeFromHandle);
			optimisticLockingCache = new OptimisticLockingCacheItem(OptimisticLockingBehavior.ConsiderOptimisticLockingField, new OptimisticLockField(this, base.OptimisticLockFieldName), new OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer(this, base.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayerName));
			base.Dictionary.AddClassInfo(this);
		}

		protected internal override object CreateObjectInstance(Session session, XPClassInfo instantiationClassInfo)
		{
			return new IntermediateObject(session, instantiationClassInfo);
		}

		public IntermediateObjectFieldInfo GetFieldInfo(XPMemberInfo refProperty)
		{
			if (intermediateObjectFieldInfoLeft.refProperty == refProperty)
			{
				return intermediateObjectFieldInfoLeft;
			}
			if (intermediateObjectFieldInfoRight.refProperty == refProperty)
			{
				return intermediateObjectFieldInfoRight;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public sealed class MemberInfoCollection : List<XPMemberInfo>
	{
		private XPClassInfo classInfo;

		private bool hasNonPersistent;

		private static char[] upcastSymbols = new char[2] { '<', '>' };

		private static char[] namespaceSplitters = new char[2] { '.', '+' };

		public bool HasNonPersistent => hasNonPersistent;

		public MemberInfoCollection(XPClassInfo classInfo, int count)
		{
			this.classInfo = classInfo;
		}

		public MemberInfoCollection(XPClassInfo classInfo)
			: this(classInfo, 4)
		{
		}

		public MemberInfoCollection(XPClassInfo classInfo, params XPMemberInfo[] members)
			: this(classInfo, members.Length)
		{
			AddRange(members);
		}

		public MemberInfoCollection(XPClassInfo classInfo, string path)
			: this(classInfo, path, addNonPersistent: false)
		{
		}

		public MemberInfoCollection(XPClassInfo classInfo, string path, bool addNonPersistent)
			: this(classInfo, path, addNonPersistent, throwOnError: true)
		{
		}

		public MemberInfoCollection(XPClassInfo classInfo, string path, bool addNonPersistent, bool throwOnError)
			: this(classInfo, SplitPath(path), addNonPersistent, throwOnError)
		{
		}

		public MemberInfoCollection(XPClassInfo classInfo, string[] matches, bool addNonPersistent, bool throwOnError)
			: this(classInfo)
		{
			//IL_00a5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = classInfo;
			for (int i = 0; i < matches.Length; i++)
			{
				if (xPClassInfo == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = FindMember(xPClassInfo, matches[i]);
				while (xPMemberInfo != null && xPMemberInfo.IsStruct && i < matches.Length - 1)
				{
					i++;
					xPMemberInfo = xPClassInfo.FindMember(xPMemberInfo.Name + "." + matches[i]);
				}
				if (xPMemberInfo == null || (!addNonPersistent && !xPMemberInfo.IsExpandableToPersistent) || (i < matches.Length - 1 && xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType == null))
				{
					if (throwOnError)
					{
						throw new InvalidPropertyPathException(Res.GetString("MetaData_IncorrectPathMemberNotExists", classInfo.FullName, string.Join(".", matches), xPClassInfo.FullName, matches[i]));
					}
					Clear();
					break;
				}
				if (!xPMemberInfo.IsExpandableToPersistent)
				{
					hasNonPersistent = true;
				}
				Add(xPMemberInfo);
				xPClassInfo = xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType;
			}
		}

		public static MemberInfoCollection ParsePath(XPClassInfo classInfo, string path)
		{
			return classInfo.ParsePath(path);
		}

		public static MemberInfoCollection ParsePersistentPath(XPClassInfo classInfo, string path)
		{
			return classInfo.ParsePersistentPath(path);
		}

		public static XPMemberInfo FindMember(XPClassInfo currentClassInfo, string match)
		{
			if (match.Length == 0 || match[0] != '<')
			{
				return currentClassInfo.FindMember(match);
			}
			int num = match.IndexOf('>');
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = match.Substring(1, num - 1);
			string match2 = match.Substring(num + 1);
			if (TryResolveType(text, currentClassInfo, out var xPClassInfo) && xPClassInfo != null && xPClassInfo.IsAssignableTo(currentClassInfo))
			{
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = FindMember(xPClassInfo, match2);
				if (xPMemberInfo != null)
				{
					return xPMemberInfo;
				}
			}
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo2 = currentClassInfo.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(string.Empty, text);
			if (xPClassInfo2 != null && xPClassInfo2.IsAssignableTo(currentClassInfo))
			{
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo2 = FindMember(xPClassInfo2, match2);
				if (xPMemberInfo2 != null)
				{
					return xPMemberInfo2;
				}
			}
			XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo3 = null;
			foreach (XPClassInfo @class in currentClassInfo.Dictionary.Classes)
			{
				if (!@class.FullName.EndsWith(text))
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num2 = @class.FullName.Length - text.Length - 1;
				if (num2 >= 0)
				{
					char c = @class.FullName[num2];
					if (c != '.' && c != '+')
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo4 = FindMember(@class, match2);
				if (xPMemberInfo4 != null && (!@class.IsPersistent || !currentClassInfo.IsPersistent || @class.IdClass == currentClassInfo.IdClass))
				{
					if (xPMemberInfo3 != null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_AmbiguousClassName", text, xPMemberInfo4.Owner.FullName, xPMemberInfo3.Owner.FullName));
					}
					xPMemberInfo3 = xPMemberInfo4;
				}
			}
			return xPMemberInfo3;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			XPClassInfo referenceType = classInfo;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				if (stringBuilder.Length != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append('.');
				}
				if (base[i] != null)
				{
					if (referenceType != null && !referenceType.IsAssignableTo(base[i].Owner))
					{
						string fullName = base[i].Owner.FullName;
						stringBuilder.Append('<');
						stringBuilder.Append(fullName);
						stringBuilder.Append('>');
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(base[i].Name);
					referenceType = base[i].ReferenceType;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append('^');
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static string[] SplitPath(string path)
		{
			if (path.IndexOf('.') < 0)
			{
				return new string[1] { path };
			}
			if (path.IndexOfAny(upcastSymbols) < 0)
			{
				return path.Split('.');
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			bool flag = false;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < path.Length; i++)
			{
				switch (path[i])
				{
				case '.':
					if (!flag)
					{
						list.Add(path.Substring(num, i - num));
						num = i + 1;
					}
					break;
				case '<':
					flag = true;
					break;
				case '>':
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num < path.Length)
			{
				if (num == 0)
				{
					return new string[1] { path };
				}
				if (path[num] != '<' || path[path.Length - 1] != '>')
				{
					list.Add(path.Substring(num, path.Length - num));
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static int LastIndexOfSplittingDotInPath(string path)
		{
			int num = path.LastIndexOf('.');
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			int num2 = path.IndexOf('>', num);
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			int num3 = path.LastIndexOf('<', num2);
			if (num3 < 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Unbalansed <upcasting> within '" + path + "' property path");
			}
			return path.LastIndexOf('.', num3);
		}

		public static int GetSplitPartsCount(string path)
		{
			if (path.Length == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 1;
			for (int i = 0; i < path.Length; i++)
			{
				switch (path[i])
				{
				case '.':
					num++;
					continue;
				case '<':
					break;
				default:
					continue;
				}
				while (path[i] != '>')
				{
					i++;
					if (i >= path.Length)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Unbalanced upcasting '" + path + "'");
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static bool TryResolveType(string className, XPClassInfo rootClassInfo, out XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			classInfo = null;
			int num = rootClassInfo.FullName.LastIndexOfAny(namespaceSplitters);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = ((className.LastIndexOfAny(namespaceSplitters) < 0) ? rootClassInfo.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(rootClassInfo.AssemblyName, rootClassInfo.FullName.Substring(0, num + 1) + className) : rootClassInfo.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(rootClassInfo.AssemblyName, className));
				classInfo = xPClassInfo;
			}
			if (classInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool TryResolveTypeAlsoByShortName(string className, XPClassInfo rootClassInfo, out XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			classInfo = null;
			if (!TryResolveType(className, rootClassInfo, out classInfo))
			{
				bool flag = className.LastIndexOfAny(namespaceSplitters) >= 0;
				foreach (XPClassInfo @class in rootClassInfo.Dictionary.Classes)
				{
					if (@class.FullName != className)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (@class.ClassType == null)
						{
							int num = @class.FullName.LastIndexOfAny(namespaceSplitters);
							if ((num < 0 || !(@class.FullName.Substring(num) == className)) && (num >= 0 || !(@class.FullName == className)))
							{
								continue;
							}
						}
						else if (@class.ClassType.Name != className)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					classInfo = @class;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class CriteriaCompilerDescriptorXpo : CriteriaCompilerDescriptor
	{
		public readonly XPClassInfo Owner;

		public readonly Session Session;

		private static Func<object, XPClassInfo, bool> isReallyUpCasted = (object instance, XPClassInfo ci) => instance != null && ci.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(instance).IsAssignableTo(ci);

		public override Type ObjectType => Owner.RealInstanceType;

		public CriteriaCompilerDescriptorXpo(XPClassInfo owner, Session session)
		{
			Owner = owner;
			Session = session;
		}

		public override Expression MakePropertyAccess(Expression baseExpression, string propertyPath)
		{
			if (EvaluatorProperty.GetIsThisProperty(propertyPath))
			{
				return baseExpression;
			}
			KeyValuePair<XPMemberInfo, string> keyValuePair = ResolveDiveStep(propertyPath);
			XPMemberInfo key = keyValuePair.Key;
			string value = keyValuePair.Value;
			if (value == null)
			{
				return MakePropertyAccessCore(baseExpression, key);
			}
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression = Expression.Parameter(key.ReferenceType.ClassType, "sub");
			Expression expression = key.ReferenceType.GetCriteriaCompilerDescriptor(Session).MakePropertyAccess((Expression)parameterExpression, value);
			if (!NullableHelpers.CanAcceptNull(expression.Type))
			{
				expression = Expression.Convert(expression, NullableHelpers.GetUnBoxedType(expression.Type));
			}
			Expression body = Expression.Condition(Expression.Call(typeof(object), "ReferenceEquals", null, parameterExpression, Expression.Constant(null)), Expression.Constant(null, expression.Type), expression);
			LambdaExpression expression2 = Expression.Lambda(body, parameterExpression);
			Expression expression3 = MakePropertyAccessCore(baseExpression, key);
			return Expression.Invoke(expression2, expression3);
		}

		private KeyValuePair<XPMemberInfo, string> ResolveDiveStep(string path)
		{
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
			{
				throw new InvalidPropertyPathException(Res.GetString("MetaData_IncorrectPath", Owner.FullName, "(Empty)"));
			}
			string[] array = MemberInfoCollection.SplitPath(path);
			int num = 1;
			XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo;
			while (true)
			{
				string text = ((num == array.Length) ? path : string.Join(".", array, 0, num));
				xPMemberInfo = MemberInfoCollection.FindMember(Owner, text);
				if (xPMemberInfo == null)
				{
					if (num == array.Length)
					{
						throw new InvalidPropertyPathException(Res.GetString("MetaData_IncorrectPath", Owner.FullName, text));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (num == array.Length)
					{
						return new KeyValuePair<XPMemberInfo, string>(xPMemberInfo, null);
					}
					if (xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				num++;
			}
			return new KeyValuePair<XPMemberInfo, string>(xPMemberInfo, string.Join(".", array, num, array.Length - num));
		}

		private Expression MakePropertyAccessCore(Expression baseExpression, XPMemberInfo mi)
		{
			if (Owner.IsAssignableTo(mi.Owner))
			{
				return mi.MakeGetExpression(baseExpression);
			}
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression = Expression.Parameter(mi.Owner.ClassType, "upCasted");
			Expression expression = mi.MakeGetExpression(parameterExpression);
			if (!NullableHelpers.CanAcceptNull(expression.Type))
			{
				expression = Expression.Convert(expression, NullableHelpers.GetUnBoxedType(expression.Type));
			}
			Expression.Constant(Owner.Dictionary);
			Expression body = Expression.Condition(Expression.Invoke(Expression.Constant(isReallyUpCasted), parameterExpression, Expression.Constant(mi.Owner)), expression, Expression.Constant(null, expression.Type));
			Expression expression2 = Expression.Lambda(body, parameterExpression);
			return Expression.Invoke(expression2, Expression.TypeAs(baseExpression, mi.Owner.ClassType));
		}

		public override CriteriaCompilerRefResult DiveIntoCollectionProperty(Expression baseExpression, string collectionPropertyPath)
		{
			//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ae: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00af: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (EvaluatorProperty.GetIsThisProperty(collectionPropertyPath))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("unexpected top level collection " + collectionPropertyPath);
			}
			KeyValuePair<XPMemberInfo, string> keyValuePair = ResolveDiveStep(collectionPropertyPath);
			XPMemberInfo key = keyValuePair.Key;
			string value = keyValuePair.Value;
			CriteriaCompilerDescriptor criteriaCompilerDescriptor;
			if (value == null)
			{
				if (!key.IsAssociationList && !key.IsNonAssociationList)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("Metadata_AssociationListExpected", Owner.FullName, collectionPropertyPath), "collectionPropertyPath");
				}
				criteriaCompilerDescriptor = key.CollectionElementType.GetCriteriaCompilerDescriptor(Session);
			}
			else
			{
				criteriaCompilerDescriptor = key.ReferenceType.GetCriteriaCompilerDescriptor(Session);
			}
			Expression expression = MakePropertyAccessCore(baseExpression, key);
			return new CriteriaCompilerRefResult(new CriteriaCompilerLocalContext(expression, criteriaCompilerDescriptor), value);
		}

		public static object FreeJoinDo(Session session, XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperator topLevelExpression, CriteriaOperator condition, OperandParameter[] parameters, object[] parameterValues)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < parameters.Length; i++)
			{
				((OperandValue)parameters[i]).Value = parameterValues[i];
			}
			object obj = session.EvaluateInTransaction(classInfo, topLevelExpression, condition);
			if (obj != null)
			{
				Type classType = CriteriaTypeResolver.ResolveType(classInfo, topLevelExpression);
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = session.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(classType);
				if (xPClassInfo != null)
				{
					return session.GetObjectByKey(xPClassInfo, obj);
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		private unsafe LambdaExpression MakeFreeJoinLambdaInternal(string joinTypeName, CriteriaOperator condition, OperandParameter[] conditionParameters, Aggregate aggregateType, string customAggregateName, CriteriaOperator[] aggregateExpressions, OperandParameter[] aggregateExpresssionsParameters, Type[] invokeTypes)
		{
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0109: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0130: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (!MemberInfoCollection.TryResolveTypeAlsoByShortName(joinTypeName, Owner, out var queryType))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Metadata_TypeNotFound", joinTypeName));
			}
			queryType.CheckAbstractReference();
			CriteriaOperator topLevelAggregate;
			if ((int)aggregateType != 7)
			{
				topLevelAggregate = (CriteriaOperator)(((int)aggregateType == 6) ? ((object)aggregateExpressions[0]) : ((object)AggregateOperand.TopLevel(aggregateType, aggregateExpressions[0])));
			}
			else
			{
				topLevelAggregate = (CriteriaOperator)(object)AggregateOperand.TopLevel(customAggregateName, (IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)aggregateExpressions);
			}
			OperandParameter[] allParameters = conditionParameters.Concat(aggregateExpresssionsParameters).ToArray();
			ParameterExpression[] array = invokeTypes.Select((Type t, int i) => Expression.Parameter(t, "p" + i + "_" + allParameters[i].ParameterName)).ToArray();
			Expression expression = Expression.NewArrayInit(typeof(object), array.Select((ParameterExpression p) => (!(p.Type != typeof(object))) ? ((Expression)p) : ((Expression)Expression.Convert(p, typeof(object)))));
			Session session = Session;
			Func<object[], object> value = (object[] values) => FreeJoinDo(session, queryType, topLevelAggregate, condition, allParameters, values);
			Expression expression2 = Expression.Invoke(Expression.Constant(value), expression);
			Type type;
			switch ((int)aggregateType)
			{
			case 1:
				type = typeof(int?);
				break;
			case 0:
				type = typeof(bool?);
				break;
			case 2:
			case 3:
			case 6:
				type = NullableHelpers.GetUnBoxedType(CriteriaTypeResolver.ResolveType(queryType, aggregateExpressions[0]));
				break;
			case 5:
				type = CriteriaTypeResolver.ResolveType(queryType, aggregateExpressions[0]);
				type = EvalHelpers.GetBinaryNumericPromotionType(type, type);
				type = NullableHelpers.GetUnBoxedType(type);
				break;
			case 4:
				type = CriteriaTypeResolver.ResolveType(queryType, aggregateExpressions[0]);
				type = EvalHelpers.GetBinaryNumericPromotionType(type, type);
				if (type != typeof(float) && type != typeof(decimal))
				{
					type = typeof(double);
				}
				type = NullableHelpers.GetUnBoxedType(type);
				break;
			case 7:
				type = typeof(object);
				break;
			default:
				throw new NotImplementedException(((object)(*(Aggregate*)(&aggregateType))/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
			}
			if (expression2.Type != type)
			{
				expression2 = Expression.Convert(expression2, type);
			}
			return Expression.Lambda(expression2, array);
		}

		public override LambdaExpression MakeFreeJoinLambda(string joinTypeName, CriteriaOperator condition, OperandParameter[] conditionParameters, Aggregate aggregateType, CriteriaOperator aggregateExpression, OperandParameter[] aggregateExpresssionParameters, Type[] invokeTypes)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return MakeFreeJoinLambdaInternal(joinTypeName, condition, conditionParameters, aggregateType, null, (CriteriaOperator[])(object)new CriteriaOperator[1] { aggregateExpression }, aggregateExpresssionParameters, invokeTypes);
		}

		public override LambdaExpression MakeFreeJoinLambda(string joinTypeName, CriteriaOperator condition, OperandParameter[] conditionParameters, string customAggregateName, IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator> aggregateExpressions, OperandParameter[] aggregateExpresssionsParameters, Type[] invokeTypes)
		{
			return MakeFreeJoinLambdaInternal(joinTypeName, condition, conditionParameters, (Aggregate)7, customAggregateName, aggregateExpressions.ToArray(), aggregateExpresssionsParameters, invokeTypes);
		}
	}
	public class ClassInfoByFullNameComparer : IComparer<XPClassInfo>
	{
		public static readonly ClassInfoByFullNameComparer Instance = new ClassInfoByFullNameComparer();

		private ClassInfoByFullNameComparer()
		{
		}

		public int Compare(XPClassInfo x, XPClassInfo y)
		{
			if (x == null)
			{
				if (y == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (y == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return StringExtensions.ComparerInvariantCulture.Compare(x.FullName, y.FullName);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpo.Logger
{
	public class LoggerBase : ILogger, ILogSource
	{
		private int capacity;

		private LogMessage[] messageArray;

		private long headtail;

		private int lostMessageCount;

		private bool enabled = true;

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				long headTail = Interlocked.Read(ref headtail);
				GetHeadAndTail(headTail, out var head, out var tail);
				if (tail <= head)
				{
					return capacity - head + tail;
				}
				return tail - head;
			}
		}

		public int Capacity => capacity;

		public int LostMessageCount => lostMessageCount;

		public bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				return enabled;
			}
			set
			{
				enabled = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsServerActive => true;

		public LoggerBase(int capacity)
		{
			this.capacity = capacity;
			messageArray = (LogMessage[])(object)new LogMessage[capacity];
		}

		private static void GetHeadAndTail(long headTail, out int head, out int tail)
		{
			head = (int)(headTail & 0x7FFFFFFF);
			tail = (int)((headTail & 0x7FFFFFFF00000000L) >> 32);
		}

		private static long GetHeadTail(int head, int tail)
		{
			return (long)((((ulong)tail & 0x7FFFFFFFuL) << 32) | ((ulong)head & 0x7FFFFFFFuL));
		}

		public void Log(LogMessage message)
		{
			if (!enabled || capacity == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			long num;
			int head;
			long headTail;
			LogMessage val;
			do
			{
				num = headtail;
				GetHeadAndTail(num, out head, out var tail);
				int num2 = head + 1;
				int num3 = tail;
				if (num2 >= capacity)
				{
					num2 = 0;
				}
				if ((num2 >= num3 && head < tail) || num2 == num3)
				{
					num3 = num2 + 1;
					flag = true;
				}
				if (num3 >= capacity)
				{
					num3 = 0;
				}
				headTail = GetHeadTail(num2, num3);
				val = messageArray[head];
			}
			while (num != Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref headtail, headTail, num));
			if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref messageArray[head], message, val) != val)
			{
				Interlocked.Increment(ref lostMessageCount);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Interlocked.Increment(ref lostMessageCount);
			}
		}

		public void Log(LogMessage[] messages)
		{
			if (enabled && capacity != 0)
			{
				foreach (LogMessage message in messages)
				{
					Log(message);
				}
			}
		}

		public LogMessage GetMessage()
		{
			if (!enabled)
			{
				return null;
			}
			long num;
			int tail;
			long headTail;
			LogMessage val;
			do
			{
				num = headtail;
				GetHeadAndTail(num, out var head, out tail);
				int num2 = tail + 1;
				if (num2 >= capacity)
				{
					num2 = 0;
				}
				if (head == tail)
				{
					return null;
				}
				headTail = GetHeadTail(head, num2);
				val = messageArray[tail];
			}
			while (num != Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref headtail, headTail, num) && val != messageArray[tail]);
			return val;
		}

		public LogMessage[] GetMessages(int messagesAmount)
		{
			if (!enabled)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<LogMessage> list = new List<LogMessage>(messagesAmount);
			for (int i = 0; i < messagesAmount; i++)
			{
				LogMessage message = GetMessage();
				if (message == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				list.Add(message);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public LogMessage[] GetCompleteLog()
		{
			if (!enabled)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<LogMessage> list = new List<LogMessage>(Count);
			LogMessage message;
			while ((message = GetMessage()) != null)
			{
				list.Add(message);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public void ClearLog()
		{
			if (enabled && capacity != 0)
			{
				long num;
				long headTail;
				do
				{
					num = headtail;
					GetHeadAndTail(num, out var _, out var _);
					int head2 = 0;
					int tail2 = 0;
					headTail = GetHeadTail(head2, tail2);
				}
				while (num != Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref headtail, headTail, num));
			}
		}
	}
	internal class LogHelpers
	{
		public static string QueryToString(ObjectsQuery query)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "ClassInfoFullName:{0}; ", new object[1] { query.ClassInfo.FullName });
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Criteria:{0}; ", new object[1] { (query.Criteria == null) ? CriteriaOperator.op_Implicit("null") : query.Criteria });
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Force:{0}; ", new object[1] { query.Force });
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "SkipSelectedRecords:{0}; ", new object[1] { query.SkipSelectedRecords });
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "TopSelectedRecords:{0}; ", new object[1] { query.TopSelectedRecords });
			stringBuilder.Append(SortingCollectionToString(query.Sorting));
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static string ObjectsByKeyQueryToString(ObjectsByKeyQuery query)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "ClassInfoFullName:{0}; ", new object[1] { query.ClassInfo.FullName });
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "ObjectsCount:{0}", new object[1] { query.IdCollection.Count });
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static string SortingCollectionToString(SortingCollection collection)
		{
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (collection == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < collection.Count; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}:{1}; ", new object[2]
				{
					collection[i].PropertyName,
					collection[i].Direction
				});
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpo.Logger.Transport
{
	public interface ILogClient : ILogSource, IDisposable
	{
		bool Start();

		bool Stop();
	}
	public class LogClient : ILogClient, ILogSource, IDisposable
	{
		private ChannelFactory<ILogSource> myChannelFactory;

		private ChannelFactory<ILogActivationServer> activationChannelFactory;

		private ILogSource xpoLogClient;

		private ILogActivationServer activationChannelClient;

		private readonly string auxPath;

		private readonly string activationPath;

		private readonly bool useRemoteProxy;

		private readonly int port;

		private readonly NetBinding binding;

		private Mutex mutex;

		private bool active;

		public bool Active => active;

		public string ChannelState
		{
			get
			{
				if (myChannelFactory != null)
				{
					return myChannelFactory.State.ToString();
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public LogClient(string host, int port)
			: this(new Host(host, port))
		{
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public LogClient(Host host)
		{
			binding = host.Binding;
			useRemoteProxy = !IsLocalhost(host.HostAddress) && binding == NetBinding.NetTcpBinding;
			if (binding == NetBinding.NetTcpBinding)
			{
				port = host.Port;
				activationPath = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, LogParams.UriString, new object[2]
				{
					host.HostAddress,
					LogParams.ServicePort
				});
				auxPath = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, LogParams.UriString, new object[2] { host.HostAddress, host.Port });
				if (!useRemoteProxy)
				{
					mutex = new Mutex(initiallyOwned: false, LogParams.MutexName + port.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
			}
			else if (host.Port == -1)
			{
				auxPath = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, LogParams.UriHttpStringPortless, new object[2] { host.HostAddress, host.ServiceName });
			}
			else
			{
				auxPath = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, LogParams.UriHttpString, new object[3] { host.HostAddress, host.Port, host.ServiceName });
			}
		}

		public static bool IsLocalhost(string hostOrIP)
		{
			IPAddress address = null;
			if (!IPAddress.TryParse(hostOrIP, out address))
			{
				address = null;
				try
				{
					IPHostEntry hostEntry = Dns.GetHostEntry(hostOrIP);
					IPAddress[] addressList = hostEntry.AddressList;
					foreach (IPAddress iPAddress in addressList)
					{
						if (iPAddress.AddressFamily == AddressFamily.InterNetwork)
						{
							address = iPAddress;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (address == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IPAddress.IsLoopback(address);
		}

		private void InitializeChannel()
		{
			if (myChannelFactory == null)
			{
				myChannelFactory = new ChannelFactory<ILogSource>(LogParams.GetBinding(binding), new EndpointAddress(new Uri(auxPath), new SpnEndpointIdentity(string.Empty)));
				xpoLogClient = myChannelFactory.CreateChannel();
			}
		}

		private void InitializeActivationChannel()
		{
			if (activationChannelFactory == null)
			{
				activationChannelFactory = new ChannelFactory<ILogActivationServer>(LogParams.GetBinding(), new EndpointAddress(new Uri(activationPath), new SpnEndpointIdentity(string.Empty)));
				activationChannelClient = activationChannelFactory.CreateChannel();
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (Active)
			{
				Stop();
			}
			try
			{
				if (myChannelFactory != null)
				{
					try
					{
						myChannelFactory.Close();
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						myChannelFactory.Abort();
					}
				}
				if (activationChannelFactory != null)
				{
					try
					{
						activationChannelFactory.Close();
						return;
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						activationChannelFactory.Abort();
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		public LogMessage GetMessage()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			LogMessage val = new LogMessage();
			try
			{
				InitializeChannel();
				return xpoLogClient.GetMessage();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				myChannelFactory = null;
				return null;
			}
		}

		public LogMessage[] GetMessages(int messagesAmount)
		{
			LogMessage[] array = (LogMessage[])(object)new LogMessage[0];
			try
			{
				InitializeChannel();
				return xpoLogClient.GetMessages(messagesAmount);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				myChannelFactory = null;
				return null;
			}
		}

		public LogMessage[] GetCompleteLog()
		{
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Expected O, but got Unknown
			LogMessage[] array = (LogMessage[])(object)new LogMessage[0];
			try
			{
				InitializeChannel();
				array = xpoLogClient.GetCompleteLog();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				array = (LogMessage[])(object)((ex.InnerException == null || ex.InnerException.InnerException == null || !(ex.InnerException.InnerException is XmlException)) ? null : new LogMessage[1]
				{
					new LogMessage((LogMessageType)1, "The maximum string content length quota has been exceeded")
				});
				myChannelFactory = null;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public bool Start()
		{
			return active = StartInternal();
		}

		private bool StartInternal()
		{
			if (binding == NetBinding.NetTcpBinding)
			{
				if (useRemoteProxy)
				{
					try
					{
						InitializeActivationChannel();
						activationChannelClient.Open(port);
						return true;
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return mutex.WaitOne();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Stop()
		{
			try
			{
				bool result = true;
				if (useRemoteProxy)
				{
					try
					{
						InitializeActivationChannel();
						result = activationChannelClient.Close(port);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						activationChannelFactory = null;
						result = false;
					}
				}
				if (mutex != null)
				{
					mutex.ReleaseMutex();
					mutex.Close();
				}
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				active = false;
			}
		}
	}

	public static class LogParams
	{
		public static readonly int LogLength = 5000;

		public static readonly string MutexName = "Global\\XPOLogServiceMutex:{8F7CD142-2BC3-48d7-92AA-54BD12A2FFB3}:";

		public static readonly int LogLengthLimit = 10000;

		public static readonly string LocalUriString = "net.tcp://localhost:{0}/WCFLogService";

		public static readonly string UriString = "net.tcp://{0}:{1}/WCFLogService";

		public static readonly string UriHttpString = "http://{0}:{1}/{2}";

		public static readonly string UriHttpStringPortless = "http://{0}/{1}";

		public static readonly int ServicePort = 52927;

		public static NetTcpBinding GetBinding()
		{
			NetTcpBinding netTcpBinding = new NetTcpBinding();
			netTcpBinding.Security.Mode = SecurityMode.Transport;
			netTcpBinding.Security.Transport.ClientCredentialType = TcpClientCredentialType.Windows;
			netTcpBinding.Security.Transport.ProtectionLevel = ProtectionLevel.EncryptAndSign;
			netTcpBinding.MaxConnections = 100;
			netTcpBinding.MaxReceivedMessageSize = 1073741824L;
			netTcpBinding.ReceiveTimeout = new TimeSpan(0, 10, 0);
			netTcpBinding.SendTimeout = new TimeSpan(0, 10, 0);
			netTcpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxArrayLength = int.MaxValue;
			netTcpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxBytesPerRead = int.MaxValue;
			netTcpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxDepth = int.MaxValue;
			netTcpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxNameTableCharCount = int.MaxValue;
			netTcpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxStringContentLength = int.MaxValue;
			return netTcpBinding;
		}

		public static System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding GetBinding(NetBinding binding)
		{
			switch (binding)
			{
			case NetBinding.NetTcpBinding:
				return GetBinding();
			case NetBinding.WSHttpBinding:
			{
				WSHttpBinding wSHttpBinding = new WSHttpBinding();
				wSHttpBinding.MaxReceivedMessageSize = 1073741824L;
				wSHttpBinding.ReceiveTimeout = new TimeSpan(0, 10, 0);
				wSHttpBinding.SendTimeout = new TimeSpan(0, 10, 0);
				wSHttpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxArrayLength = int.MaxValue;
				wSHttpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxBytesPerRead = int.MaxValue;
				wSHttpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxDepth = int.MaxValue;
				wSHttpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxNameTableCharCount = int.MaxValue;
				wSHttpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxStringContentLength = int.MaxValue;
				return wSHttpBinding;
			}
			case NetBinding.BasicHttpBinding:
			{
				BasicHttpBinding basicHttpBinding = new BasicHttpBinding();
				basicHttpBinding.MaxReceivedMessageSize = 1073741824L;
				basicHttpBinding.ReceiveTimeout = new TimeSpan(0, 10, 0);
				basicHttpBinding.SendTimeout = new TimeSpan(0, 10, 0);
				basicHttpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxArrayLength = int.MaxValue;
				basicHttpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxBytesPerRead = int.MaxValue;
				basicHttpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxDepth = int.MaxValue;
				basicHttpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxNameTableCharCount = int.MaxValue;
				basicHttpBinding.ReaderQuotas.MaxStringContentLength = int.MaxValue;
				return basicHttpBinding;
			}
			case NetBinding.WebApi:
				throw new NotSupportedException(binding.ToString());
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		public static ServiceEndpoint CreateEndpoint(EndpointAddress address, Type contractType)
		{
			ServiceEndpoint serviceEndpoint = new ServiceEndpoint(ContractDescription.GetContract(contractType), GetBinding(), address);
			foreach (OperationDescription operation in serviceEndpoint.Contract.Operations)
			{
				DataContractSerializerOperationBehavior dataContractSerializerOperationBehavior = operation.Behaviors.Find<DataContractSerializerOperationBehavior>();
				if (dataContractSerializerOperationBehavior != null)
				{
					dataContractSerializerOperationBehavior.MaxItemsInObjectGraph = 1073741824;
				}
			}
			return serviceEndpoint;
		}
	}
	public class Host
	{
		public string HostAddress = string.Empty;

		public int Port;

		public NetBinding Binding;

		public string ServiceName = string.Empty;

		public string VisibleName
		{
			get
			{
				if (Binding == NetBinding.NamedPipes)
				{
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "\\\\{0}\\{1}\\", new object[2] { HostAddress, ServiceName });
				}
				if (Binding == NetBinding.NetTcpBinding)
				{
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "net.tcp://{0}:{1}", new object[2] { HostAddress, Port });
				}
				string text = ((HostAddress == null || StringExtensions.StartsWithInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(HostAddress, "http://") || StringExtensions.StartsWithInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(HostAddress, "https://")) ? HostAddress : ("http://" + HostAddress));
				if (Port == -1)
				{
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}/{1}", new object[2] { text, ServiceName });
				}
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}:{1}/{2}", new object[3] { text, Port, ServiceName });
			}
		}

		public Host()
		{
		}

		public Host(string host, int port)
			: this()
		{
			HostAddress = host;
			Port = port;
		}

		public Host(string host, int port, NetBinding binding, string serviceName)
			: this(host, port)
		{
			Binding = binding;
			ServiceName = serviceName;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj.GetType() != typeof(Host))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Host host = obj as Host;
			if (Binding == host.Binding && HostAddress == host.HostAddress && Port == host.Port)
			{
				return ServiceName == host.ServiceName;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<string, int, NetBinding, string>(HostAddress, Port, Binding, ServiceName);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(Host host1, Host host2)
		{
			return host1.Equals(host2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(Host host1, Host host2)
		{
			return !host1.Equals(host2);
		}
	}
	public enum NetBinding
	{
		NetTcpBinding,
		WSHttpBinding,
		BasicHttpBinding,
		WebApi,
		NamedPipes
	}
	public class LogServer : ILogger, IDisposable
	{
		public const int DefaultCapacity = 10000;

		private int port;

		private string mutexName;

		private readonly object syncRoot = new object();

		private ServiceHost serviceHost;

		private LogMessageTimer timer;

		private LoggerBase logger = new LoggerBase(10000);

		private int CheckDuration = 1;

		public bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				return logger.Enabled;
			}
			set
			{
				logger.Enabled = value;
			}
		}

		public int Count => logger.Count;

		public int Capacity => logger.Capacity;

		public int LostMessageCount => logger.LostMessageCount;

		public bool IsServerActive
		{
			get
			{
				CheckIsActive();
				if (Enabled)
				{
					return serviceHost != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int Port => port;

		public LogServer(int port)
		{
			this.port = port;
			mutexName = LogParams.MutexName + port.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		private void InitializeHost()
		{
			serviceHost = new ServiceHost(new LogService(logger));
			serviceHost.Description.Endpoints.Add(LogParams.CreateEndpoint(new EndpointAddress(new Uri(string.Format(LogParams.LocalUriString, port))), typeof(ILogSource)));
			serviceHost.Open();
		}

		public void Log(LogMessage message)
		{
			if (message != null)
			{
				logger.Log(message);
			}
		}

		public void Log(LogMessage[] messages)
		{
			if (messages != null && messages.Length != 0)
			{
				logger.Log(messages);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void CheckIsActive()
		{
			//IL_01c2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01cc: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00da: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e4: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!logger.Enabled)
			{
				if (serviceHost == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					if (serviceHost != null)
					{
						CheckDuration = 1;
						serviceHost.Close();
						serviceHost = null;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (serviceHost == null)
			{
				if (timer != null && timer.Elapsed.Seconds <= CheckDuration)
				{
					return;
				}
				lock (syncRoot)
				{
					if (timer != null && timer.Elapsed.Seconds <= CheckDuration)
					{
						return;
					}
					using Mutex mutex = new Mutex(initiallyOwned: false, mutexName);
					if (timer == null)
					{
						timer = new LogMessageTimer();
					}
					timer.Restart();
					try
					{
						if (mutex.WaitOne(0))
						{
							mutex.ReleaseMutex();
							if (CheckDuration < 5)
							{
								CheckDuration++;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							CheckDuration = 1;
							InitializeHost();
						}
						return;
					}
					catch (AbandonedMutexException)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			if (timer != null && timer.Elapsed.Seconds <= CheckDuration)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				if (timer != null && timer.Elapsed.Seconds <= CheckDuration)
				{
					return;
				}
				using Mutex mutex2 = new Mutex(initiallyOwned: false, mutexName);
				if (timer == null)
				{
					timer = new LogMessageTimer();
				}
				timer.Restart();
				try
				{
					if (!mutex2.WaitOne(0))
					{
						if (CheckDuration < 5)
						{
							CheckDuration++;
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				catch (AbandonedMutexException)
				{
				}
				CheckDuration = 1;
				serviceHost.Close();
				serviceHost = null;
				mutex2.ReleaseMutex();
			}
		}

		public void ClearLog()
		{
			logger.ClearLog();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			serviceHost?.Close();
		}
	}

	public class LogActivationServer : IDisposable
	{
		[ServiceBehavior(InstanceContextMode = InstanceContextMode.Single)]
		private class LogActivationService : ILogActivationServer, IDisposable
		{
			public class LogActivationServerCommand
			{
				private LogActivationServerCommandType type;

				private readonly ManualResetEvent readyEvent;

				private int port;

				private object result;

				public LogActivationServerCommandType Type
				{
					get
					{
						return type;
					}
					set
					{
						type = value;
					}
				}

				public ManualResetEvent ReadyEvent => readyEvent;

				public int Port
				{
					get
					{
						return port;
					}
					set
					{
						port = value;
					}
				}

				public object Result
				{
					get
					{
						return result;
					}
					set
					{
						result = value;
					}
				}

				public LogActivationServerCommand(LogActivationServerCommandType type, int port)
				{
					this.type = type;
					this.port = port;
					readyEvent = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
				}
			}

			public enum LogActivationServerCommandType
			{
				Open,
				Close,
				Exists
			}

			private bool disposed;

			private readonly Thread mutexThread;

			private readonly AutoResetEvent hasCommandEvent = new AutoResetEvent(initialState: false);

			private readonly List<LogActivationServerCommand> commandList = new List<LogActivationServerCommand>();

			private readonly Dictionary<int, Mutex> mutexDictionary = new Dictionary<int, Mutex>();

			public LogActivationService()
			{
				mutexThread = new Thread(MutexThreadBody);
				mutexThread.Name = "mutexThread";
				mutexThread.IsBackground = true;
				mutexThread.Start();
			}

			public bool Open(int port)
			{
				return (bool)ExecCommand(LogActivationServerCommandType.Open, port);
			}

			public bool Close(int port)
			{
				return (bool)ExecCommand(LogActivationServerCommandType.Close, port);
			}

			public bool IsOpened(int port)
			{
				return (bool)ExecCommand(LogActivationServerCommandType.Exists, port);
			}

			public object ExecCommand(LogActivationServerCommandType type, int port)
			{
				LogActivationServerCommand logActivationServerCommand = new LogActivationServerCommand(type, port);
				lock (commandList)
				{
					commandList.Add(logActivationServerCommand);
				}
				hasCommandEvent.Set();
				logActivationServerCommand.ReadyEvent.WaitOne();
				return logActivationServerCommand.Result;
			}

			public void MutexThreadBody()
			{
				while (true)
				{
					try
					{
						hasCommandEvent.WaitOne();
						lock (commandList)
						{
							lock (mutexDictionary)
							{
								foreach (LogActivationServerCommand command in commandList)
								{
									switch (command.Type)
									{
									case LogActivationServerCommandType.Open:
										try
										{
											if (!disposed && !mutexDictionary.TryGetValue(command.Port, out var value2))
											{
												value2 = new Mutex(initiallyOwned: true, LogParams.MutexName + command.Port.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
												mutexDictionary.Add(command.Port, value2);
												command.Result = true;
											}
											else
											{
												command.Result = false;
											}
										}
										catch (Exception)
										{
											command.Result = false;
										}
										command.ReadyEvent.Set();
										break;
									case LogActivationServerCommandType.Close:
										try
										{
											if (!disposed && mutexDictionary.TryGetValue(command.Port, out var value))
											{
												value.ReleaseMutex();
												value.Close();
												mutexDictionary.Remove(command.Port);
												command.Result = true;
											}
											else
											{
												command.Result = false;
											}
										}
										catch (Exception)
										{
											command.Result = false;
										}
										command.ReadyEvent.Set();
										break;
									case LogActivationServerCommandType.Exists:
										command.Result = !disposed && mutexDictionary.ContainsKey(command.Port);
										command.ReadyEvent.Set();
										break;
									}
								}
							}
							commandList.Clear();
						}
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						Thread.Sleep(1000);
					}
				}
			}

			public void CloseAll()
			{
				CloseAllInternal();
			}

			void IDisposable.Dispose()
			{
				CloseAllInternal();
			}

			private void CloseAllInternal()
			{
				lock (mutexDictionary)
				{
					if (disposed)
					{
						return;
					}
					foreach (Mutex value in mutexDictionary.Values)
					{
						try
						{
							value.ReleaseMutex();
							value.Close();
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					}
					disposed = true;
				}

	internal class NamedPipeLogServer : IDisposable
	{
		private NamedPipeServerStream namedPipeServer;

		private readonly string pipeName;

		private readonly ILogSource logger;

		private bool isDisposed;

		public NamedPipeLogServer(string pipeName, ILogSource logSource)
		{
			logger = logSource;
			this.pipeName = pipeName;
			CreateNamedPipe();
		}

		private void CreateNamedPipe()
		{
			namedPipeServer = new NamedPipeServerStream(pipeName, PipeDirection.InOut, 1, PipeTransmissionMode.Byte, PipeOptions.Asynchronous);
			namedPipeServer.BeginWaitForConnection(NamedPipeClientConnectedHandler, null);
		}

		private void DisposeNamedPipe()
		{
			if (namedPipeServer != null)
			{
				namedPipeServer.Dispose();
				namedPipeServer = null;
			}
		}

		private void RecreateNamedPipe()
		{
			if (!isDisposed)
			{
				DisposeNamedPipe();
				CreateNamedPipe();
			}
		}

		private void NamedPipeClientConnectedHandler(IAsyncResult ar)
		{
			if (namedPipeServer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			namedPipeServer.EndWaitForConnection(ar);
			byte[] array = new byte[4];
			try
			{
				while (true)
				{
					int num = namedPipeServer.Read(array, 0, 1);
					if (num != 1)
					{
						break;
					}
					LogMessage[] data;
					switch (array[0])
					{
					case 1:
						data = logger.GetCompleteLog();
						break;
					case 2:
					{
						LogMessage message = logger.GetMessage();
						data = (LogMessage[])(object)((message == null) ? new LogMessage[0] : new LogMessage[1] { message });
						break;
					}
					case 3:
					{
						num = namedPipeServer.Read(array, 0, 4);
						if (num != 4)
						{
							RecreateNamedPipe();
							return;
						}
						int num2 = BitConverter.ToInt32(array, 0);
						if (num2 <= 0)
						{
							RecreateNamedPipe();
							return;
						}
						data = logger.GetMessages(num2);
						break;
					}
					default:
						RecreateNamedPipe();
						return;
					}
					WriteResponseToNamedPipe(data);
				}
				RecreateNamedPipe();
			}
			catch
			{
				RecreateNamedPipe();
			}
		}

		private void WriteResponseToNamedPipe(LogMessage[] data)
		{
			DataContractSerializer dataContractSerializer = new DataContractSerializer(typeof(LogMessage[]));
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			dataContractSerializer.WriteObject(memoryStream, data);
			byte[] buffer = memoryStream.GetBuffer();
			int num = (int)memoryStream.Length;
			namedPipeServer.Write(BitConverter.GetBytes(num), 0, 4);
			namedPipeServer.Write(buffer, 0, num);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			isDisposed = true;
			DisposeNamedPipe();
		}
	}

	public abstract class BaseObjectQueryGenerator : BaseQueryGenerator
	{

		}

		protected List<ModificationStatement> GenerateSql(ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet criteriaSet, MemberInfoCollection properties, bool reverse)
		{
			//IL_00ac: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b6: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (properties == null)
			{
				properties = new MemberInfoCollection(base.ClassInfo);
				foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in base.ClassInfo.PersistentProperties)
				{
					properties.Add(persistentProperty);
				}
			}
			this.properties = properties;
			List<XPClassInfo> classes = GetClasses();
			if (reverse)
			{
				classes.Reverse();
			}
			List<ModificationStatement> list = new List<ModificationStatement>(classes.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < classes.Count; i++)
			{
				base.ClassInfo = classes[i];
				CriteriaOperator criteria = criteriaSet?.GetCompleteCriteria(base.ClassInfo.TableName);
				list.Add((ModificationStatement)GenerateSql(criteria));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected List<XPClassInfo> GetClasses()
		{
			List<XPClassInfo> list = new List<XPClassInfo>(4);
			XPClassInfo baseClass = base.ClassInfo;
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = baseClass;
			do
			{
				if (baseClass.IsPersistent && baseClass.TableMapType == MapInheritanceType.OwnTable)
				{
					list.Add(xPClassInfo);
					xPClassInfo = baseClass.BaseClass;
					while (xPClassInfo != null && !xPClassInfo.IsPersistent)
					{
						xPClassInfo = xPClassInfo.BaseClass;
					}
				}
				baseClass = baseClass.BaseClass;
			}
			while (baseClass != null);
			return list;
		}

				return GetConstParameter(null, member.MappingFieldDBType, member.MappingFieldDBTypeName, member.MappingFieldSize);

		}

	public class DeleteQueryGenerator : BaseObjectQueryGenerator
	{
		private class RefHolder
		{
			public readonly IDictionary Pool;

			public readonly XPClassInfo Me;

			public readonly List<object> Objects = new List<object>();

			private bool canLoop = true;

			public Dictionary<XPClassInfo, RefHolder> DirectlyAssignableNotDeleted;

			public static RefHolder GetRefHolder(IDictionary pool, XPClassInfo ci)
			{
				return (RefHolder)pool[ci];
			}

			public static ICollection GetNonReferenced(IDictionary pool)
			{
				Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo>(pool.Count);
				foreach (XPClassInfo key in pool.Keys)
				{
					dictionary.Add(key, key);
				}
				foreach (RefHolder value in pool.Values)
				{
					foreach (XPClassInfo key2 in value.DirectlyAssignableNotDeleted.Keys)
					{
						dictionary.Remove(key2);
					}
				}
				return dictionary.Keys;
			}

			public bool CanReach(XPClassInfo target)
			{
				return CanReach(new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo>(Pool.Count), target);
			}

			private bool CanReach(Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo> processed, XPClassInfo target)
			{
				if (processed.ContainsKey(Me))
				{
					return false;
				}
				processed.Add(Me, Me);
				foreach (RefHolder value in DirectlyAssignableNotDeleted.Values)
				{
					if (value.Me == target)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (value.CanReach(processed, target))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public bool IsInLoop()
			{
				if (!canLoop)
				{
					return false;
				}
				canLoop = CanReach(Me);
				return canLoop;
			}

			private void FillDirectlyRefs()
			{
				DirectlyAssignableNotDeleted = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, RefHolder>();
				foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in Me.ObjectProperties)
				{
					if (objectProperty.HasAttribute(typeof(NoForeignKeyAttribute)))
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (RefHolder value in Pool.Values)
					{
						if (value.Me.IsAssignableTo(objectProperty.ReferenceType))
						{
							DirectlyAssignableNotDeleted[value.Me] = value;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			public RefHolder(IDictionary pool, XPClassInfo me)
			{
				Pool = pool;
				Me = me;
			}

			public static IDictionary CreatePool(XPDictionary dictionary, ICollection objects)
			{
				Dictionary<XPClassInfo, RefHolder> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, RefHolder>();
				foreach (object @object in objects)
				{
					XPClassInfo classInfo = dictionary.GetClassInfo(@object);
					if (!dictionary2.TryGetValue(classInfo, out var value))
					{
						value = new RefHolder(dictionary2, classInfo);
						dictionary2.Add(classInfo, value);
					}
					value.Objects.Add(@object);
				}
				foreach (RefHolder value2 in dictionary2.Values)
				{
					value2.FillDirectlyRefs();
				}
				return dictionary2;
			}

			public static void ProcessDelete(IDictionary pool, XPClassInfo ci)
			{
				pool.Remove(ci);
				foreach (RefHolder value in pool.Values)
				{
					value.DirectlyAssignableNotDeleted.Remove(ci);
				}
			}

			private static List<ModificationStatement> GenerateUpdatesBeforeDelete(XPClassInfo classInfo, MemberInfoCollection updateList, IList keys, BatchWideDataHolder4Modification batchWideData, LockingOption locking)

				else

						foreach (UpdateStatement item in list2)

			public ICollection<ModificationStatement> DoUpdates(LockingOption locking, BatchWideDataHolder4Modification batchWideData)
			{
				List<XPClassInfo> list = new List<XPClassInfo>(DirectlyAssignableNotDeleted.Count);
				foreach (RefHolder value in DirectlyAssignableNotDeleted.Values)
				{
					if (value.CanReach(Me))
					{
						list.Add(value.Me);
					}
				}
				MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = new MemberInfoCollection(Me);
				foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in Me.ObjectProperties)
				{
					if (objectProperty.HasAttribute(typeof(NoForeignKeyAttribute)))
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (XPClassInfo item in list)
					{
						if (item.IsAssignableTo(objectProperty.ReferenceType))
						{
							memberInfoCollection.Add(objectProperty);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (XPClassInfo item2 in list)
				{
					DirectlyAssignableNotDeleted.Remove(item2);
				}
				return GenerateUpdatesBeforeDelete(Me, memberInfoCollection, Objects, batchWideData, locking);
			}

		public static List<ModificationStatement> GenerateDelete(XPDictionary dictionary, object theObject, LockingOption locking, BatchWideDataHolder4Modification batchWideData)
		{
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = dictionary.GetClassInfo(theObject);
			ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet objectGeneratorCriteriaSet = null;
			XPMemberInfo optimisticLockFieldInDataLayer = xPClassInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer;
			if (locking == LockingOption.Optimistic)
			{
				switch (xPClassInfo.OptimisticLockingBehavior)
				{
				case OptimisticLockingBehavior.ConsiderOptimisticLockingField:
					if (optimisticLockFieldInDataLayer != null)
					{
						objectGeneratorCriteriaSet = ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet.GetCriteriaSet(xPClassInfo.IdClass.TableName, LockingHelper.GetLockingCriteria((int?)optimisticLockFieldInDataLayer.GetValue(theObject), xPClassInfo.OptimisticLockField));
					}
					break;
				case OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockModified:
				case OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockAll:
				{
					if (!batchWideData.TryGetUpdatedMembersBeforeDelete(theObject, out var members))
					{
						members = null;
					}
					objectGeneratorCriteriaSet = LockingHelper.GetLockingCriteria(xPClassInfo, xPClassInfo.PersistentProperties, theObject, OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockAll, members);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			if (objectGeneratorCriteriaSet == null)
			{
				objectGeneratorCriteriaSet = ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet.GetCommonCriteriaSet(BaseObjectQueryGenerator.BuildKeyCriteria(dictionary, theObject));
			}
			else
			{
				objectGeneratorCriteriaSet.UpdateCommonCriteria(BaseObjectQueryGenerator.BuildKeyCriteria(dictionary, theObject));
			}
			return new DeleteQueryGenerator(dictionary, theObject, batchWideData).GenerateSql(objectGeneratorCriteriaSet, null, reverse: false);
		}

		private static List<ModificationStatement> GenerateDeleteCore(XPClassInfo classInfo, IList keys, LockingOption locking, BatchWideDataHolder4Modification batchWideData)
		{
			//IL_00be: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c5: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00ee: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f5: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_008a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_01f4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01fe: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (keys.Count == 1)
			{
				return GenerateDelete(classInfo.Dictionary, keys[0], locking, batchWideData);
			}
			List<ModificationStatement> list = new List<ModificationStatement>();
			XPMemberInfo optimisticLockFieldInDataLayer = classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer;
			OptimisticLockingBehavior optimisticLockingBehavior = classInfo.OptimisticLockingBehavior;
			if (locking != LockingOption.None && (optimisticLockingBehavior == OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockModified || optimisticLockingBehavior == OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockAll))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < keys.Count; i++)
				{
					object obj = keys[i];
					if (!batchWideData.TryGetUpdatedMembersBeforeDelete(obj, out var members))
					{
						members = null;
					}
					ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet lockingCriteria = LockingHelper.GetLockingCriteria(classInfo, classInfo.PersistentProperties, obj, OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockAll, members);
					lockingCriteria.UpdateCommonCriteria((CriteriaOperator)(object)((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(classInfo.KeyProperty.Name) == (CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue(obj)));
					GenerateDeletes(classInfo, lockingCriteria, list, 1, batchWideData);
				}
			}
			else if (locking == LockingOption.None || optimisticLockFieldInDataLayer == null)
			{
				CriteriaOperator commonCriteria = (CriteriaOperator)new InOperator(classInfo.KeyProperty.Name, (IEnumerable)keys);
				List<ModificationStatement> list2 = new DeleteQueryGenerator(classInfo, batchWideData).GenerateSql(ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet.GetCommonCriteriaSet(commonCriteria), null, reverse: false);
				foreach (DeleteStatement item in list2)
				{
					DeleteStatement val = item;
					((ModificationStatement)val).RecordsAffected = keys.Count;
				}
				list.AddRange(list2);
			}
			else
			{
				Dictionary<object, List<object>> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, List<object>>();
				for (int j = 0; j < keys.Count; j++)
				{
					object value = optimisticLockFieldInDataLayer.GetValue(keys[j]);

						dictionary.Add(value, value2);
					}
					value2.Add(keys[j]);

				{
					int? dbVersion = ((item2.Key is DBNull) ? ((int?)null) : ((int?)item2.Key));
					GenerateDeletes(classInfo, ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet.GetCriteriaSet(classInfo.IdClass.TableName, LockingHelper.GetLockingCriteria(dbVersion, classInfo.OptimisticLockField), (CriteriaOperator)new InOperator(classInfo.KeyProperty.Name, (IEnumerable)item2.Value)), list, item2.Value.Count, batchWideData);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static bool AreReferences(XPClassInfo ci, ICollection classInfos)
		{
			foreach (XPClassInfo classInfo in classInfos)
			{
				foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in classInfo.ObjectProperties)
				{
					if (ci.IsAssignableTo(objectProperty.ReferenceType))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static XPClassInfo GetNonReferencedClassInfo(ICollection classInfos)
		{
			foreach (XPClassInfo classInfo in classInfos)
			{
				if (!AreReferences(classInfo, classInfos))
				{
					return classInfo;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static List<ModificationStatement> GenerateDelete(XPDictionary dictionary, ICollection objects, LockingOption locking, BatchWideDataHolder4Modification batchWideData)
		{
			List<ModificationStatement> list = new List<ModificationStatement>();
			IDictionary dictionary2 = RefHolder.CreatePool(dictionary, objects);
			while (dictionary2.Count > 0)
			{
				ICollection nonReferenced = RefHolder.GetNonReferenced(dictionary2);
				if (nonReferenced.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (XPClassInfo item in nonReferenced)
					{
						list.AddRange(GenerateDelete(item, RefHolder.GetRefHolder(dictionary2, item).Objects, locking, batchWideData));
						RefHolder.ProcessDelete(dictionary2, item);
					}
					continue;
				}
				RefHolder refHolder = null;
				foreach (RefHolder value in dictionary2.Values)
				{
					if ((refHolder == null || value.Objects.Count < refHolder.Objects.Count) && value.IsInLoop())
					{
						refHolder = value;
					}
				}
				list.AddRange(refHolder.DoUpdates(locking, batchWideData));
			}
			return list;
		}

		}

	public class ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet
	{
		private CriteriaOperator commonCriteria;

		private Dictionary<string, CriteriaOperator> criteriaDict = new Dictionary<string, CriteriaOperator>();

		public CriteriaOperator CommonCriteria => commonCriteria;

		public bool TryGetCriteria(string tableName, out CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			return criteriaDict.TryGetValue(tableName, out criteria);
		}

		public CriteriaOperator GetCompleteCriteria(string tableName)
		{
			if (!criteriaDict.TryGetValue(tableName, out var value))
			{
				return commonCriteria;
			}
			if (commonCriteria == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return CriteriaOperator.And(commonCriteria, value);
		}

		public void UpdateCriteria(string tableName, CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (criteria == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (criteriaDict.TryGetValue(tableName, out var value))
			{
				GroupOperator val = (GroupOperator)(object)((value is GroupOperator) ? value : null);
				if (val != null && (int)val.OperatorType == 0)
				{
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)val.Operands).Add(criteria);
				}
				else
				{
					criteriaDict[tableName] = CriteriaOperator.And(value, criteria);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				criteriaDict.Add(tableName, criteria);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateCommonCriteria(CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (criteria == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (commonCriteria == null)
			{
				commonCriteria = criteria;
				return;
			}
			CriteriaOperator obj = commonCriteria;
			GroupOperator val = (GroupOperator)(object)((obj is GroupOperator) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null && (int)val.OperatorType == 0)
			{
				((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)val.Operands).Add(criteria);
			}
			else
			{
				commonCriteria = CriteriaOperator.And(commonCriteria, criteria);
			}
		}

		public static ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet GetCommonCriteriaSet(CriteriaOperator commonCriteria)
		{
			ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet objectGeneratorCriteriaSet = new ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet();
			objectGeneratorCriteriaSet.UpdateCommonCriteria(commonCriteria);
			return objectGeneratorCriteriaSet;
		}

		public static ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet GetCriteriaSet(string tableName, CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet objectGeneratorCriteriaSet = new ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet();
			objectGeneratorCriteriaSet.UpdateCriteria(tableName, criteria);
			return objectGeneratorCriteriaSet;
		}

		public static ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet GetCriteriaSet(string tableName, CriteriaOperator criteria, CriteriaOperator commonCriteria)
		{
			ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet objectGeneratorCriteriaSet = new ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet();
			objectGeneratorCriteriaSet.UpdateCommonCriteria(commonCriteria);
			objectGeneratorCriteriaSet.UpdateCriteria(tableName, criteria);
			return objectGeneratorCriteriaSet;
		}
	}
