	public class ProjectionAliasPatcher
	{
		private class QueryOperandCollector : IQueryCriteriaVisitor, ICriteriaVisitor
		{
			private readonly List<QueryOperand> operandList = new List<QueryOperand>();

			public List<QueryOperand> OperandList => operandList;

			public void Clear()
			{
				operandList.Clear();
			}

			public void Visit(QuerySubQueryContainer theOperand)
			{
				Process(theOperand.AggregateProperty);
				ProcessNode((JoinNode)(object)theOperand.Node);
			}

			public void Visit(QueryOperand theOperand)
			{
				operandList.Add(theOperand);
			}

			public void Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
			{
				ProcessList(theOperator.Operands);
			}

			public void Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
			{
			}

			public void Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
			{
				ProcessList(theOperator.Operands);
			}

			public void Visit(InOperator theOperator)
			{
				Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
				ProcessList(theOperator.Operands);
			}

			public void Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
			{
				Process(theOperator.Operand);
			}

			public void Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
			{
				Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
				Process(theOperator.RightOperand);
			}

			public void Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
			{
				Process(theOperator.TestExpression);
				Process(theOperator.BeginExpression);
				Process(theOperator.EndExpression);
			}

			private void ProcessNode(JoinNode node)
			{
				if (node == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Process(node.Condition);
				foreach (JoinNode item in (List<JoinNode>)(object)node.SubNodes)
				{
					ProcessNode(item);
				}
			}

			private void ProcessList(CriteriaOperatorCollection operands)
			{
				if (operands == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)operands)
				{
					Process(item);
				}
			}

			public void Process(CriteriaOperator operand)
			{
				if (operand != null)
				{
					operand.Accept((ICriteriaVisitor)(object)this);
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly BaseStatement root;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, JoinNode> projectedNodes;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, ProjectionNodeItem> projectionNodes;

		private HashSet<string> usedProjectionNodes;

		private QueryOperandCollector queryOperandCollector;

		public ProjectionAliasPatcher(BaseStatement root, Dictionary<string, JoinNode> projectedNodes, Dictionary<string, ProjectionNodeItem> projectionNodes)
		{
			this.root = root;
			this.projectedNodes = projectedNodes;
			this.projectionNodes = projectionNodes;
		}

		public static void Patch(BaseStatement root, Dictionary<string, JoinNode> projectedNodes, Dictionary<string, ProjectionNodeItem> projectionNodes)
		{
			new ProjectionAliasPatcher(root, projectedNodes, projectionNodes).Patch();
		}

		public void Patch()
		{
			if (projectedNodes != null && projectedNodes.Count != 0)
			{
				queryOperandCollector = new QueryOperandCollector();
				PatchInternal(root);
			}
		}

		private void PatchInternal(BaseStatement statement)
		{
			if (statement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<JoinNode> list = default(List<JoinNode>);
			List<CriteriaOperator> list2 = default(List<CriteriaOperator>);
			((JoinNode)statement).CollectJoinNodesAndCriteria(ref list, ref list2);
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in list2)
			{
				queryOperandCollector.Clear();
				queryOperandCollector.Process(item);
				foreach (QueryOperand operand in queryOperandCollector.OperandList)
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(operand.NodeAlias))
					{
						continue;
					}
					ProjectionNodeItem value3;
					if (projectedNodes.TryGetValue(operand.NodeAlias, out var value))
					{
						string alias = value.Alias;
						if (usedProjectionNodes == null || !usedProjectionNodes.Contains(alias))
						{
							operand.NodeAlias = alias;
							if (projectionNodes != null && projectionNodes.TryGetValue(alias, out var value2))
							{
								BaseQueryGenerator.GetProjectedMemberColumn(operand.ColumnName, value, value2.ProjectedNodes);
							}
						}
					}
					else if (projectionNodes.TryGetValue(operand.NodeAlias, out value3))
					{
						BaseQueryGenerator.GetProjectedMemberColumn(operand.ColumnName, value3.Node, value3.ProjectedNodes);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (JoinNode item2 in list)
			{
				DBTable table = item2.Table;
				DBProjection val = (DBProjection)(object)((table is DBProjection) ? table : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					if (usedProjectionNodes == null)
					{
						usedProjectionNodes = new HashSet<string>();
					}
					usedProjectionNodes.Add(item2.Alias);
					try
					{
						PatchInternal((BaseStatement)(object)val.Projection);
					}
					finally
					{
						usedProjectionNodes.Remove(item2.Alias);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class StatementNormalizer
	{
		private class PathInfo
		{
			public string LeftNode;

			public string RightNode;

			public List<PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> CriteriaList;

			public CriteriaOperator GetCriteria()
			{
				if (CriteriaList == null || CriteriaList.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				List<CriteriaOperator> list = new List<CriteriaOperator>();
				foreach (PlanAliasCriteriaInfo criteria in CriteriaList)
				{
					list.AddRange(criteria.Criteria);
				}
				if (list.Count == 1)
				{
					return list[0];
				}
				return CriteriaOperator.And((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)list);
			}
		}

		private class PathFinder
		{
			private readonly int nodesCount;

			private readonly string rootNode;

			private PathInfo[] result;

			private readonly Stack<PathInfo> pathStack = new Stack<PathInfo>();

			private readonly Stack<string> nodeStack = new Stack<string>();

			private readonly List<PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> leftCriteriaList;

			private readonly Dictionary<string, List<string>> nodeRelations = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();

			private readonly HashSet<string> leftNodes = new HashSet<string>();

			private readonly HashSet<string> usedNodes = new HashSet<string>();

			public PathFinder(string rootNode, IEnumerable<string> rootSubNodes, IEnumerable<string> nodes, IEnumerable<PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> criteriaList, Dictionary<string, List<string>> nodeRelations)
			{
				this.rootNode = rootNode;
				usedNodes.Add(rootNode);
				foreach (string rootSubNode in rootSubNodes)
				{
					usedNodes.Add(rootSubNode);
				}
				foreach (string node in nodes)
				{
					leftNodes.Add(node);
					nodesCount++;
				}
				leftCriteriaList = new List<PlanAliasCriteriaInfo>(criteriaList);
				this.nodeRelations = nodeRelations;
			}

			public static PathInfo[] Find(string rootNode, IEnumerable<string> rootSubNodes, IEnumerable<string> nodes, IEnumerable<PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> criteriaList, Dictionary<string, List<string>> nodeRelations)
			{
				return new PathFinder(rootNode, rootSubNodes, nodes, criteriaList, nodeRelations).Find();
			}

			public PathInfo[] Find()
			{
				result = null;
				ProcessNode(rootNode);
				return result;
			}

			public bool ProcessNode(string currentNode)
			{
				if (pathStack.Count == nodesCount)
				{
					if (leftCriteriaList.Count > 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					result = pathStack.ToArray();
					Array.Reverse(result);
					return true;
				}
				if (nodeRelations.TryGetValue(currentNode, out var value))
				{
					foreach (string item in value)
					{
						if (leftNodes.Contains(item) && MoveUp(currentNode, item))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return MoveDown();
			}

			public void ProcessCriteria(PathInfo pi)
			{
				for (int num = leftCriteriaList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					PlanAliasCriteriaInfo planAliasCriteriaInfo = leftCriteriaList[num];
					string[] aliases = planAliasCriteriaInfo.Aliases;
					bool flag = true;
					foreach (string item in aliases)
					{
						if (!usedNodes.Contains(item))
						{
							flag = false;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						leftCriteriaList.RemoveAt(num);
						if (pi.CriteriaList == null)
						{
							pi.CriteriaList = new List<PlanAliasCriteriaInfo>();
						}
						pi.CriteriaList.Add(planAliasCriteriaInfo);
					}
				}
			}

			public bool MoveUp(string left, string right)
			{
				nodeStack.Push(left);
				leftNodes.Remove(right);
				usedNodes.Add(right);
				PathInfo pathInfo = new PathInfo
				{
					LeftNode = left,
					RightNode = right
				};
				ProcessCriteria(pathInfo);
				pathStack.Push(pathInfo);
				try
				{
					return ProcessNode(right);
				}
				finally
				{
					pathStack.Pop();
					if (pathInfo.CriteriaList != null)
					{
						leftCriteriaList.AddRange(pathInfo.CriteriaList);
					}
					usedNodes.Remove(right);
					leftNodes.Add(right);
					nodeStack.Pop();
				}
			}

			public bool MoveDown()
			{
				if (nodeStack.Count == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				string text = nodeStack.Pop();
				try
				{
					return ProcessNode(text);
				}
				finally
				{
					nodeStack.Push(text);
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly BaseStatement root;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, JoinNode> nodeDict = new Dictionary<string, JoinNode>();

		private readonly Dictionary<string, IEnumerable<PlanAliasCriteriaInfo>> nodeCriteriaInfoDict = new Dictionary<string, IEnumerable<PlanAliasCriteriaInfo>>();

		public StatementNormalizer(BaseStatement root)
		{
			this.root = root;
			nodeDict.Add(((JoinNode)root).Alias, (JoinNode)(object)root);
		}

		public void ProcessStatement()
		{
			FindNodes((JoinNode)(object)root);
		}

		private void FindNodes(JoinNode node)
		{
			JoinNode[] array = ((List<JoinNode>)(object)node.SubNodes).ToArray();
			JoinNode[] array2 = array;
			foreach (JoinNode subNode in array2)
			{
				FindNode(subNode, node);
			}
		}

		private void FindNode(JoinNode subNode, JoinNode parentNode)
		{
			string text = null;
			nodeDict[subNode.Alias] = subNode;
			if (!nodeCriteriaInfoDict.TryGetValue(subNode.Alias, out var value))
			{
				value = NodeCriteriaFinder.FindCriteria(null, subNode.Condition).Values;
				nodeCriteriaInfoDict.Add(subNode.Alias, value);
			}
			foreach (PlanAliasCriteriaInfo item in value)
			{
				string[] aliases = item.Aliases;
				foreach (string text2 in aliases)
				{
					if (!nodeDict.ContainsKey(text2))
					{
						text = text2;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (text != null)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				Dictionary<string, JoinNode> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, JoinNode>();
				CollectNodes(subNode, dictionary);
				if (dictionary.ContainsKey(text))
				{
					ClearNodes(subNode);
					((List<JoinNode>)(object)parentNode.SubNodes).Remove(subNode);
					Dictionary<string, JoinNode> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<string, JoinNode>();
					CollectNodes(parentNode, dictionary2);
					NormalizeNodeTree(parentNode, subNode, dictionary, dictionary2);
					return;
				}
			}
			FindNodes(subNode);
		}

		private static void CollectNodes(JoinNode node, Dictionary<string, JoinNode> collectedNodes)
		{
			collectedNodes[node.Alias] = node;
			JoinNodeCollection subNodes = node.SubNodes;
			for (int num = ((List<JoinNode>)(object)subNodes).Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				JoinNode node2 = ((List<JoinNode>)(object)subNodes)[num];
				CollectNodes(node2, collectedNodes);
			}
		}

		private static void ClearNodes(JoinNode node)
		{
			JoinNodeCollection subNodes = node.SubNodes;
			for (int num = ((List<JoinNode>)(object)subNodes).Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				JoinNode node2 = ((List<JoinNode>)(object)subNodes)[num];
				((List<JoinNode>)(object)subNodes).RemoveAt(num);
				ClearNodes(node2);
			}
		}

		private void NormalizeNodeTree(JoinNode parentNode, JoinNode subNode, Dictionary<string, JoinNode> collectedNodes, Dictionary<string, JoinNode> collectedRootSubNodes)
		{
			Dictionary<string, List<string>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();
			List<PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> list = new List<PlanAliasCriteriaInfo>();
			foreach (JoinNode value4 in collectedNodes.Values)
			{
				if (!nodeCriteriaInfoDict.TryGetValue(value4.Alias, out var value))
				{
					value = NodeCriteriaFinder.FindCriteria(null, value4.Condition).Values;
					nodeCriteriaInfoDict.Add(value4.Alias, value);
				}
				foreach (PlanAliasCriteriaInfo item in value)
				{
					string[] aliases = item.Aliases;
					for (int i = 0; i < aliases.Length; i++)
					{
						string key = aliases[i];
						if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value2))
						{
							value2 = new List<string>();
							dictionary.Add(key, value2);
						}
						for (int j = 0; j < aliases.Length; j++)
						{
							if (i != j)
							{
								value2.Add(aliases[j]);
							}
						}
					}
					list.Add(item);
				}
				value4.Condition = null;
			}
			if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(parentNode.Alias, out var value3))
			{
				value3 = new List<string>();
				dictionary.Add(parentNode.Alias, value3);
			}
			if (!value3.Contains(subNode.Alias))
			{
				value3.Add(subNode.Alias);
			}
			PathInfo[] array = PathFinder.Find(parentNode.Alias, collectedRootSubNodes.Keys, collectedNodes.Keys, list, dictionary);
			if (array == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			PathInfo[] array2 = array;
			foreach (PathInfo pathInfo in array2)
			{
				JoinNode val = ((pathInfo.LeftNode == parentNode.Alias) ? parentNode : collectedNodes[pathInfo.LeftNode]);
				JoinNode val2 = collectedNodes[pathInfo.RightNode];
				((List<JoinNode>)(object)val.SubNodes).Add(val2);
				val2.Condition = pathInfo.GetCriteria();
			}
		}

		public static void Normalize(BaseStatement statement)
		{
			new StatementNormalizer(statement).ProcessStatement();
		}
	}

	public class SessionMixingException : Exception
	{
		private Session session;

		private static DBColumn AddColumn(DBTable table, XPMemberInfo mi, string name, bool isKey, bool isReferenceKeyMember)
		{
			DBColumn val = table.GetColumn(name);
			if (val == null)
			{
				if (mi.ReferenceType != null)
				{
					mi = mi.ReferenceType.KeyProperty;
					isReferenceKeyMember = true;
				}
				val = CreateColumn(table, mi, name, isReferenceKeyMember);
				val.IsKey = isKey;
				table.AddColumn(val);
			}
			else if (isKey)
			{
				val.IsKey = isKey;
			}
			return val;
		}

		public static void ProcessClassInfo(DBTable table, XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			ValidateMembers(classInfo);
			Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, List<DBColumn>> memberColumns = new Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, List<DBColumn>>();
			ProcessMembers(table, classInfo, memberColumns);
			ProcessIndexes(table, classInfo, memberColumns);
		}

		private static void ValidateMembers(XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			foreach (XPMemberInfo member in classInfo.Members)
			{
				if (member.IsNullable.HasValue && (!member.IsPersistent || member.IsAssociationList || member.IsAliased || member.IsManyToManyAlias || member.ReferenceType != null))
				{
					string message = Res.GetString("Metadata_NullableAttributeNotApplicable", member.Name, member.Owner.FullName);
					throw new InvalidOperationException(message);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ProcessMembers(DBTable table, XPClassInfo classInfo, Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, List<DBColumn>> memberColumns)
		{
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
			{
				if (persistentProperty.IsMappingClass(classInfo))
				{
					List<DBColumn> list = ProcessMemberColumns(table, classInfo, persistentProperty);
					memberColumns.Add(persistentProperty, list);
					if (persistentProperty.IsKey)
					{
						ProcessPrimaryKey(table, list, classInfo);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ProcessIndexes(DBTable table, XPClassInfo classInfo, Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, List<DBColumn>> memberColumns)
		{
			//IL_014c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0153: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_02e7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02ee: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, bool>();
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
			{
				if (!persistentProperty.IsMappingClass(classInfo) || !persistentProperty.HasAttribute(typeof(IndexedAttribute)))
				{
					continue;
				}
				IndexedAttribute indexedAttribute = (IndexedAttribute)persistentProperty.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(IndexedAttribute));
				dictionary.Clear();
				dictionary.Add(persistentProperty, value: true);
				List<DBColumn> list = new List<DBColumn>(memberColumns[persistentProperty]);
				StringEnumerator enumerator2 = indexedAttribute.AdditionalFields.GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator2.MoveNext())
					{
						string current = enumerator2.Current;
						XPMemberInfo member = classInfo.GetMember(current);
						if (!memberColumns.ContainsKey(member))
						{
							throw new PropertyMissingException(persistentProperty.Owner.FullName, current);
						}
						if (dictionary.ContainsKey(member))
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("MetaData_PropertyIsDuplicatedInIndexDeclaration", current, classInfo.FullName, ".", persistentProperty.Name, "property"));
						}
						dictionary.Add(member, value: true);
						List<DBColumn> collection = memberColumns[member];
						list.AddRange(collection);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (enumerator2 is IDisposable disposable)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
				DBIndex val = new DBIndex(indexedAttribute.Name, (ICollection)list, indexedAttribute.Unique);
				if (!table.IsIndexIncluded(val))
				{
					table.AddIndex(val);
				}
			}
			if (!classInfo.HasAttribute(typeof(IndicesAttribute)))
			{
				return;
			}
			IndicesAttribute indicesAttribute = (IndicesAttribute)classInfo.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(IndicesAttribute));
			foreach (StringCollection index in indicesAttribute.Indices)
			{
				if (index.Count == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				XPMemberInfo member2 = classInfo.GetMember(index[0]);
				dictionary.Clear();
				dictionary.Add(member2, value: true);
				if (!member2.IsMappingClass(classInfo))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!memberColumns.ContainsKey(member2))
				{
					throw new PropertyMissingException(classInfo.FullName, member2.Name);
				}
				List<DBColumn> list2 = new List<DBColumn>(memberColumns[member2]);
				for (int i = 1; i < index.Count; i++)
				{
					string text = index[i];
					XPMemberInfo member3 = classInfo.GetMember(text);
					if (!memberColumns.ContainsKey(member3))
					{
						throw new PropertyMissingException(member2.Owner.FullName, text);
					}
					if (dictionary.ContainsKey(member3))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("MetaData_PropertyIsDuplicatedInIndexDeclaration", text, classInfo.FullName, string.Empty, string.Empty, "class"));
					}
					dictionary.Add(member3, value: true);
					List<DBColumn> collection2 = memberColumns[member3];
					list2.AddRange(collection2);
				}
				DBIndex val2 = new DBIndex((string)null, (ICollection)list2, false);
				if (!table.IsIndexIncluded(val2))
				{
					table.AddIndex(val2);
				}
			}
		}

		private static List<DBColumn> ProcessMemberColumns(DBTable table, XPClassInfo classInfo, XPMemberInfo memberInfo)
		{
			return ProcessMemberColumns(table, memberInfo, (memberInfo.SubMembers.Count == 0) ? memberInfo.MappingField : string.Empty, memberInfo.IsKey, !memberInfo.IsKey || classInfo.PersistentBaseClass == null || !(classInfo.PersistentBaseClass.TableName != table.Name), isReferenceKeyMember: false);
		}

		private static List<DBColumn> ProcessMemberColumns(DBTable table, XPMemberInfo processedMemberInfo, string mappingPath, bool isKey, bool processFk, bool isReferenceKeyMember)
		{
			if (processedMemberInfo.ReferenceType != null)
			{
				XPMemberInfo keyProperty = processedMemberInfo.ReferenceType.KeyProperty;
				List<DBColumn> list = ProcessMemberColumns(table, keyProperty, mappingPath, isKey, processFk: false, isReferenceKeyMember: true);
				if (processFk)
				{
					ProcessForeignKey(table, processedMemberInfo, list);
				}
				return list;
			}
			if (processedMemberInfo.SubMembers.Count == 0)
			{
				List<DBColumn> list2 = new List<DBColumn>(1);
				list2.Add(AddColumn(table, processedMemberInfo, mappingPath, isKey, isReferenceKeyMember));
				return list2;
			}
			List<DBColumn> list3 = new List<DBColumn>();
			foreach (XPMemberInfo subMember in processedMemberInfo.SubMembers)
			{
				if (subMember.IsPersistent)
				{
					list3.AddRange(ProcessMemberColumns(table, subMember, mappingPath + subMember.MappingField, isKey, processFk, isReferenceKeyMember));
				}
			}
			return list3;
		}

		private static void ProcessForeignKey(DBTable table, XPMemberInfo memberInfo, List<DBColumn> columns)
		{
			//IL_009d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a3: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (memberInfo.HasAttribute(typeof(NoForeignKeyAttribute)))
			{
				return;
			}
			StringCollection stringCollection = new StringCollection();
			XPMemberInfo keyProperty = memberInfo.ReferenceType.KeyProperty;
			if (keyProperty.SubMembers.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (XPMemberInfo subMember in keyProperty.SubMembers)
				{
					if (subMember.IsPersistent)
					{
						stringCollection.Add(subMember.MappingField);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				stringCollection.Add(keyProperty.MappingField);
			}
			DBForeignKey val = new DBForeignKey((ICollection)columns, memberInfo.ReferenceType.TableName, stringCollection);
			if (!table.IsForeignKeyIncluded(val))
			{
				table.AddForeignKey(val);
			}
		}

		private static void ProcessPrimaryKey(DBTable table, List<DBColumn> columns, XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_009c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a6: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (table.PrimaryKey == null)
			{
				table.PrimaryKey = new DBPrimaryKey((ICollection)columns);
			}
			if (columns.Count == 1 && classInfo == classInfo.IdClass && classInfo.KeyProperty.IsIdentity)
			{
				columns[0].IsIdentity = true;
			}
			if (classInfo.PersistentBaseClass == null || classInfo.TableMapType != MapInheritanceType.OwnTable)
			{
				return;
			}
			StringCollection stringCollection = new StringCollection();
			foreach (DBColumn column in columns)
			{
				stringCollection.Add(column.Name);
			}
			table.AddForeignKey(new DBForeignKey((ICollection)columns, classInfo.PersistentBaseClass.TableName, stringCollection));
		}

		public static DBColumn CreateColumn(DBTable table, XPMemberInfo memberInfo, string name, bool isReferenceKeyMember)
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0094: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = ((memberInfo.ReferenceType != null) ? memberInfo.ReferenceType.KeyProperty : memberInfo);
			DBColumnType columnType = DBColumn.GetColumnType(xPMemberInfo.StorageType);
			bool flag = isReferenceKeyMember || IsColumnNullable(memberInfo);
			object obj = xPMemberInfo.DefaultValue;
			if (!flag && obj == null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(xPMemberInfo.DbDefaultValue))
			{
				obj = GetDefaultValueForColumn(columnType);
			}
			DBColumn val = new DBColumn(name, memberInfo.IsKey, memberInfo.HasAttribute(typeof(DbTypeAttribute)) ? ((DbTypeAttribute)memberInfo.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(DbTypeAttribute))).DbColumnTypeName : string.Empty, xPMemberInfo.MappingFieldSize, columnType, flag, obj);
			val.DbDefaultValue = xPMemberInfo.DbDefaultValue;
			return val;
		}

		private static bool IsColumnNullable(XPMemberInfo memberInfo)
		{
			if (memberInfo.IsNullable.HasValue)
			{
				return memberInfo.IsNullable.Value;
			}
			NullableBehavior nullableBehavior = ((memberInfo.Owner.NullableBehavior != NullableBehavior.Default) ? memberInfo.Owner.NullableBehavior : ((memberInfo.Owner.Dictionary.NullableBehavior == NullableBehavior.Default) ? XpoDefault.NullableBehavior : memberInfo.Owner.Dictionary.NullableBehavior));
			if ((uint)nullableBehavior > 1u && nullableBehavior == NullableBehavior.ByUnderlyingType)
			{
				if (memberInfo.MemberType.IsGenericType && memberInfo.MemberType.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(Nullable<>))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (memberInfo.IsKey || memberInfo is ServiceField)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return !memberInfo.MemberType.IsValueType;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static object GetDefaultValueForColumn(DBColumnType type)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (type - 1) switch
			{
				0 => false, 
				1 => (byte)0, 
				4 => 0.0m, 
				5 => 0.0, 
				9 => (short)0, 
				7 => 0, 
				11 => 0L, 
				2 => (sbyte)0, 
				6 => 0f, 
				10 => (ushort)0, 
				8 => 0u, 
				12 => 0uL, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

	public class DataStorePool : DataStoreForkBase, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly AutoCreateOption aco;

		private readonly string ConnectionString;

		private readonly Queue<IDataStore> freiPool = new Queue<IDataStore>();

		private readonly Dictionary<IDataStore, IDisposable[]> garbage = new Dictionary<IDataStore, IDisposable[]>();

		private readonly int PoolSize;

		private readonly int MaxConnections;

		private int threads;

		private int connections;

		private readonly AsyncManualResetEvent freeProvider = new AsyncManualResetEvent(false);

		private bool isDisposed;

		public static int DefaultPoolSize = 8;

		public static int DefaultMaxConnections = -1;

		public const string XpoPoolParameterName = "XpoDataStorePool";

		public const string XpoPoolSizeParameterName = "XpoDataStorePoolSize";

		public const string XpoPoolMaxConnectionsParameterName = "XpoDataStorePoolMaxConnections";

		public object SyncRoot => this;

		public override AutoCreateOption AutoCreateOption => aco;

		public DataStorePool(AutoCreateOption autoCreateOption, string connectionString)
			: this(autoCreateOption, connectionString, null, null)
		{
		}//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)


		public DataStorePool(AutoCreateOption autoCreateOption, string connectionString, int? poolSize)
			: this(autoCreateOption, connectionString, poolSize, null)
		{
		}//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)


		public DataStorePool(AutoCreateOption autoCreateOption, string connectionString, int? poolSize, int? maxConnections)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			aco = autoCreateOption;
			ConnectionString = connectionString;
			PoolSize = poolSize ?? DefaultPoolSize;
			if (PoolSize < 0)
			{
				PoolSize = int.MaxValue;
			}
			MaxConnections = maxConnections ?? DefaultMaxConnections;
			if (MaxConnections < 0)
			{
				MaxConnections = int.MaxValue;
			}
			if (MaxConnections < PoolSize)
			{
				MaxConnections = PoolSize;
			}
			if (MaxConnections == 0)
			{
				MaxConnections = 1;
			}
		}

		public override IDataStore AcquireChangeProvider()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			while (true)
			{
				lock (SyncRoot)
				{
					if (isDisposed)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							threads--;
						}
						throw new ObjectDisposedException(((object)this).ToString());
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						flag = true;
						threads++;
					}
					if (freiPool.Count > 0)
					{
						return freiPool.Dequeue();
					}
					if (connections < MaxConnections)
					{
						connections++;
						break;
					}
					freeProvider.Reset();
				}
				freeProvider.WaitOne();
			}
			try
			{
				return CreateProvider();
			}
			catch
			{
				lock (SyncRoot)
				{
					connections--;
					if (flag)
					{
						threads--;
					}
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		public override async Task<IDataStore> AcquireChangeProviderAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			bool threadRegistered = false;
			while (true)
			{
				lock (SyncRoot)
				{
					if (isDisposed)
					{
						if (threadRegistered)
						{
							threads--;
						}
						throw new ObjectDisposedException(((object)this).ToString());
					}
					if (!threadRegistered)
					{
						threadRegistered = true;
						threads++;
					}
					if (freiPool.Count > 0)
					{
						return freiPool.Dequeue();
					}
					if (connections < MaxConnections)
					{
						connections++;
						break;
					}
					freeProvider.Reset();
				}
				await freeProvider.WaitOneAsync(cancellationToken);
			}
			try
			{
				return CreateProvider();
			}
			catch
			{
				lock (SyncRoot)
				{
					connections--;
					if (threadRegistered)
					{
						threads--;
					}
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		public override void ReleaseChangeProvider(IDataStore provider)
		{
			lock (SyncRoot)
			{
				threads--;
				if ((freiPool.Count < PoolSize || connections <= threads) && !isDisposed)
				{
					freiPool.Enqueue(provider);
					freeProvider.Set();
					return;
				}
				connections--;
			}
			DestroyProvider(provider);
		}

		private IDataStore CreateProvider()
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IDisposable[] objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect;
			IDataStore connectionProvider = XpoDefault.GetConnectionProvider(ConnectionString, ((DataStoreForkBase)this).AutoCreateOption, out objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect);
			lock (garbage)
			{
				garbage.Add(connectionProvider, objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect);
				return connectionProvider;
			}
		}

		private void DestroyProvider(IDataStore provider)
		{
			IDisposable[] array;
			lock (garbage)
			{
				array = garbage[provider];
				garbage.Remove(provider);
			}
			if (array != null)
			{
				IDisposable[] array2 = array;
				foreach (IDisposable disposable in array2)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public override IDataStore AcquireReadProvider()
		{
			return ((DataStoreForkBase)this).AcquireChangeProvider();
		}

		public override Task<IDataStore> AcquireReadProviderAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return ((DataStoreForkBase)this).AcquireChangeProviderAsync(cancellationToken);
		}

		public override void ReleaseReadProvider(IDataStore provider)
		{
			((DataStoreForkBase)this).ReleaseChangeProvider(provider);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			lock (SyncRoot)
			{
				if (isDisposed)
				{
					return;
				}
				isDisposed = true;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				IDataStore provider;
				lock (SyncRoot)
				{
					if (freiPool.Count == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					provider = freiPool.Dequeue();
				}
				DestroyProvider(provider);
			}
		}
	}
	public class AdvantageConnectionProvider : ConnectionProviderSql
	{
		private delegate bool TablesFilter(DBTable table);

		private bool isADS10;

		private ReflectConnectionHelper helper;

		private DbTypeMapperBase dbTypeMapper;

		public const string XpoProviderTypeString = "Advantage";

		private void CheckVersion(IDbConnection connection)
		{
			using IDbCommand dbCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
			dbCommand.CommandText = "execute procedure sp_mgGetInstallInfo()";
			using IDataReader dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
			if (!dataReader.Read())
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < dataReader.FieldCount; i++)
			{
				if (dataReader.GetName(i) == "Version")
				{
					text = dataReader.GetString(i);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				string[] array = text.Split('.');
				if (array.Length != 0 && int.TryParse(array[0], out var result))
				{
					isADS10 = result >= 10;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(DBTable table, DBColumn column, bool forTableCreate)
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(table, column);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes))
			{
				return sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes;
			}
			sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnType(table, column);
			if (column.IsKey && column.IsIdentity && ((int)column.ColumnType == 8 || (int)column.ColumnType == 12) && ConnectionProviderSql.IsSingleColumnPKColumn(table, column))
			{
				if ((int)column.ColumnType == 12)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("ConnectionProvider_TheAutoIncrementedKeyWithX0TypeIsNotSuppor", column.ColumnType, ((object)this).GetType()));
				}
				sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = "AutoInc";
			}
			if (column.IsKey || !column.IsNullable)
			{
				sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes += " CONSTRAINT NOT NULL";
			}
			if (!column.IsIdentity)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(column.DbDefaultValue))
				{
					sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes + " DEFAULT " + FormatString(column.DbDefaultValue) + "";
				}
				else if (column.DefaultValue != null && column.DefaultValue != DBNull.Value)
				{
					try
					{
						string value = FormatConstant(column.DefaultValue);
						sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes + " DEFAULT " + FormatString(value) + "";
					}
					catch (ArgumentException ex)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("SqlConnectionProvider_CannotCreateAColumnForTheX0FieldWithTheX1D", column.Name, ex.Data["Value"]), ex);
					}
				}
			}

		protected override object ReformatReadValue(object value, ReformatReadValueArgs args)
		{
			if (args.DbTypeCode == TypeCode.Decimal)
			{
				switch (args.TargetTypeCode)
				{
				case TypeCode.UInt32:
				case TypeCode.Int64:
				case TypeCode.UInt64:
					return Convert.ChangeType((decimal)value, args.TargetTypeCode, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Decimal:
					return (decimal)value;
				}
			}
			return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ReformatReadValue(value, args);
		}

		protected override object ConvertToDbParameter(object clientValue, TypeCode clientValueTypeCode)
		{
			switch (clientValueTypeCode)
			{
			case TypeCode.Object:
				if (clientValue is Guid)
				{
					return clientValue.ToString();
				}
				break;
			case TypeCode.SByte:
				return (short)(sbyte)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
				return (decimal)(uint)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				return (decimal)(ulong)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				return (decimal)(long)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return (double)(float)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return (decimal)clientValue;
			}
			return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ConvertToDbParameter(clientValue, clientValueTypeCode);
		}

		private string GetFullTypeName(string typeName, short size, short scale)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(typeName))
			{
				return typeName;
			}
			switch (typeName)
			{
			case "char":
			case "nchar":
			case "varchar":
			case "nvarchar":
				return typeName + "(" + size.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
			case "numeric":
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}({1},{2})", new object[3] { typeName, size, scale });
			default:
				return typeName;
			}
		}

		private bool TryExtractTimestampFromSTOTSFunction(string expression, out DateTime outDateTime)
		{
			int num = "STOTS('".Length + "yyyyMMdd HH:mm:ss.fff".Length + "')".Length;
			if (expression.StartsWith("STOTS('") && expression.EndsWith("')") && expression.Length == num)
			{
				string s = expression.Substring("STOTS('".Length, "yyyyMMdd HH:mm:ss.fff".Length);
				return DateTime.TryParseExact(s, "yyyyMMdd HH:mm:ss.fff", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out outDateTime);
			}
			outDateTime = DateTime.MinValue;
			return false;
		}

		private static string WrapWithCastAsTimestamp(string arg)
		{
			if (arg.StartsWith("(cast(") && arg.EndsWith(" as sql_timestamp))"))
			{
				return arg;
			}
			return string.Concat("(cast(" + arg + " as sql_timestamp))");
		}

		public override string FormatFunction(FunctionOperatorType operatorType, params string[] operands)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0224: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0cea: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			switch (operatorType - 4)
			{
			case 16:
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(abs(cast({0} as SQL_NUMERIC(20,10))))", new object[1] { operands[0] });
			case 35:
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(cast({0} as sql_numeric(38,0)) * cast({1} as sql_numeric(38,0) ))", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]

		public override string FormatFunction(ProcessParameter processParameter, FunctionOperatorType operatorType, params object[] operands)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0102: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0081: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00c6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cc: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if ((int)operatorType == 46)
			{
				object obj = operands[1];
				if (obj is OperandValue && ((OperandValue)obj).Value is string)
				{
					string text = (string)((OperandValue)obj).Value;
					int num = text.IndexOfAny(achtungChars);
					if (num < 0)
					{
						return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "({0} likE {1})", new object[2]
						{
							processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
							processParameter.Invoke((object)new ConstantValue((object)(text + "%")))
						});
					}
					if (num > 0)
					{
						return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(({0} likE {2}) And (LocatE({1}, {0}) = 1))", new object[3]
						{
							processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
							processParameter.Invoke(obj),
							(object)new ConstantValue((object)(text.Substring(0, num) + "%"))
						});
					}
				}
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(LocatE({1}, {0}) = 1)", new object[2]
				{
					processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
					processParameter.Invoke(operands[1])
				});
			}
			return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatFunction(processParameter, operatorType, operands);
		}

		private string FnConcat(string[] operands)
		{
			string text = "(";
			foreach (string arg in operands)
			{
				if (text.Length > 1)
				{
					text += " + ";
				}
				text += $"cast({arg} as sql_varchar(32000))";
			}
			return text + ")";
		}

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			object value = parameter.Value;
			createParameter = false;
			if (parameter is ConstantValue && value != null)
			{
				switch (Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
				{
				case TypeCode.Int32:
					return ((int)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Boolean:
					if (!(bool)value)
					{
						return "0";
					}
					return "1";
				case TypeCode.String:
					return FormatString(value);
				}
			}
			createParameter = true;
			return ":p" + index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		private string FormatString(object value)
		{
			return "'" + ((string)value).Replace("'", "''") + "'";
		}

		protected override IDataParameter CreateParameter(IDbCommand command, object value, string name, DBColumnType dbType, string dbTypeName, int size)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0055: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0096: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0098: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IDbDataParameter dbDataParameter = (IDbDataParameter)((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CreateParameter(command);
			dbDataParameter.Value = value;
			dbDataParameter.ParameterName = name;
			QueryParameterMode queryParameterMode = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetQueryParameterMode();
			if ((int)queryParameterMode != 1)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbTypeName))
				{
					if ((int)queryParameterMode == 3)
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterTypeAndSize(dbDataParameter, dbTypeName);
					}
					else
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterType(dbDataParameter, dbTypeName);
					}
				}
				else if ((int)queryParameterMode == 3)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterTypeAndSize(dbDataParameter, dbType, size);
				}
				else
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterType(dbDataParameter, dbType);
				}
			}
			if (value is byte[])
			{
				dbDataParameter.DbType = DbType.Binary;
			}
			if (value is string)
			{
				dbDataParameter.DbType = DbType.String;
			}
			if ((int)queryParameterMode == 3)
			{
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ValidateParameterSize(command, dbDataParameter);
			}
			return dbDataParameter;
		}

		public override string FormatConstraint(string constraintName)
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "\"{0}\"", new object[1] { constraintName });
		}

		protected string FormatConstant(object value)
		{
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
			{
			case TypeCode.Empty:
			case TypeCode.DBNull:
				return "NULL";
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return "false";
				}
				return "true";
			case TypeCode.Char:
				if (value is char && Convert.ToInt32(value) == 0)
				{
					ArgumentException ex = new ArgumentException();
					ex.Data["Value"] = "\\x" + Convert.ToInt32(value).ToString("X2");
					throw ex;
				}
				return "'" + (char)value + "'";
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
				string text = "yyyyMMdd HH:mm:ss.fff";
				return $"STOTS('{dateTime.ToString(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}')";
			}
			case TypeCode.String:
				return FormatString(value);
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return FixNonFixedText(((decimal)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return FixNonFixedText(((double)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return FixNonFixedText(((float)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.SByte:
			case TypeCode.Byte:
			case TypeCode.Int16:
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				return Convert.ToInt64(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				return Convert.ToUInt64(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			default:
				if (value is Guid)
				{
					return "'" + ((Guid)value/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString() + "'";
				}
				if (value is TimeSpan)
				{
					return FixNonFixedText(((TimeSpan)value).TotalSeconds.ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(value.ToString());
			}
		}

		private string FixNonFixedText(string toFix)
		{
			if (toFix.IndexOfAny(new char[3] { '.', 'e', 'E' }) < 0)
			{
				toFix += ".0";
			}
			return toFix;
		}

		private void ClearDatabase(IDbCommand command)
		{

		private DBColumnType GetDbTypeFromString(string typeStr, int length)
		{
			switch (typeStr)
			{
			case "int":
			case "integer":
				return (DBColumnType)8;
			case "image":
			case "binary":
			case "long binary":
			case "varbinary":
				return (DBColumnType)18;
			case "varchar":
			case "long varchar":
			case "nvarchar":
			case "long nvarchar":
			case "ntext":
			case "text":
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			case "bit":
				return (DBColumnType)1;
			case "tinyint":
				return (DBColumnType)2;
			case "smallint":
				return (DBColumnType)10;
			case "bigint":
				return (DBColumnType)12;
			case "numeric":
			case "money":
			case "decimal":
				return (DBColumnType)5;
			case "nchar":
			case "char":
				if (length == 1)
				{
					return (DBColumnType)4;
				}
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			case "float":
			case "double":
			case "real":
				return (DBColumnType)6;
			case "uniqueidentifier":
				return (DBColumnType)16;
			case "date":
			case "datetime":
				return (DBColumnType)15;
			default:
				return (DBColumnType)0;
			}

		private static string GetFullTypeName(string typeName, byte? precision, byte scale, int length)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(typeName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (typeName)
			{
			case "nchar":
			case "char":
			case "varchar":
			case "long varchar":
			case "nvarchar":
			case "long nvarchar":
				return typeName + "(" + length.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " char)";
			case "binary":
			case "long binary":
			case "varbinary":
				return typeName + "(" + length.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
			case "number":
			case "numeric":
			case "decimal":
				if (precision.HasValue)
				{
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}({1},{2})", new object[3] { typeName, precision, scale });
				}
				return typeName;
			case "float":
				if (!(precision >= 8))
				{
					return "float";
				}
				return "double precision";
			default:
				return typeName;
			}
		}

		private string FnConcat(string[] operands)
		{
			string text = "(";
			foreach (string text2 in operands)

				if (text.Length > 1)

			}

			}

		}

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			object value = parameter.Value;
			createParameter = false;
			if (parameter is ConstantValue && value != null)
			{
				switch (Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
				{
				case TypeCode.Int32:
					return ((int)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Boolean:
					if (!(bool)value)
					{
						return "0";
					}
					return "1";
				case TypeCode.String:
					return FormatString(value);
				}
			}
			createParameter = true;
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, ":p{0}", new object[1] { index });
		}

		protected override IDataParameter CreateParameter(IDbCommand command, object value, string name, DBColumnType dbType, string dbTypeName, int size)
		{
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0072: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

			//IL_004e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

			//IL_00b5: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IDbDataParameter dbDataParameter = (IDbDataParameter)((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CreateParameter(command);
			dbDataParameter.Value = value;
			dbDataParameter.ParameterName = ((string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) || name[0] != ':') ? name : name.Remove(0, 1));
			QueryParameterMode queryParameterMode = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetQueryParameterMode();
			if ((int)queryParameterMode != 1)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbTypeName))
				{
					if ((int)queryParameterMode == 3)
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterTypeAndSize(dbDataParameter, dbTypeName);
					}
					else
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterType(dbDataParameter, dbTypeName);
					}
				}
				else if ((int)queryParameterMode == 3)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterTypeAndSize(dbDataParameter, dbType, size);
				}
				else
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterType(dbDataParameter, dbType);
				}
			}
			if (value is byte[])
			{
				dbDataParameter.DbType = DbType.Binary;
			}
			if (value is string)
			{
				dbDataParameter.DbType = DbType.String;
			}

		}

		protected string FormatConstant(object value)
		{
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
			{
			case TypeCode.Empty:
			case TypeCode.DBNull:
				return "NULL";
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return "0";
				}
				return "1";
			case TypeCode.Char:
				if (value is char && Convert.ToInt32(value) < 32)
				{
					return "char(" + Convert.ToInt32(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
				}
				return "N'" + (char)value + "'";
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
				string text = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff";
				return $"convert(datetime, '{dateTime.ToString(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}', 121)";
			}
			case TypeCode.String:
				return FormatString(value);
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return FixNonFixedText(((decimal)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return FixNonFixedText(((double)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return FixNonFixedText(((float)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.SByte:
			case TypeCode.Byte:
			case TypeCode.Int16:
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				return Convert.ToInt64(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				return Convert.ToUInt64(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			default:
				if (value is Guid)
				{
					return "Cast('" + ((Guid)value/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString() + "' as uniqueidentifier)";
				}
				if (value is TimeSpan)
				{
					return FixNonFixedText(((TimeSpan)value).TotalSeconds.ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(value.ToString());
			}
		}

		private string FixNonFixedText(string toFix)
		{
			if (toFix.IndexOfAny(new char[3] { '.', 'e', 'E' }) < 0)
			{
				toFix += ".0";
			}
			return toFix;
		}

		private void ClearDatabase(IDbCommand command)
		{
			string[] storageTablesList = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetStorageTablesList(false);
			string[] array = storageTablesList;
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				command.CommandText = "drop table [" + text + "]";
				command.ExecuteNonQuery();
			}
		}

		protected override void ProcessClearDatabase()
		{
			IDbCommand command = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CreateCommand();
			ClearDatabase(command);
		}

		public override async Task<ModificationResult> ModifyDataAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken, params ModificationStatement[] dmlStatements)
		{
			AsyncOperationIdentifier asyncOperationId = AsyncOperationIdentifier.New();
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).BeginTransaction();
			try
			{
				List<ParameterValue> result = new List<ParameterValue>();
				TaggedParametersHolder identities = new TaggedParametersHolder();
				foreach (ModificationStatement val in dmlStatements)
				{
					InsertStatement ins = (InsertStatement)(object)((val is InsertStatement) ? val : null);
					if (ins != null && ins.IdentityParameter != null && ins.IdentityColumn == "XpoIdentityColumn")
					{
						identities.ConsolidateIdentity(ins.IdentityParameter);
						Query val2 = new AsaSpInsertSqlGenerator((ISqlGeneratorFormatter)(object)this, identities, new Dictionary<OperandValue, string>()).GenerateSql(ins, "XpoIdentityColumn");

						if (ins.IdentityParameter != null)

							result.Add(ins.IdentityParameter);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ParameterValue val3 = await ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).UpdateRecordAsync(val, identities, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
						if (val3 != null)
						{
							result.Add(val3);

			}

		private DBColumnType GetTypeFromNumber(byte type, byte prec, int length, short userType, byte charSize, out int effectiveLength)
		{

				return (DBColumnType)(length switch
				{
					1 => 2, 
					2 => 11,

					8 => 13, 
					_ => 0, 
				});

				}

			case 60:
			case 110:

			case 108:

			}

		private static string GetFullTypeName(string typeName, byte precision, byte scale, int length)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(typeName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (typeName)
			{
			case "unichar":
			case "univarchar":
			case "char":
			case "varchar":
				return typeName + "(" + length.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
			case "binary":
			case "varbinary":
				return typeName + "(" + length.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
			case "float":
				if (precision != 0)
				{
					return typeName + "(" + precision.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
				}
				return typeName;
			case "decimal":
			case "numeric":
				if (precision != 0)
				{
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}({1},{2})", new object[3] { typeName, precision, scale });
				}
				return typeName;
			default:
				return typeName;
			}
		}

				4 => string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(case when charindex({0}, substring({1}, {2} + 1, {3} - {2})) > 0 then charindex({0}, substring({1}, {2} + 1, {3} - {2})) + {2} - 1 else -1 end)", operands[0], operands[1], operands[2], operands[3]), 
				_ => throw new NotSupportedException(), 
			};
		}

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			object value = parameter.Value;
			createParameter = false;
			if (parameter is ConstantValue && value != null)
			{
				switch (Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
				{
				case TypeCode.Int32:
					return ((int)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Boolean:
					if (!(bool)value)
					{
						return "0";
					}
					return "1";
				case TypeCode.String:
					return FormatString(value);
				}
			}
			createParameter = true;
			return "@p" + index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		private string FormatString(object value)
		{
			return "'" + ((string)value).Replace("'", "''") + "'";
		}

		protected override IDataParameter CreateParameter(IDbCommand command, object value, string name, DBColumnType dbType, string dbTypeName, int size)
		{

		}

		public override string FormatConstraint(string constraintName)
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "[{0}]", new object[1] { constraintName });
		}

		protected string FormatConstant(object value)
		{
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
			{
			case TypeCode.Empty:
			case TypeCode.DBNull:
				return "NULL";
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return "0";
				}
				return "1";
			case TypeCode.Char:
				if (value is char && Convert.ToInt32(value) < 32)
				{
					return "char(" + Convert.ToInt32(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
				}
				return "'" + (char)value + "'";
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
				string text = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss";
				return $"cast('{dateTime.ToString(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}' as datetime)";
			}
			case TypeCode.String:
				return FormatString(value);
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return FixNonFixedText(((decimal)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return FixNonFixedText(((double)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return FixNonFixedText(((float)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.SByte:
			case TypeCode.Byte:
			case TypeCode.Int16:
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				return Convert.ToInt64(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				return Convert.ToUInt64(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			default:
				if (value is Guid)
				{
					return "'" + ((Guid)value/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString() + "'";
				}
				if (value is TimeSpan)
				{
					return FixNonFixedText(((TimeSpan)value).TotalSeconds.ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(value.ToString());
			}
		}

		private string FixNonFixedText(string toFix)
		{
			if (toFix.IndexOfAny(new char[3] { '.', 'e', 'E' }) < 0)
			{
				toFix += ".0";
			}
			return toFix;
		}

			return AseConnectionProvider.GetConnectionString(parameters["server"], parameters["database"], parameters["userid"], parameters["password"]);
		}

		public DataCacheWarpSelectDataResult(DataCacheSelectDataResult selectedData)
			: this()

			SelectResult = WcfUsedAsDumbPipeHelper.Warp((selectedData.SelectedData == null) ? null : selectedData.SelectedData.ResultSet);
			SelectingCookie = selectedData.SelectingCookie;
			base.CacheConfig = ((DataCacheResult)selectedData).CacheConfig;
			base.Cookie = ((DataCacheResult)selectedData).Cookie;
			base.UpdatedTableAges = ((DataCacheResult)selectedData).UpdatedTableAges;
		}

			//IL_001c: Expected O, but got Unknown

			val.SelectedData = new SelectedData(WcfUsedAsDumbPipeHelper.Unwarp(SelectResult));
			val.SelectingCookie = SelectingCookie;
			((DataCacheResult)val).CacheConfig = base.CacheConfig;
			((DataCacheResult)val).Cookie = base.Cookie;
			((DataCacheResult)val).UpdatedTableAges = base.UpdatedTableAges;
			return val;
		}
	}

	public class ServiceBase
	{
		public static event ServiceExceptionHandler GlobalServiceExceptionThrown;

		public event ServiceExceptionHandler ServiceExceptionThrown;

		protected virtual void OnServiceExceptionThrown(Exception ex)
		{
			ServiceExceptionEventArgs e = new ServiceExceptionEventArgs(ex);
			this.ServiceExceptionThrown?.Invoke(this, e);
			ServiceBase.GlobalServiceExceptionThrown?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected OperationResult<T> Execute<T>(OperationResultPredicate<T> predicate)
		{
			try
			{
				return new OperationResult<T>(predicate());
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				return WrapException<T>(ex);
			}
		}

		protected async Task<OperationResult<T>> ExecuteAsync<T>(Task<T> resultAwaiter)
		{
			try
			{
				return new OperationResult<T>(await resultAwaiter.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				return WrapException<T>(ex);
			}
		}

		protected OperationResult<T> WrapException<T>(Exception ex)
		{
			OnServiceExceptionThrown(ex);
			if (ex is NotSupportedException)
			{
				return new OperationResult<T>(ServiceException.NotSupported, ex.Message);
			}
			if (ex is SchemaCorrectionNeededException)
			{
				return new OperationResult<T>(ServiceException.Schema, ex.Message);
			}
			if (ex is LockingException)
			{
				return new OperationResult<T>(ServiceException.Locking, string.Empty);
			}
			if (ex is ObjectLayerSecurityException)
			{
				return new OperationResult<T>(ServiceException.ObjectLayerSecurity, OperationResult.SerializeSecurityException((ObjectLayerSecurityException)ex));
			}
			return new OperationResult<T>(ServiceException.Unknown, ex.Message);
		}
	}
	public class DataStoreService : ServiceBase, IDataStoreWarpService, IDataStoreService
	{
		protected readonly IDataStore provider;

		protected readonly ICommandChannel commandChannel;

		public DataStoreService(IDataStore provider)
		{
			this.provider = provider;
			commandChannel = (ICommandChannel)(object)((provider is ICommandChannel) ? provider : null);
		}

		public virtual OperationResult<ModificationResult> ModifyData(ModificationStatement[] dmlStatements)
		{
			return Execute(() => provider.ModifyData(dmlStatements));
		}

		public virtual OperationResult<SelectedData> SelectData(SelectStatement[] selects)
		{
			return Execute(() => provider.SelectData(selects));
		}

		public virtual OperationResult<byte[]> WarpSelectData(SelectStatement[] selects)
		{
			return Execute(() => WcfUsedAsDumbPipeHelper.Warp(provider.SelectData(selects)?.ResultSet));
		}

		public virtual OperationResult<UpdateSchemaResult> UpdateSchema(bool doNotCreateIfFirstTableNotExist, DBTable[] tables)
		{
			return Execute(() => provider.UpdateSchema(doNotCreateIfFirstTableNotExist, tables));
		}

		public virtual OperationResult<AutoCreateOption> GetAutoCreateOption()
		{
			return Execute(() => provider.AutoCreateOption);
		}

		public virtual OperationResult<object> Do(string command, object args)
		{
			if (commandChannel == null)
			{
				if (provider == null)
				{
					return new OperationResult<object>(ServiceException.NotSupported, $"Command '{command}' is not supported.");
				}
				return new OperationResult<object>(ServiceException.NotSupported, $"Command '{command}' is not supported by {((object)provider).GetType().FullName}.");
			}
			return Execute(() => commandChannel.Do(command, args));
		}
	}

	public class DataStoreClientBase<TContractType> : ClientBase<TContractType>, IDataStore, ICommandChannel where TContractType : class, IDataStoreWarpService
	{
		private bool selectDataRawFound;

		private bool selectDataRawNotFound;

		private TContractType channel;

		protected new TContractType Channel
		{
			get
			{
				TContractType val = channel;
				if (val == null)
				{
					val = (channel = CreateChannel());
					OnClientChannelCreated(val);
				}
				return val;
			}
		}

		AutoCreateOption IDataStore.AutoCreateOption => ExecuteClient(() => Channel.GetAutoCreateOption(), HandleSelectDataException).HandleError();

		public event ClientChannelCreatedHandler ClientChannelCreated;

		public static event ClientChannelCreatedHandler GlobalDataClientChannelCreated;

		public DataStoreClientBase(string configName)
			: base(configName)
		{
		}

		public DataStoreClientBase(System.ServiceModel.Channels.Binding binding, EndpointAddress remoteAddress)
			: base(binding, remoteAddress)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnClientChannelCreated(object channel)
		{
			if (this.ClientChannelCreated != null)
			{
				this.ClientChannelCreated(this, new ClientChannelCreatedEventArgs(channel));
			}
			if (DataStoreClientBase<TContractType>.GlobalDataClientChannelCreated != null)
			{
				DataStoreClientBase<TContractType>.GlobalDataClientChannelCreated(this, new ClientChannelCreatedEventArgs(channel));
			}
		}

		ModificationResult IDataStore.ModifyData(ModificationStatement[] dmlStatements)
		{
			return ExecuteClient(() => Channel.ModifyData(dmlStatements), HandleModifyDataException).HandleError();
		}

		SelectedData IDataStore.SelectData(SelectStatement[] selects)
		{
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!selectDataRawNotFound)
			{
				try
				{
					SelectedData result = new SelectedData(WcfUsedAsDumbPipeHelper.Unwarp(ExecuteClient(() => Channel.WarpSelectData(selects), HandleSelectDataException).HandleError()));
					selectDataRawFound = true;
					return result;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					if (selectDataRawFound)
					{
						throw;
					}
					selectDataRawNotFound = true;
				}
			}
			return ExecuteClient(() => Channel.SelectData(selects), HandleSelectDataException).HandleError();
		}

		UpdateSchemaResult IDataStore.UpdateSchema(bool doNotCreateIfFirstTableNotExist, params DBTable[] tables)
		{
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return ExecuteClient(() => Channel.UpdateSchema(doNotCreateIfFirstTableNotExist, tables), HandleUpdateSchemaException).HandleError();
		}

		object ICommandChannel.Do(string command, object args)
		{
			return ExecuteClient(() => Channel.Do(command, args), HandleCommandChannelException).HandleError();
		}

		public OperationResult<R> ExecuteClient<R>(OperationResultChannelPredicate<R> predicate)
		{
			return ExecuteClient(predicate, null);
		}

		public OperationResult<R> ExecuteClient<R>(OperationResultChannelPredicate<R> predicate, Func<Exception, bool> exceptionHandler)
		{
			return OperationResult.ExecuteClient(predicate, exceptionHandler, ref channel);
		}

		protected Task<OperationResult<R>> ExecuteClientAsync<R>(OperationResultChannelPredicateAsync<R> predicate)
		{
			return ExecuteClientAsync(predicate, null);
		}

		protected Task<OperationResult<R>> ExecuteClientAsync<R>(OperationResultChannelPredicateAsync<R> predicate, Func<Exception, bool> exceptionHandler)
		{
			return OperationResult.ExecuteClientAsync(predicate, exceptionHandler, delegate
			{
				channel = null;
			});
		}

		protected virtual bool HandleModifyDataException(Exception ex)
		{
			return !(ex is TimeoutException);
		}

		protected virtual bool HandleSelectDataException(Exception ex)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool HandleUpdateSchemaException(Exception ex)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool HandleCommandChannelException(Exception ex)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class OperationResult
	{
		private const string SerializeSeparator = "#|O_o|#";

		public ServiceException ErrorType;

		public string Error;

		public static int ExecuteClientMaxRetryCount = 3;

		public OperationResult()
		{
		}

		public OperationResult(ServiceException errorType, string error)
		{
			ErrorType = errorType;
			Error = error;
		}

		public static string SerializeSecurityException(ObjectLayerSecurityException securityException)
		{
			return string.Join("#|O_o|#", securityException.TypeName, securityException.PropertyName, securityException.IsDeletion ? "True" : "False");
		}

		public static ObjectLayerSecurityException DeserializeSecurityException(string data)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(data))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[] array = data.Split(new string[1] { "#|O_o|#" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
			if (array.Length != 3)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(array[0]))
			{
				return new ObjectLayerSecurityException();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(array[1]))
			{
				return new ObjectLayerSecurityException(array[0], array[1]);
			}
			return new ObjectLayerSecurityException(array[0], array[2] == "True");
		}

		public static OperationResult<T> ExecuteClient<T, N>(OperationResultChannelPredicate<T> predicate, Func<Exception, bool> exceptionHandler, ref N channel)
		{
			int executeClientMaxRetryCount = ExecuteClientMaxRetryCount;
			while (true)
			{
				try
				{
					return predicate();
				}
				catch (Exception arg)
				{
					channel = default(N);
					if (executeClientMaxRetryCount-- > 0 && (exceptionHandler == null || exceptionHandler(arg)))
					{
						continue;
					}
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		public static OperationResult<T> ExecuteClient<T, N>(OperationResultChannelPredicate<T> predicate, ref N channel)
		{
			return ExecuteClient(predicate, null, ref channel);
		}

		public static async Task<OperationResult<R>> ExecuteClientAsync<R>(OperationResultChannelPredicateAsync<R> predicate, Func<Exception, bool> exceptionHandler, Action resetChannelAction)
		{
			int count = ExecuteClientMaxRetryCount;
			while (true)
			{
				try
				{
					return await predicate().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
				catch (Exception arg)
				{
					resetChannelAction?.Invoke();
					if (count-- > 0 && (exceptionHandler == null || exceptionHandler(arg)))
					{
						continue;
					}
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		public static Task<OperationResult<R>> ExecuteClientAsync<R>(OperationResultChannelPredicateAsync<R> predicate, Action resetChannelAction)
		{
			return ExecuteClientAsync(predicate, null, resetChannelAction);
		}
	}
	public class OperationResult<T> : OperationResult
	{
		public T Result;

		public OperationResult()
		{
		}

		public OperationResult(ServiceException errorType, string error)
			: base(errorType, error)
		{
		}

		public OperationResult(T result)
			: this(ServiceException.None, (string)null)
		{
			Result = result;
		}

		public T HandleError()
		{
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			switch (ErrorType)
			{
			case ServiceException.Unknown:
				throw new Exception(Error);
			case ServiceException.Schema:
				throw new SchemaCorrectionNeededException(Error);
			case ServiceException.NotSupported:
				throw new NotSupportedException(Error);
			case ServiceException.ObjectLayerSecurity:
			{
				ObjectLayerSecurityException ex = OperationResult.DeserializeSecurityException(Error);
				if (ex == null)
				{
					ex = new ObjectLayerSecurityException();
				}
				throw ex;
			}
			case ServiceException.Locking:
				throw new LockingException();
			default:
				return Result;
			}
		}
	}

		private DBColumnType GetTypeFromString(string typeName, int size)

		private static string GetFullTypeName(string typeName, int size, short scale)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(typeName))
			{
				return typeName;
			}
			switch (typeName)
			{
			case "VARCHAR":
			case "VARGRAPHIC":
			case "CHARACTER":
			case "GRAPHIC":
				return typeName + "(" + size.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
			case "DECIMAL":
				if (size != 0)
				{
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}({1},{2})", new object[3] { typeName, size, scale });
				}
				return typeName;
			default:
				return typeName;
			}
		}
