					if (num < 0)
					{
						return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "({0} likE {1})", new object[2]
						{
							processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
							processParameter.Invoke((object)new ConstantValue((object)(text + "%")))
						});
					}
					if (num > 0)
					{
						return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(({0} likE {2}) And (PositioN({1}, {0}, CODEUNITS32) = 1))", new object[3]
						{
							processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
							processParameter.Invoke(obj),
							processParameter.Invoke((object)new ConstantValue((object)(text.Substring(0, num) + "%")))
						});
					}
				}
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(PositioN({1}, {0}, CODEUNITS32) = 1)", new object[2]
				{
					processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
					processParameter.Invoke(operands[1])
				});
			}
			return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatFunction(processParameter, operatorType, operands);
		}

		private string FnPadLeft(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "case when length({0}) > ({1}) then {0} else repeat(' ', ({1}) - length({0})) || ({0}) end", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnPadRight(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "case when length({0}) > ({1}) then {0} else ({0}) || repeat(' ', ({1}) - length({0})) end", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnCharIndex(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(position({0}, {1}, CODEUNITS32) - 1)", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			}
			if (operands.Length == 3)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(case when position({0}, substr({1}, ({2}) + 1), CODEUNITS32) > 0 then position({0}, substr({1}, ({2}) + 1), CODEUNITS32) + ({2}) - 1 else -1 end)", new object[3]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1],
					operands[2]
				});
			}
			if (operands.Length == 4)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(case when position({0}, substr({1}, ({2}) + 1, {3}), CODEUNITS32) > 0 then position({0}, substr({1}, ({2}) + 1, {3}), CODEUNITS32) + ({2}) - 1 else -1 end)", operands[0], operands[1], operands[2], operands[3]);
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnLog(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 1)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Ln({0})", new object[1] { operands[0] });
			}
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(Ln({0}) / Ln({1}))", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnRemove(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 3)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(substr({0}, 1, {1}) || substr({0}, ({1}) + 1 + ({2})))", new object[3]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1],
					operands[2]
				});
			}
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "substr({0}, 1, {1})", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnConcat(string[] operands)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			foreach (string text2 in operands)
			{
				if (text.Length > 0)
				{
					text += " || ";
				}
				text += text2;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			ParameterValue val = (ParameterValue)(object)((parameter is ParameterValue) ? parameter : null);
			if (val == null || ((int)val.DBType == 0 && string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.DBTypeName)) || (int)((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetQueryParameterMode() == 1)
			{
				if (parameter.Value == null)
				{
					return FormatConstant(null);
				}
				createParameter = false;
				object value = parameter.Value;
				TypeCode typeCode = Type.GetTypeCode(parameter.Value.GetType());
				switch (typeCode)
				{
				case TypeCode.Byte:
					return ((byte)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.UInt16:
					return ((ushort)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.UInt32:
					return ((uint)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.UInt64:
					return ((ulong)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Int16:
					return ((short)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Int32:
					return ((int)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Int64:
					return ((long)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.SByte:
					return ((sbyte)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				default:
					if (parameter is ConstantValue && value != null)
					{
						switch (typeCode)
						{
						case TypeCode.Boolean:
							if (!(bool)value)
							{
								return "0";
							}
							return "1";
						case TypeCode.String:
							return FormatString(value);
						}
					}
					createParameter = true;
					return "@p" + index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
			}
			createParameter = true;
			return "@p" + index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected string FormatString(object value)
		{
			return "'" + ((string)value).Replace("'", "''") + "'";
		}

		public override string FormatConstraint(string constraintName)
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "\"{0}\"", new object[1] { constraintName });
		}

		protected string FormatConstant(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return "NULL";
			}
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
			{
			case TypeCode.Empty:
			case TypeCode.DBNull:
				return "NULL";
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return "'0'";
				}
				return "'1'";
			case TypeCode.Char:
				if (value is char && Convert.ToInt32(value) == 0)
				{
					return Convert.ToInt32(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				return "'" + (char)value + "'";
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
				return "'" + ((DateTime)value).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.ffffff", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "'";
			case TypeCode.String:
				return FormatString(value);
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return FixNonFixedText(((decimal)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return FixNonFixedText(((double)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return FixNonFixedText(((float)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.SByte:
			case TypeCode.Byte:
			case TypeCode.Int16:
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return Convert.ToInt64(value).ToString();
				}
				return value.ToString();
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return Convert.ToUInt64(value).ToString();
				}
				return value.ToString();
			default:
				if (value is Guid)
				{
					return "'" + ((Guid)value/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString() + "'";
				}
				if (value is TimeSpan)
				{
					return FixNonFixedText(((TimeSpan)value).TotalSeconds.ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(value.ToString());
			}
		}

		private string FixNonFixedText(string toFix)
		{
			if (toFix.IndexOfAny(new char[3] { '.', 'e', 'E' }) < 0)
			{
				toFix += ".0";
			}
			return toFix;
		}

		public void ClearDatabase(IDbCommand command)
		{
			string[] storageTablesList = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetStorageTablesList(false);
			string[] array = storageTablesList;
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				string text2 = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeTableName(text);
				string text3 = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeSchemaName(text);
				command.CommandText = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "drop table \"{0}\".\"{1}\"", new object[2]
				{
					string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3) ? currentUser : text3,
					text2
				});
				command.ExecuteNonQuery();
			}
		}

		protected override void ProcessClearDatabase()
		{
			IDbCommand command = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CreateCommand();
			ClearDatabase(command);
		}

		public override string[] GetStorageTablesList(bool includeViews)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SelectStatementResult val = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).SelectData(new Query(string.Format("select TABSCHEMA, TABNAME from SYSCAT.TABLES where OWNERTYPE = 'U' and TYPE in ('T'{0})", includeViews ? ", 'V'" : string.Empty)));
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(val.Rows.Length);
			SelectStatementResultRow[] rows = val.Rows;
			foreach (SelectStatementResultRow val2 in rows)
			{
				string text = ((string)val2.Values[0]).Trim();
				string text2 = ((string)val2.Values[1]).Trim();
				if (!string.Equals(text, "SYSTOOLS"))
				{
					if (string.Equals(text, string.IsNullOrEmpty(ObjectsOwner) ? currentUser : ObjectsOwner))
					{
						arrayList.Add(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}", new object[1] { text2 }));
					}
					else
					{
						arrayList.Add(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}.{1}", new object[2] { text, text2 }));
					}
				}
			}
			return (string[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(string));
		}

		public virtual string GetCurrentUser()
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			try
			{
				Query val = new Query("SELECT CURRENT USER FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1");
				SelectStatementResult val2 = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).SelectData(val);
				return val2.Rows[0].Values[0].ToString().TrimEnd();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private void GenerateView(DBTable table, StringBuilder result)
		{
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"CREATE VIEW <SCHEMA>.\"{table.Name}_xpoView\" AS");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\tSELECT");
			for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!hasIdentityes)
				{
					hasIdentityes = table.Columns[i].IsIdentity;
				}
				string arg = (table.Columns[i].IsIdentity ? " AS \"XpoIdentityColumn\"" : string.Empty);
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, string.Format("\t\t\"{0}\"{2}{1}", table.Columns[i].Name, (i < table.Columns.Count - 1) ? "," : string.Empty, arg));
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"\tFROM <SCHEMA>.\"{table.Name}\"");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "GO");
		}

		private void GenerateInsertSP(DBTable table, StringBuilder result)
		{
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"CREATE PROCEDURE <SCHEMA>.\"sp_{table.Name}_xpoView_insert\" (");
			for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				string sqlCreateColumnType = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnType(table, table.Columns[i]);
				bool flag = false;
				string text;
				string format;
				if (table.Columns[i].IsIdentity)
				{
					text = "XpoIdentityColumn";
					format = "\tOUT @{0} {1}{3}{2}";
				}
				else
				{
					text = table.Columns[i].Name;
					format = "\tIN @{0} {1}{3}{2}";
				}
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, string.Format(format, text, sqlCreateColumnType, (i < table.Columns.Count - 1) ? "," : string.Empty, flag ? " = null" : string.Empty));
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, ") LANGUAGE SQL");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "BEGIN");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"\t\tINSERT INTO <SCHEMA>.\"{table.Name}\"(");
			for (int j = 0; j < table.Columns.Count; j++)
			{
				if (!table.Columns[j].IsIdentity)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, string.Format("\t\t\t\"{0}\"{1}", table.Columns[j].Name, (j < table.Columns.Count - 1) ? "," : string.Empty));
				}
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\t)");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\tVALUES(");
			for (int k = 0; k < table.Columns.Count; k++)
			{
				if (!table.Columns[k].IsIdentity)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, string.Format("\t\t\t@{0}{1}", table.Columns[k].Name, (k < table.Columns.Count - 1) ? "," : string.Empty));
				}
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\t);");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, string.Format("\t\tselect identity_val_local() into @{0} from sysibm.sysdummy1;", "XpoIdentityColumn"));
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "END");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "GO");
		}

		private void GenerateUpdateSP(DBTable table, StringBuilder result)
		{
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"CREATE PROCEDURE <SCHEMA>.\"sp_{table.Name}_xpoView_update\"(");
			AppendKeys(table, result);
			for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!((ConnectionProviderSql)this).IsKey(table, table.Columns[i].Name))
				{
					if (i != 0 || ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns.Count > 0)
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, ",");
					}
					string sqlCreateColumnType = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnType(table, table.Columns[i]);
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"\tIN @old_{table.Columns[i].Name} {sqlCreateColumnType},");
					result.Append($"\tIN @{table.Columns[i].Name} {sqlCreateColumnType}");
				}
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result);
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, ") LANGUAGE SQL");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "BEGIN");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"\tUPDATE <SCHEMA>.\"{table.Name}\" SET");
			bool flag = true;
			for (int j = 0; j < table.Columns.Count; j++)
			{
				if (!((ConnectionProviderSql)this).IsKey(table, table.Columns[j].Name))
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					else
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, ",");
					}
					result.Append(string.Format("\t\t\"{0}\"=@{0}", table.Columns[j].Name));
				}
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result);
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\tWHERE");
			AppendWhere(table, result);
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "END");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "GO");
		}

		private void GenerateDeleteSP(DBTable table, StringBuilder result)

		private void GenerateInsteadOfInsertTrigger(DBTable table, StringBuilder result)
		{
			string arg = $"t_{table.Name}_xpoView_insert";
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"CREATE TRIGGER <SCHEMA>.\"{arg}\"");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "INSTEAD OF INSERT");
			string arg2 = $"{table.Name}_xpoView";
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"ON <SCHEMA>.\"{arg2}\"");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "REFERENCING NEW AS inserted");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "FOR EACH ROW");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "BEGIN ATOMIC");
			string arg3 = $"sp_{table.Name}_xpoView_insert";
			if (hasIdentityes)
			{
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"\tSIGNAL SQLSTATE '38T00' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Use {arg3} instead';");
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "END");
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "GO");
				return;
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"\tCALL <SCHEMA>.\"{arg3}\"(");
			for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, ",");
				}
				result.Append($"\t\tinserted.\"{table.Columns[i].Name}\"");
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t);");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "END");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "GO");
		}

		private void AppendWhere(DBTable table, StringBuilder result)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns.Count; i++)
			{

		private void ReadDbVersion(IDbConnection conn)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Expected O, but got Unknown

			{

			}

		private bool SetServerVersionInternal(string versionString)
		{
			string[] array = versionString.Split('.');
			if (array.Length == 3 && decimal.TryParse(array[0] + "." + array[1], NumberStyles.AllowDecimalPoint, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result) && int.TryParse(array[2], out versionMinor))
			{
				versionMajor = result;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool SupportVersion(decimal major, int minor)
		{
			if (!versionMajor.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (versionMajor.Value > major)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (versionMajor.Value == major && versionMinor >= minor)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

			}
		}

		protected override object ConvertToDbParameter(object clientValue, TypeCode clientValueTypeCode)
		{
			switch (clientValueTypeCode)
			{
			case TypeCode.Object:
				if (clientValue is Guid)
				{
					return clientValue.ToString();
				}
				break;
			case TypeCode.Byte:
				return (short)(byte)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.SByte:
				return (short)(sbyte)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
				return (int)(ushort)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
				return (long)(uint)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				return (decimal)(ulong)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return (double)(float)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)clientValue)
				{
					return "0";
				}
				return "1";
			}
			return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ConvertToDbParameter(clientValue, clientValueTypeCode);
		}

		private string GetTypeNameFromCode(FirebirdDType type, short subType, short size, short precision, short scale)
		{
			if ((uint)(type - 7) <= 2u || type == FirebirdDType.Int64 || type == FirebirdDType.Blob_id)
			{
				if (subType == 2)
				{
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "decimal({0},{1})", new object[2]
					{
						precision,
						-scale
					});
				}
				if (subType == 1 || scale != 0)
				{
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "numeric({0},{1})", new object[2]
					{
						precision,
						-scale
					});
				}
			}
			switch (type)
			{
			case FirebirdDType.Short:
				return "smallint";
			case FirebirdDType.Long:
				return "integer";
			case FirebirdDType.Quad:
				return "quad";
			case FirebirdDType.Int64:
				return "bigint";
			case FirebirdDType.Blob_id:
				return "blob_id";
			case FirebirdDType.Float:
				return "float";
			case FirebirdDType.D_float:
			case FirebirdDType.Double:
				return "double precision";
			case FirebirdDType.Sql_date:
				return "date";
			case FirebirdDType.Sql_time:
				return "time";
			case FirebirdDType.Text:
			case FirebirdDType.Text2:
				return "char(" + size.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
			case FirebirdDType.Boolean:
				return "boolean";
			case FirebirdDType.Timestamp:
				return "timestamp";
			case FirebirdDType.Varying:
			case FirebirdDType.Varying2:
				return "char varying (" + size.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
			case FirebirdDType.CString:
			case FirebirdDType.CString2:
				return "cstring(" + size.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
			case FirebirdDType.Blob:
				if (subType == 1)
				{
					return "blob sub_type text";
				}
				return "blob";
			default:
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private DBColumnType GetTypeFromCode(FirebirdDType type, short subType, short size, short scale)
		{
			if (((uint)(type - 7) <= 2u || type == FirebirdDType.Int64 || type == FirebirdDType.Blob_id) && (subType == 2 || subType == 1 || scale != 0))
			{
				return (DBColumnType)5;
			}
			switch (type)
			{
			case FirebirdDType.Short:
				return (DBColumnType)10;
			case FirebirdDType.Long:
				return (DBColumnType)8;
			case FirebirdDType.Quad:
			case FirebirdDType.Int64:
			case FirebirdDType.Blob_id:
				return (DBColumnType)12;
			case FirebirdDType.Float:
				return (DBColumnType)7;
			case FirebirdDType.D_float:
			case FirebirdDType.Double:
				return (DBColumnType)6;
			case FirebirdDType.Sql_date:
			case FirebirdDType.Sql_time:
			case FirebirdDType.Sql_time_tz:
			case FirebirdDType.Timestamp_tz:
			case FirebirdDType.Timestamp:
				return (DBColumnType)15;
			case FirebirdDType.Text:
			case FirebirdDType.Text2:
				if (size == 1)
				{
					return (DBColumnType)4;
				}
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			case FirebirdDType.Boolean:
				return (DBColumnType)1;
			case FirebirdDType.Varying:
			case FirebirdDType.Varying2:
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			case FirebirdDType.CString:
			case FirebirdDType.CString2:
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			case FirebirdDType.Blob:
				if (subType != 1)
				{
					return (DBColumnType)18;
				}
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			default:
				return (DBColumnType)0;
			}
		}

		public override string FormatFunction(ProcessParameter processParameter, FunctionOperatorType operatorType, params object[] operands)
		{

			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0083: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0098: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_00a6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b0: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00bf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c9: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00dd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e7: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (operatorType - 46 <= 2)
			{
				object obj = operands[1];
				if (obj is OperandValue && ((OperandValue)obj).Value is string)
				{
					string text = (string)((OperandValue)obj).Value;
					bool flag = text.IndexOfAny(achtungChars) >= 0;
					if (flag)
					{
						text = text.Replace("\\", "\\\\").Replace("%", "\\%").Replace("_", "\\_");
					}
					string text2 = (operatorType - 46) switch
					{

		private string FnLog(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 1)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Ln({0})", new object[1] { operands[0] });
			}
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "log({1}, {0})", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnLpad(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "iif({2}({0}) > {1}, {0}, lpad({0}, {1}, ' '))", new object[3]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1],
					GetFunctionStrLenName()
				});
			}
			if (operands.Length == 3)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "iif({3}({0}) > {1}, {0}, lpad({0}, {1}, {2}))", operands[0], operands[1], operands[2], GetFunctionStrLenName());
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnRpad(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "iif({2}({0}) > {1}, {0}, rpad({0}, {1}, ' '))", new object[3]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1],
					GetFunctionStrLenName()
				});
			}
			if (operands.Length == 3)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "iif({3}({0}) > {1}, {0}, rpad({0}, {1}, {2}))", operands[0], operands[1], operands[2], GetFunctionStrLenName());
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			object value = parameter.Value;
			createParameter = false;
			if (parameter is ConstantValue && value != null)
			{
				switch (Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
				{
				case TypeCode.Int32:
					return ((int)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Boolean:
					if (!(bool)value)
					{
						return "0";
					}
					return "1";
				case TypeCode.String:
					return FormatString(value);
				}
			}
			createParameter = true;
			if (parameter.Value is string)
			{
				ParameterValue val = (ParameterValue)(object)((parameter is ParameterValue) ? parameter : null);
				if (val == null || ((int)val.DBType == 0 && string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.DBTypeName)))
				{
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "@s{0}_{1}", new object[2]
					{
						index,
						((string)parameter.Value).Length
					});
				}
			}
			return "@p" + index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected string FormatString(object value)
		{
			return "'" + ((string)value).Replace("'", "''") + "'";
		}

		private static string DecodeStrParam(string operand)
		{
			if (operand.StartsWith("@s"))
			{
				int num = int.Parse(operand.Substring(operand.IndexOf('_') + 1));
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "cast({0} as varchar({1}))", new object[2] { operand, num });
			}
			return operand;
		}

		public override string FormatConstraint(string constraintName)
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "\"{0}\"", new object[1] { constraintName });
		}

		protected string FormatConstant(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return "NULL";
			}
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
			{
			case TypeCode.Empty:
			case TypeCode.DBNull:
				return "NULL";
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return "'0'";
				}
				return "'1'";
			case TypeCode.Char:
				return "'" + (char)value + "'";
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
				string text = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.ffff";
				return "'" + dateTime.ToString(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "'";
			}
			case TypeCode.String:
				return FormatString(value);
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return FixNonFixedText(((decimal)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return FixNonFixedText(((double)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return FixNonFixedText(((float)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.SByte:
			case TypeCode.Byte:
			case TypeCode.Int16:
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return Convert.ToInt64(value).ToString();
				}
				return value.ToString();
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return Convert.ToUInt64(value).ToString();
				}
				return value.ToString();
			default:
			{
				if (value is Guid)
				{
					return "'" + ((Guid)value/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString() + "'";
				}
				if (value is TimeSpan)
				{

		protected string FormatConstant(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return "NULL";
			}
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
			{
			case TypeCode.Empty:
			case TypeCode.DBNull:
				return "NULL";
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return "FALSE";
				}
				return "TRUE";
			case TypeCode.Char:
			{
				int num = Convert.ToInt32(value);
				return FormatString(((char)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			}
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
				string text = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fffffff";
				return "'" + dateTime.ToString(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "'";
			}
			case TypeCode.String:
				return FormatString(value);
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return FixNonFixedText(((decimal)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return FixNonFixedText(((double)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return FixNonFixedText(((float)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.SByte:
			case TypeCode.Byte:
			case TypeCode.Int16:
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return Convert.ToInt64(value).ToString();
				}
				return Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return Convert.ToUInt64(value).ToString();
				}
				return Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			default:
			{
				if (value is Guid)
				{
					return "'" + ((Guid)value/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString() + "'";
				}
				if (value is TimeSpan)
				{
					return FixNonFixedText(((TimeSpan)value).TotalSeconds.ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				ArgumentException ex = new ArgumentException();
				ex.Data["Value"] = value.ToString();
				throw ex;
			}
			}
		}

		private string FixNonFixedText(string toFix)
		{
			if (toFix.IndexOfAny(new char[3] { '.', 'e', 'E' }) < 0)
			{
				toFix += ".0";
			}
			return toFix;
		}

		{

		}

		private string FnIsNull(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 1)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "({0} IS NULL)", new object[1] { operands[0] });
			}
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "IFNULL({1},{0})", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnLog(string[] operands)
		{

		private string FnRound(string[] operands)

		private string FnPadLeft(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(SELECT LPAD(T.V,GREATEST({1},LENGTH(T.V))) X FROM (SELECT ({0}) V FROM DUMMY) T)", new object[2]
				{

					operands[1]

			}
			if (operands.Length == 3)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(SELECT LPAD(T.V,GREATEST({1},LENGTH(T.V)),{2}) X FROM (SELECT ({0}) V FROM DUMMY) T)", new object[3]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1],
					operands[2]
				});
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnPadRight(string[] operands)

		private string FnSubstring(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "SUBSTRING({0},({1})+1)", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			}
			if (operands.Length == 3)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "SUBSTRING({0},({1})+1,{2})", new object[3]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1],
					operands[2]
				});
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnRemove(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "LEFT({0},{1})", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			}
			if (operands.Length == 3)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(SELECT CONCAT(LEFT(T.V0,T.V1),SUBSTRING(T.V0,T.V1+T.V2+1)) X FROM (SELECT ({0}) V0, ({1}) V1, ({2}) V2 FROM DUMMY) T)", new object[3]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1],
					operands[2]
				});
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnCharIndex(string[] operands)
		{
			return operands.Length switch
			{
				2 => string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(LOCATE({1},{0}) - 1)", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				}), 
				3 => string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(LOCATE({1},{0},({2}) + 1) - 1)", new object[3]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1],
					operands[2]
				}), 
				4 => string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(LOCATE(SUBSTRING({0},1,{3}),{1},({2}) + 1) - 1)", operands[0], operands[1], operands[2], operands[3]), 
				_ => throw new NotSupportedException(), 
			};
		}

		public override string GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(DBTable table, DBColumn column, bool forTableCreate)
		{
			string sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(table, column);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes))
			{
				return sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes;
			}
			sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnType(table, column);
			if (column.IsIdentity)
			{
				sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes += " GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY";
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(column.DbDefaultValue))
			{
				sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes + " DEFAULT " + column.DbDefaultValue;
			}
			else if (column.DefaultValue != null && column.DefaultValue != DBNull.Value)
			{
				try
				{
					string text = FormatConstant(column.DefaultValue);
					sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes + " DEFAULT " + text;
				}
				catch (ArgumentException ex)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("SqlConnectionProvider_CannotCreateAColumnForTheX0FieldWithTheX1D", column.Name, ex.Data["Value"]), ex);
				}
			}
			sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = ((!column.IsKey && column.IsNullable) ? (sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes + " NULL") : (sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes + " NOT NULL"));
			if (table.PrimaryKey != null && ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns.Count == 1 && ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns[0] == column.Name)
			{
				sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes += " PRIMARY KEY";
			}
			return sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes;
		}

		public override string[] GetStorageTablesList(bool includeViews)
		{

		}

		protected Dictionary<string, bool> GetStorageTablesList(bool includeViews, bool stripKnownSchema)
		{
			Dictionary<string, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, bool>();
			foreach (string storageTables in GetStorageTablesList("SELECT TABLE_NAME, SCHEMA_NAME FROM SYS.TABLES where IS_PUBLIC = 'TRUE' and not (SCHEMA_NAME = 'SYS' or SCHEMA_NAME like '_SYS_%')", stripKnownSchema))
			{
				dictionary.Add(storageTables, value: false);
			}
			if (includeViews)
			{
				foreach (string storageTables2 in GetStorageTablesList("SELECT VIEW_NAME, SCHEMA_NAME FROM SYS.VIEWS where not (SCHEMA_NAME = 'SYS' or SCHEMA_NAME = 'SYS_DATABASES' or SCHEMA_NAME like '_SYS_%')", stripKnownSchema))
				{
					dictionary.Add(storageTables2, value: true);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetStorageTablesList(string sql, bool stripKnownSchema)
		{
			Query val = new Query(sql);
			SelectStatementResult val2 = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).SelectData(val);
			SelectStatementResultRow[] rows = val2.Rows;
			foreach (SelectStatementResultRow val3 in rows)
			{
				string text = (string)val3.Values[0];
				string text2 = (string)val3.Values[1];
				if (stripKnownSchema && (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ObjectsOwner) || ObjectsOwner.ToUpperInvariant() == text2))
				{
					yield return text;
				}
				else
				{
					yield return text2 + "." + text;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override object ReformatReadValue(object value, ReformatReadValueArgs args)
		{
			if (args.TargetTypeCode == TypeCode.Boolean && args.DbTypeCode == TypeCode.String)

		}

		protected override object ConvertToDbParameter(object clientValue, TypeCode clientValueTypeCode)
		{
			switch (clientValueTypeCode)
			{
			case TypeCode.Object:
				if (clientValue is Guid)
				{
					return clientValue.ToString();
				}
				if (clientValue is TimeSpan timeSpan)
				{
					return timeSpan.TotalSeconds;
				}
				break;
			case TypeCode.SByte:
				return (short)(sbyte)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
				return (int)(ushort)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
				return (long)(uint)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				return (decimal)(ulong)clientValue;
			}
			return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ConvertToDbParameter(clientValue, clientValueTypeCode);
		}

		private T? GetValueOrNull<T>(object value) where T : struct
		{
			if (!object.Equals(DBNull.Value, value))
			{
				return (T)value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected DBColumnType GetTypeFromString(string typeName, int? size, int? scale, out string fullTypeName)
		{
			fullTypeName = typeName;
			switch (typeName.ToLowerInvariant())
			{
			case "boolean":
				return (DBColumnType)1;
			case "tinyint":
				return (DBColumnType)2;
			case "smallint":
				return (DBColumnType)10;
			case "integer":
				return (DBColumnType)8;
			case "bigint":
				return (DBColumnType)12;
			case "real":
				return (DBColumnType)7;
			case "double":
				return (DBColumnType)6;
			case "varchar":
			case "nvarchar":
			case "alphanum":
			case "shorttext":
				if (size.HasValue)
				{
					fullTypeName = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}({1})", new object[2] { typeName, size.Value });
				}
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			case "clob":
			case "nclob":
			case "text":
			case "bintext":
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			case "timestamp":
			case "date":
			case "seconddate":
				return (DBColumnType)15;
			case "varbinary":
			case "blob":
				return (DBColumnType)18;
			case "decimal":
			case "smalldecimal":
				if (size.HasValue)
				{
					fullTypeName = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}({1},{2})", new object[3]
					{
						typeName,
						size.Value,
						scale.HasValue ? scale.Value : 0
					});
					return (DBColumnType)5;
				}
				return (DBColumnType)6;
			default:
				return (DBColumnType)0;
			}
		}

		protected virtual ObjectName ComposeSafeObjectName(string name)
		{
			string text = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeSchemaName(name);
			if (text == string.Empty)
			{
				text = ObjectsOwner;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = text.ToUpperInvariant();
			}
			string table = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeTableName(name);
			return new ObjectName(text, table);
		}

		private string GetFullTypeName(string typeName, int size, int precision, int scale)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(typeName))

				return typeName;
			}

			case "varchar":
			case "nchar":

				return typeName;

				{
					return typeName + "(" + size.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
				}
				return typeName;
			case "numeric":
				if (precision != 0)
				{
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}({1},{2})", new object[3] { typeName, precision, scale });
				}
				return typeName;

				return typeName;
			}
		}

			dbParameter.Value = value;
			dbParameter.ParameterName = name;
			QueryParameterMode queryParameterMode = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetQueryParameterMode();
			if ((int)queryParameterMode != 1)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbTypeName))
				{
					if ((int)queryParameterMode == 3)
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterTypeAndSize((IDbDataParameter)dbParameter, dbTypeName);
					}
					else
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterType((IDbDataParameter)dbParameter, dbTypeName);
					}
				}
				else if ((int)queryParameterMode == 3)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterTypeAndSize((IDbDataParameter)dbParameter, dbType, size);
				}
				else
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterType((IDbDataParameter)dbParameter, dbType);
				}
			}
			if (dbParameter.DbType == DbType.AnsiString)
			{
				dbParameter.DbType = DbType.String;
			}
			if ((int)queryParameterMode != 3 || (size == 0 && string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbTypeName)))
			{
				if (dbParameter.DbType == DbType.String && value is string)
				{
					if (((string)value).Length > 4000)
					{
						((IDbTypeMapperMsSqlCe)((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper).SetParameterType(dbParameter, SqlDbType.NText);
					}
				}
				else if (dbParameter.DbType == DbType.Binary && value is byte[] && ((byte[])value).Length > 4000)
				{
					((IDbTypeMapperMsSqlCe)((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper).SetParameterType(dbParameter, SqlDbType.Image);
				}
			}
			if ((int)queryParameterMode == 3)
			{
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ValidateParameterSize(command, (IDbDataParameter)dbParameter);
			}
			return dbParameter;
		}

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			object value = parameter.Value;
			createParameter = false;
			if (parameter is ConstantValue && value != null)
			{
				switch (Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
				{
				case TypeCode.Int32:
					return ((int)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Boolean:
					if (!(bool)value)
					{
						return "0";
					}
					return "1";
				case TypeCode.String:
					return FormatString(value);
				}
			}
			createParameter = true;
			return "@p" + index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected string FormatString(object value)
		{
			return "N'" + ((string)value).Replace("'", "''") + "'";
		}

		public override string FormatConstraint(string constraintName)
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "\"{0}\"", new object[1] { constraintName });
		}

		protected override int GetSafeNameTableMaxLength()
		{
			return 127;
		}

		protected string FormatConstant(object value)
		{
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
			{
			case TypeCode.Empty:
			case TypeCode.DBNull:
				return "NULL";
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return "0";
				}
				return "1";
			case TypeCode.Char:
				if (value is char && Convert.ToInt32(value) == 0)
				{
					ArgumentException ex = new ArgumentException();
					ex.Data["Value"] = "\\x" + Convert.ToInt32(value).ToString("X2");
					throw ex;
				}
				return "N'" + (char)value + "'";
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
				string text = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff";
				return $"convert(datetime, '{dateTime.ToString(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}', 121)";
			}
			case TypeCode.String:
				return FormatString(value);
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return FixNonFixedText(((decimal)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return FixNonFixedText(((double)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return FixNonFixedText(((float)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.SByte:
			case TypeCode.Byte:
			case TypeCode.Int16:
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				return Convert.ToInt64(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				return Convert.ToUInt64(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			default:
				if (value is Guid)
				{
					return "Cast('" + ((Guid)value/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString() + "' as uniqueidentifier)";
				}
				if (value is TimeSpan)
				{
					return FixNonFixedText(((TimeSpan)value).TotalSeconds.ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(value.ToString());
			}
		}

		private string FixNonFixedText(string toFix)
		{
			if (toFix.IndexOfAny(new char[3] { '.', 'e', 'E' }) < 0)
			{
				toFix += ".0";
			}
			return toFix;
		}

		protected override void ProcessClearDatabase()
		{
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.Close();
			File.Delete((string)ReflectConnectionHelper.GetPropertyValue((object)((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection, "DataSource"));
			CreateDatabaseThroughSqlCeEngine();
		}

			string[] array = new string[val.Rows.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < val.Rows.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = (string)val.Rows[i].Values[0];
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static IDbConnection CreateConnection(string connectionString)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ConnectionStringParser val = new ConnectionStringParser(connectionString);
			string partByName = val.GetPartByName("ForcedConnectorAssemblyName");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(partByName))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < connectors.Length; i++)
				{
					if (connectors[i].AssemblyName == partByName)
					{
						foundConnectorIndex = i;
						break;
					}
				}
				val.RemovePartByName("ForcedConnectorAssemblyName");
				connectionString = val.GetConnectionString();
			}
			if (foundConnectorIndex < 0)
			{
				string[] array = new string[connectors.Length];
				string[] array2 = new string[connectors.Length];
				for (int j = 0; j < connectors.Length; j++)
				{
					array[j] = connectors[j].AssemblyName;
					array2[j] = connectors[j].ConnectionTypeName;
				}
				IDbConnection connection = ReflectConnectionHelper.GetConnection(array, array2, true, ref foundConnectorIndex);
				if (connection != null)
				{
					connection.ConnectionString = connectionString;
				}
				return connection;
			}
			return ReflectConnectionHelper.GetConnection(connectors[foundConnectorIndex].AssemblyName, connectors[foundConnectorIndex].ConnectionTypeName, connectionString);
		}

		public override string GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(DBTable table, DBColumn column, bool forTableCreate)
		{
			//IL_00e8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ee: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00f1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f8: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			string sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(table, column);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes))
			{
				return sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes;
			}
			sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnType(table, column);
			sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = ((!column.IsKey && column.IsNullable) ? (sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes + " NULL") : (sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes + " NOT NULL"));
			if (!column.IsIdentity)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(column.DbDefaultValue))
				{
					sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes + " DEFAULT " + column.DbDefaultValue;
				}
				else if (column.DefaultValue != null && column.DefaultValue != DBNull.Value)
				{
					try
					{
						string text = FormatConstant(column.DefaultValue);
						sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes + " DEFAULT " + text;

				sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes += " AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY";

		private void ReadDbVersion(IDbConnection conn)
		{
			if (miServerVersion == null)
			{

				{

				}
			}
			if (miServerVersion != null)
			{
				string serverVersionInternal = (string)miServerVersion.Invoke(conn, new object[0]);
				SetServerVersionInternal(serverVersionInternal);
			}

				versionMajor = 5.0m;
				versionMinor = 0;
			}
		}

		private bool SetServerVersionInternal(string versionString)
		{
			string[] array = versionString.Split('.');
			if (array.Length >= 3 && decimal.TryParse(array[0] + "." + array[1], NumberStyles.AllowDecimalPoint, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
			{
				versionMajor = result;
				string text = array[2];
				int num = text.IndexOf('-');
				if (num != -1)
				{
					text = text.Substring(0, num);
				}
				int.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out versionMinor);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool SupportVersion(decimal major, int minor)
		{
			if (!versionMajor.HasValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (versionMajor.Value > major)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (versionMajor.Value == major && versionMinor >= minor)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private DBColumnType GetTypeFromString(string typeName, out int size)
		{
			size = 0;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(typeName))
			{
				return (DBColumnType)0;
			}
			switch (typeName)
			{
			case "char(1)":
				return (DBColumnType)4;
			case "bit(1)":
			case "tinyint(1)":
				return (DBColumnType)1;
			default:
			{
				string text = RemoveBrackets(typeName);
				switch (text.ToLowerInvariant())
				{
				case "int":
					return (DBColumnType)8;
				case "int unsigned":
					return (DBColumnType)9;
				case "longblob":
				case "tinyblob":
				case "mediumblob":
				case "blob":
					return (DBColumnType)18;
				case "text":
				case "mediumtext":
				case "longtext":
					return (DBColumnType)14;
				case "bit":
				case "tinyint unsigned":
					return (DBColumnType)2;
				case "tinyint":
					return (DBColumnType)3;
				case "smallint":
					return (DBColumnType)10;
				case "smallint unsigned":
					return (DBColumnType)11;
				case "bigint":
					return (DBColumnType)12;
				case "bigint unsigned":
					return (DBColumnType)13;
				case "double":
					return (DBColumnType)6;
				case "float":
					return (DBColumnType)7;
				case "datetime":
				case "date":
					return (DBColumnType)15;
				case "decimal":
					return (DBColumnType)5;
				default:
					if (typeName.StartsWith("char("))
					{
						size = int.Parse(typeName.Substring(5, typeName.Length - 6));
						return (DBColumnType)14;
					}
					if (typeName.StartsWith("varchar("))
					{
						size = int.Parse(typeName.Substring(8, typeName.Length - 9));
						return (DBColumnType)14;
					}
					return (DBColumnType)0;
				}
			}
			}
		}

		private static string RemoveBrackets(string typeName)
		{
			string result = typeName;
			int num = typeName.IndexOf('(');
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				int num2 = typeName.IndexOf(')', num);
				if (num2 >= 0)
				{
					result = typeName.Remove(num, num2 - num + 1);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override string FormatSelect(string selectedPropertiesSql, string fromSql, string whereSql, string orderBySql, string groupBySql, string havingSql, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords)
		{
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatSelect(selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, whereSql, orderBySql, groupBySql, havingSql, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords);
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (skipSelectedRecords == 0)
			{
				empty = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, (topSelectedRecords != 0) ? "limit {0} " : string.Empty, new object[1] { topSelectedRecords });
			}
			else
			{
				int num = ((topSelectedRecords == 0) ? int.MaxValue : topSelectedRecords);
				empty = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "limit {0}, {1} ", new object[2] { skipSelectedRecords, num });
			}
			string text = ((whereSql != null) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}where {1}", new object[2]
			{
				Environment.NewLine,
				whereSql
			}) : string.Empty);
			string text2 = ((orderBySql != null) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}order by {1}", new object[2]
			{
				Environment.NewLine,
				orderBySql
			}) : string.Empty);
			string text3 = ((havingSql != null) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}having {1}", new object[2]
			{
				Environment.NewLine,
				havingSql
			}) : string.Empty);
			string text4 = ((groupBySql != null) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}group by {1}", new object[2]
			{
				Environment.NewLine,
				groupBySql
			}) : string.Empty);
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "select {1} from {2}{3}{4}{5}{6} {0}", empty, selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, text, text4, text3, text2);
		}

		public override string FormatFunction(ProcessParameter processParameter, FunctionOperatorType operatorType, params object[] operands)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0108: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0081: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00c7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d1: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if ((int)operatorType == 46)
			{
				object obj = operands[1];
				if (obj is OperandValue && ((OperandValue)obj).Value is string)
				{
					string text = (string)((OperandValue)obj).Value;
					int num = text.IndexOfAny(achtungChars);
					if (num < 0)
					{
						return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "({0} likE {1})", new object[2]
						{
							processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
							processParameter.Invoke((object)new ConstantValue((object)(text + "%")))
						});
					}
					if (num > 0)
					{
						return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(({0} likE {2}) And (LefT({0}, Length({1})) = ({1})))", new object[3]
						{
							processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
							processParameter.Invoke(obj),
							processParameter.Invoke((object)new ConstantValue((object)(text.Substring(0, num) + "%")))
						});
					}
				}
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(LefT({0}, Length({1})) = ({1}))", new object[2]
				{
					processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
					processParameter.Invoke(operands[1])
				});
			}
			return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatFunction(processParameter, operatorType, operands);
		}

		protected string FormatConstant(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return "NULL";
			}
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
			{
			case TypeCode.Empty:
			case TypeCode.DBNull:
				return "NULL";
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return "0";
				}
				return "1";
			case TypeCode.Char:
				if (value is char && Convert.ToInt32(value) < 32)
				{
					if (escapeChars.ContainsKey((char)value))
					{
						return FormatString(value);
					}
					ArgumentException ex2 = new ArgumentException();
					ex2.Data["Value"] = "\\x" + Convert.ToInt32(value).ToString("X2");
					throw ex2;
				}
				return "'" + (char)value + "'";
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
				string text = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff";
				return "'" + dateTime.ToString(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "'";
			}
			case TypeCode.String:
				return FormatString(value);
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return FixNonFixedText(((decimal)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return FixNonFixedText(((double)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return FixNonFixedText(((float)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.SByte:
			case TypeCode.Byte:
			case TypeCode.Int16:
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return Convert.ToInt64(value).ToString();
				}
				return value.ToString();
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return Convert.ToUInt64(value).ToString();
				}
				return value.ToString();
			default:
			{
				if (value is Guid)
				{
					return "'" + ((Guid)value/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString() + "'";
				}
				if (value is TimeSpan)
				{
					return FixNonFixedText(((TimeSpan)value).TotalSeconds.ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				ArgumentException ex = new ArgumentException();
				ex.Data["Value"] = value.ToString();
				throw ex;
			}
			}
		}

		private string FixNonFixedText(string toFix)
		{
			if (toFix.IndexOfAny(new char[3] { '.', 'e', 'E' }) < 0)
			{
				toFix += ".0";
			}
			return toFix;
		}

		public override string FormatBinary(BinaryOperatorType operatorType, string leftOperand, string rightOperand)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)operatorType == 11)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} % {1}", new object[2] { leftOperand, rightOperand });
			}
			return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatBinary(operatorType, leftOperand, rightOperand);
		}

		protected override object ReformatReadValue(object value, ReformatReadValueArgs args)
		{
			if (value != null && args.DbTypeCode == TypeCode.Object && args.TargetTypeCode == TypeCode.DateTime && args.DbType == typeof(byte[]) && DateTime.TryParse(Encoding.ASCII.GetString((byte[])value), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out var result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ReformatReadValue(value, args);
		}

		protected override object ConvertToDbParameter(object clientValue, TypeCode clientValueTypeCode)
		{
			if (clientValueTypeCode == TypeCode.Object && clientValue is Guid)
			{
				return clientValue.ToString();
			}
			return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ConvertToDbParameter(clientValue, clientValueTypeCode);
		}

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			object value = parameter.Value;
			createParameter = false;
			if (parameter is ConstantValue && value != null)
			{
				switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
				{
				case TypeCode.Int32:
					return ((int)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Boolean:
					if (!(bool)value)
					{
						return "0";
					}
					return "1";
				case TypeCode.String:
					return FormatString(value);
				}
			}
			createParameter = true;
			return "?p" + index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected string FormatString(object value)
		{
			string text = value.ToString();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("'");
			string text2 = text;
			foreach (char c in text2)
			{
				if (escapeChars.TryGetValue(c, out var value2))
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(value2);
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("'");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override string FormatConstraint(string constraintName)
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "`{0}`", new object[1] { constraintName });
		}

		private void ClearDatabase(IDbCommand command)
		{
			command.CommandText = "SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS = 0";
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
			string[] storageTablesList = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetStorageTablesList(false);
			string[] array = storageTablesList;
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				command.CommandText = "drop table `" + text + "`";
				command.ExecuteNonQuery();
			}
			command.CommandText = "SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS = 1";
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}

		protected override void ProcessClearDatabase()
		{
			IDbCommand command = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CreateCommand();
			ClearDatabase(command);
		}

		public override string[] GetStorageTablesList(bool includeViews)
		{
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SelectStatementResult val = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).SelectData(new Query(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, SupportVersion(5m, 0) ? ("select TABLE_NAME from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES where table_schema = '{0}' and (TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' " + (includeViews ? " or TABLE_TYPE='VIEW')" : ")")) : "show tables from {0}", new object[1] { ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.Database })));
			string[] array = new string[val.Rows.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < val.Rows.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = (string)val.Rows[i].Values[0];
			}
			return array;
		}

		private void DeriveParametersCore(IDbCommand sourceCommand)
		{
			using IDbCommand dbCommand = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.CreateCommand();
			string text = sourceCommand.CommandText;
			if (StringExtensions.StartsWithInvariantCulture(text, "`") && StringExtensions.EndsWithInvariantCulture(text, "`"))
			{
				text = text.Substring(1, text.Length - 2);
			}
			dbCommand.CommandText = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "SELECT ORDINAL_POSITION, PARAMETER_MODE, PARAMETER_NAME, DATA_TYPE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, CHARACTER_OCTET_LENGTH, NUMERIC_PRECISION, NUMERIC_SCALE, DTD_IDENTIFIER FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.Parameters WHERE SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = database() AND SPECIFIC_NAME = '{0}' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION;", new object[1] { text });
			using IDataReader dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
			while (dataReader.Read())
			{
				object[] array = new object[dataReader.FieldCount];
				dataReader.GetValues(array);
				IDbDataParameter dbDataParameter = sourceCommand.CreateParameter();
				dbDataParameter.Direction = ParseDirection(ConvertDBNull(array[1], (object v) => (string)v));
				dbDataParameter.ParameterName = ConvertDBNull(array[2], (object v) => "@" + (string)v);
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterTypeAndSize(dbDataParameter, (string)array[8]);
				sourceCommand.Parameters.Add(dbDataParameter);
			}
		}

		private T ConvertDBNull<T>(object v, Func<object, T> converter)
		{
			if (v != DBNull.Value)
			{
				return converter(v);
			}
			return default(T);
		}

		private ParameterDirection ParseDirection(string v)
		{
			if (v == null)
			{
				return ParameterDirection.ReturnValue;
			}
			return v.ToUpperInvariant() switch
			{
				"IN" => ParameterDirection.Input, 
				"OUT" => ParameterDirection.Output, 
				"INOUT" => ParameterDirection.InputOutput, 
				_ => throw new NotSupportedException(), 
			};
		}
	}

		public override void CreateTable(DBTable table)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			foreach (DBColumn column in table.Columns)
			{
				if (text.Length > 0)
				{
					text += ", ";
				}
				text = text + ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatColumnSafe(column.Name) + " " + ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(table, column);
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Transaction != null)
			{
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CommitTransaction();
				flag = true;
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ExecuteSqlSchemaUpdate("Table", table.Name, string.Empty, string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "create table {0} ({1})", new object[2]
			{
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatTableSafe(table),
				text
			}));
			if (flag)
			{
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).BeginTransaction();
			}
		}

		private DBColumnType GetTypeFromString(string typeName, int size, int? precision, int scale, string charLength, out string fullTypeName)
		{
			fullTypeName = typeName;
			switch (typeName.ToLower())
			{
			case "int":
				return (DBColumnType)8;
			case "blob":
				return (DBColumnType)18;
			case "raw":
				fullTypeName = typeName + "(" + size.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
				return (DBColumnType)18;
			case "number":
				if (precision.HasValue)
				{
					fullTypeName = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}({1},{2})", new object[3] { typeName, precision, scale });
				}
				if (precision != 0 && scale == 0)
				{
					if (precision != 1)
					{
						if (!(precision <= 3))
						{
							if (!(precision <= 5))
							{
								if (precision.HasValue && !(precision <= 10))
								{
									if (!(precision <= 20))
									{
										return (DBColumnType)5;
									}
									return (DBColumnType)12;
								}
								return (DBColumnType)8;
							}
							return (DBColumnType)10;
						}
						return (DBColumnType)2;
					}
					return (DBColumnType)1;
				}
				return (DBColumnType)5;
			case "nchar":
			case "char":
				if (size > 1)
				{
					fullTypeName = typeName + "(" + size.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
					return (DBColumnType)14;
				}
				return (DBColumnType)4;
			case "money":
				return (DBColumnType)5;
			case "float":
				if (precision.HasValue && precision != 126)
				{
					fullTypeName = typeName + "(" + precision.Value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
				}
				return (DBColumnType)6;
			case "varchar":
			case "varchar2":
				fullTypeName = typeName + "(" + charLength.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			case "nvarchar":
			case "nvarchar2":
				fullTypeName = typeName + "(" + size.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			case "date":
				return (DBColumnType)15;
			case "clob":
			case "nclob":
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			default:
				return (DBColumnType)0;
			}
		}

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			object value = parameter.Value;
			createParameter = false;
			if (parameter is ConstantValue && value != null)
			{
				switch (Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
				{
				case TypeCode.Int32:
					return ((int)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Boolean:
					if (!(bool)value)
					{
						return "0";
					}
					return "1";
				case TypeCode.String:
					return "N'" + ((string)value).Replace("'", "''") + "'";
				}
			}
			createParameter = true;
			return ":p" + index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		private string GetSchemaName(string table)
		{
			int num = table.IndexOf('.');
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return table.Substring(0, num);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private string GetTableName(string table)
		{
			int num = table.IndexOf('.');
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return table.Remove(0, num + 1);
			}
			return table;
		}

		public override string GenerateStoredProcedures(DBTable table, out string dropLines)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			GenerateView(table, stringBuilder, list);
			GenerateInsertSP(table, stringBuilder, list);
			GenerateUpdateSP(table, stringBuilder, list);
			GenerateDeleteSP(table, stringBuilder, list);
			GenerateInsteadOfInsertTrigger(table, stringBuilder, list);
			GenerateInsteadOfUpdateTrigger(table, stringBuilder, list);
			GenerateInsteadOfDeleteTrigger(table, stringBuilder, list);
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = new StringBuilder();
				for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					stringBuilder2.AppendLine(list[num]);
					stringBuilder2.AppendLine("/");
				}
				dropLines = stringBuilder2.ToString();
			}
			else
			{
				dropLines = string.Empty;
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private void GenerateView(DBTable table, StringBuilder result, List<string> dropList)
		{
			string arg = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeTableName($"{table.Name}_xpoView");
			result.AppendLine($"CREATE VIEW \"{arg}\"(");
			dropList.Add($"DROP VIEW \"{arg}\";");
			for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					result.AppendLine(",");
				}
				result.Append($"\t\"{table.Columns[i].Name}\"");
			}
			result.AppendLine();
			result.AppendLine(")");
			result.AppendLine("AS");
			result.AppendLine("\tSELECT");
			for (int j = 0; j < table.Columns.Count; j++)
			{
				if (j != 0)
				{
					result.AppendLine(",");
				}
				result.Append($"\t\t\"{table.Columns[j].Name}\"");
			}
			result.AppendLine();
			result.AppendLine($"\tFROM \"{table.Name}\";");
			result.AppendLine("/");
			arg = GetSeqViewName(table.Name);
			result.AppendLine($"CREATE SYNONYM {arg}");
			dropList.Add($"DROP SYNONYM {arg};");
			result.AppendLine($"\tFOR {GetSeqName(table.Name)}");
			result.AppendLine("/");
		}

		private void GenerateInsertSP(DBTable table, StringBuilder result, List<string> dropList)
		{
			string arg = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeTableName($"sp_{table.Name}_xpoView_insert");
			result.AppendLine($"CREATE PROCEDURE \"{arg}\"(");
			dropList.Add($"DROP PROCEDURE \"{arg}\";");
			for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					result.AppendLine(",");
				}

		private static string GetRawType(string type)
		{

			return type.Substring(0, num);
		}

		private void AppendKeys(DBTable table, StringBuilder result)
		{

			}
		}

		private void AppendWhere(DBTable table, StringBuilder result)

			}
			result.AppendLine();
			result.AppendLine("\t;");
		}

		private class ReflectionGetValuesHelper<R, N, B> : ReflectionGetValuesHelperBase where R : IDataReader, IDataRecord

			private static readonly OracleNumberComparisonDelegate oDEquals;

			private static readonly OracleNumberOperationWithInt oDTruncate;

			private static readonly OracleNumberOperationWithInt oDRound;

			private static readonly OracleNumberOperation oDLog;

			private static readonly OracleNumberOperation oDAbs;

			private static readonly OracleBooleanToBoolean oBToBoolean;

				oracleNumberMagicMantissaMax = (N)Activator.CreateInstance(typeFromHandle, decimal.MaxValue / (decimal)Math.Pow(10.0, 28.0));
				oracleNumberZero = (N)Activator.CreateInstance(typeFromHandle, 0m);
				oracleNumberTen = (N)Activator.CreateInstance(typeFromHandle, 10);

				foreach (MethodInfo methodInfo in methods)

			public override bool GetValues(IDataReader reader, Type[] fieldTypes, object[] values)
			{
				if (fieldTypes == null || !(reader is R dataReader))
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int num = fieldTypes.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (dataReader.IsDBNull(num))
					{
						values[num] = DBNull.Value;
					}
					else if (fieldTypes[num].Equals(typeof(decimal)))
					{
						values[num] = GetDecimal(dataReader, num);
					}
					else
					{
						values[num] = dataReader.GetValue(num);
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			private object GetDecimal(R dataReader, int i)
			{
				N val = getOracleNumber(dataReader, i);
				if (val.Equals(oracleNumberZero))
				{
					return 0m;
				}
				int num = (int)oDToDecimal(oDTruncate(oDLog(oDAbs(val)), 0));
				N right = oDPow(oracleNumberTen, num);
				if (oBToBoolean(oDGreaterThan(val, oracleNumberMax)) || oBToBoolean(oDGreaterThan(oracleNumberMin, val)))
				{
					N od = oDRound(oDDivide(val, right), 14);
					return (double)oDToDecimal(od) * Math.Pow(10.0, num);
				}
				N od2 = oDDivide(val, right);
				od2 = oDTruncate(od2, oBToBoolean(oDGreaterThan(oDAbs(od2), oracleNumberMagicMantissaMax)) ? 26 : 27);
				return oDToDecimal(od2) * (decimal)Math.Pow(10.0, num);
			}

			{

			}
			if (column.IsKey && column.IsIdentity && ((int)column.ColumnType == 8 || (int)column.ColumnType == 12) && ConnectionProviderSql.IsSingleColumnPKColumn(table, column))

		private string GetDBColumnTypeNameByDBInfo(byte dataType, ushort size, byte dec, ColumnTypeFlags flags)
		{
			int? num = null;
			byte? b = null;
			string text = string.Empty;
			switch (dataType)
			{
			case 0:
				num = size;
				text = (((flags & ColumnTypeFlags.Binary) != ColumnTypeFlags.Binary) ? "CHAR" : "BINARY");
				break;
			case 1:
				switch (size)
				{
				case 1:
					text = "TINYINT";
					break;
				case 2:
					text = "SMALLINT";
					break;
				case 4:
					text = "INTEGER";
					break;
				case 8:
					text = "BIGINT";
					break;
				}
				break;
			case 2:
				switch (size)
				{
				case 4:
					text = "REAL";
					break;
				case 8:
					text = "DOUBLE";
					break;
				}
				break;
			case 3:
				text = "DATE";
				break;
			case 4:
				text = "TIME";
				break;
			case 5:
				num = (((flags & ColumnTypeFlags.DecimalEvenPrecision) == ColumnTypeFlags.DecimalEvenPrecision) ? ((size - 1) * 2) : (size * 2 - 1));
				b = dec;
				text = "DECIMAL";
				break;
			case 8:
				num = size;
				b = dec;
				text = "NUMERIC";
				break;
			case 11:
				num = size - 1;
				text = "VARCHAR";
				break;
			case 12:
				num = -1;
				text = "NOTE";
				break;
			case 14:
				switch (size)
				{
				case 1:
					text = "UTINYINT";
					break;
				case 2:
					text = "USMALLINT";
					break;
				case 4:
					text = "UINTEGER";

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			createParameter = false;
			if (parameter.Value == null || parameter.Value == DBNull.Value)
			{
				return FormatConstant(null);
			}
			object value = parameter.Value;
			TypeCode typeCode = Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType());
			switch (typeCode)
			{
			case TypeCode.Byte:
				return ((byte)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
				return ((ushort)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
				return ((uint)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				return ((ulong)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			case TypeCode.Int16:
				return ((short)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			case TypeCode.Int32:
				return ((int)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				return ((long)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			case TypeCode.SByte:
				return ((sbyte)parameter.Value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			default:
				if (parameter is ConstantValue)
				{
					switch (typeCode)
					{
					case TypeCode.Boolean:
						if (!(bool)value)
						{
							return "0";
						}
						return "1";
					case TypeCode.String:
						return FormatString(value);
					}
				}
				createParameter = true;
				return "?";
			}
		}

		protected string FormatString(object value)
		{
			return "'" + ((string)value).Replace("'", "''") + "'";
		}

		public override void CreateForeignKey(DBTable table, DBForeignKey fk)
		{
			if (!(fk.PrimaryKeyTable == table.Name))
			{
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CreateForeignKey(table, fk);
			}
		}

		protected override IDataParameter CreateParameter(IDbCommand command, object value, string name, DBColumnType dbType, string dbTypeName, int size)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0031: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0096: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0098: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IDbDataParameter dbDataParameter = (IDbDataParameter)((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CreateParameter(command);
			dbDataParameter.Value = value;
			dbDataParameter.ParameterName = name;
			QueryParameterMode queryParameterMode = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetQueryParameterMode();
			if ((int)queryParameterMode != 1)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbTypeName))
				{
					if ((int)queryParameterMode == 3)
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterTypeAndSize(dbDataParameter, dbTypeName);
					}
					else
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterType(dbDataParameter, dbTypeName);
					}
				}
				else if ((int)queryParameterMode == 3)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterTypeAndSize(dbDataParameter, dbType, size);
				}
				else
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterType(dbDataParameter, dbType);
				}
			}
			if (value is byte[])
			{
				dbDataParameter.DbType = DbType.Binary;
			}
			if (value is string)
			{
				dbDataParameter.DbType = DbType.String;
			}
			if ((int)queryParameterMode == 3)
			{
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ValidateParameterSize(command, dbDataParameter);
			}
			return dbDataParameter;
		}

		public override string FormatConstraint(string constraintName)
		{
