		protected string FormatConstant(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return "NULL";
			}
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
			{
			case TypeCode.Empty:
			case TypeCode.DBNull:
				return "NULL";
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return "0";
				}
				return "1";
			case TypeCode.Char:
				if (value is char && Convert.ToInt32(value) == 0)
				{
					ArgumentException ex = new ArgumentException();
					ex.Data["Value"] = "\\x" + Convert.ToInt32(value).ToString("X2");
					throw ex;
				}
				return "'" + (char)value + "'";
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
				return "'" + ((DateTime)value).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "'";
			case TypeCode.String:
				return FormatString(value);
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return FixNonFixedText(((decimal)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return FixNonFixedText(((double)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return FixNonFixedText(((float)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.SByte:
			case TypeCode.Byte:
			case TypeCode.Int16:
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return Convert.ToInt64(value).ToString();
				}
				return value.ToString();
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return Convert.ToUInt64(value).ToString();
				}
				return value.ToString();
			default:
				if (value is Guid)
				{
					return "'" + ((Guid)value/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString() + "'";
				}
				if (value is TimeSpan)
				{
					return FixNonFixedText(((TimeSpan)value).TotalSeconds.ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(value.ToString());
			}
		}

		private string FixNonFixedText(string toFix)
		{
			if (toFix.IndexOfAny(new char[3] { '.', 'e', 'E' }) < 0)
			{
				toFix += ".0";
			}
			return toFix;
		}

		private void ReadDbVersion(IDbConnection conn)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Expected O, but got Unknown
			try
			{
				using IDbCommand dbCommand = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CreateCommand(new Query("SHOW server_version"));
				object obj = dbCommand.ExecuteScalar();
				if (obj != null && obj is string)
				{
					SetServerVersionInternal((string)obj);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private bool SetServerVersionInternal(string versionString)
		{
			int num = versionString.IndexOf(' ');
			if (num > 0)
			{
				versionString = versionString.Substring(0, num);
			}
			string[] array = versionString.Split('.');
			decimal result = default(decimal);
			int result2 = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			if (array.Length == 3)
			{
				string s = array[0] + "." + array[1];
				flag = decimal.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.AllowDecimalPoint, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out result) && int.TryParse(array[2], out result2);
			}
			else if (array.Length == 2)
			{
				flag = decimal.TryParse(array[0], out result) && int.TryParse(array[1], out result2);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				versionMajor = result;
				versionMinor = result2;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool SupportNpgsqlVersion(int major, int minor, int build)
		{
			if (npgSqlVersion == null)
			{
				npgSqlVersion = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.GetType().Assembly.GetName().Version;
			}
			if (npgSqlVersion.Major == major)
			{
				if (npgSqlVersion.Minor == minor)
				{
					return npgSqlVersion.Build >= build;
				}
				return npgSqlVersion.Minor >= minor;
			}
			return npgSqlVersion.Major > major;
		}

		private bool SupportVersion(decimal major, int minor)
		{
			if (!versionMajor.HasValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (versionMajor.Value > major)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (versionMajor.Value == major && versionMinor >= minor)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void SetServerVersion(string versionString)
		{
			if (!SetServerVersionInternal(versionString))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("versionString");
			}
		}

		protected override object ConvertToDbParameter(object clientValue, TypeCode clientValueTypeCode)
		{
			switch (clientValueTypeCode)
			{
			case TypeCode.Object:
				if (clientValue is Guid && IsLegacyGuidSupport)
				{
					if (SupportNpgsqlVersion(3, 0, 0))
					{
						return clientValue.ToString().ToCharArray();
					}
					return clientValue.ToString();
				}
				break;
			case TypeCode.Byte:
				return (short)(byte)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.SByte:
				return (short)(sbyte)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
				return (int)(ushort)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
				return (long)(uint)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				return (decimal)(ulong)clientValue;
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
				return DateTime.SpecifyKind((DateTime)clientValue, DateTimeKind.Local);
			}
			return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ConvertToDbParameter(clientValue, clientValueTypeCode);
		}

				return FnRpad(operands);
			case 0:
				switch (operands.Length)
				{
				case 1:
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(({0}) is null)", new object[1] { operands[0] });
				case 2:
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "COALESCE({0}, {1})", new object[2]
					{
						operands[0],
						operands[1]
					});
				}
				break;
			case 1:
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(({0}) is null or length({0}) = 0)", new object[1] { operands[0] });
			case 43:
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(SubsTr({0}, Length({0}) - Length({1}) + 1) = ({1}))", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			case 44:
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(StrpOS({0}, {1}) > 0)", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			case 2:
			case 5:
			case 6:
			case 7:
			case 8:
			case 11:
			case 12:
			case 16:
			case 18:
			case 19:
			case 21:
			case 24:
			case 25:
			case 26:
			case 28:
			case 29:
			case 42:
				break;
			}
			return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatFunction(operatorType, operands);
		}

		public override string FormatFunction(ProcessParameter processParameter, FunctionOperatorType operatorType, params object[] operands)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0108: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0081: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00c7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d1: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if ((int)operatorType == 46)
			{
				object obj = operands[1];
				if (obj is OperandValue && ((OperandValue)obj).Value is string)
				{
					string text = (string)((OperandValue)obj).Value;
					int num = text.IndexOfAny(achtungChars);
					if (num < 0)
					{
						return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "({0} likE {1})", new object[2]
						{
							processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
							processParameter.Invoke((object)new ConstantValue((object)(text + "%")))
						});
					}
					if (num > 0)
					{
						return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(({0} likE {2}) And (SubstR({0}, 1, Length({1})) = ({1})))", new object[3]
						{
							processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
							processParameter.Invoke(obj),
							processParameter.Invoke((object)new ConstantValue((object)(text.Substring(0, num) + "%")))
						});
					}
				}
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(SubstR({0}, 1, Length({1})) = ({1}))", new object[2]
				{
					processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
					processParameter.Invoke(operands[1])
				});
			}
			return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatFunction(processParameter, operatorType, operands);
		}

		private string FnLpad(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "case when length({0}) > {1} then {0} else lpad({0}, {1}, ' ') end", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			}
			if (operands.Length == 3)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "case when length({0}) > {1} then {0} else lpad({0}, {1}, {2}) end", new object[3]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1],
					operands[2]
				});
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnRpad(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "case when length({0}) > {1} then {0} else rpad({0}, {1}, ' ') end", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			}
			if (operands.Length == 3)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "case when length({0}) > {1} then {0} else rpad({0}, {1}, {2}) end", new object[3]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1],
					operands[2]
				});
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnRemove(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 3)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(substr({0}, 0, {1} + 1) || substr({0}, {1} + {2} + 1))", new object[3]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1],
					operands[2]
				});
			}
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "substr({0}, 0, {1} + 1)", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnLog(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 1)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "ln({0})", new object[1] { operands[0] });
			}
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(ln({0}) / ln({1}))", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		private string FnCharIndex(string[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 2)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(position({0} in {1}) - 1)", new object[2]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1]
				});
			}
			if (operands.Length == 3)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(case position({0} in substring({1}, {2} + 1)) > 0 when true then position({0} in substring({1}, {2} + 1)) + {2} - 1 else -1 end)", new object[3]
				{
					operands[0],
					operands[1],
					operands[2]
				});
			}
			if (operands.Length == 4)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(case position({0} in substring({1}, {2} + 1, {3})) > 0 when true then position({0} in substring({1}, {2} + 1, {3})) + {2} - 1 else -1 end)", operands[0], operands[1], operands[2], operands[3]);
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			object value = parameter.Value;
			createParameter = false;
			if (parameter is ConstantValue && value != null)
			{
				switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
				{
				case TypeCode.Int32:
					return ((int)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Boolean:
					if (!(bool)value)
					{
						return "false";
					}
					return "true";
				case TypeCode.String:
					return FormatString(value);
				}
			}
			createParameter = true;
			return "@p" + index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected string FormatString(object value)
		{
			return (SupportVersion(8.1m, 0) ? "E'" : "'") + ((string)value).Replace("'", "''").Replace("\\", "\\\\") + "'";
		}

		public override string FormatConstraint(string constraintName)
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "\"{0}\"", new object[1] { ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeConstraintName(constraintName) });
		}

		public override string FormatOrder(string sortProperty, SortingDirection direction)
		{
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (SupportVersion(8.3m, 0))
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} {1}", new object[2]
				{
					sortProperty,
					((int)direction == 0) ? "asc nulls first" : "desc nulls last"
				});
			}
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} {1}", new object[2]
			{
				sortProperty,
				((int)direction == 0) ? "asc" : "desc"
			});
		}

		protected string FormatConstant(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return "NULL";
			}
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
			{
			case TypeCode.Empty:
			case TypeCode.DBNull:
				return "NULL";
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return "false";
				}
				return "true";
			case TypeCode.Char:
				if (value is char && Convert.ToInt32(value) == 0)
				{
					ArgumentException ex2 = new ArgumentException();
					ex2.Data["Value"] = "\\x" + Convert.ToInt32(value).ToString("X2");
					throw ex2;
				}
				if (value is char && Convert.ToInt32(value) < 32)
				{
					return $"chr({Convert.ToByte(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)})";
				}
				return "'" + (char)value + "'";
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
				string text = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss";
				return $"cast('{dateTime.ToString(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}' as timestamp)";
			}
			case TypeCode.String:
				return FormatString(value);
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return FixNonFixedText(((decimal)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return FixNonFixedText(((double)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return FixNonFixedText(((float)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.SByte:
			case TypeCode.Byte:
			case TypeCode.Int16:
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return Convert.ToInt64(value).ToString();
				}
				return value.ToString();
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return Convert.ToUInt64(value).ToString();
				}
				return value.ToString();
			default:
			{
				if (value is Guid)
				{
					return "'" + ((Guid)value/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString() + "'";
				}
				if (value is TimeSpan)
				{
					return FixNonFixedText(((TimeSpan)value).TotalSeconds.ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				ArgumentException ex = new ArgumentException();
				ex.Data["Value"] = value.ToString();
				throw ex;
			}
			}
		}

		private string FixNonFixedText(string toFix)
		{
			if (toFix.IndexOfAny(new char[3] { '.', 'e', 'E' }) < 0)
			{
				toFix += ".0";
			}
			return toFix;
		}

		public override string FormatOuterApply(string sql, string alias)
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "cross join lateral ({0}) {1}", new object[2] { sql, alias });
		}

			{

				string text5 = ((string)val5.Values[1]).Trim();
				command.CommandText = $"drop view {((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatTable(text5, text4)}";
				command.ExecuteNonQuery();
			}

			string[] array = storageTablesList;

		private string GetSchemaName(string table)
		{
			int num = table.IndexOf('.');
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return table.Substring(0, num);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private string GetTableName(string table)
		{
			int num = table.IndexOf('.');
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return table.Remove(0, num + 1);
			}
			return table;
		}

		protected override void ProcessClearDatabase()
		{
			IDbCommand command = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CreateCommand();
			ClearDatabase(command);
		}

		private void GenerateView(DBTable table, StringBuilder result)
		{
			string arg = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeTableName($"{table.Name}_xpoView");
			result.AppendLine($"CREATE VIEW \"{arg}\"(");
			for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					result.AppendLine(",");
				}
				result.Append($"\t\"{table.Columns[i].Name}\"");
			}
			result.AppendLine();
			result.AppendLine(")");
			result.AppendLine("AS");
			result.AppendLine("\tSELECT");
			for (int j = 0; j < table.Columns.Count; j++)
			{
				if (j != 0)
				{
					result.AppendLine(",");
				}
				result.Append($"\t\t\"{table.Columns[j].Name}\"");
			}
			result.AppendLine();
			result.AppendLine($"\tFROM \"{table.Name}\";");
		}

		private void GenerateInsertSP(DBTable table, StringBuilder result)
		{
			string arg = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeTableName($"sp_{table.Name}_xpoView_insert");
			result.AppendLine($"CREATE FUNCTION \"{arg}\"(");
			for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					result.AppendLine(",");
				}
				string rawType = GetRawType(((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnType(table, table.Columns[i]));
				result.Append($"\t{table.Columns[i].Name}_ {rawType}");
			}
			result.AppendLine();
			result.AppendLine(")");
			result.AppendLine("RETURNS VOID");
			result.AppendLine("AS $$");
			result.AppendLine($"\tINSERT INTO \"{table.Name}\"(");
			for (int j = 0; j < table.Columns.Count; j++)
			{
				if (j != 0)
				{
					result.AppendLine(",");
				}
				result.Append($"\t\t\"{table.Columns[j].Name}\"");
			}
			result.AppendLine();
			result.AppendLine("\t)");
			result.AppendLine("\tVALUES(");
			for (int k = 0; k < table.Columns.Count; k++)
			{
				if (k != 0)
				{
					result.AppendLine(",");
				}
				result.Append($"\t\t${(k + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}");
			}
			result.AppendLine();
			result.AppendLine("\t);");
			result.AppendLine("$$ LANGUAGE SQL;");
		}

		private void GenerateUpdateSP(DBTable table, StringBuilder result)
		{
			string arg = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeTableName($"sp_{table.Name}_xpoView_update");
			result.AppendLine($"CREATE FUNCTION \"{arg}\"(");
			AppendKeys(table, result);
			for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!((ConnectionProviderSql)this).IsKey(table, table.Columns[i].Name))
				{
					if (i != 0 || ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns.Count > 0)
					{
						result.AppendLine(",");
					}
					string rawType = GetRawType(((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnType(table, table.Columns[i]));
					result.AppendLine($"\told_{table.Columns[i].Name} {rawType},");
					result.Append($"\t{table.Columns[i].Name}_ {rawType}");
				}
			}
			result.AppendLine();
			result.AppendLine(")");
			result.AppendLine("RETURNS VOID");
			result.AppendLine("AS $$");
			result.AppendLine($"\tUPDATE \"{table.Name}\" SET");
			bool flag = true;
			int num = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < table.Columns.Count; j++)
			{
				if (!((ConnectionProviderSql)this).IsKey(table, table.Columns[j].Name))
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					else
					{
						result.AppendLine(",");
					}
					result.Append($"\t\t\"{table.Columns[j].Name}\"=${num++ * 2 + ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns.Count + 2}");
				}
			}
			result.AppendLine();
			result.AppendLine("\tWHERE");
			AppendWhere(table, result);
			result.AppendLine("$$ LANGUAGE SQL;");
		}

			}

			{
				if (!((ConnectionProviderSql)this).IsKey(table, table.Columns[j].Name))
				{
					if (j != 0 || ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns.Count > 0)
					{
						result.AppendLine(",");
					}
					result.Append($"\t\told.\"{table.Columns[j].Name}\"");
				}
			}
			result.AppendLine();
			result.AppendLine("\t);");
		}

		private static string GetRawType(string type)
		{
			int num = type.IndexOf('(');
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return type;
			}
			return type.Substring(0, num);
		}

		private void AppendKeys(DBTable table, StringBuilder result)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					result.AppendLine(",");
				}
				DBColumn dbColumnByName = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetDbColumnByName(table, ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns[i]);
				string sqlCreateColumnType = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnType(table, dbColumnByName);
				result.Append($"\t{dbColumnByName.Name}_ {GetRawType(sqlCreateColumnType)}");
			}
		}

		private void AppendWhere(DBTable table, StringBuilder result)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					result.AppendLine(" AND");
				}
				result.Append($"\t\t\"{((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns[i]}\" = ${i + 1}");
			}
			result.AppendLine();
			result.AppendLine("\t;");
		}

			if (commandBuilderDeriveParametersHandler == null)
			{
				string text = "Npgsql";
				commandBuilderDeriveParametersHandler = ReflectConnectionHelper.GetCommandBuilderDeriveParametersDelegate(text, "Npgsql.NpgsqlCommandBuilder");
			}
			commandBuilderDeriveParametersHandler.Invoke((object)command);
		}

			return PostgreSqlConnectionProvider.GetConnectionString(parameters["server"], parameters["userid"], parameters["password"], parameters["database"]);
		}

		private bool TryParseDbDecimal(string decimalValueString, out decimal outValue)
		{

		}

		public override void CreateTable(DBTable table)
		{
			string text = "";
			foreach (DBColumn column in table.Columns)
			{

					text += ", ";
				}
				text = text + ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatColumnSafe(column.Name) + " " + ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(table, column, true);
			}
			if (table.PrimaryKey != null && !table.GetColumn(((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns[0]).IsIdentity)
			{
				StringCollection stringCollection = new StringCollection();
				for (int i = 0; i < ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns.Count; i++)
				{
					stringCollection.Add(((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatColumnSafe(((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns[i]));
				}
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ExecuteSqlSchemaUpdate("Table", table.Name, string.Empty, string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "create table {0} ({1}, primary key ({2}))", new object[3]
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatTableSafe(table),
					text,
					StringListHelper.DelimitedText(stringCollection, ",")

			}
			else
			{

		}

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			object value = parameter.Value;
			createParameter = false;
			if (parameter is ConstantValue && value != null)
			{
				switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
				{
				case TypeCode.Int32:
					return ((int)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Boolean:
					if (!(bool)value)
					{
						return "0";
					}
					return "1";
				case TypeCode.String:
					return FormatString(value);
				}
			}
			createParameter = true;
			return "@p" + index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected string FormatConstant(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return "NULL";
			}
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
			{
			case TypeCode.Empty:
			case TypeCode.DBNull:
				return "NULL";
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return "0";
				}
				return "1";
			case TypeCode.Char:
				if (value is char && Convert.ToInt32(value) < 32)
				{
					return $"char({Convert.ToByte(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)})";
				}
				return "'" + (char)value + "'";
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
				string text = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff";
				return "'" + dateTime.ToString(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "'";
			}
			case TypeCode.String:
				return FormatString(value);
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return FixNonFixedText(((decimal)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return FixNonFixedText(((double)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return FixNonFixedText(((float)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.SByte:
			case TypeCode.Byte:
			case TypeCode.Int16:
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return Convert.ToInt64(value).ToString();
				}
				return value.ToString();
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				if (value is Enum)
				{
					return Convert.ToUInt64(value).ToString();
				}
				return value.ToString();
			default:
			{
				if (value is Guid)
				{
					return "'" + ((Guid)value/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString() + "'";
				}
				if (value is TimeSpan)
				{
					return FixNonFixedText(((TimeSpan)value).TotalSeconds.ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				ArgumentException ex = new ArgumentException();
				ex.Data["Value"] = value.ToString();
				throw ex;
			}
			}
		}

		private string FixNonFixedText(string toFix)
		{
			if (toFix.IndexOfAny(new char[3] { '.', 'e', 'E' }) < 0)
			{
				toFix += ".0";
			}
			return toFix;
		}

			}
		}

		private XPVistaDBDatabase DataBase
		{
			get
			{
				if (fDataBase == null)
				{
					XPVistaDBDA engine = GetEngine(((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.GetType());
					string connectionOpenmode = engine.GetConnectionOpenmode(((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection);
					if (((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.State == ConnectionState.Open && connectionOpenmode == "ExclusiveReadWrite")
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.Close();
					}
					int num;
					switch (connectionOpenmode)
					{
					default:
						num = ((connectionOpenmode == "MultiProcessReadOnly") ? 1 : 0);
						break;
					case "SingleProcessReadWrite":
					case "SingleProcessReadOnly":
					case "MultiProcessReadWrite":
						num = 1;
						break;
					}
					bool flag = (byte)num != 0;
					fDataBase = engine.OpenDatabase(engine.GetConnectionSource(((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection), flag ? connectionOpenmode : "NonexclusiveReadWrite", (engine.GetConnectionPassword(((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection) == string.Empty) ? null : engine.GetConnectionPassword(((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection));
				}
				return fDataBase;
			}
		}

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			object value = parameter.Value;
			createParameter = false;
			if (parameter is ConstantValue && value != null)
			{
				switch (Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
				{
				case TypeCode.Int32:
					return ((int)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Boolean:
					if (!(bool)value)
					{
						return "0";
					}
					return "1";
				case TypeCode.String:
					return FormatString(value);
				}
			}
			createParameter = true;
			return "@p" + index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected virtual string FormatConstant(object value)
		{
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
			{
			case TypeCode.Empty:
			case TypeCode.DBNull:
				return "NULL";
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return "0";
				}
				return "1";
			case TypeCode.Char:
				return "'" + (char)value + "'";
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
				string text = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff";
				return $"convert(datetime, '{dateTime.ToString(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}', 121)";
			}
			case TypeCode.String:
				return FormatString(value);
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return FixNonFixedText(((decimal)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return FixNonFixedText(((double)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return FixNonFixedText(((float)value).ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			case TypeCode.SByte:
			case TypeCode.Byte:
			case TypeCode.Int16:
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				return Convert.ToInt64(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				return Convert.ToUInt64(value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			default:
				if (value is Guid)
				{
					return "Cast('" + ((Guid)value/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString() + "' as uniqueidentifier)";
				}
				if (value is TimeSpan)
				{
					return FixNonFixedText(((TimeSpan)value).TotalSeconds.ToString("r", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(value.ToString());
			}
		}

		private string FixNonFixedText(string toFix)
		{
			if (toFix.IndexOfAny(new char[3] { '.', 'e', 'E' }) < 0)
			{
				toFix += ".0";
			}
			return toFix;
		}

		protected override void ProcessClearDatabase()
		{
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.Close();
			string[] storageTablesList = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetStorageTablesList(false);
			string[] array = storageTablesList;
			foreach (string name in array)
			{
				XPVistaDBTableSchema xPVistaDBTableSchema = DataBase.TableSchema(name);
				XPVistaDBTable xPVistaDBTable = DataBase.OpenTable(name, exclusive: true, readOnly: false);
				List<XPVistaDBRelationshipInformation> foreignKeys = xPVistaDBTableSchema.GetForeignKeys();
				if (foreignKeys != null)
				{
					foreach (XPVistaDBRelationshipInformation item in foreignKeys)
					{
						xPVistaDBTable.DropForeignKey(item.Name);
					}
				}
				xPVistaDBTable.Close();
			}
			CloseDatabase();
			string[] array2 = storageTablesList;
			foreach (string name2 in array2)
			{
				DataBase.DropTable(name2);
			}
			if (((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.State == ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.Close();
			}
			CloseDatabase();
		}

			}

		}

		public override string FormatSelect(string selectedPropertiesSql, string fromSql, string whereSql, string orderBySql, string groupBySql, string havingSql, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords)
		{
			if (skipSelectedRecords != 0)
			{
				if (!((ConnectionProviderSql)this).NativeSkipTakeSupported)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException();
				}
				if (orderBySql == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Can not skip records without ORDER BY clause.");
				}
			}
			string text = ((whereSql == null) ? null : ("\nwhere " + whereSql));
			string text2 = ((orderBySql != null) ? ("\norder by " + orderBySql) : string.Empty);
			string text3 = ((havingSql != null) ? ("\nhaving " + havingSql) : string.Empty);
			string text4 = ((groupBySql != null) ? ("\ngroup by " + groupBySql) : string.Empty);
			if (skipSelectedRecords == 0)
			{
				string text5 = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "top {0} ", new object[1] { topSelectedRecords });
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "select {0}{1} from {2}{3}{4}{5}{6}", text5, selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, text, text4, text3, text2);
			}
			string text6 = ((topSelectedRecords != 0) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "\nfetch next {0} rows only", new object[1] { topSelectedRecords }) : string.Empty);
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "select {0} from {1}{2}{3}{4}{5}\noffset {6} rows{7}", selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, text, text4, text3, text2, skipSelectedRecords, text6);
		}

		public override string FormatInsertDefaultValues(string tableName)
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "insert into {0} default values", new object[1] { tableName });
		}

		protected override string FormatConstant(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return base.FormatConstant(value);
			}
			TypeCode typeCode = DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType());
			if (typeCode == TypeCode.DateTime)
			{
				DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
				string text = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fffffff";
				return $"convert(datetime, '{dateTime.ToString(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}', 121)";
			}
			return base.FormatConstant(value);
		}

		public override void GetTableSchema(DBTable table, bool checkIndexes, bool checkForeignKeys)
		{
			if (((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection is DbConnection { State: var state } dbConnection)
			{
				if (state != ConnectionState.Open)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).OpenConnection();
				}
				try
				{
					DataTable schema = dbConnection.GetSchema("VIEWCOLUMNS", new string[4]
					{
						null,
						null,
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeTableName(table.Name),
						null
					});
					if (schema.Rows.Count > 0)
					{
						foreach (DataRow row in schema.Rows)
						{
							table.AddColumn(CreateColumnFromSchemaDataRow(row));
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (state != ConnectionState.Open)
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.Close();
					}
				}
			}
			base.GetTableSchema(table, checkIndexes, checkForeignKeys);
		}

		private DBColumn CreateColumnFromSchemaDataRow(DataRow dataRow)
		{
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string text = Convert.ToString(dataRow["DATA_TYPE"]);
			short num = Convert.ToInt16(dataRow["CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH"]);
			return new DBColumn(Convert.ToString(dataRow["COLUMN_NAME"]), Convert.ToBoolean(dataRow["PRIMARY_KEY"]), text, (int)num, GetDBColumnType(text, Convert.ToInt16(dataRow["CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH"])));
		}

		private DBColumnType GetDBColumnType(string columnType, short size)
		{
			switch (columnType)
			{
			case "VarChar":
			case "NVarChar":
			case "Text":
			case "NText":
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			case "Date":
			case "DateTime":
			case "DateTime2":
				return (DBColumnType)15;
			case "Bit":
				return (DBColumnType)1;
			case "Char":
			case "NChar":
				if (size == 1)
				{
					return (DBColumnType)4;
				}
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			case "UniqueIdentifier":
				return (DBColumnType)16;
			case "Money":
			case "SmallMoney":
			case "Decimal":
				return (DBColumnType)5;
			case "Float":
				return (DBColumnType)6;
			case "Real":
				return (DBColumnType)7;
			case "TinyInt":
				return (DBColumnType)2;
			case "SmallInt":
				return (DBColumnType)10;
			case "Int":
				return (DBColumnType)8;
			case "BigInt":
				return (DBColumnType)12;
			case "Image":
			case "Binary":
			case "VarBinary":
				return (DBColumnType)18;
			default:
				return (DBColumnType)0;
			}
		}

		protected override DbTypeMapperBase CreateDbTypeMapper(Type vistaDbTypeEnumType, Type vistaDbParameterType)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (DbTypeMapperBase)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(DbTypeMapperVistaDb5<, >).MakeGenericType(vistaDbTypeEnumType, vistaDbParameterType));
		}

	public class WebApiDataStoreClient : IDataStore, IDataStoreAsync, ICacheToCacheCommunicationCore, ICacheToCacheCommunicationCoreAsync
	{
		public const string XpoProviderTypeString = "WebApi";

		private const string UriPartName = "uri";

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static bool IgnoreIllegalXmlCharacters;

		private AutoCreateOption autoCreateOption;

		private readonly HttpClient httpClient;

		private IWebApiDataFormatter fFormatter;

		private HttpClientHelper httpHelper;

		AutoCreateOption IDataStore.AutoCreateOption => autoCreateOption;

		public HttpClient HttpClient => httpClient;

		protected IWebApiDataFormatter Formatter
		{
			get
			{
				if (fFormatter == null)
				{
					fFormatter = CreateDataFormatter();
				}
				return fFormatter;
			}
		}

		protected HttpClientHelper HttpHelper
		{
			get
			{
				if (httpHelper == null)
				{
					httpHelper = new HttpClientHelper(HttpClient, Formatter);
				}
				return httpHelper;
			}
		}

		private bool ExtractMajorPartOfNativeErrorCode(Exception e, out int errorCode)
		{
			int oleDbExceptionNativeError = base.ReflectionHelper.GetOleDbExceptionNativeError(e);

		}

		private ICollection<DataRow> GetUniqe(List<DataRow> affectedRows)
		{
			Dictionary<DataRow, DataRow> dictionary = new Dictionary<DataRow, DataRow>();
			for (int num = affectedRows.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (dictionary.ContainsKey(affectedRows[num]))
				{
					affectedRows.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary.Add(affectedRows[num], null);
				}
			}
			return affectedRows;
		}

		protected virtual void DoCommit(ICollection<DataRow> affectedRows)
		{

			{
				affectedRow.AcceptChanges();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void DoRollback(ICollection<DataRow> affectedRows)
		{
			Data.RejectChanges();
		}

		public static void ClearDataSet(DataSet dataSet)
		{
			int count = dataSet.Tables.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				ConstraintCollection constraints = dataSet.Tables[i].Constraints;
				for (int j = 0; j < constraints.Count; j++)
				{
					Constraint constraint = constraints[j];
					if (!(constraint is UniqueConstraint))
					{
						constraints.RemoveAt(j);
						j--;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
			{
				dataSet.Tables[k].Constraints.Clear();
				dataSet.Tables[k].ChildRelations.Clear();
			}
			dataSet.Tables.Clear();
		}

		protected override void ProcessClearDatabase()
		{
			ClearDataSet(Data);
			descriptors.Clear();
		}

			private static int GetSchemaHash(InMemorySet inMemorySet)
			{
				int num = HashCodeHelper.StartGeneric<int>(inMemorySet.TablesCount);
				foreach (InMemoryTable table in inMemorySet.Tables)
				{
					num = HashCodeHelper.CombineGeneric<string>(num, table.Name);
					foreach (InMemoryColumn column in table.Columns)
					{
						num = HashCodeHelper.Combine(num, GetColumnHash(column));
					}
					foreach (InMemoryIndexWrapper index in table.Indexes)
					{
						num = HashCodeHelper.CombineGeneric<string, bool>(num, index.Name, index.Unique);
						foreach (InMemoryColumn column2 in index.Columns)
						{
							num = HashCodeHelper.CombineGeneric<int>(num, column2.ColumnIndex);
						}
					}
					if (table.PrimaryKey == null)
					{
						num = HashCodeHelper.Combine(num, -1);
					}
					else
					{
						num = HashCodeHelper.CombineGeneric<string, bool>(num, table.PrimaryKey.Name, table.PrimaryKey.Unique);
						foreach (InMemoryColumn column3 in table.PrimaryKey.Columns)
						{
							num = HashCodeHelper.CombineGeneric<int>(num, column3.ColumnIndex);
						}
					}
					foreach (InMemoryRelation allRelation in table.AllRelations)
					{
						num = HashCodeHelper.CombineGeneric<string>(num, allRelation.Name);
					}
				}
				return HashCodeHelper.Finish(num);
			}

			private static int GetColumnHash(InMemoryColumn column)
			{
				return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<string, object, bool, bool, int, int, Type>(column.Name, column.DefaultValue, column.AllowNull, column.AutoIncrement, column.ColumnIndex, column.MaxLength, column.Type);
			}

		private string GetConnectionString(string server, int port, string userId, string password, ConnectionSecurityMode securityMode, Dictionary<string, object> parameters = null)
		{
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			}
			string text = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId)) ? $"data source={ConnectionProviderSql.EscapeConnectionStringArgument(server)};user id={ConnectionProviderSql.EscapeConnectionStringArgument(userId)};password={ConnectionProviderSql.EscapeConnectionStringArgument(password)}" : $"data source={ConnectionProviderSql.EscapeConnectionStringArgument(server)};integrated security=SSPI");
			if ((int)securityMode == 1)
			{
				text += ";Encrypt=false";
			}
			else if ((int)securityMode == 2)

		public string[] GetDatabases(string server, int port, string userId, string password, ConnectionSecurityMode securityMode, Dictionary<string, object> parameters)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(server))
			{
				return new string[0];
			}
			using IDbConnection dbConnection = MSSqlConnectionProvider.CreateConnection(GetConnectionString(server, port, userId, password, securityMode, parameters));
			try
			{
				dbConnection.Open();
			}
			catch
			{
				return new string[0];
			}
			using IDbCommand dbCommand = dbConnection.CreateCommand();
			dbCommand.CommandText = "select name from master..sysdatabases";
			using IDataReader dataReader = dbCommand.ExecuteReader();
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			while (dataReader.Read())
			{
				string text = dataReader.GetString(0);
				if (text != "master" && text != "model" && text != "tempdb" && text != "msdb")
				{
					list.Add(text);
				}
			}
			dbConnection.Close();
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public override string GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(DBTable table, DBColumn column, bool forTableCreate)
		{
			//IL_0127: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00ee: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f4: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00f7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fe: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00ae: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b4: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(table, column);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes))
			{
				return sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes;
			}
			sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnType(table, column);
			sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = ((!column.IsKey && column.IsNullable) ? (sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes + " NULL") : (sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes + " NOT NULL"));
			if (!column.IsIdentity)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(column.DbDefaultValue))
				{
					sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes + " DEFAULT " + column.DbDefaultValue;
					if (!forTableCreate)
					{
						sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes += " WITH VALUES";
					}
				}
				else if (column.DefaultValue != null && column.DefaultValue != DBNull.Value)
				{
					MSSqlServerVersion val = new MSSqlServerVersion(is2000, is2005, is2008, isAzure);
					string text = MsSqlFormatterHelper.FormatConstant(column.DefaultValue, val);
					sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes = sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes + " DEFAULT " + text;
					if (!forTableCreate)
					{
						sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes += " WITH VALUES";
					}
				}
			}
			if (column.IsKey)
			{
				if (column.IsIdentity && ((int)column.ColumnType == 8 || (int)column.ColumnType == 12) && ConnectionProviderSql.IsSingleColumnPKColumn(table, column))
				{
					sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes += (GetIsAzure() ? " IDENTITY" : " IDENTITY NOT FOR REPLICATION");
				}
				else if ((int)column.ColumnType == 16 && ConnectionProviderSql.IsSingleColumnPKColumn(table, column) && !GetIsAzure())
				{
					sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes += " ROWGUIDCOL";
				}
			}
			return sqlCreateColumnFullAttributes;
		}

		protected override object ConvertToDbParameter(object clientValue, TypeCode clientValueTypeCode)
		{

			};
		}

		private void ReadDbVersion()
		{
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Expected O, but got Unknown

			{
				using (IDbCommand dbCommand = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CreateCommand(new Query("select @@MICROSOFTVERSION / 0x1000000")))
				{
					int num = Convert.ToInt32(dbCommand.ExecuteScalar());
					is2000 = num > 7;
					is2005 = is2000 && num > 8;
					is2008 = is2005 && num > 9;
					is2012 = is2008 && num > 10;
					return;
				}
			}
			is2000 = !text.StartsWith("07.");
			is2005 = is2000 && !text.StartsWith("08.");
			is2008 = is2005 && !text.StartsWith("09.");
			is2012 = is2008 && !text.StartsWith("10.");
		}

		private SelectStatementResult GetDataForTables(ICollection tables, TablesFilter filter, string queryText)
		{

			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown

				}

						value = "@p" + num.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

		private DBColumnType GetTypeFromString(string typeName, int length)
		{
			switch (typeName)
			{
			case "int":
				return (DBColumnType)8;
			case "image":
			case "varbinary":
				return (DBColumnType)18;
			case "nchar":
			case "char":
				if (length != 1)
				{
					return (DBColumnType)14;
				}
				return (DBColumnType)4;
			case "varchar":
			case "nvarchar":
			case "xml":
			case "ntext":

		private string GetFullTypeName(string typeName, int size, int precision, int scale)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(typeName))
			{
				return typeName;
			}
			switch (typeName.ToLower())
			{
			case "char":
			case "varchar":
			case "nchar":
			case "nvarchar":
				if (size >= 0 && size <= 4000)
				{
					return typeName + "(" + size.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
				}
				return typeName + "(max)";
			case "varbinary":
				if (size >= 0 && size <= 8000)
				{
					return typeName + "(" + size.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ")";
				}
				return typeName + "(max)";
			case "numeric":
			case "decimal":
				if (precision != 0)
				{
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}({1},{2})", new object[3] { typeName, precision, scale });
				}
				return typeName;
			default:
				return typeName;
			}
		}

		private string FormatOwnedDBObject(string schema, string objectName)
		{
			if (schema != string.Empty)
			{
				return "\"" + schema + "\".\"" + objectName + "\"";
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ObjectsOwner))
			{
				return "\"" + objectName + "\"";
			}
			return "\"" + ObjectsOwner + "\".\"" + objectName + "\"";
		}

		public override string FormatTable(string schema, string tableName)

		}

		public override string FormatSelect(string selectedPropertiesSql, string fromSql, string whereSql, string orderBySql, string groupBySql, string havingSql, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords)
		{
			if (skipSelectedRecords != 0)
			{
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatSelect(selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, whereSql, orderBySql, groupBySql, havingSql, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords);
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (topSelectedRecords != 0 && skipSelectedRecords == 0)
			{
				text = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "top {0} ", new object[1] { topSelectedRecords });
			}
			string text2 = ((whereSql == null) ? null : ("\nwhere " + whereSql));
			string text3 = ((orderBySql != null) ? ("\norder by " + orderBySql) : string.Empty);
			string text4 = ((havingSql != null) ? ("\nhaving " + havingSql) : string.Empty);
			string text5 = ((groupBySql != null) ? ("\ngroup by " + groupBySql) : string.Empty);
			if (skipSelectedRecords == 0)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "select {0}{1} from {2}{3}{4}{5}{6}", text, selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, text2, text5, text4, text3);
			}
			if (is2012 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
			{
				string text6 = ((topSelectedRecords != 0) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "\nfetch next {0} rows only", new object[1] { topSelectedRecords }) : string.Empty);
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "select {0} from {1}{2}{3}{4}{5}\noffset {6} rows{7}", selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, text2, text5, text4, text3, skipSelectedRecords, text6);
			}
			string[] columns = SimpleSqlParser.GetColumns(selectedPropertiesSql);
			StringBuilder expandedProperties = SimpleSqlParser.GetExpandedProperties(columns, "resultSet");
			selectedPropertiesSql = string.Join(", ", columns);
			string text7 = "select {8} from(select {0}, row_number() over({1}) as 'rowNumber' from {4}{5}{6}{7})resultSet where resultSet.rowNumber > {2}";
			if (topSelectedRecords != 0)
			{
				text7 += " and resultSet.rowNumber <= {2} + {3}";
			}
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, text7, selectedPropertiesSql, text3, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, fromSql, text2, text5, text4, expandedProperties);
		}

		protected override IDataParameter CreateParameter(IDbCommand command, object value, string name, DBColumnType dbType, string dbTypeName, int size)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0079: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0055: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0094: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0096: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IDbDataParameter dbDataParameter = (IDbDataParameter)((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CreateParameter(command);
			dbDataParameter.Value = value;
			dbDataParameter.ParameterName = name;
			QueryParameterMode queryParameterMode = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetQueryParameterMode();
			if ((int)queryParameterMode != 1)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbTypeName))
				{
					if ((int)queryParameterMode == 3)
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterTypeAndSize(dbDataParameter, dbTypeName);
					}
					else
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterType(dbDataParameter, dbTypeName);
					}
				}
				else if ((int)queryParameterMode == 3)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterTypeAndSize(dbDataParameter, dbType, size);
				}
				else
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterType(dbDataParameter, dbType);
				}
			}
			if ((int)queryParameterMode != 3 || (size == 0 && (int)dbType == 0 && string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbTypeName)))
			{
				AdjustParameterSize(dbDataParameter, value);
			}
			if ((int)queryParameterMode == 3)
			{
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ValidateParameterSize(command, dbDataParameter);
			}
			return dbDataParameter;
		}

		private void AdjustParameterSize(IDbDataParameter param, object value)
		{
			if ((param.DbType == DbType.AnsiString || param.DbType == DbType.String) && value is string)
			{
				int stringSize = GetStringSize(((string)value).Length);
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterTypeAndSize(param, (DBColumnType)14, stringSize);
			}
			else if (param.DbType == DbType.Binary && value is byte[])
			{
				int binarySize = GetBinarySize(((byte[])value).Length);
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).DbTypeMapper.SetParameterTypeAndSize(param, (DBColumnType)18, binarySize);
			}
		}

		private int GetStringSize(int p)
		{
			if (p > 4000)
			{
				return p;
			}
			return 4000;
		}

		private int GetBinarySize(int p)
		{
			if (p > 8000)
			{
				return p;
			}
			return 8000;
		}

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			object value = parameter.Value;
			createParameter = false;
			if (parameter is ConstantValue && value != null)
			{
				switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
				{
				case TypeCode.Int32:
					return ((int)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				case TypeCode.Boolean:
					if (!(bool)value)
					{
						return "0";
					}
					return "1";
				case TypeCode.String:
					return "N'" + ((string)value).Replace("'", "''") + "'";
				}
			}
			createParameter = true;
			int num = ((parameterNameCache != null) ? parameterNameCache.Length : 0);
			if (num <= index)
			{
				string[] array = new string[index + 10];
				if (parameterNameCache != null)
				{
					Array.Copy(parameterNameCache, array, num);
				}
				for (int i = num; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = "@p" + i.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				parameterNameCache = array;
			}
			return parameterNameCache[index];
		}

		public static void ClearDatabase(IDbCommand command)
		{
			command.CommandText = "\r\ndeclare @fk as sysname, @atbl as sysname\r\nDECLARE fkcur CURSOR FORWARD_ONLY static for select CONSTRAINT_NAME, TABLE_NAME from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS where CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'FOREIGN KEY'\r\nOPEN fkcur\r\nFETCH NEXT FROM fkcur INTO @fk, @atbl\r\nWHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0\r\nBEGIN\r\n  declare @alter as nvarchar(2048)\r\n  set @alter = 'alter table \"' + @atbl + '\" drop constraint \"' + @fk + '\"'\r\n  exec sp_executesql @alter\r\n  FETCH NEXT FROM fkcur INTO @fk, @atbl\r\nEND\r\nclose fkcur\r\nDEALLOCATE fkcur\r\n\r\ndeclare @dtbl as sysname\r\nDECLARE tblcur CURSOR FORWARD_ONLY static for select TABLE_NAME from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES where TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'\r\nOPEN tblcur\r\nFETCH NEXT FROM tblcur INTO @dtbl\r\nWHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0\r\nBEGIN\r\n  declare @drop as nvarchar(2048)\r\n  set @drop = 'drop table \"' + @dtbl + '\"'\r\n  exec sp_executesql @drop\r\n  FETCH NEXT FROM tblcur INTO @dtbl\r\nEND\r\nclose tblcur\r\nDEALLOCATE tblcur\r\n";
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}

		public static void EmptyAllTablesInDatabase(IDbCommand command)
		{
			command.CommandText = "\r\ndeclare @fk as sysname, @atbl as sysname, @prevFk as sysname\r\nset @prevFk = ''\r\nwhile 1=1\r\nbegin\r\n  set @fk = null\r\n  select top 1 @fk = CONSTRAINT_NAME, @atbl = TABLE_NAME from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS where CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'FOREIGN KEY' and CONSTRAINT_NAME > @prevFk order by CONSTRAINT_NAME\r\n  if @fk is null\r\n    break\r\n  set @prevFk = @fk\r\n  declare @alter as nvarchar(2048)\r\n  set @alter = 'alter table \"' + @atbl + '\" nocheck constraint \"' + @fk + '\"'\r\n  exec sp_executesql @alter\r\nend";
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
			command.CommandText = "\r\ndeclare @dtbl as sysname, @prevTbl as sysname\r\nset @prevTbl = ''\r\nwhile 1=1\r\nbegin\r\n  set @dtbl = null\r\n  select top 1 @dtbl = TABLE_NAME from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES where TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' and TABLE_NAME > @prevTbl order by TABLE_NAME\r\n  if @dtbl is null\r\n    break\r\n  set @prevTbl = @dtbl\r\n  declare @drop as nvarchar(2048)\r\n  set @drop = 'delete from \"' + @dtbl + '\"'\r\n  exec sp_executesql @drop\r\nend\r\n";
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
			command.CommandText = "\r\ndeclare @fk as sysname, @atbl as sysname, @prevFk as sysname\r\nset @prevFk = ''\r\nwhile 1=1\r\nbegin\r\n  set @fk = null\r\n  select top 1 @fk = CONSTRAINT_NAME, @atbl = TABLE_NAME from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS where CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'FOREIGN KEY' and CONSTRAINT_NAME > @prevFk order by CONSTRAINT_NAME\r\n  if @fk is null\r\n    break\r\n  set @prevFk = @fk\r\n  declare @alter as nvarchar(2048)\r\n  set @alter = 'alter table \"' + @atbl + '\" check constraint \"' + @fk + '\"'\r\n  exec sp_executesql @alter\r\nend";
			command.ExecuteNonQuery();
		}

		protected override void ProcessClearDatabase()
		{
			IDbCommand command = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CreateCommand();
			ClearDatabase(command);
		}

" or t.type ='v'" : "")));

		protected override string GetSafeNameRoot(string originalName)
		{
			lock (safeNames)
			{
				if (!safeNames.TryGetValue(originalName, out var value))
				{
					value = ConnectionProviderSql.GetSafeNameMsSql(originalName);
					safeNames.Add(originalName, value);
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		public override string GenerateStoredProcedures(DBTable table, out string dropLines)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			hasIdentityes = false;
			GenerateView(table, stringBuilder, list);
			GenerateInsertSP(table, stringBuilder, list);
			GenerateUpdateSP(table, stringBuilder, list);
			GenerateDeleteSP(table, stringBuilder, list);
			GenerateInsteadOfInsertTrigger(table, stringBuilder, list);
			GenerateInsteadOfUpdateTrigger(table, stringBuilder, list);
			GenerateInsteadOfDeleteTrigger(table, stringBuilder, list);
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = new StringBuilder();
				for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(stringBuilder2, list[num]);
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(stringBuilder2, "GO");
				}
				dropLines = stringBuilder2.ToString();
			}
			else
			{
				dropLines = string.Empty;
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private void GenerateView(DBTable table, StringBuilder result, List<string> dropList)
		{
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"CREATE VIEW [{table.Name}_xpoView] AS");
			dropList.Add($"DROP VIEW [{table.Name}_xpoView]");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\tSELECT");
			for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!hasIdentityes)
				{
					hasIdentityes = table.Columns[i].IsIdentity;
				}
				string arg = (table.Columns[i].IsIdentity ? " AS XpoIdentityColumn" : string.Empty);
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, string.Format("\t\t[{0}]{2}{1}", table.Columns[i].Name, (i < table.Columns.Count - 1) ? "," : string.Empty, arg));
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"\tFROM [{table.Name}]");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "GO");
		}

		private void GenerateInsertSP(DBTable table, StringBuilder result, List<string> dropList)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"CREATE PROCEDURE [sp_{table.Name}_xpoView_insert]");
			dropList.Add($"DROP PROCEDURE [sp_{table.Name}_xpoView_insert]");
			for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				string sqlCreateColumnType = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnType(table, table.Columns[i]);
				bool flag2 = false;
				for (int j = 0; j < table.ForeignKeys.Count; j++)
				{
					if (((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.ForeignKeys[j]).Columns.Contains(table.Columns[i].Name))
					{
						flag2 = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				string text;
				string format;
				if (table.Columns[i].IsIdentity)
				{
					flag = true;
					text = "XpoIdentityColumn";
					format = "\t@{0} {1}{3} OUT{2}";
				}
				else
				{
					text = table.Columns[i].Name;
					format = "\t@{0} {1}{3}{2}";
				}
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, string.Format(format, text, sqlCreateColumnType, (i < table.Columns.Count - 1) ? "," : string.Empty, flag2 ? " = null" : string.Empty));
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "AS");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "BEGIN");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\tBEGIN TRY");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"\t\tINSERT INTO [{table.Name}](");
			for (int k = 0; k < table.Columns.Count; k++)
			{
				if (!table.Columns[k].IsIdentity)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, string.Format("\t\t\t[{0}]{1}", table.Columns[k].Name, (k < table.Columns.Count - 1) ? "," : string.Empty));
				}
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\t)");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\tVALUES(");
			for (int l = 0; l < table.Columns.Count; l++)
			{
				if (!table.Columns[l].IsIdentity)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, string.Format("\t\t\t@{0}{1}", table.Columns[l].Name, (l < table.Columns.Count - 1) ? "," : string.Empty));
				}
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\t);");
			if (flag)
			{
				string arg = (is2000 ? "SCOPE_IDENTITY()" : "@@Identity");
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, string.Format("\t\tSET @{0} = {1};", "XpoIdentityColumn", arg));
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\tEND TRY");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\tBEGIN CATCH");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\tDECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\tDECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\tDECLARE @ErrorState INT;");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\tSELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\t\t@ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\t\t@ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\tRAISERROR(");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\t\t@ErrorMessage,");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\t\t@ErrorSeverity,");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\t\t@ErrorState");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\t\t);");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\tEND CATCH");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "END");
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "GO");
		}

		private void GenerateUpdateSP(DBTable table, StringBuilder result, List<string> dropList)
		{
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"CREATE PROCEDURE [sp_{table.Name}_xpoView_update]");
			dropList.Add($"DROP PROCEDURE [sp_{table.Name}_xpoView_update]");
			AppendKeys(table, result);
			for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!((ConnectionProviderSql)this).IsKey(table, table.Columns[i].Name))
				{
					if (i != 0 || ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns.Count > 0)
					{
						((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, ",");
					}
					string sqlCreateColumnType = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSqlCreateColumnType(table, table.Columns[i]);
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"\t@old_{table.Columns[i].Name} {sqlCreateColumnType},");
					result.Append($"\t@{table.Columns[i].Name} {sqlCreateColumnType}");
				}
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result);
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "AS");
			bool flag = false;
			for (int j = 0; j < table.Columns.Count; j++)
			{
				if (!((ConnectionProviderSql)this).IsKey(table, table.Columns[j].Name))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "BEGIN");
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"\tRAISERROR('There are no columns to update in {table.Name}_xpoView', 16, 1, null);");
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "END");
			}
			else
			{
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"\tUPDATE [{table.Name}] SET");
				bool flag2 = true;
				for (int k = 0; k < table.Columns.Count; k++)
				{
					if (!((ConnectionProviderSql)this).IsKey(table, table.Columns[k].Name))
					{
						if (flag2)
						{
							flag2 = false;
						}
						else
						{
							((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, ",");
						}
						result.Append(string.Format("\t\t[{0}]=@{0}", table.Columns[k].Name));
					}
				}
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result);
				((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "\tWHERE");
				AppendWhere(table, result);
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, "GO");
		}

		private void GenerateDeleteSP(DBTable table, StringBuilder result, List<string> dropList)
		{
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).StringBuilderAppendLine(result, $"CREATE PROCEDURE [sp_{table.Name}_xpoView_delete]");
			dropList.Add($"DROP PROCEDURE [sp_{table.Name}_xpoView_delete]");
			AppendKeys(table, result);
			for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!((ConnectionProviderSql)this).IsKey(table, table.Columns[i].Name))
				{
					if (i != 0 || ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)table.PrimaryKey).Columns.Count > 0)
					{
