		protected override DBTypeInfoBase CustomParseSqlType(string sqlTypeWithoutParameters, string sqlTypeParameters, string sqlTypeSuffix)
		{
			int? num = null;
			byte? b = null;
			byte? b2 = null;
			string text = sqlTypeWithoutParameters;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sqlTypeSuffix) && sqlTypeSuffix.IndexOf("UNSIGNED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
			{
				text += " UNSIGNED";
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sqlTypeParameters))
			{
				string[] array = (from v in sqlTypeParameters.Split(',')
					select v.Trim()).ToArray();
				if (array.Length >= 1 && int.TryParse(array[0], out var result))
				{
					num = result;
				}
				if (array.Length >= 2 && byte.TryParse(array[1], out var result2))
				{
					b = result2;
				}
			}
			return ((DbTypeMapperBase)this).CreateParameterDBTypeInfo(text, num, b, b2);
		}

		public override void SetParameterTypeAndSize(IDbDataParameter parameter, DBColumnType dbColumnType, int size)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00f5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00eb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ee: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)dbColumnType == 14)
			{
				if (size <= 0 || size > 16777215)
				{
					base.SetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter, mySqlTypeLongText);
					return;
				}
				if (size > 65535)
				{
					base.SetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter, mySqlTypeMediumText);
					return;
				}
				if (size > 255)
				{
					base.SetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter, mySqlTypeText);
					return;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if ((int)dbColumnType == 18)
				{
					if (size <= 0 || size > 16777215)
					{
						base.SetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter, mySqlTypeLongBlob);
					}
					else if (size > 65535)
					{
						base.SetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter, mySqlTypeMediumBlob);
					}
					else if (size > 127)
					{
						base.SetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter, mySqlTypeBlob);
					}
					else
					{
						base.SetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter, mySqlTypeTinyBlob);
					}
					return;
				}
				if (isSupport80 && (int)dbColumnType == 15)
				{
					size = 6;
				}
			}
			base.SetParameterTypeAndSize(parameter, dbColumnType, size);
		}

		public bool IsByteArraySqlDbType(IDataParameter parameter)
		{
			TSqlDbTypeEnum val = base.GetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter);
			if (!object.Equals(val, mySqlTypeBlob) && !object.Equals(val, mySqlTypeLongBlob) && !object.Equals(val, mySqlTypeMediumBlob))
			{
				return object.Equals(val, mySqlTypeTinyBlob);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsBoolSqlDbType(IDataParameter parameter)
		{
			TSqlDbTypeEnum val = base.GetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter);
			return object.Equals(val, mySqlTypeBit);
		}
	}
	internal class MySqlUpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper : UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper
	{
		protected override string AlterColumnTemplate => "alter table {0} change {1} {2} {3}";

		protected override string DropForeignKeyTemplate => "alter table {0} drop foreign key {1}";

		protected override string DropPrimaryKeyTemplate => "alter table {0} drop primary key";

		public MySqlUpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper(ISqlGeneratorFormatter sqlGeneratorFormatter, Func<DBTable, DBColumn, bool, string> getSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes, Func<string, string> formatConstraintSafe, Func<DBIndex, DBTable, string> getIndexName, Func<DBForeignKey, DBTable, string> getForeignKeyName, Func<DBPrimaryKey, DBTable, string> getPrimaryKeyName)
			: base(sqlGeneratorFormatter, getSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes, formatConstraintSafe, getIndexName, getForeignKeyName, getPrimaryKeyName)
		{
		}

		protected override string[] FormatRenameTable(RenameTableStatement statement)
		{
			return new string[1] { $"rename table {((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name)} to {base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.ComposeSafeTableName(statement.NewTableName)}" };
		}

		protected override string[] FormatRenameColumn(string tableName, string oldColumnName, string newColumnName)
		{
			return new string[0];
		}

		protected override string[] FormatCreateTable(CreateTableStatement statement)
		{
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.AddRange(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatCreateTable(statement));
			if (((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey != null)
			{
				DBColumn column = ((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.GetColumn(((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey).Columns[0]);
				if (!column.IsIdentity)
				{
					list.AddRange(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatCreatePrimaryKey(new CreatePrimaryKeyStatement(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table, ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey).Columns)));
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected override string[] FormatAlterColumn(AlterColumnStatement statement)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>(1);
			string text = base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.ComposeSafeColumnName(statement.OldColumn.Name);
			string text2 = base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.ComposeSafeColumnName(statement.NewColumn.Name);
			string text3 = base.GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table, statement.OldColumn, arg3: false);
			string text4 = base.GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table, statement.NewColumn, arg3: false);
			if (text3 != text4 || text != text2)
			{
				if (text4.EndsWith(" AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY"))
				{
					text4 = text4.Remove(text4.Length - " AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY".Length);
				}
				string item = string.Format(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).AlterColumnTemplate, ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name), ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatColumnSafe(text), ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatColumnSafe(text2), text4);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected override string[] FormatCreatePrimaryKey(CreatePrimaryKeyStatement statement)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (statement.PrimaryKeyColumns.Length == 1)
			{
				DBColumn val = statement.PrimaryKeyColumns[0];
				if (val != null && val.IsIdentity && ((int)val.ColumnType == 8 || (int)val.ColumnType == 12))
				{
					string arg = base.GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table, val, arg3: false);
					string text = $"alter table {((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name)} modify {((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatColumnSafe(val.Name)} {arg}";
					return new string[1] { text };
				}
			}
			return ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatCreatePrimaryKey(statement);
		}

		protected override string[] FormatDropPrimaryKey(DropPrimaryKeyStatement statement)
		{
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			List<string> list = new List<string>(1);
			if (((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey).Columns.Count == 1)
			{
				DBColumn column = ((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.GetColumn(((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey).Columns[0]);
				if (column != null && column.IsIdentity && ((int)column.ColumnType == 8 || (int)column.ColumnType == 12))
				{
					string text = base.GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table, column, arg3: false);
					if (text.EndsWith(" AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY"))
					{
						text = text.Remove(text.Length - " AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY".Length);
						list.Add($"alter table {((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name)} modify {((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatColumnSafe(column.Name)} {text}");
					}
				}
			}
			list.Add(string.Format(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).DropPrimaryKeyTemplate, ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name)));
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}
	internal class ReflectionGetValuesHelperBase
	{
		public virtual bool GetValues(IDataReader reader, Type[] fieldTypes, object[] values)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class ReflectionGetValuesHelper<R, OD, OG> : ReflectionGetValuesHelperBase where R : IDataReader, IDataRecord
	{
		private delegate OD OracleDataReaderGetOracleDecimalDelegate(R reader, int i);

		private delegate bool OracleDecimalComparisonDelegate(OD left, OD right);

		private delegate OD OracleDecimalOperationWithInt(OD od, int i);

		private delegate double OracleDecimalToDouble(OD od);

		private delegate decimal OracleDecimalToDecimal(OD od);

		private delegate OG OracleGlobalizationGetThreadInfoDelegate();

		private delegate string OracleGlobalizationGetNumericCharactersDelegate(OG og);

		private static readonly OD oracleDecimalMax;

		private static readonly OD oracleDecimalMin;

		private static readonly OD oracleDecimalZero;

		private static readonly OracleDataReaderGetOracleDecimalDelegate getOracleDecimal;

		private static readonly OracleDecimalComparisonDelegate oDGreaterThan;

		private static readonly OracleDecimalComparisonDelegate oDEquals;

		private static readonly OracleDecimalToDouble oDToDouble;

		private static readonly OracleDecimalToDecimal oDToDecimal;

		private static readonly OracleDecimalOperationWithInt oDSetPrecision;

		private static readonly bool BugWithSetPrecisionExistsInODP;

		private static readonly OracleGlobalizationGetThreadInfoDelegate oracleGlobalizationGetThreadInfo;

		private static readonly OracleGlobalizationGetNumericCharactersDelegate oracleGlobalizationGetNumericCharacters;

		private readonly ThreadLocal<char> currentOracleDecimalSeparator = new ThreadLocal<char>(GetOracleDecimalSeparator);

		static ReflectionGetValuesHelper()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(OD);
			oracleDecimalMax = (OD)Activator.CreateInstance(typeFromHandle, decimal.MaxValue);
			oracleDecimalMin = (OD)Activator.CreateInstance(typeFromHandle, decimal.MinValue);
			oracleDecimalZero = (OD)Activator.CreateInstance(typeFromHandle, 0m);
			MethodInfo method = typeof(R).GetMethod("GetOracleDecimal", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public, null, new Type[1] { typeof(int) }, null);
			getOracleDecimal = (OracleDataReaderGetOracleDecimalDelegate)Delegate.CreateDelegate(typeof(OracleDataReaderGetOracleDecimalDelegate), null, method);
			method = typeFromHandle.GetMethod("GreaterThan", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public, null, new Type[2] { typeFromHandle, typeFromHandle }, null);
			oDGreaterThan = (OracleDecimalComparisonDelegate)Delegate.CreateDelegate(typeof(OracleDecimalComparisonDelegate), method);
			method = typeFromHandle.GetMethod("Equals", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public, null, new Type[2] { typeFromHandle, typeFromHandle }, null);
			oDEquals = (OracleDecimalComparisonDelegate)Delegate.CreateDelegate(typeof(OracleDecimalComparisonDelegate), method);
			method = typeFromHandle.GetMethod("SetPrecision", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public, null, new Type[2]
			{
				typeFromHandle,
				typeof(int)
			}, null);
			oDSetPrecision = (OracleDecimalOperationWithInt)Delegate.CreateDelegate(typeof(OracleDecimalOperationWithInt), method);
			MethodInfo[] methods = typeFromHandle.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
			foreach (MethodInfo methodInfo in methods)
			{
				if (methodInfo.Name == "op_Explicit")
				{
					if (methodInfo.ReturnType == typeof(double))
					{
						oDToDouble = (OracleDecimalToDouble)Delegate.CreateDelegate(typeof(OracleDecimalToDouble), methodInfo);
					}
					else if (methodInfo.ReturnType == typeof(decimal))
					{
						oDToDecimal = (OracleDecimalToDecimal)Delegate.CreateDelegate(typeof(OracleDecimalToDecimal), methodInfo);
					}
				}
			}
			if (oDToDecimal == null || oDToDouble == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Methods 'ToDecimal' or 'ToDouble' not found.");
			}
			method = typeof(OG).GetMethod("GetThreadInfo", new Type[0]);
			if (method != null)
			{
				PropertyInfo property = typeof(OG).GetProperty("NumericCharacters");
				if (property != null)
				{
					oracleGlobalizationGetThreadInfo = (OracleGlobalizationGetThreadInfoDelegate)Delegate.CreateDelegate(typeof(OracleGlobalizationGetThreadInfoDelegate), method);
					oracleGlobalizationGetNumericCharacters = (OracleGlobalizationGetNumericCharactersDelegate)Delegate.CreateDelegate(typeof(OracleGlobalizationGetNumericCharactersDelegate), property.GetMethod);
				}
			}
			OD od = (OD)Activator.CreateInstance(typeFromHandle, 10304927536231884057971014491m);
			OD od2 = oDSetPrecision(od, 28);
			BugWithSetPrecisionExistsInODP = oDToDecimal(od2).ToString() != od2.ToString();
		}

		public override bool GetValues(IDataReader reader, Type[] fieldTypes, object[] values)
		{
			if (fieldTypes == null || !(reader is R dataReader))
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int num = fieldTypes.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (dataReader.IsDBNull(num))
				{
					values[num] = DBNull.Value;
				}
				else if (fieldTypes[num].Equals(typeof(decimal)))
				{
					values[num] = GetDecimal(dataReader, num);
				}
				else
				{
					values[num] = dataReader.GetValue(num);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static char GetOracleDecimalSeparator()
		{
			if (oracleGlobalizationGetNumericCharacters != null)
			{
				OG og = oracleGlobalizationGetThreadInfo();
				string text = oracleGlobalizationGetNumericCharacters(og);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return text[0];
				}
			}
			return '.';
		}

		private object GetDecimal(R dataReader, int index)
		{
			OD val = getOracleDecimal(dataReader, index);
			if (oDGreaterThan(val, oracleDecimalMax) || oDGreaterThan(oracleDecimalMin, val))
			{
				return oDToDouble(val);
			}
			if (oDEquals(val, oracleDecimalZero))
			{
				return 0m;
			}
			if (BugWithSetPrecisionExistsInODP)
			{
				string text = val.ToString();
				if (text.Length >= 27)
				{
					text = oDSetPrecision(val, 28).ToString();
					if (currentOracleDecimalSeparator.Value != '.')
					{
						text = text.Replace(currentOracleDecimalSeparator.Value, '.');
					}
					return decimal.Parse(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				return oDToDecimal(val);
			}
			OD od = oDSetPrecision(val, 28);
			return oDToDecimal(od);
		}
	}

			case "NUMBER":
			case "NUMERIC":
			case "DEC":
			case "DECIMAL":
				return "Decimal";
			case "REAL":

			case "DOUBLE PRECISION":

			case "TIMESTAMP":
				return "TimeStamp";
			case "TIMESTAMP WITH LOCAL TIME ZONE":
				return "TimeStampLTZ";
			case "TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE":

			case "BINARY_DOUBLE":

			default:
				return base.ConvertSqlTypeToParameterType(sqlType);
			}
		}

		public void SetOracleDbTypeChar(IDbDataParameter parameter, int size)

		}

		{
			if (object.Equals(((DbTypeMapper<TSqlDbTypeEnum, TSqlParameter>)this).GetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter), OracleDbTypeVarchar2))
			{
				((DbTypeMapper<TSqlDbTypeEnum, TSqlParameter>)this).SetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter, OracleDbTypeNVarchar2);
			}
		}

	internal abstract class DbTypeMapperBaseOracle<TSqlDbTypeEnum, TSqlParameter> : DbTypeMapper<TSqlDbTypeEnum, TSqlParameter> where TSqlDbTypeEnum : struct where TSqlParameter : IDbDataParameter
	{
		protected static readonly TSqlDbTypeEnum OracleDbTypeChar;

		protected static readonly TSqlDbTypeEnum OracleDbTypeNClob;

		protected static readonly TSqlDbTypeEnum OracleDbTypeBlob;

		static DbTypeMapperBaseOracle()
		{
			OracleDbTypeChar = (TSqlDbTypeEnum)Enum.Parse(typeof(TSqlDbTypeEnum), "Char");
			OracleDbTypeNClob = (TSqlDbTypeEnum)Enum.Parse(typeof(TSqlDbTypeEnum), "NClob");
			OracleDbTypeBlob = (TSqlDbTypeEnum)Enum.Parse(typeof(TSqlDbTypeEnum), "Blob");
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForByteArray(out int? size)
		{
			size = null;
			return "Raw";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForChar(out int? size)

			size = null;
			return "NChar";

		{

			return "Int32";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForTimeSpan()
		{

		}

		protected override string ConvertSqlTypeToParameterType(string sqlType)
		{
			switch (sqlType.ToUpperInvariant())
			{
			case "CHAR":
				return "Char";
			case "NCHAR":
				return "NChar";
			case "RAW":
				return "Raw";
			case "LONG RAW":
				return "LongRaw";
			case "INTEGER":
			case "INT":
				return "Int32";
			case "SMALLINT":
				return "Int16";
			case "DOUBLE PRECISION":
				return "Double";
			case "BFILE":
				return "BFile";
			case "BLOB":
				return "Blob";
			case "CLOB":
				return "Clob";
			case "NCLOB":
				return "NClob";
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override DBTypeInfoBase CustomParseSqlType(string sqlTypeWithoutParameters, string sqlTypeParameters, string sqlTypeSuffix)
		{
			if (string.Equals(sqlTypeWithoutParameters, "TIMESTAMP", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				if (string.Equals(sqlTypeSuffix, "WITH LOCAL TIME ZONE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					return ((DbTypeMapperBase)this).CreateParameterDBTypeInfo("TIMESTAMP WITH LOCAL TIME ZONE", (int?)null, (byte?)null, (byte?)null);
				}
				if (string.Equals(sqlTypeSuffix, "WITH TIME ZONE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					return ((DbTypeMapperBase)this).CreateParameterDBTypeInfo("TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE", (int?)null, (byte?)null, (byte?)null);
				}
			}
			else if (string.Equals(sqlTypeWithoutParameters, "INTERVAL DAY", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || string.Equals(sqlTypeWithoutParameters, "INTERVAL YEAR", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return ((DbTypeMapperBase)this).CreateParameterDBTypeInfo(sqlTypeWithoutParameters, (int?)null, (byte?)null, (byte?)null);
			}
			return ((DbTypeMapperBase)this).CustomParseSqlType(sqlTypeWithoutParameters, sqlTypeParameters, sqlTypeSuffix);
		}

		public override void SetParameterTypeAndSize(IDbDataParameter parameter, DBColumnType dbColumnType, int size)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)dbColumnType != 14)
			{
				if ((int)dbColumnType == 18 && (size < 0 || size >= 2000))
				{
					base.SetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter, OracleDbTypeBlob);
					parameter.Size = 0;
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (size < 0 || size > 2000)
			{
				base.SetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter, OracleDbTypeNClob);
				parameter.Size = 0;
				return;
			}
			base.SetParameterTypeAndSize(parameter, dbColumnType, size);
		}
	}

			case "NUMBER":
			case "NUMERIC":
			case "DEC":
			case "DECIMAL":
				return "Number";
			case "REAL":
			case "FLOAT":
				return "Float";
			case "LONG":
				return "LongVarChar";
			case "DATE":
				return "DateTime";
			case "TIMESTAMP":
				return "Timestamp";
			case "TIMESTAMP WITH LOCAL TIME ZONE":
				return "TimestampLocal";
			case "TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE":
				return "TimestampWithTZ";
			case "INTERVAL YEAR":
				return "IntervalYearToMonth";
			case "INTERVAL DAY":
				return "IntervalDayToSecond";
			case "ROWID":
				return "RowId";
			case "UROWID":
				return "VarChar";
			case "XMLTYPE":
				return null;
			default:
				return base.ConvertSqlTypeToParameterType(sqlType);
			}
		}

		public void SetOracleDbTypeChar(IDbDataParameter parameter, int size)
		{
			((DbTypeMapper<TSqlDbTypeEnum, TSqlParameter>)this).SetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter, DbTypeMapperBaseOracle<TSqlDbTypeEnum, TSqlParameter>.OracleDbTypeChar);
			parameter.Size = size;
		}

		public void FixVarcharParameterType(IDbDataParameter parameter)
		{
			TSqlParameter val = (TSqlParameter)parameter;
			if (object.Equals(((DbTypeMapper<TSqlDbTypeEnum, TSqlParameter>)this).GetSqlDbTypeHandler(val), OracleDbTypeVarchar))
			{
				((DbTypeMapper<TSqlDbTypeEnum, TSqlParameter>)this).SetSqlDbTypeHandler(val, DbTypeMapperBaseOracle<TSqlDbTypeEnum, TSqlParameter>.OracleDbTypeNClob);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class OracleUpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper : UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper
	{
		private Func<string, string> GetSequenceNameForTable;

		protected override string AlterColumnTemplate => "alter table {0} modify({1} {2})";

		public OracleUpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper(ISqlGeneratorFormatter sqlGeneratorFormatter, Func<DBTable, DBColumn, bool, string> getSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes, Func<string, string> formatConstraintSafe, Func<DBIndex, DBTable, string> getIndexName, Func<DBForeignKey, DBTable, string> getForeignKeyName, Func<DBPrimaryKey, DBTable, string> getPrimaryKeyName, Func<string, string> getSequenceNameForTable)
			: base(sqlGeneratorFormatter, getSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes, formatConstraintSafe, getIndexName, getForeignKeyName, getPrimaryKeyName)
		{
			GetSequenceNameForTable = getSequenceNameForTable;
		}

		protected override string[] FormatCreateTable(CreateTableStatement statement)
		{
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.AddRange(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatCreateTable(statement));
			if (((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey != null)
			{
				DBColumn column = ((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.GetColumn(((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey).Columns[0]);
				if (column.IsIdentity)
				{
					list.Add(FormatCreateSequence(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name));
				}
				else
				{
					list.AddRange(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatCreatePrimaryKey(new CreatePrimaryKeyStatement(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table, ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey).Columns)));
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected override string[] FormatRenameTable(RenameTableStatement statement)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.Add($"rename {((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name)} to {((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(statement.NewTableName)}");
			if (((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey != null)
			{
				DBColumn column = ((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.GetColumn(((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey).Columns[0]);
				if (column.IsIdentity)
				{
					string arg = GetSequenceNameForTable(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name);
					string arg2 = GetSequenceNameForTable(statement.NewTableName);
					list.Add($"rename {arg} to {arg2}");
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected override string[] FormatRenameColumn(string tableName, string oldColumnName, string newColumnName)
		{
			newColumnName = base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.FormatColumn(base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.ComposeSafeColumnName(newColumnName));
			oldColumnName = base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.FormatColumn(base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.ComposeSafeColumnName(oldColumnName));
			return new string[1] { $"alter table {((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(tableName)} rename column {oldColumnName} to {newColumnName}" };
		}

		protected override string[] FormatAlterColumn(AlterColumnStatement statement)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>(1);
			if (statement.OldColumn.IsIdentity != statement.NewColumn.IsIdentity)
			{
				if (statement.NewColumn.IsIdentity)
				{
					list.Add(FormatCreateSequence(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(FormatDropSequence(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name));
				}
			}
			string text = base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.ComposeSafeColumnName(statement.NewColumn.Name);
			string text2 = base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.ComposeSafeColumnName(statement.OldColumn.Name);
			if (!string.Equals(text2, text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				list.AddRange(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatRenameColumn(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name, text2, text));
			}
			if (statement.OldColumn.IsNullable != statement.NewColumn.IsNullable)
			{
				if (statement.NewColumn.IsNullable)
				{
					if (!statement.OldColumn.IsIdentity)
					{
						string item = string.Format(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).AlterColumnTemplate, ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name), ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatColumnSafe(text), "NULL");
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					string item2 = string.Format(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).AlterColumnTemplate, ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name), ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatColumnSafe(text), "NOT NULL");
					list.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			string text3 = base.GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table, statement.OldColumn, arg3: false);
			string text4 = base.GetSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table, statement.NewColumn, arg3: false);
			if (text4.EndsWith(" NOT NULL"))
			{
				text4 = text4.Remove(text4.Length - " NOT NULL".Length);
			}
			if (text3 != text4)
			{
				string item3 = string.Format(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).AlterColumnTemplate, ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name), ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatColumnSafe(text), text4);
				list.Add(item3);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected override string[] FormatDropTable(DropTableStatement statement)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.AddRange(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatDropTable(statement));
			if (((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey != null)
			{
				DBColumn column = ((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.GetColumn(((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey).Columns[0]);
				if (column.IsIdentity)
				{
					list.Add(FormatDropSequence(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name));
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected override string[] FormatDropColumn(DropColumnStatement statement)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.AddRange(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatDropColumn(statement));
			if (((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey != null)
			{
				DBColumn column = ((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.GetColumn(statement.ColumnName);
				if (column.IsIdentity)
				{
					list.Add(FormatDropSequence(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name));
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected override string[] FormatDropIndex(DropIndexStatement statement)
		{
			string text = $"drop index {base.FormatConstraintSafe(statement.IndexName)}";
			return new string[1] { text };
		}

		private string FormatCreateSequence(string tableName)
		{
			string text = GetSequenceNameForTable(tableName);
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "create sequence {0} START WITH 1 INCREMENT BY 1", new object[1] { text });
		}

		private string FormatDropSequence(string tableName)
		{
			string arg = GetSequenceNameForTable(tableName);
			return $"drop sequence {arg}";
		}
	}

	internal class PostgreSqlDBSchemaComparer : DBSchemaComparerSql
	{
		public PostgreSqlDBSchemaComparer(Func<string, string> tableNameMangling, Func<string, string> columnNameMangling, Func<DBTable, DBColumn, string> getSqlCreateColumnType)
			: this(tableNameMangling, columnNameMangling, getSqlCreateColumnType, (Func<string, DBTypeInfoBase>)DefaultDbTypeMapper.Instance.ParseSqlType)
		{
		}

		public PostgreSqlDBSchemaComparer(Func<string, string> tableNameMangling, Func<string, string> columnNameMangling, Func<DBTable, DBColumn, string> getSqlCreateColumnType, Func<string, DBTypeInfoBase> parseSqlType)
			: base(tableNameMangling, columnNameMangling, getSqlCreateColumnType, parseSqlType)
		{
			((DBSchemaComparerSql)this).AddCompatibleSqlTypeMapping("timestamp", "timestamp without time zone");
			((DBSchemaComparerSql)this).AddCompatibleSqlTypeMapping("char", "character");
			((DBSchemaComparerSql)this).AddCompatibleSqlTypeMapping("varchar", "character varying");
		}

		protected override bool IsSqlTypesCompatible(string sqlTypeX, string sqlTypeY)
		{
			if (((DBSchemaComparerSql)this).IsSqlTypesCompatible(sqlTypeX, sqlTypeY))
			{
				return true;
			}
			SplitSqlType(sqlTypeX, out var type, out var size, out var suffix);
			SplitSqlType(sqlTypeY, out var type2, out var size2, out var suffix2);
			if (((DBSchemaComparerSql)this).IsSqlTypesCompatible(type, type2) && string.Equals(size, size2, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return string.Equals(suffix, suffix2, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SplitSqlType(string sqlType, out string type, out string size, out string suffix)
		{
			int num = sqlType.IndexOf('(');
			int num2 = sqlType.IndexOf(')');
			if (num2 > num && num != 1)
			{
				size = sqlType.Substring(num + 1, num2 - num - 1);
				suffix = sqlType.Substring(num2 + 1);
				type = sqlType.Substring(0, num);
			}
			else
			{
				type = sqlType;
				size = "";
				suffix = "";
			}
		}
	}
	internal class PostgreSqlUpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper : UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper
	{
		private Func<DBTable, DBColumn, string> getSqlCreateColumnType;

		protected override string AlterColumnTemplate => "alter table {0} alter column {1} type {2}";

		public PostgreSqlUpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper(ISqlGeneratorFormatter sqlGeneratorFormatter, Func<DBTable, DBColumn, bool, string> getSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes, Func<string, string> formatConstraintSafe, Func<DBIndex, DBTable, string> getIndexName, Func<DBForeignKey, DBTable, string> getForeignKeyName, Func<DBPrimaryKey, DBTable, string> getPrimaryKeyName, Func<DBTable, DBColumn, string> getSqlCreateColumnType)
			: base(sqlGeneratorFormatter, getSqlCreateColumnFullAttributes, formatConstraintSafe, getIndexName, getForeignKeyName, getPrimaryKeyName)
		{
			this.getSqlCreateColumnType = getSqlCreateColumnType;
		}

		protected override string[] FormatRenameTable(RenameTableStatement statement)
		{
			return new string[1] { $"alter table {((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name)} rename to {base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.ComposeSafeTableName(statement.NewTableName)}" };
		}

		protected override string[] FormatRenameColumn(string tableName, string oldColumnName, string newColumnName)
		{
			newColumnName = base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.FormatColumn(base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.ComposeSafeColumnName(newColumnName));
			oldColumnName = base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.FormatColumn(base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.ComposeSafeColumnName(oldColumnName));
			return new string[1] { $"alter table {((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(tableName)} rename column {oldColumnName} to {newColumnName}" };
		}

		protected override string[] FormatCreateTable(CreateTableStatement statement)
		{
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.AddRange(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatCreateTable(statement));
			if (((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey != null)
			{
				DBColumn column = ((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.GetColumn(((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey).Columns[0]);
				if (!column.IsIdentity)
				{
					list.AddRange(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatCreatePrimaryKey(new CreatePrimaryKeyStatement(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table, ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.PrimaryKey).Columns)));
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private string ChangeColumnSqlTypeToCompatible(string sqlType)
		{
			if (sqlType.StartsWith("character varying(", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return "varchar(" + sqlType.Substring("character varying(".Length);
			}
			if (sqlType.StartsWith("character("))
			{
				return "char(" + sqlType.Substring("character(".Length);
			}
			if (string.Equals(sqlType, "timestamp without time zone", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return "timestamp";
			}
			return sqlType;
		}

		protected override string[] FormatAlterColumn(AlterColumnStatement statement)
		{
			//IL_00ee: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0123: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0134: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0145: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0156: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0167: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0178: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_017f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0186: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0206: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0210: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_01b0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01b7: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_02d3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02dd: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<string> list = new List<string>(1);
			string text = base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.ComposeSafeColumnName(statement.NewColumn.Name);
			string text2 = base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.ComposeSafeColumnName(statement.OldColumn.Name);
			if (!string.Equals(text2, text, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				list.AddRange(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatRenameColumn(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name, text2, text));
			}
			if (statement.OldColumn.IsIdentity == statement.NewColumn.IsIdentity)
			{
				string text3 = ChangeColumnSqlTypeToCompatible(getSqlCreateColumnType(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table, statement.OldColumn));
				string text4 = ChangeColumnSqlTypeToCompatible(getSqlCreateColumnType(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table, statement.NewColumn));
				if (text3 != text4)
				{
					string item = string.Format(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).AlterColumnTemplate, ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name), ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatColumnSafe(text), text4);
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DBColumn val = new DBColumn
				{
					Name = base.SqlGeneratorFormatter.ComposeSafeColumnName($"{statement.OldColumn.Name}Temporary{Guid.NewGuid()}"),
					ColumnType = statement.NewColumn.ColumnType,
					DBTypeName = statement.NewColumn.DBTypeName,
					Size = statement.NewColumn.Size,
					DbDefaultValue = statement.NewColumn.DbDefaultValue,
					DefaultValue = statement.NewColumn.DefaultValue,
					IsIdentity = false,
					IsKey = false,
					IsNullable = true
				};
				if (statement.NewColumn.IsIdentity)
				{
					val.IsNullable = statement.NewColumn.IsNullable;
					string arg = (((int)val.ColumnType == 12) ? "bigserial" : "serial");
					list.Add($"alter table {((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name)} add {((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatColumnSafe(val.Name)} {arg}");
				}
				else
				{
					list.AddRange(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatCreateColumn(new CreateColumnStatement(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table, val)));
					list.Add($"update {((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name)} set {((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatColumnSafe(val.Name)}={((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatColumnSafe(statement.OldColumn.Name)}");
					if (!statement.NewColumn.IsNullable || statement.NewColumn.IsKey)
					{
						val.IsNullable = false;
						string arg2 = getSqlCreateColumnType(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table, statement.NewColumn);
						list.Add(string.Format(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).AlterColumnTemplate, ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name), ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatColumnSafe(val.Name), arg2));
					}
				}
				list.AddRange(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatDropColumn(new DropColumnStatement(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table, statement.OldColumn.Name)));
				list.AddRange(((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatRenameColumn(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name, val.Name, statement.NewColumn.Name));
			}
			if (statement.OldColumn.IsNullable != statement.NewColumn.IsNullable)
			{
				string format = ((!statement.NewColumn.IsNullable) ? "alter table {0} alter column {1} set not null" : "alter table {0} alter column {1} drop not null");
				list.Add(string.Format(format, ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatTableSafe(((UpdateSchemaStatement)statement).Table.Name), ((UpdateSchemaSqlFormatterHelper)this).FormatColumnSafe(text)));
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected override string[] FormatDropIndex(DropIndexStatement statement)
		{
			return new string[1] { $"drop index {base.FormatConstraintSafe(statement.IndexName)}" };
		}

		public override void SetParameterTypeAndSize(IDbDataParameter parameter, DBColumnType dbColumnType, int size)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)dbColumnType == 14)
			{
				if (size <= 0 || size > MaxStringSize)
				{
					base.SetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter, maxStringDbType);
					return;
				}
			}
			else if ((int)dbColumnType == 18 && (size <= 0 || size > MaxBinarySize))
			{
				base.SetSqlDbTypeHandler((TSqlParameter)parameter, maxBinaryDbType);
				return;
			}
			base.SetParameterTypeAndSize(parameter, dbColumnType, size);
		}

		public string GetDBTypeString(DBColumn column, out short size)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			size = 0;
			DBColumnType columnType = column.ColumnType;
			switch (columnType - 1)
			{
			case 13:
				size = (short)((column.Size > 0) ? column.Size : 0);
				if (column.Size > 0 && column.Size <= MaxStringSize)
				{
					return "NVarChar";
				}
				return MaxStringDataType;
			case 14:
				return "DateTime";
			case 0:
				return "Bit";
			case 3:
				size = 1;
				return "NChar";
			case 15:
				return "UniqueIdentifier";
			case 4:
				return "Decimal";
			case 5:
				return "Float";
			case 6:
				return SingleDataType;
			case 12:
				return "BigInt";
			case 8:
				return "BigInt";
			case 9:
				return "SmallInt";
			case 2:
				return "SmallInt";
			case 11:
				return "BigInt";
			case 17:
				size = (short)((column.Size > 0) ? column.Size : 0);
				if (column.Size > 0 && column.Size <= MaxBinarySize)
				{
					return "VarBinary";
				}
				return MaxBinaryDataType;
			default:
				return "Int";
			}
		}

	public class HttpClientHelper
	{
		private class HttpResult<T>
		{
			public readonly ExceptionDispatchInfo ExceptionInfo;

			public T Value { get; set; }

			public bool HasException
			{
				get
				{
					if (ExceptionInfo != null)
					{
						return ExceptionInfo.SourceException != null;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			public HttpResult(ExceptionDispatchInfo exceptionInfo, Stream stream, Encoding encoding, IWebApiDataFormatter formatter)
			{
				ExceptionInfo = exceptionInfo;
				if (!HasException && stream != null)
				{
					Value = formatter.Deserialize<T>(stream, encoding);
				}
				else
				{
					ExceptionInfo?.Throw();
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly HttpClient http;

		private readonly IWebApiDataFormatter formatter;

		private readonly bool staSafe;

		private Encoding outputEncoding = Encoding.Unicode;

		public Encoding OutputEncoding
		{
			get
			{
				return outputEncoding;
			}
			set
			{
				outputEncoding = value;
			}
		}

		public HttpClientHelper(HttpClient http, IWebApiDataFormatter formatter)
			: this(http, formatter, staSafe: false)
		{
		}

		public HttpClientHelper(HttpClient http, IWebApiDataFormatter formatter, bool staSafe)
		{
			this.http = http;
			this.formatter = formatter;
			this.staSafe = staSafe;
		}

		private LifeTime<HttpResult<TResult>> CreateLifetime<TResult>()
		{
			return AsyncDownloader<HttpResult<TResult>>.CreateLifeTime(http);
		}

		public async Task<TResult> GetAsync<TResult>(string action, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Encoding responseEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;
			LifeTime<HttpResult<TResult>> val = CreateLifetime<TResult>();
			SendMethodOptions<HttpResult<TResult>> val2 = new SendMethodOptions<HttpResult<TResult>>(HttpMethod.Get, (Action<HttpRequestMessage>)null, (Predicate<HttpResponseMessage>)delegate(HttpResponseMessage response)
			{
				response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
				responseEncoding = Encoding.GetEncoding(response.Content.Headers.ContentType.CharSet);
				return true;
			}, val, (AccessSettings)null);
			Uri uri = new Uri(action, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
			return (await AsyncDownloader<HttpResult<TResult>>.LoadAsync(uri, (Func<ExceptionDispatchInfo, Stream, HttpResult<TResult>>)((ExceptionDispatchInfo ex, Stream stream) => new HttpResult<TResult>(ex, stream, responseEncoding, formatter)), cancellationToken, val2).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)).Value;
		}

		private TResult ExecuteSynchronously<TResult>(Func<Task<TResult>> asyncAction)
		{
			if (staSafe)
			{
				return StaSafeHelper.Invoke<TResult>((Func<TResult>)(() => asyncAction().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult()));
			}
			return asyncAction().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
		}

		private void ExecuteSynchronously(Func<Task> asyncAction)
		{
			if (staSafe)
			{
				StaSafeHelper.Invoke((Action)delegate
				{
					asyncAction().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
				});
			}
			else
			{
				asyncAction().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
			}
		}

		public TResult Get<TResult>(string action)
		{
			return ExecuteSynchronously(() => GetAsync<TResult>(action, CancellationToken.None));
		}

		public async Task<TResult> PostAsync<TData, TResult>(string action, TData data, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Encoding responseEncoding = Encoding.UTF8;

		private HttpContent CreateContent<TData>(TData data)
		{
			HttpContent httpContent = new StreamContent(formatter.Serialize(data, OutputEncoding));
			httpContent.Headers.ContentType = new MediaTypeHeaderValue("application/xml")
			{
				CharSet = Encoding.Unicode.WebName
			};
			return httpContent;
		}

		public static string BuildQueryString(string key, object value)
		{
			if (value == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(value.ToString()))
			{
				return key;
			}
			if (!(value is IEnumerable source) || value is string)
			{
				return key + "=" + Uri.EscapeDataString(value.ToString());
			}
			return string.Join("&", (from object x in source
				select BuildQueryString(key, x)).ToArray());
		}

		public static string BuildQueryString(IDictionary<string, object> parameters)
		{
			if (parameters == null || parameters.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return string.Join("&", parameters.Select((KeyValuePair<string, object> x) => BuildQueryString(x.Key, x.Value)));
		}

		public static string BuildQueryString(string path, string key, object value)
		{
			return path + "?" + BuildQueryString(key, value);
		}

		public static string BuildQueryString(string path, IDictionary<string, object> parameters)
		{
			return path + "?" + BuildQueryString(parameters);
		}
	}
	public interface IWebApiDataFormatter
	{
		Stream Serialize<T>(T value, Encoding encoding);

		T Deserialize<T>(Stream stream, Encoding encoding);
	}
	public abstract class WebApiXmlDataFormatterBase : IWebApiDataFormatter
	{
		private const int DefaultBufferSize = 1024;

		protected abstract T Deserialize<T>(Stream stream, Encoding encoding);

		protected abstract Stream Serialize<T>(T value, Encoding encoding);

		T IWebApiDataFormatter.Deserialize<T>(Stream stream, Encoding encoding)
		{
			return Deserialize<T>(stream, encoding);
		}

		Stream IWebApiDataFormatter.Serialize<T>(T value, Encoding encoding)
		{
			return Serialize(value, encoding);
		}

		protected StreamReader CreateStreamReader(Stream stream, Encoding encoding)
		{
			return new StreamReader(stream, encoding, detectEncodingFromByteOrderMarks: true, 1024, leaveOpen: true);
		}

		protected XmlWriter CreateXmlWriter(Stream stream, Encoding encoding)
		{
			XmlWriterSettings xmlWriterSettings = new XmlWriterSettings();
			xmlWriterSettings.Encoding = encoding;
			xmlWriterSettings.CloseOutput = false;
			xmlWriterSettings.CheckCharacters = false;
			return XmlWriter.Create(stream, xmlWriterSettings);
		}
	}
	public sealed class WebApiXmlDataFormatter : WebApiXmlDataFormatterBase
	{
		protected override T Deserialize<T>(Stream stream, Encoding encoding)
		{
			using StreamReader streamReader = CreateStreamReader(stream, encoding);
			try
			{
				return Cached.Deserialize<T>((TextReader)streamReader, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)delegate(XmlReaderSettings settings)
				{
					settings.CheckCharacters = false;
				});
			}
			finally
			{
				stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			}
		}

		protected override Stream Serialize<T>(T value, Encoding encoding)
		{
			Stream stream = new MemoryStream();
			using XmlWriter xmlWriter = CreateXmlWriter(stream, encoding);
			try
			{
				Cached.Serialize<T>(xmlWriter, (object)value);
				xmlWriter.Flush();
				return stream;
			}
			finally
			{
				stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class WebApiDataContractXmlDataFormatter : WebApiXmlDataFormatterBase
	{
		private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Type, DataContractSerializer> Serializers = new ConcurrentDictionary<Type, DataContractSerializer>();

		private static readonly Type[] DefaultKnownTypes = new Type[21]
		{
			typeof(InsertStatement),
			typeof(DeleteStatement),
			typeof(UpdateStatement),
			typeof(ParameterValue),
			typeof(QueryOperand),
			typeof(QuerySubQueryContainer),
			typeof(ContainsOperator),
			typeof(BetweenOperator),
			typeof(BinaryOperator),
			typeof(UnaryOperator),
			typeof(InOperator),
			typeof(GroupOperator),
			typeof(OperandValue),
			typeof(ConstantValue),
			typeof(OperandProperty),
			typeof(AggregateOperand),
			typeof(JoinOperand),
			typeof(FunctionOperator),
			typeof(NotOperator),
			typeof(NullOperator),
			typeof(QueryOperand)
		};

		public static readonly IWebApiDataFormatter Default = new WebApiDataContractXmlDataFormatter(DefaultKnownTypes);

		private readonly Type[] knownTypes;

		public WebApiDataContractXmlDataFormatter(Type[] knownTypes)
		{
			this.knownTypes = knownTypes;
		}

		public static DataContractSerializer GetSerializer(Type objectType, Type[] knownTypes)
		{
			return Serializers.GetOrAdd(objectType, (Type t) => new DataContractSerializer(t, knownTypes));
		}

		protected override T Deserialize<T>(Stream stream, Encoding encoding)
		{
			using StreamReader streamReader = CreateStreamReader(stream, encoding);
			XmlReader reader = SafeXml.CreateReader((TextReader)streamReader, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)delegate(XmlReaderSettings settings)
			{
				settings.CheckCharacters = false;
			});
			using XmlDictionaryReader reader2 = XmlDictionaryReader.CreateDictionaryReader(reader);
			try
			{
				DataContractSerializer serializer = GetSerializer(typeof(T), knownTypes);
				return (T)serializer.ReadObject(reader2);
			}
			finally
			{
				stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			}
		}

		protected override Stream Serialize<T>(T value, Encoding encoding)
		{
			Stream stream = new MemoryStream();
			using XmlDictionaryWriter xmlDictionaryWriter = XmlDictionaryWriter.CreateDictionaryWriter(CreateXmlWriter(stream, encoding));
			try
			{
				DataContractSerializer serializer = GetSerializer(typeof(T), knownTypes);
				serializer.WriteObject(xmlDictionaryWriter, value);
				xmlDictionaryWriter.Flush();
				return stream;
			}
			finally
			{
				stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			}
		}
	}

		private InMemoryRollBackOrderList rollbackOrder = new InMemoryRollBackOrderList();

		public void BeginTransaction()
		{
			inTransaction = true;
		}

		public void Commit()
		{
			HashSet<InMemoryRow> hashSet = new HashSet<InMemoryRow>();
			for (int i = 0; i < rollbackOrder.Count; i++)
			{
				InMemoryRollbackOrderInfo inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo = rollbackOrder[i];
				switch (inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo.NewState)
				{
				case InMemoryItemState.Deleted:
					inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo.Row.CheckPRelations();
					hashSet.Add(inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo.Row);
					break;
				case InMemoryItemState.Updated:
					inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo.Row.CheckPRelationsModified();
					break;
				}
			}
			int j = 0;
			try
			{
				for (j = 0; j < rollbackOrder.Count; j++)
				{
					InMemoryRollbackOrderInfo inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo2 = rollbackOrder[j];
					switch (inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo2.NewState)
					{
					case InMemoryItemState.Inserted:
						inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo2.Row.CheckAndEnterFRelations();
						break;
					case InMemoryItemState.Updated:
						if (!hashSet.Contains(inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo2.Row))
						{
							inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo2.Row.CheckAndEnterFRelations();
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				j--;
				for (int num = j; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					InMemoryRollbackOrderInfo inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo3 = rollbackOrder[num];
					switch (inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo3.NewState)
					{
					case InMemoryItemState.Inserted:
						inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo3.Row.LeaveFRelations();
						break;
					case InMemoryItemState.Updated:
						inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo3.Row.LeaveFRelations();
						break;
					}
				}
				throw;
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < rollbackOrder.Count; k++)
			{
				InMemoryRollbackOrderInfo inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo4 = rollbackOrder[k];
				switch (inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo4.NewState)
				{
				case InMemoryItemState.Deleted:
					inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo4.Row.Table.Rows.RemoveInternal(inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo4.Row);
					break;
				case InMemoryItemState.Inserted:
				case InMemoryItemState.Updated:
					inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo4.Row.Commit(inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo4);
					break;
				}
			}
			rollbackOrder.Clear();
			inTransaction = false;
		}

		public void Rollback()
		{
			for (int num = rollbackOrder.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				InMemoryRollbackOrderInfo inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo = rollbackOrder[num];
				if (inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo.IsNewRow)
				{
					inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo.Row.Table.Rows.RemoveInternal(inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo.Row);
				}
				else
				{
					inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo.Row.Rollback(inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo);
				}
			}
			for (int num2 = rollbackOrder.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				InMemoryRollbackOrderInfo inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo2 = rollbackOrder[num2];
				switch (inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo2.NewState)
				{
				case InMemoryItemState.Deleted:
					inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo2.Row.CheckAndEnterFRelations();
					break;
				case InMemoryItemState.Updated:
					inMemoryRollbackOrderInfo2.Row.CheckAndEnterFRelations();
					break;
				}
			}
			rollbackOrder.Clear();
			inTransaction = false;
		}

		public void BeginUpdateSchema()
		{
			updatingSchemaStatus = new UpdatingSchemaStatus();
		}

		public void EndUpdateSchema()
		{
			UpdatingSchemaStatus updatingSchemaStatus = this.updatingSchemaStatus;
			this.updatingSchemaStatus = null;
			if (updatingSchemaStatus != null && updatingSchemaStatus.FixRelations)
			{
				FixRelations();
			}
		}

		public void AddRelation(InMemoryRelationPair[] pairs)
		{
			Array.Sort(pairs, new InMemoryRelationPairPNameComparer());
			InMemoryRelation inMemoryRelation = new InMemoryRelation(pairs);
			InMemoryColumn[] pColumns = inMemoryRelation.GetPColumns();
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (IInMemoryIndex item in inMemoryRelation.PTable.IndexesInternal)
			{
				if (item.EqualsColumns(pColumns))
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				inMemoryRelation.PTable.CreateIndex(pColumns, unique: false);
			}
			try
			{
				relationsUniqueDict.Add(inMemoryRelation.Name, inMemoryRelation);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException innerException)
			{
				throw new InMemoryDuplicateNameException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_AddRelation"), innerException);
			}
			foreach (InMemoryRelationPair inMemoryRelationPair in pairs)
			{
				AddColumnToDictionary(pDict, inMemoryRelationPair.PKey, inMemoryRelation);
				AddColumnToDictionary(fDict, inMemoryRelationPair.FKey, inMemoryRelation);
			}
			try
			{
				inMemoryRelation.CheckRelation();
				FixRelations();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				RemoveRelation(inMemoryRelation.Pairs);
				throw;
			}
		}

		public List<InMemoryRelation> GetPRelations(InMemoryColumn pKey)
		{
			List<InMemoryRelation> relationsInternal = GetRelationsInternal(pDict, pKey);
			return relationsInternal ?? emptyRelationList;
		}

		public List<InMemoryRelation> GetFRelations(InMemoryColumn fKey)
		{
			List<InMemoryRelation> relationsInternal = GetRelationsInternal(fDict, fKey);
			return relationsInternal ?? emptyRelationList;
		}

		public InMemoryRelation GetRelation(string name)
		{
			if (relationsUniqueDict.TryGetValue(name, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool RemoveRelation(InMemoryRelationPair[] pairs)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			List<List<InMemoryRelation>> list2 = new List<List<InMemoryRelation>>();
			InMemoryRelation inMemoryRelation = null;
			Array.Sort(pairs, new InMemoryRelationPairPNameComparer());
			foreach (InMemoryRelation value in relationsUniqueDict.Values)
			{
				if (value.Pairs.Length != pairs.Length)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = true;
				for (int i = 0; i < pairs.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!pairs[i].PKey.Equals(value.Pairs[i].PKey) || !pairs[i].FKey.Equals(value.Pairs[i].FKey))
					{
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					inMemoryRelation = value;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (inMemoryRelation == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (InMemoryRelationPair inMemoryRelationPair in pairs)
			{
				int num = -1;
				int num2 = -1;
				List<InMemoryRelation> relationsInternal = GetRelationsInternal(pDict, inMemoryRelationPair.PKey);
				if (relationsInternal != null)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < relationsInternal.Count; k++)
					{
						if (inMemoryRelation == relationsInternal[k])
						{
							num = k;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				List<InMemoryRelation> relationsInternal2 = GetRelationsInternal(fDict, inMemoryRelationPair.FKey);
				if (relationsInternal2 != null)
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < relationsInternal2.Count; l++)
					{
						if (inMemoryRelation == relationsInternal2[l])
						{
							num2 = l;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (num >= 0 && num2 >= 0)
				{
					list.Add(num);
					list.Add(num2);
					list2.Add(relationsInternal);
					list2.Add(relationsInternal2);
					continue;
				}
				return false;
			}
			for (int m = 0; m < list.Count; m++)
			{
				list2[m].RemoveAt(list[m]);
			}
			relationsUniqueDict.Remove(inMemoryRelation.Name);
			FixRelations();
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveRelations(InMemoryColumn column)
		{
			RemoveRelations(column, doFix: true);
		}

		public void RemoveRelations(IEnumerable<InMemoryColumn> columns)
		{
			foreach (InMemoryColumn column in columns)
			{
				RemoveRelations(column, doFix: false);
			}
			FixRelations();
		}

		private void RemoveRelations(InMemoryColumn column, bool doFix)
		{
			List<InMemoryRelation> relationsInternal = GetRelationsInternal(fDict, column);
			List<InMemoryRelation> relationsInternal2 = GetRelationsInternal(pDict, column);
			fDict.Remove(column);
			pDict.Remove(column);
			if (relationsInternal != null)
			{
				foreach (InMemoryRelation item in relationsInternal)
				{
					InMemoryRelationPair[] pairs = item.Pairs;
					foreach (InMemoryRelationPair inMemoryRelationPair in pairs)
					{
						GetRelationsInternal(pDict, inMemoryRelationPair.PKey).Remove(item);
						relationsUniqueDict.Remove(item.Name);
					}
				}
			}
			if (relationsInternal2 != null)
			{
				foreach (InMemoryRelation item2 in relationsInternal2)
				{
					InMemoryRelationPair[] pairs2 = item2.Pairs;
					foreach (InMemoryRelationPair inMemoryRelationPair2 in pairs2)
					{
						GetRelationsInternal(fDict, inMemoryRelationPair2.FKey).Remove(item2);
						relationsUniqueDict.Remove(item2.Name);
					}
				}
			}
			if (doFix)
			{
				FixRelations();
			}
		}

		private void FixRelations()
		{
			if (updatingSchemaStatus != null)
			{
				updatingSchemaStatus.FixRelations = true;
				return;
			}
			foreach (InMemoryTable value in tables.Values)
			{
				value.FixRelations();
			}
		}

		public void ClearRelations()
		{
			ClearRelations(doFixRelations: true);
		}

		public void ClearRelations(bool doFixRelations)
		{
			relationsUniqueDict.Clear();
			pDict.Clear();
			fDict.Clear();
			if (doFixRelations)
			{
				FixRelations();
			}
		}

		public void ClearTables()
		{
			tables.Clear();
		}

		private static List<InMemoryRelation> GetRelationsInternal(Dictionary<InMemoryColumn, List<InMemoryRelation>> dict, InMemoryColumn column)
		{
			if (dict.TryGetValue(column, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static void AddColumnToDictionary(Dictionary<InMemoryColumn, List<InMemoryRelation>> dict, InMemoryColumn column, InMemoryRelation relation)
		{
			if (!dict.TryGetValue(column, out var value))
			{
				value = new List<InMemoryRelation>();
				dict.Add(column, value);
			}
			else
			{
				value.Contains(relation);
			}
			value.Add(relation);
		}

		private static string GetTypeString(Type type, out int size)
		{
			size = 0;
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(type))
			{
			case TypeCode.Int32:
				return "xs:int";
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
				return "xs:unsignedInt";
			case TypeCode.String:
				return "xs:string";
			case TypeCode.Object:
				return GetObjectTypeString(type);
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				return "xs:boolean";
			case TypeCode.Byte:
				return "xs:unsignedByte";
			case TypeCode.Char:
				size = 1;
				return "xs:string";
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
				return "xs:dateTime";
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return "xs:decimal";
			case TypeCode.Double:
				return "xs:double";
			case TypeCode.Int16:
				return "xs:short";
			case TypeCode.Int64:
				return "xs:long";
			case TypeCode.SByte:
				return "xs:byte";
			case TypeCode.Single:
				return "xs:float";
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
				return "xs:unsignedShort";
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
				return "xs:unsignedLong";
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static Type GetTypeFromString(string str, out Type convertFromType)
		{
			convertFromType = null;
			switch (str)
			{
			case "xs:int":
			case "xs:integer":
				return typeof(int);
			case "xs:unsignedInt":
				return typeof(uint);
			case "xs:string":
				return typeof(string);
			case "xs:hexBinary":
			case "xs:base64Binary":
				return typeof(byte[]);
			case "xs:boolean":
				return typeof(bool);
			case "xs:unsignedByte":
				return typeof(byte);
			case "xs:dateTime":
			case "xs:date":
				return typeof(DateTime);
			case "xs:decimal":
				return typeof(decimal);
			case "xs:double":
				return typeof(double);
			case "xs:duration":
				if (ConnectionProviderSql.UseLegacyTimeSpanSupport)
				{
					return typeof(TimeSpan);
				}
				convertFromType = typeof(TimeSpan);
				return typeof(double);
			case "xs:short":
				return typeof(short);
			case "xs:long":
				return typeof(long);
			case "xs:byte":
				return typeof(sbyte);
			case "xs:float":
				return typeof(float);
			case "xs:unsignedShort":
				return typeof(ushort);
			case "xs:unsignedLong":
				return typeof(ulong);
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_InvalidTypeString"));
			}
		}

		private static string GetObjectTypeString(Type type)
		{
			if ((object)typeof(byte[]) == type)
			{
				return "xs:base64Binary";
			}
			if ((object)typeof(TimeSpan) == type)
			{
				return "xs:double";
			}
			return null;
		}

		public XmlSchema GetSchema()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public string GetXmlSchema()
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			XmlWriterSettings xmlWriterSettings = new XmlWriterSettings();
			xmlWriterSettings.Indent = true;
			XmlWriter xmlWriter = XmlWriter.Create(memoryStream, xmlWriterSettings);
			GetXmlSchemaCore(xmlWriter);
			xmlWriter.Flush();
			xmlWriter.Close();
			memoryStream.Flush();
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(memoryStream);
			return streamReader.ReadToEnd();
		}

		private void GetXmlSchemaCore(XmlWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement("xs", "schema", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
			writer.WriteAttributeString("id", InMemorySetName);
			writer.WriteAttributeString("xmlns", "msdata", null, "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xml-msdata");
			writer.WriteStartElement("element", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
			writer.WriteAttributeString("name", InMemorySetName);
			writer.WriteAttributeString("IsDataSet", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xml-msdata", "true");
			writer.WriteAttributeString("UseCurrentLocale", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xml-msdata", "true");
			writer.WriteStartElement("complexType", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
			writer.WriteStartElement("choice", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
			writer.WriteAttributeString("minOccurs", "0");
			writer.WriteAttributeString("maxOccurs", "unbounded");
			foreach (InMemoryTable table in Tables)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement("element", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
				writer.WriteAttributeString("name", XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(table.Name));
				writer.WriteStartElement("complexType", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
				writer.WriteStartElement("sequence", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
				foreach (InMemoryColumn column in table.Columns)
				{
					writer.WriteStartElement("element", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
					writer.WriteAttributeString("name", XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(column.Name));
					if (column.AutoIncrement)
					{
						writer.WriteAttributeString("AutoIncrement", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xml-msdata", "true");
						writer.WriteAttributeString("AutoIncrementSeed", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xml-msdata", "1");
					}
					string typeString = GetTypeString(column.Type, out var size);
					if (typeString == null)
					{
						typeString = (((object)column.Type != typeof(Guid)) ? "xs:anyType" : "xs:string");
						writer.WriteAttributeString("DataType", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xml-msdata", column.Type.AssemblyQualifiedName);
						writer.WriteAttributeString("type", typeString);
						writer.WriteAttributeString("minOccurs", "0");
					}
					else if (size == 0)
					{
						if (column.MaxLength > 0)
						{
							writer.WriteAttributeString("minOccurs", "0");
							writer.WriteStartElement("simpleType", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
							writer.WriteStartElement("restriction", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
							writer.WriteAttributeString("base", typeString);
							writer.WriteStartElement("maxLength", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
							writer.WriteAttributeString("value", column.MaxLength.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
							writer.WriteEndElement();
							writer.WriteEndElement();
							writer.WriteEndElement();
						}
						else
						{
							writer.WriteAttributeString("type", typeString);
							writer.WriteAttributeString("minOccurs", "0");
						}
					}
					else
					{
						writer.WriteAttributeString("minOccurs", "0");
						writer.WriteStartElement("simpleType", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
						writer.WriteStartElement("restriction", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
						writer.WriteAttributeString("base", typeString);
						writer.WriteStartElement("length", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
						writer.WriteAttributeString("value", size.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
						writer.WriteEndElement();
						writer.WriteEndElement();
						writer.WriteEndElement();
					}
					writer.WriteEndElement();
				}
				writer.WriteEndElement();
				writer.WriteEndElement();
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
			writer.WriteEndElement();
			writer.WriteEndElement();
			foreach (InMemoryTable table2 in Tables)
			{
				foreach (InMemoryIndexWrapper index in table2.Indexes)
				{
					if (!index.Unique)
					{
						continue;
					}
					writer.WriteStartElement("unique", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
					writer.WriteAttributeString("name", XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(index.Name));
					if (table2.PrimaryKey != null && index.Name == table2.PrimaryKey.Name)
					{
						writer.WriteAttributeString("PrimaryKey", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xml-msdata", XmlConvert.ToString(value: true));
					}
					writer.WriteStartElement("selector", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
					writer.WriteAttributeString("xpath", ".//" + XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(table2.Name));
					writer.WriteEndElement();
					foreach (InMemoryColumn column2 in index.Columns)
					{
						writer.WriteStartElement("field", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
						writer.WriteAttributeString("xpath", XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(column2.Name));
						writer.WriteEndElement();
					}
					writer.WriteEndElement();
				}
			}
			foreach (InMemoryRelation relation in Relations)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement("unique", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
				writer.WriteAttributeString("name", XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(relation.Name + "Idx"));
				writer.WriteStartElement("selector", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
				writer.WriteAttributeString("xpath", ".//" + XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(relation.Pairs[0].PKey.Table.Name));
				writer.WriteEndElement();
				for (int i = 0; i < relation.Pairs.Length; i++)
				{
					writer.WriteStartElement("field", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
					writer.WriteAttributeString("xpath", XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(relation.Pairs[i].PKey.Name));
					writer.WriteEndElement();
				}
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
			foreach (InMemoryRelation relation2 in Relations)
			{
				writer.WriteStartElement("keyref", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
				writer.WriteAttributeString("name", XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(relation2.Name));
				writer.WriteAttributeString("refer", XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(relation2.Name + "Idx"));
				writer.WriteStartElement("selector", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
				writer.WriteAttributeString("xpath", ".//" + XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(relation2.Pairs[0].FKey.Table.Name));
				writer.WriteEndElement();
				for (int j = 0; j < relation2.Pairs.Length; j++)
				{
					writer.WriteStartElement("field", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
					writer.WriteAttributeString("xpath", XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(relation2.Pairs[j].FKey.Name));
					writer.WriteEndElement();
				}
				writer.WriteEndElement();
			}
			writer.WriteEndElement();
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public void WriteXml(string fileName)
		{
			using FileStream output = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.OpenOrCreate, FileAccess.Write);
			XmlWriterSettings xmlWriterSettings = new XmlWriterSettings();
			xmlWriterSettings.Indent = true;
			xmlWriterSettings.OmitXmlDeclaration = true;
			XmlWriter xmlWriter = XmlWriter.Create(output, xmlWriterSettings);
			WriteXml(xmlWriter);
			xmlWriter.Flush();
			xmlWriter.Close();
		}

		public void WriteXml(XmlWriter writer)
		{
			writer.WriteStartElement(InMemorySetName);
			GetXmlSchemaCore(writer);
			foreach (InMemoryTable table in Tables)
			{
				foreach (InMemoryRow row in table.Rows)
				{
					writer.WriteStartElement(XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(table.Name));
					for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
					{
						object obj = row[i];
						if (obj == null || obj is DBNull)
						{
							continue;
						}
						Type type = obj.GetType();
						if (type == table.Columns[i].Type)
						{
							switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(type))
							{
							case TypeCode.Char:
								writer.WriteStartElement(XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(table.Columns[i].Name));
								writer.WriteValue(new string((char)obj, 1));
								writer.WriteEndElement();
								break;
							default:
								writer.WriteStartElement(XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(table.Columns[i].Name));
								writer.WriteValue(obj);
								writer.WriteEndElement();
								break;
							case TypeCode.Object:
								if ((object)type == typeof(byte[]))
								{
									byte[] array = (byte[])obj;
									writer.WriteStartElement(XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(table.Columns[i].Name));
									writer.WriteBase64(array, 0, array.Length);
									writer.WriteEndElement();
									break;
								}
								if ((object)type == typeof(Guid))
								{
									writer.WriteStartElement(XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(table.Columns[i].Name));
									writer.WriteValue(XmlConvert.ToString((Guid)obj));
									writer.WriteEndElement();
									break;
								}
								if ((object)type == typeof(TimeSpan))
								{
									writer.WriteStartElement(XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(table.Columns[i].Name));
									writer.WriteValue(XmlConvert.ToString((TimeSpan)obj));
									writer.WriteEndElement();
									break;
								}
								if (!(obj is IXmlSerializable))
								{
									throw new InvalidOperationException(type.Name + " does not implement IXmlSerializable.");
								}
								writer.WriteStartElement(XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(table.Columns[i].Name));
								((IXmlSerializable)obj).WriteXml(writer);
								writer.WriteEndElement();
								break;
							}
							continue;
						}
						int size;
						string typeString = GetTypeString(type, out size);
						if (typeString == null)
						{
							if (!(obj is IXmlSerializable))
							{
								throw new InvalidOperationException(type.Name + " does not implement IXmlSerializable.");
							}
							writer.WriteStartElement(XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(table.Columns[i].Name));
							writer.WriteAttributeString("msdata", "InstanceType", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xml-msdata", type.AssemblyQualifiedName);
							((IXmlSerializable)obj).WriteXml(writer);
							writer.WriteEndElement();
						}
						else if (typeString == "xs:string" && size == 1)
						{
							writer.WriteStartElement(XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(table.Columns[i].Name));
							writer.WriteAttributeString("msdata", "InstanceType", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xml-msdata", "System.Char");
							writer.WriteValue(((char)obj).ToString());
							writer.WriteEndElement();
						}
						else if (typeString == "xs:base64Binary")
						{
							writer.WriteStartElement(XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(table.Columns[i].Name));
							writer.WriteAttributeString("xsi", "type", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance", typeString);
							writer.WriteAttributeString("xmlns", "xs", null, "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
							byte[] array2 = (byte[])obj;
							writer.WriteBase64(array2, 0, array2.Length);
							writer.WriteEndElement();
						}
						else
						{
							writer.WriteStartElement(XmlConvert.EncodeLocalName(table.Columns[i].Name));
							writer.WriteAttributeString("xsi", "type", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance", typeString);
							writer.WriteAttributeString("xmlns", "xs", null, "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema");
							writer.WriteValue(obj.ToString());
							writer.WriteEndElement();
						}
					}
					writer.WriteEndElement();
				}
			}
			writer.WriteEndElement();
		}

		public void ReadXml(string fileName)
		{
			using FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(fileName, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			using XmlReader rdr = SafeXml.CreateReader((Stream)fileStream);
			ReadXml(rdr);
		}

		public void ReadXml(XmlReader rdr)

			ClearTables();

				throw new XmlException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_XMLException_SchemaNodeNotFound"));
			}
			InMemorySetName = rdr.GetAttribute("id");

			}

			try
			{
				BeginUpdateSchema();
				try
				{
					while (true)
					{

							rdr.Read();

							break;

						{

							throw new XmlException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_XMLException_XSsequenceExpected"));

							if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
							{
								throw new XmlException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_XMLException_ColumnNameIsNotSpecified"));
							}
							string attribute = rdr.GetAttribute("AutoIncrement", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xml-msdata");
							string attribute2 = rdr.GetAttribute("type");
							Type type = null;
							Type convertFromType = null;
							if (attribute2 == null)
							{
								rdr.Read();
								if (rdr.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace)
								{
									rdr.Read();
								}
								if (rdr.Name != "xs:simpleType")
								{
									throw new XmlException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_XMLException_XSsimpleTypeExpected"));
								}
								rdr.Read();
								if (rdr.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace)
								{
									rdr.Read();
								}
								if (rdr.Name != "xs:restriction")
								{
									throw new XmlException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_XMLException_XSrestrictionExpected"));
								}
								if (rdr.GetAttribute("base") != "xs:string")
								{
									throw new XmlException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_XMLException_InvalidBaseAttributeValue"));
								}
								rdr.Read();
								if (rdr.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace)
								{
									rdr.Read();
								}
								if (rdr.Name == "xs:maxLength")
								{
									num = int.Parse(rdr.GetAttribute("value"));
								}
								else

									{
										throw new XmlException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_XMLException_XSlengthExpected"));
