								if (list3 == null)
								{
									throw new XmlException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_XMLException_NullPrimaryColumns", list2[k].ReferredIndex));
								}
								if (list3.Count != list2[k].Fields.Count)
								{
									throw new XmlException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_XMLException_InconsistentForeignKeyCount"));
								}
								InMemoryRelationPair[] array = new InMemoryRelationPair[list2[k].Fields.Count];
								for (int m = 0; m < list2[k].Fields.Count; m++)
								{
									array[m] = new InMemoryRelationPair(list3[m], list2[k].Fields[m]);
								}
								AddRelation(array);
							}
						}
						if (!flag2)
						{
							for (int n = 0; n < list.Count; n++)
							{
								IndexSerializationInfo indexSerializationInfo2 = list[n];
								InMemoryTable inMemoryTable3 = tables[indexSerializationInfo2.TableName];
								string primaryKey2 = inMemoryTable3.CreateIndex(indexSerializationInfo2.Fields.ToArray(), unique: true);
								if (indexSerializationInfo2.PrimaryKey)
								{
									inMemoryTable3.SetPrimaryKey(primaryKey2);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					EndUpdateSchema();
				}
				while ((!(rdr.Name == "xs:schema") || rdr.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement) && !rdr.EOF)
				{
					rdr.Read();
				}
				BeginTransaction();
				while (!rdr.EOF)
				{
					rdr.Read();
					if (rdr.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace)
					{
						rdr.Read();
					}
					string text10 = XmlConvert.DecodeName(rdr.Name);
					if (!tables.ContainsKey(text10))
					{
						break;
					}
					InMemoryRow inMemoryRow = null;
					while (true)
					{
						rdr.Read();
						if (rdr.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace)
						{
							rdr.Read();
						}
						string text11 = XmlConvert.DecodeName(rdr.Name);
						if (text11 == text10 && rdr.NodeType == XmlNodeType.EndElement)
						{
							break;
						}
						bool isEmptyElement = rdr.IsEmptyElement;
						InMemoryTable inMemoryTable4 = tables[text10];
						if (!inMemoryTable4.Columns.Contains(text11))
						{
							break;
						}
						if (inMemoryRow == null)
						{
							inMemoryRow = tables[text10].Rows.AddNewRow();
							inMemoryRow.BeginEdit();
						}
						InMemoryColumn inMemoryColumn = inMemoryTable4.Columns[text11];
						Type type2 = inMemoryColumn.Type;
						if (isEmptyElement)
						{
							if (type2 == typeof(string))
							{
								inMemoryRow[inMemoryColumn.ColumnIndex] = string.Empty;
							}
							continue;
						}
						dictionary.TryGetValue(inMemoryColumn, out var value);
						dictionary2.TryGetValue(inMemoryColumn, out var value2);
						inMemoryRow[inMemoryColumn.ColumnIndex] = ReadXmlValue(rdr, type2, value, value2);
						while ((!(XmlConvert.DecodeName(rdr.Name) == text11) || rdr.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement) && !rdr.EOF)
						{
							rdr.Read();
						}
					}
					inMemoryRow?.EndEdit();
					while ((!(XmlConvert.DecodeName(rdr.Name) == text10) || rdr.NodeType != XmlNodeType.EndElement) && !rdr.EOF)
					{
						rdr.Read();
					}
				}
				Commit();
			}
			finally
			{
				isLoadingMode = false;
			}
		}

		private static bool TryConvertFromHexBinary(string value, out byte[] result)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				result = null;
				return true;
			}
			if (value.Length % 2 != 0)
			{
				result = null;
				return false;
			}
			result = new byte[value.Length >> 1];
			for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i += 2)
			{
				if (!HexCharToInt(value[i], out var result2) || !HexCharToInt(value[i + 1], out var result3))
				{
					result = null;
					return false;
				}
				result[i >> 1] = (byte)((result2 << 4) + result3);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool HexCharToInt(char value, out int result)
		{
			if (value >= 'A' && value <= 'F')
			{
				result = value + 10 - 65;
				return true;
			}
			if (value >= 'a' && value <= 'f')
			{
				result = value + 10 - 97;
				return true;
			}
			if (value >= '0' && value <= '9')
			{
				result = value - 48;
				return true;
			}
			result = -1;
			return false;
		}

		private static object ReadXmlValue(XmlReader rdr, Type currentColumnType, Type convertFromColumnType, string columnTypeString)
		{
			TypeCode typeCode = DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(currentColumnType);
			if (typeCode != TypeCode.Object)
			{
				rdr.Read();
				if (rdr.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace)
				{
					rdr.Read();
				}
				switch (typeCode)
				{
				case TypeCode.Char:
					return rdr.Value[0];
				case TypeCode.UInt32:
					return XmlConvert.ToUInt32(rdr.Value);
				case TypeCode.Int16:
					return XmlConvert.ToInt16(rdr.Value);
				case TypeCode.SByte:
					return XmlConvert.ToInt16(rdr.Value);
				case TypeCode.UInt16:
					return XmlConvert.ToUInt16(rdr.Value);
				case TypeCode.UInt64:
					return XmlConvert.ToUInt64(rdr.Value);
				case TypeCode.String:
					return rdr.Value;
				case TypeCode.DateTime:
					return XmlConvert.ToDateTime(rdr.Value, XmlDateTimeSerializationMode.Unspecified);
				case TypeCode.Boolean:
					return XmlConvert.ToBoolean(rdr.Value.ToLowerInvariant());
				case TypeCode.Byte:
					return XmlConvert.ToByte(rdr.Value);
				case TypeCode.Decimal:
					return XmlConvert.ToDecimal(rdr.Value);
				case TypeCode.Single:
					return XmlConvert.ToSingle(rdr.Value);
				case TypeCode.Double:
					if (convertFromColumnType == typeof(TimeSpan))
					{
						return XmlConvert.ToTimeSpan(rdr.Value).TotalSeconds;
					}
					return XmlConvert.ToDouble(rdr.Value);
				case TypeCode.Int32:
					return XmlConvert.ToInt32(rdr.Value);
				case TypeCode.Int64:
					return XmlConvert.ToInt64(rdr.Value);
				case TypeCode.Empty:
				case TypeCode.DBNull:
					return null;
				default:
					throw new XmlException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_XMLException_CantRestoreObjectFromXML"));
				}
			}
			if (currentColumnType == typeof(TimeSpan))
			{
				rdr.Read();
				if (rdr.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace)
				{
					rdr.Read();
				}
				return XmlConvert.ToTimeSpan(rdr.Value);
			}
			if (currentColumnType == typeof(byte[]))
			{
				rdr.Read();
				if (rdr.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace)
				{
					rdr.Read();
				}
				if (columnTypeString == "xs:hexBinary" && TryConvertFromHexBinary(rdr.Value, out var result))
				{
					return result;
				}
				return Convert.FromBase64String(rdr.Value);
			}
			if (currentColumnType == typeof(Guid))
			{
				rdr.Read();
				if (rdr.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace)
				{
					rdr.Read();
				}
				return XmlConvert.ToGuid(rdr.Value);
			}
			if (currentColumnType == typeof(object))
			{
				string attribute = rdr.GetAttribute("type", "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance");
				string attribute2 = rdr.GetAttribute("InstanceType", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xml-msdata");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute))
				{
					rdr.Read();
					if (rdr.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace)
					{
						rdr.Read();
					}
					if (attribute == "xs:hexBinary")
					{
						if (!TryConvertFromHexBinary(rdr.Value, out var result2))
						{
							throw new XmlException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_XMLException_CantRestoreObjectFromXML"));
						}
						return result2;
					}
					if (attribute == "xs:base64Binary")
					{
						return Convert.FromBase64String(rdr.Value);
					}
					Type convertFromType;
					Type typeFromString = GetTypeFromString(attribute, out convertFromType);
					if (typeFromString == typeof(double) && convertFromType == typeof(TimeSpan))
					{
						return XmlConvert.ToTimeSpan(rdr.Value).TotalSeconds;
					}
					return ((IConvertible)rdr.Value).ToType(typeFromString, (IFormatProvider)CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute2))
				{
					if (attribute2 == "System.Char")
					{
						rdr.Read();
						if (rdr.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Whitespace)
						{
							rdr.Read();
						}
						return rdr.Value[0];
					}
					Type knownUserType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownUserType(attribute2, false);
					ConstructorInfo[] constructors = knownUserType.GetConstructors();
					for (int i = 0; i < constructors.Length; i++)
					{
						if (constructors[i].GetParameters().Length == 0)
						{
							IXmlSerializable xmlSerializable = (IXmlSerializable)constructors[i].Invoke(null);
							xmlSerializable.ReadXml(rdr);
							return xmlSerializable;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ConstructorInfo[] constructors2 = currentColumnType.GetConstructors();
				for (int j = 0; j < constructors2.Length; j++)
				{
					if (constructors2[j].GetParameters().Length == 0)
					{
						IXmlSerializable xmlSerializable2 = (IXmlSerializable)constructors2[j].Invoke(null);
						xmlSerializable2.ReadXml(rdr);
						return xmlSerializable2;
					}
				}
			}
			throw new XmlException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_XMLException_CantRestoreObjectFromXML"));
		}

		public void ReadFromInMemorySet(InMemorySet otherSet)
		{
			if (InTransaction || otherSet.InTransaction)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			ClearRelations();
			ClearTables();
			InMemorySetName = otherSet.InMemorySetName;
			isLoadingMode = true;
			try
			{
				BeginUpdateSchema();
				try
				{
					foreach (InMemoryTable table in otherSet.Tables)
					{
						InMemoryTable inMemoryTable = CreateTable(table.Name);
						foreach (InMemoryColumn column in table.Columns)
						{
							if (column.AutoIncrement)
							{
								inMemoryTable.Columns.Add(column.Name, column.Type, autoIncrement: true);
							}
							else
							{
								inMemoryTable.Columns.Add(column.Name, column.Type);
							}
						}
						inMemoryTable.Columns.CommitColumnsChanges();
						foreach (InMemoryIndexWrapper index in table.Indexes)
						{
							InMemoryColumn[] array = new InMemoryColumn[index.Columns.Count];
							for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
							{
								array[i] = inMemoryTable.Columns[index.Columns[i].ColumnIndex];
							}
							inMemoryTable.CreateIndex(array, index.Unique);
							if (table.PrimaryKey != null)
							{
								inMemoryTable.SetPrimaryKey(table.PrimaryKey.Name);
							}
						}
					}
					foreach (InMemoryRelation relation in otherSet.Relations)
					{
						InMemoryTable inMemoryTable2 = tables[relation.PTable.Name];
						InMemoryTable inMemoryTable3 = tables[relation.FTable.Name];
						InMemoryRelationPair[] array2 = new InMemoryRelationPair[relation.Pairs.Length];
						for (int j = 0; j < relation.Pairs.Length; j++)
						{
							array2[j] = new InMemoryRelationPair(inMemoryTable2.Columns[relation.Pairs[j].PKey.ColumnIndex], inMemoryTable3.Columns[relation.Pairs[j].FKey.ColumnIndex]);
						}
						AddRelation(array2);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					EndUpdateSchema();
				}
				BeginTransaction();
				try
				{
					foreach (InMemoryTable table2 in otherSet.Tables)
					{
						InMemoryTable inMemoryTable4 = tables[table2.Name];
						int count = table2.Columns.Count;
						foreach (InMemoryRow row in table2.Rows)
						{
							object[] array3 = new object[count];
							for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
							{
								array3[k] = row[k];
							}
							inMemoryTable4.Rows.AddNewRow(array3);
						}
					}
					Commit();
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					Rollback();
					throw;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isLoadingMode = false;
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IInMemoryTable
	{
		string Name { get; }

		bool ExistsColumn(string columnName);

		IEnumerable<string> GetColumnNames();
	}
	public class InMemoryTable : IInMemoryTable
	{
		private readonly string name;

		private readonly InMemoryColumnList columns;

		private readonly InMemoryRowList rows;

		private readonly InMemorySet baseSet;

		private InMemoryIndexWrapper primaryKey;

		private readonly InMemoryIndexWrapperCollection indexWrappers;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, IInMemoryIndex> indexes = new Dictionary<string, IInMemoryIndex>();

		private ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation> pRelations;

		private ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation> fRelations;

		private ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation> allRelations;

		public InMemoryIndexWrapper PrimaryKey => primaryKey;

		internal IEnumerable<IInMemoryIndex> IndexesInternal => indexes.Values;

		public InMemoryIndexWrapperCollection Indexes => indexWrappers;

		public string Name => name;

		public InMemoryColumnList Columns => columns;

		public InMemoryRowList Rows => rows;

		public InMemorySet BaseSet => baseSet;

		public ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation> PRelations => pRelations;

		public ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation> FRelations => fRelations;

		public ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation> AllRelations => allRelations;

		public InMemoryTable(InMemorySet set, string name)
		{
			baseSet = set;
			this.name = name;
			columns = new InMemoryColumnList(this);
			rows = new InMemoryRowList(this);
			indexWrappers = new InMemoryIndexWrapperCollection(indexes);
			pRelations = new ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation>(new InMemoryRelation[0]);
			fRelations = new ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation>(new InMemoryRelation[0]);
			allRelations = new ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation>(new InMemoryRelation[0]);
		}

		public void SetPrimaryKey(string name)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				primaryKey = null;
			}
			else
			{
				primaryKey = new InMemoryIndexWrapper(indexes[name]);
			}
		}

		public InMemoryColumn GetNewColumn(string name, Type type)
		{
			return new InMemoryColumn(this, name, type);
		}

		public string CreateIndex(InMemoryColumn[] columns, bool unique)
		{
			InMemoryDictionaryIndex inMemoryDictionaryIndex = new InMemoryDictionaryIndex(this, columns, unique);
			try
			{
				indexes.Add(inMemoryDictionaryIndex.Name, inMemoryDictionaryIndex);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				throw new InMemoryDuplicateNameException(inMemoryDictionaryIndex.Name);
			}
			try
			{
				FixIndexes();
				FillIndex(inMemoryDictionaryIndex);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				throw;
			}
			return inMemoryDictionaryIndex.Name;
		}

		public bool RemoveIndex(string name)
		{
			if (indexes.TryGetValue(name, out var _))
			{
				indexes.Remove(name);
				FixIndexes();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public InMemoryRelation GetPRelation(string name)
		{
			InMemoryRelation relation = baseSet.GetRelation(name);
			if (relation.PTable == this)
			{
				return relation;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public InMemoryRelation GetFRelation(string name)
		{
			InMemoryRelation relation = baseSet.GetRelation(name);
			if (relation.FTable == this)
			{
				return relation;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private InMemoryRelation[] GetPRelations()
		{
			List<InMemoryRelation> list = new List<InMemoryRelation>();
			foreach (InMemoryRelation relation in baseSet.Relations)
			{
				if (relation.PTable == this)
				{
					list.Add(relation);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private InMemoryRelation[] GetFRelations()
		{
			List<InMemoryRelation> list = new List<InMemoryRelation>();
			foreach (InMemoryRelation relation in baseSet.Relations)
			{
				if (relation.FTable == this)
				{
					list.Add(relation);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private InMemoryRelation[] GetAllRelations()
		{
			List<InMemoryRelation> list = new List<InMemoryRelation>();
			foreach (InMemoryRelation relation in baseSet.Relations)
			{
				if (relation.PTable == this || relation.FTable == this)
				{
					list.Add(relation);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal void FixColumns()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < rows.Count; i++)
			{
				rows[i].FixColumns();
			}
			foreach (IInMemoryIndex value in indexes.Values)
			{
				value.FixColumnsOrder();
			}
		}

		internal void FixRelations()
		{
			pRelations = new ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation>(GetPRelations());
			fRelations = new ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation>(GetFRelations());
			allRelations = new ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation>(GetAllRelations());
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				columns[i].FixColumnRelations();
			}
		}

		private void FixIndexes()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				columns[i].FixIndexes();
			}
		}

		private void FillIndex(IInMemoryIndex index)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < rows.Count; i++)
			{
				index.AddRow(rows[i]);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return name;
		}

		bool IInMemoryTable.ExistsColumn(string columnName)
		{
			return Columns.FindColumnIndex(columnName) >= 0;
		}

		IEnumerable<string> IInMemoryTable.GetColumnNames()
		{
			return Columns.Select((InMemoryColumn c) => c.Name);
		}
	}

		public InMemoryRelationCollection(IEnumerable<InMemoryRelation> collection)
			: base(collection)
		{
		}
	}

	{
	}
	public class InMemoryRowList : IEnumerable<InMemoryRow>, IEnumerable
	{
		private InMemoryTable table;

		private List<InMemoryRow> rows = new List<InMemoryRow>();

		public InMemoryRow this[int index] => rows[index];

		public int Count => rows.Count;

		public InMemoryRowList(InMemoryTable table)
		{
			this.table = table;
		}

		public InMemoryRow AddNewRow(ICollection<object> initData)
		{
			InMemoryRow inMemoryRow = new InMemoryRow(table, initData);
			rows.Add(inMemoryRow);
			CommitIfNotInTransaction();
			return inMemoryRow;
		}

		private void CommitIfNotInTransaction()
		{
			if (table.BaseSet.InTransaction)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				table.BaseSet.Commit();
			}
			catch
			{
				table.BaseSet.Rollback();
				throw;
			}
		}

		public InMemoryRow AddNewRow()
		{
			return AddNewRow(null);
		}

		public InMemoryRow InsertNewRow(int index, ICollection<object> initData)
		{
			InMemoryRow inMemoryRow = new InMemoryRow(table, initData);
			rows.Insert(index, inMemoryRow);
			CommitIfNotInTransaction();
			return inMemoryRow;
		}

		public InMemoryRow InsertNewRow(int index)
		{
			return InsertNewRow(index, null);
		}

		internal void RemoveInternal(InMemoryRow row)
		{
			rows.Remove(row);
			row.Dispose();
		}

		private void RemoveAtInternal(int index, InMemoryRow row)
		{
			rows.RemoveAt(index);
			row.Dispose();
		}

		public bool Remove(InMemoryRow row)
		{
			row.Delete();
			CommitIfNotInTransaction();
			return true;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			InMemoryRow inMemoryRow = this[index];
			inMemoryRow.Delete();
			CommitIfNotInTransaction();
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < rows.Count; i++)
			{
				rows[i].Dispose();
			}
			rows.Clear();
			foreach (InMemoryColumn column in table.Columns)
			{
				if (column.Indexes.HasIndexes)
				{
					column.Indexes.Clear();
				}
			}
		}

		public InMemoryRow FindFirst(InMemoryColumn column, object value)
		{
			return FindFirst(new InMemoryColumn[1] { column }, new object[1] { value });
		}

		public InMemoryRow[] Find(InMemoryColumn column, object value)
		{
			return Find(new InMemoryColumn[1] { column }, new object[1] { value });
		}

		public InMemoryRow[] FindWithDeleted(InMemoryColumn column, object value)
		{
			return FindWithDeleted(new InMemoryColumn[1] { column }, new object[1] { value });
		}

		public InMemoryRow FindFirst(InMemoryColumn[] columns, object[] values)
		{
			InMemoryRow[] array = Find(columns, values, findFirst: true, returnDeleted: false);
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return array[0];
		}

		public InMemoryRow[] Find(InMemoryColumn[] columns, object[] values)
		{
			return Find(columns, values, findFirst: false, returnDeleted: false);
		}

		public InMemoryRow[] FindWithDeleted(InMemoryColumn[] columns, object[] values)
		{
			return Find(columns, values, findFirst: false, returnDeleted: true);
		}

		private InMemoryRow[] Find(InMemoryColumn[] columns, object[] values, bool findFirst, bool returnDeleted)
		{
			foreach (IInMemoryIndex item in table.IndexesInternal)
			{
				if (item.EqualsColumns(columns))
				{
					return item.Find(values, returnDeleted);
				}
			}
			return InMemoryHelper.FindInRows(rows, columns, values, findFirst, returnDeleted, table.BaseSet.CaseSensitive).ToArray();
		}

		public InMemoryIndexWrapper FindIndex(InMemoryColumn[] columns)
		{
			foreach (IInMemoryIndex item in table.IndexesInternal)
			{
				if (item.EqualsColumns(columns))
				{
					return item.Wrapper;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public IEnumerator<InMemoryRow> GetEnumerator()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < rows.Count; i++)
			{
				yield return rows[i];
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < rows.Count; i++)
			{
				yield return rows[i];
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class StringComparer : IEqualityComparer<string>
	{
		public static StringComparer Default = new StringComparer();

		public bool Equals(string x, string y)
		{
			return x == y;
		}

		public int GetHashCode(string obj)
		{
			return obj.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class InMemoryColumnList : IEnumerable<InMemoryColumn>, IEnumerable
	{
		private InMemoryTable table;

		private Dictionary<string, int> indexDict = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.Default);

		private List<InMemoryColumn> columns = new List<InMemoryColumn>();

		public InMemoryTable Table => table;

		public InMemoryColumn this[int index] => columns[index];

		public InMemoryColumn this[string name] => FindColunm(name);

		public int Count => columns.Count;

		public InMemoryColumnList(InMemoryTable table)
		{
			this.table = table;
		}

		public void Add(string name, Type type)
		{
			if (indexDict.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				throw new InMemoryDuplicateNameException(name);
			}
			AddColumn(new InMemoryColumn(table, name, type));
		}

		public void Add(string name, Type type, bool autoIncrement)
		{
			if (indexDict.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				throw new InMemoryDuplicateNameException(name);
			}
			AddColumn(new InMemoryColumn(table, name, type, autoIncrement));
		}

		public void Add(string name, Type type, bool allowNull, object defaultValue)
		{
			if (indexDict.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				throw new InMemoryDuplicateNameException(name);
			}
			AddColumn(new InMemoryColumn(table, name, type, allowNull, defaultValue));
		}

		public void Insert(int index, string name, Type type)
		{
			if (indexDict.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				throw new InMemoryDuplicateNameException(name);
			}
			InsertColumn(index, new InMemoryColumn(table, name, type));
		}

		public void Insert(int index, string name, Type type, bool autoIncrement)
		{
			if (indexDict.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				throw new InMemoryDuplicateNameException(name);
			}
			InsertColumn(index, new InMemoryColumn(table, name, type, autoIncrement));
		}

		public void Insert(int index, string name, Type type, bool allowNull, object defaultValue)
		{
			if (indexDict.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				throw new InMemoryDuplicateNameException(name);
			}
			InsertColumn(index, new InMemoryColumn(table, name, type, allowNull, defaultValue));
		}

		private void AddColumn(InMemoryColumn column)
		{
			indexDict[column.Name] = columns.Count;
			columns.Add(column);
		}

		private void InsertColumn(int index, InMemoryColumn column)
		{
			columns.Insert(index, column);
			for (int i = index; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				indexDict[columns[i].Name] = i;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIndexDict()
		{
			indexDict.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				indexDict[columns[i].Name] = i;
			}
		}

		public int FindColumnIndex(string name)
		{
			if (indexDict.TryGetValue(name, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private InMemoryColumn FindColunm(string name)
		{
			int num = FindColumnIndex(name);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return columns[num];
		}

		public IEnumerator<InMemoryColumn> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return columns.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return columns.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void SetAllDeleted()
		{
			foreach (InMemoryColumn column in columns)
			{
				column.Delete();
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(InMemoryColumn column)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (columns[i] == column)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Contains(string columnName)
		{
			return indexDict.ContainsKey(columnName);
		}

		public void CommitColumnsChanges()
		{
			foreach (InMemoryColumn column in columns)
			{
				if (column.State == InMemoryItemState.Updated)
				{
					if (column.ColumnForUpdate.Name != column.Name && FindColumnIndex(column.ColumnForUpdate.Name) >= 0)
					{
						throw new InMemoryDuplicateNameException(column.ColumnForUpdate.Name);
					}
					if ((column.FRelations != null && column.FRelations.Count > 0) || (column.PRelations != null && column.PRelations.Count > 0))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_CantUpdateRelationColumn"));
					}
				}
			}
			table.FixColumns();
			List<InMemoryColumn> list = new List<InMemoryColumn>();
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				InMemoryColumn inMemoryColumn = columns[i];
				switch (inMemoryColumn.State)
				{
				case InMemoryItemState.Updated:
					if (inMemoryColumn.ColumnForUpdate != null)
					{
						inMemoryColumn = inMemoryColumn.ColumnForUpdate;
						columns[i] = inMemoryColumn;
					}
					break;
				case InMemoryItemState.Deleted:
					list.Add(inMemoryColumn);
					columns.RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
					break;
				}
			}
			UpdateIndexDict();
			for (int j = 0; j < columns.Count; j++)
			{
				columns[j].ColumnsCommitted();
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				table.BaseSet.RemoveRelations(list);
			}
		}

		public InMemoryColumn[] ToArray()
		{
			return columns.ToArray();
		}
	}
	public class InMemoryRollbackItem
	{
		public bool Updated;

		public object Data;

		public void Reset()
		{
			Updated = false;
			Data = null;
		}
	}
	public class InMemoryRollbackOrderInfo
	{
		private InMemoryItemState oldState;

		private InMemoryItemState newState;

		private InMemoryRow row;

		private bool isNewRow;

		public bool IsNewRow => isNewRow;

		public InMemoryRow Row => row;

		public InMemoryItemState OldState => oldState;

		public InMemoryItemState NewState => newState;

		public InMemoryRollbackOrderInfo(InMemoryRow row, InMemoryItemState oldState, InMemoryItemState newState, bool isNewRow)
		{
			this.row = row;
			this.oldState = oldState;
			this.newState = newState;
			this.isNewRow = isNewRow;
		}
	}
	[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Size = 1)]
	public struct InMemoryAutoIncrementValue
	{
		private static InMemoryAutoIncrementValue value;

		public static InMemoryAutoIncrementValue Value => value;
	}
	public class InMemoryRowModificationInfo
	{
		public object[] OldData;

		public bool[] Modified;

		public InMemoryRowModificationInfo()
		{
		}

		public InMemoryRowModificationInfo(object[] data)
		{
			OldData = new object[data.Length];
			data.CopyTo(OldData, 0);
			Modified = new bool[data.Length];
		}
	}
	public interface IInMemoryRow
	{
		IInMemoryTable Table { get; }

		object this[int columnIndex] { get; set; }

		object this[string columnName] { get; set; }

		void BeginEdit();

		void EndEdit();

		void CancelEdit();
	}
	public class InMemoryRow : IDisposable, IInMemoryRow
	{
		private const string StringValueIsTooLong = "String value is too long.";

		private const string ColumnIsAutoincremented = "Column is autoincremented.";

		private const string RowIsDeleted = "Row is deleted.";

		private const string NotInEditMode = "Not in edit mode.";

		private InMemoryTable table;

		private object[] data;

		private InMemoryRowModificationInfo editInfo;

		private InMemoryRowModificationInfo modificationInfo;

		private InMemoryItemState state = InMemoryItemState.Inserted;

		public InMemoryItemState State => state;

		public InMemoryTable Table => table;

		IInMemoryTable IInMemoryRow.Table => Table;

		public bool EditMode => editInfo != null;

		public object this[int columnIndex]
		{
			get
			{
				return data[columnIndex];
			}
			set
			{
				SetData(columnIndex, value);
			}
		}

		public object this[string columnName]
		{
			get
			{
				InMemoryColumn inMemoryColumn = table.Columns[columnName];
				if (inMemoryColumn == null)
				{
					throw new InMemorySetException(string.Format(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_ColumnNotFound"), columnName));
				}
				return this[inMemoryColumn.ColumnIndex];
			}
			set
			{
				InMemoryColumn inMemoryColumn = table.Columns[columnName];
				if (inMemoryColumn == null)
				{
					throw new InMemorySetException(string.Format(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_ColumnNotFound"), columnName));
				}
				this[inMemoryColumn.ColumnIndex] = value;
			}
		}

		public InMemoryRow(InMemoryTable table)
			: this(table, null)
		{
		}

		public InMemoryRow(InMemoryTable table, ICollection<object> initData)
		{
			this.table = table;
			if (initData == null)
			{
				data = new object[table.Columns.Count];
				modificationInfo = new InMemoryRowModificationInfo(data);
				CheckValues(setDefaults: true, checkAutoIncrement: true);
			}
			else
			{
				if (table.Columns.Count != initData.Count)
				{
					throw new InMemorySetException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_WrongInitData"));
				}
				data = new object[initData.Count];
				initData.CopyTo(data, 0);
				modificationInfo = new InMemoryRowModificationInfo(data);
				CheckValues(setDefaults: false, checkAutoIncrement: true);
			}
			if (!table.BaseSet.IsLoadingMode)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < data.Length; i++)
				{
					if (table.Columns[i].AutoIncrement)
					{
						data[i] = table.Columns[i].GetAutoIncrementNextValue();
					}
				}
			}
			try
			{
				AddToIndex();
			}
			catch
			{
				RemoveFromIndex();
				throw;
			}
			table.BaseSet.RollbackOrder.Add(new InMemoryRollbackOrderInfo(this, InMemoryItemState.Default, InMemoryItemState.Inserted, isNewRow: true));
		}

		private void CheckValues(bool setDefaults, bool checkAutoIncrement)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < data.Length; i++)
			{
				InMemoryColumn inMemoryColumn = table.Columns[i];
				if (setDefaults)
				{
					data[i] = inMemoryColumn.DefaultValue;
					continue;
				}
				if (inMemoryColumn.AutoIncrement)
				{
					if (!checkAutoIncrement)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (table.BaseSet.IsLoadingMode)
					{
						inMemoryColumn.UpdateAutoIncrementValue(data[i]);
					}
					else if (!(data[i] is InMemoryAutoIncrementValue))
					{
						throw new InMemorySetException(string.Format(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_InsertingDataIntoAutoincrementColumn"), inMemoryColumn.Name));
					}
				}
				if (data[i] == null)
				{
					if (inMemoryColumn.AllowNull)
					{
						continue;
					}
					throw new InMemoryNoNullAllowedException();
				}
				if (!inMemoryColumn.AutoIncrement && !inMemoryColumn.Type.IsInstanceOfType(data[i]))
				{
					data[i] = InMemoryHelper.Convert(data[i], data[i].GetType(), inMemoryColumn.Type, allowNull: false);
				}
				if (!inMemoryColumn.Type.Equals(typeof(string)) || inMemoryColumn.MaxLength <= 0 || ((string)data[i]).Length <= inMemoryColumn.MaxLength)
				{
					continue;
				}
				throw new InMemorySetException("String value is too long.");
			}
		}

		internal void CheckAndEnterFRelations()
		{
			CheckAndEnterFRelations(data);
		}

		internal void CheckAndEnterFRelationsOldData()
		{
			CheckAndEnterFRelations(modificationInfo.OldData);
		}

		private void CheckAndEnterFRelations(object[] newData)
		{
			InMemoryRow[][] array = new InMemoryRow[table.FRelations.Count][];
			for (int i = 0; i < table.FRelations.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = table.FRelations[i].CheckFAssociation(newData);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < table.FRelations.Count; j++)
			{
				table.FRelations[j].EnterFAssociation(array[j]);
			}
		}

		internal void CheckPRelations()
		{
			CheckPRelations(data, null);
		}

		internal void CheckPRelationsModified()
		{
			CheckPRelations(modificationInfo.OldData, modificationInfo.Modified);
		}

		private void CheckPRelations(object[] oldDataList, bool[] modifiedList)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < table.PRelations.Count; i++)
			{
				table.PRelations[i].CheckPAssociation(this, oldDataList, modifiedList);
			}
		}

		internal void LeaveFRelations()
		{
			LeaveFRelations(data);
		}

		internal void LeaveFRelationsOldData()
		{
			LeaveFRelations(modificationInfo.OldData);
		}

		private void LeaveFRelations(object[] leaveData)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < table.FRelations.Count; i++)
			{
				table.FRelations[i].LeaveFAssociation(this, leaveData);
			}
		}

		private void AddToIndex()
		{
			foreach (IInMemoryIndex item in table.IndexesInternal)
			{
				item.AddRow(this);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveFromIndex()
		{
			foreach (IInMemoryIndex item in table.IndexesInternal)
			{
				item.RemoveRow(this);
			}
		}

		public void BeginEdit()
		{
			if (editInfo != null)
			{
				throw new InMemorySetException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_InEditMode"));
			}
			if (state == InMemoryItemState.Deleted)
			{
				throw new InMemorySetException("Row is deleted.");
			}
			editInfo = new InMemoryRowModificationInfo(data);
		}

		public void EndEdit()
		{
			if (editInfo == null)
			{
				throw new InMemorySetException("Not in edit mode.");
			}
			if (state == InMemoryItemState.Deleted)
			{
				throw new InMemorySetException("Row is deleted.");
			}
			CheckValues(setDefaults: false, checkAutoIncrement: false);
			object[] array = data;
			data = editInfo.OldData;
			RemoveFromIndex();
			data = array;
			try
			{
				AddToIndex();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				RemoveFromIndex();
				data = editInfo.OldData;
				AddToIndex();
				data = array;
				throw;
			}
			InMemoryRowModificationInfo inMemoryRowModificationInfo = null;
			if (modificationInfo != null)
			{
				inMemoryRowModificationInfo = new InMemoryRowModificationInfo(modificationInfo.OldData);
				for (int i = 0; i < modificationInfo.Modified.Length; i++)
				{
					if (editInfo.Modified[i])
					{
						if (table.Columns[i].AutoIncrement && !table.BaseSet.IsLoadingMode)
						{
							throw new InMemorySetException("Column is autoincremented.");
						}
						modificationInfo.Modified[i] = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (modificationInfo == null)
			{
				modificationInfo = new InMemoryRowModificationInfo(editInfo.OldData);
				if (table.BaseSet.InTransaction)
				{
					SetRollbackData(state, InMemoryItemState.Updated);
					state = InMemoryItemState.Updated;
				}
				LeaveFRelationsOldData();
			}
			if (!table.BaseSet.InTransaction)
			{
				try
				{
					CheckAndEnterFRelations();
					AcceptChanges(null);
				}
				catch
				{
					CheckAndEnterFRelationsOldData();
					modificationInfo = inMemoryRowModificationInfo;
					throw;
				}
			}
			editInfo = null;
		}

		public void CancelEdit()
		{
			if (editInfo == null)
			{
				throw new InMemorySetException("Not in edit mode.");
			}
			data = editInfo.OldData;
			editInfo = null;
		}

		private void SetData(int index, object value)
		{
			if (state == InMemoryItemState.Deleted)
			{
				throw new InMemorySetException("Row is deleted.");
			}
			InMemoryColumn inMemoryColumn = table.Columns[index];
			if (inMemoryColumn.AutoIncrement)
			{
				if (!table.BaseSet.IsLoadingMode)
				{
					throw new InMemorySetException("Column is autoincremented.");
				}
				inMemoryColumn.UpdateAutoIncrementValue(value);
			}
			if (editInfo != null)
			{
				data[index] = value;
				editInfo.Modified[index] = true;
				return;
			}
			object obj = data[index];
			object obj2 = value;
			if (obj2 == null)
			{
				if (!inMemoryColumn.AllowNull)
				{
					throw new InMemoryNoNullAllowedException();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!inMemoryColumn.Type.IsInstanceOfType(obj2))
				{
					obj2 = InMemoryHelper.Convert(obj2, obj2.GetType(), inMemoryColumn.Type, allowNull: false);
				}
				if (inMemoryColumn.Type.Equals(typeof(string)) && inMemoryColumn.MaxLength > 0 && ((string)obj2).Length > inMemoryColumn.MaxLength)
				{
					throw new InMemorySetException("String value is too long.");
				}
			}
			if (inMemoryColumn.Indexes.HasIndexes)
			{
				inMemoryColumn.Indexes.RemoveRow(this);
				data[index] = obj2;
				try
				{
					inMemoryColumn.Indexes.AddRow(this);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					inMemoryColumn.Indexes.RemoveRow(this);
					data[index] = obj;
					inMemoryColumn.Indexes.AddRow(this);
					throw;
				}
			}
			if (ModifyOneValue(inMemoryColumn, obj, obj2))
			{
				LeaveFRelationsOldData();
			}
			if (table.BaseSet.InTransaction)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				CheckAndEnterFRelations();
				AcceptChanges(inMemoryColumn);
			}
			catch
			{
				CheckAndEnterFRelationsOldData();
				RejectChanges();
				throw;
			}
		}

		private bool ModifyOneValue(InMemoryColumn column, object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			data[column.ColumnIndex] = newValue;
			if (modificationInfo == null)
			{
				modificationInfo = new InMemoryRowModificationInfo(data);
				modificationInfo.Modified[column.ColumnIndex] = true;
				modificationInfo.OldData[column.ColumnIndex] = oldValue;
				if (table.BaseSet.InTransaction)
				{
					SetRollbackData(state, InMemoryItemState.Updated);
					state = InMemoryItemState.Updated;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetRollbackData(InMemoryItemState oldState, InMemoryItemState newState)
		{
			table.BaseSet.RollbackOrder.Add(new InMemoryRollbackOrderInfo(this, oldState, newState, isNewRow: false));
		}

		private void AcceptChanges(InMemoryColumn column)
		{
			if (modificationInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (column != null)
			{
				if (modificationInfo.Modified[column.ColumnIndex])
				{
					column.CheckPRelations(this, modificationInfo.OldData[column.ColumnIndex]);
				}
				column.CheckFRelations(this, data[column.ColumnIndex]);
			}
			modificationInfo = null;
		}

		private void RejectChanges()
		{
			if (modificationInfo != null)
			{
				RemoveFromIndex();
				data = modificationInfo.OldData;
				AddToIndex();
				modificationInfo = null;
			}
		}

		private T[] ArrayInsert<T>(T[] array, int index, T item)
		{
			T[] array2 = new T[array.Length + 1];
			if (index != 0)
			{
				Array.Copy(array, 0, array2, 0, index);
			}
			array2[index] = item;
			if (index != array.Length)
			{
				Array.Copy(array, index, array2, index + 1, array.Length - index);
			}
			return array2;
		}

		private T[] ArrayRemoveAt<T>(T[] array, int index)
		{
			T[] array2 = new T[array.Length - 1];
			if (index != 0)
			{
				Array.Copy(array, 0, array2, 0, index);
			}
			if (index != array.Length - 1)
			{
				Array.Copy(array, index + 1, array2, index, array.Length - index - 1);
			}
			return array2;
		}

		internal void FixColumns()
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < table.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				InMemoryColumn inMemoryColumn = table.Columns[i];
				int num2 = i + num;
				switch (inMemoryColumn.State)
				{
				case InMemoryItemState.Deleted:
					if (modificationInfo == null)
					{
						modificationInfo = new InMemoryRowModificationInfo(data);
					}
					data = ArrayRemoveAt(data, num2);
					modificationInfo.Modified = ArrayRemoveAt(modificationInfo.Modified, num2);
					modificationInfo.OldData = ArrayRemoveAt(modificationInfo.OldData, num2);
					if (editInfo != null)
					{
						editInfo.OldData = ArrayRemoveAt(editInfo.OldData, num2);
						editInfo.Modified = ArrayRemoveAt(editInfo.Modified, num2);
					}
					num--;
					break;
				case InMemoryItemState.Updated:
					data[num2] = InMemoryHelper.Convert(data[num2], inMemoryColumn);
					if (modificationInfo != null && modificationInfo.OldData != null)
					{
						modificationInfo.OldData[num2] = InMemoryHelper.Convert(modificationInfo.OldData[num2], inMemoryColumn);
					}
					if (editInfo != null)
					{
						editInfo.OldData[num2] = InMemoryHelper.Convert(editInfo.OldData[num2], inMemoryColumn);
					}
					break;
				case InMemoryItemState.Inserted:
					if (modificationInfo == null)
					{
						modificationInfo = new InMemoryRowModificationInfo(data);
					}
					data = ArrayInsert(data, num2, inMemoryColumn.DefaultValue);
					modificationInfo.Modified = ArrayInsert(modificationInfo.Modified, num2, item: false);
					modificationInfo.OldData = ArrayInsert(modificationInfo.OldData, num2, inMemoryColumn.DefaultValue);
					if (editInfo != null)
					{
						editInfo.OldData = ArrayInsert(editInfo.OldData, num2, inMemoryColumn.DefaultValue);
						editInfo.Modified = ArrayInsert(editInfo.Modified, num2, item: false);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Commit(InMemoryRollbackOrderInfo info)
		{
			if (info == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			if (info.Row != this)
			{
				throw new InMemorySetException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_WrongCommitInfo"));
			}
			if (state != InMemoryItemState.Default)
			{
				InMemoryItemState newState = info.NewState;
				if (newState == InMemoryItemState.Inserted || newState == InMemoryItemState.Updated)
				{
					AcceptChanges(null);
				}
				state = InMemoryItemState.Default;
			}
		}

		internal void Rollback(InMemoryRollbackOrderInfo info)
		{
			if (info == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			if (info.Row != this)
			{
				throw new InMemorySetException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_WrongRollbackInfo"));
			}
			if (state != InMemoryItemState.Default)
			{
				switch (info.NewState)
				{
				case InMemoryItemState.Updated:
					RejectChanges();
					state = info.OldState;
					break;
				case InMemoryItemState.Deleted:
					state = info.OldState;
					break;
				default:
					state = InMemoryItemState.Default;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Delete()
		{
			if (state != InMemoryItemState.Deleted)
			{
				LeaveFRelations();
				table.BaseSet.RollbackOrder.Add(new InMemoryRollbackOrderInfo(this, state, InMemoryItemState.Deleted, isNewRow: false));
				state = InMemoryItemState.Deleted;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			RemoveFromIndex();
			table = null;
			data = null;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("{ ");
			for (int i = 0; i < data.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				string text = ((data[i] != null) ? data[i].ToString() : "null");
				if (text.Length > 100)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(text.Substring(0, 100));
					stringBuilder.Append("...");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(text);
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(" }");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class InMemoryColumn
	{
		private string name;

		private int columnIndex;

		private Type type;

		private bool allowNull;

		private bool autoIncrement;

		private object autoIncrementNextValue;

		private object defaultValue;

		private int maxLength;

		private InMemoryTable table;

		private InMemoryItemState state = InMemoryItemState.Inserted;

		private InMemoryColumn columnForUpdate;

		private ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation> pRelations;

		private ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation> fRelations;

		private InMemoryIndexesHolder indexes = new InMemoryIndexesHolder(null);

		public string Name => name;

		public Type Type => type;

		public bool AllowNull => allowNull;

		public object DefaultValue => defaultValue;

		public InMemoryTable Table => table;

		public InMemoryItemState State => state;

		public int ColumnIndex => columnIndex;

		public InMemoryColumn ColumnForUpdate => columnForUpdate;

		public ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation> PRelations => pRelations;

		public ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation> FRelations => fRelations;

		internal InMemoryIndexesHolder Indexes => indexes;

		public bool HasIndexes => indexes.Count > 0;

		public int MaxLength
		{
			get
			{
				return maxLength;
			}
			set
			{
				maxLength = value;
			}
		}

		public bool AutoIncrement => autoIncrement;

		public InMemoryColumn(InMemoryTable table, string name, Type type)
			: this(table, name, type, autoIncrement: false, allowNull: true, null)
		{
		}

		public InMemoryColumn(InMemoryTable table, string name, Type type, bool autoIncrement)
			: this(table, name, type, autoIncrement, !autoIncrement, null)
		{
		}

		public InMemoryColumn(InMemoryTable table, string name, Type type, bool allowNull, object defaultValue)
			: this(table, name, type, autoIncrement: false, allowNull, defaultValue)
		{
		}

		private InMemoryColumn(InMemoryTable table, string name, Type type, bool autoIncrement, bool allowNull, object defaultValue)
		{
			this.autoIncrement = autoIncrement;
			if (autoIncrement)
			{
				if (allowNull)
				{
					throw new InMemoryNoAutoIncrementAllowedException();
				}
				TypeCode typeCode = DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(type);
				if ((uint)(typeCode - 5) > 7u)
				{
					throw new InMemoryNoAutoIncrementAllowedException();
				}
				autoIncrementNextValue = ((IConvertible)1).ToType(type, (IFormatProvider)CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				defaultValue = InMemoryAutoIncrementValue.Value;
			}
			else if (defaultValue == null)
			{
				if (!allowNull && table.Rows.Count != 0)
				{
					throw new InMemoryNoNullAllowedException(string.Format(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_NullDefaultValueNotAllowed"), name));
				}
			}
			else if (!type.IsInstanceOfType(defaultValue))
			{
				defaultValue = InMemoryHelper.Convert(defaultValue, defaultValue.GetType(), type, allowNull: true);
			}
			this.table = table;
			this.name = name;
			this.type = type;
			this.allowNull = allowNull;
			this.defaultValue = defaultValue;
			pRelations = new ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation>(new InMemoryRelation[0]);
			fRelations = new ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation>(new InMemoryRelation[0]);
		}

		internal void UpdateAutoIncrementValue(object value)
		{
			if (!table.BaseSet.IsLoadingMode)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_NotLoadingMode"), name));
			}
			object y = IncrementNum(value);
			if (Comparer<object>.Default.Compare(autoIncrementNextValue, y) < 0)
			{
				autoIncrementNextValue = y;
			}
		}

		public object GetAutoIncrementNextValue()
		{
			object result = autoIncrementNextValue;
			autoIncrementNextValue = IncrementNum(autoIncrementNextValue);
			return result;
		}

		private object IncrementNum(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(type) switch
			{
				TypeCode.Byte => (byte)value + 1, 
				TypeCode.Int16 => (short)value + 1, 
				TypeCode.Int32 => (int)value + 1, 
				TypeCode.Int64 => (long)value + 1, 
				TypeCode.SByte => (sbyte)value + 1, 
				TypeCode.UInt16 => (ushort)value + 1, 
				TypeCode.UInt32 => (uint)value + 1, 
				TypeCode.UInt64 => (ulong)value + 1, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("IncrementValue"), 
			};
		}

		public void Delete()
		{
			state = InMemoryItemState.Deleted;
		}

		public void Update(string name, Type type)
		{
			state = InMemoryItemState.Updated;
			columnForUpdate = new InMemoryColumn(table, name, type);
		}

		public void Update(string name, Type type, bool autoIncrement)
		{
			state = InMemoryItemState.Updated;
			columnForUpdate = new InMemoryColumn(table, name, type, autoIncrement);
		}

		public void Update(string name, Type type, bool allowNull, object defaultValue)
		{
			state = InMemoryItemState.Updated;
			columnForUpdate = new InMemoryColumn(table, name, type, allowNull, defaultValue);
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			state = InMemoryItemState.Default;
			columnForUpdate = null;
		}

		internal void ColumnsCommitted()
		{
			columnIndex = table.Columns.FindColumnIndex(name);
			Reset();
		}

		internal void FixColumnRelations()
		{
			pRelations = new ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation>(table.BaseSet.GetPRelations(this));
			fRelations = new ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryRelation>(table.BaseSet.GetFRelations(this));
		}

		internal void FixIndexes()
		{
			List<IInMemoryIndex> list = new List<IInMemoryIndex>();
			foreach (IInMemoryIndex item in table.IndexesInternal)
			{
				foreach (InMemoryColumn column in item.Columns)
				{
					if (column == this)
					{
						list.Add(item);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			indexes = new InMemoryIndexesHolder(list);
		}

		public void CheckPRelations(InMemoryRow row, object oldValue)
		{
			if (pRelations == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (InMemoryRelation pRelation in pRelations)
			{
				pRelation.CheckPAssociation(this, row, oldValue);
			}
		}

		public void CheckFRelations(InMemoryRow row, object newValue)
		{
			if (fRelations != null)
			{
				InMemoryRow[][] array = new InMemoryRow[fRelations.Count][];
				for (int i = 0; i < fRelations.Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = fRelations[i].CheckFAssociation(this, row, newValue);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < fRelations.Count; j++)
				{
					fRelations[j].EnterFAssociation(array[j]);
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return name;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(obj is InMemoryColumn inMemoryColumn))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (table.Equals(inMemoryColumn.table) && name.Equals(inMemoryColumn.name))
			{
				return type.Equals(inMemoryColumn.type);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<InMemoryTable, string, Type>(table, name, type);
		}
	}
	public class InMemoryColumnIndexComparer : IComparer<InMemoryColumn>
	{
		public int Compare(InMemoryColumn x, InMemoryColumn y)
		{
			if (x == y)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			return x.ColumnIndex.CompareTo(y.ColumnIndex);
		}
	}
	public class InMemoryRelationPairPNameComparer : IComparer<InMemoryRelationPair>
	{
		public int Compare(InMemoryRelationPair x, InMemoryRelationPair y)
		{
			if (x == y)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			return x.PKey.Name.CompareTo(y.PKey.Name);
		}
	}
	public class InMemoryRelationPairPIndexComparer : IComparer<InMemoryRelationPair>
	{
		public int Compare(InMemoryRelationPair x, InMemoryRelationPair y)
		{
			if (x == y)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			return x.PKey.ColumnIndex.CompareTo(y.PKey.ColumnIndex);
		}
	}
	public class InMemoryRelationPairFIndexComparer : IComparer<InMemoryRelationPair>
	{
		public int Compare(InMemoryRelationPair x, InMemoryRelationPair y)
		{
			if (x == y)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			return x.FKey.ColumnIndex.CompareTo(y.FKey.ColumnIndex);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class IntComparer : IEqualityComparer<int>
	{
		public static IntComparer Default = new IntComparer();

		public bool Equals(int x, int y)
		{
			return x == y;
		}

		public int GetHashCode(int obj)
		{
			return obj;
		}
	}
	public class InMemoryDictionaryIndex : IInMemoryIndex
	{
		private string name;

		private readonly bool caseSensitive;

		private bool unique;

		private InMemoryTable table;

		private InMemoryColumn[] columns;

		private InMemoryIndexWrapper wrapper;

		private ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryColumn> columnsReadOnly;

		private Dictionary<int, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, object>(IntComparer.Default);

		private HashSet<InMemoryRow> nullList = new HashSet<InMemoryRow>();

		public string Name => name;

		public bool Unique => unique;

		public ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryColumn> Columns => columnsReadOnly;

		public InMemoryIndexWrapper Wrapper => wrapper;

		public InMemoryDictionaryIndex(InMemoryTable table, InMemoryColumn[] columns, bool unique)
		{
			if (columns == null || columns.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			this.table = table;
			caseSensitive = table.BaseSet.CaseSensitive;
			this.columns = columns;
			columnsReadOnly = new ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryColumn>(columns);
			FixColumnsOrder();
			this.unique = unique;
			wrapper = new InMemoryIndexWrapper(this);
			name = GetName(columns);
		}

		private static string GetName(InMemoryColumn[] columns)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("Idx");
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Length; i++)
			{
				list.Add(columns[i].Name);
			}
			list.Sort();
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("_");
				stringBuilder.Append(list[j]);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void AddRow(InMemoryRow row)
		{
			if (InMemoryHelper.IsNullRow(row, columns))
			{
				if (!nullList.Contains(row))
				{
					if (unique && nullList.Count > 0)
					{
						throw new InMemoryConstraintException(string.Format(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_UniqueIndex"), name));
					}
					nullList.Add(row);
				}
				return;
			}
			int rowHashCode = InMemoryHelper.GetRowHashCode(row, columns, caseSensitive);
			if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(rowHashCode, out var value) || value == null)
			{
				dictionary[rowHashCode] = row;
				return;
			}
			if (value is InMemoryRow inMemoryRow)
			{
				if (inMemoryRow != row)
				{
					if (unique && inMemoryRow.State != InMemoryItemState.Deleted && InMemoryHelper.AreEqualRows(inMemoryRow, row, columns, caseSensitive))
					{
						throw new InMemoryConstraintException(string.Format(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_UniqueIndex"), name));
					}
					List<InMemoryRow> list = new List<InMemoryRow>(2);
					list.Add(inMemoryRow);
					list.Add(row);
					dictionary[rowHashCode] = list;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (!(value is List<InMemoryRow> list2))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_WrongDictionaryIndex"), name));
			}
			if (!list2.Contains(row))
			{
				if (unique && InMemoryHelper.FindAnyRow(row, columns, list2, caseSensitive))
				{
					throw new InMemoryConstraintException(string.Format(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_UniqueIndex"), name));
				}
				list2.Add(row);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveRow(InMemoryRow row)
		{
			if (InMemoryHelper.IsNullRow(row, columns))
			{
				nullList.Remove(row);
				return;
			}
			int rowHashCode = InMemoryHelper.GetRowHashCode(row, columns, caseSensitive);
			if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(rowHashCode, out var value) || value == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (value is InMemoryRow inMemoryRow)
			{
				if (inMemoryRow == row)
				{
					dictionary[rowHashCode] = null;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (!(value is List<InMemoryRow> list))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_WrongDictionaryIndex"), name));
			}
			list.Remove(row);
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				dictionary[rowHashCode] = list[0];
			}
		}

		public InMemoryRow[] Find(object[] findValues, bool returnDeleted)
		{
			if (columns.Length != findValues.Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			if (InMemoryHelper.IsNullRow(findValues))
			{
				return nullList.ToArray();
			}
			int rowHashCode = InMemoryHelper.GetRowHashCode(findValues, caseSensitive);
			List<InMemoryRow> list = new List<InMemoryRow>();
			if (dictionary.TryGetValue(rowHashCode, out var value) && value != null)
			{
				if (value is InMemoryRow inMemoryRow)
				{
					if (InMemoryHelper.AreEqualRows(inMemoryRow, columns, findValues, caseSensitive) && (returnDeleted || inMemoryRow.State != InMemoryItemState.Deleted))
					{
						list.Add(inMemoryRow);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(value is List<InMemoryRow> list2))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_WrongDictionaryIndex"), name));
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
					{
						InMemoryRow inMemoryRow2 = list2[i];
						if ((returnDeleted || inMemoryRow2.State != InMemoryItemState.Deleted) && InMemoryHelper.AreEqualRows(inMemoryRow2, columns, findValues, caseSensitive))
						{
							list.Add(inMemoryRow2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			dictionary.Clear();
			nullList.Clear();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return name.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(obj is InMemoryDictionaryIndex inMemoryDictionaryIndex) || !name.Equals(inMemoryDictionaryIndex.name))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool EqualsColumns(InMemoryColumn[] needColumns)
		{
			if (columns.Length != needColumns.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Length; i++)
			{
				if (columns[i] != needColumns[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void FixColumnsOrder()
		{
			Array.Sort(columns, new InMemoryColumnIndexComparer());
		}
	}
	public enum InMemoryItemState
	{
		Default,
		Inserted,
		Deleted,
		Updated
	}
	internal interface IInMemoryIndex
	{
		string Name { get; }

		bool Unique { get; }

		ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryColumn> Columns { get; }

		InMemoryIndexWrapper Wrapper { get; }

		void AddRow(InMemoryRow row);

		void RemoveRow(InMemoryRow row);

		void Clear();

		InMemoryRow[] Find(object[] values, bool returnDeleted);

		bool EqualsColumns(InMemoryColumn[] columns);

		void FixColumnsOrder();
	}
	public class InMemoryIndexWrapper
	{
		private IInMemoryIndex index;

		public bool Unique => index.Unique;

		public string Name => index.Name;

		public ReadOnlyCollection<InMemoryColumn> Columns => index.Columns;

		internal InMemoryIndexWrapper(IInMemoryIndex index)
		{
			this.index = index;
		}

		public InMemoryRow[] Find(object[] values, bool returnDeleted)
		{
			return index.Find(values, returnDeleted);
		}
	}
	public class InMemoryRelationPair
	{
		private InMemoryColumn pKey;

		private InMemoryColumn fKey;

		public InMemoryColumn PKey => pKey;

		public InMemoryColumn FKey => fKey;

		public InMemoryRelationPair(InMemoryColumn pKey, InMemoryColumn fKey)
		{
			if (!pKey.Type.Equals(fKey.Type))
			{
				throw new InMemorySetException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_DifferentTypes"));
			}
			this.pKey = pKey;
			this.fKey = fKey;
		}
	}
	public class InMemoryRelation
	{
		private string name;

		private InMemoryRelationPair[] pairs;

		private InMemoryRelationPair[] pairsSortedByPIndex;

		private InMemoryRelationPair[] pairsSortedByFIndex;

		private InMemoryTable pTable;

		private InMemoryTable fTable;

		private bool fCounterDictReady;

		private Dictionary<InMemoryRow, int> fCountersDict = new Dictionary<InMemoryRow, int>();

		public string Name => name;

		public InMemoryRelationPair[] Pairs => pairs;

		public InMemoryRelationPair[] PairsSortedByPIndex => pairsSortedByPIndex;

		public InMemoryRelationPair[] PairsSortedByFIndex => pairsSortedByFIndex;

		public InMemoryTable PTable => pTable;

		public InMemoryTable FTable => fTable;

		public InMemoryRelation(InMemoryRelationPair[] pairs)
		{
			if (pairs == null || pairs.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			this.pairs = pairs;
			pairsSortedByPIndex = ClonePairs(pairs);
			pairsSortedByFIndex = ClonePairs(pairs);
			pTable = pairs[0].PKey.Table;
			fTable = pairs[0].FKey.Table;
			Array.Sort(pairsSortedByPIndex, new InMemoryRelationPairPIndexComparer());
			Array.Sort(pairsSortedByFIndex, new InMemoryRelationPairFIndexComparer());
			name = GetName();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(obj is InMemoryRelation inMemoryRelation))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return name.Equals(inMemoryRelation.name);
		}

		private static InMemoryRelationPair[] ClonePairs(InMemoryRelationPair[] pairs)
		{
			InMemoryRelationPair[] array = new InMemoryRelationPair[pairs.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < pairs.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = pairs[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		private string GetName()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("FK_");
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			InMemoryRelationPair[] array = pairs;
			foreach (InMemoryRelationPair inMemoryRelationPair in array)
			{
				list.Add(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}#{1}#{2}#{3}", inMemoryRelationPair.PKey.Table.Name, inMemoryRelationPair.PKey.Name, inMemoryRelationPair.FKey.Table.Name, inMemoryRelationPair.FKey.Name));
			}
			list.Sort();
			foreach (string item in list)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("_");
				stringBuilder.Append(item);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void CheckPAssociation(InMemoryColumn col, InMemoryRow row, object oldValue)
		{
			InMemoryRelationPair[] array = pairsSortedByFIndex;
			InMemoryColumn[] array2 = new InMemoryColumn[array.Length];
			object[] array3 = new object[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = array[i].FKey;
				if (array[i].PKey == col)
				{
					array3[i] = oldValue;
				}
				else
				{
					array3[i] = row[array[i].PKey.ColumnIndex];
				}
			}
			if (InMemoryHelper.IsNullRow(array3))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (fCounterDictReady)
			{
				if (FastFCheck(row))
				{
					throw new InMemoryConstraintException();
				}
			}
			else if (FTable.Rows.FindFirst(array2, array3) != null)
			{
				throw new InMemoryConstraintException();
			}
		}

		private void RaiseConstraintException(InMemoryColumn[] columns)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (InMemoryColumn inMemoryColumn in columns)
			{
				if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(inMemoryColumn.Name);
			}
			throw new InMemoryConstraintException(string.Format(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_ConstraintConflict"), FTable.Name, stringBuilder.ToString()));
		}

		public InMemoryRow[] CheckFAssociation(InMemoryColumn col, InMemoryRow row, object newValue)
		{
			InMemoryRelationPair[] array = pairsSortedByPIndex;
			InMemoryColumn[] array2 = new InMemoryColumn[array.Length];
			object[] array3 = new object[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = array[i].PKey;
				if (array[i].FKey == col)
				{
					array3[i] = newValue;
				}
				else
				{
					array3[i] = row[array[i].FKey.ColumnIndex];
				}
			}
			if (InMemoryHelper.IsNullRow(array3))
			{
				return new InMemoryRow[0];
			}
			if (fCounterDictReady)
			{
				InMemoryRow[] array4 = PTable.Rows.Find(array2, array3);
				if (array4.Length == 0)
				{
					RaiseConstraintException(array2);
				}
				return array4;
			}
			if (PTable.Rows.FindFirst(array2, array3) == null)
			{
				throw new InMemoryConstraintException();
			}
			return new InMemoryRow[0];
		}

		public void CheckPAssociation(InMemoryRow row, object[] rowOldData, bool[] modified)
		{
			InMemoryRelationPair[] array = pairsSortedByFIndex;
			InMemoryColumn[] array2 = new InMemoryColumn[array.Length];
			object[] array3 = new object[array.Length];
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = array[i].FKey;
				int columnIndex = array[i].PKey.ColumnIndex;
				if (modified != null && modified[columnIndex])
				{
					num++;
				}
				array3[i] = rowOldData[columnIndex];
			}
			if (InMemoryHelper.IsNullRow(array3) || (modified != null && num == 0))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (fCounterDictReady)
			{
				if (FastFCheck(row))
				{
					throw new InMemoryConstraintException();
				}
			}
			else if (FTable.Rows.FindFirst(array2, array3) != null)
			{
				throw new InMemoryConstraintException();
			}
		}

		public InMemoryRow[] CheckFAssociation(object[] rowNewData)
		{
			InMemoryRelationPair[] array = pairsSortedByPIndex;
			InMemoryColumn[] array2 = new InMemoryColumn[array.Length];
			object[] array3 = new object[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = array[i].PKey;
				array3[i] = rowNewData[array[i].FKey.ColumnIndex];
			}
			if (InMemoryHelper.IsNullRow(array3))
			{
				return new InMemoryRow[0];
			}
			if (fCounterDictReady)
			{
				InMemoryRow[] array4 = PTable.Rows.Find(array2, array3);
				if (array4.Length == 0)
				{
					RaiseConstraintException(array2);
				}
				return array4;
			}
			if (PTable.Rows.FindFirst(array2, array3) == null)
			{
				throw new InMemoryConstraintException();
			}
			return new InMemoryRow[0];
		}

		public void CheckRelation()
		{
			InMemoryRowList rows = pTable.Rows;
			InMemoryRowList rows2 = fTable.Rows;
			InMemoryColumn[] array = new InMemoryColumn[pairs.Length];
			object[] array2 = new object[pairsSortedByPIndex.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < pairsSortedByPIndex.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = pairs[i].PKey;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < rows2.Count; j++)
			{
				InMemoryRow inMemoryRow = rows2[j];
				for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
				{
					array2[k] = inMemoryRow[pairs[k].FKey.ColumnIndex];
				}
				if (!InMemoryHelper.IsNullRow(array2))
				{
					InMemoryRow[] array3 = rows.Find(array, array2);
					if (array3.Length == 0)
					{
						RaiseConstraintException(array);
					}
					for (int l = 0; l < array3.Length; l++)
					{
						IncrementRowFCounter(array3[l]);
					}
				}
			}
			fCounterDictReady = true;
		}

		public void EnterFAssociation(InMemoryRow[] fRows)
		{
			if (fCounterDictReady)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < fRows.Length; i++)
				{
					IncrementRowFCounter(fRows[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public void LeaveFAssociation(InMemoryRow row, object[] rowOldData)
		{
			InMemoryRelationPair[] array = pairsSortedByPIndex;
			InMemoryColumn[] array2 = new InMemoryColumn[array.Length];
			object[] array3 = new object[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = array[i].PKey;
				array3[i] = rowOldData[array[i].FKey.ColumnIndex];
			}
			if (!InMemoryHelper.IsNullRow(array3) && fCounterDictReady)
			{
				InMemoryRow[] array4 = PTable.Rows.FindWithDeleted(array2, array3);
				for (int j = 0; j < array4.Length; j++)
				{
					DecrementRowFCounter(array4[j]);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool FastFCheck(InMemoryRow foundRow)
		{
			if (!fCountersDict.TryGetValue(foundRow, out var value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return value > 0;
		}

		private void IncrementRowFCounter(InMemoryRow foundRow)
		{
			if (!fCountersDict.TryGetValue(foundRow, out var value))
			{
				fCountersDict.Add(foundRow, 1);
			}
			else
			{
				value = (fCountersDict[foundRow] = value + 1);
			}
		}

		private void DecrementRowFCounter(InMemoryRow foundRow)
		{
			if (fCountersDict.TryGetValue(foundRow, out var value))
			{
				switch (value)
				{
				case 0:
					break;
				case 1:
					fCountersDict.Remove(foundRow);
					break;
				default:
					value = (fCountersDict[foundRow] = value - 1);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public InMemoryRow[] GetRows(InMemoryRow row)
		{
			if (row.Table == PTable)
			{
				return GetFRows(row);
			}
			return GetPRows(row);
		}

		public InMemoryColumn[] GetPColumns()
		{
			InMemoryRelationPair[] array = pairsSortedByPIndex;
			InMemoryColumn[] array2 = new InMemoryColumn[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = array[i].PKey;
			}
			return array2;
		}

		public InMemoryRow[] GetPRows(InMemoryRow row)
		{
			InMemoryRelationPair[] array = pairsSortedByPIndex;
			InMemoryColumn[] array2 = new InMemoryColumn[array.Length];
			object[] array3 = new object[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = array[i].PKey;
				array3[i] = row[array[i].FKey.ColumnIndex];
			}
			return PTable.Rows.Find(array2, array3);
		}

		public InMemoryRow[] GetFRows(InMemoryRow row)
		{
			InMemoryRelationPair[] array = pairsSortedByFIndex;
			InMemoryColumn[] array2 = new InMemoryColumn[array.Length];
			object[] array3 = new object[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = array[i].FKey;
				array3[i] = row[array[i].PKey.ColumnIndex];
			}
			return FTable.Rows.Find(array2, array3);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return name.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return name;
		}
	}
	internal class InMemoryIndexesHolder
	{

		public bool HasIndexes
		{
			get
			{
				if (indexes != null && indexes.Count != 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (indexes != null)
				{
					return indexes.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public IInMemoryIndex this[int i]
		{
			get
			{
				if (indexes == null)
				{
					throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
				}
				return indexes[i];
			}
		}

		public InMemoryIndexesHolder(List<IInMemoryIndex> indexes)
		{
			this.indexes = indexes;
		}

		public void AddRow(InMemoryRow row)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < indexes.Count; i++)
			{
				indexes[i].AddRow(row);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveRow(InMemoryRow row)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < indexes.Count; i++)
			{
				indexes[i].RemoveRow(row);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < indexes.Count; i++)
			{
				indexes[i].Clear();
			}
		}

		public IInMemoryIndex GetIndex(InMemoryColumn[] columns)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < indexes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (indexes[i].EqualsColumns(columns))
				{
					return indexes[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class InMemoryComplexSet : IInMemoryDataElector, IEnumerable<InMemoryComplexRow>, IEnumerable
	{
		private struct ProjectionColumnItem : IEquatable<ProjectionColumnItem>
		{
			public readonly string ProjectionAlias;

			public readonly string ColumnName;

			public ProjectionColumnItem(string projectionAlias, string columnName)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(projectionAlias))
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("projectionAlias");
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnName))
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("columnName");
				}
				ProjectionAlias = projectionAlias;
				ColumnName = columnName;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is ProjectionColumnItem))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Equals((ProjectionColumnItem)obj);
			}

			public bool Equals(ProjectionColumnItem other)
			{
				if (ProjectionAlias == other.ProjectionAlias)
				{
					return ColumnName == other.ColumnName;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<string, string>(ProjectionAlias, ColumnName);
			}
		}

		private class ProjectionColumnItemComparer : IEqualityComparer<ProjectionColumnItem>
		{
			private static ProjectionColumnItemComparer instance = new ProjectionColumnItemComparer();

			public static ProjectionColumnItemComparer Instance => instance;

			public bool Equals(ProjectionColumnItem x, ProjectionColumnItem y)
			{
				if (x.ProjectionAlias == y.ProjectionAlias)
				{
					return x.ColumnName == y.ColumnName;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public int GetHashCode(ProjectionColumnItem obj)
			{
				return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<string, string>(obj.ProjectionAlias, obj.ColumnName);
			}
		}

		private HashSet<string> projectionSet;

		private Dictionary<ProjectionColumnItem, int> projectionColumnDict;

		private Dictionary<string, int> complexDict = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.Default);

		private List<string> aliasList = new List<string>();

		private List<IInMemoryTable> tableList = new List<IInMemoryTable>();

		private List<InMemoryComplexRow> rows;

		public InMemoryComplexRow this[int rowIndex] => rows[rowIndex];

		public int TableCount => complexDict.Count;

		public int Count => rows.Count;

		public InMemoryComplexSet()
		{
			rows = new List<InMemoryComplexRow>();
		}

		public InMemoryComplexSet(int capacity)
		{
			rows = new List<InMemoryComplexRow>(capacity);
		}

		public void MakeProjection(string projectionAlias)
		{
			CreateProjectionDicts();
			projectionSet.Add(projectionAlias);
			for (int i = 0; i < tableList.Count; i++)
			{
				IInMemoryTable inMemoryTable = tableList[i];
				foreach (string columnName in inMemoryTable.GetColumnNames())
				{
					ProjectionColumnItem key = new ProjectionColumnItem(projectionAlias, columnName);
					if (!projectionColumnDict.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						projectionColumnDict.Add(key, i);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void CreateProjectionDicts()
		{
			if (projectionSet == null)
			{
				projectionSet = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Default);
				projectionColumnDict = new Dictionary<ProjectionColumnItem, int>(ProjectionColumnItemComparer.Instance);
			}
		}

		public void AddProjectionFromSet(InMemoryComplexSet set)
		{
			if (set == null || set.projectionSet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			CreateProjectionDicts();
			foreach (string item2 in set.projectionSet)
			{
				projectionSet.Add(item2);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<ProjectionColumnItem, int> item3 in set.projectionColumnDict)
			{
				string item = set.aliasList[item3.Value];
				int num = aliasList.IndexOf(item);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("InMemoryFull_TableNotFound", set.tableList[item3.Value].Name));
				}
				projectionColumnDict.Add(item3.Key, num);
			}
		}

		public ReadOnlyCollection<string> GetProjectionList()
		{
			return new ReadOnlyCollection<string>(new List<string>(projectionSet));
		}

		public ReadOnlyCollection<IInMemoryTable> GetTableList()
		{
			return new ReadOnlyCollection<IInMemoryTable>(tableList);
		}

		public ReadOnlyCollection<string> GetAliasList()
		{
			return new ReadOnlyCollection<string>(aliasList);
		}

		public int AddTableIfNotExists(string alias, IInMemoryTable table)
		{
			if (!complexDict.TryGetValue(alias, out var value))
			{
				return AddTable(alias, table);
			}
			if (tableList[value] == table)
			{
				return value;
			}
			throw new InMemoryDuplicateNameException(alias);
		}

		public int AddTable(string alias, IInMemoryTable table)
		{
			try
			{
				int count = complexDict.Count;
				complexDict.Add(alias, count);
				aliasList.Add(alias);
				tableList.Add(table);
				return count;
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				throw new InMemoryDuplicateNameException(alias, innerException);
			}
		}

		public int GetTableIndex(string alias)
		{
			if (complexDict.TryGetValue(alias, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public int GetTableIndex(string projectionAlias, string columnName)
		{
			if (projectionColumnDict != null && projectionColumnDict.TryGetValue(new ProjectionColumnItem(projectionAlias, columnName), out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public IInMemoryTable GetTable(int index)
		{
			return tableList[index];
		}

		public IInMemoryTable GetTable(string alias)
		{
			if (complexDict.TryGetValue(alias, out var value))
			{
				return tableList[value];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public IInMemoryTable GetTable(string projectionAlias, string columnName)
		{
			if (projectionColumnDict != null && projectionColumnDict.TryGetValue(new ProjectionColumnItem(projectionAlias, columnName), out var value))
			{
				return tableList[value];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void AddRows(IEnumerable<InMemoryComplexRow> collection)
		{
			rows.AddRange(collection);
		}

		public void AddRow(InMemoryComplexRow row)
		{
			if (row.ComplexSet != this)
			{
				throw new InMemorySetException(Res.GetString("InMemorySet_DifferentComplexSet"));
			}
			rows.Add(row);
		}

		public InMemoryComplexRow AddNewRow()
		{
			InMemoryComplexRow inMemoryComplexRow = new InMemoryComplexRow(this);
			rows.Add(inMemoryComplexRow);
			return inMemoryComplexRow;
		}

		public InMemoryComplexRow AddNewRow(int tableIndex, InMemoryRow row)
		{
			InMemoryComplexRow inMemoryComplexRow = AddNewRow();
			inMemoryComplexRow[tableIndex] = row;
			return inMemoryComplexRow;
		}

		public InMemoryComplexRow AddNewRow(string tableAlias, InMemoryRow row)
		{
			return AddNewRow(GetTableIndex(tableAlias), row);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int rowIndex)
		{
			rows.RemoveAt(rowIndex);
		}

		public void RemoveRange(int rowIndex, int rowCount)
		{
			rows.RemoveRange(rowIndex, rowCount);
		}

		public void Sort()
		{
			rows.Sort();
		}

		public void Sort(IComparer<InMemoryComplexRow> comparer)
		{
			rows.Sort(comparer);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			rows.Clear();
		}

		public void Randomize()
		{
			NonCryptographicRandom val = NonCryptographicRandom.Default;
			for (int i = 0; i < rows.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				int index = val.Next(i, rows.Count);
				InMemoryComplexRow value = rows[index];
				rows[index] = rows[i];
				rows[i] = value;
			}
		}

		public InMemoryComplexSet Process(InMemoryDataElectorContextDescriptor descriptor)
		{
			return this;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable)rows).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public IEnumerator<InMemoryComplexRow> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return rows.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
