	public class InMemoryComplexRow
	{
		private InMemoryComplexSet complexSet;

		private List<IInMemoryRow> tablesRows;

		public InMemoryComplexSet ComplexSet => complexSet;

		public IInMemoryRow this[int tableIndex]
		{
			get
			{
				if (tableIndex >= 0 && tableIndex < tablesRows.Count)
				{
					return tablesRows[tableIndex];
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (tableIndex < 0)
				{
					throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
				}
				if (tableIndex >= complexSet.TableCount)
				{
					throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
				}
				if (tableIndex >= tablesRows.Count)
				{
					for (int i = tablesRows.Count - 1; i < tableIndex; i++)
					{
						tablesRows.Add(null);
					}
				}
				tablesRows[tableIndex] = value;
			}
		}

		public IInMemoryRow this[string tableAlias] => this[complexSet.GetTableIndex(tableAlias)];

		public InMemoryComplexRow(InMemoryComplexSet resultSet)
		{
			complexSet = resultSet;
			tablesRows = new List<IInMemoryRow>(resultSet.TableCount);
		}

		public InMemoryComplexRow(InMemoryComplexSet resultSet, InMemoryComplexRow otherRow)
			: this(resultSet)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < otherRow.ComplexSet.TableCount; i++)
			{
				tablesRows.Add(otherRow[i]);
			}
		}

		public InMemoryComplexRow(InMemoryComplexRow complexRow)
			: this(complexRow.ComplexSet, complexRow)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			ReadOnlyCollection<string> aliasList = complexSet.GetAliasList();
			stringBuilder.Append("{ ");
			for (int i = 0; i < aliasList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(", ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("\"");
				stringBuilder.Append(aliasList[i]);
				stringBuilder.Append("\" ");
				if (i >= tablesRows.Count || tablesRows[i] == null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("null");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(tablesRows[i].ToString());
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public static class InMemoryHelper
	{
		public const string NullsAreNotAllowed = "Nulls are not allowed.";

		public static object[] GetValues(InMemoryRow row, InMemoryColumn[] columns)
		{
			object[] array = new object[columns.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = row[columns[i].ColumnIndex];
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static bool IsNullRow(object[] values)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				if (values[i] != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsNullRow(InMemoryRow row, InMemoryColumn[] columns)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Length; i++)
			{
				if (row[columns[i].ColumnIndex] != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static int GetValueHash(object value, bool caseSensitive)
		{
			if (caseSensitive)
			{
				return value.GetHashCode();
			}
			if (!(value is string text))
			{
				return value.GetHashCode();
			}
			return text.ToLower().GetHashCode();
		}

		private static bool AreEqualValues(bool caseSensitive, object valueLeft, object valueRight)
		{
			if (caseSensitive || !(valueLeft is string text))
			{
				if (valueLeft != valueRight)
				{
					if (valueLeft != null && valueRight != null)
					{
						return valueLeft.Equals(valueRight);
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return text.Equals(valueRight as string, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
		}

		public static int GetRowHashCode(object[] values, bool caseSensitive)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object obj in values)
			{
				if (obj != null)
				{
					num = ((num << 1) | (num >> 31)) ^ GetValueHash(obj, caseSensitive);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static int GetRowHashCode(InMemoryRow row, InMemoryColumn[] columns, bool caseSensitive)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Length; i++)
			{
				object obj = row[columns[i].ColumnIndex];
				if (obj != null)
				{
					num = ((num << 1) | (num >> 31)) ^ GetValueHash(obj, caseSensitive);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static bool AreEqualRows(InMemoryRow rowLeft, InMemoryRow rowRight, InMemoryColumn[] columns, bool caseSensitive)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Length; i++)
			{
				int columnIndex = columns[i].ColumnIndex;
				object obj = rowLeft[columnIndex];
				object obj2 = rowRight[columnIndex];
				if (obj2 == null)
				{
					if (obj != null)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!AreEqualValues(caseSensitive, obj, obj2))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool AreEqualRows(InMemoryRow row, InMemoryColumn[] columns, object[] valuesLeft, bool caseSensitive)
		{
			if (!columns.Length.Equals(valuesLeft.Length))
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < valuesLeft.Length; i++)
			{
				object obj = row[columns[i].ColumnIndex];
				if (valuesLeft[i] == null)
				{
					if (obj != null)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (!AreEqualValues(caseSensitive, valuesLeft[i], obj))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool FindAnyRow(InMemoryRow row, InMemoryColumn[] columns, List<InMemoryRow> rows, bool caseSensitive)
		{
			foreach (InMemoryRow row2 in rows)
			{
				if (row2.State == InMemoryItemState.Deleted)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = true;
				foreach (InMemoryColumn inMemoryColumn in columns)
				{
					int columnIndex = inMemoryColumn.ColumnIndex;
					if (row[columnIndex] == null)
					{
						if (row2[columnIndex] != null)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
					}
					else if (!AreEqualValues(caseSensitive, row[columnIndex], row2[columnIndex]))
					{
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static List<InMemoryRow> FindInRows(List<InMemoryRow> rows, InMemoryColumn[] columns, object[] values, bool findFirst, bool returnDeleted, bool caseSensitive)
		{
			List<InMemoryRow> list = new List<InMemoryRow>();
			for (int i = 0; i < rows.Count; i++)
			{
				InMemoryRow inMemoryRow = rows[i];
				if (!returnDeleted && inMemoryRow.State == InMemoryItemState.Deleted)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = true;
				for (int j = 0; j < columns.Length; j++)
				{
					if (values[j] == null)
					{
						if (inMemoryRow[columns[j].ColumnIndex] == null)
						{
							flag = false;
							break;
						}
					}
					else if (!AreEqualValues(caseSensitive, values[j], inMemoryRow[columns[j].ColumnIndex]))
					{
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					list.Add(inMemoryRow);
					if (findFirst)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static object Convert(object value, InMemoryColumn column)
		{
			return Convert(value, column.Type, column.ColumnForUpdate.Type, column.ColumnForUpdate.AllowNull);
		}

		public static object Convert(object value, Type oldType, Type newType, bool allowNull)
		{
			if (value != null && !oldType.Equals(newType))
			{
				try
				{
					return ((IConvertible)value).ToType(newType, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				catch (Exception innerException)
				{
					throw new InvalidCastException(string.Empty, innerException);
				}
			}
			if (!allowNull)
			{
				throw new InMemoryNoNullAllowedException();
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static object[] PrepareKey(object key)
		{
			if (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(key.GetType()) != TypeCode.Object)
			{
				return new object[1] { key };
			}
			if (!(key is IEnumerable enumerable))
			{
				return new object[1] { key };
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (object item in enumerable)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}

	internal class OleDbReflectionHelper<TOleDbConnection, TOleDbSchemaGuid, TOleDbException, TOleDbError> : OleDbReflectionHelperBase where TOleDbException : Exception
	{
		private static readonly Func<TOleDbConnection, Guid, object[], DataTable> getOldDbSchemaTableHandler;

		private static readonly GetPropertyValueDelegate getSqlErrorsHandler;

		private static readonly GetPropertyValueDelegate getSqlErrorNativeErrorHandler;

		static OleDbReflectionHelper()
		{
			OleDbReflectionHelperBase.OleDbSchemaGuidTables = (Guid)typeof(TOleDbSchemaGuid).GetField("Tables").GetValue(null);
			OleDbReflectionHelperBase.OleDbSchemaGuidProcedures = (Guid)typeof(TOleDbSchemaGuid).GetField("Procedures").GetValue(null);
			OleDbReflectionHelperBase.OleDbSchemaGuidColumns = (Guid)typeof(TOleDbSchemaGuid).GetField("Columns").GetValue(null);
			OleDbReflectionHelperBase.OleDbSchemaGuidPrimaryKeys = (Guid)typeof(TOleDbSchemaGuid).GetField("Primary_Keys").GetValue(null);
			OleDbReflectionHelperBase.OleDbSchemaGuidIndexes = (Guid)typeof(TOleDbSchemaGuid).GetField("Indexes").GetValue(null);
			OleDbReflectionHelperBase.OleDbSchemaGuidForeignKeys = (Guid)typeof(TOleDbSchemaGuid).GetField("Foreign_Keys").GetValue(null);
			getOldDbSchemaTableHandler = (Func<TOleDbConnection, Guid, object[], DataTable>)typeof(TOleDbConnection).GetMethod("GetOleDbSchemaTable", new Type[2]
			{
				typeof(Guid),
				typeof(object[])
			}).CreateDelegate(typeof(Func<TOleDbConnection, Guid, object[], DataTable>));
			getSqlErrorsHandler = ReflectConnectionHelper.CreateGetPropertyDelegate(typeof(TOleDbException), "Errors");
			getSqlErrorNativeErrorHandler = ReflectConnectionHelper.CreateGetPropertyDelegate(typeof(TOleDbError), "NativeError");
		}

		protected override DataTable GetOleDbSchemaTable(IDbConnection connection, Guid schema, object[] restrictions)
		{
			return getOldDbSchemaTableHandler((TOleDbConnection)connection, schema, restrictions);
		}

		public override int GetOleDbExceptionNativeError(Exception ex)
		{
			if (ex is TOleDbException ex2)
			{
				ICollection collection = (ICollection)getSqlErrorsHandler.Invoke((object)ex2);
				if (collection.Count > 0)
				{
					TOleDbError val = collection.Cast<TOleDbError>().First();
					return (int)getSqlErrorNativeErrorHandler.Invoke((object)val);
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override bool IsOleDbException(Exception ex)
		{
			return ex is TOleDbException;
		}
	}

	public class DataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor : EvaluatorContextDescriptor
	{
		private Hashtable children = new Hashtable();

		private object cache;

		private bool contextCaching;

		public readonly DataTable Table;

		private DataRelation relation;

		private static object noResult = new object();

		public bool ContextCaching
		{
			set
			{
				if (contextCaching == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				contextCaching = value;
				if (!value)
				{
					cache = null;
				}
				if (children.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (DataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor value2 in children.Values)
				{
					value2.ContextCaching = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public DataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor(DataRelation relation)
		{
			Table = relation.ChildTable;
			this.relation = relation;
		}

		public DataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor(DataTable table)
		{
			Table = table;
		}

		public override object GetPropertyValue(object source, EvaluatorProperty propertyPath)
		{
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[] propertyPathTokenized = propertyPath.PropertyPathTokenized;
			if (propertyPathTokenized.Length == 1)
			{
				DataColumn dataColumn = Table.Columns[propertyPathTokenized[0]];
				if (dataColumn == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidPropertyPathException(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "Can't find property '{0}'", new object[1] { propertyPath }));
				}
				DataRow dataRow = (DataRow)source;
				return dataRow[dataColumn];
			}
			EvaluatorContext nestedContext = ((EvaluatorContextDescriptor)this).GetNestedContext(source, propertyPathTokenized[0]);
			if (nestedContext == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return nestedContext.GetPropertyValue(propertyPath.SubProperty);
		}

		public override EvaluatorContext GetNestedContext(object source, string propertyPath)
		{
			//IL_00bd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DataRow dataRow = (DataRow)source;
			DataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor dataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor = (DataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor)children[propertyPath];
			DataRelation dataRelation;
			if (dataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor == null)
			{
				dataRelation = dataRow.Table.ChildRelations[propertyPath];
				dataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor = new DataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor(dataRelation);
				dataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor.ContextCaching = contextCaching;
				children[propertyPath] = dataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor;
			}
			else
			{
				dataRelation = dataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor.relation;
			}
			if (contextCaching)
			{
				object obj = dataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor.cache;
				if (obj != null)
				{
					if (obj != noResult)
					{
						return (EvaluatorContext)obj;
					}
					return null;
				}
			}
			DataRow[] childRows = dataRow.GetChildRows(dataRelation);
			if (childRows.Length > 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("InMemory_SingleRowExpected", propertyPath, childRows.Length.ToString()));
			}
			EvaluatorContext val = ((childRows.Length == 0) ? ((EvaluatorContext)null) : new EvaluatorContext((EvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)dataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor, (object)childRows[0]));
			if (contextCaching)
			{
				dataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor.cache = ((val == null) ? noResult : val);
			}
			return val;
		}

		public override IEnumerable GetCollectionContexts(object source, string collectionName)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(collectionName))
			{
				DataRelation dataRelation = Table.ChildRelations[collectionName];
				if (dataRelation == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("InMemory_NotACollection", collectionName));
				}
				DataRow dataRow = (DataRow)source;
				return (IEnumerable)new CollectionContexts((EvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)new DataViewEvaluatorContextDescriptor(dataRelation.ChildTable), (IEnumerable)dataRow.GetChildRows(dataRelation));
			}
			return (IEnumerable)new CollectionContexts((EvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)this, (IEnumerable)source);
		}

		public override IEnumerable GetQueryContexts(object source, string queryTypeName, CriteriaOperator condition, int top)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}
	}
	public class IsTopLevelAggregateChecker : IQueryCriteriaVisitor<bool>, ICriteriaVisitor<bool>
	{
		public bool Visit(QuerySubQueryContainer theOperand)
		{
			if (theOperand.Node == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Visit(QueryOperand theOperand)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public bool Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process((IEnumerable)theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public bool Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public bool Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process((IEnumerable)theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public bool Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (Process(theOperator.LeftOperand))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return Process((IEnumerable)theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public bool Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process(theOperator.Operand);
		}

		public bool Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperator.LeftOperand))
			{
				return Process(theOperator.RightOperand);
			}

		private static string GetRelationName(DataTable table, DBForeignKey fk)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("FK_");
			stringBuilder.Append(Escape(table.TableName));
			int count = ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)fk).Columns.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)fk).Columns[i]);
			}
			count = fk.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns.Count;
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(fk.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns[j]);
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(Escape(fk.PrimaryKeyTable));
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private static string Escape(string name)
		{
			return name.Replace('.', '_');
		}

		private static DataColumn[] GetColumns(DataTable table, StringCollection columns)
		{
			DataColumn[] array = new DataColumn[columns.Count];

			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = table.Columns[columns[i]];
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static string GetIndexName(DataTable table, DBIndex index)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(table.TableName);
			int count = ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)index).Columns.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)index).Columns[i]);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private static bool IsEqual(DBIndex index, UniqueConstraint constraint)
		{
			int num = constraint.Columns.Length;
			if (((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)index).Columns.Count != num)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (constraint.Columns[i].ColumnName != ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)index).Columns[i])
				{
					return false;
				}

			return Process((IEnumerable)theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public bool Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public bool Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process((IEnumerable)theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public bool Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (Process(theOperator.LeftOperand))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return Process((IEnumerable)theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public bool Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process(theOperator.Operand);
		}

		public bool Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperator.LeftOperand))
			{
				return Process(theOperator.RightOperand);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperator.TestExpression) && !Process(theOperator.BeginExpression))
			{
				return Process(theOperator.EndExpression);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool Process(IEnumerable ops)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			foreach (CriteriaOperator op2 in ops)
			{
				CriteriaOperator op = op2;
				if (Process(op))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool Process(CriteriaOperator op)
		{
			if (op == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return op.Accept<bool>((ICriteriaVisitor<bool>)this);
		}

		public static bool IsTopLevelAggregate(CriteriaOperator op)
		{
			return new IsTopLevelAggregateCheckerFull().Process(op);
		}

		public static bool IsGrouped(SelectStatement selectStatement)
		{
			if (((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)selectStatement.GroupProperties).Count > 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (selectStatement.GroupCondition != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int count = ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)((BaseStatement)selectStatement).Operands).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (IsTopLevelAggregate(((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)((BaseStatement)selectStatement).Operands)[i]))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class ContextDependenceChecker : IQueryCriteriaVisitor<bool>, ICriteriaVisitor<bool>
	{
		private HashSet<string> upNodes;

		public ContextDependenceChecker(HashSet<string> upNodes)
		{
			this.upNodes = upNodes;
		}

		public bool Process(JoinNode root)
		{
			foreach (DataSetStoreHelpersFull.NodeInfo allNode in DataSetStoreHelpersFull.GetAllNodes(root))
			{
				if (Process(allNode.Node.Condition))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool Process(HashSet<string> upNodes, JoinNode root)
		{
			return new ContextDependenceChecker(upNodes).Process(root);
		}

		private bool Process(CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			if (criteria == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (upNodes == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return criteria.Accept<bool>((ICriteriaVisitor<bool>)this);
		}

		public bool Visit(QuerySubQueryContainer theOperand)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperand.AggregateProperty))
			{
				return Process((JoinNode)(object)theOperand.Node);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Visit(QueryOperand theOperand)
		{
			return upNodes.Contains(theOperand.NodeAlias);
		}

		public bool Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			return ProcessOperands(theOperator.Operands);
		}

		private bool ProcessOperands(CriteriaOperatorCollection operands)
		{
			int count = ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)operands).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (Process(((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)operands)[i]))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public bool Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			return ProcessOperands(theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public bool Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (Process(theOperator.LeftOperand))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ProcessOperands(theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public bool Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process(theOperator.Operand);
		}

		public bool Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperator.LeftOperand))
			{
				return Process(theOperator.RightOperand);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperator.TestExpression) && !Process(theOperator.BeginExpression))
			{
				return Process(theOperator.EndExpression);
			}
			return true;
		}

	public class IndexFinderItem
	{
		public readonly InMemoryColumn Column;

		public readonly object Value;

		public readonly bool ValueIsQueryOperand;

		public IndexFinderItem(InMemoryColumn column, object value, bool valueIsQueryOperand)
		{
			Column = column;
			Value = value;
			ValueIsQueryOperand = valueIsQueryOperand;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} = {1}", new object[2] { Column, Value });
		}
	}
	public class IndexFinderItemComparerByColumnIndex : IComparer<IndexFinderItem>
	{
		public int Compare(IndexFinderItem left, IndexFinderItem right)
		{
			if (left == right)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (left == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (right == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return left.Column.ColumnIndex.CompareTo(right.Column.ColumnIndex);
		}
	}

		object ICriteriaVisitor<object>.Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)theOperator.OperatorType == 0)
			{
				return VisitGroupAnd(theOperator.Operands);
			}
			return VisitGroupOr(theOperator.Operands);
		}

		private object VisitGroupAnd(CriteriaOperatorCollection operands)
		{
			int count = ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)operands).Count;
			List<List<IndexFinderItem>> list = null;
			List<IndexFinderItem> list2 = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				object obj = Process(((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)operands)[i]);
				IndexFinderItem indexFinderItem = obj as IndexFinderItem;
				List<List<IndexFinderItem>> list3 = obj as List<List<IndexFinderItem>>;
				if (list == null)
				{
					if (indexFinderItem != null)
					{
						if (list2 == null)
						{
							list2 = new List<IndexFinderItem>();
						}
						list2.Add(indexFinderItem);
					}
					else
					{
						if (list3 == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						list = list3;
						if (list2 != null)
						{
							for (int j = 0; j < list3.Count; j++)
							{
								list3[j].AddRange(list2);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else if (indexFinderItem != null)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
					{
						list[k].Add(indexFinderItem);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (list3 == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					List<List<IndexFinderItem>> list4 = new List<List<IndexFinderItem>>();
					for (int l = 0; l < list.Count; l++)
					{
						for (int m = 0; m < list3.Count; m++)
						{
							List<IndexFinderItem> list5 = new List<IndexFinderItem>(list[l]);
							list5.AddRange(list3[m]);
							list4.Add(list5);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (list == null && list2 != null)
			{
				list = new List<List<IndexFinderItem>>();
				list.Add(list2);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private object VisitGroupOr(CriteriaOperatorCollection operands)
		{
			int count = ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)operands).Count;
			List<List<IndexFinderItem>> list = new List<List<IndexFinderItem>>();

				if (list2 != null)

					continue;
				}
				return null;
			}
			return list;

					list2.Add(new IndexFinderItem((InMemoryColumn)obj, obj2, obj2 is QueryOperand));
					list.Add(list2);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list;

			}
			if (obj2 is InMemoryColumn && obj != null)

		public IndexFinder(string alias, InMemoryTable table, bool returnProperies)

		public IndexFinder(string alias, InMemoryTable table)
		{
			this.alias = alias;
			this.table = table;
			foreach (InMemoryColumn column in table.Columns)
			{
				if (column.HasIndexes)
				{
					columnsWithIndecies.Add(column.Name, column);
				}
			}
		}

		public static IndexFinderResult Find(string alias, InMemoryTable table, CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			return Find(alias, table, criteria, returnProperties: false);
		}

		public static IndexFinderResult Find(string alias, InMemoryTable table, CriteriaOperator criteria, bool returnProperties)
		{
			return new IndexFinder(alias, table, returnProperties).Find(criteria);
		}

		public IndexFinderResult Find(CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			if (criteria == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (table.Indexes.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = criteria.Accept<object>((ICriteriaVisitor<object>)this);
			if (obj is IndexFinderItem indexFinderItem)
			{
				foreach (InMemoryIndexWrapper index in table.Indexes)
				{
					if (index.Columns.Count == 1 && index.Columns[0] == indexFinderItem.Column)
					{
						return new IndexFinderResult(new IndexFinderItem[1][] { new IndexFinderItem[1] { indexFinderItem } });
					}
				}
			}
			if (!(obj is List<List<IndexFinderItem>> list))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (list.Count == 1 && list[0].Count == 1)
			{
				foreach (InMemoryIndexWrapper index2 in table.Indexes)
				{
					if (index2.Columns.Count == 1 && index2.Columns[0] == list[0][0].Column)
					{
						return new IndexFinderResult(new IndexFinderItem[1][] { new IndexFinderItem[1] { list[0][0] } });
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			List<IndexFinderItem[]> list2 = new List<IndexFinderItem[]>();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				List<IndexFinderItem> list3 = null;
				List<IndexFinderItem> list4 = list[i];
				list4.Sort(new IndexFinderItemComparerByColumnIndex());
				foreach (InMemoryIndexWrapper index3 in table.Indexes)
				{
					List<IndexFinderItem> indexIntersection = GetIndexIntersection(index3, list4);
					if (indexIntersection != null)
					{
						if (list3 == null)
						{
							list3 = indexIntersection;
						}
						if (list3.Count < indexIntersection.Count)
						{
							list3 = indexIntersection;
						}
					}
				}
				if (list3 == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				list2.Add(list3.ToArray());
			}
			return new IndexFinderResult(list2.ToArray());
		}

		private static List<IndexFinderItem> GetIndexIntersection(InMemoryIndexWrapper index, List<IndexFinderItem> list)
		{
			int i = 0;
			List<IndexFinderItem> list2 = null;
			for (int j = 0; j < index.Columns.Count; j++)
			{
				InMemoryColumn inMemoryColumn = index.Columns[j];
				for (; i < list.Count; i++)
				{
					if (inMemoryColumn == list[i].Column)
					{
						if (list2 == null)
						{
							list2 = new List<IndexFinderItem>();
						}
						list2.Add(list[i]);
						i++;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (list2 != null && list2.Count == index.Columns.Count)
			{
				return list2;
			}
			return null;
		}

		object IQueryCriteriaVisitor<object>.Visit(QuerySubQueryContainer theOperand)
		{
			return null;
		}

		object IQueryCriteriaVisitor<object>.Visit(QueryOperand theOperand)
		{
			string text = ((theOperand.NodeAlias != null) ? theOperand.NodeAlias : string.Empty);
			if (alias == text && columnsWithIndecies.TryGetValue(theOperand.ColumnName, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (!returnProperies)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return theOperand;
		}

		public static IndexFinderItem[][] GetFullIndexResult(IndexFinderItem[][] inputResult)
		{
			List<IndexFinderItem[]> list = new List<IndexFinderItem[]>();
			List<IndexFinderItem> vector = new List<IndexFinderItem>(inputResult.Length);
			FillResultList(list, inputResult, vector, 0);
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static void FillResultList(List<IndexFinderItem[]> resultList, IndexFinderItem[][] inputResult, List<IndexFinderItem> vector, int level)
		{
			IndexFinderItem[] array = inputResult[level];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				vector.Add(array[i]);
				if (level < inputResult.Length - 1)
				{
					FillResultList(resultList, inputResult, vector, level + 1);
				}
				else
				{
					resultList.Add(vector.ToArray());
				}
				vector.RemoveAt(vector.Count - 1);
			}
		}

		public static bool HasQueryOperand(IndexFinderResult keys)
		{
			if (keys == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < keys.Result.Length; i++)
			{
				IndexFinderItem[] array = keys.Result[i];
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					if (array[j].ValueIsQueryOperand)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static InMemoryIndexWrapper[] GetIndexList(InMemoryTable table, IndexFinderResult keys)
		{
			if (keys == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			InMemoryIndexWrapper[] array = new InMemoryIndexWrapper[keys.Result.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < keys.Result.Length; i++)
			{
				IndexFinderItem[] array2 = keys.Result[i];
				InMemoryColumn[] array3 = new InMemoryColumn[array2.Length];
				for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
				{
					array3[j] = array2[j].Column;
				}
				array[i] = table.Rows.FindIndex(array3);
			}
			return array;
		}

	public struct NodeCriteriaFinderResult
	{
		public bool Processed;

		public string MainAlias;

		public List<string> List;

		public NodeCriteriaFinderResult(bool processed, string mainAlias, List<string> list)
		{
			Processed = processed;
			MainAlias = mainAlias;
			List = list;
		}

		public static NodeCriteriaFinderResult New(bool processed)
		{
			return new NodeCriteriaFinderResult(processed, null, new List<string>());
		}

		public void Union(NodeCriteriaFinderResult anotherResult)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(anotherResult.MainAlias))
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(MainAlias))
				{
					MainAlias = anotherResult.MainAlias;
				}
				else if (MainAlias != anotherResult.MainAlias)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException($"MainAlias({MainAlias}) != anotherResult.MainAlias({anotherResult.MainAlias})");
				}
			}
			if (List == null)
			{
				List = anotherResult.List;
			}
			else if (anotherResult.List != null)
			{
				List.AddRange(anotherResult.List);
			}
		}

		public string ProcessNodesString()
		{
			if (List == null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(MainAlias))
				{
					return "*" + MainAlias;
				}
				return MainAlias;
			}
			List.Sort();
			string text = null;
			for (int num = List.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (text == List[num])
				{
					List.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					text = List[num];
				}
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int count = List.Count;
			text = null;
			for (int i = -1; i < count; i++)
			{
				string text2;
				if (i >= 0)
				{
					text2 = List[i];
					if (text2 == text)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(".");
					}
					text = text2;
				}
				else
				{
					text2 = MainAlias;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(MainAlias))
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("*");
					}
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(text2);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class NodeCriteriaFinder : IQueryCriteriaVisitor<NodeCriteriaFinderResult>, ICriteriaVisitor<NodeCriteriaFinderResult>
	{
		private int inAtomicGroupLevel;

		private Dictionary<string, PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> criteriaDict;

		private string currentNodeAlias;

		public static Dictionary<string, PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> FindCriteria(string currentNodeAlias, CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			return new NodeCriteriaFinder().Find(currentNodeAlias, criteria);
		}

		public static void FindCriteria(string currentNodeAlias, CriteriaOperator criteria, Dictionary<string, PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> previousDict)
		{
			new NodeCriteriaFinder().Find(currentNodeAlias, criteria, previousDict);
		}

		public Dictionary<string, PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> Find(string currentNodeAlias, CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			Find(currentNodeAlias, criteria, new Dictionary<string, PlanAliasCriteriaInfo>());
			return criteriaDict;
		}

		public void Find(string currentNodeAlias, CriteriaOperator criteria, Dictionary<string, PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> previousDict)
		{
			if (previousDict == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			this.currentNodeAlias = currentNodeAlias;
			criteriaDict = previousDict;
			ProcessAddOperands((CriteriaOperator[])(object)new CriteriaOperator[1] { criteria });
		}

		private NodeCriteriaFinderResult Process(CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			if (criteria == null)
			{
				return new NodeCriteriaFinderResult(processed: true, null, null);
			}
			return criteria.Accept<NodeCriteriaFinderResult>((ICriteriaVisitor<NodeCriteriaFinderResult>)this);
		}

		NodeCriteriaFinderResult IQueryCriteriaVisitor<NodeCriteriaFinderResult>.Visit(QuerySubQueryContainer theOperand)
		{
			inAtomicGroupLevel++;
			try
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				NodeCriteriaFinderResult result = NodeCriteriaFinderResult.New(processed: false);
				NodeCriteriaFinderResult anotherResult = Process(theOperand.AggregateProperty);
				result.Union(anotherResult);
				if (theOperand.Node != null)
				{
					List<DataSetStoreHelpersFull.NodeInfo> allNodes = DataSetStoreHelpersFull.GetAllNodes((JoinNode)(object)theOperand.Node);
					foreach (DataSetStoreHelpersFull.NodeInfo item in allNodes)
					{
						list.Add(item.Node.Alias);
						NodeCriteriaFinderResult anotherResult2 = Process(item.Node.Condition);
						result.Union(anotherResult2);
					}
				}
				for (int num = result.List.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (list.Contains(result.List[num]))
					{
						result.List.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				inAtomicGroupLevel--;
			}
		}

		NodeCriteriaFinderResult IQueryCriteriaVisitor<NodeCriteriaFinderResult>.Visit(QueryOperand theOperand)
		{
			return new NodeCriteriaFinderResult(processed: false, null, new List<string> { theOperand.NodeAlias });
		}

		NodeCriteriaFinderResult ICriteriaVisitor<NodeCriteriaFinderResult>.Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			inAtomicGroupLevel++;
			try
			{
				return ProcessOperands((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands);
			}
			finally
			{
				inAtomicGroupLevel--;
			}
		}

		NodeCriteriaFinderResult ICriteriaVisitor<NodeCriteriaFinderResult>.Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			return new NodeCriteriaFinderResult(processed: false, null, null);
		}

		NodeCriteriaFinderResult ICriteriaVisitor<NodeCriteriaFinderResult>.Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)theOperator.OperatorType == 1)
			{
				inAtomicGroupLevel++;
				try
				{
					return ProcessOperands((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands);
				}
				finally
				{
					inAtomicGroupLevel--;
				}
			}
			if (inAtomicGroupLevel > 0)
			{
				return ProcessOperands((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands);
			}
			return ProcessAddOperands(((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands).ToArray());
		}

		private NodeCriteriaFinderResult ProcessAddOperands(CriteriaOperator[] operands)
		{
			int num = operands.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				NodeCriteriaFinderResult nodeCriteriaFinderResult = Process(operands[i]);
				if (nodeCriteriaFinderResult.List == null)
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentNodeAlias) || nodeCriteriaFinderResult.Processed)
					{
						continue;
					}
					nodeCriteriaFinderResult.MainAlias = currentNodeAlias;
				}
				else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentNodeAlias))
				{
					nodeCriteriaFinderResult.MainAlias = currentNodeAlias;
				}
				string key = nodeCriteriaFinderResult.ProcessNodesString();
				PlanAliasCriteriaInfo value = null;
				if (!criteriaDict.TryGetValue(key, out value))
				{
					value = new PlanAliasCriteriaInfo(nodeCriteriaFinderResult.MainAlias, (nodeCriteriaFinderResult.List == null) ? new string[0] : nodeCriteriaFinderResult.List.ToArray(), new List<CriteriaOperator>());
					criteriaDict.Add(key, value);
				}
				value.Criteria.Add(operands[i]);
			}
			return new NodeCriteriaFinderResult(processed: true, null, null);
		}

		private NodeCriteriaFinderResult ProcessOperands(List<CriteriaOperator> operands)
		{
			NodeCriteriaFinderResult result = default(NodeCriteriaFinderResult);
			int count = operands.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				NodeCriteriaFinderResult nodeCriteriaFinderResult = Process(operands[i]);
				if (nodeCriteriaFinderResult.List != null)
				{
					if (result.List == null)
					{
						result.List = nodeCriteriaFinderResult.List;
					}
					else
					{
						result.List.AddRange(nodeCriteriaFinderResult.List);
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		NodeCriteriaFinderResult ICriteriaVisitor<NodeCriteriaFinderResult>.Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			inAtomicGroupLevel++;
			try
			{
				List<CriteriaOperator> list = new List<CriteriaOperator>();
				list.Add(theOperator.LeftOperand);
				list.AddRange((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)theOperator.Operands);
				return ProcessOperands(list);
			}
			finally
			{
				inAtomicGroupLevel--;
			}
		}

		NodeCriteriaFinderResult ICriteriaVisitor<NodeCriteriaFinderResult>.Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			inAtomicGroupLevel++;
			try
			{
				return Process(theOperator.Operand);
			}
			finally
			{
				inAtomicGroupLevel--;
			}
		}

		NodeCriteriaFinderResult ICriteriaVisitor<NodeCriteriaFinderResult>.Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			inAtomicGroupLevel++;
			try
			{
				NodeCriteriaFinderResult result = Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
				NodeCriteriaFinderResult result2 = Process(theOperator.RightOperand);
				if (result.List == null)
				{
					return result2;
				}
				if (result2.List == null)
				{
					return result;
				}
				result.List.AddRange(result2.List);
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				inAtomicGroupLevel--;
			}
		}

		NodeCriteriaFinderResult ICriteriaVisitor<NodeCriteriaFinderResult>.Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
		{
			inAtomicGroupLevel++;
			try
			{
				NodeCriteriaFinderResult result = Process(theOperator.BeginExpression);
				NodeCriteriaFinderResult nodeCriteriaFinderResult = Process(theOperator.EndExpression);
				NodeCriteriaFinderResult nodeCriteriaFinderResult2 = Process(theOperator.TestExpression);
				NodeCriteriaFinderResult nodeCriteriaFinderResult3 = default(NodeCriteriaFinderResult);
				if (nodeCriteriaFinderResult.List == null)
				{
					nodeCriteriaFinderResult3 = nodeCriteriaFinderResult2;
				}
				else
				{
					nodeCriteriaFinderResult3 = nodeCriteriaFinderResult;
					if (nodeCriteriaFinderResult2.List != null)
					{
						nodeCriteriaFinderResult3.List.AddRange(nodeCriteriaFinderResult2.List);
					}
				}
				if (result.List == null)
				{
					return nodeCriteriaFinderResult3;
				}
				if (nodeCriteriaFinderResult3.List == null)
				{
					return result;
				}
				result.List.AddRange(nodeCriteriaFinderResult3.List);
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				inAtomicGroupLevel--;
			}
		}
	}

		public static List<List<InMemoryComplexRow>> DoGetGroupedDataCore(ExpressionEvaluator[] groupEvaluators, ExpressionEvaluator havingEvaluator, SortingListComparerFull sortingComparer, int skipRecords, int topRecords, InMemoryComplexSet rows, bool doRandomizeIfNoSorting)
		{
			Dictionary<InMemoryGroupFull, List<InMemoryComplexRow>> dictionary = new Dictionary<InMemoryGroupFull, List<InMemoryComplexRow>>();
			if (sortingComparer == null)
			{
				rows.Randomize();
			}
			if (groupEvaluators.Length == 0)
			{
				dictionary.Add(new InMemoryGroupFull(new object[0]), new List<InMemoryComplexRow>());
			}
			int count = rows.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				InMemoryComplexRow inMemoryComplexRow = rows[i];
				InMemoryGroupFull key = new InMemoryGroupFull(GetResultRow(inMemoryComplexRow, groupEvaluators));
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					value = new List<InMemoryComplexRow>();
					dictionary.Add(key, value);
				}
				value.Add(inMemoryComplexRow);
			}
			List<List<InMemoryComplexRow>> list = new List<List<InMemoryComplexRow>>();
			foreach (List<InMemoryComplexRow> value2 in dictionary.Values)
			{
				if (value2.Count > 0)
				{
					if (havingEvaluator.Fit((object)value2))
					{
						list.Add(value2);
					}
				}
				else if (havingEvaluator.Fit((object)null))
				{
					list.Add(value2);
				}
			}
			if (sortingComparer != null)
			{
				list.Sort(sortingComparer);
			}
			if (skipRecords != 0)
			{
				if (skipRecords >= list.Count)
				{
					list.Clear();
				}
				else
				{
					list.RemoveRange(0, skipRecords);
				}
			}
			if (topRecords != 0 && topRecords < list.Count)
			{
				list.RemoveRange(topRecords, list.Count - topRecords);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static bool GetComplexRowData(string alias, QueryOperand theOperand, InMemoryComplexRow complexRow, out object result)
		{

		public override object GetQueryResult(JoinNode root)
		{
			IInMemoryDataElector inMemoryDataElector;

					InMemoryDataElectorSource.FillNodesDict(nestedSource[i], hashSet);

				{
					inMemoryDataElector = planner.GetPlan(root, hashSet);
					value = new InMemoryPlanCacheItem(inMemoryDataElector);
					existsPlanCashe.Add(root, value);
				}
				else
				{
					inMemoryDataElector = planner.GetPlan(root).Process(this);
					value = new InMemoryPlanCacheItem(inMemoryDataElector);
					existsPlanCashe.Add(root, value);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				inMemoryDataElector = value.Elector;
			}

		}

	internal class InMemoryProjectionElector : IInMemoryDataElector
	{
		private readonly string projectionAlias;

		private readonly DBProjection projection;

		private readonly IInMemoryDataElector inputData;

		private Func<InMemoryComplexSet, InMemoryComplexSet> makeProjectionHandler;

		public InMemoryProjectionElector(IInMemoryDataElector inputData, DBProjection projection, string projectionAlias)
		{
			this.inputData = inputData;
			this.projectionAlias = projectionAlias;
			this.projection = projection;
		}

		private static void PrepareRowsBeforeProjection(InMemoryComplexSet rows, SelectStatement select, SortingComparerFull sortingComparer)
		{
			if (sortingComparer != null)
			{
				rows.Sort(sortingComparer);
			}
			int skipSelectedRecords = select.SkipSelectedRecords;
			if (skipSelectedRecords > 0)
			{
				if (skipSelectedRecords >= rows.Count)
				{
					rows.Clear();
				}
				else
				{
					rows.RemoveRange(0, skipSelectedRecords);
				}
			}
			int topSelectedRecords = select.TopSelectedRecords;
			if (topSelectedRecords > 0 && topSelectedRecords < rows.Count)
			{
				rows.RemoveRange(topSelectedRecords, rows.Count - topSelectedRecords);
			}
		}

		public InMemoryComplexSet Process(InMemoryDataElectorContextDescriptor descriptor)
		{
			if (makeProjectionHandler == null)
			{
				SelectStatement select = projection.Projection;
				InMemoryProjectionTable projectionTable = new InMemoryProjectionTable(projection, projectionAlias);
				if (IsTopLevelAggregateCheckerFull.IsGrouped(select))
				{
					ExpressionEvaluator[] groupEvaluators = DataSetStoreHelpersFull.PrepareDataEvaluators(select.GroupProperties, (EvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)descriptor, descriptor.CaseSensitive, descriptor.CustomFunctions, descriptor.CustomAggregates);
					ExpressionEvaluator[] dataEvaluators = DataSetStoreHelpersFull.PrepareDataEvaluators(((BaseStatement)select).Operands, (EvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)descriptor, descriptor.CaseSensitive, descriptor.CustomFunctions, descriptor.CustomAggregates);
					ExpressionEvaluator havingEvaluator = DataSetStoreHelpersFull.PrepareDataEvaluator(select.GroupCondition, (EvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)descriptor, descriptor.CaseSensitive, descriptor.CustomFunctions, descriptor.CustomAggregates);
					SortingListComparerFull sortingComparer = DataSetStoreHelpersFull.PrepareSortingListComparer(select.SortProperties, (EvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)descriptor, descriptor.CaseSensitive, descriptor.CustomFunctions, descriptor.CustomAggregates);
					makeProjectionHandler = delegate(InMemoryComplexSet rows)
					{
						List<List<InMemoryComplexRow>> list = DataSetStoreHelpersFull.DoGetGroupedDataCore(groupEvaluators, havingEvaluator, sortingComparer, select.SkipSelectedRecords, select.TopSelectedRecords, rows, doRandomizeIfNoSorting: false);
						InMemoryComplexSet inMemoryComplexSet = new InMemoryComplexSet();
						inMemoryComplexSet.AddTable(projectionAlias, projectionTable);
						foreach (List<InMemoryComplexRow> item in list)
						{
							InMemoryProjectionRow value = new InMemoryProjectionRow(projectionTable, DataSetStoreHelpersFull.GetResultRow(item, dataEvaluators));
							inMemoryComplexSet.AddRow(new InMemoryComplexRow(inMemoryComplexSet) { [0] = value });
						}
						return inMemoryComplexSet;
					};
				}
				else
				{
					ExpressionEvaluator[] dataEvaluators2 = ((!projectionTable.IsTransitive) ? DataSetStoreHelpersFull.PrepareDataEvaluators(((BaseStatement)select).Operands, (EvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)descriptor, descriptor.CaseSensitive, descriptor.CustomFunctions, descriptor.CustomAggregates) : null);
					SortingComparerFull sortingComparer2 = DataSetStoreHelpersFull.PrepareSortingComparer(select.SortProperties, (EvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)descriptor, descriptor.CaseSensitive, descriptor.CustomFunctions, descriptor.CustomAggregates);
					if (dataEvaluators2 == null)
					{
						makeProjectionHandler = delegate(InMemoryComplexSet rows)
						{
							PrepareRowsBeforeProjection(rows, select, sortingComparer2);
							rows.MakeProjection(projectionAlias);
							return rows;
						};
					}
					else
					{
						makeProjectionHandler = delegate(InMemoryComplexSet rows)
						{
							PrepareRowsBeforeProjection(rows, select, sortingComparer2);
							InMemoryComplexSet inMemoryComplexSet = new InMemoryComplexSet();
							inMemoryComplexSet.AddTable(projectionAlias, projectionTable);
							foreach (InMemoryComplexRow row in rows)
							{
								InMemoryProjectionRow value = new InMemoryProjectionRow(projectionTable, DataSetStoreHelpersFull.GetResultRow(row, dataEvaluators2));
								inMemoryComplexSet.AddRow(new InMemoryComplexRow(inMemoryComplexSet) { [0] = value });
							}
							return inMemoryComplexSet;
						};
					}
				}
			}
			InMemoryComplexSet arg = inputData.Process(descriptor);
			return makeProjectionHandler(arg);
		}
	}

			public PlanPathItemType Type => PlanPathItemType.Table;

			public long EstimatedRowsCount => rowsCount;

			public double Cost => 1.0;

			public JoinType JoinType => (JoinType)0;

			{
				this.nodeAlias = nodeAlias;
				nodes = new ReadOnlySet<string>(new string[1] { nodeAlias });
				this.rowsCount = rowsCount;
			}

			}
		}

		private class NestedLoopJoinPlanPathItem : IPlanPathItem
		{
			private readonly IPlanPathItem left;

			private readonly IPlanPathItem right;

			private readonly ReadOnlySet<string> nodes;

			private readonly JoinType joinType;

			private readonly string toStringMessage;

			private double? cost;

			private long? estimatedRowsCount;

			public ReadOnlySet<string> Nodes => nodes;

			public IPlanPathItem Left => left;

			public IPlanPathItem Right => right;

			public PlanPathItemType Type => PlanPathItemType.NestedLoop;

			public double Cost
			{
				get
				{
					if (!cost.HasValue)
					{
						cost = left.Cost + right.Cost + (double)(left.EstimatedRowsCount * right.EstimatedRowsCount);
					}
					return cost.Value;
				}
			}

			public long EstimatedRowsCount
			{
				get
				{
					//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					if (!estimatedRowsCount.HasValue)
					{
						estimatedRowsCount = (((int)joinType == 0) ? (Math.Min(left.EstimatedRowsCount, right.EstimatedRowsCount) / 2) : (left.EstimatedRowsCount * right.EstimatedRowsCount / 2));
					}
					return estimatedRowsCount.Value;
				}
			}

			public JoinType JoinType => joinType;

			public NestedLoopJoinPlanPathItem(IPlanPathItem left, IPlanPathItem right, bool isLeftOuter)
			{
				//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				this.left = left;
				this.right = right;
				joinType = (JoinType)(isLeftOuter ? 1 : 0);
				nodes = new ReadOnlySet<string>(left.Nodes, right.Nodes);
				toStringMessage = string.Format(isLeftOuter ? "[{0} *> {1}]" : "[{0} <*> {1}]", left.ToString(), right.ToString());
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return toStringMessage;
			}
		}

		private class LookupJoinPlanPathItem : IPlanPathItem
		{
			private readonly IPlanPathItem left;

			private readonly IPlanPathItem right;

			private readonly ReadOnlySet<string> nodes;

			private readonly JoinType joinType;

			private readonly string toStringMessage;

			private double? cost;

			private long? estimatedRowsCount;

			public ReadOnlySet<string> Nodes => nodes;

			public IPlanPathItem Left => left;

			public IPlanPathItem Right => right;

			public PlanPathItemType Type => PlanPathItemType.LookupInRight;

			public double Cost
			{
				get
				{
					if (!cost.HasValue)
					{
						cost = left.Cost + right.Cost + (double)left.EstimatedRowsCount;
					}
					return cost.Value;
				}
			}

			public long EstimatedRowsCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (!estimatedRowsCount.HasValue)
					{
						estimatedRowsCount = left.EstimatedRowsCount / 2;
					}
					return estimatedRowsCount.Value;
				}
			}

			public JoinType JoinType => joinType;

			public LookupJoinPlanPathItem(IPlanPathItem left, IPlanPathItem right, bool isLeftOuter)
			{
				//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				this.left = left;
				if (right.Type != PlanPathItemType.Table)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("right");
				}
				this.right = right;
				joinType = (JoinType)(isLeftOuter ? 1 : 0);
				nodes = new ReadOnlySet<string>(left.Nodes, right.Nodes);
				toStringMessage = string.Format(isLeftOuter ? "[{0} +> {1}]" : "[{0} <+> {1}]", left.ToString(), right.ToString());
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return toStringMessage;
			}
		}

		private class PlanRelationInfo
		{
			public readonly string Left;

			public readonly string Right;

			public readonly bool IsLookup;

			public readonly bool IsLeftOuter;

			public PlanRelationInfo(string left, string right, bool isLookup, bool isLeftOuter)
			{
				Left = left;
				Right = right;
				IsLookup = isLookup;
				IsLeftOuter = isLeftOuter;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				stringBuilder.Append(Left);
				if (IsLeftOuter)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" ");
					stringBuilder.Append(IsLookup ? "+" : "*");
					stringBuilder.Append("> (");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" <");
					stringBuilder.Append(IsLookup ? "+" : "*");
					stringBuilder.Append("> (");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Right);
				stringBuilder.Append(")");
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		private class PlanNodeInfo
		{
			public readonly string Alias;

			public readonly InMemoryTable Table;

			public readonly IInMemoryDataElector SubqueryElector;

			public readonly JoinNode Node;

			public readonly int Index;

			public readonly string ParentAlias;

			private PlanNodeInfo(string alias, JoinNode node, int index, string parentAlias)
			{
				Alias = alias;
				Node = node;
				Index = index;
				ParentAlias = parentAlias;
			}

			public PlanNodeInfo(string alias, InMemoryTable table, JoinNode node, int index, string parentAlias)
				: this(alias, node, index, parentAlias)
			{
				Table = table;
			}

			public PlanNodeInfo(string alias, IInMemoryDataElector subqueryElector, JoinNode node, int index, string parentAlias)
				: this(alias, node, index, parentAlias)
			{
				ref IInMemoryDataElector subqueryElector2 = ref SubqueryElector;
				DBTable table = node.Table;
				subqueryElector2 = new InMemoryProjectionElector(subqueryElector, (DBProjection)(object)((table is DBProjection) ? table : null), node.Alias);
			}

			public bool IsLeftFor(PlanNodeInfo other)
			{
				return Index < other.Index;
			}

			public bool IsSubquery()
			{
				return SubqueryElector != null;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (IsSubquery())
				{
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} join ({1}) {2}({3})", Node.Type, Table.ToString(), Alias, Index);
				}
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} join {1} {2}({3})", Node.Type, Table.Name, Alias, Index);
			}
		}

		private class NodeSetEqulityComparer : IEqualityComparer<ReadOnlySet<string>>
		{
			public static readonly NodeSetEqulityComparer Instance = new NodeSetEqulityComparer();

			public bool Equals(ReadOnlySet<string> x, ReadOnlySet<string> y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null || x.Count != y.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				foreach (string item in x)
				{
					if (!y.Contains(item))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			public int GetHashCode(ReadOnlySet<string> nodeSet)
			{
				if (nodeSet == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				int num = 0;
				foreach (string item in nodeSet)
				{
					num ^= item.GetHashCode();
				}
				return num ^ nodeSet.Count;
			}
		}

		private class PlanPathFinder : IDisposable
		{
			private const int SearchCostFoundPlansMaxRatio = 1500;

			private const int SearchCostNodeCountMaxRatio = 500;

			private IPlanPathItem bestPlan;

			private int bestPlanMissCounter;

			private int chunkCostMissCounter;

			private double? bestPlanCost;

			private readonly InMemorySet set;

			private readonly OrdinaryDictionary<string, IPlanPathItem> tableItemCache;

			private readonly Dictionary<string, PlanNodeInfo> nodes;

			private readonly Dictionary<string, List<PlanRelationInfo>> relations;

			private OrdinaryDictionary<ReadOnlySet<string>, double> chunkCostDictionary;

			public PlanPathFinder(InMemorySet set, Dictionary<string, PlanNodeInfo> nodes, Dictionary<string, List<PlanRelationInfo>> relations)
			{
				this.set = set;
				this.nodes = nodes;
				this.relations = relations;
				tableItemCache = new OrdinaryDictionary<string, IPlanPathItem>(nodes.Count);
				chunkCostDictionary = new OrdinaryDictionary<ReadOnlySet<string>, double>(nodes.Count * nodes.Count * 10, (IEqualityComparer<ReadOnlySet<string>>)NodeSetEqulityComparer.Instance);
			}

			public IPlanPathItem Find()
			{
				if (chunkCostDictionary == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				bestPlan = null;
				bestPlanCost = null;
				bestPlanMissCounter = 0;
				chunkCostMissCounter = 0;
				chunkCostDictionary.Clear();
				foreach (PlanNodeInfo value in nodes.Values)
				{
					FindInternal(CreateTableItem(value.Alias));
				}
				return bestPlan;
			}

			private void FindInternal(IPlanPathItem item)
			{
				double cost = item.Cost;
				int count = nodes.Count;
				if (item.Nodes.Count == count)
				{
					if (!bestPlanCost.HasValue || bestPlanCost > cost)
					{
						bestPlan = item;
						bestPlanCost = cost;
					}
					else
					{
						bestPlanMissCounter++;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (bestPlanCost.HasValue && (cost > bestPlanCost || (bestPlanMissCounter > 0 && chunkCostMissCounter / bestPlanMissCounter > 1500) || (count > 0 && chunkCostMissCounter / count > 500)))
					{
						return;
					}
					double num = default(double);
					if (chunkCostDictionary.TryGetValue(item.Nodes, ref num))
					{
						if (num <= cost)
						{
							chunkCostMissCounter++;
							return;
						}
						chunkCostDictionary[item.Nodes] = cost;
					}
					else
					{
						chunkCostDictionary.Add(item.Nodes, cost);
					}
					foreach (string node in item.Nodes)
					{
						if (!relations.TryGetValue(node, out var value))
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (PlanRelationInfo item2 in value)
						{
							if (item2.IsLookup && !item.Nodes.Contains(item2.Right))
							{
								FindInternal(CreateJoinWithTableItem(item, item2));
							}
						}
						foreach (PlanRelationInfo item3 in value)
						{
							if (!item3.IsLookup && !item.Nodes.Contains(item3.Right))
							{
								FindInternal(CreateJoinWithTableItem(item, item3));
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

			private IPlanPathItem CreateTableItem(string nodeAlias)
			{
				IPlanPathItem planPathItem = default(IPlanPathItem);
				if (!tableItemCache.TryGetValue(nodeAlias, ref planPathItem))
				{
					PlanNodeInfo planNodeInfo = nodes[nodeAlias];
					if (planNodeInfo.IsSubquery())
					{
						DBTable table = planNodeInfo.Node.Table;
						DBProjection projection = (DBProjection)(object)((table is DBProjection) ? table : null);
						int projectionRowCount = GetProjectionRowCount(projection);
						planPathItem = new ComplexSetPlanPathItem(nodeAlias, projectionRowCount);
					}
					else
					{
						InMemoryTable table2 = set.GetTable(planNodeInfo.Table.Name);
						planPathItem = new TablePlanPathItem(nodeAlias, table2.Rows.Count);
					}
					tableItemCache.Add(nodeAlias, planPathItem);
				}
				return planPathItem;
			}

			private int GetProjectionRowCount(DBProjection projection)
			{
				IEnumerable<DataSetStoreHelpersFull.NodeInfo> enumerable = from n in DataSetStoreHelpersFull.GetAllNodes((JoinNode)(object)projection.Projection)
					where n.Node.Table != null
					select n;
				int num = 0;
				foreach (DataSetStoreHelpersFull.NodeInfo item in enumerable)
				{
					DBTable table = item.Node.Table;
					projection = (DBProjection)(object)((table is DBProjection) ? table : null);
					num = ((projection == null) ? Math.Max(set.GetTable(item.Node.Table.Name).Rows.Count, num) : Math.Max(GetProjectionRowCount(projection), num));
				}
				return num;
			}

			private IPlanPathItem CreateJoinWithTableItem(IPlanPathItem left, PlanRelationInfo nodeRelation)
			{
				IPlanPathItem planPathItem = CreateTableItem(nodeRelation.Right);
				if (planPathItem.Type == PlanPathItemType.Table && nodeRelation.IsLookup)
				{
					return new LookupJoinPlanPathItem(left, planPathItem, nodeRelation.IsLeftOuter);
				}
				return new NestedLoopJoinPlanPathItem(left, planPathItem, nodeRelation.IsLeftOuter);
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				((FinalizeSuppressableBase)tableItemCache).Dispose();
				((FinalizeSuppressableBase)chunkCostDictionary).Dispose();
				chunkCostDictionary = null;
			}
		}

		private class ReadOnlySet<T> : ISet<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable
		{
			private readonly ICollection<T> internalList;

			public int Count => internalList.Count;

			public bool IsReadOnly => true;

			public ReadOnlySet(IEnumerable<T> source)
			{
				if (source == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("source");
				}
				if (source is ICollection<T> { Count: <=3 } collection)
				{
					internalList = collection;
				}
				else
				{
					internalList = new HashSet<T>(source);
				}
			}

			public ReadOnlySet(ICollection<T> collection1, ICollection<T> collection2)
			{
				if (collection1 == null || collection2 == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("collection1 or collection2");
				}
				if (collection1.Count + collection2.Count > 3)
				{
					HashSet<T> hashSet = new HashSet<T>(collection1);
					hashSet.UnionWith(collection2);
					internalList = hashSet;
				}
				else
				{
					List<T> list = new List<T>(collection1.Count + collection2.Count);
					list.AddRange(collection1);
					list.AddRange(collection2);
					internalList = list;
				}
			}

		private static readonly ReadOnlySet<string> emptySet = new ReadOnlySet<string>(new string[0]);

		private readonly InMemorySet dataSet;

		public InMemoryWeighedPlanner(InMemorySet dataSet)
		{
			this.dataSet = dataSet;
		}

		public IInMemoryDataElector GetPlan(JoinNode root)
		{
			return GetPlanInternal(root, emptySet);
		}

		}

		private IInMemoryDataElector GetPlanInternal(JoinNode root, ISet<string> outerNodes)
		{
			NodeCriteriaFinder nodeCriteriaFinder = new NodeCriteriaFinder();
			Dictionary<string, PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, PlanAliasCriteriaInfo>();
			List<DataSetStoreHelpersFull.NodeInfo> allNodes = DataSetStoreHelpersFull.GetAllNodes(root);
			Dictionary<string, PlanNodeInfo> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<string, PlanNodeInfo>();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DataSetStoreHelpersFull.NodeInfo item in allNodes)
			{
				JoinNode node = item.Node;
				nodeCriteriaFinder.Find(node.Alias, node.Condition, dictionary);
				DBTable table = node.Table;
				DBProjection val = (DBProjection)(object)((table is DBProjection) ? table : null);
				PlanNodeInfo value = ((val != null) ? new PlanNodeInfo(node.Alias, GetPlan((JoinNode)(object)val.Projection), node, num, item.ParentNode?.Alias) : new PlanNodeInfo(node.Alias, GetTable(node.Table.Name), node, num, item.ParentNode?.Alias));
				dictionary2.Add(node.Alias, value);
				num++;
			}
			if (dictionary2.Count == 1)
			{
				PlanNodeInfo planNodeInfo = dictionary2.Values.Single();
				if (planNodeInfo.IsSubquery())
				{
					return new InMemoryDataElectorResultSearch(planNodeInfo.SubqueryElector, planNodeInfo.Node.Condition);
				}
				return new InMemoryDataElectorTableSearch(planNodeInfo.Alias, planNodeInfo.Table, planNodeInfo.Node.Condition);
			}
			Dictionary<string, List<PlanRelationInfo>> relations = FindRelations(dictionary2, dictionary.Values);
			using PlanPathFinder planPathFinder = new PlanPathFinder(dataSet, dictionary2, relations);
			IPlanPathItem planPathItem = planPathFinder.Find();
			if (planPathItem == null)
			{
				throw new InMemorySetException(Res.GetString("InMemoryFull_CannotPrepareQueryPlan"));
			}
			IInMemoryDataElector result = CreateElector(planPathItem, dictionary2, dictionary, outerNodes);
			if (dictionary.Count > 0)
			{
				throw new InMemorySetException(Res.GetString("InMemoryFull_CannotPrepareQueryPlanX0", string.Join(", ", (from c in dictionary.Values.SelectMany((PlanAliasCriteriaInfo cd) => cd.Criteria)
					select ((object)c).ToString()).ToArray())));
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, List<PlanRelationInfo>> FindRelations(Dictionary<string, PlanNodeInfo> nodes, IEnumerable<PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> aliasCriteriaDict)
		{
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0127: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0146: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_014c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0167: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0196: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Dictionary<string, List<PlanRelationInfo>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, List<PlanRelationInfo>>();
			foreach (PlanNodeInfo nodeInfo in nodes.Values)
			{
				bool flag = (int)nodeInfo.Node.Type == 1;
				IndexFinder indexFinder = (nodeInfo.IsSubquery() ? null : new IndexFinder(nodeInfo.Alias, nodeInfo.Table, returnProperies: true));
				if (indexFinder != null)
				{
					foreach (PlanAliasCriteriaInfo item in aliasCriteriaDict)
					{
						if (!item.Aliases.Any((string a) => a == nodeInfo.Alias))
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (CriteriaOperator criterion in item.Criteria)
						{
							IndexFinderResult indexFinderResult = indexFinder.Find(criterion);
							if (indexFinderResult == null)
							{
								continue;
							}
							IndexFinderItem[][] result = indexFinderResult.Result;
							foreach (IndexFinderItem[] array in result)
							{
								IndexFinderItem[] array2 = array;
								foreach (IndexFinderItem indexFinderItem in array2)
								{
									if (!indexFinderItem.ValueIsQueryOperand)
									{
										continue;
									}
									string nodeAlias = ((QueryOperand)indexFinderItem.Value).NodeAlias;
									if (nodes.TryGetValue(nodeAlias, out var value))
									{
										bool flag2 = (int)value.Node.Type == 1;
										if (value.IsLeftFor(nodeInfo))
										{
											TryAddRelationInfo(dictionary, new PlanRelationInfo(((QueryOperand)indexFinderItem.Value).NodeAlias, nodeInfo.Alias, isLookup: true, flag));
										}
										else if (!flag2)
										{
											TryAddRelationInfo(dictionary, new PlanRelationInfo(((QueryOperand)indexFinderItem.Value).NodeAlias, nodeInfo.Alias, isLookup: true, isLeftOuter: false));
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (nodeInfo.ParentAlias != null)
				{
					PlanNodeInfo planNodeInfo = nodes[nodeInfo.ParentAlias];
					TryAddRelationInfo(dictionary, new PlanRelationInfo(planNodeInfo.Alias, nodeInfo.Alias, isLookup: false, flag));
					if (!flag)
					{
						TryAddRelationInfo(dictionary, new PlanRelationInfo(nodeInfo.Alias, planNodeInfo.Alias, isLookup: false, flag));
					}
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static void TryAddRelationInfo(Dictionary<string, List<PlanRelationInfo>> relationDict, PlanRelationInfo newRelation)
		{
			if (!relationDict.TryGetValue(newRelation.Left, out var value))
			{
				value = new List<PlanRelationInfo>();
				relationDict.Add(newRelation.Left, value);
			}
			for (int num = value.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				PlanRelationInfo planRelationInfo = value[num];
				if (planRelationInfo.Right == newRelation.Right)
				{
					if ((!planRelationInfo.IsLookup && newRelation.IsLookup) || (!planRelationInfo.IsLeftOuter && newRelation.IsLeftOuter))
					{
						value[num] = newRelation;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			value.Add(newRelation);
		}

		private IInMemoryDataElector CreateElector(IPlanPathItem plan, Dictionary<string, PlanNodeInfo> nodes, Dictionary<string, PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> criteriaDict, ISet<string> outerNodes)
		{
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0098: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_014e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0163: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0124: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0241: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0256: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ee: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02ee: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0303: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02aa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02bf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IInMemoryDataElector inMemoryDataElector = null;
			switch (plan.Type)
			{
			case PlanPathItemType.Table:
			{
				string text8 = plan.Nodes.Single();
				PlanNodeInfo planNodeInfo8 = nodes[text8];
				inMemoryDataElector = new InMemoryDataElectorTableSearch(text8, planNodeInfo8.Table, TakeCriteria(plan.JoinType, plan.Nodes, nodes, criteriaDict, outerNodes));
				break;
			}
			case PlanPathItemType.ComplexSet:
			{
				string text7 = plan.Nodes.Single();
				PlanNodeInfo planNodeInfo7 = nodes[text7];
				inMemoryDataElector = ((!planNodeInfo7.IsSubquery()) ? new InMemoryDataElectorTableSearch(text7, planNodeInfo7.Table, TakeCriteria(plan.JoinType, plan.Nodes, nodes, criteriaDict, outerNodes)) : planNodeInfo7.SubqueryElector);
				break;
			}
			case PlanPathItemType.LookupInRight:
			{
				string text5 = plan.Right.Nodes.Single();
				PlanNodeInfo planNodeInfo5 = nodes[text5];
				if (plan.Left.Type == PlanPathItemType.Table)
				{
					string text6 = plan.Left.Nodes.Single();
					PlanNodeInfo planNodeInfo6 = nodes[text6];
					inMemoryDataElector = new InMemoryDataElectorTablesJoinSearch(text6, planNodeInfo6.Table, text5, planNodeInfo5.Table, TakeCriteria(plan.JoinType, plan.Nodes, nodes, criteriaDict, outerNodes), plan.JoinType);
				}
				else
				{
					inMemoryDataElector = new InMemoryDataElectorTableJoinSearch(text5, planNodeInfo5.Table, CreateElector(plan.Left, nodes, criteriaDict, outerNodes), TakeCriteria(plan.JoinType, plan.Nodes, nodes, criteriaDict, outerNodes), plan.JoinType, isTableLeft: false);
				}
				break;
			}
			case PlanPathItemType.NestedLoop:
				if (plan.Left.Type == PlanPathItemType.Table && plan.Right.Type == PlanPathItemType.Table)
				{
					string text = plan.Left.Nodes.Single();
					PlanNodeInfo planNodeInfo = nodes[text];
					string text2 = plan.Right.Nodes.Single();
					PlanNodeInfo planNodeInfo2 = nodes[text2];
					inMemoryDataElector = new InMemoryDataElectorTablesJoinSearch(text, planNodeInfo.Table, text2, planNodeInfo2.Table, TakeCriteria(plan.JoinType, plan.Nodes, nodes, criteriaDict, outerNodes), plan.JoinType);
				}
				else if (plan.Right.Type == PlanPathItemType.Table)
				{
					string text3 = plan.Right.Nodes.Single();
					PlanNodeInfo planNodeInfo3 = nodes[text3];
					inMemoryDataElector = new InMemoryDataElectorTableJoinSearch(text3, planNodeInfo3.Table, CreateElector(plan.Left, nodes, criteriaDict, outerNodes), TakeCriteria(plan.JoinType, plan.Nodes, nodes, criteriaDict, outerNodes), plan.JoinType, isTableLeft: false);
				}
				else if (plan.Left.Type == PlanPathItemType.Table)
				{
					string text4 = plan.Left.Nodes.Single();
					PlanNodeInfo planNodeInfo4 = nodes[text4];
					inMemoryDataElector = new InMemoryDataElectorTableJoinSearch(text4, planNodeInfo4.Table, CreateElector(plan.Right, nodes, criteriaDict, outerNodes), TakeCriteria(plan.JoinType, plan.Nodes, nodes, criteriaDict, outerNodes), plan.JoinType, isTableLeft: true);
				}
				else
				{
					inMemoryDataElector = new InMemoryDataElectorResultJoinSearch(CreateElector(plan.Left, nodes, criteriaDict, outerNodes), CreateElector(plan.Right, nodes, criteriaDict, outerNodes), TakeCriteria(plan.JoinType, plan.Nodes, nodes, criteriaDict, outerNodes), plan.JoinType);
				}
				break;
			}
			CriteriaOperator val = TakeCriteria((JoinType)0, plan.Nodes, nodes, criteriaDict, outerNodes);
			if (val != null)
			{
				inMemoryDataElector = new InMemoryDataElectorResultSearch(inMemoryDataElector, val);
			}
			return inMemoryDataElector;
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator TakeCriteria(JoinType currentJoinType, ISet<string> usedNodes, Dictionary<string, PlanNodeInfo> nodes, Dictionary<string, PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> criteriaDict, ISet<string> outerNodes)
		{
			//IL_00a4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0167: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<CriteriaOperator> list = null;
			List<string> list2 = null;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, PlanAliasCriteriaInfo> item in criteriaDict)
			{
				PlanAliasCriteriaInfo value = item.Value;
				if ((usedNodes.Contains(value.MainAlias) || outerNodes.Contains(value.MainAlias)) && value.Aliases.All((string n) => usedNodes.Contains(n) || outerNodes.Contains(n)) && nodes[value.MainAlias].Node.Type == currentJoinType)
				{
					if (list == null)
					{
						list2 = new List<string>();
						list = new List<CriteriaOperator>(item.Value.Criteria);
					}
					else
					{
						list.AddRange(item.Value.Criteria);
					}
					list2.Add(item.Key);
				}
			}
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				criteriaDict.Remove(list2[0]);
				return list[0];
			}
			foreach (string item2 in list2)
			{
				criteriaDict.Remove(item2);
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new GroupOperator((GroupOperatorType)0, (IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)list);
		}

	public class InMemoryDataElectorTableSearch : IInMemoryDataElector

		public InMemoryDataElectorTableSearch(string tableAlias, InMemoryTable table, CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{

				throw new NullReferenceException();
			}
			this.tableAlias = tableAlias;
			this.table = table;
			this.criteria = criteria;
			keys = new IndexFinder(tableAlias, table).Find(criteria);
			indexList = IndexFinder.GetIndexList(table, keys);
		}

		public InMemoryComplexSet Process(InMemoryDataElectorContextDescriptor descriptor)
		{
			InMemoryComplexSet inMemoryComplexSet = new InMemoryComplexSet();
			ExpressionEvaluator val = (ExpressionEvaluator)(object)new QueryableExpressionEvaluator((EvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)descriptor, criteria, descriptor.CaseSensitive, descriptor.CustomFunctions, descriptor.CustomAggregates);
			inMemoryComplexSet.AddTable(tableAlias, table);
			InMemoryRowList rows = table.Rows;
			if (keys == null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < rows.Count; i++)
				{
					if (rows[i].State != InMemoryItemState.Deleted && val.Fit((object)new InMemoryDataElectorContextSource(tableAlias, rows[i], table)))
					{
						inMemoryComplexSet.AddNewRow(0, rows[i]);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				HashSet<InMemoryRow> hashSet = new HashSet<InMemoryRow>();
				for (int j = 0; j < keys.Result.Length; j++)
				{
					IndexFinderItem[] array = keys.Result[j];
					object[] array2 = new object[array.Length];
					for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
					{
						if (array[k].ValueIsQueryOperand)
						{
							throw new InMemorySetException(Res.GetString("InMemoryFull_WrongIndexInfo"));
						}
						array2[k] = array[k].Value;
					}
					InMemoryRow[] array3 = indexList[j].Find(array2, returnDeleted: false);
					foreach (InMemoryRow inMemoryRow in array3)
					{
						if (inMemoryRow != null && !hashSet.Contains(inMemoryRow) && val.Fit((object)new InMemoryDataElectorContextSource(tableAlias, inMemoryRow, table)))
						{
							inMemoryComplexSet.AddNewRow(0, inMemoryRow);
							hashSet.Add(inMemoryRow);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return inMemoryComplexSet;
		}

		private InMemoryComplexSet ProcessIfLeftJoin(InMemoryDataElectorContextDescriptor descriptor)

		private InMemoryComplexSet ProcessIfInnerJoin(InMemoryDataElectorContextDescriptor descriptor)
		{
			if (queryOperandDetectedLeft && queryOperandDetectedRight)
			{
				throw new InMemorySetException(Res.GetString("InMemoryFull_WrongIndexInfo"));
			}
			ExpressionEvaluator eval = (ExpressionEvaluator)(object)new QueryableExpressionEvaluator((EvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)descriptor, criteria, descriptor.CaseSensitive, descriptor.CustomFunctions, descriptor.CustomAggregates);
			InMemoryComplexSet resultSet = new InMemoryComplexSet();
			int tableLeftIndex = resultSet.AddTable(tableLeftAlias, tableLeft);
			int tableRightIndex = resultSet.AddTable(tableRightAlias, tableRight);
			if (queryOperandDetectedLeft)
			{
				IEnumerable<InMemoryRow> rows = GetRows(keysRight, indexListRight, tableRight);
				foreach (InMemoryRow rightRow in rows)
				{
					GetRows(keysLeft, indexListLeft, tableLeft, descriptor, new InMemoryDataElectorContextSource(tableRightAlias, rightRow, tableRight), delegate(InMemoryRow leftRow2)
					{
						AddRow(eval, resultSet, tableLeftIndex, tableRightIndex, leftRow2, rightRow);
					});
				}
			}
			else if (queryOperandDetectedRight)
			{
				IEnumerable<InMemoryRow> rows2 = GetRows(keysLeft, indexListLeft, tableLeft);
				foreach (InMemoryRow leftRow in rows2)
