		public static void FillNodesDict(object source, HashSet<string> nodesSet)
		{
			if (source is List<InMemoryComplexRow> list)
			{
				if (list.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (string alias in list[0].ComplexSet.GetAliasList())

				}
			}
			if (source is InMemoryComplexRow inMemoryComplexRow)
			{
				{
					foreach (string alias2 in inMemoryComplexRow.ComplexSet.GetAliasList())
					{
						nodesSet.Add(alias2);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (source is InMemoryDataElectorContextSource inMemoryDataElectorContextSource)
			{
				if (inMemoryDataElectorContextSource.ComplexRow != null)

					ReadOnlyCollection<string> aliasList = inMemoryDataElectorContextSource.ComplexRow.ComplexSet.GetAliasList();
					foreach (string item in aliasList)

					nodesSet.Add(inMemoryDataElectorContextSource.NodeAlias);
				}
				return;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("Wrong source.");
		}

		public InMemoryComplexSet Process(InMemoryDataElectorContextDescriptor descriptor)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return new InMemoryComplexSet();
			}

			{
				return ProcessComplexRowList(list);
			}
			if (source is InMemoryComplexRow row)
			{
				return ProcessComplexRow(row);
			}
			if (source is InMemoryDataElectorContextSource inMemoryDataElectorContextSource)
			{
				return ProcessContextSource(inMemoryDataElectorContextSource);
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Wrong source.");
		}

		private static InMemoryComplexSet ProcessContextSource(InMemoryDataElectorContextSource source)
		{
			if (source.ComplexRow != null)
			{
				InMemoryComplexSet inMemoryComplexSet = ProcessComplexRow(source.ComplexRow);
				if (source.ComplexRowRight != null)
				{
					InMemoryComplexSet complexSet = source.ComplexRowRight.ComplexSet;
					int tableCount = complexSet.TableCount;
					ReadOnlyCollection<string> aliasList = complexSet.GetAliasList();
					ReadOnlyCollection<IInMemoryTable> tableList = complexSet.GetTableList();
					List<int> list = new List<int>();
					for (int i = 0; i < tableCount; i++)
					{
						list.Add(inMemoryComplexSet.AddTableIfNotExists(aliasList[i], tableList[i]));
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < tableCount; j++)
					{
						inMemoryComplexSet[0][list[j]] = source.ComplexRowRight[j];
					}
					inMemoryComplexSet.AddProjectionFromSet(complexSet);
				}
				else if (source.NodeAlias != null)
				{
					int tableIndex = inMemoryComplexSet.AddTableIfNotExists(source.NodeAlias, source.Table);
					inMemoryComplexSet[0][tableIndex] = source.Row;
				}
				return inMemoryComplexSet;
			}
			if (source.NodeAlias != null)
			{
				InMemoryComplexSet inMemoryComplexSet2 = new InMemoryComplexSet(1);
				inMemoryComplexSet2.AddTable(source.NodeAlias, source.Table);
				inMemoryComplexSet2.AddNewRow(0, source.Row);
				return inMemoryComplexSet2;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Wrong source.");
		}

		private static InMemoryComplexSet ProcessComplexRow(InMemoryComplexRow row)
		{
			InMemoryComplexSet inMemoryComplexSet = new InMemoryComplexSet(1);
			InMemoryComplexSet complexSet = row.ComplexSet;
			ReadOnlyCollection<string> aliasList = complexSet.GetAliasList();
			ReadOnlyCollection<IInMemoryTable> tableList = complexSet.GetTableList();
			for (int i = 0; i < aliasList.Count; i++)
			{
				inMemoryComplexSet.AddTable(aliasList[i], tableList[i]);
			}
			inMemoryComplexSet.AddProjectionFromSet(complexSet);
			inMemoryComplexSet.AddRow(new InMemoryComplexRow(inMemoryComplexSet, row));
			return inMemoryComplexSet;
		}

		private static InMemoryComplexSet ProcessComplexRowList(List<InMemoryComplexRow> list)
		{
			InMemoryComplexSet inMemoryComplexSet = new InMemoryComplexSet(list.Count);
			InMemoryComplexSet complexSet = list[0].ComplexSet;

			ReadOnlyCollection<IInMemoryTable> tableList = complexSet.GetTableList();
			for (int i = 0; i < aliasList.Count; i++)
			{
				inMemoryComplexSet.AddTable(aliasList[i], tableList[i]);
			}
			inMemoryComplexSet.AddProjectionFromSet(complexSet);
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				inMemoryComplexSet.AddRow(new InMemoryComplexRow(inMemoryComplexSet, list[j]));
			}
			return inMemoryComplexSet;
		}
	}

	public delegate int GetValidBatchLengthCallback<T>(IList<T> items, int batchStart, int desiredLength, int batchesCount);
	public static class BatchBreaker
	{
		private struct Batch
		{
			public int Start;

			public Batch(int start)
			{
				Start = start;
			}
		}

		private struct BatchStartsCounter
		{
			public int SingleStart;

			public List<int> ManyStarts;
		}

		private class BatchComparer<T> : IEqualityComparer<Batch>
		{
			private readonly int BatchLength;

			private readonly IList<T> Bricks;

			private readonly IEqualityComparer<T> BrickComparer;

			public BatchComparer(int batchLength, IList<T> bricks, IEqualityComparer<T> brickComparer)
			{
				BatchLength = batchLength;
				Bricks = bricks;
				BrickComparer = brickComparer;
			}

			public bool Equals(Batch x, Batch y)
			{
				if (x.Start == y.Start)
				{
					return true;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < BatchLength; i++)
				{
					if (!BrickComparer.Equals(Bricks[x.Start + i], Bricks[y.Start + i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			public int GetHashCode(Batch obj)
			{
				return HashCodeHelper.CalculateInt32List(from pos in Enumerable.Range(obj.Start, BatchLength)
					select BrickComparer.GetHashCode(Bricks[pos]));
			}
		}

		public static Dictionary<int, int> Do<T>(IList<T> statements, IEqualityComparer<T> comparer)
		{
			return Do(statements, comparer, 3, (T x) => true, (IList<T> stbs, int batchStart, int desiredBatchLength, int batchesCount) => (batchesCount > 1) ? desiredBatchLength : Math.Min(desiredBatchLength, 2));
		}

		public static Dictionary<int, int> Do<T>(IList<T> statements, IEqualityComparer<T> comparer, int MaxRepeatableBatchLength, Predicate<T> isBatcheableStatement, GetValidBatchLengthCallback<T> isValidBatch)
		{
			Dictionary<int, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, int>(statements.Count);
			bool[] array = new bool[statements.Count];
			if (isBatcheableStatement != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < statements.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!isBatcheableStatement(statements[i]))
					{
						dictionary.Add(i, 1);
						array[i] = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (dictionary.Count == array.Length)
			{
				return dictionary;
			}
			if (dictionary.Count == 0 && GetValidBatchLength(statements, isValidBatch, 0, statements.Count, -1) == statements.Count)
			{
				dictionary.Add(0, statements.Count);
				return dictionary;
			}
			for (int num = MaxRepeatableBatchLength; num > 0; num--)
			{
				if (array.Length >= num * 2)
				{
					SortedList<int, byte> sortedList = GenerateBatchesStarts(array, num);
					IEqualityComparer<Batch> equalityComparer = null;
					while (sortedList.Count > 1)
					{
						if (equalityComparer == null)
						{
							equalityComparer = new BatchComparer<T>(num, statements, comparer);
						}
						List<int> list = null;
						foreach (BatchStartsCounter item in GenerateStartsByBatches(num, sortedList.Keys, equalityComparer))
						{
							if (item.ManyStarts == null)
							{
								sortedList.Remove(item.SingleStart);
							}
							else
							{
								if (list != null && list.Count >= item.ManyStarts.Count)
								{
									continue;
								}
								if (GetValidBatchLength(statements, isValidBatch, item.ManyStarts[0], num, item.ManyStarts.Count) == num)
								{
									list = item.ManyStarts;
									continue;
								}
								foreach (int manyStart in item.ManyStarts)
								{
									sortedList.Remove(manyStart);
								}
							}
						}
						if (list == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (int item2 in list)
						{
							dictionary.Add(item2, num);
							for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
							{
								int num2 = item2 + j;
								if (array[num2])
								{
									throw new InvalidOperationException("internal error (statement already used)");
								}
								array[num2] = true;
							}
							for (int k = item2 - num + 1; k < item2 + num; k++)
							{
								sortedList.Remove(k);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			int num3 = -1;
			for (int l = 0; l <= array.Length; l++)
			{
				if (l == array.Length || array[l])
				{
					if (num3 >= 0)
					{
						int num4 = l - num3;
						int num5 = num3;
						while (num4 > 0)
						{
							int validBatchLength = GetValidBatchLength(statements, isValidBatch, num5, num4, 1);
							dictionary.Add(num5, validBatchLength);
							num5 += validBatchLength;
							num4 -= validBatchLength;
						}
						num3 = -1;
					}
				}
				else if (num3 < 0)
				{
					num3 = l;
				}
			}
			if (num3 >= 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("batchStart >= 0");
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static int GetValidBatchLength<T>(IList<T> statements, GetValidBatchLengthCallback<T> isValidBatch, int currentBatchStart, int batchLength, int batchesCount)
		{
			if (batchLength <= 1)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (isValidBatch != null)
			{
				batchLength = isValidBatch(statements, currentBatchStart, batchLength, batchesCount);
				if (batchLength < 1)
				{
					return 1;
				}
			}

		private T UpdateConfigIfNeeded<T>(T rootCallResult) where T : DataCacheResult
		{
			if (((DataCacheResult)rootCallResult).CacheConfig != null)
			{
				lock (CacheConfigLock)
				{
					if (((DataCacheResult)rootCallResult).Cookie.Guid != _CacheGuid)
					{
						_CacheGuid = ((DataCacheResult)rootCallResult).Cookie.Guid;
						_CacheConfiguration = ((DataCacheResult)rootCallResult).CacheConfig;
						InfosLock.AcquireWriterLock(-1);
						try
						{
							Infos.Clear();
						}
						finally
						{
							InfosLock.ReleaseWriterLock();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return rootCallResult;
		}

		protected void ProcessPossibleAging()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			InfosLock.AcquireReaderLock(-1);
			try
			{
				foreach (TableInfo value in Infos.Values)
				{
					lock (value)
					{
						if (value.Dependency != null && value.Dependency.HasChanges)
						{
							list.Add(value.TableName);
							value.Dependency = null;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				InfosLock.ReleaseReaderLock();
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				Root.NotifyDirtyTables(DataCacheCookie.Empty, list.ToArray());
			}
		}

		private void MarkModified(params string[] tableNames)
		{
			if (tableNames == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < tableNames.Length; i++)
			{
				TableInfo tableInfo = TryGetInfo(tableNames[i]);
				if (tableInfo != null)
				{
					lock (tableInfo)
					{
						tableInfo.Dependency = null;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private TableInfo TryGetInfo(string selectedTable)
		{
			InfosLock.AcquireReaderLock(-1);
			try
			{
				if (Infos.TryGetValue(selectedTable, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				return null;
			}
			finally
			{
				InfosLock.ReleaseReaderLock();
			}
		}

		private TableInfo GetInfo(string selectedTable)
		{
			TableInfo value = TryGetInfo(selectedTable);
			if (value != null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			InfosLock.AcquireWriterLock(-1);
			try
			{
				if (!Infos.TryGetValue(selectedTable, out value))
				{
					value = new TableInfo(selectedTable);
					Infos.Add(selectedTable, value);
				}
				return value;
			}
			finally
			{
				InfosLock.ReleaseWriterLock();
			}
		}

		private void ReallyExtendAgeTracker(object data)

		private void ExtendAgeTrackers(SelectStatement[] selects)
		{
			ProcessPossibleAging();
			Dictionary<string, List<IEnumerable<string>>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, List<IEnumerable<string>>>();
			foreach (SelectStatement val in selects)
			{
				IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<string>>> tablesColumns = BaseStatement.GetTablesColumns((BaseStatement[])(object)new BaseStatement[1] { (BaseStatement)val });
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<string>> item in tablesColumns)
				{
					if (DataCacheBase.IsBadForCache(CacheConfiguration, item.Key))
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<string>> item2 in tablesColumns)
				{
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(item2.Key, out var value))
					{
						value = new List<IEnumerable<string>>();
						dictionary.Add(item2.Key, value);
						value.Add(item2.Value);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, List<IEnumerable<string>>> item3 in dictionary)
			{
				string key = item3.Key;
				TableInfo info = GetInfo(key);
				bool flag2 = false;
				lock (info)
				{
					foreach (IEnumerable<string> item4 in item3.Value)
					{
						foreach (string item5 in item4)
						{
							if (!info.TrackedColumns.ContainsKey(item5))
							{
								if (info.Dependency != null)
								{
									flag2 = true;
									info.Dependency = null;
								}
								info.TrackedColumns.Add(item5, item5);
							}
						}
					}
					if (info.Dependency != null)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					Root.NotifyDirtyTables(DataCacheCookie.Empty, new string[1] { key });
				}
				lock (info)
				{
					if (!info.CreateDependencyInProgress)
					{
						info.CreateDependencyInProgress = true;
						ThreadPool.QueueUserWorkItem(ReallyExtendAgeTracker, key);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			lock (DbConnection)
			{
				if (!isDisposed)
				{
					isDisposed = true;
					SqlDependencyHelper.Stop(ConnectionString);
					DbConnection.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual object Do(string command, object args)
		{
			ICacheToCacheCommunicationCore root = Root;
			ICommandChannel val = (ICommandChannel)(object)((root is ICommandChannel) ? root : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				if (Root == null)
				{
					return new OperationResult<object>(ServiceException.NotSupported, $"Command '{command}' is not supported.");
				}
				return new OperationResult<object>(ServiceException.NotSupported, $"Command '{command}' is not supported by {((object)Root).GetType().FullName}.");
			}
			return val.Do(command, args);
		}

		private const string installedVersionsKey = "SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Microsoft SQL Server Local DB\\Installed Versions";

		private static string apiDllPath = string.Empty;

		public const int MAX_LOCALDB_INSTANCE_NAME_LENGTH = 128;

		public MSSqlLocalDBApi()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(apiDllPath))
			{
				using RegistryKey registryKey = Registry.LocalMachine.OpenSubKey("SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Microsoft SQL Server Local DB\\Installed Versions", writable: false);
				if (registryKey != null)
				{
					string[] subKeyNames = registryKey.GetSubKeyNames();
					if (subKeyNames.Length != 0)
					{
						if (subKeyNames.Length > 1)
						{
							Array.Sort(subKeyNames);
						}
						using RegistryKey registryKey2 = registryKey.OpenSubKey(subKeyNames[subKeyNames.Length - 1], writable: false);
						if (registryKey2 != null)
						{
							string fileName = registryKey2.GetValue("InstanceAPIPath") as string;
							if (TryLoadLibrary(fileName))
							{
								apiDllPath = fileName;
								return;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else if (TryLoadLibrary(apiDllPath))
			{
				return;
			}
			throw new MSSqlLocalDBApiException("Can't find LocalDBInstance.dll location.");
		}

		public MSSqlLocalDBApi(string fileName)
		{
			if (!TryLoadLibrary(fileName))
			{
				throw new MSSqlLocalDBApiException("Can't find LocalDBInstance.dll location.");
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private bool TryLoadLibrary(string fileName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName) || !File.Exists(fileName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			handle = LoadLibrary(fileName);
			if (handle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				int lastWin32Error = Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
				throw new MSSqlLocalDBApiException($"Failed to load LocalDBInstance.dll (ErrorCode: {lastWin32Error})", lastWin32Error);
			}
			PrepareDelegates();
			return true;
		}

		private void PrepareDelegates()
		{
			if (handle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			getInstanceInfo = GetDelegate<LocalDBGetInstanceInfoDelegate>("LocalDBGetInstanceInfo");
			getInstances = GetDelegate<LocalDBGetInstancesDelegate>("LocalDBGetInstances");
			getVersionInfo = GetDelegate<LocalDBGetVersionInfoDelegate>("LocalDBGetVersionInfo");
			getVersions = GetDelegate<LocalDBGetVersionsDelegate>("LocalDBGetVersions");
			createInstance = GetDelegate<LocalDBCreateInstanceDelegate>("LocalDBCreateInstance");
			deleteInstance = GetDelegate<LocalDBDeleteInstanceDelegate>("LocalDBDeleteInstance");
			startInstance = GetDelegate<LocalDBStartInstanceDelegate>("LocalDBStartInstance");
			stopInstance = GetDelegate<LocalDBStopInstanceDelegate>("LocalDBStopInstance");
			startTracing = GetDelegate<LocalDBTracingDelegate>("LocalDBStartTracing");
			stopTracing = GetDelegate<LocalDBTracingDelegate>("LocalDBStopTracing");
			formatMessage = GetDelegate<LocalDBFormatMessageDelegate>("LocalDBFormatMessage");
			shareInstance = GetDelegate<LocalDBShareInstanceDelegate>("LocalDBShareInstance");
			unshareInstance = GetDelegate<LocalDBUnshareInstanceDelegate>("LocalDBUnshareInstance");
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private T GetDelegate<T>(string procName) where T : class
		{
			CheckHandler();
			IntPtr procAddress = GetProcAddress(handle, procName);
			if (procAddress == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			return Marshal.GetDelegateForFunctionPointer(procAddress, typeof(T)) as T;
		}

		private void RaiseLocalDBException(int hResult)
		{
			if (hResult != 0)
			{
				int messageLength = 4096;
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(messageLength);
				int num = formatMessage(hResult, 1, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.LCID & 0xFFFF, stringBuilder, ref messageLength);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					throw new MSSqlLocalDBApiException($"LocalDBFormatMessage Error - ErrorCode: 0x{num:X}", num);
				}
				throw new MSSqlLocalDBApiException($"LocalDB Error: {stringBuilder}");
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public MSSqlLocalDBVersionInfo GetVersionInfo(string versionName)
		{
			CheckHandler();
			MSSqlLocalDBVersionInfo versionInfo = default(MSSqlLocalDBVersionInfo);
			int hResult = getVersionInfo(versionName, ref versionInfo, Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(MSSqlLocalDBVersionInfo)));
			RaiseLocalDBException(hResult);
			return versionInfo;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public string[] GetVersions()
		{
			CheckHandler();
			MSSqlLocalDBVersionName[] array = new MSSqlLocalDBVersionName[256];
			int versionCount = array.Length;
			int hResult = getVersions(array, ref versionCount);
			RaiseLocalDBException(hResult);
			return (from i in array.Take(versionCount)
				select i.Value).ToArray();
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public MSSqlLocalDBInstanceInfo GetInstanceInfo(string instanceName)
		{
			CheckHandler();
			MSSqlLocalDBInstanceInfo instanceInfo = default(MSSqlLocalDBInstanceInfo);
			int hResult = getInstanceInfo(instanceName, ref instanceInfo, Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(MSSqlLocalDBInstanceInfo)));
			RaiseLocalDBException(hResult);
			return instanceInfo;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public string[] GetInstances()
		{
			CheckHandler();
			MSSqlLocalDBInstanceName[] array = new MSSqlLocalDBInstanceName[256];
			int instanceCount = array.Length;
			int hResult = getInstances(array, ref instanceCount);
			RaiseLocalDBException(hResult);
			return (from i in array.Take(instanceCount)
				select i.Value).ToArray();
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void CreateInstance(string versionName, string instanceName)
		{
			CheckHandler();
			int hResult = createInstance(versionName, instanceName, 0);
			RaiseLocalDBException(hResult);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void DeleteInstance(string instanceName)
		{
			CheckHandler();
			int hResult = deleteInstance(instanceName, 0);
			RaiseLocalDBException(hResult);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void StartInstance(string instanceName, out string connectionString)
		{
			connectionString = null;
			CheckHandler();
			int connectionStringLength = 0;
			int hResult = startInstance(instanceName, 0, null, ref connectionStringLength);
			RaiseLocalDBException(hResult);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(connectionStringLength);
			hResult = startInstance(instanceName, 0, stringBuilder, ref connectionStringLength);
			RaiseLocalDBException(hResult);
			connectionString = stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void StopInstance(string instanceName, MSSqlLocalDBShutdownFlags shutdownFlags, long timeout)
		{
			CheckHandler();
			int hResult = stopInstance(instanceName, shutdownFlags, timeout);
			RaiseLocalDBException(hResult);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void StartTracing()
		{
			CheckHandler();
			int hResult = startTracing();
			RaiseLocalDBException(hResult);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void StopTracing()
		{
			CheckHandler();
			int hResult = stopTracing();
			RaiseLocalDBException(hResult);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void ShareInstance(SecurityIdentifier sid, string instancePrivateName, string instanceSharedName)
		{
			CheckHandler();
			IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(sid.BinaryLength);
			try
			{
				byte[] array = new byte[sid.BinaryLength];
				sid.GetBinaryForm(array, 0);
				Marshal.Copy(array, 0, intPtr, array.Length);
				int hResult = shareInstance(intPtr, instancePrivateName, instanceSharedName, 0);
				RaiseLocalDBException(hResult);
			}
			finally
			{
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void UnshareInstance(string instanceSharedName)
		{
			CheckHandler();
			int hResult = unshareInstance(instanceSharedName, 0);
			RaiseLocalDBException(hResult);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void CheckHandler()
		{
			if (handle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(ToString());
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}
			if (handle != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				FreeLibrary(handle);
				handle = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
		}

		~MSSqlLocalDBApi()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		[DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Auto, SetLastError = true)]
		private static extern IntPtr LoadLibrary(string libname);

		[DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Auto)]
		private static extern bool FreeLibrary(IntPtr hModule);

		[DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Ansi)]
		private static extern IntPtr GetProcAddress(IntPtr hModule, string lpProcName);
	}

	internal class DbTypeMapperMsSql<TSqlParameter> : DbTypeMapper<SqlDbType, TSqlParameter> where TSqlParameter : IDbDataParameter
	{
		protected override string ParameterDbTypePropertyName => "SqlDbType";

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForBoolean(out int? size, out byte? precision, out byte? scale)
		{
			size = null;
			precision = (scale = null);
			return "Bit";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForByte(out byte? precision, out byte? scale)
		{
			precision = (scale = null);
			return "TinyInt";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForByteArray(out int? size)
		{
			size = null;
			return "VarBinary";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForChar(out int? size)
		{
			size = 1;
			return "NChar";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForDateTime()
		{
			return "DateTime";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForDecimal(out byte? precision, out byte? scale)
		{
			precision = (scale = null);
			return "Money";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForDouble(out byte? precision, out byte? scale)
		{
			precision = (scale = null);
			return "Float";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForGuid(out int? size)
		{
			size = null;
			return "UniqueIdentifier";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForInt16(out byte? precision, out byte? scale)
		{
			precision = (scale = null);
			return "SmallInt";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForInt32(out byte? precision, out byte? scale)
		{
			precision = (scale = null);
			return "Int";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForInt64(out byte? precision, out byte? scale)
		{
			precision = (scale = null);
			return "BigInt";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForSByte(out byte? precision, out byte? scale)
		{
			precision = (byte)3;
			scale = 0;
			return "Decimal";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForSingle(out byte? precision, out byte? scale)
		{
			precision = (scale = null);
			return "Float";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForString(out int? size)
		{
			size = 0;
			return "NVarChar";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForTimeSpan()
		{
			return "Time";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForUInt16(out byte? precision, out byte? scale)
		{
			precision = (byte)5;
			scale = 0;
			return "Decimal";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForUInt32(out byte? precision, out byte? scale)
		{
			precision = (byte)10;
			scale = 0;
			return "Decimal";
		}

		protected override string GetParameterTypeNameForUInt64(out byte? precision, out byte? scale)
		{
			precision = (byte)20;
			scale = 0;
			return "Decimal";
		}

		protected override string ConvertSqlTypeToParameterType(string sqlType)
		{
			switch (sqlType.ToUpperInvariant())
			{
			case "INT":
			case "INTEGER":
				return "Int";
			case "IMAGE":
				return "Image";
			case "VARBINARY":
				return "VarBinary";
			case "NCHAR":
				return "NChar";
			case "CHAR":
				return "Char";
			case "VARCHAR":
				return "VarChar";
			case "NVARCHAR":
				return "NVarChar";
			case "XML":
				return "Xml";
			case "NTEXT":
				return "NText";
			case "TEXT":
				return "Text";
			case "BIT":
				return "Bit";
			case "TINYINT":
				return "TinyInt";
			case "SMALLINT":
				return "SmallInt";
			case "BIGINT":
				return "BigInt";
			case "NUMERIC":
			case "DECIMAL":
				return "Decimal";
			case "MONEY":
				return "Money";
			case "SMALLMONEY":
				return "SmallMoney";
			case "FLOAT":
			case "DOUBLE PRECISION":
				return "Float";
			case "REAL":
				return "Real";
			case "UNIQUEIDENTIFIER":
				return "UniqueIdentifier";
			case "DATETIME":
				return "DateTime";
			case "DATETIME2":
				return "DateTime2";
			case "SMALLDATETIME":
				return "SmallDateTime";
			case "DATE":
				return "Date";
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override DBTypeInfoBase CustomParseSqlType(string sqlTypeWithoutParameters, string sqlTypeParameters, string sqlTypeSuffix)
		{
			if (string.Equals(sqlTypeParameters, "MAX", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return ((DbTypeMapperBase)this).CreateParameterDBTypeInfo(sqlTypeWithoutParameters, (int?)(-1), (byte?)null, (byte?)null);
			}
			return ((DbTypeMapperBase)this).CustomParseSqlType(sqlTypeWithoutParameters, sqlTypeParameters, sqlTypeSuffix);
		}

		public override void SetParameterTypeAndSize(IDbDataParameter parameter, DBColumnType dbColumnType, int size)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)dbColumnType != 14)
			{
				if ((int)dbColumnType == 18 && (size < 0 || size > 8000))
				{
					SetParameterTypeAndSizeForVarbinaryMax((TSqlParameter)parameter);
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (size < 0 || size > 4000)
			{
				SetParameterTypeAndSizeForVarcharMax((TSqlParameter)parameter);
				return;
			}
			((DbTypeMapper<SqlDbType, SqlDbType>)(object)this).SetParameterTypeAndSize(parameter, dbColumnType, size);
		}

		protected virtual void SetParameterTypeAndSizeForVarcharMax(TSqlParameter parameter)
		{
			base.SetSqlDbTypeHandler(parameter, SqlDbType.NText);
		}

		protected virtual void SetParameterTypeAndSizeForVarbinaryMax(TSqlParameter parameter)
		{
			base.SetSqlDbTypeHandler(parameter, SqlDbType.Image);
		}

		public DbTypeMapperMsSql()
		{
			((DbTypeMapper<SqlDbType, SqlDbType>)(object)this)..ctor();
		}
	}
	internal class DbTypeMapperMsSql2005<TSqlParameter> : DbTypeMapperMsSql<TSqlParameter> where TSqlParameter : IDbDataParameter
	{
		protected override void SetParameterTypeAndSizeForVarcharMax(TSqlParameter parameter)
		{
			((DbTypeMapper<SqlDbType, TSqlParameter>)this).SetSqlDbTypeHandler(parameter, SqlDbType.NVarChar);
			parameter.Size = -1;
		}

		protected override void SetParameterTypeAndSizeForVarbinaryMax(TSqlParameter parameter)
		{
			((DbTypeMapper<SqlDbType, TSqlParameter>)this).SetSqlDbTypeHandler(parameter, SqlDbType.VarBinary);
			parameter.Size = -1;
		}
	}

	{

		protected readonly XPMemberInfo Member;

		private readonly Session _Session;

		private ObjectList _InnerList;

		private static bool? _DoNotSetAssociatedMemberToNullWhenRemovingDeletedObjectFromAssociationList;

		private static int seq;

		private int seqNum = Interlocked.Increment(ref seq);

		protected IList InnerList
		{
			get
			{
				Load();
				return _InnerList;
			}
		}

		public bool IsLoaded => _InnerList != null;

		public bool IsFixedSize => false;

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public static bool? DoNotSetAssociatedMemberToNullWhenRemovingDeletedObjectFromAssociationList
		{

			set

				_DoNotSetAssociatedMemberToNullWhenRemovingDeletedObjectFromAssociationList = value;
			}
		}

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return Indexer(index);
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public int Count => InnerList.Count;

		public bool IsSynchronized => false;

		public object SyncRoot => this;

		public XPClassInfo ClassInfo => Member.CollectionElementType;

		public Session Session => _Session;

		XPDictionary IXPDictionaryProvider.Dictionary => ClassInfo.Dictionary;

		IObjectLayer IObjectLayerProvider.ObjectLayer => Session.ObjectLayer;

		IDataLayer IDataLayerProvider.DataLayer => Session.DataLayer;

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		public XPAssociationList(Session session, object owner, XPMemberInfo collectionMember)
		{
			_Session = session;
			OwnerObject = owner;
			Member = collectionMember;
		}

		public void Load()
		{
			if (!IsLoaded)
			{
				ICollection objectsInTransaction = Session.GetObjectsInTransaction(ClassInfo, GetFillCriteria(), selectDeleted: false);
				FinishPrefetch(objectsInTransaction);
			}
		}

		public async Task LoadAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (!IsLoaded)
			{
				FinishPrefetch(await Session.GetObjectsInTransactionAsync(ClassInfo, GetFillCriteria(), selectDeleted: false, cancellationToken));
			}
		}

		public void Unload()
		{
			if (IsLoaded)
			{
				_InnerList.Clear();
				_InnerList = null;
				OnUnload();
			}
		}

		public int Add(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			Session.ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(value);
			if (!Session.GetClassInfo(value).IsAssignableTo(ClassInfo))
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException(Res.GetString("Collections_InvalidCastOnAdd", Session.GetClassInfo(value), ClassInfo));
			}
			if (!IsLoaded)
			{
				Member.GetAssociatedMember().SetValue(value, OwnerObject);
				return -1;
			}
			int num = IndexOf(value);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = InnerList.Add(value);
				Member.GetAssociatedMember().SetValue(value, OwnerObject);
				OnAdd(num, value);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			while (Count > 0)
			{
				Remove(Indexer(Count - 1));
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(object value)
		{
			return IndexOf(value) >= 0;
		}

		public int IndexOf(object value)
		{
			return InnerList.IndexOf(value);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			Add(value);
		}

		private static bool IsKeyOrInKey(XPMemberInfo mi)
		{
			for (XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = mi; xPMemberInfo != null; xPMemberInfo = xPMemberInfo.ValueParent)
			{
				if (xPMemberInfo.IsKey)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool CanNullifyAssociatedMember(Session session, XPMemberInfo associatedMi, object objectRemoved)
		{
			if (IsKeyOrInKey(associatedMi))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_DoNotSetAssociatedMemberToNullWhenRemovingDeletedObjectFromAssociationList == true && session.IsObjectMarkedDeleted(objectRemoved))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Remove(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsLoaded)
			{
				int num = IndexOf(value);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				PatchObjectOnRemove(value);
			}
		}

		private void PatchObjectOnRemove(object value)
		{
			XPMemberInfo associatedMember = Member.GetAssociatedMember();
			if (associatedMember.GetValue(value) == OwnerObject && CanNullifyAssociatedMember(Session, associatedMember, value))
			{
				associatedMember.SetValue(value, null);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			object obj = Indexer(index);
			InnerList.RemoveAt(index);
			PatchObjectOnRemove(obj);
			OnRemove(index, obj);
		}

		public object Indexer(int index)
		{
			return InnerList[index];
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			InnerList.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (object inner in InnerList)
			{
				yield return inner;
			}
		}

		public bool NeedPrefetch()
		{
			if (!IsLoaded)
			{
				return !Session.IsNewObject(OwnerObject);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void FinishPrefetch(ICollection queriedObjects)
		{
			_InnerList = new ObjectList(queriedObjects);
		}

		public ObjectsQuery BeginLoad()
		{
			if (Session.IsNewObject(OwnerObject))
			{
				Load();
			}
			if (IsLoaded)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ObjectsQuery(ClassInfo, GetFillCriteria(), null, 0, 0, new CollectionCriteriaPatcher(selectDeleted: false, Session.TypesManager), force: false);
		}

		private CriteriaOperator GetFillCriteria()
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(Member.GetAssociatedMember().Name) == (CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue(OwnerObject));
		}

		public void EndLoad(IEnumerable queriedObjects)
		{
			ObjectSet objectSet = new ObjectSet();
			XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = ClassInfo.FindMember(GCRecordField.StaticName);
			foreach (object queriedObject in queriedObjects)
			{
				if (!Session.IsObjectToDelete(queriedObject, includeParent: true) && (xPMemberInfo == null || xPMemberInfo.GetValue(queriedObject) == null))
				{
					object value = Member.GetAssociatedMember().GetValue(queriedObject);
					if (value == OwnerObject)
					{
						objectSet.Add(queriedObject);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (object item in Session.GetObjectsToSave(includeParent: true))
			{
				if (!Session.IsObjectToDelete(item, includeParent: true) && Session.GetClassInfo(item).IsAssignableTo(ClassInfo) && (xPMemberInfo == null || xPMemberInfo.GetValue(item) == null))
				{
					object value2 = Member.GetAssociatedMember().GetValue(item);
					if (value2 == OwnerObject)
					{
						objectSet.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			FinishPrefetch(objectSet);
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public CriteriaOperator GetRealFetchCriteria()
		{
			return GetFillCriteria();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = ((!IsLoaded) ? "NotLoaded" : ("Count(" + Count + ")"));
			return $"{base.ToString()}({seqNum}) {text} @ {OwnerObject}->{Member.Name}";
		}

		protected virtual void OnAdd(int index, object value)
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, value, index));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnRemove(int index, object obj)
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, obj, index));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnUnload()
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}
	}
	public class XPManyToManyAliasList : IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, IXPClassInfoAndSessionProvider, IXPClassInfoProvider, IXPDictionaryProvider, ISessionProvider, IObjectLayerProvider, IDataLayerProvider, IXPUnloadableAssociationList, INotifyCollectionChanged
	{
		private readonly Session _Session;

		public readonly IList AliasedList;

		public readonly XPMemberInfo SkippedReference;

		public bool IsFixedSize => AliasedList.IsFixedSize;

		public bool IsReadOnly => AliasedList.IsReadOnly;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return Indexer(index);
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public int Count => AliasedList.Count;

		public bool IsSynchronized => AliasedList.IsSynchronized;

		public object SyncRoot => AliasedList.SyncRoot;

		public XPClassInfo ClassInfo => SkippedReference.ReferenceType;

		public XPDictionary Dictionary => ClassInfo.Dictionary;

		public Session Session => _Session;

		public IObjectLayer ObjectLayer => Session.ObjectLayer;

		public IDataLayer DataLayer => Session.DataLayer;

		bool IXPUnloadableAssociationList.IsLoaded => ((IXPUnloadableAssociationList)AliasedList).IsLoaded;

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		protected virtual object CreateIntermediateObject()
		{
			return SkippedReference.Owner.CreateNewObject(Session);
		}

		public XPManyToManyAliasList(Session session, IList aliasedCollection, XPMemberInfo skippedProperty)
		{
			_Session = session;
			AliasedList = aliasedCollection;
			if (aliasedCollection is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged += AliasedListCollectionChanged;
			}
			SkippedReference = skippedProperty;
		}

		public int Add(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (!Session.GetClassInfo(value).IsAssignableTo(ClassInfo))
			{
				throw new InvalidCastException(Res.GetString("Collections_InvalidCastOnAdd", Session.GetClassInfo(value), ClassInfo));
			}
			int num = IndexOf(value);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			object obj = CreateIntermediateObject();
			SkippedReference.SetValue(obj, value);
			return AliasedList.Add(obj);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			Session.Delete(AliasedList);
		}

		public bool Contains(object value)
		{
			return IndexOf(value) >= 0;
		}

		public int IndexOf(object value)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (Indexer(i) == value)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			Add(value);
		}

		public void Remove(object value)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(value);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			Session.Delete(AliasedList[index]);
		}

		public object Indexer(int index)
		{
			return SkippedReference.GetValue(AliasedList[index]);
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				array.SetValue(Indexer(i), i + index);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (object aliased in AliasedList)
			{
				yield return SkippedReference.GetValue(aliased);
			}
		}

		public async Task<IList> EnumerateAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (AliasedList is XPAssociationList xPAssociationList)
			{
				await xPAssociationList.LoadAsync(cancellationToken);
			}
			int count = AliasedList.Count;
			object[] array = new object[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = SkippedReference.GetValue(AliasedList[i]);
			}
			return array;
		}

		void IXPUnloadableAssociationList.Unload()
		{
			((IXPUnloadableAssociationList)AliasedList).Unload();
		}

		private void AliasedListCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnCollectionChanged(e);
		}

		private IList ConvertList(IList objects)
		{
			if (objects == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>(objects.Count);
			foreach (object @object in objects)
			{
				if (@object == null)
				{
					list.Add(null);
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(SkippedReference.GetValue(@object));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public CriteriaOperator GetRealFetchCriteria(object owner, XPMemberInfo manyToManyAliasProperty)
		{
			//IL_00b0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c0: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00c0: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00c0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c6: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!manyToManyAliasProperty.IsManyToManyAlias)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("manyToManyAliasProperty");
			}
			ManyToManyAliasAttribute manyToManyAliasAttribute = (ManyToManyAliasAttribute)manyToManyAliasProperty.GetAttributeInfo(typeof(ManyToManyAliasAttribute));
			XPMemberInfo member = manyToManyAliasProperty.Owner.GetMember(manyToManyAliasAttribute.OneToManyCollectionName);
			if (!member.IsAssociationList || member.IsManyToMany)
			{
				throw new PropertyMissingException(manyToManyAliasProperty.Owner.FullName, manyToManyAliasAttribute.OneToManyCollectionName);
			}
			XPMemberInfo associatedMember = member.GetAssociatedMember();
			XPMemberInfo member2 = member.CollectionElementType.GetMember(manyToManyAliasAttribute.ReferenceInTheIntermediateTableName);
			if (member2.ReferenceType == null)
			{
				throw new PropertyMissingException(member.CollectionElementType.FullName, manyToManyAliasAttribute.ReferenceInTheIntermediateTableName);
			}
			XPMemberInfo associatedMember2 = member2.GetAssociatedMember();
			return (CriteriaOperator)new AggregateOperand(associatedMember2.Name, (Aggregate)0, (CriteriaOperator)(object)((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(associatedMember.Name) == (CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue(owner)));
		}

		protected virtual void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				switch (e.Action)
				{
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
					this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(e.Action, ConvertList(e.NewItems), e.NewStartingIndex));
					break;
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
					this.CollectionChanged(this, new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(e.Action, ConvertList(e.OldItems), e.OldStartingIndex));
					break;
				case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
					this.CollectionChanged(this, e);
					break;
				default:
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private void InvalidateDescriptors()
		{
			if (_Descriptors != null)
			{
				_Descriptors = null;
				if (this.ListChanged != null)
				{
					this.ListChanged(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged, -1));
				}
			}
		}

		public static XPInstantPropertyDescriptorJustMessage GetMessagingDescriptorIfUnsafe(string name, PropertyDescriptor prototype)
		{
			if (prototype == null)
			{
				return new XPInstantPropertyDescriptorJustMessage(name, $"'{name}' member does not exist");
			}
			if (ReflectionDictionary.DefaultCanGetClassInfoByType(prototype.PropertyType) || (typeof(IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(prototype.PropertyType) && !DBColumn.IsStorableType(prototype.PropertyType)))
			{
				return new XPInstantPropertyDescriptorJustMessage(name, $"'{name}' member is not safe");
			}
			return null;
		}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetDescriptors()
		{
			return GetDescriptorsCore() ?? PropertyDescriptorCollection.Empty;
		}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetDescriptorsCore()
		{
			if (ElementType == null || Properties.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = DesignSession.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(ElementType);
			if (xPClassInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			for (int i = 0; i < Properties.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Properties[i].Name))
				{
					PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = null;
					try
					{
						Type type = CriteriaTypeResolver.ResolveType(xPClassInfo, Properties[i].Property);
						propertyDescriptor = new XpoViewServerModePropertyDescriptor(Properties[i].Name, type, i);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 = GetMessagingDescriptorIfUnsafe(Properties[i].Name, propertyDescriptor);
					if (propertyDescriptor2 == null)
					{
						propertyDescriptor2 = propertyDescriptor;
					}
					list.Add(propertyDescriptor2);
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray(), readOnly: true);
		}

			if (_Descriptors == null)

				_Descriptors = GetDescriptors();
			}
			return _Descriptors;
		}

				this.ListChanged(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged, -1));

		public static XPInstantPropertyDescriptorJustMessage GetMessagingDescriptorIfUnsafe(string name, PropertyDescriptor prototype)
		{
			if (prototype == null)
			{
				return new XPInstantPropertyDescriptorJustMessage(name, $"'{name}' member does not exist");
			}
			if (ReflectionDictionary.DefaultCanGetClassInfoByType(prototype.PropertyType) || (typeof(IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(prototype.PropertyType) && !DBColumn.IsStorableType(prototype.PropertyType)))
			{
				return new XPInstantPropertyDescriptorJustMessage(name, $"'{name}' member is not safe");
			}
			return null;
		}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetDescriptors()
		{
			return GetDescriptorsCore() ?? PropertyDescriptorCollection.Empty;
		}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetDescriptorsCore()
		{
			if (ElementType == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(DisplayableProperties))
			{
				return null;
			}
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = DesignSession.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(ElementType);
			if (xPClassInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = DesignSession.GetProperties(xPClassInfo);
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (string item in (from s in DisplayableProperties.Split(';')
				where !string.IsNullOrEmpty(s)
				select s).Distinct())
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = properties.Find(item, ignoreCase: false);
				if (propertyDescriptor != null)
				{
					PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 = GetMessagingDescriptorIfUnsafe(item, propertyDescriptor);
					if (propertyDescriptor2 == null)
					{
						propertyDescriptor2 = propertyDescriptor;
					}
					list.Add(propertyDescriptor2);
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray(), readOnly: true);
		}

		{
			if (_Descriptors == null)
			{
				_Descriptors = GetDescriptors();

		}

		public static IEnumerable<string> GetDefaultDisplayableProperties(XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			return GetDefaultDisplayableProperties(classInfo, 2);
		}

		public static IEnumerable<string> GetDefaultDisplayableProperties(XPClassInfo classInfo, int depthOfReferences)
		{
			return GetDefProps(depthOfReferences, classInfo);
		}

		private static IEnumerable<string> GetDefProps(int depthLeft, XPClassInfo ci)
		{
			if (depthLeft < 0)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo member in ci.Members)
			{
				if (!member.IsVisibleInDesignTime || !member.IsPublic || (!member.IsPersistent && !member.IsAliased) || member.IsDelayed)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (member.ReferenceType == null)
				{
					yield return member.Name;
					continue;
				}
				string prefix = member.Name + ".";
				foreach (string defProp in GetDefProps(depthLeft - 1, member.ReferenceType))
				{
					yield return prefix + defProp;
				}
			}
		}

	public class XPInstantFeedbackSourceObjectTypeConverter : TypeListConverter
	{
		public const string None = "(none)";

		private SortedList<string, Type> typesCache;

		public XPInstantFeedbackSourceObjectTypeConverter()
			: base(new Type[0])
		{
		}

		public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			SortedList<string, Type> availableTypes = GetAvailableTypes(context, showErrorMessage: true);
			return new StandardValuesCollection(new List<Type>(availableTypes.Values).ToArray());
		}

		private SortedList<string, Type> GetAvailableTypes(ITypeDescriptorContext context, bool showErrorMessage)
		{
			if (typesCache != null)
			{
				return typesCache;
			}
			SortedList<string, Type> sortedList = new SortedList<string, Type>();
			sortedList.Add("(none)", null);
			try
			{
				XPDictionary xPDictionary = ((!(context.Instance is Component component)) ? ((IXPDictionaryProvider)context.Instance).Dictionary : XPInstantListDesignTimeWrapper.GetDesignDictionary(component.Site));
				foreach (XPClassInfo @class in xPDictionary.Classes)
				{
					if (@class.IsPersistent && !(@class.ClassType == null) && !@class.FullName.StartsWith("DevExpress.Xpo."))
					{
						sortedList.Add(@class.FullName, @class.ClassType);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				((IUIService)context.GetService(typeof(IUIService)))?.ShowError(ex);
			}
			typesCache = sortedList;
			return sortedList;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object val)
		{
			SortedList<string, Type> availableTypes = GetAvailableTypes(context, showErrorMessage: false);
			if (val is string text)
			{
				if (text == "(none)")
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (availableTypes.TryGetValue(text, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				value = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownUserType(text, false);
				if (value != null)
				{
					return value;
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, val);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object val, Type destType)
		{
			if (destType == typeof(string))
			{
				if (val == null)
				{
					return "(none)";
				}
				if (val is Type)
				{
					return ((Type)val).FullName;
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, val, destType);
		}

		public override bool GetStandardValuesExclusive(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

	public abstract class StronglyTypedCriteriaVisitorBase<T> : IClientCriteriaVisitor<T>, ICriteriaVisitor<T>
	{
		protected readonly XPDictionary Dictionary;

		protected readonly XPClassInfo[] UpLevelsClassInfos;

		protected StronglyTypedCriteriaVisitorBase(XPClassInfo[] upLevelsClassInfos)
		{
			if (upLevelsClassInfos == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("upLevelsClassInfos");
			}
			UpLevelsClassInfos = upLevelsClassInfos;
			if (UpLevelsClassInfos.Length != 0)
			{
				Dictionary = UpLevelsClassInfos[0].Dictionary;
			}
		}

		protected static XPClassInfo[] GetUpLevels(XPClassInfo[] upLevels, EvaluatorProperty prop)
		{
			List<XPClassInfo> list = new List<XPClassInfo>();
			for (int num = upLevels.Length - 1; num >= prop.UpDepth; num--)
			{
				list.Insert(0, upLevels[num]);
			}
			if (EvaluatorProperty.GetIsThisProperty(prop.PropertyPath) && list.Count > 0)
			{
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = upLevels[prop.UpDepth];
			MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = xPClassInfo.ParsePath(prop.PropertyPath);
			foreach (XPMemberInfo item in memberInfoCollection)
			{
				if (item.ReferenceType != null && item.IsPersistent)
				{
					xPClassInfo = item.ReferenceType;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!item.IsAssociationList)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("PersistentAliasExpander_ReferenceOrCollectionExpectedInTheMiddleOfThePath", item.Name));
					}
					xPClassInfo = item.CollectionElementType;
				}
				list.Insert(0, xPClassInfo);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected XPClassInfo[] GetUpLevels(OperandProperty collection)
		{
			if (collection == null || collection.PropertyName == null || collection.PropertyName.Length == 0)
			{
				return UpLevelsClassInfos;
			}
			return GetUpLevels(UpLevelsClassInfos, EvaluatorProperty.Create(collection));
		}

		protected static XPClassInfo[] GetUpLevels(XPClassInfo[] upLevels, string className)
		{
			if (!MemberInfoCollection.TryResolveTypeAlsoByShortName(className, upLevels[0], out var classInfo))
			{
				throw new CannotResolveClassInfoException(string.Empty, className);
			}
			XPClassInfo[] array = new XPClassInfo[upLevels.Length + 1];
			Array.Copy(upLevels, 0, array, 1, upLevels.Length);
			array[0] = classInfo;
			return array;
		}

		protected XPClassInfo[] GetUpLevels(string className)
		{
			return GetUpLevels(UpLevelsClassInfos, className);
		}

		protected abstract T Visit(OperandProperty theOperand);

		protected abstract T Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand);

		protected abstract T Visit(JoinOperand theOperand);

		protected abstract T Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator);

		protected abstract T Visit(OperandValue theOperand);

		protected abstract T Visit(GroupOperator theOperator);

		protected abstract T Visit(InOperator theOperator);

		protected abstract T Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator);

		protected abstract T Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator);

		protected abstract T Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator);

		T IClientCriteriaVisitor<T>.Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
		{
			return Visit(theOperand);
		}

		T IClientCriteriaVisitor<T>.Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)
		{
			return Visit(theOperand);
		}

		T IClientCriteriaVisitor<T>.Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
		{
			return Visit(theOperand);
		}

		T ICriteriaVisitor<T>.Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Visit(theOperator);
		}

		T ICriteriaVisitor<T>.Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			return Visit(theOperand);
		}

		T ICriteriaVisitor<T>.Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Visit(theOperator);
		}

		T ICriteriaVisitor<T>.Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Visit(theOperator);
		}

		T ICriteriaVisitor<T>.Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Visit(theOperator);
		}

		T ICriteriaVisitor<T>.Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Visit(theOperator);
		}

		T ICriteriaVisitor<T>.Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Visit(theOperator);
		}

	public class ObjectList : IList, ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		public IList List;

		public const int TerminalSize = 128;

		private ObjectDictionary<int> _Index;

		private int firstInvalidIndex;

		public bool IsFixedSize => false;

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public object this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return List[index];
			}
			set
			{
				object valueForRemove = this[index];
				List[index] = value;
				InvalidateIndexAt(index, valueForRemove);
			}
		}

		public int Count => List.Count;

		public bool IsSynchronized => false;

		public object SyncRoot => this;

		public ObjectList()
			: this(0)
		{
		}

		public ObjectList(int suggestedSize)
		{
			List = new ArrayList(suggestedSize);
			ClearIndex();
		}

		public ObjectList(ICollection fillBy)
			: this(fillBy.Count)
		{
			foreach (object item in fillBy)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		public int Add(object value)
		{
			int count = Count;
			Insert(count, value);
			return count;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			List.Clear();
			ClearIndex();
		}

		public bool Contains(object value)
		{
			return IndexOf(value) >= 0;
		}

		private void ClearIndex()
		{
			_Index = null;
			firstInvalidIndex = 0;
		}

		private void InvalidateIndexAt(int index, object valueForRemove)
		{
			if (firstInvalidIndex > index)
			{
				firstInvalidIndex = index;
			}
			if (firstInvalidIndex <= 0)
			{
				_Index = null;
			}
			if (_Index != null && valueForRemove != null)
			{
				_Index.Remove(valueForRemove);
			}
		}

		public int IndexOf(object value)
		{
			if (value == null || Count <= 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (this[0] == value)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (this[Count - 1] == value)
			{
				return Count - 1;
			}
			if (_Index == null && Count > 128)
			{
				_Index = new ObjectDictionary<int>(Count);
				firstInvalidIndex = 0;
			}
			if (_Index == null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					if (this[i] == value)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (_Index.TryGetValue(value, out var value2) && value2 < firstInvalidIndex && value == this[value2])
			{
				return value2;
			}
			while (firstInvalidIndex < Count)
			{
				int num = firstInvalidIndex;
				_Index[this[num]] = num;
				firstInvalidIndex++;
				if (this[num] == value)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			List.Insert(index, value);
			InvalidateIndexAt(index, null);
		}

		public void Remove(object value)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(value);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			object valueForRemove = this[index];
			List.RemoveAt(index);
			InvalidateIndexAt(index, valueForRemove);
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			List.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return List.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}

		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = ((puncturedAt < 0) ? objects.Count : (objects.Count - 1));
			if (dreamPos >= 0)
			{
				if (num <= dreamPos && dreamPos < num2)
				{
					int num3 = cmp.Compare(GetObjectFromPuncturedCollection(objects, puncturedAt, dreamPos), obj);
					if (num3 == 0)
					{
						return dreamPos;
					}
					if (num3 < 0)
					{
						num = dreamPos + 1;
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = dreamPos;
					}
				}
				if (num < dreamPos && dreamPos <= num2)
				{
					int num4 = cmp.Compare(GetObjectFromPuncturedCollection(objects, puncturedAt, dreamPos - 1), obj);
					if (num4 == 0)
					{
						return dreamPos;
					}
					if (num4 < 0)
					{
						num = dreamPos;
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = dreamPos - 1;
					}
				}
			}
			while (num < num2)
			{
				int num5 = num + num2 >> 1;
				int num6 = cmp.Compare(GetObjectFromPuncturedCollection(objects, puncturedAt, num5), obj);
				if (num6 == 0 && dreamPos >= 0)
				{
					num6 = ((num5 >= dreamPos) ? 1 : (-1));
				}
				if (num6 < 0)
				{
					num = num5 + 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (num6 > 0)
				{
					num2 = num5;
					continue;
				}
				return num5;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class XPCollectionHelper
	{
		private abstract class ChangeSubscriber
		{
			public abstract void Add(object obj);

			public abstract void Remove(object obj);
		}

		private class WeakChangeSubscriber : ChangeSubscriber
		{
			private ObjectRecord eventHandler;

			public WeakChangeSubscriber(IObjectChange change)
			{
				eventHandler = ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(change);
			}

			public override void Add(object obj)
			{
				ObjectRecord.AddChangeHandler(obj, eventHandler);
			}

			public override void Remove(object obj)
			{
				ObjectRecord.RemoveChangeHandler(obj, eventHandler);
			}
		}

		private class StrongChangeSubscriber : ChangeSubscriber
		{
			private ObjectChangeEventHandler eventHandler;

			public StrongChangeSubscriber(IObjectChange change)
			{
				eventHandler = change.OnObjectChanged;
			}

			public override void Add(object obj)
			{
				XPBaseObject.AddChangedEventHandler(obj, eventHandler);
			}

			public override void Remove(object obj)
			{
				XPBaseObject.RemoveChangedEventHandler(obj, eventHandler);
			}
		}

		private ChangeSubscriber _EventHandler;

		protected readonly XPBaseCollection ParentCollection;

		public XPClassInfo ObjectClassInfo;

		public Session Session;

		private IList objList;

		private ChangeSubscriber EventHandler
		{
			get
			{
				if (_EventHandler == null)
				{
					if (Session.GetIdentityMapBehavior() == IdentityMapBehavior.Weak)
					{
						_EventHandler = new WeakChangeSubscriber(ParentCollection);
					}
					else
					{
						_EventHandler = new StrongChangeSubscriber(ParentCollection);
					}
				}
				return _EventHandler;
			}
		}

		public IList ObjList
		{
			get
			{
				if (objList == null)
				{
					objList = new ObjectList();
				}
				return objList;
			}
		}

		public virtual XPClassInfo FetchObjectsClassInfo => ObjectClassInfo;

		public virtual ICollection IntObjList => ObjList;

		public bool LoadCollectionOnModify
		{
			get
			{
				if (!LoadCollectionOnModifyCore)
				{
					return !ParentCollection.LoadingEnabled;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool LoadCollectionOnModifyCore => true;

		public XPCollectionHelper(XPBaseCollection owner)
		{
			ParentCollection = owner;
		}

		public virtual int Add(object newObject)
		{
			return InternalAddObject(newObject);
		}

		public virtual void Remove(object theObject)
		{
			ObjList.Remove(theObject);
			EventHandler.Remove(theObject);
		}

		public virtual void BeforeAfterRemove(object theObject)
		{
		}

		public virtual int InternalAddObject(object newObject)
		{
			int result = ObjList.Add(newObject);
			EventHandler.Add(newObject);
			return result;
		}

		public void ClearObjList()
		{
			int count = ObjList.Count;
			for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				EventHandler.Remove(ObjList[num]);
			}
			ObjList.Clear();
		}

		public virtual void Reload()
		{
		}

		public virtual CriteriaOperator PatchCriteriaFromUserToFetch(CriteriaOperator fetchCriteria)
		{
			return fetchCriteria;
		}

		public virtual IEnumerable PatchLoadedCollectionWithChangesWhileNotLoaded(IEnumerable objects)
		{
			return objects;
		}

		public virtual IEnumerable GetContentWithoutQueryIfPossible()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual Task<IEnumerable> GetContentWithoutQueryIfPossibleAsync(CancellationToken cancellation)
		{
			return Task.FromResult<IEnumerable>(null);
		}

		public virtual bool IsThereForDelete(object theObject)
		{
			return ObjList.Contains(theObject);
		}

		public virtual CriteriaOperator GetHardcodedCriterion()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual void KickOutCancelledAddNew(object sender)
		{
		}

	public abstract class XPRefCollectionHelper : XPCollectionHelper
	{
		public readonly object OwnerObject;

		public readonly XPMemberInfo RefProperty;

		protected XPRefCollectionHelper(XPBaseCollection parentCollection, object ownerObject, XPMemberInfo refProperty)
			: base(parentCollection)
		{
			OwnerObject = ownerObject;
			RefProperty = refProperty;
		}

		public override IEnumerable GetContentWithoutQueryIfPossible()
		{
			if (Session.ObjectLayer.CanLoadCollectionObjects && !ParentCollection.IsAsyncLoading)
			{
				return Session.ObjectLayer.LoadCollectionObjects(Session, RefProperty, OwnerObject);
			}
			return base.GetContentWithoutQueryIfPossible();
		}

		public override async Task<IEnumerable> GetContentWithoutQueryIfPossibleAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (Session.ObjectLayer is IObjectLayerAsync { CanLoadCollectionObjectsAsynchronously: not false } objectLayerAsync && !ParentCollection.IsAsyncLoading && objectLayerAsync != null)
			{
				return await objectLayerAsync.LoadCollectionObjectsAsync(Session, RefProperty, OwnerObject, cancellationToken);
			}
			return await base.GetContentWithoutQueryIfPossibleAsync(cancellationToken);
		}

		public abstract void ClearChangesCache();

		public abstract void Save();

		public static T GetRefCollectionHelperChecked<T>(XPBaseCollection collection, object ownerObject, XPMemberInfo collectionMember) where T : XPRefCollectionHelper
		{
			if (!(collection.Helper is T result))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Collections_GeneralPurposeCollectionInsteadOfRefCollection", ownerObject, collectionMember.Name));
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public sealed class XPRefCollectionHelperOneToMany : XPRefCollectionHelper
	{
		private ObjectSet added;

		private ObjectSet removed;

		public object AssocRefChangeRemovingObject;

		protected override bool LoadCollectionOnModifyCore => false;

		public XPRefCollectionHelperOneToMany(XPBaseCollection parentCollection, object ownerObject, XPMemberInfo refProperty)
			: base(parentCollection, ownerObject, refProperty)
		{
		}

		public override CriteriaOperator GetHardcodedCriterion()
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(RefProperty.GetAssociatedMember().Name) == (CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue(OwnerObject));
		}

		public override IEnumerable PatchLoadedCollectionWithChangesWhileNotLoaded(IEnumerable objects)
		{
			if (added == null && removed == null)
			{
				return base.PatchLoadedCollectionWithChangesWhileNotLoaded(objects);
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			ObjectSet objectSet = null;
			if (objects != null)
			{
				foreach (object @object in objects)
				{
					if (removed != null && removed.Contains(@object))
					{
						continue;
					}
					list.Add(@object);
					if (added != null && added.Contains(@object))
					{
						if (objectSet == null)
						{
							objectSet = new ObjectSet();
						}
						objectSet.Add(@object);
					}
				}
			}
			if (added != null)
			{
				foreach (object item in added)
				{
					if (objectSet == null || !objectSet.Contains(item))
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override void ClearChangesCache()
		{
			added = null;
			removed = null;
		}

		public override void Save()
		{
			if (!Session.IsUnitOfWork && RefProperty.IsAggregated)
			{
				ParentCollection.Load();
			}
			if (removed != null && !Session.IsUnitOfWork)
			{
				foreach (object item in removed)
				{
					if (!(item is IXPInvalidateableObject { IsInvalidated: not false }) && !Session.IsNewObject(item))
					{
						Session.Save(item);
					}
				}
			}
			if (RefProperty.IsAggregated && !Session.IsUnitOfWork)
			{
				foreach (object obj in base.ObjList)
				{
					Session.Save(obj);
				}
			}
			else if (!Session.IsUnitOfWork && added != null)
			{
				foreach (object item2 in added)
				{
					Session.Save(item2);
				}
			}
			Session.collectionsMarkedSaved[this] = this;
		}

		private void SetObjectPropertyValue(object theObject, object newValue)
		{
			GetObjectProperty().SetValue(theObject, newValue);
		}

		private object GetObjectPropertyValue(object theObject)
		{
			return GetObjectProperty().GetValue(theObject);
		}

		private XPMemberInfo GetObjectProperty()
		{
			return RefProperty.GetAssociatedMember();
		}

		public override int Add(object newObject)
		{
			if (GetObjectPropertyValue(newObject) != OwnerObject)
			{
				SetObjectPropertyValue(newObject, OwnerObject);
			}
			if (added == null)
			{
				added = new ObjectSet(4);
			}
			added.Add(newObject);
			if (removed != null)
			{
				removed.Remove(newObject);
			}
			return base.Add(newObject);
		}

		public override void Remove(object theObject)
		{
			if (theObject == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("theObject");
			}
			base.Remove(theObject);
			if (added != null)
			{
				added.Remove(theObject);
			}
			if (removed == null)
			{
				removed = new ObjectSet(4);
			}
			removed.Add(theObject);
		}

		public override void BeforeAfterRemove(object theObject)
		{
			base.BeforeAfterRemove(theObject);
			if (GetObjectPropertyValue(theObject) == OwnerObject && XPAssociationList.CanNullifyAssociatedMember(Session, GetObjectProperty(), theObject))
			{
				SetObjectPropertyValue(theObject, null);
			}
		}

		public override void Reload()
		{
			ClearChangesCache();
			base.Reload();
		}

		public override bool IsThereForDelete(object theObject)
		{
			if (ParentCollection.IsLoaded)
			{
				return base.IsThereForDelete(theObject);
			}
			if (base.IsThereForDelete(theObject))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (AssocRefChangeRemovingObject == theObject)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return OwnerObject == GetObjectPropertyValue(theObject);
		}

		public override void KickOutCancelledAddNew(object removedNew)
		{
			base.KickOutCancelledAddNew(removedNew);
			if (removed != null)
			{
				removed.Remove(removedNew);
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class XPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany : XPRefCollectionHelper
	{
		private ObjectDictionary<IntermediateObject> hash;

		private List<IntermediateObject> added;

		private List<IntermediateObject> removed;

		private ObjectDictionary<IntermediateObject> Hash
		{
			get
			{
				if (hash == null)
				{
					hash = new ObjectDictionary<IntermediateObject>();
				}
				return hash;
			}
		}

		public override ICollection IntObjList
		{
			get
			{
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				foreach (object intObj in base.IntObjList)
				{
					arrayList.Add(GetIntermediateObject(intObj));
				}
				return arrayList;
			}
		}

		public override XPClassInfo FetchObjectsClassInfo => RefProperty.IntermediateClass;

		public XPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany(XPBaseCollection parentCollection, object ownerObject, XPMemberInfo refProperty)
			: base(parentCollection, ownerObject, refProperty)
		{
		}

		public override CriteriaOperator GetHardcodedCriterion()
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(RefProperty.GetAssociatedMember().Name) == (CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue(OwnerObject));
		}

		private IntermediateObject GetIntermediateObject(object referred)
		{
			Hash.TryGetValue(referred, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public override CriteriaOperator PatchCriteriaFromUserToFetch(CriteriaOperator fetchCriteria)
		{
			return TopLevelPropertiesPrefixer.PatchAliasPrefix(RefProperty.Name + ".", fetchCriteria);
		}

		internal void AddIntermediateObject(IntermediateObject iObject, object referred)
		{
			if ((object)GetIntermediateObject(referred) == null)
			{
				Hash.Add(referred, iObject);
			}
		}

		private IntermediateObject CreateIntermediateObject(object referred)
		{
			IntermediateObject intermediateObject = GetIntermediateObject(referred);
			if ((object)intermediateObject == null)
			{
				IntermediateClassInfo intermediateClass = RefProperty.IntermediateClass;
				intermediateObject = new IntermediateObject(Session, intermediateClass);
				intermediateClass.GetFieldInfo(RefProperty.GetAssociatedMember()).SetValue(intermediateObject, OwnerObject);
				intermediateClass.GetFieldInfo(RefProperty).SetValue(intermediateObject, referred);
			}
			return intermediateObject;
		}

		private object GetReferredObject(IntermediateObject io)
		{
			return io.ClassInfo.GetMember(RefProperty.Name).GetValue(io);
		}

		private XPBaseCollection GetReferredCollection(IntermediateObject io)
		{
			return GetReferredCollection(GetReferredObject(io));
		}

		private XPBaseCollection GetReferredCollection(object obj)
		{
			return (XPBaseCollection)RefProperty.GetAssociatedMember().GetValue(obj);
		}

		private XPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany GetReferredHelper(IntermediateObject io)
		{
			return (XPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany)GetReferredCollection(io).Helper;
		}

		public override void ClearChangesCache()
		{
			if (added != null)
			{
				foreach (IntermediateObject item in added)
				{
					XPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany referredHelper = GetReferredHelper(item);
					if (referredHelper.added != null)
					{
						referredHelper.added.Remove(item);
					}
				}
				added = null;
			}
			if (removed == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IntermediateObject item2 in removed)
			{
				Hash.Remove(GetReferredObject(item2));
				XPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany referredHelper2 = GetReferredHelper(item2);
				referredHelper2.Hash.Remove(OwnerObject);
				if (referredHelper2.removed != null)
				{
					referredHelper2.removed.Remove(item2);
				}
			}
			removed = null;
		}

		public override void Save()
		{
			if (added != null)
			{
				foreach (IntermediateObject item in added)
				{
					item.Save();
				}
			}
			if (removed != null)
			{
				foreach (IntermediateObject item2 in removed)
				{
					if (!((IXPInvalidateableObject)item2).IsInvalidated)
					{
						item2.Delete();
					}
				}
			}
			Session.collectionsMarkedSaved[this] = this;
		}

		public override int Add(object newObject)
		{
			IntermediateObject intermediateObject = CreateIntermediateObject(newObject);
			int index;
			if (Session.IsUnitOfWork)
			{
				intermediateObject.Save();
			}
			else if (removed != null && (index = removed.IndexOf(intermediateObject)) >= 0)
			{
				removed.RemoveAt(index);
			}
			else
			{
				if (added == null)
				{
					added = new List<IntermediateObject>(4);
				}
				added.Add(intermediateObject);
			}
			int result = base.Add(intermediateObject);
			XPBaseCollection referredCollection = GetReferredCollection(newObject);
			((XPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany)referredCollection.Helper).AddIntermediateObject(intermediateObject, OwnerObject);
			referredCollection.BaseAdd(OwnerObject);
			return result;
		}

		public override void Remove(object theObject)
		{
			if (theObject == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("theObject");
			}
			if (base.ObjList.IndexOf(theObject) < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.Remove(theObject);
			IntermediateObject intermediateObject = GetIntermediateObject(theObject);
			int index;
			if (Session.IsUnitOfWork)
			{
				Hash.Remove(GetReferredObject(intermediateObject));
				intermediateObject.Delete();
			}
			else if (added != null && (index = added.IndexOf(intermediateObject)) >= 0)
			{
				added.RemoveAt(index);
				Hash.Remove(theObject);
			}
			else
			{
				if (removed == null)
				{
					removed = new List<IntermediateObject>(4);
				}
				removed.Add(intermediateObject);
			}
			GetReferredCollection(theObject).BaseRemove(OwnerObject);
		}

		public override int InternalAddObject(object newObject)
		{
			XPMemberInfo member = Session.GetClassInfo(newObject).GetMember(RefProperty.Name);
			object value = member.GetValue(newObject);
			AddIntermediateObject((IntermediateObject)newObject, value);
			return base.InternalAddObject(value);
		}
	}

	}
