	public class AnalyzeTransitionInfo
	{
		public readonly Guid JoinOperandId;

		public readonly XPClassInfo JoinClassInfo;

		public readonly XPMemberInfo MemberInfo;

		public readonly bool UpCasting;

		public readonly bool CantWrapCollection;

		public bool IsMemberInfo => MemberInfo != null;

		public AnalyzeTransitionInfo(XPMemberInfo memberInfo, bool cantWrapCollection)
			: this(memberInfo, null, upCasting: false, cantWrapCollection)
		{
		}

		public AnalyzeTransitionInfo(XPMemberInfo memberInfo, XPClassInfo classInfo, bool upCasting, bool cantWrapCollection)
		{
			if (memberInfo == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Res.GetString("CriteriaAnalizer_NullTransitionMemberInfo"));
			}
			MemberInfo = memberInfo;
			JoinClassInfo = classInfo;
			UpCasting = upCasting;
			CantWrapCollection = cantWrapCollection;
		}

		public AnalyzeTransitionInfo(Guid joinOperandId, XPClassInfo joinClassInfo, bool cantWrapCollection)
		{
			if (joinOperandId == Guid.Empty)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("CriteriaAnalizer_EmptyJoinOperandId"));
			}
			if (joinClassInfo == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Res.GetString("CriteriaAnalizer_NullJoinClassInfo"));
			}
			JoinOperandId = joinOperandId;
			JoinClassInfo = joinClassInfo;
			CantWrapCollection = cantWrapCollection;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (IsMemberInfo)
			{
				return MemberInfo.ToString();
			}
			return $"[<{JoinClassInfo.FullName}>]";
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is AnalyzeTransitionInfo analyzeTransitionInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (CantWrapCollection != analyzeTransitionInfo.CantWrapCollection)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool isMemberInfo = IsMemberInfo;
			bool isMemberInfo2 = analyzeTransitionInfo.IsMemberInfo;
			if (isMemberInfo && isMemberInfo2)
			{
				if (MemberInfo.Owner.IsPersistent)
				{
					return MemberInfo.Equals(analyzeTransitionInfo.MemberInfo);
				}
				if (MemberInfo.Equals(analyzeTransitionInfo.MemberInfo))
				{
					return object.Equals(JoinClassInfo, analyzeTransitionInfo.JoinClassInfo);
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (!isMemberInfo && !isMemberInfo2)
			{
				if (JoinOperandId.Equals(analyzeTransitionInfo.JoinOperandId))
				{
					return JoinClassInfo.Equals(analyzeTransitionInfo.JoinClassInfo);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (IsMemberInfo)
			{
				return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<XPMemberInfo, bool>(MemberInfo, CantWrapCollection);
			}
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<Guid, XPClassInfo, bool>(JoinOperandId, JoinClassInfo, CantWrapCollection);
		}
	}
	public class AnalyzeCriteriaCreator : IClientCriteriaVisitor<AnalyzeOperator>, ICriteriaVisitor<AnalyzeOperator>
	{
		public static readonly AnalyzeInfoKey NodeNameKey = new AnalyzeInfoKey("NodeName");

		public static readonly AnalyzeInfoKey ClassInfoKey = new AnalyzeInfoKey("ClassInfo");

		public static readonly AnalyzeInfoKey TransitionInfoKey = new AnalyzeInfoKey("TransitionInfo");

		public static readonly AnalyzeInfoKey OperatorIdKey = new AnalyzeInfoKey("OperatorId");

		private string currentNodeName;

		private XPClassInfo currentClassInfo;

		private readonly Stack<XPClassInfo> classInfoStack = new Stack<XPClassInfo>(5);

		private readonly Stack<string> nodeNameStack = new Stack<string>(5);

		private readonly Dictionary<string, Dictionary<AnalyzeTransitionInfo, string>> nodeToNodeMoveDict = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<AnalyzeTransitionInfo, string>>();

		private readonly Dictionary<string, XPClassInfo> nodeClassInfoDict = new Dictionary<string, XPClassInfo>();

		private int nodeNameCounter = 1;

		private bool topLevelAggregateDetected;

		public bool TopLevelAggregateDetected => topLevelAggregateDetected;

		public AnalyzeCriteriaCreator(XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			currentClassInfo = classInfo;
			currentNodeName = "N0";
			nodeClassInfoDict.Add(currentNodeName, currentClassInfo);
		}

		public void RaiseIfTopLevelAggregate()
		{
			if (TopLevelAggregateDetected)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("CriteriaAnalizer_TopLevelAggregateNotSupported"));
			}
		}

		public static AnalyzeResult Process(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperator co)
		{
			return new AnalyzeCriteriaCreator(classInfo).Process(co);
		}

		private AnalyzeResult Process(CriteriaOperator co)
		{
			AnalyzeOperator resultOperator = ProcessInternal(co);
			return new AnalyzeResult(resultOperator, nodeToNodeMoveDict, nodeClassInfoDict, topLevelAggregateDetected);
		}

		private AnalyzeOperator ProcessInternal(CriteriaOperator co)
		{
			if (co == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return co.Accept<AnalyzeOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<AnalyzeOperator>)this);
		}

		private string GetNextNodeName(AnalyzeTransitionInfo ati, XPClassInfo nextNodeClassInfo)
		{
			string text;
			if (ati != null)
			{
				Dictionary<AnalyzeTransitionInfo, string> nodeDict = GetNodeDict(currentNodeName);
				if (!nodeDict.TryGetValue(ati, out var value))
				{
					value = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "N{0}", new object[1] { nodeNameCounter++ });
					nodeDict.Add(ati, value);
				}
				text = value;
			}
			else
			{
				text = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "N{0}", new object[1] { nodeNameCounter++ });
			}
			if (!nodeClassInfoDict.ContainsKey(text))
			{
				nodeClassInfoDict.Add(text, nextNodeClassInfo);
			}
			return text;
		}

		private Dictionary<AnalyzeTransitionInfo, string> GetNodeDict(string nodeName)
		{
			if (!nodeToNodeMoveDict.TryGetValue(nodeName, out var value))
			{
				value = new Dictionary<AnalyzeTransitionInfo, string>();
				nodeToNodeMoveDict.Add(nodeName, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static bool IsUpCasting(XPClassInfo currentClassInfo, XPMemberInfo memberInfo)
		{
			XPClassInfo owner = memberInfo.Owner;
			if (currentClassInfo == owner || currentClassInfo == null || owner == null || !owner.IsPersistent)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return owner.IsAssignableTo(currentClassInfo);
		}

		public static XPClassInfo GetUpClass(XPClassInfo left, XPClassInfo right)
		{
			if (left == right)
			{
				return left;
			}
			if (left == null)
			{
				return right;
			}
			if (right == null)
			{
				return left;
			}
			if (left.IsAssignableTo(right))
			{
				return left;
			}
			if (right.IsAssignableTo(left))
			{
				return right;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("CriteriaAnalizer_ClassesAreNotAssignable", left.FullName, right.FullName));
		}

		public static XPClassInfo GetDownClass(XPClassInfo left, XPClassInfo right)
		{
			if (left == right)
			{
				return left;
			}
			if (left == null)
			{
				return right;
			}
			if (right == null)
			{
				return left;
			}
			if (left.IsAssignableTo(right))
			{
				return right;
			}
			if (right.IsAssignableTo(left))
			{
				return left;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("CriteriaAnalizer_ClassesAreNotAssignable", left.FullName, right.FullName));
		}

	public class NodePathCriteriaAnalyzer : IAnalyzeCriteriaVisitor<List<Guid>>, IClientCriteriaVisitor<List<Guid>>, ICriteriaVisitor<List<Guid>>
	{
		private string nodeName;

		public NodePathCriteriaAnalyzer(string nodeName)
		{
			this.nodeName = nodeName;
		}

		public static List<Guid> Process(string nodeName, CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			return new NodePathCriteriaAnalyzer(nodeName).Process(criteria);
		}

		public List<Guid> Process(CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			if (criteria == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return criteria.Accept<List<Guid>>((ICriteriaVisitor<List<Guid>>)this);
		}

		public List<Guid> Visit(AnalyzeOperator criteria)
		{
			List<Guid> list;
			if (criteria.Original is OperandProperty && criteria.AnalyzeInfo.TryGetValue(AnalyzeCriteriaCreator.NodeNameKey, out var value) && value.ToString() == nodeName)
			{
				list = new List<Guid>();
				list.Add((Guid)criteria.AnalyzeInfo[AnalyzeCriteriaCreator.OperatorIdKey]);
				return list;
			}
			list = Process(criteria.Original);
			if (list == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			list.Insert(0, (Guid)criteria.AnalyzeInfo[AnalyzeCriteriaCreator.OperatorIdKey]);
			return list;
		}

		public List<Guid> Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
		{
			List<Guid> result;
			if ((result = Process(theOperand.AggregatedExpression)) != null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if ((result = Process(theOperand.Condition)) != null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands)
			{
				if ((result = Process(item)) != null)
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public List<Guid> Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public List<Guid> Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)
		{
			List<Guid> result;
			if ((result = Process(theOperand.AggregatedExpression)) != null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if ((result = Process(theOperand.Condition)) != null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands)
			{
				if ((result = Process(item)) != null)
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public List<Guid> Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			return ProcessOperands(theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public List<Guid> Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public List<Guid> Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			return ProcessOperands(theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public List<Guid> Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			List<Guid> list = Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			if (list != null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			return ProcessOperands(theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public List<Guid> Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process(theOperator.Operand);
		}

		public List<Guid> Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			List<Guid> result;
			if ((result = Process(theOperator.LeftOperand)) != null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if ((result = Process(theOperator.RightOperand)) != null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public List<Guid> Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
		{
			List<Guid> result;
			if ((result = Process(theOperator.TestExpression)) != null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if ((result = Process(theOperator.BeginExpression)) != null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if ((result = Process(theOperator.EndExpression)) != null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private List<Guid> ProcessOperands(CriteriaOperatorCollection operands)
		{
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)operands)
			{
				List<Guid> list = Process(item);
				if (list != null)
				{
					return list;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		private static string GetPrefix(int prefixCount)
		{
			if (prefixCount < 0)

				return string.Empty;
			}

		}

		private string GetPathString(AnalyzeNodePathItem[] path)
		{
			if (path == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return GetPathString(path, 0, path.Length);
		}

		private string GetPathString(AnalyzeNodePathItem[] path, int start, int count)
		{
			if (path == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = start; i < start + count; i++)
			{
				XPMemberInfo memberInfo = path[i].TransitionInfo.MemberInfo;
				if (memberInfo != null)
				{
					if (path[i].TransitionInfo.UpCasting)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("<");
						stringBuilder.Append(memberInfo.Owner.FullName);
						stringBuilder.Append(">");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(memberInfo.Name);
					stringBuilder.Append('.');
					continue;
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException("JoinOperand in property path.");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private void DetectInvalidPropertyPath(AnalyzeNodePathItem[] path, string propertyName)
		{
			if (path != null)
			{
				DetectInvalidPropertyPath(path, path.Length - 1, 1, propertyName);
			}
		}

		private void DetectInvalidPropertyPath(AnalyzeNodePathItem[] path, int start, int count, string propertyName)
		{
			int num = start + count - 1;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName) && path != null && count != 0 && num >= 0 && path.Length - 1 >= num)
			{
				AnalyzeNodePathItem analyzeNodePathItem = path[num];
				if (analyzeNodePathItem != null && analyzeNodePathItem.TransitionInfo.MemberInfo != null && (analyzeNodePathItem.TransitionInfo.MemberInfo.IsCollection || analyzeNodePathItem.TransitionInfo.MemberInfo.IsAssociationList))
				{
					string item = GetPathString(path, start, count) + propertyName;
					DetectedInvalidPropertyPaths.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private static AnalyzeNodePathItem[] MergePaths(AnalyzeNodePathItem[] left, AnalyzeNodePathItem[] right)

			{

			}
			if (right != null && num2 > 0)
			{
				Array.Copy(right, 0, array, num, num2);
			}
			return array;
		}

					leftResult = 3;
				}

		{

		}

		{
			return Node + ((Type == AnalyzeNodePathItemType.Direct) ? "->" : "-<") + TransitionInfo.ToString();
		}

		{
			if (!(obj is AnalyzeNodePathItem analyzeNodePathItem))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (TransitionInfo.Equals(analyzeNodePathItem.TransitionInfo))
			{
				return Type == analyzeNodePathItem.Type;
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<AnalyzeTransitionInfo, AnalyzeNodePathItemType>(TransitionInfo, Type);
		}
	}

		private List<AnalyzeNodePathItem> FindNodePath(string node, string endNode, Dictionary<string, bool> usedNodes)
		{
			if (node == endNode)
			{
				return new List<AnalyzeNodePathItem>();
			}
			if (!NodeToNodeMoveDict.TryGetValue(node, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, AnalyzeNodePathItem> item in value)
			{
				if (!usedNodes.ContainsKey(item.Key))
				{
					usedNodes.Add(item.Key, value: true);
					List<AnalyzeNodePathItem> list = FindNodePath(item.Key, endNode, usedNodes);
					usedNodes.Remove(item.Key);
					if (list != null)
					{
						list.Insert(0, item.Value);
						return list;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

	public class AnalyzeOperator : CriteriaOperator
	{
		private CriteriaOperator original;

		private Dictionary<AnalyzeInfoKey, object> analyzeInfo;

		public CriteriaOperator Original => original;

		public Dictionary<AnalyzeInfoKey, object> AnalyzeInfo => analyzeInfo;

		public AnalyzeOperator(CriteriaOperator original)
			: this(original, new Dictionary<AnalyzeInfoKey, object>())
		{
		}

		public AnalyzeOperator(CriteriaOperator original, Dictionary<AnalyzeInfoKey, object> analyzeInfo)
		{
			this.original = original;
			this.analyzeInfo = analyzeInfo;
		}

		public override void Accept(ICriteriaVisitor visitor)
		{
			original.Accept(visitor);
		}

		public override T Accept<T>(ICriteriaVisitor<T> visitor)
		{
			if (visitor is IAnalyzeCriteriaVisitor<T> analyzeCriteriaVisitor)

				layer.SetDataLayerWideData(staticCacheKey, dictionary);

			if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(info, out var value))
			{
				value = new StrongObjectMap();
				dictionary.Add(info, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

			return nestedCommandChannel.Do(command, args);
		}

		}

	internal class QueryableExpressionEvaluatorCore : ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase, IQueryCriteriaVisitor<object>, ICriteriaVisitor<object>

		private class InOperatorCacheItem
		{
			public readonly Dictionary<object, bool> Dictionary;

			public readonly bool HasNullValue;

			public readonly bool IsNonDeterministic;

			public InOperatorCacheItem(Dictionary<object, bool> dictionary, bool hasNullValue)
			{
				Dictionary = dictionary;
				HasNullValue = hasNullValue;
			}

			public InOperatorCacheItem()
			{
				IsNonDeterministic = true;
			}

			public bool Contains(object value)
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					return HasNullValue;
				}
				return Dictionary.ContainsKey(value);
			}
		}

		private class InOperatorCacheItemComparer : IEqualityComparer<object>
		{
			public readonly bool CaseSensitive;

			{
				IsEqualityComparer = isEqulityComparer;
				CaseSensitive = caseSensitive;
				CustomComparer = customComparer;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<object>.Equals(object x, object y)
			{
				return EvalHelpers.CompareObjects(x, y, IsEqualityComparer, CaseSensitive, CustomComparer) == 0;
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<object>.GetHashCode(object obj)
			{
				return obj.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		private QueryableEvaluatorContext defaultContext;

		private Dictionary<CriteriaOperator, InOperatorCacheItem> inOperatorOptimizer;

		protected override bool Is3ValuedLogic => true;

		protected sealed override bool HasContext => defaultContext != null;

		public QueryableExpressionEvaluatorCore(bool caseSensitive)
			: base(caseSensitive, (EvaluateCustomFunctionHandler)null)

			: base(caseSensitive, evaluateCustomFunction, customAggregateResolveHandler)
		{
		}

		public virtual object Visit(QuerySubQueryContainer theOperand)
		{
			//IL_00a2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a8: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00ac: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			QuereableEvaluatorContextDescriptor quereableEvaluatorContextDescriptor = (QuereableEvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)((EvaluatorContext)defaultContext).Descriptor;
			object obj = ((EvaluatorContext)defaultContext).Source;
			quereableEvaluatorContextDescriptor.PushNestedSource(obj);
			try
			{
				if (theOperand.Node != null)
				{
					obj = quereableEvaluatorContextDescriptor.GetQueryResult((JoinNode)(object)theOperand.Node);
				}
				List<QueryableEvaluatorContext> list = new List<QueryableEvaluatorContext>();
				if (!(obj is IEnumerable enumerable))
				{
					list.Add(new QueryableEvaluatorContext((EvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)quereableEvaluatorContextDescriptor, obj));
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (object item in enumerable)
					{
						list.Add(new QueryableEvaluatorContext((EvaluatorContextDescriptor)(object)quereableEvaluatorContextDescriptor, item));
					}
				}
				QueryableEvaluatorContext queryableEvaluatorContext = defaultContext;
				try
				{
					if ((int)theOperand.AggregateType != 7)
					{
						return ((ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase)this).DoAggregate(theOperand.AggregateType, (IEnumerable)list, (CriteriaOperator)null, theOperand.AggregateProperty);
					}
					return ((ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase)this).DoCustomAggregate(theOperand.CustomAggregateName, (IEnumerable)list, (CriteriaOperator)null, theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands);
				}
				finally
				{
					defaultContext = queryableEvaluatorContext;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				quereableEvaluatorContextDescriptor.PopNestedSource();
			}
		}

		public override object Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			object obj = ((ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase)this).Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			if (((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands).Count > 3)
			{
				if (inOperatorOptimizer == null)
				{
					inOperatorOptimizer = new Dictionary<CriteriaOperator, InOperatorCacheItem>(CriteriaOperatorReferenceComparer.Instance);
				}
				if (!inOperatorOptimizer.TryGetValue((CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperator, out var value))
				{
					bool hasNullValue = false;
					bool flag = false;
					Dictionary<object, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, bool>(new InOperatorCacheItemComparer(isEqulityComparer: true, ((ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase)this).CaseSensitive, ((ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase)this).CustomComparer));
					foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
					{
						if (!(item is OperandValue))
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
						object obj2 = ((ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase)this).Process(item);
						if (obj2 == null)
						{
							hasNullValue = true;
						}
						else
						{
							dictionary[obj2] = true;
						}
					}
					value = (flag ? new InOperatorCacheItem() : new InOperatorCacheItem(dictionary, hasNullValue));
					inOperatorOptimizer.Add((CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperator, value);
				}
				if (!value.IsNonDeterministic)
				{
					return ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase.BoxBool(value.Contains(obj));
				}
			}
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item2 in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
			{
				if (EvalHelpers.CompareObjects(obj, ((ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase)this).Process(item2), true, ((ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase)this).CaseSensitive, ((ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase)this).CustomComparer) == 0)
				{
					return ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase.BoxBool(true);
				}
			}
			return ExpressionEvaluatorCoreBase.BoxBool(false);
		}

		public virtual object Visit(QueryOperand theOperand)
		{
			return defaultContext.GetOperandValue(theOperand);
		}

	public class MergeXmlSerializationHelper
	{
		private class ObjListHelper : ArrayList
		{
			private readonly XPClassInfo ClassInfo;

			public ObjListHelper(XPClassInfo ci, ICollection source)
				: base(source)
			{
				ClassInfo = ci;
			}

			public int FindObjectIndexByKey(object key)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					object value = ClassInfo.KeyProperty.GetValue(this[i]);
					if (object.Equals(key, value))
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
				return -1;
			}
		}

		public static object MergeChanges(UnitOfWork mergeDestination, XPClassInfo classInfo, object originalObject, object changedObject)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (originalObject == null && changedObject == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (changedObject == null)
			{
				object objectByKey = mergeDestination.GetObjectByKey(classInfo, classInfo.KeyProperty.GetValue(changedObject));
				if (objectByKey == null)
				{
					throw new LockingException();
				}
				mergeDestination.Delete(objectByKey);
				return null;
			}
			if (originalObject == null)
			{
				object mergeObject = classInfo.CreateNewObject(mergeDestination);
				return UpdateObject(mergeDestination, classInfo, mergeObject, null, changedObject);
			}
			object objectByKey2 = mergeDestination.GetObjectByKey(classInfo, classInfo.KeyProperty.GetValue(changedObject));
			object objectByKey3 = mergeDestination.GetObjectByKey(classInfo, classInfo.KeyProperty.GetValue(originalObject));
			if (objectByKey2 != objectByKey3)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Helpers_DifferentObjectsKeys"));
			}
			if (objectByKey2 == null)
			{
				throw new LockingException();
			}
			return UpdateObject(mergeDestination, classInfo, objectByKey2, originalObject, changedObject);
		}

		private static object UpdateObject(UnitOfWork mergeDestination, XPClassInfo ci, object mergeObject, object originalObject, object changedObject)
		{
			//IL_0139: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (XPMemberInfo collectionProperty in ci.CollectionProperties)
			{
				XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)collectionProperty.GetValue(originalObject);
				if (xPBaseCollection != null)
				{
					XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection2 = (XPBaseCollection)collectionProperty.GetValue(changedObject);
					if (!xPBaseCollection.LoadingEnabled || !xPBaseCollection2.LoadingEnabled)
					{
						MergeChanges(mergeDestination, collectionProperty.CollectionElementType, xPBaseCollection, xPBaseCollection2);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo member in ci.Members)
			{
				if ((!member.IsPersistent && !member.IsAliased) || member.IsReadOnly || member.IsFetchOnly)
				{
					continue;
				}
				object value = member.GetValue(originalObject);
				object value2 = member.GetValue(changedObject);
				if (member.ReferenceType != null)
				{
					object obj = MergeChanges(mergeDestination, member.ReferenceType, value, value2);
					if (obj != member.GetValue(mergeObject))
					{
						member.SetValue(mergeObject, obj);
						mergeDestination.Save(mergeObject);
					}
				}
				else if (!object.Equals(value, value2))
				{
					if (!object.Equals(value, member.GetValue(mergeObject)) && !object.Equals(value2, member.GetValue(mergeObject)))
					{
						throw new LockingException();
					}
					member.SetValue(mergeObject, value2);
					mergeDestination.Save(mergeObject);
				}
			}
			return mergeObject;
		}

		public static void MergeChanges(UnitOfWork mergeDestination, XPClassInfo classInfo, ICollection originalImages, ICollection changedImages)
		{
			ObjListHelper objListHelper = new ObjListHelper(classInfo, originalImages);
			ObjListHelper objListHelper2 = new ObjListHelper(classInfo, changedImages);
			while (objListHelper.Count > 0)
			{
				object obj = objListHelper[0];
				int num = objListHelper2.FindObjectIndexByKey(classInfo.KeyProperty.GetValue(obj));
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					object changedObject = objListHelper2[num];
					MergeChanges(mergeDestination, classInfo, obj, changedObject);
					objListHelper.RemoveAt(0);
					objListHelper2.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					MergeChanges(mergeDestination, classInfo, obj, null);
					objListHelper.RemoveAt(0);
				}
			}
			foreach (object item in objListHelper2)
			{
				MergeChanges(mergeDestination, classInfo, null, item);
			}
		}

		public static object MergeChanges(UnitOfWork mergeDestination, Type objType, object originalObject, object changedObject)
		{
			return MergeChanges(mergeDestination, mergeDestination.GetClassInfo(objType), originalObject, changedObject);
		}

		public static void MergeChanges(UnitOfWork mergeDestination, Type objType, ICollection originalImages, ICollection changedImages)
		{
			MergeChanges(mergeDestination, mergeDestination.GetClassInfo(objType), originalImages, changedImages);
		}
	}
	public sealed class ClonerHelper
	{
		private readonly IDictionary Mapping = new ObjectDictionary<object>();

		private readonly Session Src;

		private readonly Session Dst;

		private ClonerHelper(Session src, Session dst)
		{
			if (src.Dictionary != dst.Dictionary)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Helpers_SameDictionaryExpected"));
			}
			Src = src;
			Dst = dst;
		}

		private object Clone(object proto)
		{
			object obj = Mapping[proto];
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return obj;
			}
			XPClassInfo classInfo = Src.GetClassInfo(proto);
			obj = classInfo.CreateNewObject(Dst);
			Mapping.Add(proto, obj);
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
			{
				object obj2 = persistentProperty.GetValue(proto);
				if (obj2 != null)
				{
					if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType != null)
					{
						obj2 = Clone(obj2);
					}
					else if (obj2 is ICloneable cloneable)
					{
						obj2 = cloneable.Clone();
					}
				}
				persistentProperty.SetValue(obj, obj2);
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo associationListProperty in classInfo.AssociationListProperties)
			{
				IList list = (IList)associationListProperty.GetValue(proto);
				IList list2 = (IList)associationListProperty.GetValue(obj);
				foreach (object item in list)
				{
					list2.Add(Clone(item));
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public static object Clone(Session sourceSession, object sourceObject, Session destinationSession)
		{
			return new ClonerHelper(sourceSession, destinationSession).Clone(sourceObject);
		}

		public static object Clone(IXPSimpleObject sourceObject, Session destinationSession)
		{
			return Clone(sourceObject.Session, sourceObject, destinationSession);
		}

		public static IDictionary Clone(Session sourceSession, Session destinationSession, params ICollection[] prototypes)
		{
			ClonerHelper clonerHelper = new ClonerHelper(sourceSession, destinationSession);
			foreach (ICollection collection in prototypes)
			{
				foreach (object item in collection)
				{
					clonerHelper.Clone(item);
				}
			}
			return clonerHelper.Mapping;
		}

		public static IDictionary Clone(Session sourceSession, Session destinationSession, params XPClassInfo[] prototypes)
		{
			ClonerHelper clonerHelper = new ClonerHelper(sourceSession, destinationSession);
			foreach (XPClassInfo objType in prototypes)
			{
				foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)new XPCollection(sourceSession, objType))
				{
					clonerHelper.Clone(item);
				}
			}
			return clonerHelper.Mapping;
		}

		public static IDictionary Clone(Session sourceSession, Session destinationSession, params Type[] prototypes)
		{
			ClonerHelper clonerHelper = new ClonerHelper(sourceSession, destinationSession);
			foreach (Type objType in prototypes)
			{
				foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)new XPCollection(sourceSession, objType))
				{
					clonerHelper.Clone(item);
				}
			}
			return clonerHelper.Mapping;
		}
	}
	public class CollectionClonerHelper
	{
		private CollectionClonerHelper()
		{
		}

		public static XPBaseCollection Clone(XPBaseCollection source, Session destination)
		{
			XPClassInfo objectClassInfo = source.GetObjectClassInfo();
			XPClassInfo classInfo = destination.GetClassInfo(objectClassInfo.AssemblyName, objectClassInfo.FullName);
			XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = new XPCollection(destination, classInfo, loadingEnabled: false);
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)source)
			{
				xPBaseCollection.BaseAdd(Clone(source.Session, item, destination));
			}
			return xPBaseCollection;
		}

		public static object Clone(Session srcSession, object obj, Session dstSession)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (srcSession.IsNewObject(obj) || srcSession.IsObjectToSave(obj, includeParent: true) || srcSession.IsObjectToDelete(obj, includeParent: true))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Helpers_CloningObjectModified"));
			}
			XPClassInfo classInfo = srcSession.GetClassInfo(obj);
			XPClassInfo classInfo2 = dstSession.GetClassInfo(classInfo.AssemblyName, classInfo.FullName);
			object keyValue = srcSession.GetKeyValue(obj);
			object loadedObjectByKey = dstSession.GetLoadedObjectByKey(classInfo2, keyValue);
			if (loadedObjectByKey != null)
			{
				return loadedObjectByKey;
			}
			loadedObjectByKey = classInfo2.CreateObject(dstSession);
			SessionIdentityMap.RegisterObject(dstSession, loadedObjectByKey, keyValue);
			IXPObject iXPObject = loadedObjectByKey as IXPObject;
			iXPObject?.OnLoading();
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
			{
				object obj2 = persistentProperty.GetValue(obj);
				if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType != null)
				{
					obj2 = Clone(srcSession, obj2, dstSession);
				}
				else if (obj2 is ICloneable cloneable)
				{
					obj2 = cloneable.Clone();
				}
				XPMemberInfo member = classInfo2.GetMember(persistentProperty.Name);
				member.SetValue(loadedObjectByKey, obj2);
			}
			iXPObject?.OnLoaded();
			return loadedObjectByKey;
		}
	}

	internal class GetObjectsHelper
	{
		public static ICollection GetObjectsFromData(Session session, XPClassInfo classInfo, List<XPMemberInfo> memberInfos, LoadDataMemberOrderItem[] membersOrder, SelectedData sprocResultData, Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, int> referenceIndexDict)
		{
			List<object>[] referenceKeyList;
			List<object> primaryObjects;
			ICollection objectsFromDataCore = GetObjectsFromDataCore(session, classInfo, memberInfos, membersOrder, sprocResultData, referenceIndexDict, out referenceKeyList, out primaryObjects);
			if (primaryObjects != null && primaryObjects.Count > 0)
			{
				ObjectsByKeyQuery[] queries = BeginLoadReferenceObjects(referenceIndexDict, referenceKeyList);
				ICollection[] objectsByKey = session.GetObjectsByKey(queries, alwaysGetFromDataStore: false);
				EndLoadReferenceObjects(referenceIndexDict, objectsByKey, primaryObjects);
			}
			session.TriggerObjectsLoaded(objectsFromDataCore);
			return objectsFromDataCore;
		}

		public static async Task<ICollection> GetObjectsFromDataAsync(Session session, XPClassInfo classInfo, List<XPMemberInfo> memberInfos, LoadDataMemberOrderItem[] membersOrder, SelectedData sprocResultData, Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, int> referenceIndexDict, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			List<object>[] referenceKeyList;
			List<object> primaryObjects;
			ICollection result = GetObjectsFromDataCore(session, classInfo, memberInfos, membersOrder, sprocResultData, referenceIndexDict, out referenceKeyList, out primaryObjects);
			if (primaryObjects != null && primaryObjects.Count > 0)
			{
				ObjectsByKeyQuery[] queries = BeginLoadReferenceObjects(referenceIndexDict, referenceKeyList);
				EndLoadReferenceObjects(referenceIndexDict, await session.GetObjectsByKeyAsync(queries, alwaysGetFromDataStore: false, cancellationToken), primaryObjects);
			}
			session.TriggerObjectsLoaded(result);
			return result;
		}

		private static ICollection GetObjectsFromDataCore(Session session, XPClassInfo classInfo, List<XPMemberInfo> memberInfos, LoadDataMemberOrderItem[] membersOrder, SelectedData sprocResultData, Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, int> referenceIndexDict, out List<object>[] referenceKeyList, out List<object> primaryObjects)
		{
			referenceKeyList = null;
			primaryObjects = null;
			if (classInfo.IsPersistent)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Res.GetString("MetaData_PersistentReferenceFound", classInfo.FullName), "classInfo");
			}
			if (sprocResultData == null || sprocResultData.ResultSet == null || sprocResultData.ResultSet.Length == 0)
			{
				return new object[0];
			}
			SelectStatementResult val = sprocResultData.ResultSet[0];
			if (val == null || val.Rows == null || val.Rows.Length == 0)
			{
				return new object[0];
			}
			referenceKeyList = ((referenceIndexDict == null) ? null : new List<object>[referenceIndexDict.Count]);
			primaryObjects = ((referenceIndexDict == null) ? null : new List<object>());
			SelectStatementResultRow[] rows = val.Rows;
			object[] array = new object[rows.Length];
			if (referenceIndexDict != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < referenceKeyList.Length; i++)
				{
					referenceKeyList[i] = new List<object>();
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < rows.Length; j++)
			{
				SelectStatementResultRow val2 = rows[j];
				object obj = classInfo.CreateNewObject(session);
				if (memberInfos != null)
				{
					bool flag = true;
					object[] array2 = ((referenceIndexDict == null) ? null : new object[referenceIndexDict.Count]);
					if (membersOrder == null && memberInfos.Count != val2.Values.Length)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("DirectSQL_WrongColumnCount"));
					}
					int count = memberInfos.Count;
					for (int k = 0; k < count; k++)
					{
						XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = memberInfos[k];
						object obj2 = val2.Values[membersOrder?[k].IndexInResultSet ?? k];
						if (xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType != null)
						{
							if (referenceIndexDict == null)
							{
								throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_InternalXPOError"));
							}
							if (obj2 != null && !(obj2 is DBNull))
							{
								flag = false;
								array2[referenceIndexDict[xPMemberInfo]] = obj2;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (obj2 is DBNull)
							{
								obj2 = null;
							}
							if (xPMemberInfo.Converter == null)
							{
								obj2 = ChangeDbTypeToMemberType(obj2, xPMemberInfo.MemberType);
							}
							xPMemberInfo.SetValue(obj, (xPMemberInfo.Converter == null) ? obj2 : xPMemberInfo.Converter.ConvertFromStorageType(obj2));
						}
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						primaryObjects.Add(obj);
						for (int l = 0; l < referenceKeyList.Length; l++)
						{
							referenceKeyList[l].Add(array2[l]);
						}
					}
				}
				array[j] = obj;
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static ObjectsByKeyQuery[] BeginLoadReferenceObjects(Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, int> referenceIndexDict, List<object>[] referenceKeyList)
		{
			ObjectsByKeyQuery[] array = new ObjectsByKeyQuery[referenceIndexDict.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<XPMemberInfo, int> item in referenceIndexDict)
			{
				array[num++] = new ObjectsByKeyQuery(item.Key.ReferenceType, referenceKeyList[item.Value]);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static void EndLoadReferenceObjects(Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, int> referenceIndexDict, ICollection[] referenceObjects, List<object> primaryObjects)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<XPMemberInfo, int> item in referenceIndexDict)
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (object item2 in referenceObjects[item.Value])
				{
					item.Key.SetValue(primaryObjects[num++], item2);
				}
			}
		}

		public static object ChangeDbTypeToMemberType(object value, Type memberType)
		{
			if (value == null || value == DBNull.Value)
			{
				return value;
			}
			Type type = value.GetType();
			if (type == memberType)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (memberType.IsGenericType && memberType.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(Nullable<>))
			{
				memberType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(memberType);
			}
			if (memberType == typeof(Guid))
			{
				return (value is byte[]) ? new Guid((byte[])value) : new Guid(value.ToString());
			}
			try
			{
				return Convert.ChangeType(value, memberType);
			}
			catch (InvalidCastException)
			{
				return value;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ClassMetadataHelper
	{
		internal abstract class ItemProperties
		{
			public IDictionary dispMembers;

			public XPPropertyDescriptorCollection displayProps;

			public readonly IXPClassInfoAndSessionProvider Context;

			public abstract string GetDisplayableProperties();

			public ItemProperties(IXPClassInfoAndSessionProvider context)
			{
				Context = context;
			}
		}

		internal static PropertyDescriptorCollection GetItemProperties(ItemProperties props, PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			XPClassInfo memberType = GetMemberType(props.Context, listAccessors);
			if (memberType != null)
			{
				if (props.Context.Session.IsDesignMode && listAccessors.Length > 64)
				{
					return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(new PropertyDescriptor[0]);
				}
				return GetDescriptorCollection(props, GetMember(props.Context, listAccessors[listAccessors.Length - 1]), memberType);
			}
			if ((listAccessors != null && listAccessors.Length != 0) || props.Context.ClassInfo == null)
			{
				return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(new PropertyDescriptor[0]);
			}
			if (props.displayProps == null)
			{
				props.displayProps = new XPPropertyDescriptorCollection(props.Context.Session, props.Context.ClassInfo, new PropertyDescriptor[0]);
				string[] array = props.GetDisplayableProperties().Split(';');
				foreach (string text in array)
				{
					if (text.Length != 0)
					{
						props.displayProps.FindCaseSmart(text);
					}
				}
			}
			return props.displayProps;
		}

		private static XPPropertyDescriptorCollection GetDescriptorCollection(ItemProperties props, XPMemberInfo mem, XPClassInfo info)
		{
			if (props.dispMembers == null)
			{
				props.dispMembers = new Dictionary<object, object>();
			}
			XPPropertyDescriptorCollection xPPropertyDescriptorCollection = (XPPropertyDescriptorCollection)props.dispMembers[mem];
			if (xPPropertyDescriptorCollection == null)
			{
				xPPropertyDescriptorCollection = new XPPropertyDescriptorCollection(props.Context.Session, info, new PropertyDescriptor[0]);
				string text = ((mem.IsCollection && !mem.IsManyToMany) ? mem.GetAssociatedMember().Name : string.Empty);
				StringCollection defaultDisplayableProperties = GetDefaultDisplayableProperties(info);
				StringEnumerator enumerator = defaultDisplayableProperties.GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						string current = enumerator.Current;
						if (current.Length != 0 && text != current)
						{
							xPPropertyDescriptorCollection.FindCaseSmart(current);
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
				props.dispMembers[mem] = xPPropertyDescriptorCollection;
			}
			return xPPropertyDescriptorCollection;
		}

		private static XPMemberInfo GetMember(IXPDictionaryProvider dictionary, PropertyDescriptor prop)
		{
			if (!(prop is XPPropertyDescriptor xPPropertyDescriptor))
			{
				string memberName = XPPropertyDescriptorBase.GetMemberName(prop.Name);
				return MemberInfoCollection.FindMember(dictionary.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(prop.ComponentType), memberName);
			}
			return xPPropertyDescriptor.MemberInfo;
		}

		private static XPClassInfo GetMemberType(IXPDictionaryProvider dictionary, PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			if (listAccessors != null && listAccessors.Length != 0 && typeof(XPBaseCollection).IsAssignableFrom(listAccessors[listAccessors.Length - 1].PropertyType))
			{
				XPMemberInfo member = GetMember(dictionary, listAccessors[listAccessors.Length - 1]);
				if (member.IsAssociationList || member.IsNonAssociationList)
				{
					return member.CollectionElementType;
				}
				return member.ReferenceType;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static string GetListName(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			if (listAccessors == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringCollection stringCollection = new StringCollection();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor in listAccessors)
			{
				stringCollection.Add(propertyDescriptor.Name);
			}
			return StringListHelper.DelimitedText(stringCollection, ".");
		}

		private static bool IsGoodDefaultProperty(XPMemberInfo mi)
		{
			MemberDesignTimeVisibilityAttribute memberDesignTimeVisibilityAttribute = (MemberDesignTimeVisibilityAttribute)mi.FindAttributeInfo(typeof(MemberDesignTimeVisibilityAttribute));
			if (memberDesignTimeVisibilityAttribute != null && memberDesignTimeVisibilityAttribute.IsVisible)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!mi.IsPublic)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (typeof(IBindingList).IsAssignableFrom(mi.MemberType) && !mi.IsCollection)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (mi.MemberType != null && mi.MemberType.IsArray)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!mi.IsVisibleInDesignTime)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (mi is ServiceField)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static StringCollection GetDefaultDisplayableProperties(XPClassInfo objectInfo)
		{
			if (objectInfo == null)
			{
				return new StringCollection();
			}
			StringCollection stringCollection = new StringCollection();
			foreach (XPMemberInfo member in objectInfo.Members)
			{
				if (IsGoodDefaultProperty(member))
				{
					if (member.ReferenceType != null && member.ReferenceType.IdClass != null)
					{
						stringCollection.Add(member.Name + "!");
						stringCollection.Add(member.Name + "!Key");
					}
					stringCollection.Add(member.Name);
				}
			}
			return stringCollection;
		}
	}

		}

	public class CriteriaToDifferentSession : ClientCriteriaVisitorBase
	{
		protected readonly Session Session;

		protected override CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!(theOperand.Value is IXPSimpleObject iXPSimpleObject))
			{
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
			}
			object objectByKey = Session.GetObjectByKey(iXPSimpleObject.ClassInfo, iXPSimpleObject.Session.GetKeyValue(iXPSimpleObject));
			if (theOperand is ConstantValue)
			{
				return (CriteriaOperator)new ConstantValue(objectByKey);
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue(objectByKey);
		}

		private CriteriaToDifferentSession(Session target)
		{
			Session = target;
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator Rebase(Session targetSession, CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			return ((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)new CriteriaToDifferentSession(targetSession)).Process(criteria);
		}
	}

	public abstract class BaseListMorpher<I, T> : IList<I>, ICollection<I>, IEnumerable<I>, IEnumerable, IList, ICollection
	{
		public readonly IList<T> Morphed;

		public I this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return DownCast(Morphed[index]);
			}
			set
			{
				Morphed[index] = UpCast(value);
			}
		}

		public int Count => Morphed.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => Morphed.IsReadOnly;

		bool IList.IsFixedSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (Morphed is IList list)
				{
					return list.IsFixedSize;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => IsReadOnly;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[index];
			}
			set
			{
				this[index] = (I)value;
			}
		}

		int ICollection.Count => Count;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized
		{
			get
			{
				if (Morphed is ICollection collection)
				{
					return collection.IsSynchronized;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		object ICollection.SyncRoot
		{
			get
			{
				if (Morphed is ICollection collection)
				{
					return collection.SyncRoot;
				}
				return Morphed;
			}
		}

		protected abstract I DownCast(T value);

		protected abstract T UpCast(I value);

		protected BaseListMorpher(IList<T> morphed)
		{
			Morphed = morphed;
		}

		public int IndexOf(I item)
		{
			return Morphed.IndexOf(UpCast(item));
		}

		public void Insert(int index, I item)
		{
			Morphed.Insert(index, UpCast(item));
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			Morphed.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		public void Add(I item)
		{
			Morphed.Add(UpCast(item));
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			Morphed.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(I item)
		{
			return Morphed.Contains(UpCast(item));
		}

		public void CopyTo(I[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				array[i + arrayIndex] = this[i];
			}
		}

		public bool Remove(I item)
		{
			return Morphed.Remove(UpCast(item));
		}

		public IEnumerator<I> GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (T item in Morphed)
			{
				yield return DownCast(item);
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			if (Morphed is IList list)
			{
				return list.Add(UpCast((I)value));
			}
			int count = Count;
			Add((I)value);
			return count;
		}

		void IList.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains((I)value);
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			return IndexOf((I)value);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			Insert(index, (I)value);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			Remove((I)value);
		}

		void IList.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveAt(index);
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				array.SetValue(this[i], i + index);
			}
		}
	}

	public static class PersistentInterfaceTypedHelper
	{
		private abstract class ExtractorBase
		{
			public abstract object GetData(object interfaceObject);

			public abstract object GetInterface(object dataObject);
		}

		private class Extractor<T> : ExtractorBase
		{
			public override object GetData(object interfaceObject)
			{
				if (!(interfaceObject is IPersistentInterface<T> persistentInterface))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return persistentInterface.PersistentInterfaceData;
			}

			public override object GetInterface(object dataObject)
			{
				if (!(dataObject is IPersistentInterfaceData<T> persistentInterfaceData))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return persistentInterfaceData.Instance;
			}
		}

		private static readonly Dictionary<Type, ExtractorBase> cache = new Dictionary<Type, ExtractorBase>();

		public static object ExtractDataObject(Type interfaceType, object interfaceObject)
		{
			return GetExtractor(interfaceType).GetData(interfaceObject);
		}

		public static object ExtractInterfaceObject(Type interfaceType, object dataObject)
		{
			return GetExtractor(interfaceType).GetInterface(dataObject);
		}

		private static ExtractorBase GetExtractor(Type t)
		{
			lock (cache)
			{
				if (!cache.TryGetValue(t, out var value))
				{
					value = (ExtractorBase)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(Extractor<>).MakeGenericType(t));
					cache.Add(t, value);
				}
				return value;
			}
		}
	}

	public static class CannotLoadObjectsHelper
	{
		public class Results
		{
			public readonly Tuple<XPClassInfo, XPMemberInfo, Tuple<object, object>[]>[] OrphanedReferences;

			public Results(Tuple<XPClassInfo, XPMemberInfo, Tuple<object, object>[]>[] orphanedReferences)
			{
				OrphanedReferences = orphanedReferences;
			}
		}

		public static Results Analize(Session session)
		{
			session.TypesManager.EnsureIsTypedObjectValid();
			XPClassInfo[] source = (from XPClassInfo ci in session.Dictionary.Classes
				where ci.IsPersistent
				select ci).ToArray();
			Tuple<XPClassInfo, XPMemberInfo>[] references = source.SelectMany((XPClassInfo ci) => from XPMemberInfo mi in ci.PersistentProperties
				where mi.IsPersistent && mi.ReferenceType != null && mi.GetMappingClass(ci) == ci
				select Tuple.Create(ci, mi)).ToArray();
			return new Results(CollectOrphanedReferences(session, references));
		}

		private static Tuple<object, object>[] CollectOrphanedReferences(Session session, Tuple<XPClassInfo, XPMemberInfo> reference)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0058: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0085: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0085: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0096: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0096: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_009f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			XPClassInfo item = reference.Item1;
			XPMemberInfo item2 = reference.Item2;
			CriteriaOperator criteria = (CriteriaOperator)(object)((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(item2.Name)).IsNotNull() & (CriteriaOperator)(object)((CriteriaOperator)new JoinOperand(item2.ReferenceType.FullName, (CriteriaOperator)(object)((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(item2.ReferenceType.KeyProperty.Name) == (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty("^." + item2.Name)))).Not();
			CriteriaOperatorCollection val = new CriteriaOperatorCollection();
			((List<CriteriaOperator>)val).Add((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(item.KeyProperty.Name));
			((List<CriteriaOperator>)val).Add((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(item2.Name));
			List<object[]> source = session.SelectData(item, val, criteria, selectDeleted: true, 0, null);
			return source.Select((object[] oa) => Tuple.Create(oa[0], oa[1])).ToArray();
		}

		private static Tuple<XPClassInfo, XPMemberInfo, Tuple<object, object>[]>[] CollectOrphanedReferences(Session session, IEnumerable<Tuple<XPClassInfo, XPMemberInfo>> references)
		{
			List<Tuple<XPClassInfo, XPMemberInfo, Tuple<object, object>[]>> list = new List<Tuple<XPClassInfo, XPMemberInfo, Tuple<object, object>[]>>();
			foreach (Tuple<XPClassInfo, XPMemberInfo> reference in references)
			{
				Tuple<object, object>[] array = CollectOrphanedReferences(session, reference);
				if (array.Length != 0)
				{
					list.Add(Tuple.Create(reference.Item1, reference.Item2, array));
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}
	public class InTransactionLoader : IPersistentValueExtractor
	{
		private enum InTransactionState
		{
			AnalyzeAndExecQuery,
			AfterAnalyzeQueryDirectGetObjects,
			AfterAnalyzeQueryNullCriteria,
			GetOriginalObjects,
			AfterGetOriginalObjectsThroughCollection,
			ReturnResult,
			SelectDataPostProcessing,
			SelectDataReturnResult
		}

		[Flags]
		private enum InTransactionMode
		{
			Sync = 1,
			Async = 2,
			SelectData = 4
		}

		public class GroupByObjectsDescriptor : CriteriaCompilerDescriptor
		{
			private readonly CriteriaCompilerDescriptor ObjectDescriptor;

			private CriteriaCompilerDescriptor _TopLevelDescriptor;

			private CriteriaCompilerDescriptor TopLevelDescriptor
			{
				get
				{
					//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0019: Expected O, but got Unknown
					if (_TopLevelDescriptor == null)
					{
						_TopLevelDescriptor = (CriteriaCompilerDescriptor)new DefaultTopLevelCriteriaCompilerContextDescriptor(ObjectDescriptor);
					}
					return _TopLevelDescriptor;
				}
			}

			public override Type ObjectType => typeof(IEnumerable);

			public static T GetSingleObject<T>(IEnumerable enumerable) where T : class
			{
				if (enumerable == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (enumerable is ICollection collection)
				{
					if (collection.Count == 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (enumerable is IList list)
					{
						return (T)list[0];
					}
				}
				IEnumerator enumerator = enumerable.GetEnumerator();
				if (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					return (T)enumerator.Current;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public GroupByObjectsDescriptor(CriteriaCompilerDescriptor _ObjectDescriptor)
			{
				ObjectDescriptor = _ObjectDescriptor;
			}

			public override Expression MakePropertyAccess(Expression baseExpression, string propertyPath)
			{
				ParameterExpression parameterExpression = Expression.Parameter(ObjectDescriptor.ObjectType, "row");
				Expression expression = ObjectDescriptor.MakePropertyAccess((Expression)parameterExpression, propertyPath);
				if (!NullableHelpers.CanAcceptNull(expression.Type))
				{
					expression = Expression.Convert(expression, NullableHelpers.GetUnBoxedType(expression.Type));
				}
				Expression body = Expression.Condition(Expression.Call(typeof(object), "ReferenceEquals", null, parameterExpression, Expression.Constant(null)), Expression.Constant(null, expression.Type), expression);
				LambdaExpression expression2 = Expression.Lambda(body, parameterExpression);
				MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = Expression.Call(typeof(GroupByObjectsDescriptor), "GetSingleObject", new Type[1] { ObjectDescriptor.ObjectType }, baseExpression);
				return Expression.Invoke(expression2, methodCallExpression);
			}

			public override CriteriaCompilerRefResult DiveIntoCollectionProperty(Expression baseExpression, string collectionPropertyPath)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(collectionPropertyPath))
				{
					return TopLevelDescriptor.DiveIntoCollectionProperty(baseExpression, collectionPropertyPath);
				}
				MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = Expression.Call(typeof(GroupByObjectsDescriptor), "GetSingleObject", new Type[1] { ObjectDescriptor.ObjectType }, baseExpression);
				return ObjectDescriptor.DiveIntoCollectionProperty((Expression)methodCallExpression, collectionPropertyPath);
			}

			public override LambdaExpression MakeFreeJoinLambda(string joinTypeName, CriteriaOperator condition, OperandParameter[] conditionParameters, Aggregate aggregateType, CriteriaOperator aggregateExpression, OperandParameter[] aggregateExpresssionParameters, Type[] invokeTypes)
			{
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return ObjectDescriptor.MakeFreeJoinLambda(joinTypeName, condition, conditionParameters, aggregateType, aggregateExpression, aggregateExpresssionParameters, invokeTypes);
			}

			public override LambdaExpression MakeFreeJoinLambda(string joinTypeName, CriteriaOperator condition, OperandParameter[] conditionParameters, string customAggregateName, IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator> aggregateExpressions, OperandParameter[] aggregateExpresssionsParameters, Type[] invokeTypes)
			{
				return ObjectDescriptor.MakeFreeJoinLambda(joinTypeName, condition, conditionParameters, customAggregateName, aggregateExpressions, aggregateExpresssionsParameters, invokeTypes);
			}
		}

		private class SelectDataGroup
		{
			public readonly object[] GroupValues;

			public SelectDataGroup(object[] groupValues)
			{
				GroupValues = groupValues;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (!(obj is SelectDataGroup selectDataGroup))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (GroupValues.Length != selectDataGroup.GroupValues.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num = GroupValues.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					if (!object.Equals(GroupValues[i], selectDataGroup.GroupValues[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGenericList<object>((IList<object>)GroupValues);
			}
		}

		private class SelectDataComparerWrapper : IComparer<object>
		{
			private IComparer comparer;

			public SelectDataComparerWrapper(IComparer comparer)
			{
				this.comparer = comparer;
			}

			public int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				return comparer.Compare(x, y);
			}
		}

		private class SelectDataSortingListComparer : IComparer<List<object>>
		{
			private readonly Func<object, object>[] Evaluators;

			private readonly SortingDirection[] SortingDirections;

			public SelectDataSortingListComparer(Func<object, object>[] sortingEvaluators, SortingDirection[] sortingDirections)
			{
				Evaluators = sortingEvaluators;
				SortingDirections = sortingDirections;
			}

			int IComparer<List<object>>.Compare(List<object> xRows, List<object> yRows)
			{
				if (xRows == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Internal error: xRows == null");
				}
				if (yRows == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Internal error: yRows == null");
				}
				int num = Evaluators.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					Func<object, object> func = Evaluators[i];
					int num2 = Comparer<object>.Default.Compare(func(xRows), func(yRows));
					if (num2 != 0)
					{
						if (SortingDirections[i])
						{
							return -num2;
						}
						return num2;
					}
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public ICollection[] GetObjects(ObjectsQuery[] queries)
		{
			currentMode = InTransactionMode.Sync;
			objectsToSave = session.GetObjectsToSave(includeParent: true);
			objectsToDelete = session.GetObjectsToDelete(includeParent: true);
			if (objectsToSave.Count == 0 && objectsToDelete.Count == 0)
			{
				return session.GetObjectsInternal(queries);
			}
			StateQuery(session.PrepareQueries(queries, doDetectPostProcessing: false, this), queries);
			Process();
			return loadObjectsState.Result;
		}

		public object GetObjectsAsync(ObjectsQuery[] queries, AsyncLoadObjectsCallback callback)
		{
			mainRequest = new VirtualAsyncRequest(AsyncOperationsHelper.CaptureSynchronizationContextOrFail());
			loadObjectsCallback = callback;
			currentMode = InTransactionMode.Async;
			objectsToSave = session.GetObjectsToSave(includeParent: true);
			objectsToDelete = session.GetObjectsToDelete(includeParent: true);
			if (objectsToSave.Count == 0 && objectsToDelete.Count == 0)
			{
				return session.GetObjectsInternalAsync(queries, callback);
			}
			StateQuery(session.PrepareQueries(queries, doDetectPostProcessing: false, this), queries);
			ProcessAsync();
			return mainRequest;
		}

		public Task<ICollection[]> GetObjectsAsync(ObjectsQuery[] queries, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			TaskCompletionSource<ICollection[]> tcs = new TaskCompletionSource<ICollection[]>();
			object ar = GetObjectsAsync(queries, delegate(ICollection[] result, Exception ex)
			{
				if (ex == null)
				{
					tcs.TrySetResult(result);
				}
				else
				{
					tcs.TrySetException(ex);
				}
			});
			cancellationToken.Register(delegate
			{
				tcs.TrySetCanceled();
				((AsyncRequest)ar).Cancel();
			});
			return tcs.Task;
		}

		public List<object[]> SelectData(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, CriteriaOperator criteria, CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties, CriteriaOperator groupCriteria, bool selectDeleted, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords, SortingCollection sorting)
		{
			currentMode = InTransactionMode.Sync | InTransactionMode.SelectData;
			objectsToSave = session.GetObjectsToSave(includeParent: true);
			objectsToDelete = session.GetObjectsToDelete(includeParent: true);
			if (objectsToSave.Count == 0 && objectsToDelete.Count == 0)
			{
				return session.SelectDataInternal(classInfo, properties, criteria, groupProperties, groupCriteria, selectDeleted, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, sorting);
			}
			ObjectsQuery queryForSelectData = GetQueryForSelectData(classInfo, criteria, selectDeleted, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, sorting);
			List<object[]> list = session.PrepareSelectData(classInfo, ref properties, ref criteria, ref groupProperties, ref groupCriteria, ref sorting, doDetectPostProcessing: false, this);
			if (list == null)
			{
				StateSelectData(queryForSelectData, classInfo, properties, criteria, groupProperties, groupCriteria, selectDeleted, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, sorting);
				Process();
				return selectDataState.Result;
			}
			return list;
		}

		public object SelectDataAsync(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, CriteriaOperator criteria, CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties, CriteriaOperator groupCriteria, bool selectDeleted, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords, SortingCollection sorting, AsyncSelectDataCallback callback)
		{
			mainRequest = new VirtualAsyncRequest(AsyncOperationsHelper.CaptureSynchronizationContextOrFail());
			selectDataCallback = callback;
			currentMode = InTransactionMode.Async | InTransactionMode.SelectData;
			objectsToSave = session.GetObjectsToSave(includeParent: true);
			objectsToDelete = session.GetObjectsToDelete(includeParent: true);
			if (objectsToSave.Count == 0 && objectsToDelete.Count == 0)
			{
				return session.SelectDataInternalAsync(classInfo, properties, criteria, groupProperties, groupCriteria, selectDeleted, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, sorting, callback);
			}
			ObjectsQuery queryForSelectData = GetQueryForSelectData(classInfo, criteria, selectDeleted, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, sorting);
			List<object[]> list = session.PrepareSelectData(classInfo, ref properties, ref criteria, ref groupProperties, ref groupCriteria, ref sorting, doDetectPostProcessing: false, this);
			if (list == null)
			{
				StateSelectData(queryForSelectData, classInfo, properties, criteria, groupProperties, groupCriteria, selectDeleted, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, sorting);
				ProcessAsync();
			}
			else
			{
				StateSelectDataReturnResult(list);
				ProcessAsync();
			}
			return mainRequest;
		}

		public Task<List<object[]>> SelectDataAsync(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, CriteriaOperator criteria, CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties, CriteriaOperator groupCriteria, bool selectDeleted, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords, SortingCollection sorting, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			TaskCompletionSource<List<object[]>> tcs = new TaskCompletionSource<List<object[]>>();
			object ar = SelectDataAsync(classInfo, properties, criteria, groupProperties, groupCriteria, selectDeleted, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, sorting, delegate(List<object[]> result, Exception ex)
			{
				if (ex == null)
				{
					tcs.TrySetResult(result);
				}
				else
				{
					tcs.TrySetException(ex);
				}
			});
			cancellationToken.Register(delegate
			{
				tcs.TrySetCanceled();
				((AsyncRequest)ar).Cancel();
			});
			return tcs.Task;
		}

		private void Process()
		{
			switch (currentState)
			{
			case InTransactionState.AnalyzeAndExecQuery:
				ProcessAnalyzeAndExecQuery();
				break;
			case InTransactionState.AfterAnalyzeQueryNullCriteria:
				ProcessAfterAnalyzeQueryNullCriteria();
				break;
			case InTransactionState.AfterAnalyzeQueryDirectGetObjects:
				ProcessAfterAnalyzeQueryDirectGetObjects();
				break;
			case InTransactionState.AfterGetOriginalObjectsThroughCollection:
				ProcessAfterGetOriginalObjectsThroughtCollection();
				break;
			case InTransactionState.GetOriginalObjects:
				ProcessGetOriginalObjects();
				break;
			case InTransactionState.ReturnResult:
				ProcessReturnResult();
				break;
			case InTransactionState.SelectDataPostProcessing:
				ProcessSelectDataPostProcessing();
				break;
			case InTransactionState.SelectDataReturnResult:
				ProcessSelectDataReturnResult();
				break;
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException(currentState.ToString());
			}
		}

		private void ProcessAsync()
		{
			ThreadPool.QueueUserWorkItem(delegate
			{
				try
				{
					session.AsyncExecuteQueue.Invoke(mainRequest.SyncContext, delegate
					{
						if (mainRequest.IsCanceled)
						{
							return;
						}
						try
						{
							Process();
						}
						catch (Exception ex4)
						{
							try
							{
								ProcessException(ex4);
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}
					}, null, operationEnd: true);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					Exception ex2 = ex;
					Exception exi = ex2;
					try
					{
						session.AsyncExecuteQueue.Invoke(mainRequest.SyncContext, delegate
						{
							if (mainRequest.IsCanceled)
							{
								return;
							}
							try
							{
								ProcessException(exi);
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}, null, operationEnd: true);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
			});
		}

		private void ExecDirectSelectData()
		{
			if ((currentMode & InTransactionMode.Sync) == InTransactionMode.Sync)
			{
				StateSelectDataReturnResult(session.SelectDataInternal(selectDataState.PreparedQuery.ClassInfo, selectDataState.Properties, selectDataState.PreparedQuery.Criteria, selectDataState.GroupProperties, selectDataState.GroupCriteria, selectDataState.PreparedQuery.CollectionCriteriaPatcher.SelectDeleted, selectDataState.PreparedQuery.SkipSelectedRecords, selectDataState.PreparedQuery.TopSelectedRecords, selectDataState.PreparedQuery.Sorting));
				Process();
			}
			else
			{
				if ((currentMode & InTransactionMode.Async) != InTransactionMode.Async)
				{
					return;
				}
				mainRequest.AddNestedRequest(session.SelectDataInternalAsync(selectDataState.PreparedQuery.ClassInfo, selectDataState.Properties, selectDataState.PreparedQuery.Criteria, selectDataState.GroupProperties, selectDataState.GroupCriteria, selectDataState.PreparedQuery.CollectionCriteriaPatcher.SelectDeleted, selectDataState.PreparedQuery.SkipSelectedRecords, selectDataState.PreparedQuery.TopSelectedRecords, selectDataState.PreparedQuery.Sorting, delegate(List<object[]> result, Exception ex)
				{
					if (ex != null)
					{
						ProcessException(ex);
					}
					else
					{
						StateSelectDataReturnResult(result);
						ProcessAsync();
					}
				}) as AsyncRequest);
			}
		}

		private void ExecQueries(ObjectsQuery[] query, InTransactionState stateAfterExecute)
		{
			queriesForExecute = query;
			currentState = stateAfterExecute;
			if ((currentMode & InTransactionMode.Sync) == InTransactionMode.Sync)
			{
				queriesForExecuteResult = session.GetObjectsInternal(queriesForExecute);
				Process();
			}
			else
			{
				if ((currentMode & InTransactionMode.Async) != InTransactionMode.Async)
				{
					return;
				}
				mainRequest.AddNestedRequest(session.GetObjectsInternalAsync(queriesForExecute, delegate(ICollection[] result, Exception ex)
				{
					if (ex != null)
					{
						ProcessException(ex);
					}
					else
					{
						queriesForExecuteResult = result;
						ProcessAsync();
					}
				}) as AsyncRequest);
			}
		}

		private ObjectsQuery GetQueryForSelectData(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperator criteria, bool selectDeleted, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords, SortingCollection sorting)
		{
			return new ObjectsQuery(classInfo, criteria, sorting, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, new CollectionCriteriaPatcher(selectDeleted, session.TypesManager), force: false);
		}

		private void StateSelectData(ObjectsQuery originalQuery, XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties, CriteriaOperator criteria, CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties, CriteriaOperator groupCriteria, bool selectDeleted, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords, SortingCollection sorting)
		{
			selectDataState = new SelectDataState();
			selectDataState.OriginalQuery = originalQuery;
			selectDataState.PreparedQuery = GetQueryForSelectData(classInfo, criteria, selectDeleted, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords, sorting);
			selectDataState.Properties = properties;
			selectDataState.GroupProperties = groupProperties;
			selectDataState.GroupCriteria = groupCriteria;
			selectDataState.Grouped = selectDataState.GroupProperties != null && ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)selectDataState.GroupProperties).Count > 0;
			if (!selectDataState.Grouped && selectDataState.Properties != null && ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)selectDataState.Properties).Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)selectDataState.Properties).Count; i++)
				{
					if (IsTopLevelAggregateCheckerClient.IsTopLevelAggregate(((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)selectDataState.Properties)[i]))
					{
						selectDataState.Grouped = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			ObjectsQuery[] queries = new ObjectsQuery[1]
			{
				new ObjectsQuery(classInfo, criteria, selectDataState.Grouped ? null : sorting, (!selectDataState.Grouped) ? skipSelectedRecords : 0, (!selectDataState.Grouped) ? topSelectedRecords : 0, new CollectionCriteriaPatcher(selectDeleted, session.TypesManager), force: false)
			};
			StateQuery(queries, new ObjectsQuery[1] { originalQuery });
		}

		private void StateQuery(ObjectsQuery[] queries, ObjectsQuery[] originalQueries)
		{
			loadObjectsState = new LoadObjectsState();
			loadObjectsState.Queries = queries;
			loadObjectsState.OriginalQueries = originalQueries;
			loadObjectsState.Result = new ICollection[queries.Length];
			loadObjectsState.QueryIndex = -1;
			StateNextQuery();
		}

		private void StateNextQuery()
		{
			loadObjectsState.QueryIndex++;
			if (loadObjectsState.QueryIndex >= loadObjectsState.Queries.Length)
			{
				if (IsSelectDataMode)
				{
					currentState = InTransactionState.SelectDataPostProcessing;
				}
				else
				{
					currentState = InTransactionState.ReturnResult;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				currentState = InTransactionState.AnalyzeAndExecQuery;
			}
		}

		private void StateSelectDataReturnResult(List<object[]> result)
		{
			if (selectDataState == null)
			{
				selectDataState = new SelectDataState();
			}
			selectDataState.Result = result;
			currentState = InTransactionState.SelectDataReturnResult;
		}

		private void ProcessSelectDataPostProcessing()
		{
			try
			{
				List<object[]> result = ((!selectDataState.Grouped && (loadObjectsState.Queries.Length == 0 || loadObjectsState.Result.Length == 0 || loadObjectsState.Result[0] == null || loadObjectsState.Result[0].Count <= 0)) ? new List<object[]>(0) : ((!selectDataState.Grouped) ? ProcessPostProcessingNormal() : ProcessPostProcessingGrouped()));
				StateSelectDataReturnResult(result);
				Process();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ProcessException(ex);
			}
		}

		private List<object[]> ProcessPostProcessingGrouped()
		{
			Dictionary<SelectDataGroup, List<object>> dictionary = new Dictionary<SelectDataGroup, List<object>>();
			CriteriaCompilerDescriptor criteriaCompilerDescriptor = selectDataState.PreparedQuery.ClassInfo.GetCriteriaCompilerDescriptor(session);
			Func<object, object>[] evaluators = PrepareDataEvaluators(selectDataState.Properties, (CriteriaCompilerDescriptor)(object)new GroupByObjectsDescriptor(criteriaCompilerDescriptor));
			Func<object, object>[] array = PrepareDataEvaluators(selectDataState.GroupProperties, criteriaCompilerDescriptor);
			Func<object, bool> func = PrepareDataPredicate(selectDataState.GroupCriteria, criteriaCompilerDescriptor);
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				dictionary.Add(new SelectDataGroup(new object[0]), new List<object>());
			}
			ObjectSet objectSet = new ObjectSet();
			foreach (object item in loadObjectsState.Result[0])
			{
				objectSet.Add(item);
				SelectDataGroup key = new SelectDataGroup(GetResultRow(item, array));
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					value = new List<object>();
					dictionary.Add(key, value);
				}
				value.Add(item);
			}
			List<List<object>> list = new List<List<object>>();
			foreach (List<object> value2 in dictionary.Values)
			{
				if (value2.Count > 0)
				{
					if (func(value2[0]))
					{
						list.Add(value2);
					}
				}
				else if (func(null))
				{
					list.Add(value2);
				}
			}
			if (selectDataState.PreparedQuery.Sorting != null && selectDataState.PreparedQuery.Sorting.Count > 0)
			{
				IComparer<List<object>> comparer = PrepareSortingComparer(selectDataState.PreparedQuery.Sorting, selectDataState.PreparedQuery.ClassInfo);
				list.Sort(comparer);
			}
			int skipSelectedRecords = selectDataState.PreparedQuery.SkipSelectedRecords;
			int topSelectedRecords = selectDataState.PreparedQuery.TopSelectedRecords;
			if (skipSelectedRecords != 0)
			{
				if (skipSelectedRecords >= list.Count)
				{
					list.Clear();
				}
				else
				{
					list.RemoveRange(0, skipSelectedRecords);
				}
			}
			if (topSelectedRecords != 0 && topSelectedRecords < list.Count)
			{
				list.RemoveRange(topSelectedRecords, list.Count - topSelectedRecords);
			}
			int count = list.Count;
			List<object[]> list2 = new List<object[]>(count);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				list2.Add(GetResultRow(list[i], evaluators));
			}
			return list2;
		}

		private static object[] GetResultRow(object obj, Func<object, object>[] evaluators)
		{
			int num = evaluators.Length;
			object[] array = new object[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = evaluators[i](obj);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private List<object[]> ProcessPostProcessingNormal()
		{
			List<object[]> list = new List<object[]>();
			if (loadObjectsState.Result != null && loadObjectsState.Result[0] != null && loadObjectsState.Result[0].Count > 0)
			{
				if (selectDataState.Properties != null && ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)selectDataState.Properties).Count > 0)
				{
					Func<object, object>[] array = PrepareDataEvaluators(selectDataState.Properties, selectDataState.PreparedQuery.ClassInfo.GetCriteriaCompilerDescriptor(session));
					int num = array.Length;
					for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
					{
						Func<object, object> evaluator = array[i];
						object[] array2 = (from object o in loadObjectsState.Result[0]
							select evaluator(o)).ToArray();
						if (list.Count == 0)
						{
							object[] array3 = array2;
							foreach (object obj in array3)
							{
								object[] array4 = new object[num];
								array4[i] = obj;
								list.Add(array4);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							for (int num3 = 0; num3 < array2.Length; num3++)
							{
								list[num3][i] = array2[num3];

				if ((selectDeleted || !session.IsObjectToDelete(item2, includeParent: true)) && session.GetClassInfo(item2).IsAssignableTo(classInfo))

		private static void TryCollectObjectsFromIntermediateClass(object theObject, ObjectSet preparedResult, Session session, XPClassInfo currentClassInfo, bool selectDeleted)
		{

				if (value != null && (selectDeleted || !session.IsObjectToDelete(value, includeParent: true)))
				{
					preparedResult.Add(value);
				}
			}
			if (intermediateClassInfo.intermediateObjectFieldInfoRight.ReferenceType != null && intermediateClassInfo.intermediateObjectFieldInfoRight.ReferenceType.IsAssignableTo(currentClassInfo))
			{
				object value2 = intermediateClassInfo.intermediateObjectFieldInfoRight.GetValue(theObject);

	public class SmellingJoinOperandFinder : IClientCriteriaVisitor<bool>, ICriteriaVisitor<bool>
	{
		private class JoinOperandCriteriaPreprocessor : ClientCriteriaVisitorBase
		{
			private const string OuterPropertyPrefix = "outer_";

			private int level;

			protected override CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
			{
				//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0041: Expected O, but got Unknown
				int num = 0;
				string text = theOperand.PropertyName;
