				{
					num++;
					text = text.Remove(0, 2);
				}
				if (level - num < 0)
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty("outer_" + text);
				}
				return ((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)this).Visit(theOperand);
			}

			protected override CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
			{
				//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0023: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (theOperand is OperandParameter)
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty("outer_" + ((OperandParameter)theOperand).ParameterName);
				}
				return ((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)this).Visit(theOperand);
			}

			protected override CriteriaOperator Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
			{
				level++;
				try
				{
					return ((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)this).Visit(theOperand);
				}
				finally
				{
					level--;
				}
			}

			protected override CriteriaOperator Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand, bool processCollectionProperty)
			{
				level++;
				try
				{
					return ((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)this).Visit(theOperand, false);
				}
				finally
				{
					level--;
				}
			}

			protected override CriteriaOperator Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
			{
				//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				CriteriaOperator val = null;
				foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
				{
					CriteriaOperator val2 = ((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)this).Process(item);
					val = GroupOperator.Combine(theOperator.OperatorType, val, val2);
				}
				return val;
			}

			public static CriteriaOperator Preprocess(CriteriaOperator criteria)
			{
				return ((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)new JoinOperandCriteriaPreprocessor()).Process(criteria);
			}
		}

		private XPClassInfo currentClassInfo;

		private CriteriaOperator originalCriteria;

		public SmellingJoinOperandFinder(XPClassInfo currentClassInfo, CriteriaOperator originalCriteria)
		{
			this.currentClassInfo = currentClassInfo;
			this.originalCriteria = JoinOperandCriteriaPreprocessor.Preprocess(originalCriteria);

		public bool Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperand.AggregatedExpression) && !Process(theOperand.Condition))
			{
				return Process((IEnumerable)theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
		{
			if (currentClassInfo != null)
			{
				XPClassInfo classInfo = null;
				if (!MemberInfoCollection.TryResolveTypeAlsoByShortName(theOperand.JoinTypeName, currentClassInfo, out classInfo))
				{
					throw new CannotResolveClassInfoException(string.Empty, theOperand.JoinTypeName);
				}
				CriteriaOperator val = JoinOperandCriteriaPreprocessor.Preprocess(theOperand.Condition);
				if (currentClassInfo == classInfo && CriteriaOperator.CriterionEquals(val, originalCriteria))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (!Process(theOperand.AggregatedExpression) && !Process(theOperand.Condition))
			{
				return Process((IEnumerable)theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public bool Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process((IEnumerable)theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public bool Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public bool Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process((IEnumerable)theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public bool Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (Process(theOperator.LeftOperand))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return Process((IEnumerable)theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public bool Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process(theOperator.Operand);
		}

		public bool Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperator.LeftOperand))
			{
				return Process(theOperator.RightOperand);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperator.TestExpression) && !Process(theOperator.BeginExpression))
			{
				return Process(theOperator.EndExpression);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool Process(IEnumerable ops)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			foreach (CriteriaOperator op2 in ops)
			{
				CriteriaOperator op = op2;
				if (Process(op))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Process(CriteriaOperator op)
		{
			if (op == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return op.Accept<bool>((ICriteriaVisitor<bool>)this);
		}
	}
	public class IsTopLevelAggregateCheckerClient : IClientCriteriaVisitor<bool>, ICriteriaVisitor<bool>
	{
		public bool Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)
		{
			return theOperand.IsTopLevel;
		}

		public bool Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public bool Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public bool Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process((IEnumerable)theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public bool Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public bool Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process((IEnumerable)theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public bool Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (Process(theOperator.LeftOperand))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return Process((IEnumerable)theOperator.Operands);
		}

		public bool Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process(theOperator.Operand);
		}

		public bool Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperator.LeftOperand))
			{
				return Process(theOperator.RightOperand);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperator.TestExpression) && !Process(theOperator.BeginExpression))
			{
				return Process(theOperator.EndExpression);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool Process(IEnumerable ops)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			foreach (CriteriaOperator op2 in ops)
			{
				CriteriaOperator op = op2;
				if (Process(op))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool Process(CriteriaOperator op)
		{
			if (op == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return op.Accept<bool>((ICriteriaVisitor<bool>)this);
		}

		public static bool IsTopLevelAggregate(CriteriaOperator op)

	public static class WcfUsedAsDumbPipeHelper
	{
		private const string UnpackedSignature = "Xpo.SSRs.0.Un:";

		private const string GzPackedSignature = "Xpo.SSRs.0.Gz:";

		public static byte[] Warp(SelectStatementResult[] resultSet)
		{
			if ("Xpo.SSRs.0.Gz:".Length != "Xpo.SSRs.0.Un:".Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("GzPackedSignature.Length != UnpackedSignature.Length");
			}
			if (resultSet == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			byte[] array;
			using (MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream())
			{
				string text = "Xpo.SSRs.0.Un:";
				foreach (char c in text)
				{
					memoryStream.WriteByte((byte)c);
				}
				SelectResultsToStream(memoryStream, resultSet);
				array = memoryStream.ToArray();
			}
			if (CanTryPackWhole(array))
			{
				using MemoryStream memoryStream2 = new MemoryStream();
				string text2 = "Xpo.SSRs.0.Gz:";
				foreach (char c2 in text2)
				{
					memoryStream2.WriteByte((byte)c2);
				}
				using (GZipStream gZipStream = new GZipStream(memoryStream2, CompressionMode.Compress, leaveOpen: true))
				{
					gZipStream.Write(array, "Xpo.SSRs.0.Un:".Length, array.Length - "Xpo.SSRs.0.Un:".Length);
					gZipStream.Flush();
				}
				if ((double)memoryStream2.Length < (double)array.Length * 0.8)
				{
					return memoryStream2.ToArray();
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static SelectStatementResult[] Unwarp(byte[] warped)
		{
			if ("Xpo.SSRs.0.Gz:".Length != "Xpo.SSRs.0.Un:".Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("GzPackedSignature.Length != UnpackedSignature.Length");
			}
			if (warped == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(warped);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < "Xpo.SSRs.0.Un:".Length; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append((char)memoryStream.ReadByte());
			}
			string text = stringBuilder.ToString();
			if (!(text == "Xpo.SSRs.0.Un:"))
			{
				if (text == "Xpo.SSRs.0.Gz:")
				{
					using GZipStream stream = new GZipStream(memoryStream, CompressionMode.Decompress, leaveOpen: true);
					return SelectResultsFromStream(stream);
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Unexpected Signature: " + text);
			}
			return SelectResultsFromStream(memoryStream);
		}

		private static bool CanTryPackWhole(byte[] load)
		{
			if (load == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("load");
			}
			if (load.Length < 4096)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (load.Length < 1048576)
			{
				return true;
			}
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			using (GZipStream gZipStream = new GZipStream(memoryStream, CompressionMode.Compress, leaveOpen: true))
			{
				gZipStream.Write(load, load.Length / 2 - 65536, 131072);
				gZipStream.Flush();
			}
			return memoryStream.Length < 91750;
		}

		private static void SelectResultsToStream(Stream stream, SelectStatementResult[] resultSet)
		{
			BinaryWriter binaryWriter = new BinaryWriter(stream);
			binaryWriter.Write(resultSet.Length);
			foreach (SelectStatementResult val in resultSet)
			{
				binaryWriter.Write(val.Rows.Length);
				SelectStatementResultRow[] rows = val.Rows;
				foreach (SelectStatementResultRow val2 in rows)
				{
					binaryWriter.Write(val2.Values.Length);
					object[] values = val2.Values;
					foreach (object value in values)
					{
						WriteObject(binaryWriter, value);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static SelectStatementResult[] SelectResultsFromStream(Stream stream)
		{
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Expected O, but got Unknown
			BinaryReader binaryReader = new BinaryReader(stream);
			int num = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
			SelectStatementResult[] array = (SelectStatementResult[])(object)new SelectStatementResult[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				int num2 = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
				SelectStatementResultRow[] array2 = (SelectStatementResultRow[])(object)new SelectStatementResultRow[num2];
				for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
				{
					int num3 = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
					object[] array3 = new object[num3];
					for (int k = 0; k < num3; k++)
					{
						array3[k] = ReadObject(binaryReader);
					}
					array2[j] = new SelectStatementResultRow(array3);
				}
				array[i] = new SelectStatementResult(array2);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static void WriteObject(BinaryWriter wr, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				wr.Write((byte)0);
				return;
			}
			Type type = value.GetType();
			sbyte b = (sbyte)Type.GetTypeCode(type);
			switch (b)
			{
			case 3:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write((bool)value);
				return;
			case 4:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write((char)value);
				return;
			case 5:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write((sbyte)value);
				return;
			case 6:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write((byte)value);
				return;
			case 7:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write((short)value);
				return;
			case 8:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write((ushort)value);
				return;
			case 9:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write((int)value);
				return;
			case 10:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write((uint)value);
				return;
			case 11:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write((long)value);
				return;
			case 12:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write((ulong)value);
				return;
			case 13:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write((float)value);
				return;
			case 14:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write((double)value);
				return;
			case 15:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write((decimal)value);
				return;
			case 16:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write(((DateTime)value).ToBinary());
				return;
			case 18:
				wr.Write(b);
				wr.Write((string)value);
				return;
			}
			if (type == typeof(byte[]))
			{
				wr.Write((sbyte)(-1));
				byte[] array = (byte[])value;
				wr.Write(array.Length);
				wr.Write(array);
			}
			else if (type == typeof(Guid))
			{
				wr.Write((sbyte)(-2));
				wr.Write(((Guid)value).ToByteArray(), 0, 16);
			}
			else if (type == typeof(TimeSpan))
			{
				wr.Write((sbyte)(-3));
				wr.Write(((TimeSpan)value).Ticks);
			}
			else
			{
				wr.Write((sbyte)1);
				SafeBinaryFormatter.Serialize(wr.BaseStream, value);
			}
		}

		private static object ReadObject(BinaryReader rd)
		{
			sbyte b = rd.ReadSByte();
			return b switch
			{
				0 => null, 
				3 => rd.ReadBoolean(), 
				4 => rd.ReadChar(), 
				5 => rd.ReadSByte(), 
				6 => rd.ReadByte(), 
				7 => rd.ReadInt16(), 
				8 => rd.ReadUInt16(), 
				9 => rd.ReadInt32(), 
				10 => rd.ReadUInt32(), 
				11 => rd.ReadInt64(), 
				12 => rd.ReadUInt64(), 
				13 => rd.ReadSingle(), 
				14 => rd.ReadDouble(), 
				15 => rd.ReadDecimal(), 
				16 => DateTime.FromBinary(rd.ReadInt64()), 
				18 => rd.ReadString(), 
				1 => SafeBinaryFormatter.Deserialize(rd.BaseStream), 
				-1 => rd.ReadBytes(rd.ReadInt32()), 
				-2 => new Guid(rd.ReadBytes(16)), 
				-3 => TimeSpan.FromTicks(rd.ReadInt64()), 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Unknown type code: " + b), 
			};
		}
	}
	public static class ConnectionParameter
	{
		private const string GenerateConnectionHelperParameterName = "generateConnectionHelper";

		private const string SettingsLocation = "DevExpress\\XpoWizard\\";

		private static readonly string SettingsFilename = "settings" + "_v23_2" + ".xml";

		public static Dictionary<string, string> GetParamsDict(IConnectionPage connPage)
		{
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			if (connPage.IsServerbased)
			{
				dictionary.Add("server", connPage.ServerName);
			}
			if (connPage is IConnectionPageEx connectionPageEx && connPage.IsServerbased && connPage.Factory.HasPort)
			{
				object parameterValue = connectionPageEx.GetParameterValue("port");
				if (parameterValue != null)
				{
					dictionary.Add("port", ((int)parameterValue).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
			}
			if (connPage.IsServerbased && connPage.Factory.HasMultipleDatabases)
			{
				dictionary.Add("database", connPage.DatabaseName);
			}
			else
			{
				dictionary.Add("database", connPage.FileName);
			}
			if (connPage.Factory.HasIntegratedSecurity)
			{
				dictionary.Add("useIntegratedSecurity", connPage.AuthType.ToString());
			}
			if (connPage.Factory.HasUserName)
			{
				dictionary.Add("userid", connPage.UserName);
			}
			if (connPage.Factory.HasPassword)
			{
				dictionary.Add("password", connPage.Password);
			}
			dictionary.Add("read only", "1");
			dictionary.Add("generateConnectionHelper", connPage.GenerateConnectionHelper ? "true" : "false");
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static void SetParamsDict(string providerKey, Dictionary<string, string> paramDict, IConnectionPage connPage)
		{
			if (providerKey == connPage.CustomConStrTag)
			{
				connPage.LastConStr = paramDict[connPage.CustomConStrTag];
				connPage.SetProvider(providerKey);
				return;
			}
			connPage.SetProvider(providerKey);
			if (connPage.Factory == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (connPage.IsServerbased)
			{
				connPage.ServerName = paramDict["server"];
			}
			IConnectionPageEx connectionPageEx = connPage as IConnectionPageEx;
			if (connPage.IsServerbased && connPage.Factory.HasPort && connectionPageEx != null)
			{
				if (paramDict.TryGetValue("port", out var value))
				{
					connectionPageEx.SetParameterValue("port", Convert.ToInt32(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
				}
				else
				{
					connectionPageEx.SetParameterValue("port", null);
				}
			}
			if (connPage.Factory.HasUserName)
			{
				connPage.UserName = paramDict["userid"];
			}
			if (connPage.Factory.HasPassword)
			{
				connPage.Password = paramDict["password"];
			}
			if (connPage.Factory.HasIntegratedSecurity)
			{
				connPage.AuthType = bool.Parse(paramDict["useIntegratedSecurity"]);
			}
			if (connPage.IsServerbased && connPage.Factory.HasMultipleDatabases)
			{
				connPage.DatabaseName = paramDict["database"];
			}
			else
			{
				connPage.FileName = paramDict["database"];
			}
			if (paramDict.ContainsKey("generateConnectionHelper"))
			{
				connPage.CeConnectionHelper = paramDict["generateConnectionHelper"] == "true";
			}
		}

		private static ConnectionPageSettings GetSettings(IConnectionPage connPage)
		{
			if (connPage.Factory == null)
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				dictionary.Add(connPage.CustomConStrTag, connPage.CustomConStr);
				return new ConnectionPageSettings(connPage.CustomConStrTag, dictionary);
			}
			return new ConnectionPageSettings(connPage.Factory.ProviderKey, GetParamsDict(connPage));
		}

		public static void SetSettings(ConnectionPageSettings settings, IConnectionPage connPage)
		{
			SetParamsDict(settings.ProviderKey, settings.ParamDict, connPage);
		}

		public static void TryToLoadSettingsFromBase64(IConnectionPage connPage, string base64String)
		{
			byte[] buffer = Convert.FromBase64String(base64String);
			using MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream(buffer);
			TryToLoadSettings(connPage, stream);
		}

		public static void TryToLoadSettings(IConnectionPage connPage, Stream stream)
		{
			try
			{
				ConnectionPageSettings connectionPageSettings = SafeXml.Deserialize<ConnectionPageSettings>(stream, (Type[])null);
				if (connectionPageSettings != null)
				{
					SetSettings(connectionPageSettings, connPage);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		public static void TryToLoadSettings(IConnectionPage connPage)
		{
			string path = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "DevExpress\\XpoWizard\\");
			string path2 = Path.Combine(path, SettingsFilename);
			if (!File.Exists(path2))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				using FileStream stream = new FileStream(path2, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
				TryToLoadSettings(connPage, stream);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		public static string SaveSettingsToBase64(IConnectionPage connPage)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			SaveSettings(connPage, memoryStream);
			memoryStream.Flush();
			return Convert.ToBase64String(memoryStream.ToArray());
		}

		public static void SaveSettings(IConnectionPage connPage, Stream stream)
		{
			try
			{
				ConnectionPageSettings settings = GetSettings(connPage);
				XmlWriterSettings xmlWriterSettings = new XmlWriterSettings();
				xmlWriterSettings.Indent = true;
				using XmlWriter xmlWriter = XmlWriter.Create(stream, xmlWriterSettings);
				SafeXml.Serialize<ConnectionPageSettings>(xmlWriter, (object)settings, (Type[])null, (XmlSerializerNamespaces)null);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		public static void SaveSettings(IConnectionPage connPage)
		{
			try
			{
				string text = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "DevExpress\\XpoWizard\\");
				string path = Path.Combine(text, SettingsFilename);
				if (!Directory.Exists(text))
				{
					Directory.CreateDirectory(text);
				}
				using FileStream stream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write);
				SaveSettings(connPage, stream);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}
	}

	public class ConnectionPageSettings
	{
		public class ConnectionPageSettingsItem
		{
			[XmlAttribute("name")]
			public string Name;

			[XmlAttribute("value")]
			public string Value;

			public ConnectionPageSettingsItem()
			{
			}

			public ConnectionPageSettingsItem(string name, string value)
			{
				Name = name;
				Value = value;
			}
		}

		private string providerKey;

		private Dictionary<string, string> paramDict;

		[XmlAttribute("providerKey")]
		public string ProviderKey
		{
			get
			{
				return providerKey;
			}
			set
			{
				providerKey = value;
			}
		}

		[XmlIgnore]
		public Dictionary<string, string> ParamDict => paramDict;

		[XmlArray("parameter")]
		public ConnectionPageSettingsItem[] Parameters
		{
			get
			{
				ConnectionPageSettingsItem[] array = new ConnectionPageSettingsItem[paramDict.Count];
				int num = 0;
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> item in paramDict)
				{
					array[num] = new ConnectionPageSettingsItem(item.Key, item.Value);
					num++;
				}
				return array;
			}
			set
			{
				if (paramDict == null)
				{
					paramDict = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				}
				else
				{
					paramDict.Clear();
				}
				if (value != null && value.Length != 0)
				{
					foreach (ConnectionPageSettingsItem connectionPageSettingsItem in value)
					{
						paramDict[connectionPageSettingsItem.Name] = connectionPageSettingsItem.Value;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public ConnectionPageSettings()
		{
		}

		public ConnectionPageSettings(string providerKey, Dictionary<string, string> paramDict)
		{
			this.providerKey = providerKey;
			this.paramDict = paramDict;
		}
	}

	public sealed class QueryData
	{
		private class EmptyConverter : ValueConverter
		{
			public static readonly EmptyConverter Default = new EmptyConverter();

			public override Type StorageType => null;

			public override object ConvertToStorageType(object value)
			{
				return value;
			}

			public override object ConvertFromStorageType(object value)
			{
				return value;
			}
		}

		public abstract class ValueAccessor
		{
			public readonly XPMemberInfo Member;

			public abstract object Value { get; }

			public ValueAccessor(XPMemberInfo member)
			{
				Member = member;
			}

			public static ValueAccessor CreateAccessor(QueryData data, XPMemberInfo member, ref int index)
			{
				XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = ((member.ReferenceType == null) ? member : member.ReferenceType.KeyProperty);
				if (xPMemberInfo.SubMembers.Count == 0)
				{
					ValueConverter valueConverter = CreateDataConverter(xPMemberInfo);
					if (!(valueConverter is EmptyConverter))
					{
						return new ConvertedValueAccessor(data, index++, member, valueConverter);
					}
					return new SimpleValueAccessor(data, index++, member);
				}
				List<ValueAccessor> list = new List<ValueAccessor>();
				foreach (XPMemberInfo subMember in xPMemberInfo.SubMembers)
				{
					if (subMember.IsPersistent)
					{
						list.Add(CreateAccessor(data, subMember, ref index));
					}
				}
				return new SubValueAccessor(list, member);
			}
		}

		public sealed class TypedRefAccessor : ValueAccessor
		{
			private ValueAccessor value;

			private ValueAccessor type;

			public override object Value => value.Value;

			public object TypeId => type.Value;

			public TypedRefAccessor(ValueAccessor value, ValueAccessor type)
				: base(null)
			{
				this.value = value;
				this.type = type;
			}
		}

		private class SimpleValueAccessor : ValueAccessor
		{
			private QueryData data;

			private int index;

			public override object Value => data.row.Values[index];

			public SimpleValueAccessor(QueryData data, int index, XPMemberInfo member)
				: base(member)
			{
				this.data = data;
				this.index = index;
			}
		}

		private sealed class ConvertedValueAccessor : SimpleValueAccessor
		{
			private ValueConverter converter;

			public override object Value => converter.ConvertFromStorageType(base.Value);

			public ConvertedValueAccessor(QueryData data, int index, XPMemberInfo member, ValueConverter converter)
				: base(data, index, member)
			{
				this.converter = converter;
			}
		}

		private sealed class NullValueAccessor : ValueAccessor
		{
			public override object Value => null;

			public NullValueAccessor(XPMemberInfo member)
				: base(member)
			{
			}
		}

		public sealed class SubValueAccessor : ValueAccessor
		{
			public List<ValueAccessor> Nested;

			public override object Value
			{
				get
				{
					List<object> list = new IdList();
					bool flag = true;
					foreach (ValueAccessor item in Nested)
					{
						object value = item.Value;
						if (value != null)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						list.Add(value);
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						return list;
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			public SubValueAccessor(List<ValueAccessor> nested, XPMemberInfo member)
				: base(member)
			{
				Nested = nested;
			}
		}

		private MemberPathCollection properties;

		private Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, ValueAccessor> members;

		private SelectStatementResult data;

		private int pos;

		private SelectStatementResultRow row;

		private Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, QueryData> nestedDatas = new Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, QueryData>();

		private XPClassInfo classInfo;

		private List<ValueAccessor> linearMembers;

		public MemberPathCollection Properties => properties;

		public int Count => data.Rows.Length;

		public void SetData(SelectStatementResult data)
		{
			this.data = data;
			pos = 0;
		}

		public static ValueConverter CreateDataConverter(XPMemberInfo member)
		{
			ValueConverter converter = member.Converter;
			if (converter != null)
			{
				return converter;
			}
			return EmptyConverter.Default;
		}

		public QueryData GetNestedData(XPMemberInfo mi)
		{
			if (!nestedDatas.TryGetValue(mi, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (pos >= data.Rows.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			row = data.Rows[pos];
			pos++;
			return true;
		}

		private QueryData()
		{
		}

		private void AddMember(XPMemberInfo mi, QueryData root, MemberInfoCollection parentPath, ref int index)
		{
			members[mi] = ValueAccessor.CreateAccessor(root, mi, ref index);
			MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = new MemberInfoCollection(root.classInfo, parentPath.Count + 1);
			memberInfoCollection.AddRange(parentPath);
			memberInfoCollection.Add(mi);
			properties.Add(memberInfoCollection);
		}

		private void Init(QueryData root, XPClassInfo classInfo, MemberInfoCollection parentPath, ref int index)
		{
			properties = new MemberPathCollection();
			members = new Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, ValueAccessor>();
			if (classInfo.IsTypedObject && classInfo.IsAbstract)
			{
				AddMember(classInfo.KeyProperty, root, parentPath, ref index);
				AddMember(classInfo.GetMember("ObjectType"), root, parentPath, ref index);
				XPMemberInfo optimisticLockField = classInfo.OptimisticLockField;
				if (optimisticLockField != null)
				{
					AddMember(optimisticLockField, root, parentPath, ref index);
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
			{
				if ((persistentProperty.IsDelayed && persistentProperty.ReferenceType == null) || persistentProperty.IsReadOnly)
				{
					continue;
				}
				ExplicitLoadingAttribute explicitLoadingAttribute = (ExplicitLoadingAttribute)persistentProperty.FindAttributeInfo(typeof(ExplicitLoadingAttribute));
				int num = explicitLoadingAttribute?.Depth ?? 1;
				XPClassInfo referenceType = persistentProperty.ReferenceType;
				if (parentPath.Count <= num && referenceType != null && !persistentProperty.IsKey && !persistentProperty.IsDelayed && (persistentProperty.IsAggregated || (explicitLoadingAttribute != null && num > 0)))
				{
					QueryData queryData = new QueryData();
					MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = new MemberInfoCollection(root.classInfo);
					memberInfoCollection.AddRange(parentPath);
					memberInfoCollection.Add(persistentProperty);
					queryData.Init(root, referenceType, memberInfoCollection, ref index);
					nestedDatas.Add(persistentProperty, queryData);
					properties.AddRange(queryData.Properties);
					members[persistentProperty] = new NullValueAccessor(persistentProperty);
					continue;
				}
				AddMember(persistentProperty, root, parentPath, ref index);
				if (!persistentProperty.IsDelayed && referenceType != null && referenceType.IsTypedObject && referenceType.HasDescendants)
				{
					MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection2 = new MemberInfoCollection(root.classInfo);
					memberInfoCollection2.AddRange(parentPath);
					memberInfoCollection2.Add(persistentProperty);
					XPMemberInfo member = referenceType.GetMember("ObjectType");
					memberInfoCollection2.Add(member);
					properties.Add(memberInfoCollection2);
					members[persistentProperty] = new TypedRefAccessor(GetAccessor(persistentProperty), ValueAccessor.CreateAccessor(root, member, ref index));
				}
			}
		}

		public QueryData(XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			int index = 0;
			this.classInfo = classInfo;
			Init(this, classInfo, new MemberInfoCollection(classInfo), ref index);
		}

		public ValueAccessor GetAccessor(int index)
		{
			return linearMembers[index];
		}

		public QueryData(XPClassInfo classInfo, CriteriaOperatorCollection properties)
		{
			int index = 0;
			linearMembers = new List<ValueAccessor>();
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item2 in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)properties)
			{
				OperandProperty val = (OperandProperty)(object)((item2 is OperandProperty) ? item2 : null);
				if (val == null)
				{
					SimpleValueAccessor item = new SimpleValueAccessor(this, index++, null);
					linearMembers.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = classInfo.ParsePersistentPath(val.PropertyName);
					linearMembers.Add(ValueAccessor.CreateAccessor(this, memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1], ref index));
				}
			}
		}

		public object GetValue(XPMemberInfo member)
		{
			return GetAccessor(member).Value;
		}

		public ValueAccessor GetAccessor(XPMemberInfo member)
		{
			members.TryGetValue(member, out var value);
			return value;
		}
	}
	public enum WaitForAsyncOperationResult
	{
		EmptyQueue,
		ThreadReentrancy,
		IdleQueue,
		OperationComplete
	}
	internal class LinkedUniqueQueue<T>
	{
		public class LinkedQueueItem
		{
			public LinkedQueueItem Prev;

			public LinkedQueueItem Next;

			public T Data;

			public LinkedQueueItem(T data)
			{
				Data = data;
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<T, LinkedQueueItem> linksDictionary = new Dictionary<T, LinkedQueueItem>();

		private LinkedQueueItem head;

		private LinkedQueueItem tail;

		public int Count => linksDictionary.Count;

		public bool EnqueueItem(T data)
		{
			if (linksDictionary.ContainsKey(data))
			{
				return false;
			}
			LinkedQueueItem linkedQueueItem = new LinkedQueueItem(data);
			if (head == null)
			{
				head = linkedQueueItem;
			}
			else
			{
				tail.Next = linkedQueueItem;
				linkedQueueItem.Prev = tail;
			}
			tail = linkedQueueItem;
			linksDictionary.Add(data, linkedQueueItem);
			return true;
		}

		public bool DequeueItem(out T data)
		{
			if (head == null)
			{
				data = default(T);
				return false;
			}
			LinkedQueueItem linkedQueueItem = head;
			head = linkedQueueItem.Next;
			if (head == null)
			{
				tail = null;
			}
			data = linkedQueueItem.Data;
			linksDictionary.Remove(data);
			return true;
		}

		public bool Remove(T data)
		{
			if (!linksDictionary.TryGetValue(data, out var value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (head == value)
			{
				head = value.Next;
				if (head == null)
				{
					tail = null;
				}
				value.Next = null;
				linksDictionary.Remove(data);
				return true;
			}
			if (tail == value)
			{
				tail = value.Prev;
				tail.Next = null;
				value.Prev = null;
				linksDictionary.Remove(data);
				return true;
			}
			value.Prev.Next = value.Next;
			value.Next.Prev = value.Prev;
			value.Prev = null;
			value.Next = null;
			return true;
		}

		public bool Contains(T data)
		{
			return linksDictionary.ContainsKey(data);
		}
	}
	internal class PriorityRequestQueue
	{
		private LinkedUniqueQueue<AsyncRequest> idleQueue = new LinkedUniqueQueue<AsyncRequest>();

		private LinkedUniqueQueue<AsyncRequest> normalQueue = new LinkedUniqueQueue<AsyncRequest>();

		private LinkedUniqueQueue<AsyncRequest> highQueue = new LinkedUniqueQueue<AsyncRequest>();

		public int Count => idleQueue.Count + normalQueue.Count + highQueue.Count;

		public bool HasOnlyIdle
		{
			get
			{
				if (idleQueue.Count > 0 && normalQueue.Count == 0)
				{
					return highQueue.Count == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public void Enqueue(AsyncRequest request)
		{
			if (request != null && !request.IsCanceled)
			{
				switch (request.Priority)
				{
				case AsyncRequestPriority.Normal:
					normalQueue.EnqueueItem(request);
					break;
				case AsyncRequestPriority.Idle:
					idleQueue.EnqueueItem(request);
					break;
				case AsyncRequestPriority.High:
					highQueue.EnqueueItem(request);
					break;
				default:
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
			}
		}

		public AsyncRequest Dequeue()
		{
			if (Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AsyncRequest data;
			do
			{
				if (highQueue.DequeueItem(out data) && !data.IsCanceled)
				{
					return data;
				}
			}
			while (data != null);
			do
			{
				if (normalQueue.DequeueItem(out data) && !data.IsCanceled)
				{
					return data;
				}
			}
			while (data != null);
			do
			{
				if (idleQueue.DequeueItem(out data) && !data.IsCanceled)
				{
					return data;
				}
			}
			while (data != null);
			return null;
		}

		public void NotifyPriorityChanged(AsyncRequest request)
		{
			if (idleQueue.Remove(request) || normalQueue.Remove(request) || highQueue.Remove(request))
			{
				Enqueue(request);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(AsyncRequest request)
		{
			if (!idleQueue.Contains(request) && !normalQueue.Contains(request))
			{
				return highQueue.Contains(request);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class AsyncExecuteQueue
	{
		private class ExecuteInvokeInfo : IDisposable
		{
			private SendOrPostCallback d;

			private object state;

			private bool executed;

			private Exception error;

			private readonly bool operationEnd;

			private readonly ManualResetEvent operationEndEvent = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);

			public ManualResetEvent OperationEndEvent => operationEndEvent;

			public SendOrPostCallback D => d;

			public object State => state;

			public bool Executed
			{
				get
				{
					return executed;
				}
				set
				{
					executed = value;
				}
			}

			public Exception Error
			{
				get
				{
					return error;
				}
				set
				{
					error = value;
				}
			}

			public bool OperationEnd => operationEnd;

			public ExecuteInvokeInfo(SendOrPostCallback d, object state, bool operationEnd)
			{
				this.d = d;
				this.state = state;
				this.operationEnd = operationEnd;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				d = null;
				state = null;
			}
		}

		private int syncRequestsCount;

		private AutoResetEvent syncExecuteEvent = new AutoResetEvent(initialState: false);

		private SendOrPostCallback syncExecuteDelegate;

		private object syncExecuteState;

		private Thread executingThread;

		private bool asyncThreadWorking;

		private bool asyncThreadNotWorkingButHasExecTask;

		private bool asyncThreadWorkingButAllAreIdle;

		private PriorityRequestQueue asyncQueue = new PriorityRequestQueue();

		private AsyncRequest currentRequest;

		public AsyncExecuteQueue()
		{
			syncExecuteDelegate = ExecuteInvoke;
		}

		public bool ContainsRequest(AsyncRequest request, bool includeCurrentRequest)
		{
			if (!includeCurrentRequest || currentRequest != request)
			{
				return asyncQueue.Contains(request);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public WaitForAsyncOperationResult WaitForAsyncOperationEnd()
		{
			return WaitForAsyncOperationEnd(null);
		}

		public WaitForAsyncOperationResult WaitForAsyncOperationEnd(AsyncRequest request)
		{
			if (executingThread == Thread.CurrentThread)
			{
				return WaitForAsyncOperationResult.ThreadReentrancy;
			}
			lock (this)
			{
				if (syncRequestsCount < 0)
				{
					syncRequestsCount = 0;
				}
				syncRequestsCount++;
			}
			lock (asyncQueue)
			{
				if (request != null && !request.IsCanceled && !request.IsInQueueOrCurrent(this))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Request not found.");
				}
			}
			while (true)
			{
				lock (asyncQueue)
				{
					if (asyncThreadNotWorkingButHasExecTask)
					{
						asyncThreadNotWorkingButHasExecTask = false;
					}
					else
					{
						if (!asyncThreadWorking)
						{
							lock (this)
							{
								syncRequestsCount--;
							}
							return WaitForAsyncOperationResult.EmptyQueue;
						}
						if (asyncThreadWorkingButAllAreIdle && (request == null || request.IsCanceled || !request.IsInQueueOrCurrent(this)))
						{
							return WaitForAsyncOperationResult.IdleQueue;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!syncExecuteEvent.WaitOne())
				{
					continue;
				}
				lock (asyncQueue)
				{
					if (asyncThreadNotWorkingButHasExecTask)
					{
						asyncThreadNotWorkingButHasExecTask = false;
					}
					else
					{
						if (!asyncThreadWorking)
						{
							lock (this)
							{
								syncRequestsCount--;
							}
							return WaitForAsyncOperationResult.EmptyQueue;
						}
						if (asyncThreadWorkingButAllAreIdle && (request == null || request.IsCanceled || !request.IsInQueueOrCurrent(this)))
						{
							return WaitForAsyncOperationResult.IdleQueue;
						}
					}
				}
				ExecuteInvokeInfo executeInvokeInfo = syncExecuteState as ExecuteInvokeInfo;
				if (executeInvokeInfo == null || !executeInvokeInfo.Executed)
				{
					syncExecuteDelegate(syncExecuteState);
					syncExecuteState = null;
					if (executeInvokeInfo != null && executeInvokeInfo.OperationEnd)
					{
						bool flag = request == null;
						if (!flag)
						{
							if (request.IsCanceled)
							{
								flag = true;
							}
							else
							{
								lock (asyncQueue)
								{
									flag = request.IsInQueue(this);
								}
							}
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							lock (this)
							{
								syncRequestsCount--;
							}
							return WaitForAsyncOperationResult.OperationComplete;
						}
					}
				}
				if (request == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (request.IsCanceled)
				{
					break;
				}
				lock (asyncQueue)
				{
					if (!request.IsInQueueOrCurrent(this))
					{
						return WaitForAsyncOperationResult.OperationComplete;
					}
				}
			}
			return WaitForAsyncOperationResult.OperationComplete;
		}

		public void Invoke(SynchronizationContext syncContext, SendOrPostCallback d, object state, bool operationEnd)
		{
			ExecuteInvokeInfo executeInvokeInfo = new ExecuteInvokeInfo(d, state, operationEnd);
			do
			{
				bool flag = false;
				lock (this)
				{
					syncExecuteState = executeInvokeInfo;
					syncExecuteEvent.Set();
					if (syncRequestsCount <= 0)
					{
						flag = true;
						syncContext.Post(syncExecuteDelegate, syncExecuteState);
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					executeInvokeInfo.OperationEndEvent.WaitOne();
					break;
				}
			}
			while (!executeInvokeInfo.OperationEndEvent.WaitOne(100));
			if (executeInvokeInfo.Error != null)
			{
				throw executeInvokeInfo.Error;
			}
		}

		private void ExecuteInvoke(object state)
		{
			if (!(state is ExecuteInvokeInfo executeInvokeInfo))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				lock (executeInvokeInfo)
				{
					if (executeInvokeInfo.Executed)
					{
						return;
					}
					executingThread = Thread.CurrentThread;
					executeInvokeInfo.Executed = true;
				}
				try
				{
					if (executeInvokeInfo.D == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Async_InternalErrorAsyncActionIsAlreadyDisposed"));
					}
					executeInvokeInfo.D(executeInvokeInfo.State);
				}
				catch (Exception error)
				{
					executeInvokeInfo.Error = error;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				executingThread = null;
				executeInvokeInfo.Dispose();
				executeInvokeInfo.OperationEndEvent.Set();
			}
		}

		public void ExecRequest(AsyncRequest request)
		{
			lock (asyncQueue)
			{
				asyncQueue.Enqueue(request);
				if (!asyncThreadWorking)
				{
					asyncThreadWorking = true;
					asyncThreadWorkingButAllAreIdle = false;
					ThreadPool.QueueUserWorkItem(AsyncWorkCycle);
				}
			}
		}

		public void NotifyPriorityChanged(AsyncRequest request)
		{
			lock (asyncQueue)
			{
				asyncQueue.NotifyPriorityChanged(request);
			}
		}

		private void AsyncWorkCycle(object state)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			while (true)
			{
				lock (asyncQueue)
				{
					if (asyncQueue.Count == 0)
					{
						asyncThreadWorking = false;
						asyncThreadNotWorkingButHasExecTask = flag;
						syncExecuteEvent.Set();
						currentRequest = null;
						break;
					}
					if (asyncQueue.HasOnlyIdle)
					{
						asyncThreadWorkingButAllAreIdle = true;
						syncExecuteEvent.Set();
					}
					currentRequest = asyncQueue.Dequeue();
				}
				currentRequest.Exec();
				flag = true;
			}
		}
	}
	public enum AsyncRequestPriority
	{
		Normal,
		Idle,
		High
	}
	internal class VirtualAsyncRequest : AsyncRequest
	{
		private bool executed;

		public void Stop()
		{
			executed = true;
		}

		public VirtualAsyncRequest(SynchronizationContext context)
			: base(context)
		{
		}

		public override bool IsInQueue(AsyncExecuteQueue q)
		{
			if (executed)
			{
				return base.IsInQueue(q);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsInQueueOrCurrent(AsyncExecuteQueue q)
		{
			if (executed)
			{
				return base.IsInQueueOrCurrent(q);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class AsyncRequest
	{
		private bool isCanceled;

		private AsyncExecuteQueue queue;

		private AsyncRequestPriority priority;

		private readonly SynchronizationContext syncContext;

		private readonly AsyncRequestExec exec;

		private readonly List<AsyncRequest> nestedRequests = new List<AsyncRequest>();

		public SynchronizationContext SyncContext => syncContext;

		public AsyncRequestPriority Priority => priority;

		public bool IsCanceled => isCanceled;

		public AsyncRequest(SynchronizationContext syncContext)
		{
			this.syncContext = syncContext;
		}

		public AsyncRequest(SynchronizationContext syncContext, AsyncRequestExec exec)
			: this(syncContext)
		{
			this.exec = exec;
		}

		public AsyncRequest AddNestedRequest(AsyncRequest nested)
		{
			if (nested == null)
			{
				return nested;
			}
			lock (nestedRequests)
			{
				if (IsCanceled)
				{
					nested.Cancel();
				}
				nested.SetPriority(Priority);
				nestedRequests.Add(nested);
				return nested;
			}
		}

		public AsyncRequest RemoveNestedRequest(AsyncRequest nested)
		{
			if (nested == null)
			{
				return nested;
			}
			lock (nestedRequests)
			{
				nestedRequests.Remove(nested);
				return nested;
			}
		}

		public void Cancel()
		{
			isCanceled = true;
			lock (nestedRequests)
			{
				foreach (AsyncRequest nestedRequest in nestedRequests)
				{
					nestedRequest.Cancel();
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetPriority(AsyncRequestPriority priority)
		{
			if (this.priority == priority)
			{
				return;
			}
			this.priority = priority;
			if (queue != null)
			{
				queue.NotifyPriorityChanged(this);
			}
			lock (nestedRequests)
			{
				foreach (AsyncRequest nestedRequest in nestedRequests)
				{
					nestedRequest.SetPriority(priority);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual bool IsInQueue(AsyncExecuteQueue q)
		{
			if (q != null && q.ContainsRequest(this, includeCurrentRequest: false))
			{
				return true;
			}
			lock (nestedRequests)
			{
				foreach (AsyncRequest nestedRequest in nestedRequests)
				{
					if (nestedRequest.IsInQueue(q))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual bool IsInQueueOrCurrent(AsyncExecuteQueue q)
		{
			if (q != null && q.ContainsRequest(this, includeCurrentRequest: true))
			{
				return true;
			}
			lock (nestedRequests)
			{
				foreach (AsyncRequest nestedRequest in nestedRequests)
				{
					if (nestedRequest.IsInQueueOrCurrent(q))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Exec()
		{
			if (exec != null)
			{
				exec(this);
			}
		}

		public AsyncRequest Start(AsyncExecuteQueue queue)
		{
			return StartWithPriority(queue, AsyncRequestPriority.Normal);
		}

		public AsyncRequest StartWithPriority(AsyncExecuteQueue queue, AsyncRequestPriority priority)
		{
			if (this.queue != null || queue == null || exec == null || syncContext == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SetPriority(priority);
			this.queue = queue;
			this.queue.ExecRequest(this);
			return this;
		}
	}
	internal delegate void AsyncRequestExec(AsyncRequest request);
	public delegate void AsyncLoadObjectsCallback(ICollection[] result, Exception ex);
	public delegate void AsyncFindObjectCallback(object result, Exception ex);
	internal class ObjectCollectionLoader
	{
		private class AsyncLoadRequest : AsyncRequest
		{
			private LoadObjectsContext loadObjectsContext;

			private AsyncLoadObjectsCallback callback;

			public LoadObjectsContext LoadObjectsContext => loadObjectsContext;

			public AsyncLoadObjectsCallback Callback => callback;

			public AsyncLoadRequest(LoadObjectsContext loadObjectsContext, AsyncLoadObjectsCallback callback, SynchronizationContext syncContext, AsyncRequestExec exec)
				: base(syncContext, exec)
			{
				this.loadObjectsContext = loadObjectsContext;
				this.callback = callback;
			}
		}

		private class LoadDataResult
		{
			private ObjectsQuery[] queries;

			private QueryData[] data;

			private SelectedData result;

			public ObjectsQuery[] Queries => queries;

			public QueryData[] Data => data;

			public SelectedData Result => result;

			public LoadDataResult(ObjectsQuery[] queries, QueryData[] data, SelectedData result)
			{
				this.queries = queries;
				this.data = data;
				this.result = result;
			}
		}

		private class LoadObjectsContext
		{
			private ObjectsQuery[] queries;

			private ICollection[] result;

			private ExpandedCriteriaHolder[] expanded;

			private bool[] requiresResorting;

			private ObjectsQuery[] loadDataQuery;

			public ObjectsQuery[] Queries => queries;

			public ICollection[] Result => result;

			public ExpandedCriteriaHolder[] Expanded => expanded;

			public bool[] RequiresResorting => requiresResorting;

			public ObjectsQuery[] LoadDataQuery => loadDataQuery;

			public LoadObjectsContext(ObjectsQuery[] queries, ICollection[] result, ExpandedCriteriaHolder[] expanded, bool[] requiresResorting, ObjectsQuery[] loadDataQuery)
				: this(queries, result, expanded, requiresResorting)
			{
				this.loadDataQuery = loadDataQuery;
			}

			public LoadObjectsContext(ObjectsQuery[] queries, ICollection[] result, ExpandedCriteriaHolder[] expanded, bool[] requiresResorting)
			{
				this.queries = queries;
				this.result = result;
				this.expanded = expanded;
				this.requiresResorting = requiresResorting;
			}
		}

		private class LoadStub
		{
			private OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior loadMerge;

			private object id;

			private bool isProceed;

			private bool isNeedReload;

			private XPClassInfo classInfo;

			private object loadedObject;

			private Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, bool> delayedMembers = new Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, bool>();

			private Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object> memberValues = new Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object>();

			public object Id => id;

			public object LoadedObject
			{
				get
				{
					return loadedObject;
				}
				set
				{
					loadedObject = value;
				}
			}

			public bool IsProceed => isProceed;

			public bool IsNeedReload => isNeedReload;

			public XPClassInfo ClassInfo => classInfo;

			public OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior LoadMerge
			{
				get
				{
					return loadMerge;
				}
				set
				{
					loadMerge = value;
				}
			}

			public ICollection Members => memberValues.Keys;

			public LoadStub(XPClassInfo classInfo, object id)
			{
				this.classInfo = classInfo;
				this.id = id;
			}

			public LoadStub(XPClassInfo classInfo, object id, object loadedObject)
				: this(classInfo, id)
			{
				this.loadedObject = loadedObject;
			}

			public void SetMemberValue(XPMemberInfo mi, object value, bool isDelayed)
			{
				memberValues[mi] = value;
				delayedMembers[mi] = true;
			}

			public void SetMemberValue(XPMemberInfo mi, object value)
			{
				memberValues[mi] = value;
			}

			public object GetMemberValue(XPMemberInfo mi)
			{
				if (memberValues.TryGetValue(mi, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				if (loadedObject == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return mi.GetValue(loadedObject);
			}

			public bool IsDelayedMember(XPMemberInfo mi)
			{
				return delayedMembers.ContainsKey(mi);
			}

			public void Proceed()
			{
				isProceed = true;
			}

			public void NeedReload()
			{
				isNeedReload = true;
			}
		}

		private class ProcessAssociationStubData
		{
			public readonly object OldData;

			public readonly object NewData;

			public ProcessAssociationStubData(object oldData, object newData)
			{
				OldData = oldData;
				NewData = newData;
			}
		}

		private class StubMap : Dictionary<object, object>, IObjectMap
		{
			void IObjectMap.Add(object theObject, object id)
			{
				base[id] = theObject;
			}

			void IObjectMap.Remove(object id)
			{
				Remove(id);
			}

			public object Get(object id)
			{
				if (!TryGetValue(id, out var value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}

			public int CompactCache()
			{
				return 0;
			}

			public void ClearCache()
			{
				Clear();
			}
		}

		private class ObjectLoader
		{
			private class DataMember
			{
				public QueryData.ValueAccessor Index;

				public XPMemberInfo Member;

				protected ObjectLoader loader;

				protected void SetValue(object value)
				{
					if (loader.useStubs)
					{
						((LoadStub)loader.theObject).SetMemberValue(Member, value);
					}
					else
					{
						Member.SetValue(loader.theObject, value);
					}
				}

				public virtual void AcquireValue()
				{
					SetValue(Index.Value);
				}

				protected DataMember(ObjectLoader loader, XPMemberInfo mi, QueryData.ValueAccessor index)
				{
					this.loader = loader;
					Member = mi;
					Index = index;
				}

				public static DataMember CreateDataMember(ObjectLoader loader, XPMemberInfo mi, QueryData.ValueAccessor index)
				{
					if (mi.IsDelayed)
					{
						return new DelayedDataMember(loader, mi, index);
					}
					if (mi.SubMembers.Count > 0)
					{
						return new SubDataMember(loader, mi, index);
					}
					if (mi.ReferenceType != null)
					{
						ObjectLoader subLoader = loader.GetSubLoader(mi, mi.ReferenceType);
						if (subLoader == null)
						{
							return new RefDataMember(loader, mi, index);
						}
						return new RefLoadDataMember(loader, mi, subLoader, index);
					}
					return new DataMember(loader, mi, index);
				}
			}

			private class RefDataMemberBase : DataMember
			{
				private bool? processRefChange;

				protected RefDataMemberBase(ObjectLoader loader, XPMemberInfo mi, QueryData.ValueAccessor index)
					: base(loader, mi, index)
				{
				}

				protected void SetRefValue(object newValue)
				{
					if (loader.useStubs)
					{
						LoadStub loadStub = loader.theObject as LoadStub;
						if (IsProcessingRefChanges())
						{
							object memberValue = loadStub.GetMemberValue(Member);
							loadStub.SetMemberValue(Member, new ProcessAssociationStubData(memberValue, newValue));
						}
						else
						{
							loadStub.SetMemberValue(Member, newValue);
						}
					}
					else if (IsProcessingRefChanges())
					{
						object value = Member.GetValue(loader.theObject);
						SetValue(newValue);
						Member.ProcessAssociationRefChange(loader.loader.Session, loader.theObject, value, newValue, skipNonLoadedCollections: true);
					}
					else
					{
						SetValue(newValue);
					}
				}

				private bool IsProcessingRefChanges()
				{
					if (!processRefChange.HasValue)
					{
						processRefChange = Member.IsAssociation;
					}
					return processRefChange.Value;
				}
			}

			private sealed class RefDataMember : RefDataMemberBase
			{
				private IObjectMap stubObjects;

				private IObjectMap classObjects;

				public RefDataMember(ObjectLoader loader, XPMemberInfo mi, QueryData.ValueAccessor index)
					: base(loader, mi, index)
				{
					stubObjects = loader.loader.CreateStubMap(mi.ReferenceType);
					classObjects = SessionIdentityMap.GetMap(loader.loader.session, mi.ReferenceType);
				}

				public override void AcquireValue()
				{
					object obj = Index.Value;
					if (obj != null)
					{
						object obj2;
						if (loader.useStubs)
						{
							obj2 = stubObjects.Get(obj);
							if (obj2 == null)
							{
								obj2 = classObjects.Get(obj);
								if (obj2 != null)
								{
									obj2 = new LoadStub(Member.ReferenceType, obj, obj2);
									stubObjects.Add(obj2, obj);
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							obj2 = classObjects.Get(obj);
						}
						if (obj2 == null)
						{
							XPClassInfo classInfo;
							if (Index is QueryData.TypedRefAccessor { TypeId: var typeId })
							{
								if (typeId != null)
								{
									XPObjectType objectType = loader.loader.Session.GetObjectType((int)typeId);
									classInfo = objectType.GetClassInfo();
								}
								else
								{
									classInfo = Member.ReferenceType;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								classInfo = Member.ReferenceType;
							}
							obj2 = loader.DelayLoading(loader.useStubs ? stubObjects : classObjects, classInfo, obj);
						}
						obj = obj2;
					}
					SetRefValue(obj);
				}
			}

			private sealed class RefLoadDataMember : RefDataMemberBase
			{
				private ObjectLoader subLoader;

				public RefLoadDataMember(ObjectLoader loader, XPMemberInfo mi, ObjectLoader subLoader, QueryData.ValueAccessor index)
					: base(loader, mi, index)
				{
					this.subLoader = subLoader;
				}

				public override void AcquireValue()
				{
					SetRefValue(subLoader.LoadObject());
				}
			}

			private sealed class SubDataMember : DataMember
			{
				private List<DataMember> subMembers;

				public SubDataMember(ObjectLoader loader, XPMemberInfo mi, QueryData.ValueAccessor index)
					: base(loader, mi, index)
				{
					subMembers = new List<DataMember>();
					foreach (QueryData.ValueAccessor item in ((QueryData.SubValueAccessor)index).Nested)
					{
						subMembers.Add(DataMember.CreateDataMember(loader, item.Member, item));
					}
				}

				public override void AcquireValue()
				{
					foreach (DataMember subMember in subMembers)
					{
						subMember.AcquireValue();
					}
				}
			}

			private sealed class DelayedDataMember : DataMember
			{
				public DelayedDataMember(ObjectLoader loader, XPMemberInfo mi, QueryData.ValueAccessor index)
					: base(loader, mi, index)
				{
				}

				public override void AcquireValue()
				{
					if (loader.useStubs)
					{
						((LoadStub)loader.theObject).SetMemberValue(Member, (Index == null) ? null : Index.Value, isDelayed: true);
					}
					else
					{
						XPDelayedProperty.Init(loader.loader.Session, loader.theObject, Member, (Index == null) ? null : Index.Value);
					}
				}
			}

			private object theObject;

			private readonly bool useStubs;

			private readonly ObjectCollectionLoader loader;

			private readonly QueryData data;

			private readonly XPClassInfo classInfo;

			private readonly XPMemberInfo optimistickLock;

			private readonly XPMemberInfo optimistickLockInDataLayer;

			private readonly DataMember[] members;

			private readonly IObjectMap stubObjects;

			private readonly IObjectMap classObjects;

			private readonly QueryData.ValueAccessor keyAccessor;

			private readonly QueryData.ValueAccessor typeAccessor;

			private readonly bool forceReload;

			private static Func<object, object> ReturnMemberValue = (object arg) => (arg is DataMember { Index: not null } dataMember) ? dataMember.Index.Value : null;

			public ObjectLoader(ObjectCollectionLoader loader, QueryData data, XPClassInfo classInfo, bool forceReload, bool useStubs)
			{
				this.useStubs = useStubs;
				this.forceReload = forceReload;
				this.loader = loader;
				this.data = data;
				this.classInfo = classInfo;
				stubObjects = loader.CreateStubMap(classInfo);
				classObjects = SessionIdentityMap.GetMap(loader.session, classInfo);
				classInfo.CheckAbstractReference();
				if (classInfo.IsTypedObject)
				{
					typeAccessor = data.GetAccessor(classInfo.GetMember("ObjectType"));
					if (typeAccessor == null)
					{
						throw new TypeFieldIsEmptyException(classInfo.FullName);
					}
				}
				optimistickLock = classInfo.OptimisticLockField;
				optimistickLockInDataLayer = classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer;
				keyAccessor = data.GetAccessor(classInfo.KeyProperty);
				List<DataMember> list = new List<DataMember>();
				foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
				{
					QueryData.ValueAccessor accessor = data.GetAccessor(persistentProperty);
					if ((accessor != null || persistentProperty.IsDelayed) && (typeAccessor == null || accessor != typeAccessor))
					{
						list.Add(DataMember.CreateDataMember(this, persistentProperty, accessor));
					}
				}
				members = list.ToArray();
			}

			private void InternalLoadObject(object id, OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior loadMerge)
			{
				loader.ProcessLoaded(classInfo, id);
				if (!useStubs)
				{
					loader.Session.TriggerObjectLoading(theObject);
					loader.objectsToFireLoaded.Add(theObject);
					LoadProperties(loadMerge);
					return;
				}
				LoadStub loadStub = (LoadStub)theObject;
				if (loadMerge != OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Default)
				{
					loadStub.LoadMerge = loadMerge;
				}
				loadStub.NeedReload();
				loader.objectsToFireLoaded.Add(theObject);
				LoadProperties(OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Default);
			}

			private bool IsObjectVersionChanged()
			{
				if (useStubs)
				{
					if (optimistickLock != null)
					{
						return (int?)OptimisticLockField.ConvertDbVersionToInt(data.GetValue(optimistickLock)) != (int?)((LoadStub)theObject).GetMemberValue(optimistickLock.Owner.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer);
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (optimistickLock != null)
				{
					return (int?)OptimisticLockField.ConvertDbVersionToInt(data.GetValue(optimistickLock)) != (int?)optimistickLock.Owner.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer.GetValue(theObject);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public object LoadObject()
			{
				object value = keyAccessor.Value;
				if (value == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (useStubs)
				{
					theObject = stubObjects.Get(value);
					if (theObject == null)
					{
						theObject = classObjects.Get(value);
						if (theObject != null)
						{
							theObject = new LoadStub(loader.Session.GetClassInfo(theObject), value, theObject);
							stubObjects.Add(theObject, value);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					theObject = classObjects.Get(value);
				}
				OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior loadMergeState = OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Default;
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = ResolveClassInfo();
				if (theObject == null)
				{
					CreateTypedObject(value, xPClassInfo);
					ValidateTypedObjectType(xPClassInfo);
				}
				else
				{
					ValidateTypedObjectType(xPClassInfo);
					if (loader.HasObjectLoaded(theObject) || (!loader.IsDelayed(xPClassInfo, value) && !NeedReload(loader.Session, xPClassInfo, forceReload, out loadMergeState, IsObjectVersionChanged)))
					{
						return theObject;
					}
				}
				if (xPClassInfo != classInfo)
				{
					loader.DelayLoading(xPClassInfo, value, theObject);
				}
				else
				{
					InternalLoadObject(value, loadMergeState);
				}
				return theObject;
			}

			private void ValidateTypedObjectType(XPClassInfo resolvedType)
			{
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = (useStubs ? ((LoadStub)theObject).ClassInfo : loader.Session.GetClassInfo(theObject));
				if (resolvedType != xPClassInfo)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Loader_InternalErrorOrUnsupportedReferenceStructure", xPClassInfo, resolvedType));
				}
			}

			private void CreateTypedObject(object id, XPClassInfo classInfo)
			{
				if (useStubs)
				{
					theObject = new LoadStub(classInfo, id);
					loader.CreateStubMap(classInfo).Add(theObject, id);
				}
				else
				{
					theObject = classInfo.CreateObject(loader.Session);
					classObjects.Add(theObject, id);
				}
			}

			private XPClassInfo ResolveClassInfo()
			{
				if (typeAccessor == null)
				{
					return classInfo;
				}
				object value = typeAccessor.Value;
				if (value == null)
				{
					return classInfo;
				}
				XPObjectType objectType = loader.Session.GetObjectType((int)value);
				return objectType.GetClassInfo();
			}

			private void LoadProperties(OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior loadMerge)
			{
				DataMember[] array = members;
				foreach (DataMember dataMember in array)
				{
					if (AcceptLoadPropertyAndResetModified(loader.Session.TrackPropertiesModifications, loadMerge, theObject, classInfo, dataMember.Member, ReturnMemberValue, dataMember))
					{
						dataMember.AcquireValue();
					}
				}
				if (optimistickLock != null && !useStubs)
				{
					optimistickLockInDataLayer.SetValue(theObject, optimistickLock.GetValue(theObject));
				}
			}

			private ObjectLoader GetSubLoader(XPMemberInfo property, XPClassInfo objType)
			{
				QueryData nestedData = data.GetNestedData(property);
				if (nestedData == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new ObjectLoader(loader, nestedData, objType, forceReload: false, useStubs);
			}

			private object DelayLoading(IObjectMap map, XPClassInfo classInfo, object id)
			{
				object obj;
				if (map is StubMap)
				{
					obj = new LoadStub(classInfo, id);
					loader.CreateStubMap(classInfo).Add(obj, id);
				}
				else
				{
					obj = classInfo.CreateObject(loader.Session);
					map.Add(obj, id);
				}
				loader.DelayLoading(classInfo, id, obj);
				return obj;
			}
		}

		private readonly IDataLayer dataLayer;

		private readonly Session session;

		private readonly Dictionary<XPClassInfo, StubMap> stubObjects = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, StubMap>();

		private readonly Dictionary<XPClassInfo, IDictionary<object, object>> delayedObjects = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, IDictionary<object, object>>();

		public ObjectSet objectsToFireLoaded = new ObjectSet();

		private static readonly IDictionary<object, object> emptyList = new Dictionary<object, object>();

		private LoadObjectsContext asyncLoadObjectsContext;

		private AsyncLoadObjectsCallback asyncCallback;

		private SynchronizationContext syncContext;

		private bool DoEnsureIsTypedObjectValid = true;

		public IDataLayer DataLayer => dataLayer;

		private Session Session => session;

		public ObjectCollectionLoader(Session session, IDataLayer dataLayer)
		{
			this.session = session;
			this.dataLayer = dataLayer;
		}

		private IDataLayerAsync GetDataLayerAsync()
		{
			if (DataLayer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(DataLayer is IDataLayerAsync result))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Async_DataLayerDoesNotImplementIDataLayerAsync", DataLayer.GetType().FullName));
			}
			return result;
		}

		private IDictionary<object, object> GetDelayedList(XPClassInfo type)
		{
			if (!delayedObjects.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				return emptyList;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private IDictionary<object, object> CreateDelayedList(XPClassInfo type)
		{
			if (!delayedObjects.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				value = new Dictionary<object, object>();
				delayedObjects[type] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void DelayLoading(XPClassInfo type, object id, object obj)
		{
			CreateDelayedList(type)[id] = obj;
		}

		private void ProcessLoaded(XPClassInfo classInfo, object id)
		{
			GetDelayedList(classInfo).Remove(id);
		}

		private bool IsDelayed(XPClassInfo classInfo, object id)
		{
			return GetDelayedList(classInfo).ContainsKey(id);
		}

		private IObjectMap CreateStubMap(XPClassInfo type)
		{
			if (!stubObjects.TryGetValue(type.IdClass, out var value))
			{
				value = new StubMap();
				stubObjects[type.IdClass] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static bool NeedReload(Session session, XPClassInfo ci, bool forceReload, out OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior loadMergeState, Func<bool> isObjectVersionChanged)
		{
			//IL_01b2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			loadMergeState = OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Default;
			OptimisticLockingReadBehavior optimisticLockingReadBehavior = ci.OptimisticLockingReadBehavior;
			if (optimisticLockingReadBehavior == OptimisticLockingReadBehavior.Default)
			{
				optimisticLockingReadBehavior = session.OptimisticLockingReadBehavior;
			}
			if (optimisticLockingReadBehavior == OptimisticLockingReadBehavior.Default)
			{
				optimisticLockingReadBehavior = XpoDefault.OptimisticLockingReadBehavior;
			}
			if (forceReload)
			{
				switch (optimisticLockingReadBehavior)
				{
				case OptimisticLockingReadBehavior.MergeCollisionIgnore:
					if (session.InTransaction && (ci.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? session.TrackPropertiesModifications))
					{
						loadMergeState = OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Ignore;
					}
					break;
				case OptimisticLockingReadBehavior.MergeCollisionThrowException:
					if (session.InTransaction && (ci.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? session.TrackPropertiesModifications))
					{
						loadMergeState = OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.ThrowException;
					}
					break;
				case OptimisticLockingReadBehavior.MergeCollisionReload:
					if (session.InTransaction && (ci.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? session.TrackPropertiesModifications))
					{
						loadMergeState = OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Reload;
					}
					break;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if ((ci.OptimisticLockingBehavior == OptimisticLockingBehavior.ConsiderOptimisticLockingField || ci.OptimisticLockingBehavior == OptimisticLockingBehavior.NoLocking) && !isObjectVersionChanged())
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (optimisticLockingReadBehavior)
			{
			case OptimisticLockingReadBehavior.MergeCollisionIgnore:
				if (!session.InTransaction)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ci.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? session.TrackPropertiesModifications)
				{
					loadMergeState = OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Ignore;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			case OptimisticLockingReadBehavior.MergeCollisionThrowException:
				if (!session.InTransaction)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ci.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? session.TrackPropertiesModifications)
				{
					loadMergeState = OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.ThrowException;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			case OptimisticLockingReadBehavior.MergeCollisionReload:
				if (!session.InTransaction)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ci.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? session.TrackPropertiesModifications)
				{
					loadMergeState = OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Reload;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			case OptimisticLockingReadBehavior.Ignore:
				return false;
			case OptimisticLockingReadBehavior.ReloadObject:
				return true;
			case OptimisticLockingReadBehavior.Mixed:
				return !session.InTransaction;
			case OptimisticLockingReadBehavior.ThrowException:
				throw new LockingException();
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Loader_ReloadError", typeof(OptimisticLockingReadBehavior).Name, optimisticLockingReadBehavior.ToString()));
			}
		}

		public static bool AcceptLoadPropertyAndResetModified(bool trackPropertiesModifications, OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior loadMerge, object currentObject, XPClassInfo classInfo, XPMemberInfo member, Func<object, object> getNewValue, object getNewValueArgument)
		{
			//IL_00e3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			switch ((member != classInfo.OptimisticLockField) ? ((member.MergeCollisionBehavior == OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Default) ? loadMerge : member.MergeCollisionBehavior) : OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Default)
			{
			case OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Ignore:
				if (member.GetModified(currentObject))
				{
					member.ResetModified(currentObject);
					member.SetModified(currentObject, getNewValue(getNewValueArgument));
					return false;
				}
				break;
			case OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Reload:
				if (member.GetModified(currentObject))
				{
					if (member.IsDelayed && member.ReferenceType == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!LockingHelper.IsModifiedInDataLayer(member, member.GetOldValue(currentObject), getNewValue(getNewValueArgument)))
					{
						return false;
					}
					member.ResetModified(currentObject);
				}
				break;
			case OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.ThrowException:
				if (member.GetModified(currentObject))
				{
					if (member.IsDelayed && member.ReferenceType == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!LockingHelper.IsModifiedInDataLayer(member, member.GetOldValue(currentObject), getNewValue(getNewValueArgument)))
					{
						return false;
					}
					throw new LockingException();
				}
				break;
			default:
				if (trackPropertiesModifications && member.GetModified(currentObject))
				{
					member.ResetModified(currentObject);
				}
				break;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public object LoadObjectsAsync(ObjectsQuery[] queries, AsyncLoadObjectsCallback callback, SynchronizationContext syncContext)
		{
			if (callback == null || syncContext == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			return new AsyncLoadRequest(PrepareLoadObjects(queries), callback, syncContext, LoadObjectsExecRequest).Start(session.AsyncExecuteQueue);
		}

		private void LoadObjectsExecRequest(AsyncRequest ar)
		{
			AsyncLoadRequest asyncLoadRequest = (AsyncLoadRequest)ar;
			asyncLoadObjectsContext = asyncLoadRequest.LoadObjectsContext;
			asyncCallback = asyncLoadRequest.Callback;
			syncContext = asyncLoadRequest.SyncContext;
			try
			{
				if (asyncLoadObjectsContext.LoadDataQuery == null)
				{
					session.AsyncExecuteQueue.Invoke(syncContext, delegate
					{
						asyncCallback(asyncLoadObjectsContext.Result, null);
					}, null, operationEnd: true);
					return;
				}
				LoadDataResult loadDataResult = InternalLoadData(asyncLoadObjectsContext.LoadDataQuery);
				List<ICollection> list = new List<ICollection>();
				session.AsyncExecuteQueue.Invoke(syncContext, InternalLoadObjectsInStack, new object[2] { loadDataResult, list }, operationEnd: false);
				while (delayedObjects.Count > 0)
				{
					LoadDelayedObjectsAsync();
				}
				if (list.Count == 0 && asyncLoadObjectsContext.Queries.Length != 0)
				{
					for (int num = 0; num < asyncLoadObjectsContext.Queries.Length; num++)
					{
						list.Add(new object[0]);
					}
				}
				session.AsyncExecuteQueue.Invoke(syncContext, EndLoadObjectsAndCallBack, list.ToArray(), operationEnd: true);
			}
			catch (Exception state)
			{
				try
				{
					session.AsyncExecuteQueue.Invoke(syncContext, CallBackException, state, operationEnd: true);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadDelayedObjectsAsync()
		{
			ObjectSet objectSet = new ObjectSet();
			ObjectsQuery[] array = PrepareLoadDelayedObjects(objectSet);
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				LoadDataResult loadDataResult = InternalLoadData(array);
				session.AsyncExecuteQueue.Invoke(syncContext, EndLoadDelayedObjectsInStack, new object[2] { loadDataResult, objectSet }, operationEnd: false);
			}
			else
			{
				delayedObjects.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void PrepareLoadObjectsInStack(object param)
		{
			ObjectsQuery[] queries = (ObjectsQuery[])param;
			asyncLoadObjectsContext = PrepareLoadObjects(queries);
		}

		private void EndLoadObjectsAndCallBack(object param)
		{
			ICollection[] result = EndLoadObjects(asyncLoadObjectsContext, (ICollection[])param, proceesStubs: true);
			SessionIdentityMap.Extract(session).Compact();
			asyncCallback(result, null);
		}

		private void InternalLoadObjectsInStack(object param)
		{
			object[] array = (object[])param;
			LoadDataResult loadResult = (LoadDataResult)array[0];
			List<ICollection> list = (List<ICollection>)array[1];
			list.AddRange(InternalLoadObjects(loadResult, useStubs: true));
		}

		private void EndLoadDelayedObjectsInStack(object param)
		{
			object[] array = (object[])param;
			LoadDataResult loadDataResult = (LoadDataResult)array[0];
			ObjectSet toLoad = (ObjectSet)array[1];
			EndLoadDelayedObjects(loadDataResult, toLoad, useStubs: true);
		}

		private void CallBackException(object param)
		{
			asyncCallback(null, (Exception)param);
		}

		private void LoadDelayedObjects(bool useStubs)
		{
			ObjectSet toLoad = new ObjectSet();
			ObjectsQuery[] array = PrepareLoadDelayedObjects(toLoad);
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				LoadDataResult loadDataResult = InternalLoadData(array);
				EndLoadDelayedObjects(loadDataResult, toLoad, useStubs);
			}
			else
			{
				delayedObjects.Clear();
			}
		}

		private async Task LoadDelayedObjectsAsync(bool useStubs, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			ObjectSet toLoad = new ObjectSet();
			ObjectsQuery[] array = PrepareLoadDelayedObjects(toLoad);
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				EndLoadDelayedObjects(await InternalLoadDataAsync(array, cancellationToken), toLoad, useStubs);
			}
			else
