			}
		}

		public ICollection[] LoadObjects(ObjectsQuery[] queries)
		{
			session.WaitForAsyncOperationEnd();
			LoadObjectsContext loadObjectsContext = PrepareLoadObjects(queries);
			if (loadObjectsContext.LoadDataQuery == null)
			{
				return loadObjectsContext.Result;
			}
			SessionStateStack.Enter(Session, SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant);
			ICollection[] objs;
			try
			{
				objs = InternalLoadObjects(InternalLoadData(loadObjectsContext.LoadDataQuery), useStubs: false);
				while (delayedObjects.Count > 0)
				{
					LoadDelayedObjects(useStubs: false);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(Session, SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant);
			}
			return EndLoadObjects(loadObjectsContext, objs, proceesStubs: false);
		}

		public async Task<ICollection[]> LoadObjectsAsync(ObjectsQuery[] queries, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			LoadObjectsContext loadObjectsContext = await PrepareLoadObjectsAsync(queries, cancellationToken);
			if (loadObjectsContext.LoadDataQuery == null)
			{
				return loadObjectsContext.Result;
			}
			int asyncOperationId = SessionStateStack.GetNewAsyncOperationId();
			await SessionStateStack.EnterAsync(Session, SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			ICollection[] objs;
			try
			{
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				objs = InternalLoadObjects(await InternalLoadDataAsync(loadObjectsContext.LoadDataQuery, cancellationToken), useStubs: false);
				while (delayedObjects.Count > 0)
				{
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					await LoadDelayedObjectsAsync(useStubs: false, cancellationToken);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(Session, SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant, asyncOperationId);
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			return EndLoadObjects(loadObjectsContext, objs, proceesStubs: false);
		}

		private ObjectsQuery[] PrepareLoadDelayedObjects(ObjectSet toLoad)
		{
			//IL_00be: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cd: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<ObjectsQuery> list = new List<ObjectsQuery>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<XPClassInfo, IDictionary<object, object>> delayedObject in delayedObjects)
			{
				if (delayedObject.Value.Count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				List<object> list2 = new List<object>(delayedObject.Value.Keys);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<object, object> item in delayedObject.Value)
				{
					toLoad.Add(item.Value);
				}
				list2.Sort();
				int terminalInSize;
				for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i += terminalInSize)
				{
					terminalInSize = XpoDefault.GetTerminalInSize(list2.Count - i);
					list.Add(new ObjectsQuery(delayedObject.Key, (CriteriaOperator)new InOperator(delayedObject.Key.KeyProperty.Name, (IEnumerable)GetRangeHelper.GetRange(list2, i, terminalInSize)), null, 0, 0, null, force: false));
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private void EndLoadDelayedObjects(LoadDataResult loadDataResult, ObjectSet toLoad, bool useStubs)
		{
			ICollection[] array = InternalLoadObjects(loadDataResult, useStubs);
			foreach (ICollection collection in array)
			{
				foreach (object item in collection)
				{
					toLoad.Remove(item);
				}
			}
			if (toLoad.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Session.SuppressExceptionOnReferredObjectAbsentInDataStore)
			{
				foreach (object item2 in toLoad)
				{
					XPClassInfo type = ((!useStubs) ? Session.GetClassInfo(item2) : ((LoadStub)item2).ClassInfo);
					IDictionary<object, object> delayedList = GetDelayedList(type);
					foreach (KeyValuePair<object, object> item3 in delayedList)
					{
						if (item3.Value == item2)
						{
							delayedList.Remove(item3.Key);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			foreach (object item4 in toLoad)
			{
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = ((!useStubs) ? Session.GetClassInfo(item4) : ((LoadStub)item4).ClassInfo);
				IDictionary<object, object> delayedList2 = GetDelayedList(xPClassInfo);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<object, object> item5 in delayedList2)
				{
					if (item5.Value == item4)
					{
						if (text.Length > 0)
						{
							text += ", ";
						}
						text = text + xPClassInfo.FullName + "(" + item5.Key.ToString() + ")";
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			throw new CannotLoadObjectsException(text);
		}

		private ICollection[] InternalLoadObjects(LoadDataResult loadResult, bool useStubs)
		{
			ICollection[] array = new ICollection[loadResult.Result.ResultSet.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < loadResult.Result.ResultSet.Length; i++)
			{
				QueryData queryData = loadResult.Data[i];
				ObjectLoader objectLoader = new ObjectLoader(this, queryData, loadResult.Queries[i].ClassInfo, loadResult.Queries[i].Force, useStubs);
				queryData.SetData(loadResult.Result.ResultSet[i]);
				List<object> list = new List<object>(queryData.Count);
				while (queryData.MoveNext())
				{
					list.Add(objectLoader.LoadObject());
				}
				array[i] = list;
			}
			return array;
		}

		private LoadObjectsContext PrepareLoadObjects(ObjectsQuery[] queries)
		{
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (queries == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("queries");
			}
			List<ObjectsQuery> list = new List<ObjectsQuery>();
			ICollection[] array = new ICollection[queries.Length];
			ExpandedCriteriaHolder[] array2 = new ExpandedCriteriaHolder[queries.Length];
			bool[] array3 = new bool[queries.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < queries.Length; i++)
			{
				XPClassInfo classInfo = queries[i].ClassInfo;
				array2[i] = PersistentCriterionExpander.ExpandToLogical(Session, classInfo, queries[i].Criteria, doDetectPostProcessing: true);
				if (array2[i].IsFalse || (int)Session.UpdateSchema(true, classInfo) == 1)
				{
					array[i] = new object[0];
				}
				else
				{
					array3[i] = PrepareLoadObjectsProcessQuery(queries[i], array2[i], list);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return new LoadObjectsContext(queries, array, null, null);
			}
			return new LoadObjectsContext(queries, array, array2, array3, list.ToArray());
		}

		{

			for (int i = 0; i < queries.Length; i++)
			{

				expanded[i] = PersistentCriterionExpander.ExpandToLogical(Session, classInfo, queries[i].Criteria, doDetectPostProcessing: true);
				bool isFalse = expanded[i].IsFalse;
				bool flag = isFalse;
				if (!flag)

				}

				}
			}

		}

					if (expandedCriteriaHolder.RequiresPostProcessing)

			int num2 = query.TopSelectedRecords;

			{

				num = 0;

		}

		{
			SessionStateStack.Enter(Session, SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant);

					foreach (LoadStub value2 in value.Values)

						ProcessStub(value, value2);
					}

				for (int i = 0; i < objs.Length; i++)

			}
		}

		private ICollection[] EndLoadObjects(LoadObjectsContext loadObjectsContext, ICollection[] objs, bool proceesStubs)
		{
			if (proceesStubs)
			{
				objs = ProcessStubs(objs);
				Session.TriggerObjectsLoaded(ProcessFileLoaded(objectsToFireLoaded));
			}
			else
			{
				Session.TriggerObjectsLoaded(objectsToFireLoaded);
			}
			objectsToFireLoaded.Clear();
			ICollection[] result = loadObjectsContext.Result;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < loadObjectsContext.Queries.Length; i++)
			{
				if (result[i] != null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				ICollection collection = objs[num];
				num++;
				ObjectsQuery objectsQuery = loadObjectsContext.Queries[i];
				if (!objectsQuery.SkipDuplicateCheck)
				{
					ObjectSet objectSet = new ObjectSet(collection.Count);
					foreach (object item in collection)
					{
						objectSet.Add(item);
					}
					if (objectSet.Count < collection.Count)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("The result collection contains duplicate objects.");
					}
					objectSet = null;
				}
				bool requiresPostProcessing = loadObjectsContext.Expanded[i].RequiresPostProcessing;
				bool flag = loadObjectsContext.RequiresResorting[i];
				if (flag && (objectsQuery.SkipSelectedRecords != 0 || (objectsQuery.TopSelectedRecords != 0 && collection.Count > objectsQuery.TopSelectedRecords)))
				{
					collection = ReSort(collection, objectsQuery);
					flag = false;
					if (!requiresPostProcessing)
					{
						collection = GetSkipTopRows(collection, objectsQuery);
					}
				}
				if (requiresPostProcessing)
				{
					collection = ReFilter(collection, objectsQuery);
					requiresPostProcessing = false;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					collection = ReSort(collection, objectsQuery);
					flag = false;
				}
				result[i] = collection;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private ICollection GetSkipTopRows(ICollection rows, ObjectsQuery currentQuery)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>(currentQuery.TopSelectedRecords);
			int num = currentQuery.SkipSelectedRecords;
			foreach (object row in rows)
			{
				if (num > 0)
				{
					num--;
					continue;
				}
				list.Add(row);
				if (list.Count != currentQuery.TopSelectedRecords)
				{
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
			return list;
		}

		private ICollection ReSort(ICollection rows, ObjectsQuery currentQuery)
		{
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (rows.Count <= 1)
			{
				return rows;
			}
			IComparer comparer = XPCollectionCompareHelper.CreateComparer(currentQuery.Sorting, currentQuery.ClassInfo.GetCriteriaCompilerDescriptor(Session), new CriteriaCompilerAuxSettings(Session.CaseSensitive, Session.Dictionary.CustomFunctionOperators));
			object[] array = ListHelper.FromCollection(rows).ToArray();
			Array.Sort(array, comparer);
			return array;
		}

		private ICollection ReFilter(ICollection rows, ObjectsQuery currentQuery)
		{
			if (rows.Count == 0)
			{
				return rows;
			}
			Func<object, bool> func = XPBaseCollection.CreatePredicate(Session, currentQuery.ClassInfo, currentQuery.Criteria, Session.CaseSensitive);
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			int num = currentQuery.SkipSelectedRecords;
			foreach (object row in rows)
			{
				if (!func(row))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					num--;
					continue;
				}
				list.Add(row);
				if (currentQuery.TopSelectedRecords != list.Count)
				{
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
			return list;
		}

		public bool HasObjectLoaded(object theObject)
		{
			return objectsToFireLoaded.Contains(theObject);
		}
	}
	public class ParentCriteriaGenerator : ClientCriteriaVisitorBase
	{
		protected readonly Session session;

		protected readonly Session parent;

		protected readonly NestedParentMap map;

		protected readonly ISecurityRuleProvider securityDictionary;

		protected readonly object securityContext;

		protected ParentCriteriaGenerator(NestedUnitOfWork nuow)
			: this(nuow, nuow.Parent, nuow.Map, null)
		{
		}

		protected ParentCriteriaGenerator(Session session, Session parentSession, NestedParentMap map, SecurityContext securityContext)
		{
			this.session = session;
			parent = parentSession;
			this.map = map;
			this.securityContext = securityContext;
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (session.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(theOperand.Value) == null)
			{
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
			}
			object value = theOperand.Value;
			if (!(value is ISessionProvider sessionProvider) || sessionProvider.Session != parent)
			{
				value = NestedWorksHelper.GetParentObject(session, parent, map, value);
				if (theOperand is ConstantValue)
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)new ConstantValue(value);
				}
				return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue(value);
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator GetNestedCriteria(NestedUnitOfWork nuow, CriteriaOperator op)
		{
			return ((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)new ParentCriteriaGenerator(nuow)).Process(op);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator GetNestedCriteria(Session session, Session parent, NestedParentMap map, SecurityContext securityContext, CriteriaOperator op)
		{
			return ((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)new ParentCriteriaGenerator(session, parent, map, securityContext)).Process(op);
		}

	public abstract class NestedParentMap
	{
		public static NestedParentMap Extract(NestedUnitOfWork source)
		{
			return source.Map;
		}

		protected NestedParentMap(Session session)
		{
			session.AfterDropIdentityMap += AfterDropIdentityMapHandler;
		}

		private void AfterDropIdentityMapHandler(object sender, SessionManipulationEventArgs e)
		{
			Clear();
		}

		public abstract void Add(object parent, object nested, bool hasValidKey);

		public abstract object GetParent(object nested);

		public abstract object GetNested(object parent);

		public abstract void KickOut(object nested);

		public abstract void Clear();
	}
	public class WeakNestedParentMap : StrongNestedParentMap
	{
		private Dictionary<ObjectRecord, ObjectRecord> Parents = new Dictionary<ObjectRecord, ObjectRecord>();

		private Dictionary<ObjectRecord, ObjectRecord> Nesteds = new Dictionary<ObjectRecord, ObjectRecord>();

		public WeakNestedParentMap(Session session)
			: base(session)
		{
		}

		public override void Add(object parent, object nested, bool hasValidKey)
		{
			if (hasValidKey)
			{
				ObjectRecord objectRecord = ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(parent);
				ObjectRecord objectRecord2 = ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(nested);
				Nesteds[objectRecord] = objectRecord2;
				Parents[objectRecord2] = objectRecord;
			}
			else
			{
				base.Add(parent, nested, hasValidKey);
			}
		}

		public override object GetParent(object nested)
		{
			object parent = base.GetParent(nested);
			if (parent != null)
			{
				return parent;
			}
			ObjectRecord objectRecord = ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(nested);
			if (Parents.TryGetValue(objectRecord, out var value))
			{
				return value.Object;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override object GetNested(object parent)
		{
			object nested = base.GetNested(parent);
			if (nested != null)
			{
				return nested;
			}
			ObjectRecord objectRecord = ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(parent);
			if (Nesteds.TryGetValue(objectRecord, out var value))
			{
				return value.Object;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void KickOut(object nested)
		{
			base.KickOut(nested);
			ObjectRecord objectRecord = ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(nested);
			if (Parents.TryGetValue(objectRecord, out var value))
			{
				Parents.Remove(objectRecord);
				Nesteds.Remove(value);
			}
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			base.Clear();
			Parents.Clear();
			Nesteds.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class StrongNestedParentMap : NestedParentMap
	{
		private ObjectDictionary<object> Parents = new ObjectDictionary<object>();

		private ObjectDictionary<object> Nesteds = new ObjectDictionary<object>();

		public StrongNestedParentMap(Session session)
			: base(session)
		{
		}

		public override void Add(object parent, object nested, bool hasValidKey)
		{
			Parents.Add(nested, parent);
			Nesteds.Add(parent, nested);
		}

		public override object GetParent(object nested)
		{
			if (Parents.TryGetValue(nested, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override object GetNested(object parent)
		{
			if (Nesteds.TryGetValue(parent, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void KickOut(object nested)
		{
			if (Parents.TryGetValue(nested, out var value))
			{
				Parents.Remove(nested);
				Nesteds.Remove(value);
			}
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			Parents.Clear();
			Nesteds.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class NestedLoader
	{
		private struct ObjectPair
		{
			public readonly object Source;

			public readonly object Destination;

			public readonly OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior LoadMerge;

			public ObjectPair(object source, object destination, OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior loadMerge)
			{
				Source = source;
				Destination = destination;
				LoadMerge = loadMerge;
			}
		}

		private struct ObjectGroup
		{
			public readonly IList<ObjectPair> Processed;

			public readonly string[] PreFetchPaths;

			public ObjectGroup(IList<ObjectPair> processed, string[] preFetchPaths)
			{
				Processed = processed;
				PreFetchPaths = preFetchPaths;
			}
		}

		private readonly Queue<ObjectPair> toProcess = new Queue<ObjectPair>();

		private readonly NestedParentMap Map;

		private readonly SecurityContext SecurityContext;

		public readonly Session Owner;

		public readonly Session OwnerParent;

		private static Func<object, object> ReturnArgument = (object arg) => arg;

		public NestedLoader(Session owner, Session ownerParent, NestedParentMap map, SecurityContext securityContext)
		{
			Owner = owner;
			OwnerParent = ownerParent;
			Map = map;
			SecurityContext = securityContext;
		}

		public NestedLoader(Session owner, Session ownerParent, NestedParentMap map)
			: this(owner, ownerParent, map, null)
		{
		}

		public NestedLoader(NestedUnitOfWork owner)
			: this(owner, owner.Parent, NestedParentMap.Extract(owner))
		{
		}

		private void BeginCloneObjects(ObjectDictionary<object> processedPairs, List<object> toFireLoaded, IDictionary<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup> processed)
		{
			do
			{
				ObjectPair item = toProcess.Dequeue();
				toFireLoaded.Add(item.Destination);
				ProcessObjectPropertiesToCloneObject(item.Source, processedPairs);
				ProcessCollectionPropertiesToCloneObject(item.Source, processedPairs);
				GetProcessedGroup(Owner.GetClassInfo(item.Source), processed).Processed.Add(item);
			}
			while (toProcess.Count > 0);
		}

		private ObjectGroup GetProcessedGroup(XPClassInfo classInfo, IDictionary<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup> processed)
		{
			if (!processed.TryGetValue(classInfo, out var value))
			{
				string[] array3;
				if (SecurityContext != null)
				{
					HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
					foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
					{
						if (persistentProperty.IsReadOnly || persistentProperty.IsDelayed || !SecurityContext.GetSelectMemberExpression(classInfo, persistentProperty, out var memberExpression))
						{
							continue;
						}
						CriteriaOperator expandedCriteria = PersistentCriterionExpander.Expand(OwnerParent, classInfo, memberExpression).ExpandedCriteria;
						bool hasJoinOperand;
						string[] array = SecurityContext.FindDelayedProperties(classInfo, expandedCriteria, out hasJoinOperand);
						if (!hasJoinOperand)
						{
							string[] array2 = array;
							foreach (string item in array2)
							{
								hashSet.Add(item);
							}
						}
					}
					array3 = new string[hashSet.Count];
					hashSet.CopyTo(array3);
				}
				else
				{
					array3 = new string[0];
				}
				value = new ObjectGroup(new List<ObjectPair>(), array3);
				processed.Add(classInfo, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void ProcessObjectPropertiesToCloneObject(object source, ObjectDictionary<object> processedPairs)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = Owner.GetClassInfo(source);
			foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in classInfo.ObjectProperties)
			{
				if (objectProperty.IsReadOnly)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (objectProperty.IsDelayed)
				{
					XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(source, objectProperty);
					if (!delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded || delayedPropertyContainer.Value == null || (!OwnerParent.IsNewObject(source) && !OwnerParent.IsNewObject(delayedPropertyContainer.Value)))
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				object value = objectProperty.GetValue(source);
				if (value != null && !processedPairs.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
				{
					value2 = GetNestedObjectCore(value, forceLoad: false);
					processedPairs.Add(value, value2);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessCollectionPropertiesToCloneObject(object source, ObjectDictionary<object> processedPairs)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = Owner.GetClassInfo(source);
			foreach (XPMemberInfo collectionProperty in classInfo.CollectionProperties)
			{
				XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)collectionProperty.GetValue(source);
				if (xPBaseCollection == null || !xPBaseCollection.IsLoaded)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (object intObj in xPBaseCollection.Helper.IntObjList)
				{
					if (!(intObj is IXPInvalidateableObject { IsInvalidated: not false }) && !processedPairs.TryGetValue(intObj, out var value))
					{
						value = GetNestedObjectCore(intObj, forceLoad: false);
						processedPairs.Add(intObj, value);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void EndCloneObjects(IDictionary<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup> processed, ObjectDictionary<object> processedPairs)
		{
			SessionStateStack.Enter(OwnerParent, SessionState.LoadingObjectsIntoNestedUow);
			try
			{
				EndCloneObjectsCore(processed, processedPairs);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(OwnerParent, SessionState.LoadingObjectsIntoNestedUow);
			}
		}

		private async Task EndCloneObjectsAsync(IDictionary<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup> processed, ObjectDictionary<object> processedPairs, int asyncOperationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			await SessionStateStack.EnterAsync(OwnerParent, SessionState.LoadingObjectsIntoNestedUow, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			try
			{
				EndCloneObjectsCore(processed, processedPairs);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(OwnerParent, SessionState.LoadingObjectsIntoNestedUow, asyncOperationId);
			}
		}

		private void EndCloneObjectsCore(IDictionary<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup> processed, ObjectDictionary<object> processedPairs)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup> item in processed)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < item.Value.Processed.Count; i++)
				{
					ObjectPair objectPair = item.Value.Processed[i];
					Owner.TriggerObjectLoading(objectPair.Destination);
					CloneData(objectPair.Source, objectPair.Destination, objectPair.LoadMerge, processedPairs);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CloneData(object source, object destination, OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior loadMerge, ObjectDictionary<object> processedPairs)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = Owner.GetClassInfo(source);
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
			{
				if (persistentProperty.IsReadOnly)
				{
					continue;
				}
				object obj = null;
				if (persistentProperty.IsDelayed && !OwnerParent.IsNewObject(source))
				{
					if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType == null)
					{
						if (ObjectCollectionLoader.AcceptLoadPropertyAndResetModified(Owner.TrackPropertiesModifications, loadMerge, destination, classInfo, persistentProperty, ReturnArgument, null))
						{
							XPDelayedProperty.Init(Owner, destination, persistentProperty, null);
						}
						continue;
					}
					bool flag = false;
					XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(source, persistentProperty);
					object obj2 = null;
					if (!delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded)
					{
						obj2 = delayedPropertyContainer.InternalValue;
					}
					else
					{
						obj = delayedPropertyContainer.Value;
						if (obj != null)
						{
							if (OwnerParent.IsNewObject(obj))
							{
								flag = true;
							}
							else
							{
								obj = persistentProperty.ReferenceType.GetId(obj);
							}
						}
						obj2 = obj;
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						if (ObjectCollectionLoader.AcceptLoadPropertyAndResetModified(Owner.TrackPropertiesModifications, loadMerge, destination, classInfo, persistentProperty, ReturnArgument, obj2))
						{
							XPDelayedProperty.Init(Owner, destination, persistentProperty, obj2);
						}
						continue;
					}
				}
				obj = ((SecurityContext == null) ? persistentProperty.GetValue(source) : SecurityContext.GetValueBySecurityRule(source, persistentProperty));
				if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType != null && obj != null)
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					if (!processedPairs.TryGetValue(obj, out var value))
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
					else
					{
						obj = NestedWorksHelper.TryGetNestedObject(OwnerParent, Map, obj);
						flag2 = obj != value;
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("NestedSession_NotClonable", classInfo.FullName, persistentProperty.Name));
					}
				}
				if (ObjectCollectionLoader.AcceptLoadPropertyAndResetModified(Owner.TrackPropertiesModifications, loadMerge, destination, classInfo, persistentProperty, ReturnArgument, obj))
				{
					persistentProperty.SetValue(destination, obj);
				}
			}
		}

		private object CreateNestedObject(object pObject, bool forceLoad)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = Owner.GetClassInfo(pObject);
			if (Owner.ObjectLayer.IsStaticType(classInfo))
			{
				Map.Add(pObject, pObject, hasValidKey: true);
				return pObject;
			}
			if (SecurityContext != null)
			{
				ISecurityRule securityRule = null;
				ISecurityRule2 securityRule2 = null;
				if (SecurityContext.SecurityRuleProvider is ISecurityRuleProvider2 { Enabled: not false } securityRuleProvider)
				{
					securityRule2 = securityRuleProvider.GetRule(classInfo);
				}
				else
				{
					securityRule = SecurityContext.SecurityRuleProvider.GetRule(classInfo);
				}
				if (securityRule != null && !SecurityContext.IsSystemClass(classInfo) && !securityRule.ValidateObjectOnSelect(SecurityContext, classInfo, pObject))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (securityRule2 != null && !SecurityContext.IsSystemClass(classInfo) && !securityRule2.ValidateObjectOnSelect(SecurityContext, classInfo, pObject))
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = OwnerParent.IsNewObject(pObject);
			object nObject;
			if (flag2)
			{
				nObject = classInfo.CreateObject(Owner);
			}
			else
			{
				object id = classInfo.GetId(pObject);
				nObject = Owner.GetLoadedObjectByKey(classInfo, id);
				if (nObject == null)
				{
					nObject = classInfo.CreateObject(Owner);
					SessionIdentityMap.RegisterObject(Owner, nObject, id);
				}
				else
				{
					Map.KickOut(nObject);
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			Map.Add(pObject, nObject, !flag2);
			OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior loadMergeState = OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Default;
			if (!flag || ObjectCollectionLoader.NeedReload(Owner, classInfo, forceLoad, out loadMergeState, () => IsObjectVersionChanged(nObject, pObject)))
			{
				toProcess.Enqueue(new ObjectPair(pObject, nObject, loadMergeState));
			}
			return nObject;
		}

		public bool IsObjectVersionChanged(object nestedObject, object parentObject)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = Owner.GetClassInfo(parentObject);
			if (classInfo.OptimisticLockField == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int?)classInfo.OptimisticLockField.GetValue(nestedObject) != (int?)classInfo.OptimisticLockField.GetValue(parentObject))
			{
				return (int?)classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer.GetValue(nestedObject) != (int?)classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer.GetValue(parentObject);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private object GetNestedObjectCore(object parentObject, bool forceLoad)
		{
			object rv = NestedWorksHelper.TryGetNestedObject(OwnerParent, Map, parentObject);
			if (rv != null)
			{
				if (!(rv is IXPInvalidateableObject { IsInvalidated: not false }))
				{
					OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior loadMergeState = OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Default;
					if (ObjectCollectionLoader.NeedReload(Owner, Owner.GetClassInfo(parentObject), forceLoad, out loadMergeState, () => IsObjectVersionChanged(rv, parentObject)))
					{
						toProcess.Enqueue(new ObjectPair(parentObject, rv, loadMergeState));
					}
					return rv;
				}
				Map.KickOut(rv);
			}
			rv = CreateNestedObject(parentObject, forceLoad);
			return rv;
		}

		public ICollection[] GetNestedObjects(ICollection[] parentObjects)
		{
			return GetNestedObjects(parentObjects, null);
		}

		public Task<ICollection[]> GetNestedObjectsAsync(ICollection[] parentObjects, int asyncOperationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			return GetNestedObjectsAsync(parentObjects, null, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
		}

		public ICollection[] GetNestedObjects(ICollection[] parentObjects, bool[] force)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			SessionStateStack.Enter(Owner, SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant);
			ICollection[] nestedObjectsCore;
			try
			{
				nestedObjectsCore = GetNestedObjectsCore(parentObjects, force, list);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(Owner, SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant);
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				Owner.TriggerObjectsLoaded(list);
			}
			return nestedObjectsCore;
		}

		public async Task<ICollection[]> GetNestedObjectsAsync(ICollection[] parentObjects, bool[] force, int asyncOperationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			List<object> objectsToFireLoaded = new List<object>();
			await SessionStateStack.EnterAsync(Owner, SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			ICollection[] result;
			try
			{
				result = await GetNestedObjectsCoreAsync(parentObjects, force, objectsToFireLoaded, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(Owner, SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant, asyncOperationId);
			}
			if (objectsToFireLoaded.Count > 0)
			{
				Owner.TriggerObjectsLoaded(objectsToFireLoaded);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private ICollection[] GetNestedObjectsCore(ICollection[] parentObjects, bool[] force, List<object> outObjectsToFireLoaded)
		{
			ICollection[] result = ProcessParentObjectsForGetNestedObjects(parentObjects, force, outObjectsToFireLoaded);
			ProcessObjectsToFireLoadedForGetNestedObjects(outObjectsToFireLoaded);
			return result;
		}

		private async Task<ICollection[]> GetNestedObjectsCoreAsync(ICollection[] parentObjects, bool[] force, List<object> outObjectsToFireLoaded, int asyncOperationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			ICollection[] result = await ProcessParentObjectsForGetNestedObjectsAsync(parentObjects, force, outObjectsToFireLoaded, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			ProcessObjectsToFireLoadedForGetNestedObjects(outObjectsToFireLoaded);
			return result;
		}

		private ICollection[] ProcessParentObjectsForGetNestedObjects(ICollection[] parentObjects, bool[] force, List<object> outObjectsToFireLoaded)
		{
			ObjectDictionary<object> processedPairs = new ObjectDictionary<object>();
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			IDictionary<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup> dictionary = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup>();
			ICollection[] result = BeginProcessParentObjectsForGetNestedObjects(parentObjects, force, processedPairs, list, dictionary);
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup> item in dictionary)
			{
				if (item.Value.PreFetchPaths.Length == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				list2.Clear();
				foreach (ObjectPair item2 in item.Value.Processed)
				{
					list2.Add(item2.Source);
				}
				OwnerParent.PreFetch(item.Key, list2, item.Value.PreFetchPaths);
			}
			EndCloneObjects(dictionary, processedPairs);
			outObjectsToFireLoaded.AddRange(list);
			return result;
		}

		private async Task<ICollection[]> ProcessParentObjectsForGetNestedObjectsAsync(ICollection[] parentObjects, bool[] force, List<object> outObjectsToFireLoaded, int asyncOperationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			ObjectDictionary<object> processedPairs = new ObjectDictionary<object>();
			List<object> toFireLoaded = new List<object>();
			IDictionary<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup> processed = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup>();
			ICollection[] result = await BeginProcessParentObjectsForGetNestedObjectsAsync(parentObjects, force, processedPairs, toFireLoaded, processed, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			List<object> objects = new List<object>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup> item in processed)
			{
				if (item.Value.PreFetchPaths.Length == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				objects.Clear();
				foreach (ObjectPair item2 in item.Value.Processed)
				{
					objects.Add(item2.Source);
				}
				await OwnerParent.PreFetchAsync(item.Key, objects, cancellationToken, item.Value.PreFetchPaths);
			}
			await EndCloneObjectsAsync(processed, processedPairs, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			outObjectsToFireLoaded.AddRange(toFireLoaded);
			return result;
		}

		private ICollection[] BeginProcessParentObjectsForGetNestedObjects(ICollection[] parentObjects, bool[] force, ObjectDictionary<object> processedPairs, List<object> toFireLoaded, IDictionary<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup> processed)
		{
			SessionStateStack.Enter(OwnerParent, SessionState.LoadingObjectsIntoNestedUow);
			try
			{
				return BeginProcessParentObjectsForGetNestedObjectsCore(parentObjects, force, processedPairs, toFireLoaded, processed);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(OwnerParent, SessionState.LoadingObjectsIntoNestedUow);
			}
		}

		private async Task<ICollection[]> BeginProcessParentObjectsForGetNestedObjectsAsync(ICollection[] parentObjects, bool[] force, ObjectDictionary<object> processedPairs, List<object> toFireLoaded, IDictionary<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup> processed, int asyncOperationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			await SessionStateStack.EnterAsync(OwnerParent, SessionState.LoadingObjectsIntoNestedUow, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			try
			{
				return BeginProcessParentObjectsForGetNestedObjectsCore(parentObjects, force, processedPairs, toFireLoaded, processed);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(OwnerParent, SessionState.LoadingObjectsIntoNestedUow, asyncOperationId);
			}
		}

		private ICollection[] BeginProcessParentObjectsForGetNestedObjectsCore(ICollection[] parentObjects, bool[] force, ObjectDictionary<object> processedPairs, List<object> toFireLoaded, IDictionary<XPClassInfo, ObjectGroup> processed)
		{
			ICollection[] array = new ICollection[parentObjects.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < parentObjects.Length; i++)
			{
				bool forceLoad = force != null && force[i];
				List<object> list = new List<object>(parentObjects[i].Count);
				foreach (object item in parentObjects[i])
				{
					if (item == null)
					{
						list.Add(null);
						continue;
					}
					object nestedObjectCore = GetNestedObjectCore(item, forceLoad);
					if (nestedObjectCore != null)
					{
						list.Add(nestedObjectCore);
					}
				}
				array[i] = list;
			}
			if (toProcess.Count > 0)
			{
				BeginCloneObjects(processedPairs, toFireLoaded, processed);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private void ProcessObjectsToFireLoadedForGetNestedObjects(IList objectsToFireLoaded)
		{
			foreach (object item in objectsToFireLoaded)
			{
				XPClassInfo classInfo = Owner.GetClassInfo(item);
				XPMemberInfo optimisticLockField = classInfo.OptimisticLockField;
				if (optimisticLockField != null)
				{
					classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer.SetValue(item, optimisticLockField.GetValue(item));
				}
			}
		}

		public object GetNestedObject(object parentObject)
		{
			ICollection[] nestedObjects = GetNestedObjects(new ICollection[1] { new object[1] { parentObject } });
			IEnumerator enumerator = nestedObjects[0].GetEnumerator();
			enumerator.MoveNext();
			return enumerator.Current;
		}
	}
	internal static class NestedWorksHelper
	{
		public static object CommitObject(Session session, Session parentSession, NestedParentMap map, object obj, XPMemberInfo[] membersNotToSave)
		{
			object obj2 = CreateParentObject(session, parentSession, map, obj);
			XPClassInfo classInfo = session.GetClassInfo(obj);
			parentSession.TriggerObjectLoading(obj2);
			bool flag = classInfo.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? parentSession.TrackPropertiesModifications;
			bool flag2 = classInfo.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? session.TrackPropertiesModifications;
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
			{
				if ((persistentProperty.IsDelayed && !XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(obj, persistentProperty).IsLoaded) || persistentProperty.IsReadOnly || persistentProperty.IsFetchOnly || (membersNotToSave != null && Array.IndexOf(membersNotToSave, persistentProperty) >= 0))
				{
					continue;
				}
				object obj3 = persistentProperty.GetValue(obj);
				if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType != null && obj3 != null)
				{
					obj3 = CreateParentObject(session, parentSession, map, obj3);
				}
				if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType != null)
				{
					object value = persistentProperty.GetValue(obj2);
					persistentProperty.SetValue(obj2, obj3);
					if (flag && !PersistentBase.CanSkipAssignment(value, obj3))
					{
						persistentProperty.SetModified(obj2, value);
					}
					persistentProperty.ProcessAssociationRefChange(parentSession, obj2, value, obj3);
				}
				else if (flag)
				{
					object value2 = persistentProperty.GetValue(obj2);
					persistentProperty.SetValue(obj2, obj3);
					if (!PersistentBase.CanSkipAssignment(value2, obj3))
					{
						persistentProperty.SetModified(obj2, value2);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					persistentProperty.SetValue(obj2, obj3);
				}
			}
			if (obj2 is IntermediateObject && parentSession.IsNewObject(obj2))
			{
				IntermediateObject intermediateObject = (IntermediateObject)obj2;
				IntermediateClassInfo intermediateClassInfo = (IntermediateClassInfo)parentSession.GetClassInfo(intermediateObject);
				XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)intermediateClassInfo.intermediateObjectFieldInfoRight.refProperty.GetValue(intermediateObject.LeftIntermediateObjectField);
				XPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany xPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany = (XPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany)xPBaseCollection.Helper;
				xPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany.AddIntermediateObject(intermediateObject, intermediateObject.RightIntermediateObjectField);
				xPBaseCollection.BaseAdd(intermediateObject.RightIntermediateObjectField);
			}
			return obj2;
		}

		public static void CommitDeletedObject(Session session, Session parentSession, NestedParentMap map, object obj)
		{
			object parentObject = GetParentObject(session, parentSession, map, obj);
			if (parentObject == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XPClassInfo classInfo = session.GetClassInfo(obj);
			bool flag = classInfo.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? parentSession.TrackPropertiesModifications;
			bool flag2 = classInfo.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? session.TrackPropertiesModifications;
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
			{
				if (flag2 && flag && persistentProperty.GetModified(obj) && !persistentProperty.GetModified(parentObject))
				{
					persistentProperty.SetModified(parentObject, persistentProperty.GetValue(parentObject));
				}
			}
			if (obj is IntermediateObject)
			{
				IntermediateObject intermediateObject = (IntermediateObject)parentObject;
				IntermediateClassInfo intermediateClassInfo = (IntermediateClassInfo)parentSession.GetClassInfo(intermediateObject);
				if (intermediateObject.LeftIntermediateObjectField != null && intermediateObject.RightIntermediateObjectField != null)
				{
					XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)intermediateClassInfo.intermediateObjectFieldInfoRight.refProperty.GetValue(intermediateObject.LeftIntermediateObjectField);
					xPBaseCollection.BaseRemove(intermediateObject.RightIntermediateObjectField);
				}
			}
			parentSession.Delete(parentObject);
		}

		public static object CreateParentObject(Session session, Session parentSession, NestedParentMap map, object obj)
		{
			object parentObject = GetParentObject(session, parentSession, map, obj);
			if (parentObject != null)
			{
				return parentObject;
			}
			parentObject = session.GetClassInfo(obj).CreateObject(parentSession);
			map.Add(parentObject, obj, !session.IsNewObject(obj));
			return parentObject;
		}

		public static void ValidateVersions(Session session, Session parentSession, NestedParentMap map, ObjectSet lockedParentsObjects, ICollection nestedObjects, LockingOption lockingOption, bool objectsForDelete)
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00db: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (object nestedObject in nestedObjects)
			{
				object parentObject = GetParentObject(session, parentSession, map, nestedObject);
				if (parentObject == null)
				{
					if (!session.IsNewObject(nestedObject))
					{
						throw new LockingException();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (lockedParentsObjects.Contains(parentObject))
					{
						continue;
					}
					lockedParentsObjects.Add(parentObject);
					if (session.IsNewObject(nestedObject) != parentSession.IsNewObject(parentObject))
					{
						throw new LockingException();
					}
					XPClassInfo classInfo = session.GetClassInfo(nestedObject);
					if (lockingOption != LockingOption.Optimistic)
					{
						continue;
					}
					OptimisticLockingBehavior optimisticLockingBehavior = classInfo.OptimisticLockingBehavior;
					switch (optimisticLockingBehavior)
					{
					case OptimisticLockingBehavior.ConsiderOptimisticLockingField:
					{
						XPMemberInfo optimisticLockField = classInfo.OptimisticLockField;
						if (optimisticLockField != null && (int?)optimisticLockField.GetValue(parentObject) != (int?)classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer.GetValue(nestedObject))
						{
							throw new LockingException();
						}
						break;
					}
					case OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockModified:
					case OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockAll:
						if (LockingHelper.HasModified(classInfo, classInfo.PersistentProperties, nestedObject, parentObject, objectsForDelete ? OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockAll : optimisticLockingBehavior))
						{
							throw new LockingException();
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static object GetParentObject(Session session, Session parentSession, NestedParentMap map, object obj)
		{
			session.ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(obj);
			object parent = map.GetParent(obj);
			if (parent != null)
			{
				return parent;
			}
			if (session.IsNewObject(obj))
			{
				return parent;
			}
			XPClassInfo classInfo = session.GetClassInfo(obj);
			object id = classInfo.GetId(obj);
			parent = parentSession.GetObjectByKey(classInfo, id);
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			map.Add(parent, obj, hasValidKey: true);
			return parent;
		}

		public static async Task<object> GetParentObjectAsync(Session session, Session parentSession, NestedParentMap map, object obj, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			session.ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(obj);
			object parent = map.GetParent(obj);
			if (parent != null)
			{
				return parent;
			}
			if (session.IsNewObject(obj))
			{
				return parent;
			}
			XPClassInfo classInfo = session.GetClassInfo(obj);
			object id = classInfo.GetId(obj);
			parent = await parentSession.GetObjectByKeyAsync(classInfo, id, cancellationToken);
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			map.Add(parent, obj, hasValidKey: true);
			return parent;
		}

		public static object GetNestedObject(Session session, Session parentSession, NestedParentMap map, object obj)
		{
			return GetNestedObject(session, parentSession, map, obj, null);
		}

		public static object GetNestedObject(Session session, Session parentSession, NestedParentMap map, object obj, SecurityContext securityContext)
		{
			object obj2 = TryGetNestedObject(parentSession, map, obj);
			if (obj2 == null)
			{
				return new NestedLoader(session, parentSession, map, securityContext).GetNestedObject(obj);
			}
			return obj2;
		}

		public static object TryGetNestedObject(Session parent, NestedParentMap map, object obj)
		{
			parent.ThrowIfObjectFromDifferentSession(obj);
			return map.GetNested(obj);
		}

					object value3 = persistentProperty.GetValue(obj2);

						persistentProperty.SetValue(obj2, obj3);

			}

	public class FieldsClassBase : OperandProperty
	{
		public FieldsClassBase()
			: base(string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public FieldsClassBase(string propertyName)
			: base(propertyName)
		{
		}

		protected string GetNestedName(string nestedPropertyName)
		{
			if (((OperandProperty)this).PropertyName == null || ((OperandProperty)this).PropertyName.Length == 0)
			{
				return nestedPropertyName;
			}
			return ((OperandProperty)this).PropertyName + "." + nestedPropertyName;

	public abstract class XPPropertyDescriptorBase : PropertyDescriptor
	{
		internal abstract class ValueAccessor
		{
			public abstract string ChangedPropertyName { get; }

			public virtual bool IsReferenceAsCollection => false;

			public abstract object GetValue(object obj);

			public abstract bool SetValue(object obj, object value);
		}

		internal class MemberAccessor : ValueAccessor
		{
			protected readonly XPMemberInfo Member;

			private bool upCast;

			public override string ChangedPropertyName => Member.Name;

			public MemberAccessor(XPClassInfo objectType, XPMemberInfo member)
			{
				Member = member;
				upCast = !objectType.IsAssignableTo(member.Owner);
			}

			public override object GetValue(object obj)
			{
				if (obj == null || (upCast && !Member.Owner.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(obj).IsAssignableTo(Member.Owner)))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Member.GetValue(obj);
			}

			public override bool SetValue(object obj, object value)
			{
				if (obj == null || (upCast && !Member.Owner.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(obj).IsAssignableTo(Member.Owner)))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (PersistentBase.CanSkipAssignment(GetValue(obj), value))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (obj is IXPReceiveOnChangedFromXPPropertyDescriptor iXPReceiveOnChangedFromXPPropertyDescriptor)
				{
					iXPReceiveOnChangedFromXPPropertyDescriptor.BeforeChangeByXPPropertyDescriptor();
					try
					{
						Member.SetValue(obj, value);
						iXPReceiveOnChangedFromXPPropertyDescriptor.FireChangedByXPPropertyDescriptor(ChangedPropertyName);
					}
					finally
					{
						iXPReceiveOnChangedFromXPPropertyDescriptor.AfterChangeByXPPropertyDescriptor();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Member.SetValue(obj, value);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal class RelationAsCollectionAccessor : MemberAccessor
		{
			private Session session;

			public override bool IsReferenceAsCollection => true;

			public RelationAsCollectionAccessor(XPClassInfo objectType, XPMemberInfo member, Session session)
				: base(objectType, member)
			{
				this.session = session;
			}

			public override object GetValue(object obj)
			{
				XPCollection xPCollection = new XPCollection(session, Member.ReferenceType, loadingEnabled: false);
				GC.SuppressFinalize(xPCollection);
				xPCollection.BindingBehavior = CollectionBindingBehavior.AllowNew | CollectionBindingBehavior.AllowRemove;
				object value = base.GetValue(obj);
				if (value != null)
				{
					xPCollection.BaseAdd(value);
				}
				return xPCollection;
			}

			public override bool SetValue(object obj, object value)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Object_ReferencePropertyViaCollectionAccessor"));
			}
		}

		internal class RelationAsKeyAccessor : MemberAccessor
		{
			private Session session;

			private ISessionProvider sessionProvider;

			public RelationAsKeyAccessor(XPClassInfo objectType, XPMemberInfo member, Session session)
				: base(objectType, member)
			{
				this.session = session;
			}

			public RelationAsKeyAccessor(XPClassInfo objectType, XPMemberInfo member, ISessionProvider sessionProvider)
				: base(objectType, member)
			{
				this.sessionProvider = sessionProvider;
			}

			public override object GetValue(object obj)
			{
				object value = base.GetValue(obj);
				if (value == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return GetSession(obj)?.GetKeyValue(value);
			}

			public override bool SetValue(object obj, object value)
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					Session session = GetSession(obj);
					if (session == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					value = session.GetObjectByKey(Member.ReferenceType, value);
				}
				return base.SetValue(obj, value);
			}

			private Session GetSession(object obj)
			{
				if (session != null)
				{
					return session;
				}
				if (sessionProvider != null && sessionProvider.Session != null)
				{
					return sessionProvider.Session;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal class RelatedMemberAccessor : MemberAccessor
		{
			private ValueAccessor next;

			private string changedPropertyName;

			public override string ChangedPropertyName
			{
				get
				{
					if (changedPropertyName == null)
					{
						changedPropertyName = Member.Name + "." + next.ChangedPropertyName;
					}
					return changedPropertyName;
				}
			}

			public RelatedMemberAccessor(XPClassInfo objectType, XPMemberInfo member, ValueAccessor next)
				: base(objectType, member)
			{
				this.next = next;
				changedPropertyName = null;
			}

			public override object GetValue(object obj)
			{
				return next.GetValue(base.GetValue(obj));
			}

			public override bool SetValue(object obj, object value)
			{
				bool flag = next.SetValue(base.GetValue(obj), value);
				if (flag && obj is IXPReceiveOnChangedFromXPPropertyDescriptor iXPReceiveOnChangedFromXPPropertyDescriptor)
				{
					iXPReceiveOnChangedFromXPPropertyDescriptor.FireChangedByXPPropertyDescriptor(ChangedPropertyName);
				}
				return flag;
			}
		}

		internal class DesignAccessor : ValueAccessor
		{
			protected readonly Type MemberType;

			protected readonly Session Session;

			protected readonly ISessionProvider SessionProvider;

			protected readonly XPClassInfo CollectionType;

			public override string ChangedPropertyName => string.Empty;

			public DesignAccessor(Type memberType, Session session, XPClassInfo relationType)
			{
				MemberType = memberType;
				Session = session;
				CollectionType = relationType;
			}

			public DesignAccessor(Type memberType, ISessionProvider sessionProvider, XPClassInfo relationType)
			{
				MemberType = memberType;
				SessionProvider = sessionProvider;
				CollectionType = relationType;
			}

			private object GetDesingCollection(XPClassInfo classInfo)
			{
				Session session = ((Session != null) ? Session : SessionProvider.Session);
				return ((DesignTimeReflection)classInfo.Dictionary).GetDesignCollection(classInfo, session);
			}

			private XPBindingSource GetDesignBindingSource(XPClassInfo classInfo)
			{
				XPCollection dataSource = GetDesingCollection(classInfo) as XPCollection;
				XPBindingSource xPBindingSource = new XPBindingSource();
				xPBindingSource.DataSource = dataSource;
				return xPBindingSource;
			}

			public override object GetValue(object obj)
			{
				if (typeof(XPBaseCollection).IsAssignableFrom(MemberType))
				{
					return GetDesingCollection(CollectionType);
				}
				if (MemberType == typeof(XPBindingSource))
				{
					return GetDesignBindingSource(CollectionType);
				}
				if (MemberType == typeof(bool))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (MemberType == typeof(string))
				{
					return "Test String";
				}
				if (MemberType == typeof(int))
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (MemberType == typeof(decimal))
				{
					return 0m;
				}
				if (MemberType.IsEnum)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override bool SetValue(object obj, object value)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		public const string ReferenceAsObjectTail = "!";

		public const string ReferenceAsKeyTail = "!Key";

		public XPPropertyDescriptorBase(string propertyName)
			: base(propertyName, new Attribute[0])
		{
		}

		public static string GetMemberName(string propertyName)
		{
			if (propertyName.EndsWith("!"))
			{
				return propertyName.Substring(0, propertyName.Length - "!".Length);
			}
			if (propertyName.EndsWith("!Key"))
			{
				return propertyName.Substring(0, propertyName.Length - "!Key".Length);
			}
			return propertyName;
		}
	}
	public sealed class XPPropertyDescriptor : XPPropertyDescriptorBase, IReferenceAsCollectionPropertyDescriptorMarker, IObjectChange
	{
		private static bool _NonAggregatedPathsEditable;

		private XPMemberInfo targetMember;

		private XPClassInfo objectType;

		private MemberInfoCollection path;

		private Type propertyType;

		private ValueAccessor accessor;

		private string displayName;

		private string memberName;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Obsolete("This property provides backward compatibility with XPO v1.5. It must not be switched to true in a situation other than that. If you set it to True to make subproperties of a referenced object editable, you must implement proper saving or canceling changes made to the referenced object, when it is being edited in UI as a part of its parent object.")]
		public static bool NonAggregatedPathsEditable
		{
			get
			{
				return _NonAggregatedPathsEditable;
			}
			set
			{
				_NonAggregatedPathsEditable = value;
			}
		}

		public override string DisplayName => displayName;

		public override bool IsReadOnly
		{
			get
			{
				if (targetMember.IsReadOnly || propertyType == typeof(XPCollection) || targetMember.IsFetchOnly)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (((ReadOnlyAttribute)Attributes[typeof(ReadOnlyAttribute)]).IsReadOnly)
				{
					return true;
				}
				for (int i = (_NonAggregatedPathsEditable ? 1 : 0); i < path.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!path[i].IsAggregated)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override Type PropertyType
		{
			get
			{
				if (propertyType == null)
				{
					return typeof(object);
				}
				Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(propertyType);
				if (underlyingType == null)
				{
					return propertyType;
				}
				return underlyingType;
			}
		}

		public override Type ComponentType => objectType.ClassType;

		public XPMemberInfo MemberInfo => targetMember;

		bool IReferenceAsCollectionPropertyDescriptorMarker.IsReferenceAsCollectionPropertyDescriptor => accessor.IsReferenceAsCollection;

		public XPPropertyDescriptor(XPClassInfo objectType, string propertyName)
			: base(propertyName)
		{
			this.objectType = objectType;
			MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = new MemberInfoCollection(objectType, XPPropertyDescriptorBase.GetMemberName(propertyName), addNonPersistent: true);
			targetMember = memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1];
			memberName = XPPropertyDescriptorBase.GetMemberName(propertyName);
			displayName = targetMember.DisplayName;
			if (displayName == string.Empty)
			{
				displayName = memberName;
			}
			memberInfoCollection.RemoveAt(memberInfoCollection.Count - 1);
			path = memberInfoCollection;
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = ((memberInfoCollection.Count == 0) ? objectType : memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1].Owner);
			propertyType = targetMember.MemberType;
			accessor = new MemberAccessor(xPClassInfo, targetMember);
			for (int num = memberInfoCollection.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				accessor = new RelatedMemberAccessor((num == 0) ? objectType : memberInfoCollection[num - 1].Owner, memberInfoCollection[num], accessor);
			}
		}

		public XPPropertyDescriptor(Session session, XPClassInfo objectType, string propertyName)
			: base(propertyName)
		{
			//IL_00bc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.objectType = objectType;
			MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = new MemberInfoCollection(objectType, XPPropertyDescriptorBase.GetMemberName(propertyName), addNonPersistent: true);
			targetMember = memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1];
			memberName = XPPropertyDescriptorBase.GetMemberName(propertyName);
			displayName = targetMember.DisplayName;
			if (displayName == string.Empty)
			{
				displayName = memberName;
			}
			memberInfoCollection.RemoveAt(memberInfoCollection.Count - 1);
			path = memberInfoCollection;
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = ((memberInfoCollection.Count == 0) ? objectType : memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1].Owner);
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo2;
			if (propertyName.EndsWith("!Key"))
			{
				xPClassInfo2 = null;
				if (targetMember.ReferenceType == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidPropertyPathException(propertyName);
				}
				propertyType = targetMember.ReferenceType.KeyProperty.MemberType;
				accessor = new RelationAsKeyAccessor(xPClassInfo, targetMember, session);
			}
			else if (targetMember.ReferenceType == null || propertyName.EndsWith("!"))
			{
				xPClassInfo2 = null;
				propertyType = targetMember.MemberType;
				accessor = new MemberAccessor(xPClassInfo, targetMember);
			}
			else
			{
				xPClassInfo2 = targetMember.ReferenceType;
				propertyType = typeof(XPCollection);
				accessor = new RelationAsCollectionAccessor(xPClassInfo, targetMember, session);
			}
			if (session.IsDesignMode)
			{
				accessor = new DesignAccessor(PropertyType, session, (targetMember.IsAssociationList || targetMember.IsNonAssociationList) ? targetMember.CollectionElementType : xPClassInfo2);
				return;
			}
			for (int num = memberInfoCollection.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				accessor = new RelatedMemberAccessor((num == 0) ? objectType : memberInfoCollection[num - 1].Owner, memberInfoCollection[num], accessor);
			}
		}

		protected override void FillAttributes(IList attributeList)
		{
			Attribute[] array = targetMember.Attributes;
			foreach (object value in array)
			{
				attributeList.Add(value);
			}
		}

		public override object GetValue(object component)
		{
			return accessor.GetValue(component);
		}

		public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override void ResetValue(object component)
		{
		}

		public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
		{
			accessor.SetValue(component, Convert.IsDBNull(value) ? null : value);
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override void AddValueChanged(object component, EventHandler handler)
		{
			if (component != null)
			{
				XPBaseObject.AddChangedEventHandler(component, this);
				base.AddValueChanged(component, handler);
			}
		}

		public override void RemoveValueChanged(object component, EventHandler handler)
		{
			if (component != null)
			{
				base.RemoveValueChanged(component, handler);
				XPBaseObject.RemoveChangedEventHandler(component, this);
			}
		}

		void IObjectChange.OnObjectChanged(object sender, ObjectChangeEventArgs arg)
		{
			if (arg.Reason == ObjectChangeReason.Reset || (arg.Reason == ObjectChangeReason.PropertyChanged && arg.PropertyName == memberName))
			{
				OnValueChanged(sender, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class XPPropertyDescriptorCollection : PropertyDescriptorCollection
	{
		private XPClassInfo objectType;

		private Session session;

		public override PropertyDescriptor this[string itemIndex] => FindCaseSmart(itemIndex);

		public override PropertyDescriptor this[int itemIndex] => base[itemIndex];

		public XPPropertyDescriptorCollection(Session session, XPClassInfo objectType, ICollection descriptors)
			: base(null)
		{
			this.objectType = objectType;
			this.session = session;
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor descriptor in descriptors)
			{
				Find(descriptor.Name, ignoreCase: false);
			}
		}

		public XPPropertyDescriptorCollection(Session session, XPClassInfo objectType, PropertyDescriptor[] descriptors)
			: base(null)
		{
			this.objectType = objectType;
			this.session = session;
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor in descriptors)
			{
				Find(propertyDescriptor.Name, ignoreCase: false);
			}
		}

		public XPPropertyDescriptorCollection(Session session, XPClassInfo objectType)
			: base(null)
		{
			this.objectType = objectType;
			this.session = session;
			foreach (XPMemberInfo member in objectType.Members)
			{
				if (member.IsPublic)
				{
					Find(member.Name, ignoreCase: false);
				}
			}
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptor Find(string name, bool ignoreCase)
		{
			if (name == null || name.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = base.Find(name, ignoreCase);
			if (propertyDescriptor == null)
			{
				MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = new MemberInfoCollection(objectType, XPPropertyDescriptorBase.GetMemberName(name), addNonPersistent: true, throwOnError: false);
				if (memberInfoCollection.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (name.EndsWith("!") && memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1].ReferenceType == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (name.EndsWith("!Key") && (memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1].ReferenceType == null || !memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1].ReferenceType.IsPersistent))
				{
					return null;
				}
				propertyDescriptor = new XPPropertyDescriptor(session, objectType, name);
				Add(propertyDescriptor);
			}
			return propertyDescriptor;
		}

		public PropertyDescriptor FindCaseSmart(string name)
		{
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = Find(name, ignoreCase: false);
			if (propertyDescriptor != null)
			{
				return propertyDescriptor;
			}
			return Find(name, ignoreCase: true);
		}
	}
	public sealed class XPDesignTimePropertyDescriptorCollection : PropertyDescriptorCollection
	{
		private readonly XPClassInfo objectType;

		public override PropertyDescriptor this[string itemIndex] => FindCaseSmart(itemIndex);

		public override PropertyDescriptor this[int itemIndex] => base[itemIndex];

		public XPDesignTimePropertyDescriptorCollection(XPClassInfo objectType)
			: base(null)
		{
			this.objectType = objectType;
			StringCollection defaultDisplayableProperties = ClassMetadataHelper.GetDefaultDisplayableProperties(objectType);
			StringEnumerator enumerator = defaultDisplayableProperties.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					string current = enumerator.Current;
					Find(current, ignoreCase: false);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptor Find(string name, bool ignoreCase)
		{
			if (name == null || name.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = base.Find(name, ignoreCase);
			if (propertyDescriptor == null)
			{
				MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = new MemberInfoCollection(objectType, XPPropertyDescriptorBase.GetMemberName(name), addNonPersistent: true, throwOnError: false);
				if (memberInfoCollection.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (name == "This" || name.EndsWith("!") || name.EndsWith("!Key"))
				{
					return null;
				}
				propertyDescriptor = new XPPropertyDescriptor(objectType, name);
				Add(propertyDescriptor);
			}
			return propertyDescriptor;
		}

		public PropertyDescriptor FindCaseSmart(string name)
		{
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = Find(name, ignoreCase: false);
			if (propertyDescriptor != null)
			{
				return propertyDescriptor;
			}
			return Find(name, ignoreCase: true);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class ObjectRecordsHashTable : OrdinaryDictionary<object, ObjectRecord>
	{
		private sealed class ObjectAndObjectRecordsComparer : IEqualityComparer<object>
		{
			public static ObjectAndObjectRecordsComparer Instance = new ObjectAndObjectRecordsComparer();

			bool IEqualityComparer<object>.Equals(object x, object y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				ObjectRecord objectRecord = x as ObjectRecord;
				ObjectRecord objectRecord2 = y as ObjectRecord;
				if (objectRecord != null)
				{
					if (objectRecord2 != null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					x = objectRecord.Object;
				}
				else if (objectRecord2 != null)
				{
					y = objectRecord2.Object;
				}
				return y == x;
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<object>.GetHashCode(object obj)
			{
				if (obj is IXPImmutableHashCode iXPImmutableHashCode)
				{
					return iXPImmutableHashCode.GetImmutableHashCode();
				}
				return obj.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		public int BucketsLength => base.ProtectedCurrentPrimeModulo;

		public ObjectRecordsHashTable()
			: this(0)
		{
		}

		public ObjectRecordsHashTable(int size)
			: base(size, (IEqualityComparer<object>)ObjectAndObjectRecordsComparer.Instance)
		{
		}
	}
	public class WeakObjectIdentityMap : ObjectIdentityMap
	{
		private sealed class WeakObjectMap : Dictionary<object, ObjectRecord>, IObjectMap
		{
			private WeakObjectIdentityMap cache;

			public WeakObjectMap(WeakObjectIdentityMap cache)
			{
				this.cache = cache;
			}

			void IObjectMap.Add(object theObject, object id)
			{
				if (!TryGetValue(id, out var value))
				{
					value = ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(theObject);
					Add(id, value);
					if (Environment.OSVersion.Platform == PlatformID.Win32NT)
					{
						PerformanceCounters.ObjectsInCache.Increment();
						PerformanceCounters.ObjectsInCacheAdded.Increment();
					}
					cache.count++;
				}
				else
				{
					if (value.IsAlive)
					{
						throw new ObjectCacheException(id, theObject, value.Object);
					}
					value = ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(theObject);
					base[id] = value;
				}
			}

			void IObjectMap.Remove(object id)
			{
				Remove(id);
			}

			public object Get(object id)
			{
				if (!TryGetValue(id, out var value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value.Object;
			}

			public int CompactCache()
			{
				List<object> list = (from pair in this
					where !pair.Value.IsAlive
					select pair.Key).ToList();
				foreach (object item in list)
				{
					Remove(item);
				}
				return list.Count;
			}

			public void ClearCache()
			{
				foreach (ObjectRecord value in base.Values)
				{
					if (value.Object is IXPInvalidateableObject iXPInvalidateableObject)
					{
						iXPInvalidateableObject.Invalidate();
					}
				}
				Clear();
			}
		}

		private int count;

		private int _lastCompactGC;

		protected override IObjectMap CreateMap()
		{
			return new WeakObjectMap(this);
		}

		public WeakObjectIdentityMap(IObjectLayerProvider objectLayerProvider)
			: base(objectLayerProvider)
		{
		}

		private void CompactCache()
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (IObjectMap value in classes.Values)
			{
				num += value.CompactCache();
			}
			count -= num;
			if (Environment.OSVersion.Platform == PlatformID.Win32NT)
			{
				PerformanceCounters.ObjectsInCache.Decrement(num);
				PerformanceCounters.ObjectsInCacheRemoved.Increment(num);
			}
		}

		public override void Compact()
		{
			int lastCompactGC = _lastCompactGC;
			int num = GC.CollectionCount(GC.MaxGeneration);
			if (lastCompactGC != num)
			{
				_lastCompactGC = num;
				if (lastCompactGC != 0)
				{
					CompactCache();
				}
				ObjectRecord.MayBeCompact();
			}
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			foreach (IObjectMap value in classes.Values)
			{
				value.ClearCache();
			}
			classes.Clear();
			if (Environment.OSVersion.Platform == PlatformID.Win32NT)
			{
				PerformanceCounters.ObjectsInCache.Decrement(count);
				PerformanceCounters.ObjectsInCacheRemoved.Increment(count);
			}
			count = 0;
			ObjectRecord.MayBeCompact();
		}

		~WeakObjectIdentityMap()
		{
			if (Environment.OSVersion.Platform == PlatformID.Win32NT)
			{
				PerformanceCounters.ObjectsInCache.Decrement(count);
				PerformanceCounters.ObjectsInCacheRemoved.Increment(count);
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IObjectMap
	{
		void Add(object theObject, object id);

		object Get(object id);

		void Remove(object id);

		int CompactCache();

		void ClearCache();
	}
	public class StrongObjectIdentityMap : ObjectIdentityMap
	{
		private sealed class StrongObjectMap : Dictionary<object, object>, IObjectMap
		{
			void IObjectMap.Add(object theObject, object id)
			{
				try
				{
					Add(id, theObject);
				}
				catch (ArgumentException)
				{
					throw new ObjectCacheException(id, theObject, base[id]);
				}
			}

			void IObjectMap.Remove(object id)
			{
				Remove(id);
			}

			public object Get(object id)
			{
				if (!TryGetValue(id, out var value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}

			public int CompactCache()
			{
				return 0;
			}

			public void ClearCache()
			{
				foreach (object value in base.Values)
				{
					if (value is IXPInvalidateableObject iXPInvalidateableObject)
					{
						iXPInvalidateableObject.Invalidate();
					}
				}
				Clear();
			}
		}

		public StrongObjectIdentityMap(IObjectLayerProvider objectLayerProvider)
			: base(objectLayerProvider)
		{
		}

		protected override IObjectMap CreateMap()
		{
			return new StrongObjectMap();
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			foreach (IObjectMap value in classes.Values)
			{
				value.ClearCache();
			}
			classes.Clear();
		}
	}
	public abstract class ObjectIdentityMap
	{
		private readonly IObjectLayer objectLayer;

		protected Dictionary<XPClassInfo, IObjectMap> classes = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, IObjectMap>();

		protected XPDictionary Dictionary => ObjectLayer.Dictionary;

		protected IObjectLayer ObjectLayer => objectLayer;

		public ObjectIdentityMap(IObjectLayerProvider objectLayerProvider)
		{
			objectLayer = objectLayerProvider.ObjectLayer;
		}

		protected abstract IObjectMap CreateMap();

		public IObjectMap GetObjects(XPClassInfo classInfo)
		{
			if (!classes.TryGetValue(classInfo.IdClass, out var value))
			{
				value = (ObjectLayer.IsStaticType(classInfo) ? ObjectLayer.GetStaticCache(classInfo) : CreateMap());
				classes[classInfo.IdClass] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public object Get(IObjectMap objects, object id)
		{
			return objects.Get(id);
		}

		public object Get(XPClassInfo objectClass, object id)
		{
			if (id == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Get(GetObjects(objectClass), id);
		}

		public void Add(IObjectMap objects, object theObject, object id)
		{
			objects.Add(theObject, id);
		}

		public void Add(object theObject, object id)
		{
			Add(GetObjects(Dictionary.GetClassInfo(theObject)), theObject, id);
		}

		public void Remove(object theObject)
		{
			if (theObject != null)
			{
				XPClassInfo classInfo = Dictionary.GetClassInfo(theObject);
				IObjectMap objects = GetObjects(classInfo);
				objects.Remove(classInfo.GetId(theObject));
			}
		}

		public abstract void Clear();

		public virtual void Compact()
		{
		}
	}
	[CollectionDataContract]
	public sealed class IdList : List<object>, IComparable
	{
		public IdList()
		{
		}

		public IdList(ICollection list)
			: base((IEnumerable<object>)ListHelper.FromCollection(list))
		{
		}

		public override bool Equals(object anotherObject)
		{
			if (!(anotherObject is IdList idList))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.Count != idList.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				if (base[i] == null || !base[i].Equals(idList[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGenericList<object>((IList<object>)this);
		}

		int IComparable.CompareTo(object anotherObject)
		{
			if (!(anotherObject is IdList idList))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("anotherObject");
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				num = DefaultComparer.Compare(base[i], idList[i]);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
