	[SecuritySafeCritical]
	public class NakedObjectRecord : ObjectRecord, IXPCustomPropertyStore, IXPModificationsStore
	{
		private Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object> customPropertyStore;

		private Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object> modificationsStore;

		private Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object> CustomPropertyStore
		{
			get
			{
				if (customPropertyStore == null)
				{
					customPropertyStore = new Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object>(3);
				}
				return customPropertyStore;
			}
		}

		public bool HasCustomPropertyStore => customPropertyStore != null;

		internal Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object> ModificationsStore
		{
			get
			{
				if (modificationsStore == null)
				{
					modificationsStore = new Dictionary<XPMemberInfo, object>();
				}
				return modificationsStore;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasModificationStore => modificationsStore != null;

		public NakedObjectRecord(object theObject)
			: base(theObject)
		{
		}

		object IXPCustomPropertyStore.GetCustomPropertyValue(XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			if (HasCustomPropertyStore)
			{
				if (!CustomPropertyStore.TryGetValue(property, out var value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		bool IXPCustomPropertyStore.SetCustomPropertyValue(XPMemberInfo property, object theValue)
		{
			if (HasCustomPropertyStore || theValue != null)
			{
				object customPropertyValue = ((IXPCustomPropertyStore)this).GetCustomPropertyValue(property);
				if (PersistentBase.CanSkipAssignment(customPropertyValue, theValue))
				{
					return false;
				}
				CustomPropertyStore[property] = theValue;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IXPModificationsStore.ClearModifications()
		{
			if (HasModificationStore)
			{
				ModificationsStore.Clear();
			}
		}

		void IXPModificationsStore.SetPropertyModified(XPMemberInfo property, object oldValue)
		{
			if (!ModificationsStore.ContainsKey(property))
			{
				ModificationsStore.Add(property, oldValue);
			}
		}

		bool IXPModificationsStore.GetPropertyModified(XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			if (HasModificationStore)
			{
				return ModificationsStore.ContainsKey(property);
			}
			return false;
		}

		object IXPModificationsStore.GetPropertyOldValue(XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			if (HasModificationStore && ModificationsStore.TryGetValue(property, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		void IXPModificationsStore.ResetPropertyModified(XPMemberInfo property)
		{
			if (HasModificationStore)
			{
				ModificationsStore.Remove(property);
			}
		}

		bool IXPModificationsStore.HasModifications()
		{
			if (!HasModificationStore)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ModificationsStore.Count > 0;
		}
	}
	[SecuritySafeCritical]
	public class ObjectRecord
	{
		private abstract class ChangeHandler
		{
			public ChangeHandler next;

			public ChangeHandler(ChangeHandler next)
			{
				this.next = next;
			}

			public abstract void Invoke(object sender, ref object[] parameters, ObjectChangeEventArgs args);
		}

		private class ObjectRecordChangeHandler : ChangeHandler
		{
			public ObjectRecord target;

			public MethodInfo method;

			public ObjectRecordChangeHandler(ObjectRecord target, ObjectChangeEventHandler handler, ChangeHandler next)
				: base(next)
			{
				this.target = target;
				method = handler.Method;
			}

			public override void Invoke(object sender, ref object[] parameters, ObjectChangeEventArgs args)
			{
				object obj = target.Object;
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (obj is IObjectChange)
				{
					((IObjectChange)obj).OnObjectChanged(sender, args);
					return;
				}
				if (parameters == null)
				{
					parameters = new object[2] { sender, args };
				}
				method.Invoke(obj, parameters);
			}
		}

		private class InterfacedChangeHandler : ChangeHandler
		{
			public ObjectRecord target;

			public InterfacedChangeHandler(ObjectRecord target, ChangeHandler next)
				: base(next)
			{
				this.target = target;
			}

			public override void Invoke(object sender, ref object[] parameters, ObjectChangeEventArgs args)
			{
				if (target.Object is IObjectChange objectChange)
				{
					objectChange.OnObjectChanged(sender, args);
				}
			}
		}

		private class StaticChangeHandler : ChangeHandler
		{
			public ObjectChangeEventHandler handler;

			public StaticChangeHandler(ObjectChangeEventHandler handler, ChangeHandler next)
				: base(next)
			{
				this.handler = handler;
			}

			public override void Invoke(object sender, ref object[] parameters, ObjectChangeEventArgs args)
			{
				handler(sender, args);
			}
		}

		private readonly int hash;

		private GCHandle handle;

		private static GCHandle zeroHandle;

		private ChangeHandler changeHandler;

		private static ObjectRecordsHashTable nonSavedObjects;

		private static int _lastCollection;

		public static int CompactPeriodicity;

		private static readonly object lockObject;

		public bool IsAlive => Object != null;

		public object Object
		{
			get
			{
				GCHandle gCHandle = handle;
				if (!gCHandle.IsAllocated)
				{
					return null;
				}
				object target = gCHandle.Target;
				if (!handle.IsAllocated)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return target;
			}
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return hash;
		}

		static ObjectRecord()
		{
			nonSavedObjects = new ObjectRecordsHashTable();
			CompactPeriodicity = 8;
			lockObject = new object();
			GCHandle gCHandle = GCHandle.Alloc(new object());
			gCHandle.Free();
			zeroHandle = gCHandle;
		}

		protected ObjectRecord(object theObject)
		{
			if (theObject is IXPImmutableHashCode iXPImmutableHashCode)
			{
				hash = iXPImmutableHashCode.GetImmutableHashCode();
			}
			else
			{
				hash = theObject.GetHashCode();
			}
			handle = GCHandle.Alloc(theObject, GCHandleType.Weak);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			GCHandle gCHandle = handle;
			handle = zeroHandle;
			if (gCHandle.IsAllocated)
			{
				gCHandle.Free();
			}
			if (disposing)
			{
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}
		}

		~ObjectRecord()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		private static bool FindObjectRecord(object theObject, out ObjectRecord rec)
		{
			return ((OrdinaryDictionary<object, ObjectRecord>)nonSavedObjects).TryGetValue(theObject, ref rec);
		}

		private static IEnumerator<ObjectRecord> FilterDead(IEnumerable<ObjectRecord> whole)
		{
			foreach (ObjectRecord item in whole)
			{
				object obj = item.Object;
				if (obj != null)
				{
					yield return item;
				}
				else
				{
					item.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void CompactBeforeOverflow()
		{
			int count = ((OrdinaryDictionary<object, ObjectRecord>)nonSavedObjects).Count;
			if (count < 2048 || count < nonSavedObjects.BucketsLength)
			{
				return;
			}
			OnceEnumerableCollection<ObjectRecord> val = LohPooled.ToListAndDisposeToOnceEnumerableCollection<ObjectRecord>(FilterDead(((OrdinaryDictionary<object, ObjectRecord>)nonSavedObjects).Values), (int?)null);
			int size;
			try
			{
				size = ((val.Count > count / 2) ? (count * 2) : count);
			}
			catch (OverflowException)
			{
				size = count;
			}
			((FinalizeSuppressableBase)nonSavedObjects).Dispose();
			nonSavedObjects = new ObjectRecordsHashTable(size);
			foreach (ObjectRecord item in val)
			{
				((OrdinaryDictionary<object, ObjectRecord>)nonSavedObjects).Add((object)item, item);
			}
		}

		public static void Compact()
		{
			lock (lockObject)
			{
				int count = ((OrdinaryDictionary<object, ObjectRecord>)nonSavedObjects).Count;
				if (count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				OnceEnumerableCollection<ObjectRecord> val = LohPooled.ToListAndDisposeToOnceEnumerableCollection<ObjectRecord>(FilterDead(((OrdinaryDictionary<object, ObjectRecord>)nonSavedObjects).Values), (int?)null);
				int size;
				try
				{
					size = checked(val.Count * 2 + 128);
				}
				catch (OverflowException)
				{
					size = count;
				}
				((FinalizeSuppressableBase)nonSavedObjects).Dispose();
				nonSavedObjects = new ObjectRecordsHashTable(size);
				foreach (ObjectRecord item in val)
				{
					((OrdinaryDictionary<object, ObjectRecord>)nonSavedObjects).Add((object)item, item);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void MayBeCompact()
		{
			int lastCollection = _lastCollection;
			int num = GC.CollectionCount(GC.MaxGeneration);
			if ((num < lastCollection || num - lastCollection >= CompactPeriodicity) && lastCollection == Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _lastCollection, num, lastCollection))
			{
				Compact();
			}
		}

		private static ObjectRecord InternalCreateObjectRecord(object theObject)
		{
			CompactBeforeOverflow();
			ObjectRecord objectRecord = ((theObject is IXPCustomPropertyStore && theObject is IXPModificationsStore) ? new ObjectRecord(theObject) : new NakedObjectRecord(theObject));
			((OrdinaryDictionary<object, ObjectRecord>)nonSavedObjects).Add((object)objectRecord, objectRecord);
			return objectRecord;
		}

		public static ObjectRecord GetObjectRecord(object theObject)
		{
			lock (lockObject)
			{
				ObjectRecord rec;
				return FindObjectRecord(theObject, out rec) ? rec : InternalCreateObjectRecord(theObject);
			}
		}

		private static ObjectRecord GetChangeHandler(ObjectChangeEventHandler handler)
		{
			return GetObjectRecord(handler.Target);
		}

		public static void AddChangeHandler(object theObject, ObjectRecord target)
		{
			AddChangeHandler(GetObjectRecord(theObject), target);
		}

		public static void AddChangeHandler(ObjectRecord record, ObjectRecord target)
		{
			record.changeHandler = new InterfacedChangeHandler(target, record.changeHandler);
		}

		public static void AddChangeHandler(object theObject, ObjectChangeEventHandler handler)
		{
			object target = handler.Target;
			if (target == null)
			{
				ObjectRecord objectRecord = GetObjectRecord(theObject);
				objectRecord.changeHandler = new StaticChangeHandler(handler, objectRecord.changeHandler);
			}
			else
			{
				ObjectRecord target2 = GetChangeHandler(handler);
				ObjectRecord objectRecord2 = GetObjectRecord(theObject);
				objectRecord2.changeHandler = new ObjectRecordChangeHandler(target2, handler, objectRecord2.changeHandler);
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveChangeHandler(ObjectRecord record, ObjectRecord target)
		{
			ChangeHandler next = record.changeHandler;
			ChangeHandler changeHandler = null;
			while (next != null)
			{
				if (next is InterfacedChangeHandler interfacedChangeHandler && interfacedChangeHandler.target == target)
				{
					if (changeHandler == null)
					{
						record.changeHandler = next.next;
					}
					else
					{
						changeHandler.next = next.next;
					}
					break;
				}
				changeHandler = next;
				next = next.next;
			}
		}

		private static void RemoveChangeHandler(ObjectRecord record, ObjectRecord target, ObjectChangeEventHandler handler_)
		{
			ChangeHandler next = record.changeHandler;
			ChangeHandler changeHandler = null;
			MethodInfo method = handler_.Method;
			while (next != null)
			{
				if (next is ObjectRecordChangeHandler objectRecordChangeHandler && objectRecordChangeHandler.target == target && (object)method == objectRecordChangeHandler.method)
				{
					if (changeHandler == null)
					{
						record.changeHandler = next.next;
					}
					else
					{
						changeHandler.next = next.next;
					}
					break;
				}
				changeHandler = next;
				next = next.next;
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveChangeHandler(object theObject, ObjectRecord target)
		{
			lock (lockObject)
			{
				if (FindObjectRecord(theObject, out var rec))
				{
					RemoveChangeHandler(rec, target);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveChangeHandler(object theObject, ObjectChangeEventHandler handler)
		{
			lock (lockObject)
			{
				object target = handler.Target;
				ObjectRecord rec3;
				if (target != null)
				{
					if (FindObjectRecord(target, out var rec) && FindObjectRecord(theObject, out var rec2))
					{
						RemoveChangeHandler(rec2, rec, handler);
					}
				}
				else if (FindObjectRecord(theObject, out rec3))
				{
					RemoveChangeHandler(rec3, handler);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void RemoveChangeHandler(ObjectRecord record, ObjectChangeEventHandler handler)
		{
			ChangeHandler next = record.changeHandler;
			ChangeHandler changeHandler = null;
			while (handler != null)
			{
				if (next is StaticChangeHandler staticChangeHandler && object.Equals(staticChangeHandler.handler, handler))
				{
					if (changeHandler == null)
					{
						record.changeHandler = next.next;
					}
					else
					{
						changeHandler.next = next.next;
					}
					break;
				}
				changeHandler = next;
				next = next.next;
			}
		}

		private void OnChange(object sender, ObjectChangeEventArgs args)
		{
			object[] parameters = null;
			for (ChangeHandler next = changeHandler; next != null; next = next.next)
			{
				next.Invoke(sender, ref parameters, args);
			}
		}

		public static void OnChange(object sender, object theObject, ObjectChangeEventArgs args)
		{
			GetObjectRecord(theObject).OnChange(sender, args);
		}
	}
	public class XPCursorEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		private PageSelector pageSelector;

		private int posInCurrentCollection;

		private int currentCollectionBase;

		private int pageSize;

		private Session session;

		private List<object> currentCollection;

		private SortingCollection sorting;

		private bool IsAfterLastElement => currentCollectionBase + posInCurrentCollection >= pageSelector.Count;

		private bool IsBeforeFirstElement => currentCollectionBase + posInCurrentCollection < 0;

		public object Current
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsBeforeFirstElement || IsAfterLastElement)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Paging_EnumeratorPositioning"));
				}
				return currentCollection[posInCurrentCollection];
			}
		}

		public XPCursorEnumerator(Session session, XPClassInfo objectClassInfo, PageSelector pageSelector, int pageSize, SortingCollection sorting)
		{
			this.pageSelector = pageSelector;
			this.pageSize = pageSize;
			this.sorting = sorting;
			this.session = session;
			Reset();
		}

		public XPCursorEnumerator(Session session, XPClassInfo objectClassInfo, PageSelector pageSelector)
			: this(session, objectClassInfo, pageSelector, 512, new SortingCollection())
		{
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (IsAfterLastElement)
			{
				return false;
			}
			posInCurrentCollection++;
			if (IsAfterLastElement)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (posInCurrentCollection >= pageSize)
			{
				currentCollectionBase += pageSize;
				posInCurrentCollection = 0;
				ICollection collection = pageSelector.FillCollectionWithPageVerified(session, sorting, currentCollectionBase, pageSize);
				currentCollection = ListHelper.FromCollection(collection);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			currentCollectionBase = -pageSize;
			posInCurrentCollection = pageSize - 1;
		}
	}

				return object.Equals(Key, purgerObjectUid.Key);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class PurgerObjectRecord
	{
		public readonly Purger Owner;

		public readonly XPClassInfo ClassInfo;

		public readonly object Key;

		private List<object> _ReferencedObjects;

		private List<object> _ReferredByObjects;

		public IList<object> ReferencedObjects
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ReferencedObjects == null)
				{
					_ReferencedObjects = new List<object>();
				}
				return _ReferencedObjects;
			}
		}

		public bool IsReferredBy
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ReferredByObjects == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ReferredByObjects.Count > 0;
			}
		}

		public IList<object> ReferredByObjects
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ReferredByObjects == null)
				{
					_ReferredByObjects = new List<object>();
				}
				return _ReferredByObjects;
			}
		}

		public PurgerObjectRecord(Purger owner, XPClassInfo classInfo, object key)
		{
			ClassInfo = classInfo;
			Key = key;
			Owner = owner;
		}

		public PurgerObjectUid GetUid()
		{
			return new PurgerObjectUid(ClassInfo, Key);
		}

		public void ClearReferencedObjects()
		{
			if (_ReferencedObjects == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable referencedObjects = _ReferencedObjects;
			_ReferencedObjects = null;
			foreach (PurgerObjectRecord item in referencedObjects)
			{
				item.ReferredByObjects.Remove(this);
			}
		}

		public void ClearReferredByObjects()
		{
			if (_ReferredByObjects == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable referredByObjects = _ReferredByObjects;
			_ReferredByObjects = null;
			foreach (PurgerObjectRecord item in referredByObjects)
			{
				item.ReferencedObjects.Remove(this);
			}
		}
	}

	public class Purger
	{
		private readonly IDataLayer PurgeDataLayer;

		private readonly Session PurgeSession;

		private readonly Dictionary<PurgerObjectUid, PurgerObjectRecord> RecordsByUid = new Dictionary<PurgerObjectUid, PurgerObjectRecord>();

		private readonly IList<PurgeFK> ReferenceMembers = new List<PurgeFK>();

		private readonly PurgeResult Result = new PurgeResult();

		protected Purger(IObjectLayer objectLayer, IDataLayer dataLayer)
		{
			PurgeSession = new Session(objectLayer);
			PurgeDataLayer = dataLayer;
		}

		public static PurgeResult Purge(IObjectLayer objectLayer, IDataLayer dataLayer)
		{
			return new Purger(objectLayer, dataLayer).Purge();
		}

		public PurgeResult Purge()
		{
			PurgeSession.TypesManager.EnsureIsTypedObjectValid();
			EnsureTypes();
			FillRecords();
			Result.Processed = RecordsByUid.Count;
			FillReferenceMembers();
			ExcludeReferencedByNonMarked();
			Result.ReferencedByNonDeletedObjects = Result.Processed - RecordsByUid.Count;
			FillReferencedAndReferredBy();
			Result.Purged = RecordsByUid.Count;
			Result.NonPurged = Result.Processed - Result.Purged;
			RealPurge();
			return Result;
		}

		public static void FillProps(CriteriaOperatorCollection props, string prefix, XPMemberInfo member)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (member.SubMembers.Count == 0)
			{
				((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)props).Add((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(prefix + member.Name));
				return;
			}
			foreach (XPMemberInfo subMember in member.SubMembers)
			{
				if (subMember.IsPersistent)
				{
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)props).Add((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(prefix + subMember.Name));
				}
			}
		}

		private void FillReferencedAndReferredBy()
		{
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0070: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_006b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0075: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0076: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0082: Expected O, but got Unknown
			foreach (PurgeFK referenceMember in ReferenceMembers)
			{
				if (!referenceMember.MappingClass.IsGCRecordObject)
				{
					continue;
				}
				CriteriaOperator criteria = (CriteriaOperator)new GroupOperator((GroupOperatorType)0, (CriteriaOperator[])(object)new CriteriaOperator[2]
				{
					(CriteriaOperator)new UnaryOperator((UnaryOperatorType)3, (CriteriaOperator)new UnaryOperator((UnaryOperatorType)4, (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(GCRecordField.StaticName))),
					(CriteriaOperator)new UnaryOperator((UnaryOperatorType)3, (CriteriaOperator)new UnaryOperator((UnaryOperatorType)4, (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(referenceMember.Reference.Name + "." + GCRecordField.StaticName)))
				});
				CriteriaOperatorCollection val = new CriteriaOperatorCollection();
				FillProps(val, string.Empty, referenceMember.MappingClass.KeyProperty);
				FillProps(val, referenceMember.Reference.Name + ".", referenceMember.Reference.ReferenceType.KeyProperty);
				SelectStatement val2 = ClientSelectSqlGenerator.GenerateSelect(referenceMember.MappingClass, criteria, val, null, null, null, new CollectionCriteriaPatcher(selectDeleted: true, PurgeSession.TypesManager), 0, 0);
				SelectStatementResult val3 = PurgeDataLayer.SelectData(val2).ResultSet[0];
				SelectStatementResultRow[] rows = val3.Rows;
				foreach (SelectStatementResultRow val4 in rows)
				{
					object key = ExtractValue(string.Empty, referenceMember.MappingClass.KeyProperty, val, val4.Values);
					object key2 = ExtractValue(referenceMember.Reference.Name + ".", referenceMember.Reference.ReferenceType.KeyProperty, val, val4.Values);
					RecordsByUid.TryGetValue(new PurgerObjectUid(referenceMember.MappingClass, key), out var value);
					RecordsByUid.TryGetValue(new PurgerObjectUid(referenceMember.Reference.ReferenceType, key2), out var value2);
					if (value != null && value2 != null)
					{
						if (!value.ReferencedObjects.Contains(value2))
						{
							value.ReferencedObjects.Add(value2);
						}
						if (!value2.ReferredByObjects.Contains(value))
						{
							value2.ReferredByObjects.Add(value);
						}
					}
					else if (value == null && value2 != null)
					{
						UnRegister(value2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void RealPurge()
		{
			while (true)
			{
				PurgerObjectRecord purgerObjectRecord = DeleteAllNonReferredByAndGetLeastReferred();
				if (purgerObjectRecord != null)
				{
					KillReferences(new List<object>(purgerObjectRecord.ReferredByObjects));
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

			//IL_005d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Expected O, but got Unknown

			//IL_0080: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CriteriaOperatorCollection val = new CriteriaOperatorCollection();
			FillProps(val, fk.Reference.Name + ".", fk.Reference.ReferenceType.KeyProperty);
			CriteriaOperator val2 = (CriteriaOperator)new UnaryOperator((UnaryOperatorType)3, (CriteriaOperator)new UnaryOperator((UnaryOperatorType)4, (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(fk.Reference.Name + "." + GCRecordField.StaticName)));

			SelectStatementResultRow[] rows = val4.Rows;
			foreach (SelectStatementResultRow val5 in rows)
			{

		private void ExcludeReferencedByNonMarked()
		{
			IEnumerable<PurgeFK> enumerable = new List<PurgeFK>(ReferenceMembers);
			foreach (PurgeFK item in enumerable)
			{
				ExcludeReferencedByNonMarked(item);
			}
		}

		private void FillReferenceMembers()
		{
			Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo>();
			foreach (PurgerObjectRecord value in RecordsByUid.Values)
			{
				XPClassInfo classInfo = value.ClassInfo;
				if (dictionary.ContainsKey(classInfo))
				{
					continue;
				}
				dictionary.Add(classInfo, classInfo);
				foreach (XPObjectType value2 in PurgeSession.TypesManager.AllTypes.Values)
				{
					XPClassInfo typeClassInfo = value2.TypeClassInfo;
					if (typeClassInfo == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in typeClassInfo.ObjectProperties)
					{
						if (objectProperty.IsPersistent && classInfo.IsAssignableTo(objectProperty.ReferenceType))
						{
							PurgeFK item = new PurgeFK(objectProperty, objectProperty.GetMappingClass(typeClassInfo));
							if (!ReferenceMembers.Contains(item))
							{
								ReferenceMembers.Add(item);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void Register(PurgerObjectRecord newRecord)
		{
			RecordsByUid.Add(newRecord.GetUid(), newRecord);
		}

		private void UnRegister(PurgerObjectRecord record)
		{
			if (!RecordsByUid.ContainsKey(record.GetUid()))
			{
				return;
			}
			RecordsByUid.Remove(record.GetUid());
			foreach (PurgerObjectRecord item in new List<object>(record.ReferencedObjects))
			{
				UnRegister(item);
			}
			record.ClearReferredByObjects();
		}

		private void UnRegister(PurgerObjectUid uid)
		{
			RecordsByUid.TryGetValue(uid, out var value);
			if (value != null)
			{
				UnRegister(value);
			}
		}

		private void FillRecords()
		{
			ICollection markDeletedObjects = GetMarkDeletedObjects();
			foreach (PurgerObjectRecord item in markDeletedObjects)
			{
				Register(item);
			}
		}

		private void EnsureTypes()
		{
			List<XPClassInfo> list = new List<XPClassInfo>(PurgeSession.TypesManager.AllTypes.Count);
			foreach (XPObjectType value in PurgeSession.TypesManager.AllTypes.Values)
			{
				XPClassInfo classInfo = value.GetClassInfo();
				if (classInfo.IsGCRecordObject || classInfo.HasPurgebleObjectReferences())
				{
					list.Add(classInfo);
				}
			}
			PurgeSession.UpdateSchema(list.ToArray());
		}

		private PurgerObjectRecord DeleteAllNonReferredByAndGetLeastReferred()
		{
			PurgerObjectRecord result;
			while (true)
			{
				int num = int.MaxValue;
				result = null;
				List<PurgerObjectRecord> list = new List<PurgerObjectRecord>();
				foreach (PurgerObjectRecord value in RecordsByUid.Values)
				{
					if (value.IsReferredBy)
					{
						if (value.ReferredByObjects.Count < num)
						{
							num = value.ReferredByObjects.Count;
							result = value;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(value);
					}
				}
				if (list.Count == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				DoDeletes(list);
				foreach (PurgerObjectRecord item in list)
				{
					item.ClearReferencedObjects();
					UnRegister(item);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static ICollection GetCriteriasFromKeys(XPClassInfo ci, List<object> keys)
		{
			if (keys.Count == 0)
			{
				return new object[0];
			}
			if (keys.Count <= 64)
			{
				object[] array = keys.ToArray();
				return new object[1] { new object[2] { ci, array } };
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			list.AddRange(ListHelper.FromCollection(GetCriteriasFromKeys(ci, GetRangeHelper.GetRange(keys, 0, keys.Count / 2))));
			list.AddRange(ListHelper.FromCollection(GetCriteriasFromKeys(ci, GetRangeHelper.GetRange(keys, keys.Count / 2, keys.Count - keys.Count / 2))));
			return list;
		}

		private static ICollection GetCriteriasFromRecordsCollection(IEnumerable records)
		{
			Dictionary<XPClassInfo, List<object>> dictionary = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, List<object>>();
			foreach (PurgerObjectRecord record in records)
			{
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(record.ClassInfo, out var value))
				{
					value = new List<object>();
					dictionary.Add(record.ClassInfo, value);
				}
				value.Add(record.Key);
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (XPClassInfo key in dictionary.Keys)
			{
				list.AddRange(ListHelper.FromCollection(GetCriteriasFromKeys(key, dictionary[key])));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static object ExtractSimpleValue(string extractedPropertyName, CriteriaOperatorCollection requiredProperties, object[] requestResult)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)requiredProperties).Count; i++)
			{
				CriteriaOperator obj = ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)requiredProperties)[i];
				OperandProperty val = (OperandProperty)(object)((obj is OperandProperty) ? obj : null);
				if (val != null && val.PropertyName == extractedPropertyName)
				{
					return requestResult[i];
				}
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}

		public static object ExtractValue(string extractedPropertyPrefix, XPMemberInfo member, CriteriaOperatorCollection requiredProperties, object[] requestResult)
		{
			if (member.SubMembers.Count == 0)
			{
				return ExtractSimpleValue(extractedPropertyPrefix + member.Name, requiredProperties, requestResult);
			}
			IdList idList = new IdList();
			foreach (XPMemberInfo subMember in member.SubMembers)
			{
				if (subMember.IsPersistent)
				{
					idList.Add(ExtractSimpleValue(extractedPropertyPrefix + subMember.Name, requiredProperties, requestResult));
				}
			}
			return idList;
		}

		private ICollection GetMarkDeletedObjects()
		{
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0087: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0082: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_008e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0095: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00a5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00af: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo>();
			List<PurgerObjectRecord> list = new List<PurgerObjectRecord>();
			foreach (XPObjectType value in PurgeSession.TypesManager.AllTypes.Values)
			{
				if (value.TypeClassInfo == null)

					continue;
				}
				XPClassInfo idClass = value.TypeClassInfo.IdClass;
				if (idClass != null && idClass.IsGCRecordObject && !dictionary.ContainsKey(idClass))
				{

					CriteriaOperator criteria = (CriteriaOperator)new UnaryOperator((UnaryOperatorType)3, (CriteriaOperator)new UnaryOperator((UnaryOperatorType)4, (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(GCRecordField.StaticName)));
					CriteriaOperatorCollection val = new CriteriaOperatorCollection();

					{

					}
					FillProps(val, string.Empty, idClass.KeyProperty);
					SelectStatement val2 = ClientSelectSqlGenerator.GenerateSelect(idClass, criteria, val, null, null, null, new CollectionCriteriaPatcher(selectDeleted: true, PurgeSession.TypesManager), 0, 0);
					SelectStatementResult val3 = PurgeDataLayer.SelectData(val2).ResultSet[0];
					SelectStatementResultRow[] rows = val3.Rows;
					foreach (SelectStatementResultRow val4 in rows)

		private PurgerObjectRecord CreateNewObjectRecord(XPClassInfo baseClassInfo, CriteriaOperatorCollection requiredProperties, object[] selectResult)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = baseClassInfo;
			if (baseClassInfo.IsTypedObject)
			{
				object obj = ExtractValue(string.Empty, baseClassInfo.GetMember("ObjectType"), requiredProperties, selectResult);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					classInfo = PurgeSession.TypesManager.GetObjectType((int)obj).GetClassInfo();
				}
			}
			object key = ExtractValue(string.Empty, baseClassInfo.KeyProperty, requiredProperties, selectResult);
			return new PurgerObjectRecord(this, classInfo, key);
		}

	public abstract class NestedGuidParentMap
	{
		public abstract void Add(object parent, Guid nestedGuid, bool hasValidKey);

		public abstract object GetParent(Guid nestedGuid);

		public abstract Guid GetNested(object parent);

		public abstract void KickOut(object parent);

		public abstract void KickOut(Guid nestedGuid);
	}
	public class StrongNestedGuidParentMap : NestedGuidParentMap
	{
		private Dictionary<Guid, object> Parents = new Dictionary<Guid, object>();

		private ObjectDictionary<Guid> Nesteds = new ObjectDictionary<Guid>();

		public override void Add(object parent, Guid nestedGuid, bool hasValidKey)
		{
			Parents.Add(nestedGuid, parent);
			Nesteds.Add(parent, nestedGuid);
		}

		public override object GetParent(Guid nestedGuid)
		{
			if (Parents.TryGetValue(nestedGuid, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Guid GetNested(object parent)
		{
			if (Nesteds.TryGetValue(parent, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return Guid.Empty;
		}

		public override void KickOut(Guid nestedGuid)
		{
			if (Parents.TryGetValue(nestedGuid, out var value))
			{
				Parents.Remove(nestedGuid);
				Nesteds.Remove(value);
			}
		}

		public override void KickOut(object parent)
		{
			if (Nesteds.TryGetValue(parent, out var value))
			{
				Parents.Remove(value);
				Nesteds.Remove(parent);
			}
		}
	}
	public class WeakNestedGuidParentMap : StrongNestedGuidParentMap
	{
		private Dictionary<Guid, ObjectRecord> Parents = new Dictionary<Guid, ObjectRecord>();

		private Dictionary<ObjectRecord, Guid> Nesteds = new Dictionary<ObjectRecord, Guid>();

		public override void Add(object parent, Guid nestedGuid, bool hasValidKey)
		{
			if (hasValidKey)
			{
				ObjectRecord objectRecord = ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(parent);
				Nesteds[objectRecord] = nestedGuid;
				Parents[nestedGuid] = objectRecord;
			}
			else
			{
				base.Add(parent, nestedGuid, hasValidKey);
			}
		}

		public override object GetParent(Guid nestedGuid)
		{
			object parent = base.GetParent(nestedGuid);
			if (parent != null)
			{
				return parent;
			}
			if (Parents.TryGetValue(nestedGuid, out var value))
			{
				return value.Object;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Guid GetNested(object parent)
		{
			Guid nested = base.GetNested(parent);
			if (nested != Guid.Empty)
			{
				return nested;
			}
			ObjectRecord objectRecord = ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(parent);
			if (Nesteds.TryGetValue(objectRecord, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return Guid.Empty;
		}

		public override void KickOut(Guid nestedGuid)
		{
			base.KickOut(nestedGuid);
			if (Parents.TryGetValue(nestedGuid, out var value))
			{
				Parents.Remove(nestedGuid);
				Nesteds.Remove(value);
			}
		}

		public override void KickOut(object parent)
		{
			base.KickOut(parent);
			ObjectRecord objectRecord = ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(parent);
			if (Nesteds.TryGetValue(objectRecord, out var value))
			{
				Parents.Remove(value);
				Nesteds.Remove(objectRecord);
			}
		}
	}

		public static object CommitObjectProperties(Session parentSession, NestedGuidParentMap map, XPObjectClassInfoStubCache ciCache, XPClassInfo ci, XPObjectStub obj, object parent)
		{
			parentSession.TriggerObjectLoading(parent);
			XPClassInfoStub stub = ciCache.GetStub(ci);
			bool flag = ci.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? parentSession.TrackPropertiesModifications;
			ci.KeyProperty.SetValue(parent, obj.Key);
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in ci.PersistentProperties)
			{
				if (persistentProperty.IsReadOnly || persistentProperty.IsFetchOnly || !stub.IsMemberChanged(obj, persistentProperty.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				object obj2 = stub.GetMemberValue(obj, persistentProperty.Name);
				if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType != null && obj2 != null)
				{
					if (!(obj2 is XPObjectStub obj3))
					{
						continue;
					}
					obj2 = CreateParentObject(parentSession, map, persistentProperty.ReferenceType, obj3);
				}
				if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType != null)
				{
					object value = persistentProperty.GetValue(parent);
					persistentProperty.SetValue(parent, obj2);
					if (flag && !PersistentBase.CanSkipAssignment(value, obj2))
					{
						persistentProperty.SetModified(parent, value);
					}
					persistentProperty.ProcessAssociationRefChange(parentSession, parent, value, obj2);
					continue;
				}
				if (persistentProperty.Converter != null)
				{
					obj2 = persistentProperty.Converter.ConvertFromStorageType(obj2);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					object value2 = persistentProperty.GetValue(parent);
					persistentProperty.SetValue(parent, obj2);
					if (!PersistentBase.CanSkipAssignment(value2, obj2))
					{
						persistentProperty.SetModified(parent, value2);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					persistentProperty.SetValue(parent, obj2);
				}
			}
			if (parent is IntermediateObject && parentSession.IsNewObject(parent))
			{
				IntermediateObject intermediateObject = (IntermediateObject)parent;
				IntermediateClassInfo intermediateClassInfo = (IntermediateClassInfo)parentSession.GetClassInfo(intermediateObject);
				XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)intermediateClassInfo.intermediateObjectFieldInfoRight.refProperty.GetValue(intermediateObject.LeftIntermediateObjectField);
				XPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany xPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany = (XPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany)xPBaseCollection.Helper;
				xPRefCollectionHelperManyToMany.AddIntermediateObject(intermediateObject, intermediateObject.RightIntermediateObjectField);
				xPBaseCollection.BaseAdd(intermediateObject.RightIntermediateObjectField);
			}
			return parent;
		}

		public static void CommitDeletedObjects(Session parentSession, NestedGuidParentMap map, XPObjectClassInfoStubCache ciCache, XPClassInfo[] classInfoList, XPObjectStubCollection objectList)
		{
			object[] parentObjects = GetParentObjects(parentSession, map, classInfoList, objectList);
			for (int i = 0; i < objectList.Count; i++)
			{
				XPObjectStub xPObjectStub = objectList[i];
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = classInfoList[i];
				object obj = parentObjects[i];
				if (obj == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				XPClassInfoStub stub = ciCache.GetStub(xPClassInfo);
				if (xPClassInfo.TrackPropertiesModifications ?? parentSession.TrackPropertiesModifications)
				{
					foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in xPClassInfo.PersistentProperties)
					{
						if (!persistentProperty.IsReadOnly && !persistentProperty.IsFetchOnly && stub.IsMemberChanged(xPObjectStub, persistentProperty.Name) && !persistentProperty.GetModified(obj))
						{
							persistentProperty.SetModified(obj, persistentProperty.GetValue(obj));
						}
					}
				}
				if (xPObjectStub.IsIntermediate)
				{
					IntermediateObject intermediateObject = (IntermediateObject)obj;
					IntermediateClassInfo intermediateClassInfo = (IntermediateClassInfo)parentSession.GetClassInfo(intermediateObject);
					if (intermediateObject.LeftIntermediateObjectField != null && intermediateObject.RightIntermediateObjectField != null)
					{
						XPBaseCollection xPBaseCollection = (XPBaseCollection)intermediateClassInfo.intermediateObjectFieldInfoRight.refProperty.GetValue(intermediateObject.LeftIntermediateObjectField);
						xPBaseCollection.BaseRemove(intermediateObject.RightIntermediateObjectField);
					}
				}
				parentSession.Delete(obj);
			}
		}

		public static object[] CreateParentObjects(Session parentSession, NestedGuidParentMap map, XPClassInfo[] classInfoList, XPObjectStubCollection objectList)
		{
			object[] parentObjects = GetParentObjects(parentSession, map, classInfoList, objectList);
			for (int i = 0; i < objectList.Count; i++)
			{
				object obj = parentObjects[i];
				if (obj == null)
				{
					obj = classInfoList[i].CreateObject(parentSession);
					XPObjectStub xPObjectStub = objectList[i];
					map.Add(obj, xPObjectStub.Guid, !xPObjectStub.IsNew);
					parentObjects[i] = obj;
				}
			}
			return parentObjects;
		}

		public static object CreateParentObject(Session parentSession, NestedGuidParentMap map, XPClassInfo ci, XPObjectStub obj)
		{
			object parentObject = GetParentObject(parentSession, map, ci, obj);
			if (parentObject != null)
			{
				return parentObject;
			}
			parentObject = ci.CreateObject(parentSession);
			map.Add(parentObject, obj.Guid, !obj.IsNew);
			return parentObject;
		}

		public static void ValidateVersions(Session parentSession, NestedGuidParentMap map, XPObjectClassInfoStubCache ciCache, ObjectSet lockedParentsObjects, XPClassInfo[] objectClassInfoList, XPObjectStubCollection nestedObjects, LockingOption lockingOption, bool objectsToDelete)
		{
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00db: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0101: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			object[] parentObjects = GetParentObjects(parentSession, map, objectClassInfoList, nestedObjects);
			for (int i = 0; i < nestedObjects.Count; i++)
			{
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = objectClassInfoList[i];
				XPObjectStub xPObjectStub = nestedObjects[i];
				object obj = parentObjects[i];
				if (obj == null)
				{
					if (!xPObjectStub.IsNew)
					{
						throw new LockingException();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (lockedParentsObjects.Contains(obj))
					{
						continue;
					}
					lockedParentsObjects.Add(obj);
					if (xPObjectStub.IsNew != parentSession.IsNewObject(obj))
					{
						throw new LockingException();
					}
					if (lockingOption != LockingOption.Optimistic)
					{
						continue;
					}
					OptimisticLockingBehavior optimisticLockingBehavior = xPClassInfo.OptimisticLockingBehavior;
					switch (optimisticLockingBehavior)
					{
					case OptimisticLockingBehavior.ConsiderOptimisticLockingField:
					{
						XPMemberInfo optimisticLockField = xPClassInfo.OptimisticLockField;
						if (optimisticLockField != null && (int?)optimisticLockField.GetValue(obj) != (int?)xPObjectStub.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer)
						{
							throw new LockingException();
						}
						break;
					}
					case OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockModified:
					case OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockAll:
						if (LockingHelper.HasModified(ciCache.GetStub(xPClassInfo), xPObjectStub, xPClassInfo.PersistentProperties, obj, objectsToDelete ? OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockAll : optimisticLockingBehavior))
						{
							throw new LockingException();
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static object[] GetParentObjects(Session parentSession, NestedGuidParentMap map, XPClassInfo[] classInfoList, XPObjectStubCollection objectList)
		{
			object[] array = new object[objectList.Count];

					if (obj != null)

						array[i] = obj;
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (xPObjectStub.IsNew)
				{
					array[i] = obj;
					continue;
				}
				if (list == null)
				{
					list = new List<int>(objectList.Count);

				list.Add(i);
			}
			if (list == null)
			{
				return array;
			}
			Dictionary<XPClassInfo, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, bool>();
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				int num = list[j];
				XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = classInfoList[num];
				if (dictionary.ContainsKey(xPClassInfo))
				{
					continue;
				}
				dictionary.Add(xPClassInfo, value: true);
				List<int> list2 = new List<int>(objectList.Count - j);
				List<object> list3 = new List<object>(objectList.Count - j);
				list2.Add(num);
				list3.Add(objectList[num].Key);
				for (int k = j + 1; k < list.Count; k++)
				{
					int num2 = list[k];
					if (classInfoList[num2] == xPClassInfo)
					{
						list2.Add(num2);
						list3.Add(objectList[num2].Key);
					}
				}
				ICollection objectsByKey = parentSession.GetObjectsByKey(xPClassInfo, list3, alwaysGetFromDataStore: false);
				bool flag = parentSession.ObjectLayer.IsStaticType(xPClassInfo);
				int num3 = 0;
				foreach (object item in objectsByKey)
				{
					array[list2[num3]] = item;
					if (item != null)
					{
						map.KickOut(item);
						map.Add(item, objectList[list2[num3]].Guid, hasValidKey: true);
					}
					num3++;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

			return obj2;
		}

		public static XPObjectStub CreateNestedStubObjectJustWithIdentities(Session session, NestedGuidParentMap map, XPObjectClassInfoStubCache ciCache, object obj)

		}

		public static XPObjectStub CreateNestedStubObject(Session session, NestedGuidParentMap map, XPObjectStubCache objCache, XPObjectClassInfoStubCache ciCache, object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Guid guid = map.GetNested(obj);
			bool flag = session.IsNewObject(obj);
			if (guid == Guid.Empty)
			{
				guid = Guid.NewGuid();
				map.Add(obj, guid, !flag);
			}
			else
			{
				if (CreateNestedStubDictionary.ContainsKey(guid))
				{
					return CreateNestedStubObjectJustWithIdentities(session, map, ciCache, obj);
				}
				if (objCache != null)
				{
					XPObjectStub stub = objCache.GetStub(guid);
					if (stub != null)
					{
						return stub;
					}
				}
			}
			CreateNestedStubDictionary.Add(guid, value: true);
			try
			{
				XPClassInfo classInfo = session.GetClassInfo(obj);
				XPClassInfoStub stub2 = ciCache.GetStub(classInfo);
				XPObjectStub xPObjectStub = new XPObjectStub(stub2, guid);
				if (flag)
				{
					xPObjectStub.MarkAsNew();
				}
				if (obj is IntermediateObject)
				{
					xPObjectStub.MarkAsIntermediate();
				}
				objCache?.Add(guid, xPObjectStub);
				xPObjectStub.Key = classInfo.KeyProperty.GetValue(obj);
				foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
				{
					if (persistentProperty.IsReadOnly || persistentProperty.IsKey)
					{
						continue;
					}
					object obj2;
					if (persistentProperty.IsDelayed && !session.IsNewObject(obj))
					{
						XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(obj, persistentProperty);
						if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType == null)
						{
							if (!delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded)
							{
								continue;
							}
							obj2 = delayedPropertyContainer.Value;
						}
						else
						{
							if (!delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded)
							{
								stub2.SetMemberValue(xPObjectStub, persistentProperty.Name, delayedPropertyContainer.InternalValue);
								continue;
							}
							obj2 = delayedPropertyContainer.Value;
							if (obj2 == null)
							{
								stub2.SetMemberValue(xPObjectStub, persistentProperty.Name, null);
								continue;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						obj2 = persistentProperty.GetValue(obj);
					}
					if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType != null && obj2 != null)
					{
						obj2 = CreateNestedStubObject(session, map, objCache, ciCache, obj2);
					}
					if (persistentProperty.Converter != null)
					{
						obj2 = persistentProperty.Converter.ConvertToStorageType(obj2);
					}
					stub2.SetMemberValue(xPObjectStub, persistentProperty.Name, obj2);
				}
				return xPObjectStub;
			}
			finally
			{
				CreateNestedStubDictionary.Remove(guid);
			}
		}

		public static XPObjectStub CreateParentStubObjectJustWithIdentities(Session session, NestedParentGuidMap map, XPObjectClassInfoStubCache ciCache, object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)

		public static XPObjectStub CreateParentStubObject(Session session, NestedParentGuidMap map, XPObjectStubCache objCache, XPObjectClassInfoStubCache ciCache, object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool flag = session.IsNewObject(obj);
			Guid guid = map.GetParent(obj);
			if (guid == Guid.Empty)
			{
				guid = Guid.NewGuid();
				map.Add(guid, obj, !flag);
			}
			else
			{
				if (CreateParentStubDictionary.ContainsKey(guid))
				{
					return CreateParentStubObjectJustWithIdentities(session, map, ciCache, obj);
				}
				if (objCache != null)
				{
					XPObjectStub stub = objCache.GetStub(guid);
					if (stub != null)
					{
						return stub;
					}
				}
			}
			CreateParentStubDictionary.Add(guid, value: true);
			try
			{
				XPClassInfo classInfo = session.GetClassInfo(obj);
				XPClassInfoStub stub2 = ciCache.GetStub(classInfo);
				XPObjectStub xPObjectStub = new XPObjectStub(stub2, guid);
				if (flag)
				{
					xPObjectStub.MarkAsNew();
				}
				if (obj is IntermediateObject)
				{
					xPObjectStub.MarkAsIntermediate();
				}
				objCache?.Add(guid, xPObjectStub);
				xPObjectStub.Key = classInfo.KeyProperty.GetValue(obj);
				foreach (XPMemberInfo item in session.GetPropertiesListForUpdateInsert(obj, !flag, addDelayedReference: true))
				{
					if (item.IsReadOnly || item.IsKey)
					{
						continue;
					}
					object value;
					if (item.IsDelayed && !session.IsNewObject(obj))
					{
						XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(obj, item);
						if (item.ReferenceType == null)
						{
							if (!delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded || !delayedPropertyContainer.IsModified)
							{
								continue;
							}
							value = delayedPropertyContainer.Value;
						}
						else
						{
							if (!delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded)
							{
								stub2.SetMemberValue(xPObjectStub, item.Name, delayedPropertyContainer.InternalValue);
								continue;
							}
							value = delayedPropertyContainer.Value;
							if (value == null)
							{
								stub2.SetMemberValue(xPObjectStub, item.Name, null);
								if (item.GetModified(obj))
								{
									object obj2 = item.GetOldValue(obj);
									if (obj2 != null)
									{
										obj2 = CreateParentStubObject(session, map, objCache, ciCache, obj2);
									}
									stub2.SetMemberOldValue(xPObjectStub, item.Name, obj2);
								}
								continue;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						value = item.GetValue(obj);
					}
					value = PrepareMemberValue(session, map, objCache, ciCache, item, value);
					stub2.SetMemberValue(xPObjectStub, item.Name, value);
					if (item.GetModified(obj))
					{
						stub2.SetMemberOldValue(xPObjectStub, item.Name, PrepareMemberValue(session, map, objCache, ciCache, item, item.GetOldValue(obj)));
					}
				}
				if (classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer != null)
				{
					xPObjectStub.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer = classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer.GetValue(obj);
				}
				return xPObjectStub;
			}
			finally
			{
				CreateParentStubDictionary.Remove(guid);
			}
		}

		private static object PrepareMemberValue(Session session, NestedParentGuidMap map, XPObjectStubCache objCache, XPObjectClassInfoStubCache ciCache, XPMemberInfo mi, object value)
		{
			if (mi.ReferenceType != null && value != null)
			{
				value = CreateParentStubObject(session, map, objCache, ciCache, value);
			}
			if (mi.Converter != null)
			{
				value = mi.Converter.ConvertToStorageType(value);
			}
			return value;
		}
	}
	public abstract class NestedParentGuidMap
	{
		public static NestedParentMap Extract(NestedUnitOfWork source)
		{
			return source.Map;
		}

		protected NestedParentGuidMap(Session session)
		{
			session.AfterDropIdentityMap += AfterDropIdentityMapHandler;
		}

		private void AfterDropIdentityMapHandler(object sender, SessionManipulationEventArgs e)
		{
			Clear();
		}

		public abstract void Add(Guid parentGuid, object nested, bool hasValidKey);

		public abstract Guid GetParent(object nested);

		public abstract object GetNested(Guid parentGuid);

		public abstract void KickOut(object nested);

		public abstract void Clear();
	}
	public class StrongNestedParentGuidMap : NestedParentGuidMap
	{
		private ObjectDictionary<Guid> Parents = new ObjectDictionary<Guid>();

		private Dictionary<Guid, object> Nesteds = new Dictionary<Guid, object>();

		public StrongNestedParentGuidMap(Session session)
			: base(session)
		{
		}

		public override void Add(Guid parentGuid, object nested, bool hasValidKey)
		{
			Parents.Add(nested, parentGuid);
			Nesteds.Add(parentGuid, nested);
		}

		public override Guid GetParent(object nested)
		{
			if (Parents.TryGetValue(nested, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return Guid.Empty;
		}

		public override object GetNested(Guid parentGuid)
		{
			if (Nesteds.TryGetValue(parentGuid, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void KickOut(object nested)
		{
			if (Parents.TryGetValue(nested, out var value))
			{
				Parents.Remove(nested);
				Nesteds.Remove(value);
			}
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			Parents.Clear();
			Nesteds.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class WeakNestedParentGuidMap : StrongNestedParentGuidMap
	{
		private Dictionary<ObjectRecord, Guid> Parents = new Dictionary<ObjectRecord, Guid>();

		private Dictionary<Guid, ObjectRecord> Nesteds = new Dictionary<Guid, ObjectRecord>();

		public WeakNestedParentGuidMap(Session session)
			: base(session)
		{
		}

		public override void Add(Guid parentGuid, object nested, bool hasValidKey)
		{
			if (hasValidKey)
			{
				ObjectRecord objectRecord = ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(nested);
				Nesteds[parentGuid] = objectRecord;
				Parents[objectRecord] = parentGuid;
			}
			else
			{
				base.Add(parentGuid, nested, hasValidKey);
			}
		}

		public override Guid GetParent(object nested)
		{
			Guid parent = base.GetParent(nested);
			if (parent != Guid.Empty)
			{
				return parent;
			}
			ObjectRecord objectRecord = ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(nested);
			if (Parents.TryGetValue(objectRecord, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return Guid.Empty;
		}

		public override object GetNested(Guid parentGuid)
		{
			object nested = base.GetNested(parentGuid);
			if (nested != null)
			{
				return nested;
			}
			if (Nesteds.TryGetValue(parentGuid, out var value))
			{
				return value.Object;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void KickOut(object nested)
		{
			base.KickOut(nested);
			ObjectRecord objectRecord = ObjectRecord.GetObjectRecord(nested);
			if (Parents.TryGetValue(objectRecord, out var value))
			{
				Parents.Remove(objectRecord);
				Nesteds.Remove(value);
			}
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			base.Clear();
			Parents.Clear();
			Nesteds.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class NestedStubLoader
	{
		private struct ObjectPair
		{
			public readonly XPObjectStub Source;

			public readonly object Destination;

			public readonly OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior LoadMerge;

			public ObjectPair(XPObjectStub source, object destination, OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior loadMerge)
			{
				Source = source;
				Destination = destination;
				LoadMerge = loadMerge;
			}
		}

		private readonly ObjectSet forced = new ObjectSet();

		private readonly Queue<ObjectPair> toProcess = new Queue<ObjectPair>();

		private readonly NestedParentGuidMap Map;

		public readonly Session Owner;

		public readonly Session OwnerParent;

		private readonly XPObjectClassInfoStubCache ciCache;

		private static Func<object, object> ReturnArgument = (object arg) => arg;

		public NestedStubLoader(Session owner, NestedParentGuidMap map, XPObjectClassInfoStubCache ciCache)
		{
			Owner = owner;
			Map = map;
			this.ciCache = ciCache ?? new XPObjectClassInfoStubCache(owner);
		}

		private void CloneObjects(out IList toFireLoaded)
		{
			toFireLoaded = new List<object>();
			Dictionary<Guid, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<Guid, bool>();
			List<ObjectPair> list = new List<ObjectPair>();
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			do
			{
				ObjectPair item = toProcess.Dequeue();
				toFireLoaded.Add(item.Destination);
				XPObjectStub source = item.Source;
				XPClassInfo classInfo = ciCache.GetClassInfo(source.ClassName);
				XPClassInfoStub stub = ciCache.GetStub(classInfo);
				foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in classInfo.ObjectProperties)
				{
					if (!objectProperty.IsReadOnly && stub.IsMemberChanged(source, objectProperty.Name))
					{
						object memberValue = stub.GetMemberValue(source, objectProperty.Name);
						if (memberValue != null && memberValue is XPObjectStub parentObject)
						{
							list2.Add(GetNestedObjectCore(parentObject, forceLoad: false));
						}
					}
				}
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(item.Source.Guid))
				{
					list.Add(item);
					dictionary.Add(item.Source.Guid, value: true);
				}
			}
			while (toProcess.Count > 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				ObjectPair objectPair = list[i];
				Owner.TriggerObjectLoading(objectPair.Destination);
				CloneData(objectPair.Source, objectPair.Destination, objectPair.LoadMerge);
			}
			GC.KeepAlive(list2);
		}

		private void CloneData(XPObjectStub source, object destination, OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior loadMerge)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = ciCache.GetClassInfo(source.ClassName);
			XPClassInfoStub stub = ciCache.GetStub(classInfo);
			foreach (XPMemberInfo persistentProperty in classInfo.PersistentProperties)
			{
				if (persistentProperty.IsReadOnly)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (persistentProperty.IsDelayed && !source.IsNew)
				{
					if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType == null)
					{
						if (ObjectCollectionLoader.AcceptLoadPropertyAndResetModified(Owner.TrackPropertiesModifications, loadMerge, destination, classInfo, persistentProperty, ReturnArgument, null))
						{
							XPDelayedProperty.Init(Owner, destination, persistentProperty, null);
						}
						continue;
					}
					bool flag = false;
					object obj = stub.GetMemberValue(source, persistentProperty.Name);
					if (obj != null && obj is XPObjectStub xPObjectStub)
					{
						if (xPObjectStub.IsNew)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							obj = xPObjectStub.Key;
						}
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						if (ObjectCollectionLoader.AcceptLoadPropertyAndResetModified(Owner.TrackPropertiesModifications, loadMerge, destination, classInfo, persistentProperty, ReturnArgument, obj))
						{
							XPDelayedProperty.Init(Owner, destination, persistentProperty, obj);
						}
						continue;
					}
				}
				object obj2 = stub.GetMemberValue(source, persistentProperty.Name);
				if (persistentProperty.ReferenceType != null && obj2 != null)
				{
					obj2 = Map.GetNested(((XPObjectStub)obj2).Guid);
					if (obj2 == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("NestedSession_NotClonable", classInfo.FullName, persistentProperty.Name));
					}
				}
				if (persistentProperty.Converter != null)
				{
					obj2 = persistentProperty.Converter.ConvertFromStorageType(obj2);
				}
				if (ObjectCollectionLoader.AcceptLoadPropertyAndResetModified(Owner.TrackPropertiesModifications, loadMerge, destination, classInfo, persistentProperty, ReturnArgument, obj2))
				{
					persistentProperty.SetValue(destination, obj2);
				}
			}
		}

		private object CreateNestedObject(XPObjectStub pObject, bool forceLoad)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = ciCache.GetClassInfo(pObject.ClassName);
			bool flag = false;
			object nObject;
			if (pObject.IsNew)
			{
				nObject = classInfo.CreateObject(Owner);
			}
			else
			{
				object key = pObject.Key;
				nObject = Owner.GetLoadedObjectByKey(classInfo, key);
				if (nObject == null)
				{
					nObject = classInfo.CreateObject(Owner);
					SessionIdentityMap.RegisterObject(Owner, nObject, classInfo.KeyProperty.ExpandId(key));
				}
				else
				{
					Map.KickOut(nObject);
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			Map.Add(pObject.Guid, nObject, !pObject.IsNew);
			OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior loadMergeState = OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Default;
			if (!flag || ObjectCollectionLoader.NeedReload(Owner, classInfo, forceLoad, out loadMergeState, () => IsObjectVersionChanged(nObject, pObject)))
			{
				toProcess.Enqueue(new ObjectPair(pObject, nObject, loadMergeState));
			}
			return nObject;
		}

		private object GetNestedObjectCore(XPObjectStub parentObject, bool forceLoad)
		{
			object rv = Map.GetNested(parentObject.Guid);
			if (rv != null)
			{
				if (!(rv is IXPInvalidateableObject { IsInvalidated: not false }))
				{
					OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior loadMergeState = OptimisticLockingReadMergeBehavior.Default;
					if (ObjectCollectionLoader.NeedReload(Owner, ciCache.GetClassInfo(parentObject.ClassName), forceLoad, out loadMergeState, () => IsObjectVersionChanged(rv, parentObject)) && !forced.Contains(rv))
					{
						toProcess.Enqueue(new ObjectPair(parentObject, rv, loadMergeState));
						forced.Add(rv);
					}
					return rv;
				}
				Map.KickOut(rv);
			}
			rv = CreateNestedObject(parentObject, forceLoad);
			return rv;
		}

		public bool IsObjectVersionChanged(object nestedObject, XPObjectStub parentObject)
		{
			XPClassInfo classInfo = ciCache.GetClassInfo(parentObject.ClassName);
			XPClassInfoStub stub = ciCache.GetStub(classInfo);
			if (classInfo.OptimisticLockField == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int?)classInfo.OptimisticLockField.GetValue(nestedObject) != (int?)stub.GetMemberValue(parentObject, stub.OptimisticLockFieldName))
			{
				return (int?)classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer.GetValue(nestedObject) != (int?)parentObject.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public ICollection[] GetNestedObjects(XPObjectStubCollection[] parentObjects, bool[] force)
		{
			SessionStateStack.Enter(Owner, SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant);
			ICollection[] nestedObjectsCore;
			IList objectsToFireLoaded;
			try
			{
				nestedObjectsCore = GetNestedObjectsCore(parentObjects, force, out objectsToFireLoaded);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(Owner, SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant);
			}
			if (objectsToFireLoaded != null)
			{
				Owner.TriggerObjectsLoaded(objectsToFireLoaded);
			}
			return nestedObjectsCore;
		}

		public async Task<ICollection[]> GetNestedObjectsAsync(XPObjectStubCollection[] parentObjects, bool[] force, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			int asyncOperationId = SessionStateStack.GetNewAsyncOperationId();
			await SessionStateStack.EnterAsync(Owner, SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant, asyncOperationId, cancellationToken);
			ICollection[] nestedObjectsCore;
			IList objectsToFireLoaded;
			try
			{
				nestedObjectsCore = GetNestedObjectsCore(parentObjects, force, out objectsToFireLoaded);
			}
			finally
			{
				SessionStateStack.Leave(Owner, SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant, asyncOperationId);
			}
			if (objectsToFireLoaded != null)
			{
				Owner.TriggerObjectsLoaded(objectsToFireLoaded);
			}
			return nestedObjectsCore;
		}

		public ICollection[] GetNestedObjectsCore(XPObjectStubCollection[] parentObjects, bool[] force, out IList objectsToFireLoaded)
		{
			objectsToFireLoaded = null;

			}

		}

		public static bool IColumnsServerActionsAllowAction(Session session, XPClassInfo ci, string fieldName)
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Expected O, but got Unknown

		}

			}
			CriteriaOperator val = ((ServerModeCore)this).ExtractExpressionCore(input);
			ExpandedCriteriaHolder expandedCriteriaHolder = PersistentCriterionExpander.Expand(ClassInfo, Session, val);
			if (expandedCriteriaHolder.RequiresPostProcessing)

			}
			return expandedCriteriaHolder.ExpandedCriteria;
		}

		{
			int num = 0;
			CriteriaOperator expression = ((ServerModeCore)this).ExtractExpressionValue(valuesExpression, ref num);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return new object[0];
			}
			CriteriaOperator filter = (ignoreAppliedFilter ? filterExpression : (filterExpression & base.FilterClause));
			return ((ServerModeCore)this).WithReentryProtection<object[]>((Func<object[]>)(() => GetUniqueValues(valuesExpression, expression, maxCount, filter)));
		}

		private object[] GetUniqueValues(CriteriaOperator originalExpression, CriteriaOperator expandedExpression, int maxCount, CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int topSelectedRecords = ((maxCount > 0) ? maxCount : 0);
			CriteriaOperatorCollection val = new CriteriaOperatorCollection();
			((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)val).Add(expandedExpression);
			SortingCollection sorting = new SortingCollection(new SortProperty(expandedExpression, (SortingDirection)0));
			IList<object[]> list = Session.SelectData(ClassInfo, val, FixedCriteria & filter, val, null, selectDeleted: false, 0, topSelectedRecords, sorting);
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>(list.Count);
			foreach (object[] item in list)
			{
				list2.Add(item[0]);
			}
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = GetObjectExpressionType(originalExpression);
			if (xPClassInfo == null)
			{
				xPClassInfo = XpoServerModeCache.ObjectExpressionType(ClassInfo, expandedExpression);
			}
			if (xPClassInfo != null)
			{
				list2 = ListHelper.FromCollection(Session.GetObjectsByKey(xPClassInfo, list2, alwaysGetFromDataStore: false));
			}
			return list2.ToArray();
		}

		private XPClassInfo GetObjectExpressionType(CriteriaOperator originalExpression)
		{
			OperandProperty val = (OperandProperty)(object)((originalExpression is OperandProperty) ? originalExpression : null);
			if (val == null || val.PropertyName == null || !val.PropertyName.EndsWith("!"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[] array = val.PropertyName.Split('.');
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i].EndsWith("!"))
				{
					array[i] = array[i].Substring(0, array[i].Length - 1);
				}
				else if (array[i].EndsWith("!Key", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			string path = string.Join(".", array);
			MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = ClassInfo.ParsePath(path);
			if (!memberInfoCollection.HasNonPersistent)
			{
				return memberInfoCollection[memberInfoCollection.Count - 1].ReferenceType;
			}
			return null;
		}

			}
		}

		}

			}

		private void NotifyObjectChangedIfNeeded(object obj)
		{
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = base.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(obj);
			if (xPClassInfo != null && xPClassInfo.IsAssignableTo(ClassInfo))
			{
				int num = Nested.IndexOf(obj);
				if (num >= 0)
				{

	public class XpoServerCollectionAdderRemover : XpoServerCollectionWrapperBase
	{
		private readonly bool deleteOnRemove;

		private List<object> addedItems = new List<object>();

		private ObjectSet addedItemsDictionary = new ObjectSet();

		private ObjectSet removedItemsDictionary = new ObjectSet();

		private int currentGroupDepth;

		private object nowAdding;

		private bool CollectionInModifiedState
		{
			get
			{
				if (addedItemsDictionary.Count == 0)
				{
					return removedItemsDictionary.Count != 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private bool AddingRemovingAllowed => currentGroupDepth == 0;

		public override int Count => base.Count + addedItemsDictionary.Count - removedItemsDictionary.Count;

		public override object this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				int num = index - base.Count + removedItemsDictionary.Count;
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					return addedItems[num];
				}
				return base[IndexToBase(index)];
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public override bool IsReadOnly => true;

		public override bool IsFixedSize => !AddingRemovingAllowed;

		public override bool AllowRemove => AddingRemovingAllowed;

		public override bool AllowNew => AddingRemovingAllowed;

		public override bool SupportsChangeNotification => true;

		private event ListChangedEventHandler _ListChanged;

		public override event ListChangedEventHandler ListChanged
		{
			add
			{
				_ListChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				_ListChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		public XpoServerCollectionAdderRemover(IXpoServerModeGridDataSource nested, bool deleteOnRemove)
			: base(nested)
		{
			this.deleteOnRemove = deleteOnRemove;
			Nested.ListChanged += OnNestedListChanged;
		}

		public override object DXClone()
		{
			if (CollectionInModifiedState)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Can't clone modified collection");
			}
			return new XpoServerCollectionAdderRemover((IXpoServerModeGridDataSource)((IDXCloneable)Nested).DXClone(), deleteOnRemove);
		}

		public override int Add(object value)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(value);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (!AddingRemovingAllowed)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("ServerModeGridSource_GroupAndAddOrRemoveIsNotAllwed"));
			}
			if (removedItemsDictionary.Contains(value))
			{
				removedItemsDictionary.Remove(value);
			}
			else
			{
				addedItemsDictionary.Add(value);
				addedItems.Add(value);
			}
			num = IndexOf(value);
			RaiseChanged(new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.ItemAdded, num));
			return num;
		}

		public override void Remove(object value)
		{
			RemoveAt(IndexOf(value));
		}

		public override void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0 && index < Count)
			{
				if (!AddingRemovingAllowed)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("ServerModeGridSource_GroupAndAddOrRemoveIsNotAllwed"));
				}
				object obj = this[index];
				if (addedItemsDictionary.Contains(obj))
				{
					addedItemsDictionary.Remove(obj);
					addedItems.Remove(obj);
				}
				else
				{
					removedItemsDictionary.Add(obj);
				}
				RaiseChanged(new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.ItemDeleted, index));
				if (deleteOnRemove)
				{
					base.Session.Delete(obj);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Apply(CriteriaOperator filterCriteria, ICollection<ServerModeOrderDescriptor[]> sortInfo, int groupCount, ICollection<ServerModeSummaryDescriptor> summaryInfo, ICollection<ServerModeSummaryDescriptor> totalSummaryInfo)
		{
			if (groupCount > 0 && CollectionInModifiedState)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("ServerModeGridSource_GroupAndAddOrRemoveIsNotAllwed"));
			}
			currentGroupDepth = groupCount;
			base.Apply(filterCriteria, sortInfo, groupCount, summaryInfo, totalSummaryInfo);
			ValidateLists();
		}

		public override bool Contains(object value)
		{
			if (addedItemsDictionary.Contains(value))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (removedItemsDictionary.Contains(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.Contains(value);
		}

		public override void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override List<ListSourceGroupInfo> GetGroupInfo(ListSourceGroupInfo parentGroup)
		{
			return base.GetGroupInfo(parentGroup);
		}

		public override int GetRowIndexByKey(object key)
		{
			if (!CollectionInModifiedState)
			{
				return base.GetRowIndexByKey(key);
			}
			if (key == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = base.Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(key);
			object value;
			if (xPClassInfo != null && xPClassInfo.IsAssignableTo(ClassInfo))
			{
				value = key;
			}
			else
			{
				try
				{
					value = base.Session.GetObjectByKey(ClassInfo, key);
				}
				catch
				{
					value = null;
				}
			}
			return IndexOf(value);
		}

		public override object GetRowKey(int index)
		{
			object obj = this[index];
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (base.Session.IsNewObject(obj))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.Session.GetKeyValue(obj);
		}

		public override List<object> GetTotalSummary()
		{
			return base.GetTotalSummary();
		}

		public override int IndexOf(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (addedItemsDictionary.Contains(value))
			{
				int i;
				for (i = 0; addedItems[i] != value; i++)
				{
				}
				return base.Count - removedItemsDictionary.Count + i;
			}
			if (removedItemsDictionary.Contains(value))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return IndexFromBase(base.IndexOf(value));
		}

		protected int IndexFromBase(int baseIndex)
		{
			if (baseIndex < 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = baseIndex;
			foreach (object item in removedItemsDictionary)
			{
				int num2 = base.IndexOf(item);
				if (num2 >= 0 && num2 < baseIndex)
				{
					num--;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected int IndexToBase(int outerIndex)
		{
			if (removedItemsDictionary.Count == 0)
			{
				return outerIndex;
			}
			int[] array = new int[removedItemsDictionary.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object item in removedItemsDictionary)
			{
				int num2 = base.IndexOf(item);
				array[num++] = num2;
			}
			Array.Sort(array);
			int num3 = outerIndex;
			int[] array2 = array;
			foreach (int num4 in array2)
			{
				if (num4 > num3)
				{
					break;
				}
				num3++;
			}
			return num3;
		}

		public override void Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			Add(value);
		}

		public override void Refresh()
		{
			addedItems.Clear();
			addedItemsDictionary.Clear();
			removedItemsDictionary.Clear();
			base.Refresh();
		}

		private void ValidateLists()
		{
			for (int num = addedItems.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				object obj = addedItems[num];
				if (base.Contains(obj))
				{
					addedItemsDictionary.Remove(obj);
					addedItems.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>(removedItemsDictionary.Count);
			foreach (object item in removedItemsDictionary)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			foreach (object item2 in list)
			{
				if (!base.Contains(item2))
				{
					removedItemsDictionary.Remove(item2);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnNestedListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ValidateLists();
			RaiseChanged(new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.Reset, -1));
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseChanged(ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (this._ListChanged != null)
			{
				this._ListChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		protected virtual object CreateAddNewInstance()
		{
			return ClassInfo.CreateNewObject(base.Session);
		}

		public override object AddNew()
		{
			object obj = CreateAddNewInstance();
			Add(obj);
			SubscribeNewlyAdded(obj);
			return obj;
		}

		private void SubscribeNewlyAdded(object obj)
		{
			IXPObjectWithChangedEvent iXPObjectWithChangedEvent = obj as IXPObjectWithChangedEvent;
			ObjectChangeEventHandler value = NewAddedObjectChangedHandler;
			nowAdding = obj;
			if (iXPObjectWithChangedEvent != null)
			{
				iXPObjectWithChangedEvent.Changed += value;
			}
			else if (base.Session != null)
			{
				base.Session.ObjectChanged -= value;
				base.Session.ObjectChanged += value;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeNewlyAdded(object obj)
		{
			IXPObjectWithChangedEvent iXPObjectWithChangedEvent = obj as IXPObjectWithChangedEvent;
			ObjectChangeEventHandler value = NewAddedObjectChangedHandler;
			nowAdding = null;
			if (iXPObjectWithChangedEvent != null)
			{
				iXPObjectWithChangedEvent.Changed -= value;
			}
			else if (base.Session != null)
			{
				base.Session.ObjectChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		private void NewAddedObjectChangedHandler(object sender, ObjectChangeEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender == nowAdding)
			{
				switch (e.Reason)
				{
				case ObjectChangeReason.EndEdit:
					UnsubscribeNewlyAdded(sender);
					break;
				case ObjectChangeReason.CancelEdit:
					UnsubscribeNewlyAdded(sender);
					Remove(sender);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public override IList GetAllFilteredAndSortedRows()
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>(ListHelper.FromCollection(base.GetAllFilteredAndSortedRows()));
			foreach (object item in addedItemsDictionary)
			{
				list.Remove(item);
			}
			foreach (object item2 in removedItemsDictionary)
			{
				list.Remove(item2);
			}
			list.AddRange(addedItems);
			return list;
		}

		public override bool AllowAction(string fieldName, ColumnServerActionType action)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			bool flag = base.AllowAction(fieldName, action);
			if ((int)action == 1)
			{
				flag = flag && !CollectionInModifiedState;
			}
			return flag;
		}
	}

	public sealed class XPObjectTypesManager

		public XPObjectTypesManager(Session session)
			: this(session.ObjectLayer)

		public XPObjectTypesManager(IObjectLayer layer)
		{
