		}

		private IObjectLayerAsync GetObjectLayerAsync()
		{
			if (!(managedLayer is IObjectLayerAsync result))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Res.GetString("Async_ObjectLayerDoesNotImplementIObjectLayerAsync", managedLayer.GetType().FullName));
			}
			return result;
		}

		private Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPObjectType> GetAllTypes()
		{
			if (loadedTypes == null)
			{
				XPClassInfo classInfo = managedLayer.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(typeof(XPObjectType));
				loadedTypes = managedLayer.GetObjectLayerWideObjectTypes();
				if (loadedTypes == null)
				{
					using (managedLayer.Dictionary.LockObject.Lock())
					{
						loadedTypes = managedLayer.GetObjectLayerWideObjectTypes();
						if (loadedTypes == null)
						{
							managedLayer.RegisterStaticTypes(classInfo);
							loadedTypes = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPObjectType>();
							XPObjectType xPObjectType = new XPObjectType(managedLayer.Dictionary, classInfo.AssemblyName, classInfo.FullName);
							loadedTypes[xPObjectType.TypeClassInfo] = xPObjectType;
							managedLayer.SetObjectLayerWideObjectTypes(loadedTypes);
							try
							{
								using Session session = new StrongSession(managedLayer);
								ICollection objectTypesList = session.GetObjects(classInfo, null, null, 0, selectDeleted: true, force: false);
								FillLoadedTypes(objectTypesList);
							}
							catch (SchemaCorrectionNeededException)
							{
							}
						}
					}
				}
				objects = managedLayer.GetStaticCache(classInfo);
			}
			return loadedTypes;
		}

		private async Task<Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPObjectType>> GetAllTypesAsync(AsyncOperationIdentifier asyncOperationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (loadedTypes == null)
			{
				XPClassInfo objectType = managedLayer.Dictionary.GetClassInfo(typeof(XPObjectType));
				loadedTypes = managedLayer.GetObjectLayerWideObjectTypes();
				if (loadedTypes == null)
				{
					using (await managedLayer.Dictionary.LockObject.LockAsync(asyncOperationId))
					{
						loadedTypes = managedLayer.GetObjectLayerWideObjectTypes();
						if (loadedTypes == null)
						{
							managedLayer.RegisterStaticTypes(objectType);
							loadedTypes = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPObjectType>();
							XPObjectType xPObjectType = new XPObjectType(managedLayer.Dictionary, objectType.AssemblyName, objectType.FullName);
							loadedTypes[xPObjectType.TypeClassInfo] = xPObjectType;
							managedLayer.SetObjectLayerWideObjectTypes(loadedTypes);
							try
							{
								using Session session = new StrongSession(managedLayer);
								FillLoadedTypes(await session.GetObjectsAsync(objectType, null, null, 0, selectDeleted: true, force: false, cancellationToken));
							}
							catch (SchemaCorrectionNeededException)
							{
							}
						}
					}
				}
				objects = managedLayer.GetStaticCache(objectType);
			}
			return loadedTypes;
		}

		private void FillLoadedTypes(ICollection objectTypesList)
		{
			List<object> list = ListHelper.FromCollection(objectTypesList);
			List<XPClassInfo> list2 = new List<XPClassInfo>(objectTypesList.Count);
			while (true)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					XPObjectType xPObjectType = (XPObjectType)list[num];
					if (xPObjectType.IsValidType)
					{
						loadedTypes.Add(xPObjectType.TypeClassInfo, xPObjectType);
						list2.Add(xPObjectType.TypeClassInfo);
						list.RemoveAt(num);
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					break;
				}
				Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo> processedClassInfos = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, XPClassInfo>();
				foreach (XPClassInfo item in list2)
				{
					item.TouchRecursive(processedClassInfos);
				}
				list2.Clear();
			}
		}

		public XPObjectType GetObjectType(int id)
		{
			GetAllTypes();
			XPObjectType xPObjectType = (XPObjectType)objects.Get(id);
			if (xPObjectType != null)
			{
				return xPObjectType;
			}
			using (managedLayer.Dictionary.LockObject.Lock())
			{
				using (Session session = new StrongSession(managedLayer))
				{
					xPObjectType = session.GetObjectByKey<XPObjectType>(id);
				}
				if (xPObjectType != null && xPObjectType.IsValidType)
				{
					loadedTypes.Add(xPObjectType.TypeClassInfo, xPObjectType);
					return xPObjectType;
				}
				throw new TypeNotFoundException(id);
			}
		}

		public XPObjectType GetObjectType(XPClassInfo objectType)
		{
			if (!GetAllTypes().TryGetValue(objectType, out var value))
			{
				using (managedLayer.Dictionary.LockObject.Lock())
				{
					using (Session session = new StrongSession(managedLayer))
					{
						value = session.FindObject<XPObjectType>((CriteriaOperator)(object)((CriteriaOperator)(object)XPObjectType.Fields.TypeName == CriteriaOperator.op_Implicit(objectType.FullName)));
					}
					if (value == null)
					{
						objectType.GetRefTypes();
						value = new XPObjectType(managedLayer.Dictionary, objectType.AssemblyName, objectType.FullName);
						managedLayer.CreateObjectType(value);
					}
					if (!GetAllTypes().ContainsKey(objectType))
					{
						loadedTypes.Add(objectType, value);
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public async Task<XPObjectType> GetObjectTypeAsync(XPClassInfo objectType, AsyncOperationIdentifier asyncOperationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{

			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!(await GetAllTypesAsync(asyncOperationId, cancellationToken)).TryGetValue(objectType, out var type))
			{
				using (await managedLayer.Dictionary.LockObject.LockAsync(asyncOperationId))
				{
					using (Session session = new StrongSession(managedLayer))
					{
						type = await session.FindObjectAsync<XPObjectType>((CriteriaOperator)(object)((CriteriaOperator)(object)XPObjectType.Fields.TypeName == CriteriaOperator.op_Implicit(objectType.FullName)), cancellationToken);
					}
					if (type == null)
					{
						objectType.GetRefTypes();
						type = new XPObjectType(managedLayer.Dictionary, objectType.AssemblyName, objectType.FullName);
						await GetObjectLayerAsync().CreateObjectTypeAsync(type, cancellationToken);
					}
					if (!(await GetAllTypesAsync(asyncOperationId, cancellationToken)).ContainsKey(objectType))
					{
						loadedTypes.Add(objectType, type);
					}
				}
			}
			return type;
		}

	internal class LockingHelper
	{
		public static CriteriaOperator GetLockingCriteria(int? dbVersion, XPMemberInfo optimisticLock)

			}

		}

		private static bool IsPropertyToCheckLocking(OptimisticLockingBehavior option, XPMemberInfo mi, bool isModified)
		{
			if (mi.IsKey || (mi.IsDelayed && mi.ReferenceType == null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (mi.IsOptimisticLockingIgnored)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (option == OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockModified && !isModified)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet GetLockingCriteria(XPClassInfo ci, IEnumerable properties, object theObject, OptimisticLockingBehavior option)
		{
			return GetLockingCriteria(ci, properties, theObject, option, null);
		}

		public static ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet GetLockingCriteria(XPClassInfo ci, IEnumerable properties, object theObject, OptimisticLockingBehavior option, IList exclude)
		{
			if (option == OptimisticLockingBehavior.NoLocking || option == OptimisticLockingBehavior.ConsiderOptimisticLockingField)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet result = new ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet();
			XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = ci.FindMember(GCRecordField.StaticName);
			bool flag = xPMemberInfo != null && xPMemberInfo.GetValue(theObject) != null;
			foreach (XPMemberInfo mi in properties)
			{
				if (exclude != null && exclude.Contains(mi))
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool modified = mi.GetModified(theObject);
				if (!IsPropertyToCheckLocking(option, mi, modified || flag))
				{
					continue;
				}
				string tableName = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(mi.Owner.TableName) ? ci.IdClass.TableName : mi.Owner.TableName);
				if (mi.SubMembers.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (XPMemberInfo subMember in mi.SubMembers)
					{
						if (subMember.IsPersistent)
						{
							AddLockingPropertyCriteria(theObject, result, modified, tableName, (XPMemberInfo smi, object o) => smi.GetConst(mi.GetOldValue(o), mi), subMember);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					AddLockingPropertyCriteria(theObject, result, modified, tableName, (XPMemberInfo m, object o) => m.GetOldValue(o), mi);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static void AddLockingPropertyCriteria(object theObject, ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet result, bool isModified, string tableName, Func<XPMemberInfo, object, object> getOldValue, XPMemberInfo memberInfo)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0083: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			OperandProperty val = new OperandProperty(memberInfo.Name);
			object obj = null;
			if (isModified)
			{
				obj = getOldValue(memberInfo, theObject);
			}
			else if (memberInfo.IsDelayed)
			{
				XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(theObject, memberInfo);
				if (delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded)
				{
					obj = delayedPropertyContainer.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					val = new OperandProperty(memberInfo.Name + "." + memberInfo.ReferenceType.KeyProperty.Name);
					obj = delayedPropertyContainer.InternalValue;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				obj = memberInfo.GetValue(theObject);
			}
			result.UpdateCriteria(tableName, (CriteriaOperator)((obj == null) ? ((object)((CriteriaOperator)val).IsNull()) : ((object)((CriteriaOperator)(object)val == (CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue(obj)))));
		}

		public static object GetNestedValue(XPClassInfoStub classInfoStub, XPObjectStub obj, int memberIndex, out bool isModified)
		{
			object result = obj.Data[memberIndex];
			XPClassInfoStubOldValueContainer xPClassInfoStubOldValueContainer = ((obj.OldData == null) ? null : obj.OldData[memberIndex]);
			if (xPClassInfoStubOldValueContainer == null)
			{
				isModified = false;
				return result;
			}
			isModified = true;
			return xPClassInfoStubOldValueContainer.Data;
		}

		private static object GetNestedValue(object theObject, XPMemberInfo mi, bool isModified)
		{
			object obj = null;
			if (isModified)
			{
				return mi.GetOldValue(theObject);
			}
			if (mi.IsDelayed)
			{
				XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(theObject, mi);
				return delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded ? delayedPropertyContainer.Value : delayedPropertyContainer.InternalValue;
			}
			return mi.GetValue(theObject);
		}

		private static object GetParentValue(object parentObject, XPMemberInfo mi)
		{
			object obj = null;
			if (mi.GetModified(parentObject) || !mi.IsDelayed)
			{
				return mi.GetValue(parentObject);
			}
			XPDelayedProperty delayedPropertyContainer = XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(parentObject, mi);
			return delayedPropertyContainer.IsLoaded ? delayedPropertyContainer.Value : delayedPropertyContainer.InternalValue;
		}

		public static bool HasModified(XPClassInfoStub classInfoStub, XPObjectStub obj, IEnumerable properties, object parentObject, OptimisticLockingBehavior option)
		{
			if (option == OptimisticLockingBehavior.NoLocking || option == OptimisticLockingBehavior.ConsiderOptimisticLockingField)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int memberIndex = classInfoStub.GetMemberIndex(GCRecordField.StaticName, raiseException: false);
			bool flag = memberIndex >= 0 && obj.Data[memberIndex] != null;
			foreach (XPMemberInfo property in properties)
			{
				int memberIndex2 = classInfoStub.GetMemberIndex(property.Name, raiseException: false);
				if (memberIndex2 < 0 || !obj.Changed[memberIndex2])
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool isModified;
				object obj2 = GetNestedValue(classInfoStub, obj, memberIndex2, out isModified);
				if (IsPropertyToCheckLocking(option, property, isModified || flag))
				{
					if (property.ReferenceType != null && obj2 is XPObjectStub)
					{
						obj2 = ((XPObjectStub)obj2).Key;
					}
					object parentValue = GetParentValue(parentObject, property);
					if (IsModifiedInDataLayer(property, obj2, parentValue))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool HasModified(XPClassInfo ci, IEnumerable properties, object theObject, object parentObject, OptimisticLockingBehavior option)
		{
			if (option == OptimisticLockingBehavior.NoLocking || option == OptimisticLockingBehavior.ConsiderOptimisticLockingField)
			{
				return false;
			}
			XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = ci.FindMember(GCRecordField.StaticName);
			bool flag = xPMemberInfo != null && xPMemberInfo.GetValue(theObject) != null;
			foreach (XPMemberInfo property in properties)
			{
				bool modified = property.GetModified(theObject);
				if (IsPropertyToCheckLocking(option, property, modified || flag))
				{
					object nestedValue = GetNestedValue(theObject, property, modified);
					object parentValue = GetParentValue(parentObject, property);
					if (IsModifiedInDataLayer(property, nestedValue, parentValue))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool BytesAreEquals(byte[] oldValue, byte[] newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue == newValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (oldValue.Length != newValue.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = oldValue.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (oldValue[i] != newValue[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsModifiedInDataLayer(XPMemberInfo member, object nestedValue, object parentValue)
		{
			if (nestedValue == parentValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (nestedValue is ValueType && parentValue is ValueType)
			{
				return !object.Equals(nestedValue, parentValue);
			}
			if (nestedValue is string && parentValue is string)
			{
				return !object.Equals(nestedValue, parentValue);
			}
			if (nestedValue is byte[] && parentValue is byte[])
			{
				return !BytesAreEquals((byte[])nestedValue, (byte[])parentValue);
			}
			if (nestedValue != null && parentValue != null)
			{
				if (member.ReferenceType != null)
				{
					Type type = nestedValue.GetType();
					Type type2 = parentValue.GetType();
					if (!type.IsValueType && !type.IsEnum && !type.IsPrimitive && !type.IsGenericType)
					{
						nestedValue = member.ReferenceType.KeyProperty.GetValue(nestedValue);
					}
					if (!type2.IsValueType && !type2.IsEnum && !type2.IsPrimitive && !type2.IsGenericType)
					{
						parentValue = member.ReferenceType.KeyProperty.GetValue(parentValue);
					}
					if (object.Equals(nestedValue, parentValue))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (member.IsStruct && member.SubMembers.Count > 0)
				{
					IdList idList = nestedValue as IdList;
					IdList idList2 = parentValue as IdList;
					if (idList == null)
					{
						idList = member.ExpandId(nestedValue) as IdList;
					}
					if (parentValue == null)
					{
						idList2 = member.ExpandId(parentValue) as IdList;
					}
					if (idList.Count != idList2.Count)
					{
						return true;
					}
					int num = 0;
					foreach (XPMemberInfo subMember in member.SubMembers)
					{
						if (subMember.IsPersistent)
						{
							if (IsModifiedInDataLayer(subMember, idList[num], idList2[num]))
							{
								return true;
							}
							num++;
						}
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class ProcessingSave
	{
		private class InsertUpdate
		{
			public readonly object TheObject;

			public readonly MemberInfoCollection Updatable;

			public InsertUpdate(object theObject, MemberInfoCollection updatable)
			{
				TheObject = theObject;
				Updatable = updatable;
			}
		}

		private List<object> processedObjectsList;

		private Session session;

		private List<object> insertList = new List<object>();

		private readonly BatchWideDataHolder4Modification BatchWideData;

		private Session Session => session;

		public ProcessingSave(Session session, BatchWideDataHolder4Modification batchWideData)
		{
			this.session = session;
			BatchWideData = batchWideData;
			processedObjectsList = ListHelper.FromCollection(SaveOrderer.PrepareSaveOrder(session));
		}

		private void InternalInsertObject(List<ModificationStatement> insertList, List<InsertUpdate> updateList, object theObject)
		{
			//IL_0187: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			XPClassInfo classInfo = Session.GetClassInfo(theObject);
			XPMemberInfo optimisticLockField = classInfo.OptimisticLockField;
			if (optimisticLockField != null && optimisticLockField.GetValue(theObject) == null)
			{
				optimisticLockField.SetValue(theObject, 0);
			}
			XPMemberInfo keyProperty = classInfo.KeyProperty;
			MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection = new MemberInfoCollection(classInfo);
			MemberInfoCollection memberInfoCollection2 = new MemberInfoCollection(classInfo);
			foreach (XPMemberInfo item in Session.GetPropertiesListForUpdateInsert(theObject, isUpdate: false, addDelayedReference: false))
			{
				if (keyProperty.MappingField == item.MappingField && keyProperty != item)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (item.ReferenceType != null)
				{
					object value = item.GetValue(theObject);
					if (value != null && Session.IsNewObject(value) && !BatchWideData.IsObjectAlreadyInserted(value))
					{
						memberInfoCollection2.Add(item);
					}
					else
					{
						memberInfoCollection.Add(item);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					memberInfoCollection.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (keyProperty.IsAutoGenerate)
			{
				if (keyProperty.MemberType == typeof(Guid))
				{
					object value2 = keyProperty.GetValue(theObject);
					if (value2 == null || (Guid)value2 == Guid.Empty)
					{
						keyProperty.SetValue(theObject, XpoDefault.NewGuid());
					}
				}
				else if (!keyProperty.IsIdentity)
				{
					throw new KeysAutogenerationNonSupportedTypeException(classInfo.FullName);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Session.CheckDuplicateObjectInIdentityMap(theObject);
			}
			BatchWideData.RegisterInsertedObject(theObject);
			List<ModificationStatement> list = InsertQueryGenerator.GenerateInsert(Session.Dictionary, BatchWideData, theObject, memberInfoCollection);
			InsertStatement val = (InsertStatement)list[0];
			if (val.IdentityParameter != null)
			{
				this.insertList.Add(theObject);
			}
			insertList.AddRange(list);
			if (memberInfoCollection2.Count > 0)
			{
				updateList.Add(new InsertUpdate(theObject, memberInfoCollection2));
			}
		}

		private void InternalUpdateObject(List<ModificationStatement> updateList, object theObject)
		{
			Session.CheckDuplicateObjectInIdentityMap(theObject);
			XPClassInfo classInfo = Session.GetClassInfo(theObject);
			XPMemberInfo optimisticLockField = classInfo.OptimisticLockField;
			MemberInfoCollection propertiesListForUpdateInsert = Session.GetPropertiesListForUpdateInsert(theObject, isUpdate: true, addDelayedReference: false);
			if (Session.LockingOption == LockingOption.Optimistic)
			{
				switch (classInfo.OptimisticLockingBehavior)
				{
				case OptimisticLockingBehavior.ConsiderOptimisticLockingField:
					if (optimisticLockField != null)
					{
						updateList.AddRange(UpdateQueryGenerator.GenerateUpdate(Session.Dictionary, BatchWideData, theObject, propertiesListForUpdateInsert, ObjectGeneratorCriteriaSet.GetCriteriaSet(classInfo.IdClass.TableName, LockingHelper.GetLockingCriteria((int?)classInfo.OptimisticLockFieldInDataLayer.GetValue(theObject), optimisticLockField))));
						return;
					}
					break;
				case OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockModified:
				case OptimisticLockingBehavior.LockAll:
					updateList.AddRange(UpdateQueryGenerator.GenerateUpdate(Session.Dictionary, BatchWideData, theObject, propertiesListForUpdateInsert, LockingHelper.GetLockingCriteria(classInfo, classInfo.PersistentProperties, theObject, classInfo.OptimisticLockingBehavior)));
					return;
				}
			}
			updateList.AddRange(UpdateQueryGenerator.GenerateUpdate(Session.Dictionary, BatchWideData, theObject, propertiesListForUpdateInsert));
		}

		public List<ModificationStatement> Process()
		{
			List<XPClassInfo> list = ProcessBegin();
			Session.UpdateSchema(list.ToArray());
			return ProcessEnd();
		}

		public async Task<List<ModificationStatement>> ProcessAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			List<XPClassInfo> list = ProcessBegin();
			await Session.UpdateSchemaAsync(cancellationToken, list.ToArray());
			return ProcessEnd();
		}

		private List<XPClassInfo> ProcessBegin()
		{
			Dictionary<XPClassInfo, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<XPClassInfo, object>();
			List<XPClassInfo> list = new List<XPClassInfo>();
			foreach (object processedObjects in processedObjectsList)
			{
				XPClassInfo classInfo = Session.GetClassInfo(processedObjects);
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(classInfo))
				{
					dictionary.Add(classInfo, null);
					list.Add(classInfo);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<ModificationStatement> ProcessEnd()
		{
			List<ModificationStatement> list = new List<ModificationStatement>();
			List<InsertUpdate> list2 = new List<InsertUpdate>();
			List<object> list3 = new List<object>();
			foreach (object processedObjects in processedObjectsList)
			{
				if (Session.IsNewObject(processedObjects))
				{
					InternalInsertObject(list, list2, processedObjects);
				}
				else
				{
					list3.Add(processedObjects);
				}
			}
			foreach (InsertUpdate item in list2)
			{
				list.AddRange(UpdateQueryGenerator.GenerateUpdate(Session.Dictionary, BatchWideData, item.TheObject, item.Updatable));
			}
			foreach (object item2 in list3)
			{
				InternalUpdateObject(list, item2);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public void ProcessResults(ModificationResult result)
		{
			if (insertList.Count > 0)
			{
				SessionStateStack.Enter(Session, SessionState.ApplyIdentities);
				try
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < insertList.Count; i++)
					{
						Session.SetKeyValue(insertList[i], ((OperandValue)result.Identities[i]).Value);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					SessionStateStack.Leave(Session, SessionState.ApplyIdentities);
				}
			}
			if (BatchWideData.InsertedObjects != null)
			{
				foreach (object insertedObject in BatchWideData.InsertedObjects)
				{
					Session.RegisterInsertedObject(insertedObject);
				}
			}
			if (BatchWideData.DeletedObjects == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object deletedObject in BatchWideData.DeletedObjects)
			{
				if (!Session.IsNewObject(deletedObject))
				{
					SessionIdentityMap.UnregisterObject(Session, deletedObject);
				}
				if (deletedObject is IXPInvalidateableObject iXPInvalidateableObject)
				{
					iXPInvalidateableObject.Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class SaveOrderer
	{
		public readonly XPDictionary Dictionary;

		public readonly IDictionary NonSavedObjects;

		public readonly ObjectDictionary<ObjectSet> ReferredBy;

		public readonly ObjectDictionary<ObjectSet> References;

		public readonly List<object> Result;

		private List<object> NonReferencedObjects;

		private SaveOrderer(XPDictionary dictionary, ICollection newObjectsToSave)
		{
			Dictionary = dictionary;
			Result = new List<object>(newObjectsToSave.Count);
			ReferredBy = new ObjectDictionary<ObjectSet>(newObjectsToSave.Count);
			References = new ObjectDictionary<ObjectSet>(newObjectsToSave.Count);
			foreach (object item in newObjectsToSave)
			{
				ReferredBy.Add(item, new ObjectSet());
			}
			foreach (object item2 in newObjectsToSave)
			{
				ObjectSet objectSet = new ObjectSet();
				References.Add(item2, objectSet);
				XPClassInfo classInfo = Dictionary.GetClassInfo(item2);
				foreach (XPMemberInfo objectProperty in classInfo.ObjectProperties)
				{
					if (!objectProperty.IsDelayed || XPDelayedProperty.GetDelayedPropertyContainer(item2, objectProperty).IsLoaded)
					{
						object value = objectProperty.GetValue(item2);
						if (value != null && ReferredBy.ContainsKey(value))
						{
							objectSet.Add(value);
							ReferredBy[value].Add(item2);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			NonReferencedObjects = new List<object>();
			foreach (object key in References.Keys)
			{
				if (References[key].Count == 0)
				{
					NonReferencedObjects.Add(key);
				}
			}
		}

		public void MarkObjectAsSaved(object obj)
		{
			if (!ReferredBy.TryGetValue(obj, out var value))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object item in value)
			{
				ObjectSet objectSet = References[item];
				objectSet.Remove(obj);
				if (objectSet.Count == 0)
				{
					NonReferencedObjects.Add(item);
				}
			}
			foreach (object item2 in References[obj])
			{
				ReferredBy[item2].Remove(obj);
			}
			ReferredBy.Remove(obj);
			References.Remove(obj);
			Result.Add(obj);
		}

		public void Do()
		{
			ProcessGoodObjects();
			Dictionary<object, ObjectSet>.Enumerator enumerator = References.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				EleminateLoop(enumerator.Current.Key);
				enumerator = References.GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		private void ProcessGoodObjects()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < NonReferencedObjects.Count; i++)
			{
				MarkObjectAsSaved(NonReferencedObjects[i]);
			}
			NonReferencedObjects.Clear();
		}

		private void EleminateLoop(object nextObject)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			ObjectDictionary<int> objectDictionary = new ObjectDictionary<int>();
			int num = 0;
			while (true)
			{
				objectDictionary[nextObject] = num;
				list.Add(nextObject);
				IEnumerator enumerator = References[nextObject].GetEnumerator();
				if (!enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_InternalXPOError"));
				}
				nextObject = enumerator.Current;
				if (objectDictionary.ContainsKey(nextObject))
				{
					NonReferencedObjects.Add(nextObject);
					for (int i = 0; i < NonReferencedObjects.Count; i++)
					{
						object obj = NonReferencedObjects[i];
						MarkObjectAsSaved(obj);
						if (objectDictionary.TryGetValue(obj, out var value) && value < num)
						{
							num = value;
						}
					}
					NonReferencedObjects.Clear();
					num--;
					if (num < 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					nextObject = list[num];
					list.RemoveRange(num, list.Count - num);
					num--;
				}
				num++;
			}
		}

		private static List<object> DoOrder(XPDictionary dictionary, ICollection newObjectsToSave)
		{
			SaveOrderer saveOrderer = new SaveOrderer(dictionary, newObjectsToSave);
			saveOrderer.Do();
			return saveOrderer.Result;
		}

		public static IList PrepareSaveOrder(Session session)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			foreach (object item in session.GetObjectsToSave())
			{
				if (!session.IsObjectToDelete(item))
				{
					if (session.IsNewObject(item))
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					else
					{
						list2.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			List<object> list3 = new List<object>();
			list3.AddRange(DoOrder(session.Dictionary, list));
			list3.AddRange(list2);
			return list3;
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum SessionState
	{
		Empty = 0,
		GetObjectsNonReenterant = 1,
		BeginTransaction = 2,
		CommitTransactionNonReenterant = 4,
		CommitChangesToDataLayer = 8,
		RollbackTransaction = 0x10,
		LoadingObjectsIntoNestedUow = 0x20,
		ReceivingObjectsFromNestedUow = 0x40,
		CancelEdit = 0x80,
		CreateObjectLoadingEnforcer = 0x100,
		OptimisticLockFieldsProcessing = 0x200,
		ApplyIdentities = 0x400,
		LoadingStates = 0x7C1,
		SavingStates = 0x224,
		ProhibitedForGetObjects = 0x39B,
		ProhibitedForCancelEdit = 0x3BB,
		ProhibitedGeneric = 0x7F7,
		SessionObjectsToSaveOrDeleteChanging = 0x800,
		ProhibitedSessionObjectsToSaveOrDeleteChanging = 0x29,
		CommitChangesToDataLayerInner = 0x1000,
		CrossThreadFailure = 0x2000
	}
	public static class SessionStateStack
	{
		private static bool _SuppressCrossThreadFailuresDetection;

		private static int asyncOperationSequenceId;

		[Obsolete("CrossThread Failures Detection suppressed")]
		public static bool SuppressCrossThreadFailuresDetection
		{
			get
			{
				return _SuppressCrossThreadFailuresDetection;
			}
			set
			{
				_SuppressCrossThreadFailuresDetection = value;
			}
		}

		public static void ThrowIfCantEnter(Session session, SessionState newState)
		{
			SessionState sessionState;
			switch (newState)
			{
			case SessionState.BeginTransaction:
			case SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant:
			case SessionState.RollbackTransaction:
			case SessionState.LoadingObjectsIntoNestedUow:
			case SessionState.ReceivingObjectsFromNestedUow:
				sessionState = SessionState.ProhibitedGeneric;
				break;
			case SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant:
				sessionState = SessionState.ProhibitedForGetObjects;
				break;
			case SessionState.CancelEdit:
				sessionState = SessionState.ProhibitedForCancelEdit;
				break;
			case SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayer:
			case SessionState.CreateObjectLoadingEnforcer:
			case SessionState.OptimisticLockFieldsProcessing:
			case SessionState.ApplyIdentities:
			case SessionState.CommitChangesToDataLayerInner:
				sessionState = SessionState.LoadingStates;
				break;
			case SessionState.SessionObjectsToSaveOrDeleteChanging:
				sessionState = SessionState.ProhibitedSessionObjectsToSaveOrDeleteChanging;
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(Res.GetString("Session_UnexpectedState"), newState.ToString()), "newState");
			}
			sessionState |= newState | SessionState.CrossThreadFailure;
			if ((session._StateStack & sessionState) == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = string.Format(Res.GetString("Session_EnteringTheX0StateFromTheX1StateIsProhibit"), newState, session._StateStack & sessionState, session._StateStack, session);
			if (newState == SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant)
			{
				if (IsInAnyOf(session, SessionState.LoadingStates))
				{
					text += Res.GetString("Session_MostProbablyYouAreTryingToInitiateAnObjectEx");
				}
				else if (IsInAnyOf(session, SessionState.SavingStates))
				{
					text += Res.GetString("Session_MostProbablyYouAreTryingToInitiateAnObject");
				}
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException(text);
		}

		public static void Enter(Session session, SessionState newState)
		{
			if (!_SuppressCrossThreadFailuresDetection && (session._StateStack == SessionState.Empty || newState == SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant || newState == SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant))
			{
				ThrowIfCrossThreadFailureOnEnter(session, newState, 0);
			}
			ThrowIfCantEnter(session, newState);
			session._StateStack |= newState;
		}

		public static async Task EnterAsync(Session session, SessionState newState, int asyncOperationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken))
		{
			if (!_SuppressCrossThreadFailuresDetection)
			{
				if (asyncOperationId == 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("asyncOperationId");
				}
				if (session._StateStack == SessionState.Empty || newState == SessionState.GetObjectsNonReenterant || newState == SessionState.CommitTransactionNonReenterant || newState == SessionState.LoadingObjectsIntoNestedUow)
				{
					await session._AsyncLockSemaphore.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
					ThrowIfCrossThreadFailureOnEnter(session, newState, asyncOperationId);
				}
			}
			ThrowIfCantEnter(session, newState);
			session._StateStack |= newState;
		}

		private static void ThrowIfCrossThreadFailureOnEnter(Session session, SessionState newState, int asyncOperationId)
		{
			Thread currentThread = Thread.CurrentThread;
			Thread thread = session._ExchangeThreadWatch(currentThread);
			int num = session._ExchangeAsyncOperationWatch(asyncOperationId);
			if (thread != null && thread != currentThread)
			{
				session._StateStack |= SessionState.CrossThreadFailure;
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_CrossThreadFailureDetected", session));
			}
			if (num != 0 && num != asyncOperationId)
			{
				session._ExchangeAsyncOperationWatch(num);
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_CrossThreadFailureDetected", session));
			}
		}

		public static void Leave(Session session, SessionState state, int asyncOperationId = 0)
		{
			session._StateStack &= ~state;
			if (session._StateStack != SessionState.Empty)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Thread thread = session._ExchangeThreadWatch(null);
				int num = session._ExchangeAsyncOperationWatch(0);
				if (thread != null && thread != Thread.CurrentThread && num == 0)
				{
					session._StateStack |= SessionState.CrossThreadFailure;
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_CrossThreadFailureDetected", session));
				}
				if (asyncOperationId != 0 && num != asyncOperationId)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Session_CrossThreadFailureDetected", session));
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (asyncOperationId != 0)
				{
					session._AsyncLockSemaphore.Release();
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool IsInAnyOf(Session session, SessionState states)
		{
			return (session._StateStack & states) != 0;
		}

		internal static int GetNewAsyncOperationId()
		{
			int num;
			do
			{
				num = Interlocked.Increment(ref asyncOperationSequenceId);
			}
			while (num == 0);
			return num;
		}
	}
	internal static class AsyncOperationsHelper
	{
		public static SynchronizationContext CaptureSynchronizationContextOrFail()
		{
			SynchronizationContext synchronizationContext = SyncHelper.TryCaptureSynchronizationContext();
			if (synchronizationContext == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Async_OperationCannotBePerformedBecauseNoSyncContext"));
			}
			return synchronizationContext;
		}

		public static void FailIfSynchronizationContextUnavailable()
		{
			if (SyncHelper.CanCaptureContext())
			{
				return;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("Async_OperationCannotBePerformedBecauseNoSyncContext"));
		}
	}

		public void Dispose()

				return false;
			}
			if (!(obj is FreeQuerySet freeQuerySet) || JoinType != freeQuerySet.JoinType)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MasterJoin != freeQuerySet.MasterJoin && (MasterJoin == null || freeQuerySet.MasterJoin == null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MasterJoin != null && !MasterJoin.Equals(freeQuerySet.MasterJoin))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MasterJoinEqualsOperands == freeQuerySet.MasterJoinEqualsOperands)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (MasterJoinEqualsOperands == null || freeQuerySet.MasterJoinEqualsOperands == null || MasterJoinEqualsOperands.Count != freeQuerySet.MasterJoinEqualsOperands.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = MasterJoinEqualsOperands.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!CriteriaOperator.CriterionEquals(MasterJoinEqualsOperands[i].UpOperand, freeQuerySet.MasterJoinEqualsOperands[i].UpOperand) || !CriteriaOperator.CriterionEquals(MasterJoinEqualsOperands[i].Operand, freeQuerySet.MasterJoinEqualsOperands[i].Operand))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public interface ILinqExtendedCriteriaVisitor<T>
	{
		T Visit(MemberInitOperator theOperand);

		T Visit(ExpressionAccessOperator theOperand);

		T Visit(QuerySet theOperand);
	}
	public class MemberInitOperator : CriteriaOperator
	{
		private ConstructorInfo constructor;

		private Type[] cachedSourceTypes;

		[XmlAttribute]
		public string DeclaringTypeAssemblyName;

		[XmlAttribute]
		public string DeclaringTypeName;

		[XmlAttribute]
		public bool UseConstructor;

		[XmlAttribute]
		public bool CreateNewObject;

		public XPMemberAssignmentCollection Members;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static bool EnableUnsafeDeserialization;

		internal static Type GetMemberType(MemberInfo mi)
		{
			return mi.MemberType switch
			{
				MemberTypes.Field => ((FieldInfo)mi).FieldType, 
				MemberTypes.Property => ((PropertyInfo)mi).PropertyType, 
				MemberTypes.Method => ((MethodInfo)mi).ReturnType, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(), 
			};
		}

		private Type GetDeclaringTypeInternal()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(DeclaringTypeAssemblyName))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_TheDeclaringTypeAssemblyNamePropertyIsEmpt"));
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(DeclaringTypeName))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Res.GetString("LinqToXpo_TheDeclaringTypeNamePropertyIsEmpty"));
			}
			return XPTypeActivator.GetType(DeclaringTypeAssemblyName, DeclaringTypeName);
		}

		public Type GetDeclaringType()
		{
			if (constructor == null)
			{
				return GetDeclaringTypeInternal();
			}
			return constructor.DeclaringType;
		}

		private Type GetSourceType(CriteriaTypeResolver resolver, CriteriaOperator prop)
		{
			if (prop is GroupSet)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return resolver.Resolve(prop);
		}

		public Type[] GetSourceTypes(Type type, CriteriaTypeResolver resolver)
		{
			if (cachedSourceTypes == null)
			{
				if (CreateNewObject)
				{
					if (UseConstructor)
					{
						ConstructorInfo constructorInfo = GetConstructor(type);
						ParameterInfo[] parameters = constructorInfo.GetParameters();
						Type[] array = new Type[parameters.Length];
						for (int i = 0; i < parameters.Length; i++)
						{
							array[i] = GetSourceType(resolver, Members[i].Property);
						}
						cachedSourceTypes = array;
					}
					else
					{
						Type[] array2 = new Type[Members.Count];
						for (int j = 0; j < Members.Count; j++)
						{
							array2[j] = GetSourceType(resolver, Members[j].Property);
						}
						cachedSourceTypes = array2;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Type elementType = type.GetElementType();
					Type[] array3 = new Type[Members.Count];
					for (int k = 0; k < array3.Length; k++)
					{
						array3[k] = GetSourceType(resolver, Members[k].Property);
					}
					cachedSourceTypes = array3;
				}
			}
			return cachedSourceTypes;
		}

		public ConstructorInfo GetConstructor(Type type)
		{
			if (constructor == null)
			{
				if (type == null)
				{
					type = GetDeclaringTypeInternal();
					if (type == null)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException("type");
					}
				}
				Type[] array = new Type[UseConstructor ? Members.Count : 0];
				if (UseConstructor)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						MemberInfo member = Members[i].GetMember(type);
						array[i] = GetMemberType(member);
					}
				}
				constructor = type.GetConstructor(array);
			}
			return constructor;
		}

		public MemberInitOperator()
		{
			if (!EnableUnsafeDeserialization)
			{
				throw new SerializationException(Res.GetString("InitOperator_DeserializationProhibitedDueSecurityIssue"));
			}
		}

		public MemberInitOperator(MemberInitOperator source, XPMemberAssignmentCollection newMembers)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("source");
			}
			CreateNewObject = source.CreateNewObject;
			UseConstructor = source.UseConstructor;
			constructor = source.constructor;
			DeclaringTypeAssemblyName = source.DeclaringTypeAssemblyName;
			DeclaringTypeName = source.DeclaringTypeName;
			Members = newMembers;
		}

		public MemberInitOperator(string declaringTypeAssemblyName, string declaringTypeName, XPMemberAssignmentCollection members, bool createNewObject)
		{
			Members = members;
			CreateNewObject = createNewObject;
			DeclaringTypeAssemblyName = declaringTypeAssemblyName;
			DeclaringTypeName = declaringTypeName;
		}

		public MemberInitOperator(Type declaringType, XPMemberAssignmentCollection members, bool createNewObject)
		{
			Members = members;
			CreateNewObject = createNewObject;
			if (declaringType != null)
			{
				DeclaringTypeAssemblyName = declaringType.Assembly.FullName;
				DeclaringTypeName = declaringType.FullName;
			}
		}

		public MemberInitOperator(bool useConstructor, XPMemberAssignmentCollection members, ConstructorInfo constructor)
		{
			Members = members;
			this.constructor = constructor;
			UseConstructor = useConstructor;
			CreateNewObject = true;
			DeclaringTypeAssemblyName = constructor.DeclaringType.Assembly.FullName;
			DeclaringTypeName = constructor.DeclaringType.FullName;
		}

		public bool TryGetSingleQuerySet(out QuerySet set)
		{
			if (TryGetSingleProperty(out var property))
			{
				set = property as QuerySet;
				return set != null;
			}
			set = null;
			return false;
		}

		public bool TryGetSingleProperty(out CriteriaOperator property)
		{
			bool flag = !CreateNewObject && !UseConstructor && Members != null && Members.Count == 1 && Members[0].Property != null;
			property = (flag ? Members[0].Property : null);
			return flag;
		}

		public override void Accept(ICriteriaVisitor visitor)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}

		public override T Accept<T>(ICriteriaVisitor<T> visitor)
		{
			if (!(visitor is ILinqExtendedCriteriaVisitor<T> linqExtendedCriteriaVisitor))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			return linqExtendedCriteriaVisitor.Visit(this);
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator CloneCommon()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = HashCodeHelper.StartGeneric<bool, bool>(UseConstructor, CreateNewObject);
			if (Members != null)
			{
				num = HashCodeHelper.CombineGenericList<XPMemberAssignment>(num, (IList<XPMemberAssignment>)Members);
			}
			return HashCodeHelper.Finish(num);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((object)((object)this).GetType() != obj.GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			MemberInitOperator memberInitOperator = (MemberInitOperator)obj;
			if (UseConstructor != memberInitOperator.UseConstructor || CreateNewObject != memberInitOperator.CreateNewObject)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((UseConstructor && GetConstructor(null) != memberInitOperator.GetConstructor(null)) || DeclaringTypeName != memberInitOperator.DeclaringTypeName)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Members == memberInitOperator.Members)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Members == null || memberInitOperator.Members == null || Members.Count != memberInitOperator.Members.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Members.Count; i++)
			{
				if (Members[i].MemberName != memberInitOperator.Members[i].MemberName || !CriteriaOperator.CriterionEquals(Members[i].Property, memberInitOperator.Members[i].Property))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (CreateNewObject)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				stringBuilder.Append("new ");
				if (!DeclaringTypeName.Contains("<>"))
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(DeclaringTypeName);
					stringBuilder.Append(' ');
				}
				string value;
				if (UseConstructor)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("(");
					value = ")";
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("{ ");
					value = " }";
				}
				if (Members != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < Members.Count; i++)
					{
						XPMemberAssignment xPMemberAssignment = Members[i];
						if (i > 0)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(",  ");
						}
						stringBuilder.Append(xPMemberAssignment.MemberName);
						stringBuilder.Append(" = ");
						stringBuilder.Append((xPMemberAssignment.Property == null) ? "null" : ((object)xPMemberAssignment.Property).ToString());
					}
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(value);
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			if (Members != null && Members.Count != 0)
			{
				if (Members[0].Property != null)
				{
					return ((object)Members[0].Property).ToString();
				}
				return "{ null }";
			}
			return "{ Empty }";
		}

		internal static MemberInitOperator CreateUntypedMemberInitOperator(CriteriaOperator operand)
		{
			return new MemberInitOperator(null, new XPMemberAssignmentCollection
			{
				new XPMemberAssignment(operand)
			}, createNewObject: false);
		}

	public class MemberAccessOperator : RefCompiler
	{
		private static Dictionary<MemberInfo, Func<object, object>> compiledExpressions = new Dictionary<MemberInfo, Func<object, object>>();

		private MemberExpression memberExpression;

		private Func<object, object> expression;

		public override object Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (expression == null)
				{
					expression = GetExpression(memberExpression.Member, memberExpression.Expression.Type);
				}
				return expression((memberExpression == null) ? null : ((ConstantExpression)memberExpression.Expression).Value);
			}
		}

		public MemberAccessOperator(MemberExpression expression)
		{
			memberExpression = expression;
		}

		public MemberAccessOperator()
		{
			expression = GetBaseValue;
		}

		private object GetBaseValue(object value)
		{
			return ((OperandValue)this).Value;
		}

		public static Func<object, object> GetExpression(MemberInfo member, Type t)
		{
			lock (compiledExpressions)
			{
				if (!compiledExpressions.TryGetValue(member, out var value))
				{
					ParameterExpression parameterExpression = Expression.Parameter(typeof(object), "value");
					Expression expression = (t.IsValueType ? Expression.Convert(parameterExpression, member.DeclaringType) : Expression.TypeAs(parameterExpression, member.DeclaringType));
					Expression<Func<object, object>> expression2 = Expression.Lambda<Func<object, object>>(Expression.Convert(Expression.MakeMemberAccess(expression, member), typeof(object)), new ParameterExpression[1] { parameterExpression });
					value = expression2.Compile();
					compiledExpressions.Add(member, value);
				}
				return value;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class DownLevelReprocessor : IClientCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>, ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>
	{
		private Dictionary<JoinOperandInfo, bool> joinOperandList;

		public Dictionary<JoinOperandInfo, bool> JoinOperandList => joinOperandList;

		public static CriteriaOperator Reprocess(CriteriaOperator criteria, out Dictionary<JoinOperandInfo, bool> joinOperandList)
		{
			DownLevelReprocessor downLevelReprocessor = new DownLevelReprocessor();
			CriteriaOperator result = downLevelReprocessor.Process(criteria);
			joinOperandList = downLevelReprocessor.JoinOperandList;
			return result;
		}

		public CriteriaOperator Process(CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			if (criteria == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return criteria.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)this);
		}

		CriteriaOperator IClientCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0078: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0079: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (joinOperandList == null)
			{
				joinOperandList = new Dictionary<JoinOperandInfo, bool>();
			}
			joinOperandList[new JoinOperandInfo(theOperand)] = true;
			if ((int)theOperand.AggregateType != 7)
			{
				return Process(theOperand.AggregatedExpression);
			}
			if (((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands).Count == 1)
			{
				return Process(((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands)[0]);
			}
			JoinOperand val = new JoinOperand(theOperand.JoinTypeName, theOperand.Condition, theOperand.CustomAggregateName, (IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)new CriteriaOperatorCollection());
			ProcessOperands(val.CustomAggregateOperands, theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands);
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)val;
		}

		CriteriaOperator IClientCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		CriteriaOperator IClientCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty("^." + theOperand.PropertyName);
		}

		private void ProcessOperands(CriteriaOperatorCollection newCollection, CriteriaOperatorCollection oldCollection)
		{
			int count = ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)oldCollection).Count;

	internal class ParamExpression
	{
		private string[] names;

		private object[] values;

		private bool used;

		public ParamExpression(string[] names, object[] values)
		{
			this.names = names;
			this.values = values;
		}

		public bool Use()
		{
			bool result = used;
			used = false;
			return result;
		}

		public bool UnUse(bool value)
		{
			bool result = used;
			if (value)
			{
				used = value;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void SetUsed()
		{
			used = true;
		}

		public bool MemeberAccessOperator(MemberExpression expression, out object value)
		{
			int num = Array.IndexOf(names, expression.Member.Name);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				value = null;
				return false;
			}
			value = values[num];
			SetUsed();
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class CachedQueryBase
	{
		private class MemberAccessChecker : ExpressionVisitor
		{
			private string[] names;

			private bool memberAccessed;

			private MemberAccessChecker(string[] names)
			{
				this.names = names;
			}

			protected override Expression VisitMember(MemberExpression node)
			{
				if (Array.IndexOf(names, node.Member.Name) >= 0)
				{
					memberAccessed = true;
				}
				return base.VisitMember(node);
			}

			public static bool HasParameters(Expression e, string[] names)
			{
				MemberAccessChecker memberAccessChecker = new MemberAccessChecker(names);
				memberAccessChecker.Visit(e);
				return memberAccessChecker.memberAccessed;
			}
		}

		private MethodCallExpression nextExpression;

		protected CachedQueryBase next;

		private readonly string[] names;

		private MethodInfo[] converters;

		private Expression[] arguments;

		private static readonly Expression emptyParams;

		private static MethodInfo mi;

		protected void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			nextExpression = (MethodCallExpression)expression;
			converters = new MethodInfo[nextExpression.Arguments.Count];
			for (int i = 1; i < converters.Length; i++)
			{
				converters[i] = mi.MakeGenericMethod(nextExpression.Arguments[i].Type);
			}
			if (!MemberAccessChecker.HasParameters(expression, names))
			{
				arguments = new Expression[nextExpression.Arguments.Count];
				for (int j = 1; j < arguments.Length; j++)
				{
					arguments[j] = Expression.Call(converters[j], nextExpression.Arguments[j], emptyParams);
				}
			}
		}

		private static T GetFirst<T>(T value, ParamExpression param)
		{
			return value;
		}

		static CachedQueryBase()
		{
			emptyParams = Expression.Constant(new ParamExpression(new string[0], new object[0]));
			mi = typeof(CachedQueryBase).GetMethod("GetFirst", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
		}

		public object Process(IQueryable source, params object[] values)
		{
			return Process(source, Expression.Constant(new ParamExpression(names, values)));
		}

		public object Process(IQueryable source)
		{
			return Process(source, (Expression)null);
		}

		protected object Process(IQueryable source, Expression values)
		{
			MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = nextExpression;
			if (methodCallExpression == null)
			{
				return source;
			}
			Expression[] array = new Expression[methodCallExpression.Arguments.Count];
			array[0] = Expression.Constant(source);
			for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = ((arguments == null) ? Expression.Call(converters[i], methodCallExpression.Arguments[i], values) : arguments[i]);
			}
			methodCallExpression = Expression.Call(methodCallExpression.Method, array);
			if (next != null)
			{
				return next.Process(source.Provider, methodCallExpression, values);
			}
			return source.Provider.Execute(methodCallExpression);
		}

		protected abstract object Process(IQueryProvider iQueryProvider, MethodCallExpression e, Expression values);

		protected CachedQueryBase(MethodInfo method)
		{
			ParameterInfo[] parameters = method.GetParameters();
			names = new string[parameters.Length - 1];
			for (int i = 0; i < parameters.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				names[i] = parameters[i + 1].Name;
			}
		}

		protected CachedQueryBase(CachedQueryBase baseQuery)
		{
			names = baseQuery.names;
		}
	}

			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)theOperand.AggregateType == 1 || (int)theOperand.AggregateType == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int)theOperand.AggregateType != 7)
			{
				return Process(theOperand.AggregatedExpression);
			}
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands)
			{
				if (Process(item))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
}
